title: PhoneHarness: Harnessing Phone-Use Agents through Mixed GUI, CLI, and Tool Actions
summary: Phone agents are increasingly expected to complete real mobile workflows rather than merely predict the next screen action. However, much of the current mobile-agent literature still evaluates agents primarily as GUI controllers that observe a screen, emit taps and swipes, and are scored by target app state. Real phone-use tasks are broader: they require deciding when to use app GUIs, device-side commands, or structured tools, while leaving evidence that the intended side effect actually occurred. We introduce PhoneHarness, a mixed-action benchmark and execution harness for studying phone-use agents on verifiable mobile workflows. PhoneHarness runs a device-side agent loop over GUI, CLI, and host-side tool actions, combining deterministic action routing with bounded GUI delegation and auditable execution traces. Its benchmark, PhoneHarness Bench, evaluates whether agents complete tasks with observable side effects, not only whether they produce plausible final answers. On the annotated evaluation split, PhoneHarness reaches a 75.0% pass rate, outperforming the strongest non-PhoneHarness settings by 12.9 percentage points. PhoneHarness and PhoneHarness Bench therefore play distinct but mutually dependent roles: the harness makes mixed phone workflows executable, while the benchmark measures whether agents can use that harness reliably and safely. Our findings suggest that reliable phone automation depends on action-surface routing and verifiable execution, not only visual GUI control.

AI.tldr: PhoneHarness是一个混合动作基准和执行框架，用于研究手机代理在可验证移动工作流上的表现。它通过GUI、CLI和主机端工具动作的结合，实现了75.0%的通过率，比最强非PhoneHarness设置高出12.9个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有手机代理研究大多将代理评估为仅能观察屏幕、执行点击和滑动的GUI控制器，而真实手机任务需要代理决定何时使用应用GUI、设备端命令或结构化工具，并留下可验证的执行证据。因此需要一个能够评估代理在可验证移动工作流上表现的混合动作基准和框架。
AI.method: PhoneHarness运行设备端代理循环，整合GUI、CLI和主机端工具动作，采用确定性动作路由、有界GUI委托和可审计执行轨迹。其基准PhoneHarness Bench评估代理是否能完成具有可观察副作用的任务，而非仅生成合理的最终答案。
AI.result: 在注释评估集上，PhoneHarness达到75.0%的通过率，比最强非PhoneHarness设置高出12.9个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的手机自动化不仅依赖于视觉GUI控制，还依赖于动作表面路由和可验证执行。PhoneHarness和PhoneHarness Bench扮演不同但相互依赖的角色：框架使混合手机工作流可执行，基准衡量代理能否可靠且安全地使用该框架。

title: Evaluating the Robustness of Proof Autoformalization in Lean 4
summary: Proof autoformalization aims to translate a mathematical informal proof written in natural language into a formal proof in a formal language such as Lean~4. Several works have developed LLM-based models for proof autoformalization. However, existing evaluations have typically focused on translating well-formed informal proofs from curated datasets. We argue that a robust proof autoformalizer must remain faithful even for informal proofs that diverge from these idealized ones, and we present the first study on the robustness of proof autoformalization models. We formulate two categories of perturbations and evaluate robustness under each: a global perturbation paraphrases the informal proof in a different style, under which the formalization should remain consistent; a local perturbation alters a value, symbol, or proof step, possibly in a counterfactual way, and a robust formalization should faithfully reflect the perturbation rather than reverting to the original one or inferring a different one on its own. We build a benchmark with both perturbations on miniF2F and MATH-500, and automatically measure how stable a proof autoformalization's correctness is under global perturbations and how faithfully its output reflects local perturbations. We evaluate seven recent models, all of which are sensitive to global perturbations and mostly fail to remain faithful under local perturbations. Code and data are available via https://github.com/ucr-rai/robust-proof-autoformalization.

AI.tldr: 本文首次针对证明自动形式化模型的鲁棒性进行系统研究，提出了全局扰动（改写风格）和局部扰动（修改数值、符号或证明步骤）两类评估方法，在miniF2F和MATH-500上构建基准测试，评估了七个最新模型，发现所有模型对全局扰动敏感，且大多数在局部扰动下无法保持忠实性。
AI.motivation: 现有证明自动形式化评估仅关注从精心整理的数据集中翻译形式良好的非正式证明，但实际应用中非正式证明可能存在偏离理想情况的问题，因此需要评估模型的鲁棒性，即面对偏离理想情况的非正式证明时仍能保持忠实。
AI.method: 提出两类扰动：1) 全局扰动——以不同风格改写非正式证明，形式化结果应保持一致；2) 局部扰动——反事实地修改值、符号或证明步骤，形式化输出应忠实反映扰动而非恢复原结果。在miniF2F和MATH-500上构建基准，自动测量全局扰动下的正确性稳定性和局部扰动下的忠实性。
AI.result: 评估了七个最新模型，所有模型均对全局扰动敏感，且大部分在局部扰动下无法保持忠实。
AI.conclusion: 现有证明自动形式化模型在鲁棒性方面存在明显不足，需要进一步改进以应对非理想情况下的非正式证明。

title: Context Compression Is Not One Thing: Readable Symbolic Re-expression vs. Coherent Summary at Matched Budget
summary: We study context compression for multi-hop question answering with small language models. We propose Telegraph English, a readable symbolic format that rewrites retrieved passages into structured entity-relation statements, preserving reasoning evidence at lower token cost. In controlled experiments on MuSiQue, TwoWiki, and HotpotQA, Telegraph English outperforms three matched-budget compression baselines (character-level deletion, truncation, and random sub-sampling) on every dataset, with gains of 13 to 20 F1 percentage point. It also outperforms a coherent prose summary produced by the same encoder on the hardest dataset. A pre-registered depth-interaction hypothesis is null: the advantage does not grow with reasoning depth within datasets. We interpret these results as evidence that readable symbolic re-expression preserves entity content more densely than either natural language or coherent summarization at matched token budget.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为"Telegraph English"的可读符号格式，用于压缩多跳问答中的检索段落。该方法将段落重写为结构化的实体-关系陈述，在更低的token成本下保留推理证据。实验表明，在MuSiQue、TwoWiki和HotpotQA三个数据集上，该方法在匹配预算的压缩基线中全面领先，F1提升13-20个百分点。预先注册的深度交互假设未获支持：优势并不随推理深度增长。
AI.motivation: 研究小语言模型在多跳问答中的上下文压缩问题，探索如何在有限token预算下更有效地保留推理所需的关键证据。
AI.method: 提出Telegraph English——一种可读符号格式，将检索到的段落重写为结构化的实体-关系陈述，以更低的token成本保留推理证据。
AI.result: 在MuSiQue、TwoWiki和HotpotQA三个数据集上，Telegraph English对比三种匹配预算的压缩基线（字符级删除、截断、随机子采样）均取得显著优势，F1提升13-20个百分点。在最难的数据集上，还优于相同编码器生成的连贯散文摘要。但预先注册的深度交互假设不成立，优势不随推理深度增长。
AI.conclusion: 可读符号重新表达在匹配token预算下，比自然语言或连贯摘要更密集地保留了实体内容，从而带来更好的问答性能。

title: Simplifying the Modeling of Arbitrary Conditionals in Natural Language
summary: Causal Transformers model sequences through an autoregressive factorization of the joint distribution, which enables efficient left-to-right decoding and conditional likelihood computation. However, they cannot tractably sample from or evaluate arbitrary conditionals -- e.g., a block of text conditioned on past and future tokens. Recent work aims to solve this problem through novel architectures, but they often lead to sub-optimal modeling of such conditionals and degraded generations. We propose Arbitrary Conditionals GPT (AC-GPT) which introduces a simple modification to standard causal Transformers to enable evaluating and sampling from arbitrary conditionals -- including past, future, and mixed contexts -- within a single forward pass. Unlike prior approaches, our method preserves the standard left-to-right ordering and next-token prediction objective essential for both strong performance and efficient training on natural language. Crucially, this compatibility allows existing LLMs to be fine-tuned for arbitrary conditioning. Our empirical results indicate that our method outperforms baselines on modeling arbitrary conditionals, without degrading standard left-to-right performance.

AI.tldr: AC-GPT通过对标准因果Transformer进行简单修改，使其能够在单次前向传播中评估和采样任意条件（包括过去、未来和混合上下文），同时保持从左到右的排序和下一个词预测目标，支持从现有LLM微调，且不降低标准性能。
AI.motivation: 标准因果Transformer无法高效地对任意条件（如同时依赖过去和未来token的文本块）进行采样或评估，现有方法通过新颖架构解决此问题但往往导致条件建模次优和生成质量下降。
AI.method: 提出AC-GPT，对标准因果Transformer进行简单修改，使其在保持从左到右排序和下一个词预测目标的前提下，支持在单次前向传播中评估和采样任意条件（包括过去、未来和混合上下文）。
AI.result: AC-GPT在建模任意条件任务上优于基线方法，且不降低标准从左到右的生成性能。
AI.conclusion: AC-GPT兼容现有LLM微调，能够在保持强性能和高效训练的同时，有效解决因果Transformer在任意条件建模上的局限性。

title: QPILOTS: Efficient Test-Time Q-Steering for Flow Policies
summary: Flow-matching and diffusion policies are expressive action generators, but optimizing them with temporal-difference reinforcement learning (RL) remains difficult. Effective policy extraction requires exploiting the critic's action gradient, yet directly backpropagating this signal through a multi-step denoising process can be numerically unstable. Existing methods work around this either by discarding gradient information, distilling the policy into a simpler one-step actor, or repeatedly fine-tuning the denoising policy as the critic improves. We propose QPILOTS, a method that leaves the original policy unmodified and steers the denoising process at inference time. At each denoising step, instead of evaluating the critic on the noisy intermediate action where critic predictions are unreliable, we first project that intermediate state to an estimate of the final clean action and compute the critic gradient there. We introduce two variants: QPILOTS-U uses a fast single-point approximation, while QPILOTS-M draws differentiable posterior samples via a learned auxiliary network. On a standard offline-to-online RL benchmark, QPILOTS achieves the best aggregate performance, reaching an average success rate of 90% across 50 tasks. We also apply QPILOTS to steer a large, frozen, pretrained Vision-Language Action (VLA) foundation model, outperforming or matching prior inference-time approaches across six manipulation tasks in simulation.

AI.tldr: QPILOTS是一种无需修改原始扩散/流匹配策略模型，通过在推理时利用评论家梯度引导去噪过程的方法，解决了TD-RL优化这类生成式动作策略的困难。在离线到在线RL基准测试中，QPILOTS在50个任务上平均成功率达90%，并成功应用于冻结的VLA基础模型，在6个操作任务中优于或匹配现有推理时方法。
AI.motivation: 流匹配和扩散策略是表达能力强的动作生成器，但使用时序差分强化学习优化它们仍然困难。现有方法要么丢弃梯度信息，要么将策略蒸馏为简单的单步actor，要么在评论家改进时重复微调去噪策略，缺乏一种既能利用评论家梯度又保持数值稳定性且不修改原始策略的方法。
AI.method: 提出QPILOTS方法，在推理时引导去噪过程，不修改原始策略。在每个去噪步骤中，先将带噪中间状态投影到最终干净动作的估计值，再在该投影上计算评论家梯度，从而避免在不可靠的带噪中间动作上直接评估评论家。包含两种变体：QPILOTS-U使用快速单点近似；QPILOTS-M通过学习的辅助网络绘制可微的后验样本。
AI.result: 在标准离线到在线RL基准测试中，QPILOTS在50个任务上实现了90%的平均成功率，综合性能最佳。应用于冻结的预训练VLA基础模型时，在6个模拟操作任务上优于或匹配现有推理时方法。
AI.conclusion: QPILOTS提供了一种无需修改策略模型即可利用评论家梯度引导去噪推理的有效范式，在多个基准上取得了最优性能，并且适用于大规模VLA基础模型，具有良好的通用性和实用性。

title: A Definition of Good Explanations and the Challenges Explaining LLM Outputs
summary: How to define a good explanation is a long-standing philosophical debate which has found recent renewed interest in the context of AI outputs. Explainability is crucial for AI adoption in many contexts, but in order to produce good explanations of AI systems, we must first have an understanding of what good explanations are. In this paper we propose a definition inspired by the notion of counterfactual explanations, however we argue that one must also take into account the interlocutor's prior beliefs in each fact that could be offered in an explanation. We explore the ramifications of this definition for AI explainability and, in particular, why LLM outputs are difficult to produce good explanations for.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于反事实解释且考虑 interlocutor 先验信念的解释定义，并探讨了该定义对 AI 可解释性的影响，特别是 LLM 输出难以产生良好解释的原因。
AI.motivation: 好的解释定义是哲学长期争论的问题，在 AI 输出可解释性背景下重新受到关注。为了让 AI 系统产生好的解释，首先必须理解什么是好的解释。
AI.method: 受反事实解释概念启发，提出新的解释定义，强调必须考虑 interlocutor 对每个可能被纳入解释的事实的先验信念。
AI.result: 该定义对 AI 可解释性有重要影响，特别揭示了 LLM 输出难以产生良好解释的根本原因。
AI.conclusion: 好的解释不仅需要反事实推理，还需要建模理解对象的先验信念，LLM 的黑箱性质与此存在根本性冲突。

title: CoRA: Confidence-Rationale Alignment for Reliable Chain-of-Thought Reasoning
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning can improve LLM performance, but high answer confidence may be misleading when the accompanying CoT rationale is plausible yet incomplete or poorly supported. We study confidence--rationale alignment: whether a model's confidence in its committed answer is justified by its generated rationale. We introduce a GRPO-based reinforcement learning framework that jointly rewards answer correctness, committed-answer probability, and rubric-based rationale support, where the rubric assesses grounding, coherence, task match, and connection to the selected answer without revealing the gold answer to the judge. Across MedQA, MathQA, and OpenBookQA using three open-weight LLMs, our method reduces the confidence--rationale alignment error by up to 26.51% compared with untuned checkpoints, SFT, and correctness-only GRPO, while maintaining competitive accuracy and often improving calibration. These results show that reliable CoT reasoning requires not only confident answers, but rationales that substantively support them.

AI.tldr: 提出基于GRPO的强化学习框架，通过联合奖励答案正确性、承诺答案概率和基于评分标准的推理支持，来提升LLM推理中置信度与推理过程的对齐，在MedQA、MathQA和OpenBookQA上使对齐误差降低最高26.51%。
AI.motivation: CoT推理中模型对答案的高置信度可能具有误导性，因为伴随的推理过程虽然看似合理但不完整或缺乏充分支持，现有方法未有效对齐置信度与推理过程。
AI.method: 采用GRPO强化学习框架，联合优化三个奖励信号：答案正确性、承诺答案概率、以及基于评分标准的推理支持度（评分标准评估推理的 grounding、连贯性、任务匹配度以及与所选答案的关联性，且不向评判者暴露标准答案）。
AI.result: 在MedQA、MathQA和OpenBookQA上使用三个开源LLM，相比未调优的基线、SFT和仅优化正确性的GRPO，置信度-推理对齐误差降低最多26.51%，同时保持竞争性准确率并改善校准效果。
AI.conclusion: 可靠的CoT推理不仅需要高置信度的答案，还需要推理过程实质性地支持该答案。

title: GRAPE: Guided Parameter-Space Evolution for Compact Adversarial Robustness
summary:
Adversarial Training (AT) improves neural network robustness, but most methods train a fixed parameter space from the start. This paper asks whether the order in which parameters become optimizable can affect the final robust solution, even when the final architecture or computation budget is controlled.
  We propose GRAPE, Guided Parameter-Space Evolution, a training framework for compact adversarial robustness. GRAPE combines parameter-space stabilization with progressive hidden expansion: it stabilizes robust optimization in the currently exposed space, gradually releases new optimizable dimensions, and uses an adversarial spectral utilization score to guide newly released capacity toward high-pressure modules. In contrast to fixed-structure AT, GRAPE treats robust model learning as a process of progressive parameter-space exposure and evolution.
  Under the standard $\ell_\infty$ threat model on CIFAR-10, with fixed-structure ResNet-18 AT as a controlled reference, GRAPE improves PGD-20 robust accuracy from 51.70% to 56.94% at a nearly matched computation budget with a FLOPs ratio of 1.009x, while reducing parameter count by about 21.4%. A sequential grow variant with the same final ResNet-18 architecture reaches 56.52% PGD-20 robust accuracy, indicating that the gain is not only due to final architecture differences but also to the parameter-space exposure path. These results suggest that guided parameter-space evolution can yield compact and robust parameter configurations under matched computation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出GRAPE（引导式参数空间演化）框架，通过逐步暴露参数空间并利用对抗频谱利用分数引导容量分配，在固定计算预算下显著提升紧凑型网络的鲁棒性。在CIFAR-10的ℓ∞威胁模型下，相比固定结构的ResNet-18对抗训练，GRAPE在计算量基本持平（FLOPs比1.009x）且参数量减少21.4%的情况下，将PGD-20鲁棒准确率从51.70%提升至56.94%。
AI.motivation: 探究参数的可优化顺序是否会影响最终鲁棒解的质量，即使最终架构或计算预算被控制。现有对抗训练方法通常从一开始就训练固定参数空间，忽视了参数暴露路径对鲁棒性的潜在影响。
AI.method: 提出GRAPE框架，包含两个核心机制：（1）参数空间稳定化——在当前暴露空间中稳定鲁棒优化；（2）渐进式隐藏扩展——逐步释放新的可优化维度，并利用对抗频谱利用分数引导新释放的容量优先分配给高压力模块。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10的ℓ∞威胁模型下，以固定结构ResNet-18 AT为对照基准，GRAPE在计算量基本匹配（FLOPs比1.009x）且参数量减少约21.4%的情况下，PGD-20鲁棒准确率从51.70%提升至56.94%。顺序增长变体在相同最终架构下达到56.52%，表明增益不仅来自架构差异，还来自参数空间暴露路径。
AI.conclusion: 引导式参数空间演化能够在匹配计算预算的条件下，生成紧凑且鲁棒的参数配置，参数的可优化顺序是影响最终鲁棒性的重要因素。

title: Dr-DCI: Scaling Direct Corpus Interaction via Dynamic Workspace Expansion
summary: Agentic search over large corpora relies on retriever-mediated interfaces (e.g., BM25 or ColBERT) for scalable candidate discovery. While effective at ranking relevant documents, these interfaces expose evidence only as ranked results or bounded document views, limiting agents' ability to reorganize material and verify constraints across documents. Direct Corpus Interaction (DCI) addresses this limitation by exposing shell-executable corpus operations for flexible search, filtering, comparison, and verification. However, full-corpus terminal commands become slow and unstable as the corpus grows, degrading performance and efficiency. We introduce DR-DCI, a retriever-steered DCI framework that treats retrieval as an agent-callable action for expanding a local workspace. Rather than operating directly over the full corpus, the agent dynamically pulls relevant documents into an evolving workspace and conducts DCI operations within it. This design combines retriever-level recall with DCI-style precision: retrieval keeps exploration scalable, while DCI preserves the local operations needed for effective evidence resolution. Experiments show that DR-DCI is both effective and efficient across scales. On Browsecomp-Plus, DR-DCI reaches 71.2\% accuracy, improving over raw DCI and ablated variants by up to 8.3 points while reducing tool usage, wall time, and estimated cost. With workspace-preserving context reset, accuracy further improves to 73.3\%. In corpus-scaling experiments, DR-DCI remains effective from 100K to 10M documents, whereas raw DCI becomes unstable and BM25 performs substantially worse. DR-DCI also scales to a 20M-scale file-per-document Wiki-18 QA setting, achieving an average score of 63.0 across six benchmarks and outperforming retrieval-based and trained search-agent baselines. Ablation analysis further shows that ranked previews and inter-document DCI are key to performance.

AI.tldr: DR-DCI将检索器作为智能体可调用的动作，动态地将相关文档拉入工作空间进行DCI操作，从而在保持可扩展性的同时实现精确的证据解析。在BrowseComp-Plus上达到71.2%准确率，比原始DCI提升8.3个点，并有效扩展到20M文档规模。
AI.motivation: 传统检索器（如BM25、ColBERT）以排序列表或有界视图暴露证据，限制了智能体重组材料和跨文档验证约束的能力。直接语料交互（DCI）虽提供灵活操作，但全语料终端命令随规模增长变得缓慢且不稳定。
AI.method: DR-DCI将检索视为智能体可调用的动作，用于扩展局部工作空间。智能体动态地从完整语料库中抽取相关文档到演化的工作空间中，并在该空间内执行DCI操作。结合了检索级别的召回（可扩展性）和DCI级别的精度（局部操作）。
AI.result: BrowseComp-Plus上准确率71.2%，比原始DCI提升8.3点，同时减少工具使用、墙壁时间和估计成本。工作空间保持上下文重置后准确率达73.3%。从10万到1000万文档保持有效，而原始DCI不稳定、BM25性能大幅下降。在2000万规模Wiki-18 QA上平均得分63.0，超越检索基线和训练搜索智能体基线。
AI.conclusion: DR-DCI通过检索器引导的动态工作空间机制，有效结合了检索的可扩展性与DCI的精确操作能力，实现了跨规模的有效性和效率提升。消融实验表明排序预览和文档间DCI是性能的关键因素。

title: Nemotron 3 Ultra: Open, Efficient Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Transformer Model for Agentic Reasoning
summary: We introduce Nemotron 3 Ultra, a 550 billion total and 55 billion active parameter Mixture-of-Experts Hybrid Mamba-Attention language model. We pre-trained Nemotron 3 Ultra on 20 trillion text tokens, then extended the context length to 1M tokens, and post-trained using Supervised Fine Tuning (SFT), Reinforcement Learning (RL), and Multi-teacher On-Policy Distillation (MOPD). Nemotron 3 Ultra is our most capable model yet, employing multiple key technologies - LatentMoE, Multi Token Prediction (MTP), NVFP4 pre-training, multi-environment RLVR, MOPD, and reasoning budget control. Nemotron 3 Ultra achieves up to ~6x higher inference throughput as compared to state-of-the-art publicly available LLMs while attaining on-par accuracy. The state-of-the-art accuracy, high inference throughput, and 1M token context length make Nemotron 3 Ultra ideal for long-running autonomous agentic tasks. We open-source the base, post-trained, and quantized checkpoints, along with the training data and recipe on HuggingFace.

AI.tldr: Nemotron 3 Ultra 是一个5500亿总参数、55亿活跃参数的混合专家（MoE）Hybrid Mamba-Attention语言模型，在20万亿文本 token 上预训练，支持100万 token 上下文，通过SFT、RL和多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）后训练，达到与公开SOTA LLM相当的精度，但推理吞吐量提升约6倍，适合长时间自主智能体任务，并开源了模型权重、训练数据和配方。
AI.motivation: 构建一个在推理效率（吞吐量提升约6倍）与准确性之间取得更好平衡的大语言模型，同时支持超长上下文（100万 token），以满足长时间运行的自主智能体任务需求。
AI.method: 采用Mixture-of-Experts架构结合Hybrid Mamba-Attention机制，总参数550B/活跃参数55B；预训练20万亿文本 token；扩展上下文至100万 token；后训练包括SFT、强化学习（RL）以及多教师在线蒸馏（MOPD）；关键技术包括LatentMoE、多 token 预测（MTP）、NVFP4预训练、多环境RLVR、MOPD和推理预算控制。
AI.result: 相比公开SOTA LLM，Nemotron 3 Ultra在保持同等精度的同时，推理吞吐量提升约6倍，支持100万 token 上下文长度。
AI.conclusion: Nemotron 3 Ultra在准确率、高推理吞吐量和超长上下文方面表现出色，非常适合长时间运行的自主智能体任务，并已开源全部模型、训练数据和配方。

title: α-Fair Insurance Pricing: A Fairness Continuum
summary: Fairness in insurance pricing remains a long-standing and deeply debated puzzle. On one hand, insurers, driven by profitability considerations, set premiums that differentiate across individual risks to achieve actuarial fairness. On the other hand, insurance serves a critical societal function by pooling risks across a population, motivating cross-subsidization among groups to promote solidarity fairness. The tension between these two competing notions of fairness makes insurance pricing inherently complex, particularly in modern settings where granular data allow for increasingly fine risk differentiation and regulators face growing pressure to protect vulnerable groups. To address this challenge, we propose an $α$-\textbf{F}air \textbf{I}ndividual \textbf{S}olvent \textbf{P}remium ($α$-FISP) framework for insurance pricing that explicitly captures the trade-off between actuarial and solidarity fairness while guaranteeing solvency, a fundamental requirement in insurance operations. We formulate the pricing problem as a constrained optimization task, where actuarially fair premiums are adjusted subject to budget constraints on cross-subsidization within each risk class. This formulation naturally yields a family of solutions parameterized by $α$, tracing a continuum between purely actuarial and purely solidarity-based pricing and enabling decision-makers to select an operating point along this fairness spectrum. We derive theoretical guarantees for the proposed framework. Numerical experiments show that $α$-FISP is computationally tractable and aligns well with the U.S. regulatory regimes featuring heterogeneous state-level fairness requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出α-FISP框架，通过约束优化建模保险定价中精算公平与社会团结公平之间的权衡，并保证偿付能力，参数α可连续调节两种公平的权重。
AI.motivation: 保险定价中长期存在精算公平（按个体风险差异化定价）与社会团结公平（风险共担与交叉补贴）之间的根本性矛盾，尤其在细粒度数据使风险区分更精细、监管要求保护弱势群体的背景下，亟需一个能显式建模这一权衡同时保证偿付能力的定价框架。
AI.method: 将保险定价建模为带预算约束的优化问题，在各风险类别内部的交叉补贴约束下调整精算公平保费；通过参数α∈[0,1]生成从纯精算公平到纯团结公平的连续解族。
AI.result: 理论层面推导了框架的保证性质；数值实验表明α-FISP计算可处理，且能很好地适应美国各州不同公平要求的混合监管环境。
AI.conclusion: α-FISP为监管者和保险公司提供了一个灵活、可计算且理论上稳健的工具，可在精算公平与团结公平之间选择理想的操作点，同时满足偿付能力约束。

title: Relational Structural Causal Models
comment: Proceedings of the Forty-Third International Conference on Machine Learning
summary: An artificial intelligence must have a model of its environment that is causal, supporting reasoning about interventions and counterfactuals, and also combinatorial, supporting generalization to unseen combinations of objects. In this work, we formally study when and how such a model can be learned. We develop relational structural causal models, extending structural causal models (Pearl 2009) to settings where objects and their relations vary. First, we show how answers to not only causal but also observational queries about unseen combinations of objects can not be identified without further assumptions. To enable such identification--including in the presence of unobserved confounding--we define relational causal graphs and derive symbolic identification criteria. Finally, we propose relational neural causal models, a provably correct approach that outperforms non-relational baselines on simulated traffic scenes with varying cars, signals, and pedestrians.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了关系结构因果模型（RSCM），将结构因果模型扩展到对象及其关系可变的场景，并证明了在无额外假设的情况下，无法识别关于未见对象组合的因果和观察查询。通过定义关系因果图并推导符号识别标准，作者提出了一种关系神经因果模型，在模拟交通场景中优于非关系基线方法。
AI.motivation: 人工智能系统需要具备因果性（支持干预和反事实推理）和组合性（泛化到未见过的对象组合）的环境模型。现有因果模型无法处理对象及其关系动态变化的场景，因此需要一种能将因果推理与关系组合泛化相结合的形式化框架。
AI.method: 首先定义关系结构因果模型（RSCM），扩展标准SCM以支持可变的对象和关系；然后定义关系因果图，并推导出符号识别标准，用于在存在未观测混杂的情况下识别因果和观测查询；最后提出关系神经因果模型（RNCM）作为可证明正确的实现方法。
AI.result: 理论结果表明，对未见对象组合的因果和观测查询在无额外假设下不可识别；所提出的关系因果图及符号识别标准可在存在未观测混杂时实现识别；关系神经因果模型在模拟交通场景（包含变化的车辆、信号灯和行人）中显著优于非关系基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 成功构建了兼具因果性和组合性的环境模型框架，为AI系统在动态关系场景下的因果推理提供了理论基础和可行的实现方案。

title: Are Online Skill and Memory Modules Always Worth Their Tokens? A Budget-Constrained Study of Web Agents
summary: Online web agents often augment a base actor with memory, workflow, or skill modules. These modules can improve performance, but they also consume test-time tokens, a cost rarely reported alongside the actor's inference cost. We study online augmentation, where this overhead is paid on every task, and re-evaluate its benefits under a fixed total inference budget. We compare AWM, ASI, and ReasoningBank with a token-matched vanilla baseline that uses the same budget for additional actor steps. Across three WebArena domains and three models, Gemini 3 Flash, GPT-5.4-mini, and Qwen 3.6-27B, the vanilla baseline matches or surpasses all three augmentation methods in aggregate success rate while often using fewer total tokens. We observe a similar trend on WorkArena-L1 with Qwen 3.6-27B, indicating that the effect extends to enterprise knowledge-work tasks. Our results suggest that skills and workflow memory can be useful in specific domains, but their apparent gains often vanish against a budget-matched actor. We further show that run-to-run variance materially affects outcomes and should be reported as a core evaluation criterion for online web agents.

AI.tldr: 在固定推理预算下，基础在线Web智能体通过增加自身推理步数，在成功率上匹配或超越使用记忆、工作流或技能模块的增强方法，且消耗更少token。增强方法的表面增益在预算匹配后消失，运行方差应作为核心评估指标。
AI.motivation: 现有在线Web智能体常通过引入记忆、工作流、技能等模块来提升性能，但这些模块会消耗额外的测试时token。这些成本很少被报告，因此本文旨在重新评估这些增强方法在**固定推理预算**下的真实收益。
AI.method: 在固定总推理预算下，将AWM、ASI、ReasoningBank三种增强方法与一个token数量匹配的vanilla基线（使用相同预算进行更多actor推理步数）进行比较。在WebArena（三个领域）上用Gemini 3 Flash、GPT-5.4-mini、Qwen 3.6-27B三个模型以及WorkArena-L1上用Qwen 3.6-27B进行实验。
AI.result: 在聚合成功率上，token匹配的vanilla基线在所有设定下匹配或超越了三种增强方法，且通常使用更少的总token。在WorkArena-L1上也观察到类似趋势。技能和工作流记忆在特定领域有用，但表面增益在预算匹配后消失。运行间方差对结果有实质性影响。
AI.conclusion: 在线Web智能体的增强方法（记忆、工作流、技能模块）在固定推理预算下的优势消失，vanilla基线通过增加actor自身步数即可达到相同或更好效果。研究建议将运行方差作为在线Web智能体的核心评估指标进行报告。

title: GRASP: Gradient-Aligned Sequential Parameter Transfer for Memory-Efficient Multi-Source Learning
summary: Multi-source transfer learning faces a fundamental scalability bottleneck: existing approaches require either loading all K source models into memory simultaneously during parameter fusion, requiring O(K) memory, or deploying all models at inference time, making production deployment infeasible. We propose GRASP (Gradient-Aligned Sequential Parameter Transfer), which achieves superior knowledge integration while maintaining O(1) memory consumption through three key innovations: (1) sequential processing that merges one source at a time into an evolving target model, (2) parameter-wise gradient alignment that selectively transfers only parameters whose optimization directions align with the target domain, avoiding negative transfer, and (3) iterative fine-tuning that adapts transferred knowledge before integrating the next source. Extensive experiments across three continual learning benchmarks (Yearbook, CLEAR-10, CLEAR-100) spanning 10 to 108-year temporal distribution shifts and four architectures (1.3M to 25.6M parameters) demonstrate that GRASP achieves 93.5% mean accuracy over all datasets and architectures compared to ensemble method's 71.7% accuracy while requiring only constant memory versus K models for standard multi-source fusion. Critically, GRASP's sequential previously merged models and scales to arbitrarily many sources without memory growth, making it uniquely suitable for resource-constrained deployment and continually evolving source domains.

AI.tldr: 提出GRASP框架，通过顺序处理、参数级梯度对齐和迭代微调三大创新，在多源迁移学习中实现O(1)内存消耗的持续学习，在多个基准测试中达到93.5%的平均准确率，显著优于集成方法的71.7%。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模多源迁移学习方法面临可扩展性瓶颈：参数融合时需要同时加载所有K个源模型，内存开销为O(K)；或在推理时部署所有模型，导致生产部署不可行。亟需一种内存高效且知识整合能力强的多源迁移学习方案。
AI.method: (1) 顺序处理：每次仅将一个源模型合并到动态演化的目标模型中；(2) 参数级梯度对齐：仅选择优化方向与目标域对齐的参数进行迁移，避免负迁移；(3) 迭代微调：在整合下一个源模型前，先对已迁移的知识进行适应调整。
AI.result: 在Yearbook、CLEAR-10、CLEAR-100三个持续学习基准测试和四种架构（1.3M-25.6M参数）上，GRASP达到93.5%平均准确率，远超集成方法的71.7%，且内存消耗恒定为O(1)，与源模型数量无关。
AI.conclusion: GRASP的顺序处理机制使其能够扩展到任意数量的源模型而不增加内存消耗，特别适用于资源受限部署和持续演化的源域场景，解决了多源迁移学习的可扩展性瓶颈。

title: Trust Between AI Agents: Measuring Formation, Breakage, and Recovery, with Implications for Governing Multi-Agent Systems
summary: As language-model agents increasingly work in teams, each agent must decide how much to trust its teammates. Yet we lack a standard way to measure trust between AI agents. We propose a behavioral measure based on costly verification. In a cooperative survival game, checking a teammate's work consumes resources, while trusting a wrong answer can be fatal. Relative to a memoryless version of the same model, reduced verification provides an observable measure of trust. Using this framework, we study trust formation, breakage, and recovery across six frontier model snapshots. When paired with a consistently reliable teammate, four snapshots (Claude Opus 4.6, Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-5.1, and Gemini 3.1 Pro) reduce verification by roughly 60-85%, whereas two smaller snapshots show little or no such adjustment. Failures reverse this discount, but models differ in how they respond. Some concentrate renewed scrutiny on the culprit, while others become more cautious toward the entire team. Recovery is slower than formation, and clustered failures sustain suspicion far longer than the same number of failures spread apart. These differences have practical consequences. Models that form trust verify less, decide more quickly, and achieve higher payoffs in our environment. By contrast, persistent over-verification is associated with indecision rather than safety. Our results show that trust dispositions can be measured before deployment and suggest that calibration, rather than maximal suspicion, should be the central concern in the governance of multi-agent AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于代价性验证的行为度量方法来衡量AI智能体之间的信任，并通过合作生存游戏实验，研究了六种前沿模型在信任形成、破裂与恢复方面的表现差异。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统中，智能体需要决定信任队友的程度，但目前缺乏统一的信任度量标准。
AI.method: 提出基于代价性验证的行为度量方法：在合作生存游戏中，检查队友工作消耗资源，信任错误答案可能致命。通过减少验证行为来量化信任。
AI.result: 四个较大模型（Claude Opus 4.6等）面对可靠队友时验证减少约60-85%；两个较小模型几乎无调整。信任破裂后恢复慢于形成，且模型对失败的反应策略不同（集中审查罪魁祸首或对整个团队更谨慎）。
AI.conclusion: 信任倾向可以在部署前测量，多智能体AI系统治理的核心关切应是信任校准而非最大程度的怀疑。

title: Deep Temporal Modeling and Ensemble Fusion for Multimodal Emotion Recognition from Physiological Signals
comment: Accepted for publication in the 17th ACM International Conference on Bioinformatics, Computational Biology and Health Informatics (ACM BCB 2026). DOI: https://doi.org/10.1145/3807503.3819363
summary: Physiological stress and emotion recognition are important for health monitoring and affective computing. In this work, we present a comprehensive evaluation of deep learning models such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM), Temporal Convolutional Networks (TCN), and Transformer on the WESAD dataset for multimodal affect recognition using wrist and chest sensor signals. We perform ablation studies to assess the individual contributions of each modality by training models on wrist-only and chest-only inputs. In addition, we implement a late-fusion ensemble strategy that combines predictions from all three architectures trained on multimodal input. We also employ early fusion at the sensor level by concatenating wrist and chest signals before feeding them into each model. Our results show that Transformer models consistently achieve the highest accuracy in multimodal settings, while TCN models perform best in the wrist-only configuration. The ensemble method yields the highest overall accuracy (98.91 +/- 0.13%) and macro-F1 score (98.56 +/- 0.17%). These findings demonstrate the effectiveness of sensor fusion and ensemble-based fusion in developing robust systems for physiological emotion recognition.

AI.tldr: 该论文对LSTM、TCN和Transformer三种深度学习模型在WESAD数据集上进行多模态情感识别评估，通过消融实验、早期融合和晚期融合策略，发现集成方法在腕部和胸部传感器信号融合中达到最高准确率（98.91%）和宏F1分数（98.56%），证明了传感器融合和集成融合在生理情绪识别中的有效性。
AI.motivation: 生理压力和情绪识别对健康监测和情感计算具有重要意义，现有研究缺乏对多种深度学习模型在多模态生理信号上的系统性比较和融合策略评估。
AI.method: 使用WESAD数据集中的腕部和胸部传感器信号，分别训练LSTM、TCN和Transformer三种深度学习模型；进行消融实验分析单个模态贡献；实施早期融合（传感器级信号拼接）和晚期融合（集成三个架构的预测结果）策略。
AI.result: Transformer在多模态设置下准确率最高，TCN在仅使用腕部信号时表现最佳；集成方法达到最高总体准确率（98.91±0.13%）和宏F1分数（98.56±0.17%）。
AI.conclusion: 传感器融合和基于集成的融合策略能有效提升生理情绪识别系统的鲁棒性和性能。

title: Policy Regret for Embedding Model Routing: Contextual Bandits with Low-Rank Experts
summary: Modern recommendation systems increasingly rely on dynamically routing diverse queries to multiple embedding models. Despite its practical significance, this problem remains poorly understood under realistic conditions like adversarial queries, bandit feedback, and limited observability of models. We formalize embedding model routing as an adversarial contextual linear bandit with low-rank experts, where contexts are queries, actions are items, and experts are the embedding models working on low-rank latent representation spaces. We first establish that standard regret notions suffer from structural misspecification or statistical intractability, and we identify a log-quadratic policy class that is expressive enough to capture query-dependent model routing, yet structured enough to allow efficient online learning. Second, we propose a policy gradient algorithm called Hypentropy Policy Gradient (HPG). It provably adapts to the unknown low-rank structure under incomplete information and attains $\tilde{\mathcal O}(s\sqrt{M T})$ linearized policy regret -- where $s, M$, and $T$ are the intrinsic rank of the experts, the number of models, and the number of rounds -- thus avoiding a curse of dimensionality. Finally, we also provide an computationally efficient and parameter-free implementation of HPG.

AI.tldr: 本文形式化地将嵌入模型路由问题建模为具有低秩专家的对抗性上下文线性赌博机，并提出了一种名为Hypentropy策略梯度（HPG）的算法，该算法在仅部分可观测和对抗性查询条件下，能够自适应地学习未知的低秩结构，并达到$\tilde{\mathcal O}(s\sqrt{M T})$的线性化策略遗憾界，避免了维度灾难。
AI.motivation: 现代推荐系统需要将多样化查询动态路由到多个嵌入模型，但在对抗性查询、赌博反馈和模型部分可观测等现实条件下，该问题尚未得到充分理解。
AI.method: 首先将嵌入模型路由形式化为具有低秩专家的对抗性上下文线性赌博机问题；然后识别出一类对数-二次策略类，该策略类既能表达查询依赖的模型路由，又支持高效在线学习；最后提出Hypentropy策略梯度（HPG）算法，能自适应未知低秩结构。
AI.result: HPG算法在线性化策略遗憾上达到$\tilde{\mathcal O}(s\sqrt{M T})$的界，其中$s$为专家内在秩，$M$为模型数，$T$为轮次，避免了维度灾难。同时提供了计算高效且无需超参数调的实现。
AI.conclusion: 证明了标准遗憾概念存在结构错配或统计难解性问题，而所提出的策略类和方法能够有效解决嵌入模型路由在现实条件下的学习问题。

title: PrologMCP: A Standardized Prolog Tool Interface for LLM Agents
comment: Accepted at Joint Workshop on Statistics and Knowledge Integration for Logic, Learning, Ethical Decisions, and LLMs, 18 July 2026, Lisbon
summary: Frontier reasoning-tuned language models still fail on deductive tasks at depth, and the cost of improved performance through extended internal reasoning scales poorly. Symbolic delegation offers a complementary route: a language model translates the problem, while a solver performs the inference. However, current autoformalization pipelines for logic programming are typically bespoke integrations tied to particular tasks or agents. We introduce PrologMCP, a task-agnostic, open-source server that exposes Prolog as a stateful tool through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Its compact tool interface, structured error reporting, and per-session isolation make the translate-run-inspect-repair loop a reusable primitive for MCP-capable agents. We evaluate a formalizer agent enhanced with PrologMCP against standard and reasoning LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.6, GPT-4.1, and o4-mini) on two subsets of PARARULE-Plus: a general-purpose sample and a more challenging one targeting a specific failure mode of natural-language reasoning. On the general sample, the formalizer matches or exceeds reasoning LLMs (accuracy 1.00 vs.\ 1.00 / 0.998), with the largest gains over standard models (0.762 for GPT-4.1). On the challenging subset, the formalizer remains near-perfect (1.00 / 0.99) while reasoning LLMs drop to 0.95 / 0.94. These results suggest that delegating inference to Prolog via MCP is a robust and inspectable alternative to extended natural-language reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PrologMCP——一个通过Model Context Protocol将Prolog暴露为状态化工具的通用开源服务器，使语言模型能够将推理任务委托给Prolog求解器。实验表明，这种符号化委托方法在演绎推理任务上匹配或超越了大语言模型（包括推理增强模型），并在困难样本上表现更鲁棒（准确率1.00 vs 0.94），且具备可审计性。
AI.motivation: 前沿推理调优的语言模型在深度演绎推理任务上仍存在失败，且通过扩展内部推理来提升性能的成本呈不良扩展。符号化委托——语言模型负责翻译问题，求解器负责推理——提供了补充路径，但当前逻辑编程的自动形式化流程通常是针对特定任务或智能体的定制集成，缺乏通用性和复用性。
AI.method: 提出PrologMCP，一个基于Model Context Protocol（MCP）的开源服务器，将Prolog暴露为状态化工具。其核心设计包括：紧凑的工具接口、结构化错误报告、每会话隔离机制，从而将"翻译-执行-检查-修复"循环封装为MCP兼容智能体的可复用原语。
AI.result: 在PARARULE-Plus通用样本上，形式化智能体匹配或超越推理LLM（准确率1.00 vs 1.00/0.998），显著优于标准模型（GPT-4.1为0.762）。在困难子集上，形式化智能体保持近乎完美表现（1.00/0.99），而推理LLM降至0.95/0.94。
AI.conclusion: 通过MCP将推理委托给Prolog是一种鲁棒且可审计的替代方案，优于扩展自然语言推理。

title: ReportQA: QA-Based Radiology Report Evaluation
summary: Radiology report evaluation is essential for advancing automated report generation. Natural language generation metrics have limited clinical relevance. Clinical efficacy (CE) metrics evaluate important medical findings, but focus mainly on presence and cover only a limited set of entities. Due to heavy reliance on manual annotations, it is difficult for CE metrics to extend clinical entities or attributes. In clinical practice, radiology reports serve as a medium for information transfer. Clinicians use them to perform downstream diagnostic tasks without directly inspecting images. Based on this insight, we propose ReportQA, a clinical-related and flexible radiology report evaluation framework, supporting detailed quantitative analysis of radiology report generation systems. We first collect datasets covering multiple imaging modalities and anatomical regions. We then construct knowledge trees of clinical entities and attributes with radiologist guidance, and use large language models (LLMs) to extract structured information from raw reports. Next, we generate QA pairs from predefined templates and apply quality control through self-filtering and report-based filtering. During evaluation, the report is treated as context, and an LLM acts as a judge model to answer the QA pairs. Based on the resulting QA accuracy, we introduce QAScore metric. Compared with existing metrics, QAScore shows better alignment with radiologist judgments. Experiments on multiple state-of-the-art vision-language models reveal that current report-based inference paradigms struggle to learn fine-grained clinical representations and exhibit strong negative prior biases. In contrast, question-driven inference provides a more effective alternative. For reproducibility and extensibility, we release the knowledge trees, structured reports, and QA pairs, along with the pipeline code for QA construction and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReportQA——一个基于问答的放射学报告评估框架。通过构建临床知识树、利用LLM提取结构化信息、生成QA对并计算QAScore指标，该方法在临床相关性方面优于现有指标。实验表明当前报告生成模型存在细粒度表示学习和负先验偏差问题，而问题驱动的推理方式更有效。
AI.motivation: 现有放射学报告评估方法存在局限：自然语言生成指标缺乏临床相关性，临床效能指标仅关注有限实体且依赖人工标注难以扩展。基于放射学报告是临床信息传递媒介的洞察，需要一种灵活、可扩展且临床相关的自动化评估框架。
AI.method: 收集多模态多解剖区域数据集→在放射科医生指导下构建临床实体和属性的知识树→使用LLM从原始报告中提取结构化信息→基于预定义模板生成QA对→通过自过滤和报告过滤进行质量控制→评估时将报告作为上下文，LLM作为评审模型回答QA，计算QAScore指标。
AI.result: QAScore与放射科医生判断的一致性优于现有指标。实验揭示当前基于报告生成的模型难以学习细粒度临床表示，存在强负先验偏差；问题驱动的推理方式更有效。
AI.conclusion: ReportQA提供了一个临床相关、灵活可扩展的放射学报告评估框架，支持细粒度定量分析，并公开了知识树、结构化报告、QA对及流水线代码以促进可复现性和扩展性。

title: Separable Neural Architectures as Physical World Models: from Mathematical Theory to Applications
summary: This work introduces the Separable Neural Architecture (SNA), a function representational class combining neural approximation with tensor decomposition. The SNA decouples localized coordinate functions (atoms) from global interactions governed by a sparse, low-rank interaction object. This architecture possesses a compact and smooth inductive bias well-suited for solving partial differential equations (PDEs). When viewed as a Galerkin trial space under the variational SNA (VSNA) framework, the formulation satisfies classical variational guarantees under Lax-Milgram: well-posedness, quasi-optimality, convergence, and stability. In high-dimensional spatiotemporal--parametric PDEs, the VSNA mitigates the curse of dimensionality by scaling algebraically rather than exponentially. Exploiting an entirely factorized, tensor-native alternating least squares (ALS) optimization framework reduces this cost to linear in dimension. The VSNA is validated across elliptic, hyperbolic, and parabolic systems, demonstrating close alignment with predicted algebraic and spectral scaling rates. We showcase the SNA as a "solve once, query anywhere" physical world model via two engineering case studies: a 7D parametric manufacturing simulation and an experimental thermal-to-property inversion pipeline for Inconel 718. The VSNA executes a 1,000,000-query Monte Carlo sweep in 102s on a standard laptop CPU, yielding a 150,000x speedup over a full-grid finite element baseline hosted on an NVIDIA A100 GPU. It further enables real-time generative inverse-mode reconstructions under 100ms. These results demonstrate that the SNA serves as a compact mathematical substrate for continuous parameter manifolds to enable real-time inversion, optimization loops, and rapid uncertainty propagation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出分离式神经架构(SNA)，将神经网络与张量分解结合，实现紧凑平滑的偏微分方程求解器。在变分框架(VSNA)下满足经典变分保证，高维问题中复杂度随维度线性增长（而非指数）。在7D参数化制造模拟和Inconel 718热-物性反演中，实现百万次蒙特卡洛采样仅需102秒（比GPU上的有限元基线快15万倍），反向重建低于100毫秒。
AI.motivation: 高维时空-参数化PDE求解面临维度灾难，传统数值方法（如有限元）计算成本随维度指数增长，且现有神经网络方法缺乏严格的变分保证和收敛性分析。
AI.method: 提出SNA架构：将函数表示为局部坐标函数（原子）与稀疏低秩交互对象的张量分解组合；在VSNA框架下将其作为Galerkin试验空间，满足Lax-Milgram引理保证；采用完全因子化的交替最小二乘(ALS)优化框架，使计算成本随维度线性缩放。
AI.result: 在椭圆、双曲、抛物型PDE系统上验证了代数与谱缩放率；7D制造模拟中，CPU上102秒完成百万次查询（150,000倍加速于GPU有限元）；反向重建低于100ms。
AI.conclusion: SNA作为连续参数流形的紧凑数学基板，可实现实时反演、优化循环和快速不确定性传播，且具有严格的收敛保证。

title: Semantics-Enhanced Retrieval-Augmented Time Series Forecasting
comment: Accepted to the ICML 2026 Workshop on Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence
summary: Time series forecasting models often benefit from historical patterns. Inspired by Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), recent research explored retrieving relevant historical time series segments to enhance forecasting. However, relying solely on time series similarity is often insufficient for retrieval under non-stationarity. To address this, we propose a multimodal approach: a \textbf{S}emantics-\textbf{E}nhanced \textbf{R}etrieval-\textbf{A}ugmented Time Series \textbf{F}orecasting framework, SERAF. Unlike mainstream approaches that depend only on time series similarity, SERAF conducts dual retrieval over the time series and their self-generated textual descriptions. It retrieves two complementary sets of historical patterns and corresponding futures, which are selectively and jointly used to guide future predictions. Experiments across seven real-world datasets demonstrate the effectiveness of SERAF in bridging numerical and semantic views of time series compared with state-of-the-art baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出SERAF框架，通过双重检索（时间序列相似性+自生成文本描述）增强非平稳时间序列预测，实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于检索增强的时间序列预测方法仅依赖时序相似性检索，在非平稳条件下检索效果不足。
AI.method: 构建语义增强的检索增强时序预测框架SERAF，对时间序列及其自生成文本描述进行双重检索，选择性融合利用两组互补的历史模式与对应未来值来指导预测。
AI.result: 在7个真实数据集上的实验表明，SERAF在融合时序数值视角与语义视角方面优于现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 引入文本语义信息进行双重检索能有效弥补纯时序相似性检索在非平稳场景下的不足，提升预测性能。

title: Equity with Efficiency: An Empirical Study of Tokenizers for Multilingual Large Language Models
summary: Multilingual large language models (LLMs) depend on subword tokenization to bridge discrete text and continuous neural representation. State-of-the-art multilingual LLMs often use Byte-level Byte-Pair Encoding (BPE) tokenizers that structurally favor high-resource languages and Latin scripts. For speakers of underrepresented languages, particularly those across Southeast Asia, this bias inflates inference costs and widens cross-lingual capability gaps. We present the first systematic comparison of equitable tokenizers on a unified benchmark spanning 11 Southeast Asian languages. Beyond tokenizer-level analysis of compression efficiency and cross-lingual equity, we assess downstream task performance through controlled 1.5B-parameter language model training using the same training data. Our results show that Parity-aware BPE lies on the Pareto frontier of the efficiency-equity trade-off, achieving strong compression parity at competitive cost. Morphology-Driven Byte Encoding delivers the best semantic reasoning performance through morphologically richer representations, albeit at a higher computational expense. Byte Latent Transformer underperforms on downstream tasks, possibly because its architectural assumptions misalign with the constraints of limited low-resource training data. Together, our findings demonstrate that cross-lingual fairness and tokenization efficiency are not fundamentally at odds, and offer practical guidance for designing equitable multilingual models.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统比较了多种公平性分词器在11种东南亚语言上的表现，发现Parity-aware BPE在效率与公平性之间达到帕累托最优，Morphology-Driven Byte Encoding在语义推理上表现最佳但计算成本高，Byte Latent Transformer因架构假设与低资源数据不匹配而表现不佳。研究表明跨语言公平性与分词效率并非根本矛盾。
AI.motivation: 多语言大语言模型使用的Byte-level BPE分词器结构性地偏向高资源语言和拉丁文字，导致低资源语言（尤其是东南亚语言）的推理成本升高和跨语言能力差距扩大，亟需探索更公平的分词方案。
AI.method: 在统一的基准上对11种东南亚语言进行系统比较，包括分词器层面的压缩效率和跨语言公平性分析，以及通过使用相同训练数据控制训练1.5B参数语言模型的下游任务性能评估。
AI.result: Parity-aware BPE在效率与公平性的权衡中处于帕累托前沿；Morphology-Driven Byte Encoding通过更丰富的形态表示获得最佳语义推理性能，但计算成本更高；Byte Latent Transformer因架构假设与低资源训练数据限制不匹配，在下游任务中表现欠佳。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言公平性与分词效率并非根本矛盾，研究为设计公平的多语言模型提供了实践指导。

title: Remember, Don't Re-read: Stateful ReAct Agents for Token-Efficient Autonomous Experimentation
summary: The autoresearch pattern enables autonomous experimentation by having a large language model (LLM) iteratively modify code to optimize a target metric. Its stateless design, however, reconstructs experimental context from scratch at every iteration, incurring $O(n)$ token cost per iteration and $O(n^{2})$ total. This work reformulates the pattern as a stateful ReAct agent using LangGraph, where typed persistent state carries experimental history across iterations via a tool-calling interface. Two benchmarks are evaluated: hyperparameter tuning (15 iterations, small per-iteration observations) and code performance optimization (40 iterations, large per-iteration observations containing full source code and benchmark results). On hyperparameter tuning, the stateful agent consumes 90\% fewer tokens (2{,}492 vs.\ 24{,}465). On code optimization, the stateful agent consumes 52\% fewer tokens (627K vs.\ 1{,}275K) while achieving comparable optimization quality on both tasks. The token reduction is structural: the stateless agent re-reads the full history at $O(n)$ cost per iteration, while the stateful agent operates within a fixed-size conversation window at $O(1)$ cost. This paper describes the architecture in sufficient detail for practitioners to implement a stateful autoresearch agent for their own workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将有状态ReAct智能体（基于LangGraph）替代无状态autoresearch模式，通过持久化类型状态保存实验历史，将每次迭代的token成本从O(n)降至O(1)，在超参数调优和代码优化任务上分别减少90%和52%的token消耗，且优化质量相当。
AI.motivation: 无状态autoresearch模式每次迭代从零重建实验上下文，导致每轮O(n)的token成本及总成本O(n²)，效率低下且成本高昂。
AI.method: 将无状态模式重构为基于LangGraph的有状态ReAct智能体，利用类型化持久状态通过工具调用接口跨迭代传递实验历史，使每次迭代在固定大小的对话窗口内运行。
AI.result: 超参数调优任务（15轮）：有状态智能体消耗2,492 tokens，比无状态的24,465 tokens减少90%。代码优化任务（40轮）：消耗627K tokens，比1,275K tokens减少52%，优化质量相当。
AI.conclusion: 有状态架构在保持优化质量的前提下，通过结构性的token成本降低（从O(n)到O(1)）显著提升效率，且该架构细节可供实践者复现。

title: AI Engram: In Search of Memory Traces in Artificial Intelligence
comment: Accepted to ICML 2026 (Oral). Code is available at https://github.com/jeakwon/ai-engram/
summary: Memory formation is fundamental to intelligence, yet whether deep neural networks preserve identifiable memory traces analogous to biological memory units remains an open question. This work introduces a geometric framework to identify such "AI engrams" by formalizing the neuroscientific criteria of specificity, reactivation, sufficiency, and necessity into a constrained inverse problem. We derive a closed-form estimator that isolates individual memory traces from globally entangled parameters, and show that this biologically-derived solution corresponds to a natural gradient update on the parameter manifold. AI engrams enable surgical manipulation of learned knowledge: any subset of memories can be composed or erased through linear arithmetic, without iterative optimization. Experiments ranging from simple MLPs to LLMs demonstrate the causal validity and substantial scalability of AI engrams. Together, these results bridge theories of biological memory and artificial representation learning and offer geometric insight into how deep networks simultaneously support functional specificity within distributed storage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种几何框架，通过形式化神经科学的记忆标准（特异性、再激活、充分性、必要性），从深度神经网络中识别出"AI印记"（AI engrams），实现了对学习记忆的精确操控，并通过线性算术进行记忆的组合与擦除。
AI.motivation: 探究深度神经网络中是否存在类似生物记忆单元的可识别记忆痕迹， bridging生物记忆理论与人工表征学习之间的鸿沟。
AI.method: 将神经科学的四维标准（特异性、再激活、充分性、必要性）形式化为约束逆问题，推导出闭式估计量以从全局纠缠参数中分离出个体记忆痕迹，并证明该生物衍生解对应于参数流形上的自然梯度更新。
AI.result: AI印记可通过线性算术对任意记忆子集进行组合或擦除，无需迭代优化；实验从简单MLP到LLM验证了因果有效性和可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: AI印记桥接了生物记忆理论与人工表征学习，提供了深度网络在分布式存储中同时支持功能特异性的几何洞见。

title: A Practical Evaluation Method for Long-Form Simultaneous Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: Simultaneous speech-to-speech translation (SimulS2ST) enables real-time cross-lingual communication, but existing evaluation has focused largely on short or pre-segmented speech rather than long-form, continuous input. Prior approaches are difficult to reproduce and make assumptions that do not hold for end-to-end systems. We present a practical evaluation method for long-form SimulS2ST. Given source speech, pre-segmented source transcripts, and reference translations, we run automatic speech recognition (ASR) and forced alignment on the generated target speech to recover token-level timestamps, then apply a sentence-embedding-based aligner to match the target text to its corresponding source sentences. This enables sentence-level computation of latency and quality metrics, including YAAL and xCOMET, which are then aggregated into final system-level scores. Experiments on representative SimulS2ST systems show that the method is effective in practice and reveal that current systems suffer from substantial latency accumulation on long speech.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对长语音的同步语音到语音翻译（SimulS2ST）的实用评估方法，通过ASR和强制对齐恢复目标语音的词级时间戳，再结合句子嵌入对齐器匹配源句，实现句子级别的延迟和质量度量。实验表明该方法有效，并揭示现有系统在长语音上存在显著的延迟累积问题。
AI.motivation: 现有SimulS2ST评估多集中于短语音或预先切分的语音，缺乏对长语音连续输入的有效评估方法；且已有方法难以复现，其假设不适用于端到端系统。
AI.method: 给定源语音、预切分的源文本和参考译文后，对生成的目标语音进行ASR和强制对齐以恢复词级时间戳，再使用基于句子嵌入的对齐器将目标文本与对应源句子匹配，从而计算句子级别的YAAL和xCOMET等延迟与质量指标，最终聚合成系统级评分。
AI.result: 在代表性SimulS2ST系统上的实验表明该方法在实践中有效，并揭示现有系统在处理长语音时存在显著的延迟累积问题。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法为长语音SimulS2ST提供了可复现且实用的评估手段，填补了现有评估体系在长语音场景下的空白，并指出了当前系统的一大瓶颈——长语音下的延迟累积。

title: A Comparative Study of Graph Neural Network Layer Selection for Interaction Modelling in Driving Trajectory Prediction
summary: Autonomous driving systems rely on precise trajectory prediction to plan safe and efficient movement. Graph Neural Networks (GNNs) have become a promising approach for modelling spatiotemporal interactions among road agents. However, designing GNN architectures for trajectory prediction remains non-standardized, with little guidance on which graph layers effectively capture spatial interactions and temporal dynamics. This paper offers a detailed comparative study of 19 graph layer types, focusing on their spatial and temporal processing capabilities to discover the most effective architectures for trajectory prediction. Within the explored hyperparameter setting, we highlight five standout layer combinations, with ARMA, Chebyshev, and topology-aware layers consistently performing better than others. Beyond performance metrics, our findings yield practical design principles: sum-based aggregation is more effective than mean-based methods, multi-head attention mechanisms enable richer interactions, and assigning different weights to different hop distances significantly improves prediction accuracy. These findings offer useful guidance for designing more interpretable and effective trajectory prediction models.

AI.tldr: 本文对19种图神经网络层在轨迹预测中的空间和时间处理能力进行了系统比较，发现ARMA、Chebyshev和拓扑感知层表现最佳，并总结出若干实用设计原则。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶系统依赖精确的轨迹预测来规划安全高效的行驶路径。尽管GNN已成为建模道路智能体时空交互的主流方法，但针对轨迹预测的GNN架构设计缺乏标准化，现有研究对于哪些图网络层能有效捕捉空间交互和时间动态缺乏系统指导。
AI.method: 对19种图神经网络层类型进行详细的比较研究，聚焦其空间和时间处理能力，通过在特定超参数设置下进行实验，找出最有效的架构组合。
AI.result: ARMA、Chebyshev和拓扑感知层在性能上持续优于其他层；sum聚合优于mean聚合；多头注意力机制能实现更丰富的交互；为不同跳数距离分配不同权重可显著提升预测精度。
AI.conclusion: 本文发现为设计更具可解释性和有效性的轨迹预测模型提供了实用指导原则，有助于推动自动驾驶系统中轨迹预测架构的标准化设计。

title: Metric Match: A Subset Selection Approach to Evaluating LLM Judge Reliability
summary: LLM judges are used to reduce the need for costly human labor in evaluating open-ended text generation. However, the reliability of these judges depends critically on their alignment with human raters -- a property that itself depends on costly human annotations. In this work, we develop a method (Metric Match) for estimating correlation-based reliability metrics of LLM judges from limited annotations. Metric Match selects a subset of samples for human annotation such that the subset matches the population reliability metric with respect to acquired synthetic labels. We empirically show that Metric Match achieves a win-rate of 0.838 against random subset selection across four different correlation metrics and 15 datasets, with an 18.7% decrease in average estimation error and reduces annotation needs by 32.5%. We provide a cost model and highlight a medical case study where our method saves $1,041.67 compared to random selection for expert annotation. Further, we shift our task from reliability estimation to reliability classification of whether a given judge is above a deployment threshold, outperforming random selection with Metric Match. All project code is publicly available, and we additionally provide an installable package for ease of use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Metric Match方法，通过选择少量样本进行人工标注来估计LLM评估者与人类评分者之间的一致性可靠性指标，实验表明该方法在多个指标和数据集上优于随机选择，平均减少32.5%的标注需求。
AI.motivation: LLM评估者被广泛用于替代昂贵的人工评估，但其可靠性高度依赖与人类评分者的一致性，而验证这种一致性本身需要大量人工标注。现有方法在标注预算有限时难以准确估计LLM评估者的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出Metric Match方法，通过选择与总体可靠性指标相匹配的样本子集进行人工标注。具体地，利用已有的合成标签（LLM产生的标签）来引导子集选择，使得所选子集在合成标签上的相关性指标与总体上的指标相匹配，从而用更少的标注样本更好地估计真实可靠性。
AI.result: 在15个数据集和4种相关性指标上，Metric Match的胜率为0.838，平均估计误差降低18.7%，标注需求减少32.5%。在医学案例研究中，与随机选择相比节省了1041.67美元的专家标注费用。此外，在可靠性分类任务中也优于随机选择。
AI.conclusion: Metric Match能有效减少评估LLM评估者可靠性所需的人工标注量，在估计准确性和成本节约方面均显著优于随机基线，且提供了可复现的代码和安装包。

title: CoCoGEC: Counterfactual Generation for Robust Grammatical Error Correction
summary: Grammatical error correction (GEC) systems are usually trained and evaluated on GEC benchmarks, but their performance often drops sharply once the surrounding context is slightly perturbed or extended. This indicates that the existing GEC models usually fail to understand the error patterns in the varying contexts. In this paper, we thoroughly investigate the counterfactuals for GEC tasks, where the subtle changes to the contexts could lead to the label flipping issue. We propose CoCoGEC, a counterfactual generation framework that creates copies of training instances with error-irrelevant contexts altered. Our framework systematically generates counterfactuals by (1) generating intra- and inter-sentence counterfactuals that maintain the error patterns as well as syntax of the original instances by altering the word-level and sentence-level contexts; (2) revising the generated counterfactuals by selecting the instances with flipped labels and high GEC Mutual Information (MI) coefficient. Extensive experiments show that our method substantially improves the stability of GEC models, outperforming a set of data augmentation baselines. Particularly, it could achieve absolute F0.5 gains of +9.9, +11.3, and +20.8 points on the perturbed BEA-19*,CoNLL-14*, and TEM-8* data set.Our code is released at https://github.com/Quinnok/CoCoGEC

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoCoGEC，一个针对语法纠错任务的因果反事实生成框架，通过改变与错误无关的上下文生成反事实样本，显著提升GEC模型在扰动上下文中的稳定性，在三个数据集上分别获得+9.9、+11.3和+20.8的F0.5绝对增益。
AI.motivation: 现有GEC系统在上下文发生轻微扰动或扩展时性能急剧下降，说明模型未能理解不同上下文中的错误模式。作者希望提升GEC模型对上下文变化的鲁棒性。
AI.method: 提出CoCoGEC框架：1) 生成词级（intra-sentence）和句级（inter-sentence）反事实样本，通过改变词级和句级上下文同时保留原实例的错误模式和句法结构；2) 通过选择标签翻转且具有高GEC互信息系数的实例来修正生成的反事实样本。
AI.result: 该方法显著提升GEC模型的稳定性，超越多种数据增强基线。在扰动的BEA-19*、CoNLL-14*和TEM-8*数据集上分别获得+9.9、+11.3和+20.8的F0.5绝对增益。
AI.conclusion: 通过系统地生成与错误无关的反事实上下文，可以有效提升GEC模型在不同上下文环境下的稳定性和泛化能力。

title: Leveraging Physiological Signals to Predict Exam Outcomes with Machine Learning
summary: This study investigates the application of machine learning models to predict exam outcomes using physiological data collected during examination sessions. Physiological stress indicators, including electrodermal activity, heart rate, and skin temperature, were analyzed to uncover their association with academic performance. A variety of machine learning approaches were employed, ranging from standard models like logistic regression, random forest, and support vector machines to more advanced architectures, including transformers, long short-term memory (LSTM), and gated recurrent unit (GRU) models. This diversity aimed to capture the complex interactions within the data effectively. A key focus was assessing the adaptability of transformers in processing numerical data and evaluating their performance in this novel context. Standard performance metrics, such as accuracy, precision, recall, and F1-score, were used to compare model efficacy. The experimental results demonstrate that while deep learning models generally excel at capturing complex relationships in physiological data, simpler models like random forests can sometimes achieve superior performance while offering computational efficiency and interpretability. Furthermore, transformers demonstrated notable versatility, showcasing performances comparable to those of the LSTM and GRU models. This research underscores the importance of experimenting with a broad class of models that align with the objectives of the problem at hand, balancing precision, efficiency, and interpretability. By elucidating the relationships between physiological signals and academic performance, this study contributes to understanding stressors affecting students' mental health. It further promotes leveraging physiological data to enhance student well-being and academic outcomes.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用机器学习模型分析考试期间的生理数据（皮肤电活动、心率、皮肤温度）来预测考试成绩，比较了从逻辑回归、随机森林到Transformer、LSTM、GRU等多种模型，发现深度学习模型擅长捕捉复杂关系，但随机森林等简单模型在性能、效率和可解释性方面有时更具优势，Transformer展示了与LSTM/GRU相当的性能。
AI.motivation: 探究生理信号与学业表现之间的关联，通过机器学习预测考试成绩，从而理解影响学生心理健康的压力因素，并促进利用生理数据改善学生福祉和学业成果。
AI.method: 收集考试期间的生理数据（皮肤电活动、心率、皮肤温度）作为特征，采用多种机器学习模型进行预测，包括逻辑回归、随机森林、支持向量机等标准模型，以及Transformer、LSTM、GRU等深度学习架构，使用准确率、精确率、召回率和F1分数作为评估指标。
AI.result: 深度学习模型在捕捉生理数据复杂关系方面表现优异，但随机森林等简单模型有时能取得更优性能且兼具计算效率和可解释性；Transformer展示了与LSTM和GRU相当的性能，表现出良好的适应性。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了根据问题目标尝试多种模型的重要性，需要在精度、效率和可解释性之间取得平衡；揭示了生理信号与学业表现之间的关系，有助于理解学生压力因素，为利用生理数据提升学生福祉和学术成果提供了依据。

title: OSGuard: A Benchmark for Safety in Computer-Use Agents
summary: Computer-use agents are increasingly evaluated by whether they complete realistic desktop and web tasks. However, task success alone can miss failures in which an agent reaches the nominal goal through an unsafe shortcut. We introduce OSGuard, a dual-granularity benchmark suite for evaluating safety in computer-use agents under benign, unchanged user instructions. OSGuard contains an action-level benchmark for local guardrail decisions and a risk-augmented execution suite for end-to-end evaluation. The action-level benchmark consists of contextualized proposed actions labeled as allowed, unrelated, or unsafe, each judged relative to the original instruction and current interface state. The execution suite contains manually constructed OSWorld-derived task variants in which the original task remains achievable, but the environment is modified to introduce latent hazards such as destructive overwrites, etc. Each variant is paired with augmented evaluators that retain the original task-success criterion while adding explicit state-based safety invariants, allowing us to distinguish safe completions from unsafe completions that satisfy the nominal task objective. Our experimental results on OSGuard show that current multimodal guardrails can perform well on isolated action judgments, while risk-augmented execution exposes remaining gaps between local oversight and reliable end-to-end safety. This dual-granularity design enables more precise diagnosis of whether models can both recognize unsafe proposed actions and improve full-task safety when deployed as guardrails.

AI.tldr: OSGuard是一个双粒度基准测试套件，用于评估计算机使用智能体在良性用户指令下的安全性，包含动作级基准（局部护栏决策）和风险增强执行套件（端到端评估）。实验表明当前多模态护栏在孤立动作判断上表现良好，但端到端安全仍存在差距。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用智能体评估仅关注任务完成度，忽略了智能体可能通过不安全捷径（如破坏性覆盖等）达到名义目标的安全隐患。
AI.method: 构建双粒度基准：1）动作级基准：对上下文相关的提议动作标注为允许、无关或不安全，基于原始指令和当前界面状态判断；2）风险增强执行套件：在OSWorld任务变体中引入潜在危害，保留原始成功标准的同时增加显式状态安全不变量，区分安全完成与不安全完成。
AI.result: 当前多模态护栏在孤立动作判断上表现良好，但风险增强执行暴露了局部监督与可靠端到端安全之间的差距。
AI.conclusion: 双粒度设计能够更精确地诊断模型是否能识别不安全提议动作，并在部署为护栏时提升全任务安全性。

title: Stop When Further Reasoning Won't Help: Attention-State Adaptive Generation in Reasoning Models
summary: By incorporating test-time compute scaling, large reasoning models (LRMs) can solve complex problems through explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning processes. However, they often suffer from overthinking, resulting in redundant token outputs and degraded accuracy. Current methods to mitigate this issue remain limited: training-based approaches require substantial computational resources, while training-free methods rely on well-crafted prompts or unreliable confidence signals. In this work, we investigate early stopping from the perspective of attention distributions and propose a simple method, ASAG, which infers the model's reasoning state and adaptively adjusts the generation strategy. The proposed framework is training-free and plug-and-play, enabling seamless integration into existing LRMs. Extensive experiments on nine benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements across mainstream LRMs with varying parameter scales, including the DeepSeek-R1-Distill and Qwen3 series. Specifically, ASAG improves average accuracy by 3.2% while reducing the number of generated tokens by nearly 40% across all reasoning tasks on Qwen3-8B.

AI.tldr: 针对大型推理模型（LRM）在链式思维推理中存在的"过度思考"问题（冗余token输出和精度下降），本文提出了一种无需训练、即插即用的注意力分布引导的早期停止方法ASAG，通过推断模型推理状态自适应调整生成策略。实验表明，ASAG在多个基准上平均提升3.2%准确率，同时减少近40%的生成token数量。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在复杂问题求解中常产生冗余token输出和精度下降的"过度思考"问题，现有缓解方法（基于训练的方法资源消耗大，基于无训练的方法依赖精心设计的提示词或不可靠的置信度信号）存在局限性。
AI.method: 提出ASAG（Attention-distribution-based early Stopping with Adaptive Generation），从注意力分布角度推断模型的推理状态，自适应调整生成策略，是一种无需训练、即插即用的方法。
AI.result: 在九个基准数据集上，对DeepSeek-R1-Distill和Qwen3系列等多种主流LRM进行实验，均取得一致改进。以Qwen3-8B为例，平均准确率提升3.2%，同时生成token数量减少近40%。
AI.conclusion: ASAG作为一种无训练、即插即用的方法，能有效缓解LRM的过度思考问题，兼顾精度提升与推理效率优化，具有良好的通用性和可集成性。

title: Benchmarking Instance-Dependent Label Noise with Controlled Corruptions
summary: Synthetic instance-dependent label noise (IDN) benchmarks are widely used to evaluate noisy-label learning methods, yet existing approaches typically generate noise through imperfect annotators or classifier raters, leaving the source of ambiguity implicit. We introduce CILN, a benchmark generation framework that creates IDN through controlled input corruptions. A diverse voter pool labels corrupted instances, producing benchmark datasets in which both the source and severity of ambiguity are explicit and controllable. Using CIFAR10, MNIST, and Adult, we construct 90 benchmark settings spanning multiple corruption families and severity levels. Our experiments show that the resulting benchmarks exhibit genuine instance-dependent noise, provide diverse confusion structures, and, on CIFAR-10, can produce label distributions that are closer to human uncertainty than an existing synthetic IDN benchmark. We further demonstrate that corruption-mediated IDN can expose failure modes of popular noisy-label learning methods, including Co-Teaching and DivideMix, that are not observed under comparable levels of rater-fallibility noise. These findings suggest that noise structure, not only noise rate, plays an important role in benchmark difficulty and algorithm behavior. By making ambiguity generation explicit and controllable, CILN provides a complementary benchmarking framework for studying noisy-label learning under diverse sources of instance difficulty.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CILN框架，通过受控输入损坏生成合成实例依赖标签噪声（IDN）基准数据集，使噪声来源和严重程度明确可控。实验表明该方法能产生真实的实例相关噪声，暴露流行噪声标签学习方法（如Co-Teaching、DivideMix）的失败模式，并发现噪声结构（而非仅噪声率）对基准难度和算法行为有重要影响。
AI.motivation: 现有合成IDN基准通常通过不完美标注者或分类器评分生成噪声，噪声来源不明确且不可控，缺乏对歧义来源的显式建模。
AI.method: CILN框架通过对输入样本施加受控损坏（多种损坏家族和严重程度），由多样化的投票池对损坏样本进行标注，从而生成噪声来源和严重程度均明确可控的基准数据集。
AI.result: 使用CIFAR10、MNIST和Adult构建了90个基准设置；生成的基准展现出真实的实例依赖噪声和多样的混淆结构；在CIFAR-10上可产生比现有合成IDN基准更接近人类不确定性的标签分布；能暴露Co-Teaching和DivideMix等方法的失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 噪声结构（而非仅噪声率）对基准难度和算法行为有重要影响，CILN通过使歧义生成显式化和可控化，为研究不同实例难度来源下的噪声标签学习提供了互补的基准框架。

title: Fusion is not one-size-fits-all: Cross-Modal Representation Alignment for Time-to-Event Modeling
summary: Accurate time-to-event (TTE) prediction from multimodal clinical data remains challenging due to modality imbalance and distribution shift. We introduce a foundation model-driven framework for cross-modal representation alignment between CT imaging and longitudinal EHR data, designed to generalize across tasks and institutions. CT and EHR modalities are encoded independently using domain-specific foundation models and aligned in a shared latent space through four principled fusion strategies: late fusion, contrastive alignment, cross-attention, and co-attention. We evaluate two clinically distinct TTE tasks: pulmonary embolism (PE) mortality and cardiovascular disease (CVD) outcomes, on large-scale multi-institutional cohorts (PE: N=3,099 train; 1,098 internal; 435 external; CVD: N=2,951 train; 837 internal; 682 external). Fusion consistently improves concordance index by 1.5-5.4% over unimodal baselines when modalities contribute comparably. Overall, contrastive multimodal fusion, particularly with CLMBR representations, provided the most consistent and statistically robust improvements, especially for PE mortality prediction. For MACE, cross-attention (one-hot) achieved the highest internal performance and image-guided co-attention achieved the best external performance. We therefore introduce a generalizable foundation model-based cross-modal alignment framework and provide the first systematic analysis of fusion behavior under modality imbalance in TTE prediction. Our results establish task-aware multimodal alignment as a necessary design principle for robust generalization and scalable clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于基础模型的多模态融合框架，用于CT影像与纵向EHR数据的时间-事件预测，通过四种融合策略对齐跨模态表征，并在两个临床任务（PE死亡率和CVD结局）的大规模多中心队列中验证，结果表明对比融合在模态贡献均衡时提升C-index 1.5-5.4%，且任务感知的对齐策略对泛化至关重要。
AI.motivation: 多模态临床数据的时间-事件预测面临模态不平衡和分布偏移两大挑战，现有方法缺乏系统性的跨模态对齐研究。
AI.method: 使用领域专用基础模型分别编码CT和EHR模态，通过四种融合策略（晚期融合、对比对齐、交叉注意力、协同注意力）在共享潜在空间中对齐表征，并在两个临床TTE任务上评估。
AI.result: 融合方法在模态贡献均衡时C-index提升1.5-5.4%；对比融合（尤其CLMBR表征）在PE死亡率预测中表现最一致稳健；MACE任务中交叉注意力（one-hot）内部最优，图像引导协同注意力外部最优。
AI.conclusion: 任务感知的多模态对齐是鲁棒泛化和可扩展临床部署的必要设计原则，本文首次系统分析了模态不平衡下融合行为对TTE预测的影响。

title: Ling and Ring 2.6 Technical Report: Efficient and Instant Agentic Intelligence at Trillion-Parameter Scale
summary: Efficient and scalable agentic intelligence requires models that can deliver both low-latency responses and strong reasoning capabilities while remaining practical to train, serve, and deploy. In this report, we present Ling-2.6 and Ring-2.6, a family of models designed to address this challenge at scale. Ling-2.6 is optimized for instant response generation and high capability per output token, whereas Ring-2.6 is tailored for deeper reasoning and more advanced agentic workflows. Instead of training from scratch, we upgrade the Ling-2.0 base model through architectural migration pre-training and large-scale post-training. This upgrade is guided by a unified co-design of model architecture, optimization objectives, serving systems, and agent training environments, enabling improvements in both model capability and deployment efficiency. At the architectural level, we introduce a hybrid linear attention design that integrates Lightning Attention with MLA, improving the efficiency of long-context training and decoding. To further enhance token efficiency, we optimize capability per output token through Evolutionary Chain-of-Thought, Linguistic Unit Policy Optimization, bidirectional preference alignment, and shortest-correct-response distillation. For agentic capabilities, we propose KPop, a reinforcement learning framework designed to support stable training of Ring-2.6-1T on large-scale environment-grounded data. KPop improves training efficiency through asynchronous scheduling across coding, search, tool use, and workflow execution, enabling scalable learning from complex agent-environment interactions. Together, Ling-2.6 and Ring-2.6 provide a practical pathway toward efficient, scalable, and open agentic systems. We open-source all checkpoints in the 2.6 family to support further research and development in practical agentic intelligence.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了Ling-2.6和Ring-2.6模型家族，通过架构迁移预训练、混合线性注意力设计（Lightning Attention + MLA）、以及KPop强化学习框架，实现了低延迟响应与强推理能力的平衡，并开源了所有检查点。
AI.motivation: 现有模型难以同时满足低延迟响应、强推理能力以及训练/部署的实用性，需要一种可扩展且高效的代理智能方案。
AI.method: 1) 从Ling-2.0基础模型通过架构迁移预训练和大规模后训练升级；2) 混合线性注意力设计（Lightning Attention + MLA）提升长上下文训练和解码效率；3) 通过进化式思维链、语言单元策略优化、双向偏好对齐和最短正确响应蒸馏优化每token能力；4) 提出KPop强化学习框架，支持Ring-2.6-1T在环境接地数据上的稳定训练，通过异步调度提升训练效率。
AI.result: Ling-2.6实现即时响应生成和高每token能力；Ring-2.6实现更深层推理和更高级的代理工作流；整个2.6系列模型开源。
AI.conclusion: Ling-2.6和Ring-2.6提供了一条通向高效、可扩展、开源的代理智能系统的实用路径。

title: Zero-order Parameter-free Optimization for LMO-based Methods: Novel Approach for Efficient Fine-tuning
summary: Fine-tuning large language models (LLMs) has become a central application of modern optimization, enabling pretrained models to adapt to diverse downstream tasks and domain-specific data. A major obstacle in large-scale fine-tuning is the memory overhead of backpropagation, which requires storing activations, gradients, and optimizer states. Zeroth-order (ZO) optimization offers a memory-efficient alternative, but its performance is highly sensitive to the stepsize and smoothing parameter, often requiring costly task-specific tuning. Parameter-free (PF) optimization addresses this issue by adapting algorithmic parameters without prior knowledge of problem-dependent constants. Moreover, large-scale fine-tuning can benefit from geometry-aware updates that account for the heterogeneous structure of parameter blocks, which can be modeled through methods that exploit linear minimization oracle (LMO). In this work, we study PF adaptation for LMO-based ZO optimization and introduce $\texttt{AdaNAGED}$, a method that unifies gradient-free training, adaptive tuning, and non-Euclidean update geometry. We establish convergence guarantees and validate the method on large-scale LLM fine-tuning task with $\texttt{OPT}-1.3\mathrm{B}$ model.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaNAGED方法，统一了零阶优化、无参数自适应和非欧几里得更新几何，用于大语言模型的高效微调，在OPT-1.3B模型上验证了有效性。
AI.motivation: 大语言模型微调中反向传播的内存开销巨大，而零阶优化虽能降低内存但性能高度依赖超参数调优，且缺乏对参数块异构结构的几何感知能力。
AI.method: 提出AdaNAGED方法，将无参数自适应技术、基于线性最小化预言机（LMO）的几何感知更新与零阶优化统一在一个框架中，无需手动调参即可自适应调整步长和平滑参数。
AI.result: 在OPT-1.3B模型的大规模LLM微调任务上进行了验证，并建立了收敛性保证。
AI.conclusion: AdaNAGED能够在不依赖人工调参的情况下实现内存高效的LLM微调，同时通过非欧几里得几何感知更新提升了优化效果。

title: Risk-Aware LLM Agents for Geospatial Data Retrieval: Design and Preliminary Adversarial Evaluation
comment: Accepted for publication in the International Archives of the Photogrammetry, Remote Sensing and Spatial Information Sciences (ISPRS Archives), ISPRS Congress 2026
summary: We present an LLM-driven framework for retrieving remote sensing data from cloud-based geospatial catalogues using natural language queries. The system converts user intent into structured API calls, enabling efficient access to satellite imagery and environmental datasets. The architecture integrates three agents: Guardrail for safety and policy enforcement, General-QA for intent interpretation, and Recommender-Analyst for schema-aware API call generation. This coordinated design ensures reliable, semantically aligned interaction with external data services. The modular framework is portable across platforms through API schema substitution and supports applications in environmental monitoring, disaster response, and climate analysis. It establishes a scalable interface between user intent and geospatial infrastructure, enabling streamlined and automated Earth observation workflows. Preliminary experiments under adversarial multi-turn settings show that prompt-level safety instructions improve robustness, although rare high-impact failures persist in API manipulation scenarios and highlight the need for adaptive, system-level defenses that balance safety, usability, and cost efficiency, which motivates the use of our intercept-level Guardrail agent.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于大语言模型的框架，通过自然语言查询从云地理空间目录中检索遥感数据，利用三个智能体（Guardrail、General-QA、Recommender-Analyst）实现用户意图到结构化API调用的转换，提供可扩展的地球观测工作流接口。
AI.motivation: 解决遥感数据检索中用户需要通过复杂API和专业查询语言访问云地理空间目录的难题，旨在降低使用门槛，实现自然语言驱动的数据获取。
AI.method: 构建三智能体架构：Guardrail负责安全与策略执行，General-QA进行意图理解，Recommender-Analyst生成符合模式（schema）的API调用。框架通过API模式替换实现跨平台移植。
AI.result: 在对抗性多轮对话实验中，提示级安全指令提升了鲁棒性，但在API操控场景中仍存在罕见的高影响失败，表明需要自适应、系统级的防御机制。
AI.conclusion: 该框架建立了用户意图与地理空间基础设施之间的可扩展接口，实现了自动化地球观测工作流，并强调了系统级安全防御（如拦截级Guardrail智能体）在平衡安全性、可用性和成本效率方面的重要性。

title: AdaMame: A Training Recipe for Adaptive Multilingual Reasoning
summary: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) show strong performance in English, they often fail to reason in the language of the query, a phenomenon known as language collapse. Existing RL-based fixes typically add a binary language fidelity reward to the accuracy objective, yet still incur trade-off in accuracy, mid-trace code-switching, and excessive token usage. In this work, we propose AdaMame, a two-stage training recipe for multilingual mathematical reasoning that addresses these limitations by adaptively aligning the reasoning language to the query language without compromising accuracy. The first SFT stage fine-tunes on naturally occurring reasoning traces across five languages to establish multilingual reasoning capability. In the subsequent RL stage, we introduce AdaMame-GRPO, an adaptation of Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) in which a query-conditioned alignment factor grows progressively during training, guiding the model to first explore diverse reasoning languages before exploiting reasoning in the query language. Evaluated across two benchmarks, two LRMs, and 12 languages, AdaMame-GRPO achieves Pareto-optimal performance across reasoning accuracy, language fidelity, and token efficiency over all baselines, with the strongest gains on out-of-domain, lower-resource languages.

AI.tldr: AdaMame提出两阶段训练方案（SFT+RL），通过自适应对齐推理语言与查询语言，在不牺牲准确率的前提下解决多语言数学推理中的语言崩溃问题，在12种语言上实现准确率、语言保真度和token效率的帕累托最优。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型（LRMs）在英语上表现强劲，但存在"语言崩溃"现象——模型无法用查询语言进行推理。现有基于RL的修复方法在准确率、中间代码切换和token使用量之间存在权衡，亟需一种能同时兼顾准确率、语言保真度和token效率的解决方案。
AI.method: 两阶段训练：1) SFT阶段：在5种语言的自然推理轨迹上微调，建立多语言推理能力；2) RL阶段：提出AdaMame-GRPO，在GRPO中引入查询条件对齐因子，该因子在训练过程中逐渐增长，引导模型先探索多种推理语言，再利用查询语言进行推理。
AI.result: 在两个基准、两个LRM和12种语言上，AdaMame-GRPO在所有基线上实现了推理准确率、语言保真度和token效率的帕累托最优，在域外低资源语言上提升最为显著。
AI.conclusion: AdaMame通过渐进式对齐策略有效解决了多语言推理中的语言崩溃问题，在不牺牲准确率的前提下实现了语言对齐和token效率的双重优化，尤其有利于低资源语言场景。

title: FastMix: Fast Data Mixture Optimization via Gradient Descent
summary: While large and diverse datasets have driven recent advances in large models, identifying the optimal data mixture for pre-training and post-training remains a significant open problem. We address this challenge with FASTMIX, a novel framework that automates data mixture discovery while training only a single proxy model. Instead of relying on predefined heuristics or resource-intensive simulations, FASTMIX jointly optimizes mixture coefficients and model parameters, substantially improving efficiency and scalability over prior approaches. At the core of FASTMIX is a reformulation of mixture selection as a bilevel optimization problem. Under this reformulation, we show that optimizing mixture ratios is mathematically equivalent to assigning per-source loss weights under uniform source sampling. This embeds the mixture coefficients directly into the differentiable iterative optimization objective, enabling efficient, gradient-based optimization of both mixture and model. To solve the optimization problem, FASTMIX implements an approximate iterative optimization procedure, alternating between (i) updating model parameters on data sampled according to current mixture ratios (inner loop) and (ii) updating mixture ratios based on validation feedback (outer loop). Across pre- and post-training, FASTMIX outperforms baselines while drastically reducing search cost. Code (https://github.com/hrtan/fastmix)

AI.tldr: FASTMIX是一个自动化数据混合配比发现的框架，只需训练单个代理模型，通过将混合选择重新定义为双层优化问题，实现了混合系数和模型参数的联合优化，在预训练和后训练中均以极低搜索成本超越基线方法。
AI.motivation: 大规模模型性能高度依赖训练数据的混合配比，但如何确定最优数据混合比例仍是一个重要的开放问题。现有方法依赖预定义启发式规则或资源密集型的仿真实验，效率低下且难以扩展。
AI.method: FASTMIX将数据混合选择重新定义为双层优化问题，证明优化混合比例等价于在均匀源采样下为每个源分配可微的损失权重，从而将混合系数嵌入迭代优化目标。通过近似迭代优化过程交替执行：(i) 内循环——根据当前混合比例采样数据更新模型参数；(ii) 外循环——基于验证反馈更新混合比例。
AI.result: 在预训练和后训练场景中，FASTMIX均优于基线方法，同时大幅降低了搜索成本。
AI.conclusion: FASTMIX通过将数据混合选择转化为可微的双层优化问题，实现了高效、可扩展的数据配比自动发现，为大规模模型训练中的数据混合优化提供了一种实用的解决方案。

title: Cognitive Debt: AI as Intellectual Leverage and the Dynamics of Systemic Fragility
comment: 46 pages, 3 figures. Preliminary version; comments welcome
summary: We develop a formal theory of cognitive debt: the stock of unverified reasoning obligations that accumulates when individuals use AI as a substitute rather than a complement for first-principles cognition. The model features two state variables per agent, cognitive capital and cognitive debt, and a multiplicative production technology in which cognitive capital functions as collateral that determines the return to AI adoption. We establish six propositions. Rational agents incur positive cognitive debt because the costs are deferred, partially external, and masked by short-run productivity gains. Tranquil periods lower subjective risk assessments, raise AI substitution intensity, and compound leverage, generating a cognitive Minsky moment in which subjective risk falls while true systemic fragility rises. Expected crisis losses are convex in aggregate leverage. Post-crisis, output-target pressure can produce a false-correction loop in which agents patch AI failures with more AI. The decentralised equilibrium over-adopts substitutive AI relative to the social optimum because of systemic risk, cognitive public goods, and arms-race externalities. In a two-type heterogeneous-agent economy, high-cognitive-capital agents adopt AI more intensively and may eventually erode their unaided cognitive capital below that of initially lower-skilled agents.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了“认知债务”的形式化理论，将AI作为替代而非补充第一性原理认知时积累的未验证推理义务存量模型化，证明理性动机会导致认知债务积累，并引发认知明斯基时刻、虚假纠正循环及过度采纳等问题。
AI.motivation: 解释为何理性个体会在明知风险的情况下，仍以替代性方式使用AI，导致认知能力退化与系统性脆弱性累积。
AI.method: 建立包含认知资本与认知债务两个状态变量的形式化模型，采用乘数生产技术，将认知资本作为决定AI采纳回报的抵押品，并通过六个命题进行理论推导。
AI.result: 1) 理性动机会产生正向认知债务；2) 平静期降低风险感知、提高替代强度，引发认知明斯基时刻；3) 预期危机损失是总杠杆的凸函数；4) 危机后产出目标压力导致虚假纠正循环；5) 分散均衡因系统风险、认知公共品和军备竞赛外部性过度采纳替代性AI；6) 高认知资本个体采纳AI更积极，最终可能使自身原始认知资本低于最初的低技能者。
AI.conclusion: AI的替代性使用会导致个体和系统的认知脆弱性累积，需要从宏观审慎角度进行治理。

title: When Cognitive Graphs Meet LLMs: BDEI Cognitive Pathways for Panic Emotional Arousal Prediction
summary: Predicting individual panic emotional arousal timing before manifestation is essential for proactive emergency intervention. Existing methods incorporate cognitive elements but none explicitly model the emotional arousal process, making them ill-suited for emotional arousal timing prediction. We argue that grounding prediction in appraisal emotion theory is necessary because it explicitly models this process, but three problems must be solved. (1) Appraisal theory posits that emotion arises from simultaneous evaluation across multiple threat dimensions, yet no prior work fuses these inputs into risk perception. (2) Existing cognitive models lack an Emotion node, decoupling threat appraisal from emotional arousal and forcing emotions to be inferred indirectly from behaviors.
