(3) Given their generalizable cognitive reasoning, current approaches adopt LLMs as the primary decision-maker, yet overlook the fragility and hallucination-proneness of their outputs. To address these issues, we introduce PanicCognitivePath (PCP), a framework that addresses all three. A Psychological Safety Distance (PSD) model, grounded in psychological distance theory, maps four-domain signals into a unified risk metric as the entry condition for subsequent cognitive reasoning. An explicit Emotion node grounded in appraisal emotion theory is introduced into BDI, forming a Belief-Desire-Emotion-Intention (BDEI) pathway. Agents whose risk metric exceeds the PSD threshold enter this pathway, coupling threat appraisal directly to emotional arousal. The BDEI pathway governs all state transitions while the LLM is confined to parameter estimation for the Belief-to-Desire transition, confining hallucinations to a single step and preventing error propagation. Experiments on Hurricane Sandy show PCP improves arousal timing accuracy by 10.68% over baselines, reduces peak count error to 7.07%.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PanicCognitivePath (PCP)框架，通过引入心理安全距离模型、显式情绪节点和限制LLM作用范围，解决了基于评估情绪理论预测个体恐慌情绪唤醒时机的三个关键问题，在飓风桑迪数据集上实现了 arousal 时机准确率提升10.68%，峰值计数误差降至7.07%。
AI.motivation: 现有方法无法预测个体恐慌情绪唤醒时机，因为缺乏对情绪唤醒过程显式建模。作者认为基于评估情绪理论进行预测是必要的，但面临三个未解决问题：(1)多维度威胁评估的融合缺失；(2)现有认知模型缺乏情绪节点，情绪只能从行为间接推断；(3)LLM作为主要决策者存在脆弱性和幻觉倾向。
AI.method: PCP框架包含三个核心组件：(1)基于心理距离理论的PSD模型，将四域信号映射为统一风险度量；(2)在BDI架构中引入显式情绪节点，形成BDEI路径，使威胁评估直接耦合情绪唤醒；(3)将LLM限制在Belief-to-Desire转换的参数估计步骤，限制幻觉传播范围。
AI.result: 在飓风桑迪数据集上，PCP的arousal时机准确率比基线方法提升10.68%，峰值计数误差降至7.07%。
AI.conclusion: 将评估情绪理论与认知架构结合，并合理约束LLM的角色，可以有效提升情绪唤醒时机的预测精度，为主动应急干预提供支持。

title: Rational Sparse Autoencoder
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) are standard tools for mechanistic interpretability, but current SAE families are constrained by fixed encoder nonlinearities such as ReLU, JumpReLU, and TopK. This hard-codes a particular sparsity mechanism into the model and can distort the reconstruction-versus-sparsity trade-off. We introduce the Rational Sparse Autoencoder (RSAE), which replaces the fixed encoder activation with a trainable rational function. Rational activations are flexible enough to uniformly approximate the activation primitives used by existing SAE families on compact domains (for TopK, the thresholded gate obtained after a separating top-k threshold is supplied), while also providing a richer function class for adapting to the observed pre-activation geometry. We realise this idea through a two-stage pipeline: an initialisation procedure that copies the pre-trained baseline SAE weights, plugs in rational coefficients obtained by the relaxed Remez exchange on synthetic data, and calibrates the scale parameters along with the rational coefficients; followed by a fine-tuning step under the standard sparsity-regularised reconstruction objective. Empirically, on residual-stream activations of three open-weight language models and across all three baseline activation families, the RSAE strictly improves on it after the fine-tuning step, both on reconstruction-side metrics and on downstream-behaviour metrics, without sacrificing feature-level interpretability under sparse probing. These gains are consistent across host language models, across baseline activation families, and across the full range of baseline sparsity we tested, while the upgrade itself adds only a handful of scalar parameters per autoencoder and runs in minutes on a single consumer GPU.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Rational Sparse Autoencoder (RSAE)，用可训练的有理函数替换SAE中固定的编码器非线性激活（如ReLU、JumpReLU、TopK），通过初始化（基于松弛Remez交换拟合有理系数）和微调两阶段流程，在多个语言模型和基线激活族上一致改进了重建质量和下游行为指标，且仅增加少量标量参数。
AI.motivation: 现有SAE家族使用固定的编码器非线性（ReLU, JumpReLU, TopK），硬编码了特定的稀疏机制，导致重建与稀疏性之间的权衡失真。需要一种更灵活、能自适应预激活几何结构的激活函数来统一并改进现有方法。
AI.method: 两阶段流水线：(1) 初始化阶段：复制预训练基线SAE权重，通过松弛Remez交换在合成数据上拟合有理系数，并校准尺度参数与有理系数；(2) 微调阶段：在标准稀疏正则化重建目标下微调。核心是用可训练的有理函数替代固定激活函数。
AI.result: 在三个开源语言模型的残差流激活上，对所有三种基线激活族（ReLU, JumpReLU, TopK），RSAE在微调后严格改进了重建指标和下游行为指标，且不损失特征层面的可解释性。改进在不同模型、激活族和稀疏度范围上一致，额外参数极少，可在单张消费级GPU上数分钟内完成。
AI.conclusion: 可训练的有理激活函数能灵活近似现有SAE激活函数并适应数据几何结构，提供了一种低成本、高回报的SAE改进方案，有望成为SAE架构的通用升级。

title: VGPT-RSI for RH-Adjacent Formal Progress: Boundary Certificates, Verified Finite Lagarias Inequalities, and Explicit Failure Localization
summary: The Riemann Hypothesis remains one of the central unsolved problems in mathematics. Rather than claiming proof, we investigate whether a verifiable AI-assisted reasoning system can produce reliable, formally checked partial progress while explicitly identifying the remaining mathematical obstructions. We apply the Verifiable Growing Physical Transformer with Recursive Self-Improvement (VGPT-RSI) to two RH-adjacent certification tasks. First, we construct and verify a finite RH-boundary certificate for inequality on a parameterized safe lower curve over a region. The numerical boundary curve is converted into a certificate-backed lower curve, audited using outward-rounded interval arithmetic and Arb/FLINT ball arithmetic, and then checked in Rocq/CoqInterval for the parameterized theorem. Second, we initiate a formal Lagarias-route certificate. Lagarias criterion states that RH is equivalent to the global inequality. We formalize the finite quantity and produce a Coq-checked finite certificate. The final system identifies the exact unresolved mathematical bottlenecks: formalizing the Lagarias equivalence, proving the global tail theorem beyond any finite cutoff, and potentially reducing counterexamples to colossally abundant or related extremal integers. These results demonstrate that VGPT-RSI can produce certified RH-adjacent formal progress, organize proof dependencies, and avoid overclaiming when the remaining obstruction is genuinely mathematical.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种可验证的AI辅助推理系统VGPT-RSI，用于对黎曼猜想（RH）相关的部分任务进行形式化验证。系统成功构造了RH边界证书和Lagarias路线证书，并在Coq等证明助手中完成了形式化检查，同时明确指出了未被解决的数学障碍（如Lagarias等价性的形式化、全局尾部定理的证明等），避免了过度声称。
AI.motivation: 黎曼猜想是数学中核心未解决问题。作者并非试图证明RH，而是探索能否构建一个可验证的AI辅助推理系统，在明确识别剩余数学障碍的前提下，产生可靠、经形式化检查的部分进展。
AI.method: 采用VGPT-RSI（可验证的成长型物理变换器与递归自改进）框架，应用于两类RH邻近的认证任务：（1）构造并验证RH边界证书：将数值边界曲线转化为证书支持的下界曲线，使用外向舍入区间算术和Arb/FLINT球算术审计，并在Rocq/CoqInterval中检查参数化定理；（2）启动形式化Lagarias路线证书：形式化Lagarias准则中的有限量，生成Coq检查的有限证书。
AI.result: 系统成功产生了经过认证的RH邻近形式化进展，组织了证明依赖关系，并明确识别了未被解决的数学瓶颈：形式化Lagarias等价性、证明超越有限截断的全局尾部定理、以及可能将反例约化到超穷大或相关极值整数。
AI.conclusion: VGPT-RSI能够产生经过认证的RH邻近形式化进展，组织证明依赖关系，并在剩余障碍是真正的数学问题时避免过度声称，展示了AI辅助形式化推理在重大数学问题上的可行应用范式。

title: PACUTE: Phonology-, Affix-, and Character-level Understanding of Tokens for Filipino
summary: Large language models (LLMs) process text as sequences of subword tokens, which can obscure the character-level and morphological structure that underlies word formation. This limitation is most acute for languages with non-concatenative morphology, where standard tokenizers systematically misalign token boundaries with morpheme boundaries. We introduce PACUTE, a diagnostic benchmark of 4,600 tasks designed to evaluate morphological understanding in Filipino, a language characterized by productive infixation, reduplication, and diacritic-driven lexical distinctions that are typically absent from written text. PACUTE includes a hierarchical diagnostic framework of six compositional levels that localizes where morphological understanding breaks down. Evaluating open-weight LLMs and frontier commercial models, we find that open-weight models perform near chance on morpheme decomposition regardless of scale. Frontier models perform much better, often recovering individual affixes under contains-match scoring, but remain far below their character-level ceilings on compositional tasks of morpheme transformations and syllabification. These results identify productive morphological composition, rather than character access alone, as the persistent bottleneck for Filipino word-structure understanding.

AI.tldr: 本文提出PACUTE基准测试集（4,600个任务），评估LLM对菲律宾语形态结构的理解能力。发现开源模型在语素分解上近乎随机表现，前沿模型虽能识别部分词缀但在语素变换和音节划分等组合任务上远低于字符级上限，揭示产出性形态组合而非字符访问是核心瓶颈。
AI.motivation: LLM将文本处理为子词token序列，这掩盖了字符级和形态结构，尤其对非拼接形态语言（如菲律宾语）问题严重——标准tokenizer的系统性错位会导致词边界与语素边界不一致。
AI.method: 构建PACUTE基准，包含6个组合层次的诊断框架（从字符识别到形态变换），针对菲律宾语的中缀、重叠、变音符号等特征设计4,600项任务，评估开源与前沿商业模型。
AI.result: 开源模型在语素分解任务上接近随机水平；前沿模型在包含匹配评分下能较好恢复单个词缀，但在语素变换和音节划分的组合任务上远低于字符级理论上限。
AI.conclusion: 菲律宾语词汇结构理解的核心瓶颈在于产出性形态组合能力，而非简单的字符级访问权限。

title: Unlocking Latent Dimensions: Exploring Representations of Large-Scale X-ray Scattering Data using Variational Autoencoders
summary: Scientific user facilities generate X-ray scattering data faster than traditional workflows can process them. We address this challenge across two settings, offline dataset exploration and live on-the-fly analysis. We train a domain-specific attention-based Convolutional Variational Autoencoder (C-VAE) on 1.5 million X-ray scattering images to learn low-dimensional representations capturing structural variation across diverse experimental conditions. The learned latent space reveals well-organized clusters and smooth trajectories reflecting experimental progression. It further supports controlled synthetic scattering image generation across diverse structural states. When deployed without retraining, the model organizes time-resolved film formation experiments at two synchrotron facilities into interpretable latent structures. Benchmarking against DINOv3 (ViT-7B), a general-purpose vision foundation model, demonstrates that domain-specific training yields more interpretable latent organization for scattering data. Both workflows are integrated within Latent Space Explorer, a component of the MLExchange platform, supporting interactive structural exploration across archived datasets and live experiments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对科学用户设施中X射线散射数据处理速度滞后的挑战，提出了一种基于注意力机制的卷积变分自编码器（C-VAE），在150万张散射图像上训练得到低维潜在表示，支持离线数据集探索和实时在线分析。该模型能形成可解释的潜在空间结构，并在两个同步辐射设施的时间分辨薄膜实验中无需重新训练即可泛化应用。与通用视觉基础模型DINOv3对比，领域专用训练产生更优的潜在组织。系统已集成到MLExchange平台的Latent Space Explorer中。
AI.motivation: 科学用户设施产生的X射线散射数据量远超传统工作流的处理能力，急需高效的数据处理方法以支持离线数据集探索和实时在线分析。
AI.method: 训练一个基于注意力机制的卷积变分自编码器（C-VAE），在150万张X射线散射图像上学习低维潜在表示；利用潜在空间进行数据聚类、轨迹分析和受控合成图像生成；跨设施部署验证泛化能力；与DINOv3（ViT-7B）通用视觉基础模型进行对比基准测试。
AI.result: 潜在空间呈现良好组织的聚类结构和反映实验进展的平滑轨迹；支持跨结构状态的受控合成散射图像生成；在两个不同同步辐射设施的时间分辨实验中无需重新训练即可形成可解释的潜在结构；领域专用训练在散射数据上比DINOv3通用模型获得更可解释的潜在组织。
AI.conclusion: 领域专用的C-VAE方法能有效处理X射线散射数据，支持离线探索和实时分析，并已集成到MLExchange平台的Latent Space Explorer中，为科学用户设施提供了一个实用的交互式结构探索工具。

title: Towards Verifiable Agentic Data Science: Solving Irregular TSQA Via Tool-Grounded Reasoning
summary: Time series data in real-world deployments is overwhelmingly irregular. Observations are asynchronous, missing values are informative rather than random, and sampling frequencies vary across sensors and operational windows. However, existing Time Series Question Answering (TSQA) benchmarks mostly assume regularly sampled inputs, leaving a fundamental gap in understanding how large language models (LLMs) and AI agents perform under irregular conditions. To bridge this gap, we introduce IRTS-ToolBench, a benchmark of 1,700 questions spanning 10 task types across 13 domains. IRTS-ToolBench is designed to be used independently by any researcher working on LLM-based irregular time series analysis, providing standardized inputs and a reproducible evaluation protocol. Code can be found in https://github.com/SanhornC/IRTS-ToolBench.

AI.tldr: IRTS-ToolBench是一个包含1,700个问题、覆盖10种任务类型和13个领域的不规则时间序列问答基准，旨在填补现有TSQA基准主要假设规则采样、忽略实际部署中不规则性的空白，为基于LLM的不规则时间序列分析提供标准化输入和可复现评估协议。
AI.motivation: 现实世界中的时间序列数据普遍存在不规则性（异步观测、缺失值具信息性、采样频率因传感器和操作窗口而异），但现有时间序列问答基准大多假设规则采样输入，未能评估LLM和AI智能体在不规则条件下的表现，存在根本性研究空白。
AI.method: 构建了IRTS-ToolBench基准，包含1,700个问题，覆盖10种任务类型和13个领域，提供标准化输入和可复现评估协议。
AI.result: 建立了首个专门针对不规则时间序列问答的标准化基准，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: IRTS-ToolBench填补了不规则时间序列QA评估的空白，可被任何研究LLM不规则时间序列分析的研究者独立使用。

title: Can Agents Read the Room? Benchmarking Visual Social Intelligence in Multimodal Simulation
summary: Social interaction depends on both language and visible social signals, such as facial expressions, posture, gaze, and emotional shifts. Yet existing social-agent benchmarks are largely text-based and rarely test whether multimodal agents can use visual cues to guide interaction. We introduce \textsc{\benchmarkname{}}, a benchmark evaluating visual social intelligence in multimodal social simulation. It contains 240 scenarios, 585 role instances, and 2,340 role-task instances, combining aligned textual-visual evidence, structured role profiles, and four role-level tasks: expression task, characteristic task, interaction regulation task, and interaction outcome task. Evaluating seven recent MLLMs under verbalized-vision and direct-vision reveals a clear gap between local role enactment and interaction management: role-specific expression and conflict handling are near saturation, whereas interaction regulation and visually grounded outcome achievement remain substantially more difficult. The code is released at https://github.com/JunsWan/AgentViSS, and the dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/JunsWan/AgentViSS.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了AgentViSS基准，用于评估多模态社会模拟中的视觉社交智能。基准包含240个场景、585个角色实例和2,340个角色任务实例，结合图文对齐证据、结构化角色档案和四个角色级任务。对七个最新MLLM的评估显示，局部角色扮演和冲突处理接近饱和，但交互调节和视觉接地结果达成仍然困难。
AI.motivation: 现有社交智能基准大多基于文本，很少测试多模态智能体是否能够利用视觉线索（如面部表情、姿势、目光、情绪变化）来指导社交互动，缺乏对视觉社交智能的评估。
AI.method: 构建包含240个场景、585个角色实例和2,340个角色任务实例的多模态社交模拟基准，结合图文对齐证据和结构化角色档案，设计四个角色级任务（表情、特征、交互调节、交互结果），在verbalized-vision和direct-vision两种设置下评估七个MLLM。
AI.result: 局部角色表达和冲突处理接近饱和，而交互调节和视觉接地结果达成仍然具有显著困难，揭示了局部角色扮演与整体交互管理之间的能力差距。
AI.conclusion: 当前多模态大语言模型在视觉社交智能方面存在能力鸿沟，尤其在需要全局交互调节和视觉接地结果的任务上表现不佳，为未来多模态社交智能研究提供了评估方向和改进空间。

title: How Should World Models Be Evaluated? A Decision-Making-Centric Position
summary:
World models have rapidly become one of the central abstractions in modern AI. Yet the term now refers to several different objects: action-conditioned environment models, latent imagination models, future-video predictors, interactive neural simulators, latent predictive representations, and synthetic-data engines. Evaluation has broadened with the term. Recent papers measure video realism, perceptual similarity, instruction following, physical plausibility, policy ranking, executability, planning success, and downstream policy improvement. The result is not only metric diversity but also a recurring problem of claim/evidence mismatch: papers frequently make a stronger claim about what their model is useful for than their evaluation can actually establish.
  This paper surveys the recent literature and argues that the central question is use-dependent. When a model is presented as a world model for embodied decision-making, a more decisive issue is not whether it generates visually compelling videos, but whether it supports reliable counterfactual reasoning, policy evaluation, planning, and policy optimization under intervention, policy-induced distribution shift, and long-horizon rollout. We organize the literature using an L0--L7 ladder that ranges from visual plausibility to policy optimization utility. In our interpretation, L0--L3 are most naturally read as diagnostics of generated artifacts, L4 is often the first genuinely interventional test, and L5--L7 provide the most direct evidence of decision usefulness. Based on this diagnosis, we propose a decision-making-centric evaluation framework and a benchmark protocol that foreground counterfactual action fidelity, closed-loop rollout validity, reward/value prediction, policy-ranking agreement, optimization lift, model exploitability, and uncertainty calibration.

AI.tldr: 本文系统梳理了世界模型在具身决策中的评估问题，指出现有评估指标多样但存在“声明与证据不匹配”的问题，提出以决策为中心的L0-L7评估阶梯框架，并建议重点关注反事实推理、策略优化等决策实用性指标。
AI.motivation: 当前“世界模型”概念泛化，涵盖多种不同对象，评估指标多样但存在严重的声明与证据不匹配问题——论文常对其模型实用性做出强声明，但所用评估无法支撑该声明。亟需建立以决策为中心的统一评估框架。
AI.method: 系统调研近期文献，提出L0-L7评估阶梯（从视觉合理性到策略优化效用），将不同评估指标按决策实用性分级，并设计以决策为中心的基准协议。
AI.result: 识别出L0-L3主要诊断生成伪影，L4是首个真正的干预测试，L5-L7提供最直接的决策有用性证据。提出包含反事实动作保真度、闭环 rollout 有效性、奖励/价值预测、策略排序一致性、优化提升、模型可利用性和不确定性校准等维度的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的评估应以决策实用性为核心，而非视觉质量。L0-L7阶梯为不同研究提供了清晰的定位与评估指导，有助于解决声明与证据不匹配的问题。

title: CONCORD: Asynchronous Sparse Aggregation for Device-Cloud RAG under Document Isolation
comment: to be published in IEEE ICWS 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) has emerged as a pivotal technique for improving language models by incorporating external knowledge at inference time. As device-cloud collaborative inference makes it feasible to deploy small language models on edge devices, a new setting arises in which private documents remain on the device and public knowledge resides in the cloud. Privacy and policy constraints often forbid raw document exchange, creating a document-isolated dual-end RAG setting. However, existing methods rely on frequent remote synchronization and dense evidence transfer, limiting throughput under realistic latency and bandwidth conditions. To address this issue, we propose CONCORD, an asynchronous sparse aggregation framework for dual-end RAG under document isolation. CONCORD treats the cloud as an asynchronously arriving evidence source rather than a continuously synchronized co-generator. Specifically, we introduce waiting debt control to decide whether each decoding step should continue waiting for remote participation based on the observed return of waiting. We also design a certificate-guided minimal supplementation mechanism that requests only the remote evidence needed to determine the current greedy decision. Steps that consult the cloud preserve the same greedy token as dense dual-end aggregation, while the remaining steps commit locally without remote evidence. Experiments on Natural Questions and WikiText-2 show that CONCORD improves end-to-end throughput over baselines by $1.66\times$ and $2.15\times$, respectively, while reducing per-token communication by over two orders of magnitude and maintaining comparable answer quality and perplexity.

AI.tldr: CONCORD是一个面向文档隔离场景下双端RAG的异步稀疏聚合框架，通过等待债务控制和证书引导的最小补充机制，在保持答案质量的同时，提升了1.66-2.15倍吞吐量并降低两个数量级的通信量。
AI.motivation: 在设备-云协同推理中，私有文档留在设备端、公有知识在云端，由于隐私和政策限制禁止原始文档交换，形成了文档隔离的双端RAG场景。现有方法依赖频繁远程同步和密集证据传输，在现实延迟和带宽条件下吞吐量受限。
AI.method: 提出CONCORD框架，包含两个核心机制：(1) 等待债务控制——根据等待的观察收益决定每个解码步是否继续等待远程参与；(2) 证书引导的最小补充机制——仅请求确定当前贪心决策所需的远程证据。将云端视为异步到达的证据源而非连续同步的协同生成器。
AI.result: 在Natural Questions和WikiText-2上，CONCORD相比基线分别提升1.66倍和2.15倍端到端吞吐量，每token通信量降低两个数量级以上，同时保持可比的答案质量和困惑度。
AI.conclusion: CONCORD通过异步稀疏聚合有效解决了文档隔离双端RAG场景下的通信瓶颈问题，实现了效率与质量的良好平衡。

title: Beyond Layer Importance in Layer-wise Sparsity: An Inter-Layer Perturbation-Absorption Perspective
comment: 10 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Submitted to EMNLP 2026
summary: The considerable layer-wise redundancy in large language models (LLMs) has established non-uniform sparsity allocation across layers as the standard pruning approach for efficient compression. Existing layer-wise allocation methods that estimate allocation strategy from local signals such as activation outliers or weight spectra mainly derive from local layer importance, whereas the final post-pruning performance is also influenced by the network's subsequent compensatory capacity. In this paper, we directly characterize this property through controlled perturbation experiments. We make the following empirical findings. First, layers exhibit highly heterogeneous responses to pruning-scale perturbations. In most cases, early layers amplify perturbations, while middle and late layers actively absorb them, with relative L2 drift decreasing monotonically across depth and direction realigning toward the unperturbed hidden-state trajectory. Second, absorption is a large-perturbation phenomenon. Under small perturbations the network exhibits amplification across all layers, and the transition to absorption occurs smoothly as perturbation magnitude grows to pruning scale. This enriches the linearized accumulation theory underlying related works. Building on these findings, we define an absorption coefficient per layer and propose absorption-aware correction, an orthogonal augmentation that improves OWL and AlphaPruning by reducing perplexity by 7.13% and boosting zero-shot accuracy by 1.02% across multiple model families at 70% sparsity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过控制扰动实验发现LLM中不同层对剪枝扰动的响应存在异质性：浅层放大扰动，中深层吸收扰动，并基于此提出吸收系数感知的校正方法，在70%稀疏度下将困惑度降低7.13%，零样本准确率提升1.02%。
AI.motivation: 现有非均匀层间剪枝方法主要基于激活异常值或权重谱等局部信号估计分配策略，但忽略了网络后续的补偿能力对剪枝后性能的影响。本文旨在直接刻画这一补偿特性，以提升剪枝效果。
AI.method: 通过受控扰动实验发现：1) 浅层放大扰动，中深层主动吸收扰动，相对L2漂移随深度单调递减且方向重新对齐；2) 吸收是大扰动现象，小扰动下各层均放大，随扰动增大平滑过渡到吸收。基于此定义每层的吸收系数，提出吸收感知校正作为正交增强方法。
AI.result: 在70%稀疏度下，该方法在多个模型家族上将OWL和AlphaPruning的困惑度降低7.13%，零样本准确率提升1.02%。
AI.conclusion: 中深层网络具有主动吸收剪枝扰动的能力，利用这一特性进行吸收感知校正可以有效改善现有剪枝方法的性能。

title: Transformers Learn the Mestre-Nagao Heuristic
summary: We train a two-layer transformer encoder to classify rational elliptic curves $E/\mathbb{Q}$ of conductor $\leq 10000$ as either rank 0 or rank 1 from the first 128 normalized Frobenius traces. We achieve >99% accuracy on both classes, and accuracy is essentially unchanged on test curves with no isogeny or quadratic-twist relative in the training set. We then apply techniques from mechanistic interpretability such as attention analysis, linear probing, activation patching, logit attribution, and neuron-level circuit analysis to reverse-engineer the algorithm the (centroid in function space) model learned. We find that a sparse circuit of 20 out of 512 layer-1 MLP neurons is sufficient for rank prediction under a linear probe with an AUROC of 0.992 at plateau, implementing a push-pull detector architecture of rank-0 and rank-1 detectors with a one-sided readout. However, we notice that the model has sub-optimal readout problems indicating a mismatch in rank-order between the readout pathway and the discriminative circuit. Critically, the learned input weights of the top discriminating neuron match the Mestre-Nagao sum heuristic weights $\log(p)/(p\cdot \log{B})$ with a Spearman coefficient $r = 0.997$ and Pearson coefficient $r = 0.952$: the model has learnt a result from analytic number theory from the Frobenius trace data alone. We additionally find that all 50 independently trained models concentrate CLS attention on prime positions at 2-50$\times$ the rate of composite positions. The CLS embedding encodes $\log{L(E,1)}$ with $R^2 = 0.962\pm 0.011$ across the 50 models (after controlling for the conductor). Activation patching analysis reveals that attention weights are dissociated from causal information flow. Additionally, the 50 solutions from training are near-identical in function space (with pairwise agreement $>$98.8%) despite large weight space barriers.

AI.tldr: 训练一个两层Transformer编码器，利用前128个归一化Frobenius迹对$\mathbb{Q}$上导子$\leq 10000$的有理椭圆曲线进行秩0/秩1分类，准确率>99%。通过机械可解释性技术发现：一个仅含20个MLP神经元的稀疏电路即可实现近乎完美的秩预测；顶部判别神经元的输入权重与Mestre-Nagao和启发式权重高度匹配（Spearman r=0.997）；CLS嵌入编码了$\log{L(E,1)}$（R²=0.962）；50个独立训练的模型在函数空间几乎等同（ pairwise agreement >98.8%），但权重空间存在巨大差异。
AI.motivation: 理解Transformer模型从椭圆曲线Frobenius迹数据中学习到的算法机制，验证模型是否学习到了有意义的数论规律，并探索机械可解释性在数学领域的应用。
AI.method: 训练两层Transformer编码器，使用前128个归一化Frobenius迹作为输入；应用注意力分析、线性探测、激活修补、logit归因和神经元级电路分析等机械可解释性技术；分析50个独立训练模型的函数空间一致性。
AI.result: 模型在秩0/秩1分类上达到>99%准确率；20个MLP神经元构成push-pull检测器架构；顶部神经元权重与Mestre-Nagao和启发式高度相关（Spearman r=0.997）；CLS嵌入编码$\log{L(E,1)}$（R²=0.962）；注意力集中在素数位置；50个模型函数空间高度一致（>98.8%）但权重空间存在障碍。
AI.conclusion: Transformer模型从数据中自发学习到了解析数论中的Mestre-Nagao和启发式方法；机械可解释性技术成功揭示了模型内部的数学学习机制；函数空间收敛但权重空间存在障碍，表明存在多种参数化方式实现相同函数。

title: CogGuard: Cognitive and Operational Profiling for Proactive Warning in Edge Intelligent Services
summary: Proactive warning is an important capability for edge intelligent services, where the system predicts whether a subject will successfully complete an incoming task under strict latency and privacy constraints. Such prediction depends on both long-term static attributes and short-term dynamic states derived from historical interaction logs. Recent Large Language Models (LLMs) offer strong long-context reasoning for constructing structured profiles from these logs, but existing solutions face two challenges for edge deployment: (1) profiling methods are typically domain-specific and lack a reusable abstraction across service scenarios, and (2) fine-tuning alignment models on heterogeneous edge clusters incurs high synchronization overhead due to the variance in input sequence lengths. To address these challenges, we propose CogGuard, a proactive-warning framework for edge intelligent services. CogGuard decouples offline LLM-based profile construction from online Small Language Model (SLM)-based score prediction through a shared static-dynamic profile-to-score pipeline, and instantiates it in two representative scenarios: educational performance warning and operational task outcome warning. For efficient profile construction, we design scenario-specific profiling methods with prefix-aligned KV-cache reuse to reduce repeated encoding overhead. For edge-side model alignment, we propose a length-aware distributed fine-tuning strategy with contrastive regularization to mitigate workload imbalance on heterogeneous clusters. Experiments on education and operation datasets show that CogGuard reduces profile construction time by up to 48% and distributed fine-tuning time by 19%, while achieving MAEs of 13.4 and 5.9, respectively, on 100-point-scale warning tasks. In the largest educational setting, CogGuard reduces prediction error by 15.4% compared with the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: CogGuard是一个面向边缘智能服务的主动预警框架，通过解耦离线LLM画像构建与在线SLM评分预测，结合前缀对齐KV缓存复用和长度感知分布式微调策略，在教育和运营任务上分别将画像构建时间降低48%、分布式微调时间降低19%，并在100分量表上达到13.4和5.9的MAE。
AI.motivation: 边缘智能服务需要在严格的延迟和隐私约束下预测用户能否成功完成即将到来的任务，这依赖于从历史交互日志中提取的长期静态属性和短期动态状态。现有方法存在两个挑战：(1) 画像构建方法通常是领域特定的，缺乏跨服务场景的可复用抽象；(2) 在异构边缘集群上微调对齐模型因输入序列长度差异导致高同步开销。
AI.method: CogGuard提出离线LLM画像构建与在线SLM评分预测解耦的静态-动态画像到评分流水线，设计场景特定的画像构建方法并采用前缀对齐KV缓存复用减少重复编码开销；提出长度感知分布式微调策略结合对比正则化缓解异构集群上的工作负载不平衡。
AI.result: 在教育与运营数据集上，CogGuard将画像构建时间降低48%，分布式微调时间降低19%；在100分量表预警任务上分别达到13.4和5.9的MAE；在最大教育场景中，预测误差相比最强基线降低15.4%。
AI.conclusion: CogGuard通过LLM-SLM解耦架构和长度感知分布式训练策略，有效解决了边缘智能服务中主动预警的效率与领域泛化问题，验证了其在教育和运营两个代表性场景中的有效性。

title: AmchiBias: Measuring Stereotypical Bias in Goan Identity Groups with a Minimal Pair Dataset in English and Konkani
comment: The 1st Workshop on Stereotypes Across Cultures in Language Technologies
summary: Socio-cultural stereotypical bias is an important consideration in the development and deployment of NLP systems. It is however often considered only at the national level, despite rich subnational socio-cultural structures. We present AmchiBias, the first benchmark for measuring socio-cultural stereotypical bias for the Indian state of Goa with its unique historically multicultural setting. It covers various Goan identity groups and comprises 313 minimal pairs across eight sociodemographic dimensions in both English and Devanagari Konkani. We then evaluate stereotypical bias in five multilingual encoder models on this benchmark. We find near-chance scores in Konkani, reflecting language incompetence for general multilingual models and a lack of Goan cultural competence for Indian language models. Queried in English, models with a stronger Indian language coverage show higher bias for pan-Indian groups than hyperlocal Goan groups. This suggests the English signal reflects pan-Indian pretraining associations rather than genuine Goan cultural knowledge. Our findings highlight a critical gap in low-resource multilingual NLP evaluation for hyperlocal community identities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了AmchiBias，首个针对印度果阿地区社会文化刻板印象偏见的基准测试，包含313个最小对立对，涵盖8个社会人口维度，使用英语和天城文孔卡尼语。评估5个多语言编码模型后发现：模型在孔卡尼语上表现接近随机（反映语言能力不足和缺乏果阿文化知识）；用英语查询时，印度语言覆盖更强的模型对泛印度群体的偏见高于果阿本地群体，说明其英语信号反映的是泛印度预训练关联而非真实的果阿文化知识。研究揭示了低资源多语言NLP在超本地社区身份评估方面的关键缺口。
AI.motivation: 社会文化刻板印象偏见在NLP系统开发中很重要，但现有研究通常只考虑国家层面，忽视了丰富的次国家（子国家）社会文化结构。印度果阿地区具有独特的多元历史文化背景，却缺乏相应的偏见评估基准。
AI.method: 构建AmchiBias基准：包含313个最小对立对，涵盖果阿多个身份群体和8个社会人口维度（英语和天城文孔卡尼语）。使用该基准评估5个多语言编码器模型的刻板印象偏见。
AI.result: 孔卡尼语上模型表现接近随机，反映语言能力不足和果阿文化知识缺失；英语查询时，印度语言覆盖更强的模型对泛印度群体偏见更高，对果阿本地群体偏见较低。
AI.conclusion: 低资源多语言NLP模型缺乏超本地社区文化的表征能力，现有评估方式忽视了次国家层面的文化多样性。英语信号反映的是泛印度预训练关联而非真实的本地文化知识。

title: Temporal Difference Learning for Diffusion Models
summary: Diffusion models are typically trained with objectives that focus on local denoising targets at individual time steps (or adjacent pairs), which do not enforce consistency between predictions along the denoising trajectory. This lack of cross-time consistency can degrade performance, especially for few-step samplers. We introduce a temporal difference (TD) objective that penalizes inconsistency of the model's multi-step progress along the denoising path. By reformulating the diffusion process as a Markov reward process and casting denoising as a policy evaluation problem in reinforcement learning, we derive a unified TD approach that applies to both discrete- and continuous-time diffusion formulations. We further propose a principled sample-based reweighting method that stabilizes training. Empirically, we show that using our TD training can significantly improve sample quality measured by FID, with stronger advantages when the number of sampling steps is small, highlighting its practical utility under low-computation-budget scenarios. We provide ablation studies to justify our design choices, including pairwise loss reweighting, regularization weight, and one-step stride. Overall, our TD approach can be a general drop-in that enforces cross-time consistency and improves generation quality across different diffusion generative models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种时序差分（TD）目标函数，通过将扩散过程重新表述为马尔可夫奖励过程，并将去噪视为强化学习中的策略评估问题，来惩罚去噪轨迹上预测的不一致性，从而提升扩散模型的样本质量，尤其在少步采样场景下优势显著。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型的目标函数仅关注单个时间步（或相邻步）的局部去噪，缺乏沿去噪轨迹的跨时间一致性约束，导致模型在少步采样时性能下降。
AI.method: 将扩散过程建模为马尔可夫奖励过程，去噪视为强化学习中的策略评估问题，推导出统一的时序差分（TD）目标函数，适用于离散和连续时间扩散公式；并提出基于样本的 principled 重加权方法来稳定训练。
AI.result: TD训练显著提升了样本质量（FID指标），在采样步数少时优势更强；消融实验验证了成对损失重加权、正则化权重和一步跨度等设计选择的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TD目标函数是一种通用的即插即用方法，能够强制跨时间一致性并提升不同扩散生成模型的生成质量。

title: Attribute Inference from Interactive Targeted Ads
summary:
Targeted advertising systems can pair audiences selected by advertisers with ad units that expose visible user actions. When an interaction remains linked to the campaign that elicited it, the advertiser may receive an observation tied to a user rather than only an aggregate report. We model that channel as a noisy oracle for attribute inference. The model separates targeting predicates, exposure, interaction, and disclosure. These boundaries capture the gap between eligibility and delivery, and the gap between interaction and advertiser visibility.
  We build a reproducible benchmark using synthetic populations calibrated with public data, each with known sensitive labels. A generated campaign semantics layer provides topic variants and response priors. The simulator generates the ground truth, event traces, disclosed observations, and metrics. The evaluation compares Bayesian, supervised, positive and unlabeled, and adaptive attacks under common campaign and disclosure definitions.
  The final evaluation uses four topic variants, seven simulator seeds, and two interaction settings. Repeated campaigns with identity exposure produce measurable but bounded inference signal. At $160$ campaigns, Bayesian and supervised attacks reach about $0.64$ AUC in the main setting and about $0.65$ AUC in the higher interaction setting. Disclosure policy is the strongest control. Aggregate reporting removes the evaluated oracle input tied to users. Type filtering and randomized disclosure reduce the released signal. The result is a model, artifact, and defense evaluation method for privacy in interactive targeted advertising. The code is available at https://github.com/P-HOW/Interactive-Ad-Oracle.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了定向广告系统中用户交互暴露导致的属性推断隐私风险，建立了包含目标谓词、曝光、交互和披露边界的噪声预言机模型，并通过合成种群模拟器评估了多种推断攻击，发现披露策略是最有效的控制手段。
AI.motivation: 定向广告系统中，广告商可能通过用户与广告的交互观察到与用户关联的信号，从而推断用户敏感属性。现有研究缺乏对交互式广告中这种属性推断信道的形式化建模和系统化评估。
AI.method: 提出噪声预言机模型，分离目标谓词、曝光、交互和披露四个边界；基于公共数据校准合成种群并生成广告活动语义层；构建模拟器生成真实标签、事件轨迹、披露观测和评估指标；比较贝叶斯、监督学习、正无标签学习和自适应攻击。
AI.result: 在4个主题变体、7个模拟种子和2种交互设置下，重复160次广告活动后贝叶斯和监督攻击在主要设置中达到约0.64 AUC，高交互设置中约0.65 AUC。披露策略是最强的控制手段，汇总报告消除了预言机输入，类型过滤和随机化披露减少了释放信号。
AI.conclusion: 提出了交互式定向广告中隐私问题的模型、工件和防御评估方法，代码已开源。

title: Spokes: Optimizing for Diverse Pretraining Data Selection
summary: Diversity plays a critical role in data selection, improving performance under fixed data budgets by reducing redundancy and repetition. However, optimizing for diversity is inherently challenging, as it is a set-level property that depends on interactions between data points rather than individual examples. As a result, existing approaches typically rely on proxies or approximations, which often fail to ensure sufficiently diverse subsets. In this work, we directly optimize diversity by introducing a probabilistic diversification framework based on the G-Vendi score, optimized via exponentiated gradient descent. Our method produces subsets that are substantially more diverse than those obtained via random sampling, achieving a +489 increase in G-Vendi score on a 500k-sample subset. We evaluate our approach on FineWeb and DCLM, where it consistently outperforms existing methods. Notably, SPOKES (diversity-only) improves average downstream performance by +0.4 and +0.5 points over random sampling on DCLM and FineWeb, respectively. More importantly, jointly optimizing for both quality and diversity yields the strongest results: SPOKES achieves gains of +1.5 and +1.4 points on DCLM and FineWeb, outperforming all baselines, including semantic deduplication and quality filtering.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于G-Vendi分数的概率多样化框架SPOKES，通过指数梯度下降直接优化数据多样性，在FineWeb和DCLM数据集上显著优于随机采样和现有方法，联合优化质量和多样性可获得最佳下游性能提升。
AI.motivation: 多样性在数据选择中至关重要，但作为集合级属性其优化具有挑战性，现有代理或近似方法往往无法确保足够的子集多样性。
AI.method: 基于G-Vendi分数构建概率多样化框架，通过指数梯度下降直接优化多样性，并联合优化数据质量和多样性。
AI.result: 在50万样本子集上G-Vendi分数提升+489；在DCLM和FineWeb上，仅多样性的SPOKES分别提升+0.4和+0.5个点；联合优化提升+1.5和+1.4个点，超越语义去重和质量过滤等基线。
AI.conclusion: 直接优化多样性比代理方法更有效，且联合优化质量和多样性可获得最强性能。

title: Physics-conforming Latent Twins
summary: Surrogate models are central to scientific machine learning, where they enable fast prediction, simulation, inference, and control for complex physical systems. For time-dependent problems, however, accurate interpolation of training trajectories is not sufficient: reliable surrogates should also respect the conservation laws, invariants, admissibility conditions, and dissipative structures that give those trajectories physical meaning. We introduce Physics-conforming Latent Twins, a framework for learning latent surrogate solution operators whose dynamics satisfy selected physical principles by design. The method builds on the Latent Twin formulation by jointly learning an encoder, a decoder, and a latent flow map between arbitrary time-indexed states, while constraining the latent dynamics to preserve or dissipate prescribed structural quantities. We develop a constraint-transfer viewpoint that connects physical structure in the original state space with compatible constraints in latent space, and prove structure-preservation bounds showing how latent enforcement improves control of physical defects after decoding. We also derive algebraic conditions for latent flow maps that preserve linear and quadratic invariants or enforce dissipative inequalities. Numerical experiments on representative ODE and PDE benchmarks demonstrate improved constraint satisfaction, structural fidelity, and qualitative long-time behavior while maintaining accurate surrogate prediction.

AI.tldr: 提出物理一致潜影双胞胎(PCLT)框架，通过约束潜在动力学满足选定的物理原理（守恒律、不变量、耗散结构），在保持代理预测精度的同时提高结构保真度。
AI.motivation: 传统代理模型能准确插值训练轨迹，但无法保证满足物理系统的守恒律、不变量、可容许条件和耗散结构，导致长时间演化失去物理意义。
AI.method: 基于潜影双胞胎架构，联合学习编码器、解码器和潜在流映射，通过约束传递观点将原始状态空间的物理结构转化为潜在空间中的相容约束，并对潜在动力学施加线性/二次不变量保持或耗散不等式约束。
AI.result: 在代表性ODE和PDE基准上，在保持代理预测准确性的同时，显著提升了约束满足度、结构保真度和定性长时间行为。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的约束传递理论框架和代数条件使得潜在代理模型能够内在地满足物理结构，解码后物理缺陷可控，为科学机器学习中物理信息代理建模提供了新范式。

title: Visual-Seeker: Towards Visual-Native Multimodal Agentic Search via Active Visual Reasoning
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in many visual tasks, but they often struggle with factual grounding when confronted with complex, open-world scenarios. While recent multimodal deep search agents attempt to address this issue by utilizing external tools, the visual-native search paradigm remains underexplored. Existing methods primarily rely on simple images with explicit semantics and text-only evidence trajectories, limiting the agent's ability to perform multi-hop, cross-modal reasoning and search. To address these limitations, we propose Visual-Seeker, a visual-native multimodal deep search agent via active visual reasoning. Rather than treating vision as a static input, our agent actively attends to fine-grained visual details, dynamically harvests visual evidence throughout the search process. To unlock its visual-native potential, we design an active visual reasoning data pipeline and synthesize 5K high-quality multimodal trajectories for model training. Extensive experiments demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance across five challenging multimodal search benchmarks, even surpassing several proprietary models, validating robust visual-native reasoning and search in real-world web environments. The code and data can be accessed at: https://github.com/ZhengboZhang/Visual-Seeker.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Visual-Seeker，一种视觉原生的多模态深度搜索智能体，通过主动视觉推理实现细粒度视觉证据的动态采集，在五个挑战性基准上达到SOTA，甚至超越多个闭源模型。
AI.motivation: 现有MLLM在复杂开放场景中缺乏事实基础，多模态深度搜索代理主要依赖显式语义明确的简单图像和纯文本证据轨迹，缺乏多跳跨模态推理与搜索能力，视觉原生的搜索范式尚未得到充分探索。
AI.method: 提出Visual-Seeker，将视觉作为动态输入而非静态特征，通过主动注意细粒度视觉细节并在搜索过程中动态采集视觉证据；设计主动视觉推理数据管线，合成5K高质量多模态轨迹用于模型训练。
AI.result: 在五个挑战性多模态搜索基准上达到SOTA性能，超越多个闭源模型。
AI.conclusion: Visual-Seeker验证了在真实Web环境中进行视觉原生推理和搜索的有效性，代码和数据已开源。

title: Evaluating and Preserving Lexical Stress in English-to-Chinese Speech-to-Speech Translation
summary: Speech-to-speech translation (S2ST) systems have achieved impressive progress in semantic accuracy and speech naturalness. However, the cross-lingual transfer of lexical stress, a vital cue for emphasis and speaker intent, remains heavily underexplored, compounded by a lack of reliable automatic evaluation metrics for tonal languages like Chinese. We investigate English-to-Chinese S2ST stress transfer by constructing a stress-annotated Chinese dataset and an XLS-R-based Mandarin stress detector. Integrating this with the English EmphAssess system, we propose a novel objective metric for cross-lingual stress evaluation. Furthermore, we fine-tune CosyVoice3 to build a stress-aware S2ST system. Experiments demonstrate that our proposed S2ST architecture significantly outperforms existing systems in stress translation capability while maintaining competitive translation quality. Furthermore, our evaluation metric exhibits a strong correlation with human subjective judgments.

AI.tldr: 本文针对英中语音到语音翻译中词汇重音跨语言迁移问题，构建了带重音标注的中文数据集和基于XLS-R的普通话重音检测器，提出跨语言重音评估指标，并微调CosyVoice3构建重音感知S2ST系统，实验证明该方法在重音翻译能力上显著优于现有系统，且评估指标与人工判断高度相关。
AI.motivation: 现有S2ST系统在语义准确性和语音自然度上取得显著进展，但词汇重音（表达强调和说话者意图的关键线索）的跨语言迁移问题仍未得到充分探索，且缺乏针对汉语等声调语言的可靠自动评估指标。
AI.method: 构建重音标注的中文数据集；开发基于XLS-R的普通话重音检测器；结合英语EmphAssess系统提出跨语言重音评估指标；微调CosyVoice3构建重音感知S2ST系统。
AI.result: 所提出的S2ST架构在重音翻译能力上显著优于现有系统，同时保持有竞争力的翻译质量；提出的评估指标与人类主观判断呈现强相关性。
AI.conclusion: 本研究填补了英中S2ST中词汇重音跨语言迁移的空白，验证了重音感知S2ST系统的可行性，并提供了可靠的自动评估方法。

title: Size Doesn't Matter: Cosine-Scored Sparse Autoencoders
summary: Sparse autoencoders (SAEs) detect features via inner product, so a feature's activation scales with both its directional alignment and the input's norm. Under BatchTopK, high-norm tokens inflate all pre-activations simultaneously, claiming dictionary slots regardless of content alignment. This matters because sublayer normalization has already discarded the magnitude the score measures, so the encoder detects a quantity the model does not read. We replace the score with a learned blend of cosine similarity and input magnitude, letting the optimizer choose how much norm to use; a per-feature extension lets each feature decide independently. In both regimes, training is free to recover inner product but never does, with no feature ever choosing more than half-magnitude dependence. At matched reconstruction, the cosine encoder learns features that align with human-recognizable concepts far more often than standard, filling dictionary slots that inner product wastes on norm detectors. Loss reweighting that equalizes gradients barely closes the gap, confirming forward-pass score geometry as the lever. The advantage is not universal across tasks or depths, but we believe cosine scoring should be the default for dictionary learning on normalized representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出用余弦相似度替代内积作为稀疏自编码器的评分函数，避免高范数令牌（token）在BatchTopK下因范数膨胀而占据字典槽位的问题。在匹配重建损失下，余弦评分法学习到的特征更符合人类可识别概念，且训练过程不会退化回内积方式。实验表明，这种改进在前向传播评分几何层面发挥作用，但并非在所有任务和深度上都普遍优越。
AI.motivation: 标准稀疏自编码器（SAE）使用内积作为特征激活评分，这导致高范数令牌会同时抬高所有预激活值，无论其与特征方向是否对齐，从而浪费字典槽位。由于子层归一化已丢弃了模型实际不读取的幅度信息，内积评分度量了模型不关心的量。
AI.method: 将内积评分替换为余弦相似度与输入幅度的可学习混合形式，让优化器自行选择使用多少范数信息；进一步扩展为每个特征独立决定其混合比例。训练过程允许恢复内积形式，但实验发现从未发生。
AI.result: 在匹配重建损失下，余弦编码器比标准内积编码器学习到更多与人类可识别概念对齐的特征，且没有特征选择超过一半的幅度依赖。损失重新加权（均衡梯度）几乎无法缩小差距，证实了前向传播评分几何是决定性因素。
AI.conclusion: 对于归一化表示的字典学习，余弦评分应作为默认方法。但该优势并非在所有任务和深度上普遍存在。

title: Mask-Proof: An LLM-based Automated Data Curation Pipeline on Mathematical Proofs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly capable of mathematical problem solving and can even assist with research-level proofs, yet we still lack a scalable and reproducible way to measure step-level reasoning in long proofs across diverse sources. This evaluation gap limits trustworthy AI assistance in proof-certified scientific progress. Existing evaluations often emphasize final answers or rely on costly expert grading, while end-to-end proof generation remains open-ended and hard to verify automatically. We introduce Mask-Proof, a pipeline that turns real proofs into automatically checkable masked-step tasks. It masks key formula steps, provides the necessary surrounding context, and evaluates model reconstructions with an LLM-based equivalence judge using repeated votes for stability. The resulting Mask-ProofBench contains 292 curated problems across diverse research areas. Experiments with 17 models show that reasoning-enhanced models outperform standard models by 12% to 27%. Our evaluator achieves 96.8% agreement with expert annotators, enabling faithful, reproducible, and comparable measurement of step-level mathematical reasoning. Benchmark, annotations, and code are available at https://github.com/weating/Mask-Proof.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Mask-Proof流程，将真实数学证明转化为可自动检查的掩码步骤任务，构建了Mask-ProofBench基准（292个问题），并通过基于LLM的等价性判断器实现步骤级推理的忠实、可重复评估，评估器与专家一致性达96.8%。
AI.motivation: 现有评估方法要么只关注最终答案，要么依赖昂贵的专家评分，而端到端的证明生成仍然开放且难以自动验证，缺乏可扩展且可重复的步骤级推理评估方法。
AI.method: 提出Mask-Proof流水线：从真实证明中掩码关键公式步骤，提供必要的上下文，利用基于LLM的等价性判断器（通过重复投票提升稳定性）评估模型重建结果，构建包含292个跨领域问题的基准测试集。
AI.result: 在17个模型上的实验表明，推理增强模型比标准模型性能提升12%至27%；评估器与专家标注者的一致性达到96.8%。
AI.conclusion: Mask-Proof实现了对步骤级数学推理的忠实、可重复且可比较的评估，填补了长证明推理评估的空白，有助于推动可信AI在数学证明辅助方面的进展。

title: Adapting Reinforcement Learning with Chain-of-Thought Supervision for Explainable Detection of Hateful and Propagandistic Memes
summary: Hateful and propagandistic memes exploit the interplay between images and text to convey harmful intent that neither modality reveals alone. Although thinking-based multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have advanced vision-language understanding, their application to meme content moderation remains underexplored. We propose a reinforcement learning-based post-training method that improves classification performance and reference-based explanation quality in thinking-based MLLMs via task-specific rewards and Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). Concretely, we (i) conduct a systematic empirical study of off-the-shelf MLLMs for hateful and propagandistic meme understanding across English and Arabic benchmarks, (ii) extend existing meme datasets with weakly supervised chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales via distillation and multi-LLM fine-grained propaganda annotations, (iii) introduce a GRPO-based objective with thinking-length regularization that jointly optimizes classification accuracy and explanation quality, and (iv) investigate self-supervised GRPO on unlabeled memes using consensus-based pseudo-labels. Experiments on the Hateful Memes and ArMeme benchmarks show that our approach improves over previously reported results on FHM accuracy (up to +2.1%, from 79.9% to 82.0%) and on ArMeme macro-F1 (up to +7.6 points, from 0.536 to 0.612 with explanations; +6.1 compared to the original ArMeme benchmark), while also generating natural-language explanations. On ArMeme, sequence-classification baselines remain stronger in terms of raw accuracy, whereas our approach provides more balanced per-class performance along with explanations. We publicly release our code, data extensions, and evaluation resources.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于强化学习（GRPO）的后训练方法，通过任务特定奖励和思维链推理优化多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在仇恨与宣传性模因内容审核中的分类性能和可解释性，在Hateful Memes和ArMeme基准上取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 尽管思考型多模态大语言模型在视觉-语言理解方面取得进展，但其在模因内容审核（尤其是仇恨性和宣传性模因）中的应用尚未被充分探索；现有模型难以捕捉图像与文本交互产生的隐藏有害意图。
AI.method: (i) 系统实证研究现成MLLMs在英阿双语仇恨/宣传模因理解；(ii) 通过蒸馏和 multi-LLM 细粒度标注扩展模因数据集，添加弱监督思维链推理；(iii) 提出基于GRPO的目标函数（含思考长度正则化），联合优化分类准确率和解释质量；(iv) 探索基于共识伪标签的自监督GRPO在无标注模因上的应用。
AI.result: 在Hateful Memes基准上FHM准确率提升+2.1%（79.9%→82.0%）；在ArMeme基准上宏F1提升+7.6点（0.536→0.612，含解释）；相比原始ArMeme基准提升+6.1点；同时生成自然语言解释。序列分类基线在原始准确率上仍更强，但本方法在各类别上表现更均衡。
AI.conclusion: 基于GRPO的强化学习后训练可有效提升思考型MLLMs在模因内容审核中的分类与解释能力，尤其在不平衡类别上表现更优，且具有跨语言泛化能力；代码、数据和评估资源已公开。

title: Machine Learning and the Random Walk Puzzle: Forecasting the CAD/USD Exchange Rate with Expanding Window Evaluation and SHAP Interpretability
summary: This study examines whether machine learning (ML) models can outperform the naive random walk benchmark in forecasting the monthly USD/CAD exchange rate. Using daily data from the Bank of Canada spanning January 2017 to May 2026, resampled into 113 monthly observations, five ML models are evaluated: linear regression, random forest, gradient boosting, XGBoost, and AdaBoost. These models are benchmarked against the naive random walk model and exponential smoothing with Holt-Winters seasonality (ETS). All models are evaluated using an expanding-window framework to maintain strict out-of-sample integrity, and forecast-accuracy differences are assessed using the Diebold-Mariano (DM) test. Structural break detection identifies four significant breakpoints in the series, corresponding to the escalation of the US-China trade war in 2018, the COVID-19 economic recovery in 2020, the peak of the Bank of Canada rate-hiking cycle in 2022, and the start of the Bank of Canada rate-cutting cycle in 2024. SHAP, or Shapley Additive Explanations, analysis is applied to interpret the drivers of the best-performing ML model. The results show that the naive random walk model remains a formidable benchmark. Linear regression is the only model that statistically outperforms the naive random walk model, with a DM statistic of 3.0585 and a p value of 0.0071, whereas the ML ensemble models show only marginal differences. Random Forest with an expanding-window framework achieves the lowest MAPE of 1.17 percent among all models except the random walk. SHAP analysis confirms that short-term lags, particularly lag1 and lag2, and recent rolling means dominate predictions, consistent with the near-random-walk behavior of exchange rates.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了五种机器学习模型在预测美元/加元月度汇率方面是否优于随机游走基准。结果表明，线性回归是唯一在统计上显著优于随机游走的模型（DM统计量3.0585，p值0.0071），而集成模型仅表现出边际差异。扩展窗口下的随机森林取得了最低MAPE（1.17%）。SHAP分析证实短期滞后项和滚动均值主导预测，符合汇率的近随机游走特性。研究还识别了四个结构性断点，对应贸易战、疫情、加息和降息周期。
AI.motivation: 检验机器学习模型能否在外汇预测中击败看似简单但极具竞争力的随机游走基准，并识别汇率时间序列中的结构性断点，以解释模型表现的局限性。
AI.method: 使用加拿大银行2017年1月至2026年5月的日度数据重采样为113个月度观测值，采用线性回归、随机森林、梯度提升、XGBoost和AdaBoost五种模型，以随机游走和指数平滑为基准，通过扩展窗口框架保证严格的样本外评估，使用Diebold-Mariano检验评估预测精度差异，并应用SHAP进行可解释性分析。
AI.result: 线性回归是唯一在统计上显著优于随机游走的模型（DM=3.0585, p=0.0071）；集成学习模型仅表现出边际差异；扩展窗口下的随机森林实现最低MAPE（1.17%）；SHAP分析显示滞后1期、滞后2期和近期滚动均值是主导预测因子。
AI.conclusion: 随机游走模型在外汇预测中仍是强有力的基准，复杂机器学习集成模型未能显著超越该基准，线性回归的微弱优势暗示简单模型在当前预测任务中可能更具效率。

title: Feature Attribution in Directed Acyclic Graphs Using Edge Intervention
summary: Shapley value-based feature attribution methods face challenges in scenarios involving complex feature interactions and causal relationships, even when a causal structure is provided. Existing methods typically adopt a node-centric view, attributing importance solely to individual features. Consequently, they often fail to simultaneously capture the externality and exogenous influence of features, leading to unreasonable interpretations. To overcome these limitations, we propose a novel feature attribution method called DAG-SHAP, which is based on edge intervention. DAG-SHAP treats each feature edge as an individual attribution object, ensuring that both externality and exogenous contributions of features are appropriately captured. Additionally, we introduce an approximation method for efficiently computing DAG-SHAP. Extensive experiments on both real and synthetic datasets validate the effectiveness of DAG-SHAP. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZJU-DIVER/DAG-SHAP.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DAG-SHAP，一种基于边干预的特征归因方法，通过将每条特征边作为归因对象来解决现有方法在复杂特征交互和因果关系场景中无法同时捕获特征外部性和外生影响的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Shapley值的特征归因方法在复杂特征交互和因果关系场景中存在局限，即使提供了因果结构，它们通常采用节点中心视角，仅将重要性归因于单个特征，无法同时捕获特征的外部性和外生影响，导致解释不合理。
AI.method: 提出DAG-SHAP方法，基于边干预（edge intervention），将每条特征边作为独立的归因对象，同时捕获特征的外部性和外生贡献，并引入近似计算方法以提高效率。
AI.result: 在真实和合成数据集上的大量实验验证了DAG-SHAP的有效性。
AI.conclusion: DAG-SHAP通过创新的边干预视角，有效克服了传统节点中心归因方法的局限，能够更合理地解释复杂因果场景中的特征重要性。

title: Prior over Evidence: Stereotype-Driven Diagnosis in LLM-Based L2 Pronunciation Feedback
summary: Large language models are increasingly deployed for written pronunciation feedback in second-language (L2) English learning, under the assumption that their diagnoses are grounded in the supplied speech evidence rather than in priors from pretraining. This assumption is tested on 1,800 L2-Arctic utterances spanning six L1 backgrounds, three audio-capable LLMs, four pronunciation dimensions, and five evidence conditions ranging from a text-only baseline to numeric acoustic features and raw audio. Each (utterance x model x condition x dimension) cell is scored on three metrics: Rating Accuracy (RA) against gold labels, Evidence Coherence (EC) assessing internal consistency without ground truth, and Grounded Correctness (GC) evaluated against gold evidence. Results show three findings across models. First, rating accuracy and grounded reasoning decouple: 39.6% of judged cells contain internally coherent reasoning that supports a wrong rating, against only 15.8% where the reasoning supports a correct rating. Second, phoneme-level feedback converges to a fixed inventory of L2-English difficulty phones that recurs across all six L1 backgrounds and all evidence conditions. Third, acoustic evidence improves the rating only when the supplied feature directly probes the target dimension: textualised F0 range raises pitch-variation grounding from (0.18-0.19) to (0.45-0.62) across all three models, while stress and phoneme correctness, which require target-to-realisation alignment, remain ungrounded. The same audio waveform without textualised F0 values does not reproduce this improvement. These findings indicate that current general-purpose LLMs are more reliable as verbalisers of externally computed pronunciation evidence than as standalone diagnostic engines.

AI.tldr: 本研究测试了三个音频大语言模型在1800条L2-Arctic语音数据上的发音反馈能力，发现：评分准确率与基于证据的推理存在脱节（39.6%的推理内部一致但评分错误）；音素级反馈趋同于固定的L2英语难点音素库，不受L1背景和输入条件影响；声学证据仅在直接探测目标维度时提升评分（如文本化F0范围提升音高变异评分），原始音频无法复现此效果。结论：当前通用LLM更适合作为外部发音证据的言语化工具，而非独立的诊断引擎。
AI.motivation: 验证一个关键假设：LLM在二语英语发音反馈中的诊断是否真正基于所提供的语音证据，而非依赖预训练阶段的先验知识。
AI.method: 使用1800条L2-Arctic语音数据（涵盖6种母语背景），测试3个音频LLM、4个发音维度、5种证据条件（从纯文本基线到数值声学特征再到原始音频），通过评分准确率(RA)、证据一致性(EC)和基于证据的正确性(GC)三个指标进行评估。
AI.result: 1）39.6%的评估单元包含内部一致但评分错误的推理，仅15.8%的推理支持正确评分；2）音素级反馈在所有L1背景和证据条件下收敛到固定的L2英语难点音素库；3）文本化F0范围将音高变异评分从0.18-0.19提升至0.45-0.62，但原始音频无法复现此效果，重音和音素正确性维度仍无法基于证据。
AI.conclusion: 当前通用LLM更可靠的是作为外部计算出发音证据的言语化工具，而非独立的诊断引擎。

title: Phase-Localized Curation Does Not Help: A Negative Result on Per-Phase Metric Selection for Demonstration Filtering
summary: Manipulation demonstrations have temporal phase structure, and a natural hypothesis is that demonstration-curation metrics should be applied within phases rather than globally. The idea is to segment each trajectory into phases, score each phase with the metric that is locally most informative, and then aggregate. This follows directly from prior work showing that a single global metric can be the best detector of a defect and yet the worst curator of the resulting policy. We test the per-phase hypothesis on three contact-rich LIBERO pick-and-place tasks with a controlled early-release structural defect, comparing phase-gated curation against the same metrics applied uniformly and against a strong single global metric. Across all three tasks and five random seeds per condition, phase-gated curation is never the best curation strategy, and it is the worst of the three on two of the three tasks (Task 1: 86.0 vs. 92.0 for global; Task 3: 22.7 vs. 48.0 for uniform). We trace the failure to a concrete mechanism. When the defect signal is concentrated in a single phase, rank-aggregating across phases dilutes that signal with uninformative scores from defect-free phases, selecting a worse demonstration subset than simply applying the defect-informative metric everywhere. We further show that the per-phase metric selection does not transfer across tasks, since no phase shares a winning metric between any two tasks, so the selection cannot be reused and must be re-derived per task from a noisy sweep. These results bound a plausible and previously untested method, and they argue that practitioners should prefer identifying a single defect-informative metric over decomposing curation by phase. We release the full pipeline, all metric implementations, and per-seed results.

AI.tldr: 本文检验了“按阶段进行演示整理”的假设，发现在三个LIBERO拾取任务上，分阶段整理从未优于全局或统一度量策略，反而因信号稀释和度量不可迁移导致性能更差。结论是应优先寻找单一缺陷信息度量，而非按阶段分解整理。
AI.motivation: 操作演示具有阶段性时间结构，自然假设是演示整理指标应在阶段内而非全局应用。先前工作表明单一全局指标可能是最好的缺陷检测器却最差的策略整理器，因此需要检验分阶段整理是否更优。
AI.method: 在三个LIBERO拾取-放置任务上引入受控的提前释放结构缺陷，将分阶段门控整理与统一度量应用及强全局度量进行对比。每个条件使用5个随机种子，评估三种策略的整理性能。
AI.result: 分阶段门控整理从未是最佳策略，在三个任务中有两个任务上表现最差（任务1：86.0 vs 全局92.0；任务3：22.7 vs 统一48.0）。失败机制：缺陷信号集中在单一阶段时，跨阶段排序聚合会稀释信号；分阶段度量选择无法跨任务迁移。
AI.conclusion: 分阶段整理假设被证伪，实践者应优先寻找单一缺陷信息度量，而非按阶段分解整理。已发布完整流程、度量实现和逐种子结果。

title: A Formal Framework for Declarative Agentic AI in Business Process Analysis
summary: Agentic AI opens new opportunities for automating Business Process (BP), enabling autonomous decision-making and dynamic adaptation. However, realising this potential requires BP entities and their interactions to be defined with formal precision. This paper presents a formal framework for Agentic BP analysis through the AGO methodology. AGO captures the modelling perspective in terms of who is acting (Agents), why it is carried out (Goals), and what the relevant entities are (Objects). Grounded in set theory and mathematical logic, we formally define the AGO entity types and their interactions, organising all definitions into a BP Knowledge Base (BPKB). The resulting BPKB supports structured querying, incremental updates, and automatic generation of BP workflows, while ensuring soundness and completeness of the derived paths.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AGO方法论（Agent-Goal-Object），通过集合论和数学逻辑形式化定义业务流程中的智能体、目标和对象实体及其交互，构建业务流程知识库（BPKB），支持结构化查询、增量更新和自动工作流生成，并保证推导路径的合理性与完备性。
AI.motivation: Agentic AI在自动化业务流程方面具有巨大潜力，但需要以形式化精度定义BP实体及其交互关系。现有方法缺乏严格的数学基础来支持自主决策和动态适应。
AI.method: 提出AGO方法论，从三个维度（Agents, Goals, Objects）捕获建模视角；基于集合论和数学逻辑形式化定义AGO实体类型及其交互；将所有定义组织成业务流程知识库（BPKB）。
AI.result: BPKB支持结构化查询、增量更新和BP工作流的自动生成，同时保证推导路径的合理性（soundness）和完备性（completeness）。
AI.conclusion: AGO框架为Agentic BP分析提供了形式化的数学基础，能够有效支撑自主决策和动态适应场景下的业务流程自动化。

title: Replay What Matters: Off-Policy Replay for Efficient LLM Reinforcement Unlearning
summary: LLM unlearning has emerged as a cost-effective alternative to full retraining for removing hazardous knowledge from pretrained models while preserving general utility. Recent RL-based methods such as RULE reformulate unlearning as learning a refusal behavior, but their on-policy optimization repeatedly samples from the same forget and retain/boundary prompts throughout training. We identify a critical inefficiency in this process: easy cases quickly converge and provide little useful gradient signal, while hard cases near the forget/retain boundary continue to produce low-reward rollouts that are discarded after a single use. To address this issue, we propose ReRULE, an off-policy replay enhancement for reinforcement unlearning. ReRULE stores low-reward hard-case rollout groups in a replay buffer during early GRPO training and reuses them in later stages through importance-sampled off-policy updates, redirecting computation toward boundary cases that still require learning. Theoretically, we show that ReRULE yields a tighter hard-case convergence bound than pure on-policy RULE. Empirically, ReRULE improves MUSE-Books Retain Quality from 46.3 to 56.2 while adding only 5--11% training time across benchmarks. Its limited improvement on the simpler TOFU setting further supports the intended conditional behavior: replay is most beneficial when the hard/easy disparity is pronounced.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ReRULE，一种基于离策略重放增强的强化学习遗忘方法，通过存储低奖励困难样本并在后续阶段重用来解决RULE方法中易收敛样本和困难样本之间的效率不平衡问题，在MUSE-Books基准上将保留质量从46.3提升至56.2，仅增加5-11%的训练时间。
AI.motivation: 现有RL-based遗忘方法（如RULE）采用同策略优化，易样本快速收敛后提供梯度信号有限，而边界处的困难样本产生的低奖励轨迹在使用一次后被丢弃，导致计算资源浪费和效率低下。
AI.method: 提出ReRULE，在早期GRPO训练中将低奖励困难样本的轨迹组存储到经验回放缓冲区，在后续阶段通过重要性采样的离策略更新重新利用这些样本，将计算重新定向到仍需要学习的边界样本上。
AI.result: 在MUSE-Books基准上，保留质量从46.3提升至56.2，训练时间仅增加5-11%；在更简单的TOFU设置上提升有限，验证了该方法在困难/易样本差异显著时最有效。
AI.conclusion: ReRULE通过离策略回放机制有效解决了遗忘任务中的样本效率问题，理论分析表明其具有更紧的困难样本收敛界，实验验证了其有效性和条件性行为。

title: TriAdReview: Triangular Adversarial Review Architecture for Multi-Model Technical Document Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for technical document generation, yet single-model outputs often suffer from over-engineering, security blind spots, and incomplete coverage. We propose TriAdReview, a triangular adversarial review architecture that employs two independent reviewer models (engineering and boundary perspectives) and a triangular judging mechanism to iteratively improve a generator model's output. We evaluate TriAdReview across five benchmark tasks - architecture design, code generation, proposal review, security audit, and requirements analysis - using three configurations: single model (baseline), dual model (single review), and triple model (full system). Results across 75 experiments (n=5 per cell) show that the triple model configuration achieves a 10.1% overall improvement over the single model baseline (26.2 vs. 23.8 out of 50; p<0.05, paired t-test), with particularly strong gains on security audit (+27.6%), code generation (+20.8%), and architecture design (+15.6%). A second scorer (mimo-v2.5-pro) confirms the direction with a smaller effect (+2.7%), suggesting moderate inter-rater agreement. However, the system shows a -7.5% degradation on requirements analysis, revealing that adversarial review architectures have a structural bias toward simplification that is counterproductive for completeness-oriented tasks. We analyze this boundary condition through a task-type framework and demonstrate that reviewer prompt adaptation partially mitigates the issue. Our findings provide the first empirical characterization of when multi-model adversarial review helps versus harms, with implications for the design of collaborative AI systems.

AI.tldr: TriAdReview是一种三角对抗评审架构，使用两个独立的评审模型（工程视角和边界视角）和三角判断机制迭代改进生成器输出。在五项基准任务上，三模型配置相比单模型基线整体提升10.1%，但在需求分析任务上出现-7.5%的性能退化，揭示了对抗评审架构对完整性导向任务的结构性偏见。
AI.motivation: 单模型生成技术文档存在过度工程化、安全盲点和覆盖不全等问题，需要一种多模型协作的评审机制来提升输出质量。
AI.method: 提出TriAdReview三角对抗评审架构，包含两个独立评审模型（工程视角和边界视角）和一个三角判断机制，通过迭代方式改进生成器输出。在三组配置（单模型基线、双模型单评审、三模型全系统）下进行75组实验。
AI.conclusion: 首次实证刻画了多模型对抗评审在何种任务上有效或有害，揭示了其对完整性导向任务存在结构性简化偏见，评审提示适配可部分缓解该问题。

title: CODA-BENCH: Can Code Agents Handle Data-Intensive Tasks?
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026. 37 pages, 11 figures. Project page: https://coda-bench.github.io/ Code: https://github.com/ruc-datalab/CoDA-Bench Data: https://huggingface.co/datasets/RUC-DataLab/CoDA-Bench
summary: Advanced agents are increasingly demonstrating the potential to operate as autonomous engineers, creating a growing demand for evaluation benchmarks that capture the complexity of real-world development. Such environments typically involve both complex code and large-scale data (i.e., file system). However, existing benchmarks usually evaluate code-centric or data-centric capabilities in isolation, leaving a clear gap with real development scenarios. In this paper, we bridge this gap by introducing CODA-BENCH, the first benchmark to jointly evaluate code and data intelligence in a data-intensive environment. We construct a data-intensive Linux sandbox based on the Kaggle ecosystem (containing hundreds of datasets), where agents must actively explore complex file hierarchies to identify relevant resources and generate code for data-driven analytical tasks. CODA-BENCH comprises 1,009 tasks spanning 31 communities, with each task environment containing an average of 980 files, simulating realistic data scale and noise. Evaluations of advanced agents reveal that even top-performing systems struggle to effectively integrate data discovery with code execution, achieving a success rate of only 61.1%. These results highlight a substantial gap in current agentic capabilities for data-intensive tasks and point to promising directions for future research.

AI.tldr: CODA-BENCH是首个联合评估代码与数据智能的基准测试，基于Kaggle生态系统构建数据密集型Linux沙箱，包含1009个任务（平均980个文件/任务），测试发现即使最先进的智能体成功率也仅为61.1%，揭示了数据密集型任务中智能体能力的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试通常孤立评估代码或数据能力，与现实开发场景（代码与大规模数据交织）存在明显差距，缺乏能同时评估两者协同能力的基准。
AI.method: 基于Kaggle生态系统构建数据密集型Linux沙箱（含数百个数据集），智能体需主动探索复杂文件层级、识别相关资源并生成代码完成数据分析任务。共1009个任务，覆盖31个社区，每个任务环境平均包含980个文件。
AI.result: 最先进智能体在CODA-BENCH上成功率仅61.1%，表明现有系统难以有效整合数据发现与代码执行。
AI.conclusion: 当前智能体在数据密集型任务中存在显著能力差距，为未来研究指明了方向。

title: Privacy-Preserving Text Sanitization for Distributed Agents Collaboration via Disentangled Representations
summary: When distributed agents exchange text across organizational boundaries, privacy leakage arises not only from explicit identifiers but also from distributional signatures such as formatting conventions, vocabulary choices, and syntactic patterns. We propose DiSan(Disentangled Sanitization), a privacy-preserving sanitization framework and a built-in component of Intern-Shannon for multi-agent collaboration. DiSan uses a two-stream encoder to factorize text into a source-invariant role subspace that preserves task semantics and a source-identifying style subspace that remains local. Federated proto-type alignment and adversarial regularization enable joint training without centralizing raw text. Experiments show that identifier-level masking is insufficient: masking 19.2% of tokens reduces TF-IDF stylometric attribution by only 18.6%. By contrast, DiSan reduces answer-level PII exposure by 20 times while maintaining 83% answer faithfulness on a distributed multi-agent RAG benchmark, and lowers Enron stylometric attribution by 73.2% under TF-IDF and 70.6% under a neural probe.

AI.tldr: DiSan是一个用于多智能体协作场景的隐私保护文本净化框架，通过将文本分解为任务相关的源不变子空间和风格相关的源识别子空间，在保持任务语义的同时大幅降低隐私泄露风险。
AI.motivation: 分布式智能体在跨组织边界交换文本时，隐私泄露不仅来自显式标识符，还来自分布特征（如格式习惯、词汇选择、句法模式），现有标识符级掩码方法不足以防范此类风险。
AI.method: 提出DiSan框架，采用双流编码器将文本分解为源不变角色子空间（保留任务语义）和源识别风格子空间（保持本地），通过联邦原型对齐和对抗正则化实现联合训练，无需集中原始文本。
AI.result: 对比标识符掩码（掩码19.2%token仅降低18.6%笔迹归因），DiSan在分布式多智能体RAG基准上降低20倍答案级PII暴露，同时保持83%答案忠实度；在Enron数据集上降低73.2%（TF-IDF）和70.6%（神经探针）笔迹归因准确率。
AI.conclusion: 标识符级掩码不足以防御基于分布特征的隐私攻击，DiSan通过解耦文本的语义与风格实现更有效的隐私保护，同时保持任务实用性。

title: An Integrable Token Mixing Layer from the Generalized Yang Baxter Equation
summary: The YB Mixer is a sequence token mixing layer derived from free fermion and generalized Yang Baxter structures. It applies a core principle from integrable systems where a local algebraic constraint guarantees global computational stability. By using the Ising exchange algebra the mixer creates a free fermionic structure that acts as an exactly norm preserving orthogonal map. This algebra also produces commuting transfer matrices which allow inference to be order free and adaptable to any variable budget. To ensure the model can generalize to longer sequence lengths it uses a spectral circulant generator. This generator maintains the crucial orthogonal and commuting properties of the system. The result is a highly stable and mathematically grounded architecture for sequence processing.

AI.tldr: YB Mixer是一种基于自由费米子和Yang-Baxter结构的序列token混合层，通过Ising交换代数实现精确保范正交映射和可交换转移矩阵，支持无需排序的可变预算推理，并利用谱循环生成器保证长序列泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 从可积系统中提取核心原则，利用局部代数约束保证全局计算稳定性，构建数学基础扎实的序列处理架构。
AI.method: 采用Ising交换代数构建自由费米子结构，形成精确保范的正交映射；利用该代数产生可交换转移矩阵，支持顺序无关和可变预算推理；通过谱循环生成器维持正交性和可交换性，保障长序列泛化。
AI.result: 得到高度稳定且具有数学基础的序列处理架构，支持顺序无关推理和适应可变预算。
AI.conclusion: YB Mixer为序列处理提供了一种数学上可证明的稳定架构，兼具正交保范、顺序无关推理和长序列泛化能力。

title: Forced Deferral: Manipulating Routing Decisions in Multimodal LLM Cascades
summary: While multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have shown strong visual reasoning abilities, serving a large model for every query is computationally expensive. MLLM cascades mitigate this cost by first querying a weak but cheaper model and deferring to a strong model when the weak model's output is unconfident. However, since the weak model's confidence directly controls compute allocation, these systems expose a new attack surface: an adversary can manipulate confidence so that their queries are consistently deferred to the strong model. Motivated by this vulnerability, we introduce the Forced Deferral Attack (FDA), an adversarial image attack that lowers the weak model's confidence and causes cascades to route queries to the strong model. FDA learns a universal border trigger by optimizing a temperature-flattened objective. This objective pushes the weak model's token distribution on triggered inputs toward less concentrated targets constructed from its clean responses. Across datasets, model families, and deferral metrics, FDA consistently increases strong-model routing while outperforming image-perturbation and prompt-injection baselines. These results show that MLLM cascades are vulnerable to attacks that manipulate compute allocation, forcing unintended strong-model usage without directly targeting answer correctness.

AI.tldr: 本文提出强制延迟攻击（FDA），通过对抗性图像触发器降低弱模型置信度，使多模态大模型级联系统将更多查询路由到强模型，揭示了计算资源分配机制的安全漏洞。
AI.motivation: 多模态大模型级联系统通过弱模型置信度控制计算资源分配，但置信度机制存在被操控的风险——攻击者可操纵置信度使查询被强制路由到强模型，造成计算资源滥用。
AI.method: FDA通过学习通用边框触发器，利用温度展平目标函数将弱模型在触发输入上的token分布推向基于其干净响应构建的分散目标，从而降低置信度并触发延迟。
AI.result: 在多种数据集、模型族和延迟指标下，FDA一致提高了强模型路由率，效果优于图像扰动和提示注入基线。
AI.conclusion: MLLM级联系统易受操纵计算分配的攻击，攻击者无需破坏答案正确性即可强制非预期的强模型使用，需重视此类安全威胁。

title: Beyond Monolingual Deep Research: Evaluating Agents and Retrievers with Cross-Lingual BrowseComp-Plus
summary: Deep research agents are increasingly evaluated on their ability to search for evidence, reason over retrieved sources, and produce grounded answers. Existing browsing benchmarks, however, largely assume that the user's query and the supporting evidence are written in the same language, leaving open whether agentic search systems can operate when relevant evidence appears in another language. We introduce XBCP (Cross-lingual BrowseComp-Plus), a controlled benchmark that preserves the English question-and-answer space of BrowseComp-Plus but varies the languages of the supporting documents. XBCP instantiates two complementary settings: in the cross-lingual setting, each query is paired with evidence in a single assigned language. In the multilingual setting, the full evidence corpus is distributed equally and randomly across 12 languages spanning high-resource and low-resource regimes. We evaluate four deep research agents using sparse and dense multilingual retrievers, measuring answer accuracy, evidence recall, search behavior, calibration, citation fidelity, and oracle retrieval. Results reveal substantial degradation when evidence is translated. Even strong, dense retrievers lose evidence recall, and agents become less calibrated and cite evidence less reliably. Notably, accuracy remains lower even when all gold evidence is supplied directly. These findings suggest that cross-lingual deep research exposes both retrieval failures and an independent, agent-side difficulty in integrating language-mismatched evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出跨语言浏览基准XBCP，评估深度研究智能体在证据语言与查询语言不一致时的表现。实验表明，跨语言场景下智能体的准确性、证据召回率、校准度和引用可靠性均显著下降，且即使直接提供所有黄金证据，准确率仍然较低，说明存在检索失败和智能体侧的语言不匹配证据整合困难两个独立问题。
AI.motivation: 现有浏览基准大多假设用户查询与支持证据使用同一种语言，忽略了实际场景中相关证据可能出现在另一种语言的情况，因此需要构建跨语言评估基准来检验智能体搜索系统在语言不匹配条件下的表现。
AI.method: 基于BrowseComp-Plus保留英文问答空间，构建XBCP基准，包含两个设置：跨语言设置（每个查询配对单一语言证据）和多语言设置（证据语料库均匀分布在12种高/低资源语言中）。使用稀疏和稠密两种多语言检索器评估四种深度研究智能体，测量多项指标。
AI.result: 跨语言场景下性能显著下降：稠密检索器的证据召回率降低，智能体校准度变差，引用可靠性下降。即使直接提供所有黄金证据，准确率仍然低于同语言场景。
AI.conclusion: 跨语言深度研究暴露了两类问题：检索失败和智能体侧整合语言不匹配证据的独立困难。现有系统在跨语言场景下存在系统性缺陷，需要针对性改进。

title: High-Dimensional Random Projection for Activation Steering in Language Models
summary: Activation steering has emerged as a key methodology for controlling the behavior of large language models (LLMs). Existing difference-in-means based methods, however, are fundamentally limited: they capture only mean differences between class activations and fail to recover discriminative signals that naturally exist in the nonlinear feature subspace under the superposition hypothesis. Motivated by that, we propose High-Dimensional Random-projection for Activation Steering (HiDRA), a training-free approach that integrates seamlessly with existing activation steering methods. By performing activation addition in the projected high-dimensional space, HiDRA can provably capture a better discriminative structure beyond the reach of linear methods. Experiments across diverse LLM families and benchmarks demonstrate that HiDRA consistently outperforms baseline counterparts, achieving stronger behavioral control without significant computational overhead.

AI.tldr: HiDRA是一种无需训练、基于高维随机投影的激活引导方法，通过在投影高维空间中进行激活添加，能够捕捉到传统线性方法无法获取的非线性判别信号，从而更有效地控制大语言模型的行为。
AI.motivation: 现有基于差值均值的激活引导方法只能捕捉类别激活之间的均值差异，无法恢复在叠加假设下非线性特征子空间中自然存在的判别信号，存在根本性局限。
AI.method: 提出HiDRA（High-Dimensional Random-projection for Activation Steering），一种无需训练的方法，通过在投影高维空间中进行激活添加，可证明地捕获超越线性方法所能达到的更优判别结构，并能无缝集成到现有激活引导方法中。
AI.result: 在多种LLM家族和基准测试中，HiDRA在无需显著计算开销的情况下，持续优于基线方法，实现了更强的行为控制效果。
AI.conclusion: 高维随机投影策略能够有效弥补线性激活引导方法的不足，为LLM行为控制提供了一种高效、可扩展的改进方案。

title: ChatPlanner: A Large Language Model Framework for Personalized Public Transit Routing
comment: Under Review at Transportation Research Part C
summary: Personalized public transit routing in public transit systems remains challenging due to the difficulty of capturing and integrating diverse user preferences into routing algorithms. This paper presents ChatPlanner, a novel framework that leverages Large Language Models (LLMs) to enable preference aware public transit routing. Our approach employs fine-tuned LLMs with Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) to extract routing parameters and interpret nuanced user preferences from natural language queries, subsequently integrating these preferences into the objective function of a public transit routing algorithm. This study designs preference aware datasets incorporating eight personas and five contexts to establish scoring standards for both fine-tuning and RAG. This work conducted three experiments to validate the solutions' feasibility, extraction of routing information and preferences, and solution set quality and completeness. Results demonstrate that ChatPlanner generates feasible solutions reliably. Fine-tuning enforces the required output structure and learns general preference patterns, while RAG provides query-specific context to resolve imprecise or conversational expressions and calibrate continuous scores. The combination of both achieves the highest accuracy in routing information extraction and user preference interpretation. Results based on selected case studies show that by capturing user preferences, ChatPlanner identifies valuable solutions across different dimensions that existing route planners overlook, generating more valuable route alternatives. This research establishes a new paradigm for integrating natural language understanding into transportation optimization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ChatPlanner框架，利用微调LLM结合RAG技术从自然语言查询中提取用户偏好并整合到公交路由算法中，实验表明该方法能可靠生成可行路线，并发现现有规划器忽略的个性化方案。
AI.motivation: 个性化公交路由因难以捕获和整合多样化的用户偏好而具有挑战性，现有方法无法有效理解自然语言表达的细微偏好。
AI.method: 采用微调LLM+RAG提取路由参数和用户偏好，将偏好整合进公交路由算法的目标函数中，并设计包含8种人物和5种场景的偏好感知数据集用于微调和RAG。
AI.result: ChatPlanner可靠生成可行方案；微调强制输出结构并学习一般偏好模式，RAG提供查询特定上下文以解析模糊表达并校准连续分数，两者结合在路由信息提取和偏好解释上准确率最高；案例研究表明能发现现有规划器忽略的个性化路线。
AI.conclusion: 建立了将自然语言理解整合到交通优化的新范式，通过捕获用户偏好生成更有价值的路线备选方案。

title: Rethinking the Role of Efficient Attention in Hybrid Architectures
summary: Modern language models increasingly adopt hybrid architectures that combine full attention with efficient attention modules, such as sliding-window attention (SWA) and recurrent sequence mixers. However, how these efficient modules shape model capabilities remains poorly understood. To address this gap, we conduct a systematic analysis across hybrid architectures from three perspectives: scaling behavior, mechanism analysis, and architecture design. First, from a scaling perspective, we find that efficient-attention design primarily affects how fast long-context capability emerges, while different hybrids eventually converge to comparable long-context performance under sufficient training. Second, mechanistically, we show that long-range retrieval is mainly carried by full attention, whereas efficient attention shapes its optimization trajectory. This explains a counter-intuitive phenomenon we call Large-Window Laziness: larger SWA windows can delay the formation of retrieval heads in full-attention layers. Third, guided by this mechanism, we show that applying NoPE to only the full-attention layers of a small-window SWA hybrid substantially improves long-context performance with negligible impact on short-context performance.

AI.tldr: 本文系统分析了混合架构中高效注意力模块（如滑动窗口注意力SWA和循环序列混合器）对模型能力的影响，从缩放行为、机制分析和架构设计三个角度展开。研究发现：高效注意力设计主要影响长上下文能力的涌现速度，不同混合架构在充分训练下最终收敛到可比性能；长距离检索主要由全注意力完成，而高效注意力塑造其优化轨迹，解释了“大窗口懒惰”现象；基于此机制，对全注意力层应用NoPE可显著提升长上下文性能。
AI.motivation: 现代语言模型越来越多地采用结合全注意力与高效注意力模块（如SWA和循环序列混合器）的混合架构，但这些高效模块如何塑造模型能力尚不明确，本文旨在填补这一理解空白。
AI.method: 从三个视角进行系统分析：1）缩放行为：考察不同混合架构下长上下文能力的涌现速度；2）机制分析：发现长距离检索由全注意力主导，高效注意力影响其优化轨迹，揭示“大窗口懒惰”现象（更大SWA窗口延迟全注意力层检索头的形成）；3）架构设计：基于机制发现，对小型窗口SWA混合架构中的全注意力层应用NoPE（无位置编码）。
AI.result: 高效注意力设计主要影响长上下文能力的涌现速度而非最终性能；不同混合架构在充分训练后收敛到可比的长上下文性能；全注意力承担长距离检索任务，高效注意力塑造优化轨迹；更大SWA窗口会延迟检索头的形成；对全注意力层应用NoPE能显著提升长上下文性能，且对短上下文性能影响极小。
AI.conclusion: 本文系统揭示了混合架构中高效注意力模块的作用机制，为混合架构设计提供了理论指导，特别是通过NoPE策略优化全注意力层可有效提升长上下文能力。

title: Diversity-Driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization via Nested Pareto Set Learning
comment: 32 pages, 7 figures, accepted by ICML 2026. Project: https://github.com/YaolinWen/DOMOO
summary: Multi-objective optimization (MOO) has emerged as a powerful approach to solving complex optimization problems involving multiple objectives. In many practical scenarios, function evaluations are unavailable or prohibitively expensive, necessitating optimization solely based on a fixed offline dataset. In this setting, known as offline MOO, the goal is to find out the Pareto set without access to the true objective functions. This setting suffers from the out-of-distribution (OOD) issue, where the surrogate model is not accurate for unseen designs. Due to the OOD issue, surrogate errors may cause the optimizer to select solutions that do not lie on the true Pareto front and are biased toward its extremes. To address this, this paper proposes Diversity-driven Offline Multi-Objective Optimization (DOMOO), which aims to find out a diverse and high-quality set of solutions. First, DOMOO incorporates an accumulative risk control module that estimates the potential risk of candidate solutions and alleviates the OOD issue between the training data and the generated solutions. In addition, a nested Pareto set learning (PSL) strategy is proposed to jointly learn preference and PSL parameters, then optimize them, enabling adaptation to diverse Pareto front geometries. To further enhance solution quality, we design a diversity-driven selection strategy that extracts a representative and well-distributed set of final solutions. To achieve this diversity-driven selection strategy, we propose $\text{IGD}_\text{offline}$, a tailored indicator for the offline setting that considers both diversity and convergence, and avoids the bias of hypervolume indicator. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world benchmarks show that DOMOO achieves the best average rank across tasks in both convergence and diversity among the compared methods.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DOMOO框架，通过累积风险控制、嵌套Pareto集学习策略和基于IGD_offline指标的多样性驱动选择策略，解决离线多目标优化中的分布外问题和解集多样性不足的挑战。
AI.motivation: 离线多目标优化中存在分布外问题，导致代理模型对未见设计不准确，优化器可能选择不在真实Pareto前沿上的解且偏向极端区域，因此需要一种能同时保证解集多样性和高质量的方法。
AI.method: 1) 累积风险控制模块：估计候选解的潜在风险，缓解训练数据与生成解之间的分布外问题；2) 嵌套Pareto集学习策略：联合学习偏好和PSL参数，适应不同Pareto前沿几何形状；3) 多样性驱动选择策略：基于提出的IGD_offline指标（兼顾多样性与收敛性），提取代表性且分布均匀的最终解集。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界基准测试上的大量实验表明，DOMOO在收敛性和多样性方面均取得了所比较方法中最好的平均排名。
AI.conclusion: DOMOO有效解决了离线多目标优化中的分布外问题和解集多样性不足的挑战，通过三个核心模块协同作用，实现了高质量且多样化的Pareto解集。

title: APEX: Adaptive Principle EXtraction A Three-Layer Self-Evolution Framework for Production AI Agents
comment: 8 pages, 1 figure, 4 tables. Evaluated on a production 15-node compute fleet with 114 real task traces. Code available at https://aispark.airlive.com/joe-hackathon/
summary: Self-improvement in AI agents has emerged as a key research frontier: systems that modify their own prompts, workflows, and decision rules based on accumulated operational experience. The state-of-the-art Self-Harness framework [1] achieves 14--21% improvement on Terminal-Bench-2.0 by mining failure clusters and patching the agent harness. However, Self-Harness optimises only one dimension -- the prompt harness -- leaving behavioural principles and workflow topology unchanged. We propose APEX (Adaptive Principle EXtraction), a three-layer co-evolution framework that simultaneously evolves: (L1) the harness via failure-mode patching, (L2) behavioural principles via success-trace distillation [2], and (L3) the agent workflow topology via structural fitness-based selection [6]. We implement APEX on Joe [13], a production-grade super AI Agent built on NVIDIA Nemotron and designed as an Edge AI Agent Factory for the NVIDIA Agent Challenge 2026, managing a 15-node compute fleet using 114 real task traces collected over 18 days. APEX achieves an APEX Health Score of 0.570 (+90% vs. baseline 0.300) in a single evolutionary run, distilling 6 novel reusable principles and selecting a research-first workflow topology scoring 0.900 (+20%). Our results demonstrate that multi-dimensional co-evolution substantially outperforms single-axis harness optimisation, at a cost of only 4 LLM calls (~270 s) on a local qwen2.5-coder:32b instance.

AI.tldr: APEX是一个三层协同进化框架，同时优化Agent的提示词（L1）、行为原则（L2）和工作流拓扑（L3），在Joe Agent上实现Health Score从0.300提升至0.570（+90%），仅需4次LLM调用（~270秒）。
