We investigated the convergence properties of tabular MCES by constructing examples in which the algorithm converges to suboptimal solutions. This paper presents new counterexamples for both initial-visit and first-visit MCES and gives a convergence-restoring modification for the initial-visit case. We show that stable suboptimal solutions may exist for initial-visit MCES with sample-average updates even when greedy actions are updated more often than non-greedy actions on average. However, by scaling learning rates inversely to update frequencies on a state-by-state basis, convergence to optimality is guaranteed. Unlike previous uniformisation methods, this modification is applicable to large-scale problems that require approximating the estimated value function. We then extend the example to show that sample-average first-visit MCES may also converge to suboptimal solutions. This largely settles a fundamental open problem and shows that exploring starts alone do not guarantee convergence to optimality. More broadly, these results highlight that convergence depends critically on the relative size and frequency of updates applied to different actions, making the choice of learning rates and the balance between exploration and exploitation central to the analysis of MCES and the implementation of scalable Monte Carlo control methods.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了蒙特卡洛探索启动(MCES)的渐近行为，通过构造反例证明初始访问和首次访问MCES都可能收敛到次优解，并提出通过状态级缩放学习率来保证收敛到最优解的修正方法，基本解决了这一长期存在的开放问题。
AI.motivation: MCES的渐近行为是强化学习中一个长期悬而未决的开放问题，即使在表格设置下也不清楚其是否保证收敛到最优解。
AI.method: 通过构造反例展示初始访问和首次访问MCES收敛到次优解的情况，并提出按状态级更新频率逆比例缩放学习率的修正方法。
AI.result: 证明了即使贪婪动作平均更新频率高于非贪婪动作，初始访问MCES使用样本平均更新仍可能收敛到次优解；通过状态级逆频率缩放学习率可保证收敛到最优解；首次访问MCES也可能收敛到次优解。
AI.conclusion: 探索启动本身并不能保证收敛到最优性，收敛关键取决于不同动作更新的相对大小和频率，学习率选择和探索-利用平衡对MCES分析至关重要。

title: Large Language Models as Optimizers: A Survey of Direct vs. Tool-Augmented Approaches and Their Performance Frontiers
comment: 6 pages, 1 figure, 2 tables, accepted at 49th ICT and Electronics Convention, MIPRO - https://mipro.hr; Paper ID: #23463
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly involved in complex mathematical optimization, even if the pragmatic user who triggers them is unaware of it. After all, many real-world problems reduce to the search for better or the best solutions. The field of LLM-as-optimizer has three paradigms: direct optimization, tool-augmented optimization, and tool-creating optimization. Direct optimization uses iterative prompting and heuristic generation to navigate solution spaces. Tool-augmented optimization translates natural language problems into formal specifications and orchestrates external solvers. Tool-creating optimization goes further, using LLMs to discover reusable algorithms or heuristics that can be deployed at zero marginal LLM cost. We describe current performance frontiers based on the benchmarks from the literature. We identify the critical reasoning gap in current architectures and argue for trade-offs between the future potential of direct optimization and the auditability of tool-augmented optimization. Even future, more powerful models might opt for tool-making to improve operational efficiency for repetitive families of problems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了LLM作为优化器的三种范式：直接优化、工具增强优化和工具创造优化，分析了各自的性能边界与推理能力差距，并讨论了直接优化的未来潜力与工具增强优化的可审计性之间的权衡。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多地参与复杂数学优化问题求解，但用户可能并未意识到这一过程。作者旨在系统梳理LLM-as-optimizer的三种范式，分析当前性能边界和关键推理差距，并探讨不同范式间的权衡关系。
AI.method: 采用文献综述方法，基于现有基准测试描述当前性能前沿，识别三种优化范式（直接优化、工具增强优化、工具创造优化）的特点与差异。
AI.result: 识别出当前架构中存在的关键推理差距；指出直接优化未来潜力大但可审计性不足，工具增强优化可审计性强但扩展性受限；提出未来更强大的模型可能倾向于工具创造范式以提高重复性问题的操作效率。
AI.conclusion: 三种优化范式各有优劣，需要根据场景权衡选择；工具创造优化有望成为未来发展方向，能够在零边际LLM成本下部署可复用算法。

title: EIBench: A Simulator-Based Benchmark and Turn-Credit RL for Emotion Management
summary: Emotional intelligence (EI) in Large Language Models (LLMs) is often evaluated through static understanding tasks or single-response dialogue generation. However, emotion management is interactive: a good model should not only recognize a user's emotion, but also improve the user's emotional and relational state over several turns. We introduce EIBench, a simulator-based benchmark for interactive emotion management. EIBench contains 2,222 scenarios, with 2,009 for training and 213 for held-out testing. The scenarios are organized by a 2x2 taxonomy covering Support, Defense, Repair, and Charm, which together capture different forms of support, boundary maintenance, trust repair, and rapport building. In each scenario, an LLM simulator plays the user, updates an emotion-relation state after each turn, and maps the final state to an anchor-based score. This design makes EIBench both an evaluation benchmark and a training environment: the final state gives the outcome reward, while the per-turn state updates provide dense feedback for RL. We evaluate 15 open- and closed-source LLMs. Current models perform well on support and rapport-building scenes, but struggle with boundary maintenance under user pressure. To improve the EI ability of LLMs, we propose Centered Turn-Credit GRPO (CTC-GRPO), a GRPO extension that reuses the simulator's per-turn state updates as dense turn-level feedback while preserving the final outcome reward. CTC-GRPO improves Qwen3-8B from -22.4 to +22.4 on EIBench and also improves on out-of-distribution evaluations including SAGE (+12.4) and EQBench3 (+20.9%). Our results show that simulator-tracked user states can support both evaluation and training for multi-turn emotion management.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EIBench——基于模拟器的交互式情绪管理基准，包含2,222个场景和2x2分类体系（支持、防御、修复、魅力）。该基准既可评估又可训练LLM的情绪管理能力，并提出CTC-GRPO方法，利用模拟器的逐轮状态更新作为密集奖励，将Qwen3-8B的EIBench得分从-22.4提升至+22.4，同时在SAGE和EQBench3上也取得显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM情绪智力评估多限于静态理解或单轮对话生成，忽略了情绪管理的交互性——模型不仅需识别用户情绪，还应能在多轮对话中改善用户的情感和关系状态。
AI.method: 构建EIBench基准：包含2,222个场景（2,009训练+213测试），采用2x2分类（支持/防御/修复/魅力）。LLM模拟器扮演用户，逐轮更新情感-关系状态，最终映射为锚点分数。提出CTC-GRPO（Centered Turn-Credit GRPO），复用模拟器的逐轮状态更新作为密集的逐轮反馈，同时保留最终结果奖励。
AI.result: 评估15个开源/闭源LLM，当前模型在支持和建立融洽关系场景中表现良好，但在用户压力下的边界维护上表现不佳。CTC-GRPO将Qwen3-8B从-22.4提升至+22.4，并在OOD评估中提升SAGE +12.4、EQBench3 +20.9%。
AI.conclusion: 模拟器跟踪的用户状态可同时支持多轮情绪管理的评估与训练，CTC-GRPO通过逐轮密集奖励显著提升LLM的情绪管理能力。

title: AI for Social Good: An Investigation of the Causal Relationship Between Environmental Regulations and Their Effects on Air Pollution in London, UK
summary: Air pollution regulation is central to urban public health governance, but estimating its effects is difficult because policies are implemented non-randomly and pollution trajectories are shaped by meteorology, socioeconomic change, temporal trends, and overlapping interventions. This study develops an uncertainty-aware Bayesian deep learning framework to estimate the aggregate effect of air pollution regulations on PM$_{2.5}$ concentrations in London from 2010 to 2020. The framework integrates daily PM$_{2.5}$ observations from Inner London monitoring stations, meteorological covariates, annual socioeconomic indicators, month-of-year and day-of-week indicators, and daily regulation status data for 32 policy measures. A Bayesian LSTM captures temporal dependencies in environmental and socioeconomic covariates, Bayesian embedding layers represent temporal and regulation status inputs, and a regulation status prediction branch supports propensity score-based adjustment for non-random policy implementation. Regulatory effects are estimated by comparing observed PM$_{2.5}$ concentrations with counterfactual predictions under a hypothetical no-regulation scenario, with uncertainty summarized across repeated Bayesian training runs and bootstrap resampling. Results show that London's regulations were associated with an average PM$_{2.5}$ reduction of 1.88 $μ$g/m$^3$, a relative reduction of 12.35%, with a 95% confidence interval of 1.64-2.12 $μ$g/m$^3$. Estimated effects were limited before 2013, became clearer from 2013 to 2017, and were strongest in 2018 and 2019. The findings suggest that sustained and cumulative regulatory interventions contributed to measurable improvements in London's air quality. This study demonstrates how uncertainty-aware causal AI can support environmental accountability, public health protection, and evidence-based governance for environmental decision-making.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种不确定性感知的贝叶斯深度学习框架，用于估计伦敦2010-2020年间32项空气污染法规对PM₂.₅浓度的累计因果效应。结果表明，法规与平均1.88 μg/m³（12.35%）的PM₂.₅减少相关，效果在2018-2019年最强，展现了不确定性感知因果AI在环境治理与公共健康决策中的价值。
AI.motivation: 空气污染法规是城市公共健康治理的核心，但由于政策实施非随机、污染轨迹受气象、社会经济变化、时间趋势及多重干预叠加影响，准确估计法规的因果效应极其困难。
AI.method: 构建不确定性感知的贝叶斯深度学习框架：（1）贝叶斯LSTM捕捉环境与社会经济协变量的时间依赖；（2）贝叶斯嵌入层表示时间与法规状态输入；（3）法规状态预测分支支持基于倾向得分的非随机政策调整；（4）通过对比观测值与无法规反事实预测的差值估计效应，不确定性通过重复贝叶斯训练和bootstrap重采样汇总。
AI.result: 伦敦法规与平均1.88 μg/m³（12.35%）的PM₂.₅减少相关，95%置信区间为1.64-2.12 μg/m³；2013年前效果有限，2013-2017年逐渐明显，2018-2019年效果最强。
AI.conclusion: 持续累积的法规干预为伦敦空气质量带来了可测量的改善；不确定性感知的因果AI能够支持环境问责、公共卫生保护及基于证据的环境治理决策。

title: Your Agent Has a Genome: Sequence-Level Behavioral Analysis and Runtime Governance of LLM-Powered Autonomous Agents
summary: We propose Base Sequence Analysis, a framework that encodes the runtime behavior of LLM-powered autonomous agents into compact symbolic sequences using a four-letter alphabet: X (Explore), E (Execute), P (Plan), and V (Verify). Drawing an analogy to genomic sequence analysis, we apply n-gram pattern mining, Markov transition matrices, and point-biserial correlation to 347 real-world execution traces collected from a production ReAct agent system over 8 days. Our analysis reveals that (1) the trigram P-X-P is the only statistically significant high-risk pattern, lowering success rate by 10.4%; (2) P-ratio is the strongest negative predictor of success (r=-0.256, p<0.0001); and (3) the E->V transition probability is only 2.1%, indicating a systemic verification deficit. Based on these findings, we design Governor, a three-layer runtime intervention system comprising a rule engine, a statistical accumulator, and a chi-square-based threshold adaptor. In a natural before/after deployment evaluation (N=101 vs. N=246), Governor achieves a +6.2% absolute increase in task success rate while simultaneously reducing average token consumption by 44%. To validate cross-system generality, we apply the XEPV encoding to 2,000 public SWE-agent trajectories on SWE-bench, confirming that exploration spirals and the E->V verification deficit replicate in an independent system. We outline six research directions including base sequence language models, cross-agent behavioral fingerprinting, and reward shaping, and release an open-source toolkit for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文提出XEPV四字母编码框架，将LLM自主智能体的运行时行为转化为符号序列，并通过347条生产环境ReAct智能体轨迹的分析，发现P-X-P三字母模式降低成功率10.4%、P-ratio为最强负预测因子(r=-0.256)、E→V转移概率仅2.1%存在系统性验证缺陷。基于此设计三层运行时干预系统Governor，在部署前后评估中实现成功率+6.2%、token消耗-44%，并在SWE-bench的2000条轨迹上验证了跨系统泛化性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体行为分析缺乏统一框架，难以系统性地表征和挖掘智能体运行时行为模式与任务成功率之间的关联，亟需一种类似基因组分析的符号化方法来实现行为模式的量化发现与干预。
AI.method: 采用四字母X(探索)、E(执行)、P(规划)、V(验证)编码智能体运行时行为，运用n-gram模式挖掘、马尔可夫转移矩阵、点二列相关分析347条生产ReAct轨迹；基于发现设计Governor三层系统（规则引擎、统计累加器、卡方阈值自适应器），并在SWE-bench的2000条轨迹上进行跨系统验证。
AI.result: (1) P-X-P三字母模式是唯一统计显著的高风险模式，降低成功率10.4%；(2) P-ratio是成功率最强负预测因子(r=-0.256, p<0.0001)；(3) E→V转移概率仅2.1%，存在系统性验证缺陷。Governor实现成功率+6.2%，token消耗降低44%。跨系统验证确认了探索螺旋和E→V验证缺陷的泛化性。
AI.conclusion: XEPV编码框架能有效揭示LLM智能体的行为模式与性能关联，Governor系统能同时提升成功率和效率。提出了六个未来研究方向（碱基序列语言模型、跨智能体行为指纹识别、奖励塑形等），并开源工具包以促进可复现研究。

title: LLM-Assisted Stance Detection in Scientific Discourse: A Test Case in Bayesian Cognitive Science
summary: Qualitative coding is central to social science, but expert annotation is difficult to scale. LLMs offer a possible extension, yet require careful validation when the target construct is interpretive, theoretically loaded, and only indirectly expressed. We study this problem in a difficult case: detecting whether authors treat Bayesian models as descriptions of mental and neural mechanisms (realism) or as useful mathematical tools (instrumentalism). Our method combines a theory-driven codebook, expert-coded reference annotations, a diagnostic-gated prompt-optimization search yielding a shared zero-shot prompt for three frontier LLMs (GPT-5.1, Claude Sonnet 4.6, Gemini 3 Pro Preview), and multi-rater reliability analysis. The final prompt achieved a held-out combined reliability score of 0.76 (harmonic mean of ICC = 0.79 and $α$ = 0.74), with all diagnostics satisfied. Deployed on 6,858 quotes from 210 articles, the three LLMs reached substantial quote-level agreement (ICC = 0.80; $α$ = 0.76; combined = 0.78) and near-perfect article-level rank stability ($r$ = 0.96-0.97 across rater pairs). The corpus was predominantly weakly realist, but article-level stances were rarely uniform: only 1.4% of articles used a single band, while 59.5% spanned four or more. Low-level perception/motor articles scored 8.8 Realism points higher than high-level cognition articles ($p < .001$, $d = 0.60$), quantifying a long-held qualitative intuition. We present this as an expert-led case study; the framework is intended to generalize to similar theoretically demanding tasks, not to all qualitative analysis.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合理论驱动编码手册、专家标注、诊断门控提示优化搜索和多方信度分析的框架，利用三个前沿LLM（GPT-5.1、Claude Sonnet 4.6、Gemini 3 Pro Preview）对贝叶斯建模中的实在论与工具主义立场进行自动编码。最终提示在保留集上达到0.76的综合信度，部署到6,858条引文后LLM间一致性达0.78，文章级排序稳定性接近完美（r=0.96-0.97）。研究发现低层感知/运动文章比高层认知文章实在论得分高8.8分（p<.001, d=0.60），量化了长期以来的定性直觉。
AI.motivation: 定性编码是社会科学的核心方法，但专家标注难以规模化。LLM提供了一种潜在的扩展手段，然而当目标构念是解释性的、理论负载的且仅间接表达时，需要谨慎验证。本研究在贝叶斯模型实在论与工具主义这一困难案例中探索该问题。
AI.method: 结合理论驱动编码手册、专家编码参考标注、诊断门控提示优化搜索（为三个前沿LLM生成共享的零样本提示），以及多方信度分析。
AI.result: 最终提示保留集综合信度0.76（ICC=0.79, α=0.74的调和平均），所有诊断指标满足。部署到6,858条引文后，LLM间引文级一致性ICC=0.80, α=0.76, 综合0.78；文章级排序稳定性r=0.96-0.97。语料库整体偏向弱实在论，但仅1.4%文章使用单一频段，59.5%跨越四个及以上频段。低层感知/运动文章比高层认知文章实在论得分高8.8分（p<.001, d=0.60）。
AI.conclusion: 本研究提供了一个专家主导的案例研究框架，旨在推广到类似的理论密集型分析任务，而非适用于所有定性分析场景。框架的有效性通过严格的信度指标和诊断得到验证。

title: Trust-Region Diffusion Policies for Massively Parallel On-Policy RL
summary: Reinforcement learning with massively parallel simulations has become a standard framework for developing robust, deployable policies; however, most existing approaches still rely on simple Gaussian policy parameterizations. Diffusion models provide a more expressive policy class and have shown strong performance on challenging control problems, yet most diffusion-based RL methods are designed for offline or off-policy training. In this work, we ask whether diffusion policies can be trained effectively in the massively parallel, on-policy regime. To this end, we introduce Trust-region Diffusion Policies (TruDi), which enables diffusion policies for on-policy RL with massively parallel simulations. This setting is particularly challenging because the data distribution changes quickly across updates, making stable training with complex policies difficult. TruDi addresses this by integrating a trust-region optimization rule to enforce a KL-divergence constraint over the entire diffusion trajectory. Empirically, we evaluate TruDi on a diverse set of 4 massively parallel RL benchmarks comprising a total of 73 tasks. Across these tasks, TruDi consistently outperforms or is on-par with strong baselines on standard tasks and achieves clear gains on more challenging humanoid control tasks, establishing a strong new baseline for massively parallel on-policy RL.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Trust-region Diffusion Policies (TruDi)，将扩散策略成功应用于大规模并行同策略强化学习，通过信任区域优化约束整个扩散轨迹的KL散度，在73个任务中一致优于或持平强基线方法，尤其在复杂人形机器人控制任务上表现突出。
AI.motivation: 现有大规模并行RL主要使用简单高斯策略参数化，而扩散模型虽表达能力强但多数方法仅限于离线或离策略训练。作者试图探索扩散策略能否在大规模并行同策略RL场景中有效训练。
AI.method: 提出TruDi框架，通过信任区域优化规则对扩散轨迹全过程施加KL散度约束，解决同策略训练中数据分布快速变化导致的训练不稳定问题，实现扩散策略在大规模并行仿真环境中的稳定学习。
AI.result: 在涵盖73个任务的4个大规模并行RL基准测试中，TruDi在标准任务上一致优于或持平强基线，在复杂人形机器人控制任务上获得明显提升，建立了大规模并行同策略RL的新基线。
AI.conclusion: TruDi成功证明了扩散策略在大规模并行同策略RL框架下的可行性与有效性，为复杂控制任务提供了一种更具表达力的策略表示方法。

title: Agentic Retrieval and Reinforcement Learned Equation Chains: A Controlled Generation Framework for Complex and Novel Physics Word Problems
summary: Generating high-quality Physics Word Problems (PWPs) that are novel, complex, and solvable remains a challenging and underexplored problem in educational content generation. Existing approaches, many adapted from Math Word Problem (MWP) generation, often produce ambiguous, unsolvable, or structurally simple questions with limited linguistic diversity. We introduce ARVRE (Agentic Retrieval Value Reinforced Equation-chain), a two-stage framework for generating diverse and mathematically valid PWPs. In the first stage, a form of offline temporal-difference learning is used to construct valid chains of physics equations, while an agentic retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework dynamically selects topic-specific concepts and vocabulary. This design enables explicit control over problem structure and difficulty. In the second stage, a Large Language Model (LLM) converts the equation chain and retrieved concepts into a natural-language physics question. By grounding generation in valid equation chains, our method preserves mathematical correctness while promoting linguistic diversity and contextual richness. Human and automated evaluations demonstrate that ARVRE generates PWPs that are more complex, novel, and solvable than those produced by existing approaches. These results highlight the potential of combining reinforcement learning, retrieval, and LLMs for reliable generation of educational physics content.

AI.tldr: 提出ARVRE框架，通过两阶段生成（方程链构建+自然语言转换）解决物理应用题生成中数学正确性、语言多样性和问题可解性难以兼顾的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有的物理应用题生成方法（多改编自数学应用题生成）存在生成问题模糊、不可解、结构简单、语言多样性不足等问题，亟需一种能保证数学正确性同时提升复杂度和新颖性的生成框架。
AI.method: 两阶段框架ARVRE：第一阶段使用离线时序差分学习构建有效的物理方程链，并采用智能体检索增强生成机制动态选择主题相关概念和词汇，实现对问题结构和难度的显式控制；第二阶段使用大语言模型将方程链和检索到的概念转换为自然语言物理问题。
AI.result: 人工评估和自动评估均表明，ARVRE生成的物理应用题在复杂度、新颖性和可解性方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 结合强化学习、检索增强生成和大语言模型的方法在可靠生成教育级物理内容方面具有显著潜力。

title: LLM Judges Have Dark Current: A Psychometric Datasheet for LLM-as-a-Judge Evaluation
summary: LLM-as-a-judge systems are now routinely used for open-ended model evaluation, where human preference annotation is costly, slow, and difficult to reproduce. Yet these judges are often reported as scalar accuracy, win-rate, or agreement devices. We argue that a judge should instead be reported as a measurement instrument. We introduce a Judge Datasheet protocol that measures dark current under true-vacuum inputs, stable cross-sensitivity to same-quality surface variation, positional false preference, target sensitivity on a controlled quality ladder, and the criterion or operating point induced by tie instructions. The direction-stability decomposition reveals that apparent Delta0 preference can be stable surface response or disguised position bias. In a three-judge open-weight case study, Llama-3.1-8B shows high dark current and presentation-conflicted Delta0 behavior, Qwen2.5-14B is vacuum-clean and target-sensitive but mixes stable and positional over-discrimination, and Qwen2.5-32B is vacuum-clean with low stable cross-sensitivity and low positional false preference. A strict tie criterion eliminates Qwen32B Delta0 false preference but absorbs marginal Delta1 target signals into ties while preserving Delta5 sensitivity. The results show that prompting moves the criterion, not the resolution. We do not claim that the downstream mechanism hypothesis that motivated this work is confirmed; the contribution is a metrological protocol for measuring the measuring device before downstream claims are made.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Judge Datasheet协议，将LLM评判系统视为测量仪器而非简单分类器，通过暗电流、交叉灵敏度、位置偏差、目标灵敏度等指标系统评估评判质量，并通过三个开源模型的案例研究验证了该协议的有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评判器仅报告标量准确率、胜率或一致性指标，未将其作为测量仪器进行系统校准和特性报告，导致评判质量难以可信评估，阻碍了模型评估的可靠性。
AI.method: 提出Judge Datasheet协议，包含五个维度：(1) 真空输入下的暗电流测量；(2) 同质表面变化的稳定交叉灵敏度；(3) 位置性虚假偏好；(4) 控制质量阶梯上的目标灵敏度；(5) 平局指令诱导的操作点/标准。引入方向-稳定性分解方法，区分真实偏好与位置偏差。
AI.result: 三个开源模型案例研究显示：Llama-3.1-8B暗电流高且呈现冲突性Delta0行为；Qwen2.5-14B无暗电流且目标灵敏，但混合了稳定和位置性的过度区分；Qwen2.5-32B无暗电流、低稳定交叉灵敏度和低位置虚假偏好。严格平局标准消除了Qwen32B的Delta0虚假偏好，但将边际Delta1信号吸收为平局。
AI.conclusion: 提示工程改变的是评判标准（criterion）而非分辨率（resolution）；本文贡献在于提供了一种在下游声明之前测量测量设备的计量学协议，而非验证驱动工作的下游机制假设。

title: When to use what Schatten-$p$ norm in deep learning?
summary: Schatten-$\infty$ based optimizers such as Muon have shown promising empirical performance, but there remains seemingly conflicting observations regarding whether they are beneficial. We resolve this conflict by showing that the conclusion is regime dependent. Even when the objective is smooth in the Schatten-$\infty$ geometry, smaller Schatten-$p$ geometries can be optimal, specifically in the low-dimensional regime, which we show includes Chinchilla scaling. This conclusion follows from a new noise-robust acceleration result for the SODA framework for $p>2$. The same analysis explains why Muon-like methods do not require warmup, why they naturally favor large batches, and yields a batch size scaling rule for arbitrary $p$.

AI.tldr: 针对Schatten-∞优化器（如Muon）效果存在冲突观测的问题，本文证明结论依赖于具体场景：即使在Schatten-∞几何下目标平滑，低维场景（包括Chinchilla缩放）中更小Schatten-p几何可能最优。该结论源于对SODA框架中p>2的噪声鲁棒加速分析，同时解释了Muon类方法为何不需要warmup、自然倾向于大batch，并给出了任意p的batch size缩放规则。
AI.motivation: 解决Schatten-∞优化器（如Muon）在经验效果上存在的冲突观测，澄清其适用条件。
AI.method: 通过场景依赖性分析，利用SODA框架在p>2时的噪声鲁棒加速结果，从理论上推导不同Schatten-p几何的优化性能差异。
AI.result: 1）结论依赖场景：低维场景（包括Chinchilla缩放）下更小的Schatten-p几何更优；2）解释了Muon类方法不需要warmup、倾向大batch的原因；3）给出了任意p的batch size缩放规则。
AI.conclusion: Schatten-∞优化器的效果是场景依赖的，更小Schatten-p几何在低维场景中更具优势，相关理论分析统一解释了Muon类方法的多个经验现象。

title: Integrating Reasoning and Generalization in Text-to-SQL via Self-Enhanced Fine-Tuning
summary: Text-to-SQL aims to translate natural language questions into executable SQL queries over structured databases, enabling non-expert users to access data intuitively. While recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have shown promise in this task, existing LLM-based approaches often struggle to strike a balance between strong reasoning capabilities and robust generalization. To address these limitations, we propose CoTE-SQL to enhance the LLM-based text-to-SQL generation with three key innovations: (i) self-enhanced reasoning traces distilled from LLMs without human annotation, (ii) structured chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting with modular decomposition and examples retrieval, and (iii) error-aware revision based on SQL execution feedback. Extensive experiments on the Spider and Bird benchmarks demonstrate that CoTE-SQL achieves new state-of-the-art performance among methods built on open-source LLMs with comparable model sizes on Bird (53.39% EX / 59.02 VES) and strong results on Spider (79.60% EX / 77.19 VES), with especially significant gains on complex queries. Results highlight the effectiveness of combining self-enhancement, structured reasoning, and execution-time feedback within an LLM-based framework for text-to-SQL design.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CoTE-SQL框架，通过自增强推理蒸馏、结构化链式提示和基于执行反馈的错误修正，在开源LLM基础上实现了Text-to-SQL任务的新SOTA性能（Bird 53.39% EX, Spider 79.60% EX）。
AI.motivation: 现有基于LLM的Text-to-SQL方法难以同时兼顾强推理能力和良好泛化性，亟需一种能在两者间取得平衡的方法。
AI.method: CoTE-SQL包含三个创新：(i) 无需人工标注的自增强推理轨迹蒸馏；(ii) 结合模块化分解和示例检索的结构化思维链提示；(iii) 基于SQL执行反馈的错误感知修正机制。
AI.result: 在Spider基准上达到79.60% EX / 77.19 VES，在Bird基准上达到53.39% EX / 59.02 VES，尤其在复杂查询上提升显著，在开源LLM方法中取得新SOTA。
AI.conclusion: 将自增强、结构化推理和执行时反馈三者结合在LLM框架内，是提升Text-to-SQL任务性能的有效设计策略。

title: Distilling Examples into Task Instructions: Enhanced In-Context Learning for Real-World B2B Conversations
comment: Accepted for publication in Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics 2026
summary: In-context learning (ICL) is the standard method for low-resource classification, yet its efficacy in specialized domains remains largely unexplored. We address the challenge of classifying semantically complex, multi-party B2B conversations, where traditional ICL encounters significant limitations, especially as context length increases due to the concatenation of multiple few-shot examples. We introduce the \texttt{Call Playbook} dataset, featuring five classification tasks derived from real-world B2B conversations targeting core sales concepts. To bridge the gap between performance and practical utility, we propose novel knowledge extraction methods that distill verbose examples into compact, interpretable representations of structured classification criteria and precise task descriptions. Our approach achieves a 99\% reduction in token usage and improves macro-averaged AUC by up to 7\% over traditional ICL. Notably, it remains robust as context grows, unlike advanced token compression baselines which degrade by over 9 F1 points. Importantly, our framework enables direct refinement of classification logic, addressing critical needs for transparency, efficiency, and user interaction in real-world NLP applications.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多参与者B2B商务对话分类任务，提出了知识提取方法将冗长的示例转化为紧凑、可解释的结构化分类标准，在《Call Playbook》数据集上实现了99%的token压缩和最高7%的宏平均AUC提升，且具备良好的鲁棒性和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 上下文学习（ICL）在低资源分类中是标准方法，但在专业领域（特别是语义复杂的多人B2B商务对话）中效力未知。传统ICL随少量样本串联导致上下文增长，性能显著受限，缺乏透明性、效率和用户交互能力。
AI.method: 提出新颖的知识提取方法，将冗长的示例蒸馏为紧凑、可解释的结构化分类标准和精确的任务描述；构建包含五个分类任务的《Call Playbook》真实B2B对话数据集。
AI.result: token使用减少99%；宏平均AUC相比传统ICL提升最高7%；随上下文增长保持鲁棒，而先进token压缩基线F1下降超过9点。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够直接优化分类逻辑，满足真实NLP应用对透明性、效率和用户交互的关键需求，在专业领域优于传统ICL和先进压缩方法。

title: RECTOR: Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling for Affective and Cognitive Representation Learning
summary: Affective and cognitive disorders manifest as distributed, time-varying brain network dynamics across regions, channels, and time, challenging robust representation learning from EEG/sEEG for clinical diagnosis. We propose RECTOR (Masked Region-Channel-Temporal Modeling), an end-to-end self-supervised framework that unifies joint region-channel-temporal representation learning beyond fixed anatomical priors. At its core, RECTOR-SA is a hierarchical, block-sparse self-attention induced by Adaptive Functional Partitioning that evolves region structures from static anatomical definitions to adaptive functional regions. The self-supervision is driven by Masked Topology and Representation Learning, which jointly optimizes three complementary objectives: Masked Predictive Modeling, Topological Structure Modeling, and Cross-View Consistency. Across diverse benchmarks, RECTOR sets a new state-of-the-art in EEG emotion recognition and sEEG task-engagement classification. Crucially, its strong robustness to missing channels and cross-montage generalization underscores its potential for large-scale pre-training on heterogeneous EEG/sEEG, providing interpretable insights at both region and channel levels.

AI.tldr: 提出RECTOR框架，通过掩码区域-通道-时间建模和层级块稀疏自注意力机制，实现EEG/sEEG的自监督表征学习，在情感识别和任务参与分类任务上达到SOTA，并展现出对缺失通道和跨导联的强鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 情感和认知障碍表现为跨区域、通道和时间的分布式动态脑网络，传统方法难以从中学习鲁棒的表征用于临床诊断。
AI.method: 提出RECTOR框架，核心包括：(1) RECTOR-SA：基于自适应功能分区的层级块稀疏自注意力，将静态解剖区域演化为自适应功能区域；(2) 掩码拓扑与表征学习，联合优化三个互补目标：掩码预测建模、拓扑结构建模、跨视图一致性。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上，EEG情感识别和sEEG任务参与分类任务达到SOTA；对缺失通道和跨导联泛化表现出强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: RECTOR框架在异构EEG/sEEG的大规模预训练方面具有潜力，能提供区域和通道层面的可解释性洞察。

title: NeuroSymbolic AI for Legal AI-TRISM: Trustworthy, Reliable, Interpretable, Safe Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have transformed natural language processing, but their lack of interpretable reasoning and tendency to hallucinate pose significant challenges for legal applications. While LLMs show promise for legal text analysis and generation, they struggle with accurate citation attribution and precedent verification. For example, in legal contexts, a single incorrect precedent can jeopardize a case. Current approaches to improve LLM reliability in legal domains suffer from two key limitations: inadequate integration of structured legal knowledge during training or fine-tuning, and insufficient verification mechanisms for generated legal content. To address these challenges, we propose the TRISM (Trustworthy, Reliable, Interpretable, Safe Models) framework, which integrates NeuroSymbolic AI principles with LLMs to leverage both neural learning capabilities and symbolic reasoning over structured legal knowledge. The TRISM approach addresses the above limitations while maintaining interpretable decision pathways. Our framework formalizes the extraction of symbolic knowledge from legal textual documents and incorporates Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) as a core component for grounding LLM outputs in verified legal sources. In this position paper, we make the following contributions: (1) An analysis of the limitations of AI in law; (2) Introduce RASOR RAG which creates foundations for neurosymbolic RAG by generating explicit interpretable rationales that could be formalized into symbolic representations; (3) A formalized methodology for creating symbolic legal knowledge bases that support both interpretable reasoning and output verification in LLMs; and (4) The TRISM framework for integrating symbolic legal knowledge with LLMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了TRISM框架，通过神经符号AI与RAG技术结合，解决LLMs在法律应用中缺乏可解释推理、幻觉及引证不准确的问题。
AI.motivation: LLMs在法律文本分析与生成中表现不佳，主要存在两个关键局限：训练/微调阶段缺乏结构化法律知识的有效整合，以及对生成的法律内容缺乏充分的验证机制。一个错误的先例引用可能危及整个案件，因此亟需提升LLM在法律领域的可信度与可靠性。
AI.method: 提出TRISM框架，将神经符号AI原理与LLM相结合；通过RASOR RAG生成可解释的推理依据并形式化为符号表示；构建符号化法律知识库以支持可解释推理和输出验证；设计整合符号法律知识与LLM的完整框架。
AI.result: 本文为立场论文，主要贡献包括：(1)分析了AI在法律领域的局限性；(2)提出RASOR RAG，为神经符号RAG奠定基础；(3)提出构建符号法律知识库的规范化方法论；(4)提出TRISM框架。
AI.conclusion: TRISM框架通过神经符号AI与RAG的融合，有望解决LLM在法律应用中缺乏可解释性和引证准确性的核心问题，为构建可信、可靠、可解释且安全的AI法律系统提供了新路径。

title: Extending Item Response Theory for Efficient and Meaningful Multilingual Evaluation
summary: Multilingual benchmarks are central to evaluating large language models (LLMs) across languages, but they suffer from three issues: exhaustive evaluation scales linearly with the number of languages, automatic translation introduces errors that are easily missed at scale, and some items conflate general and culture-specific knowledge. We address all three with a unified statistical framework, Multilingual-IRT, which extends Item Response Theory with per-language difficulty deviations, split discriminability separating content from language effects, and per-language ability residuals. Fitting Multilingual-IRT on 25 LLMs across 29 languages of MMLU-Pro-X, we show that its fitted parameters support three practical applications: predicting unobserved (item, LLM, language) instances with 11-16% lower binary cross-entropy than the strongest accuracy-based baseline, surfacing candidate translation errors distributed across all 28 non-English languages, whereas accuracy-based baselines concentrate detections in a few languages, and recovering culture-specific items that accuracy-based baselines miss.

AI.tldr: 提出Multilingual-IRT统一统计框架，通过项目反应理论（IRT）扩展，在MMLU-Pro-X数据集的25个LLM和29种语言上，解决了多语言基准测试中评估成本线性增长、自动翻译错误难以检测、以及通用知识与文化特定知识混淆的三个核心问题。
AI.motivation: 多语言基准测试存在三大痛点：1）穷举评估随语言数量线性扩展，成本高；2）自动翻译引入的错误在大规模下难以被有效检测；3）测试条目混淆了通用知识与文化特定知识。现有方法无法同时解决这三个问题。
AI.method: 将项目反应理论（IRT）扩展为Multilingual-IRT框架，引入三个关键参数：每个语言的难度偏移（per-language difficulty deviations）、区分度分裂（split discriminability）以分离内容与语言效应、以及每个语言的能力残差（per-language ability residuals）。在MMLU-Pro-X数据集（25个LLM，29种语言）上拟合模型。
AI.result: 1）预测未见（item, LLM, language）实例时，二元交叉熵比最强基于准确率的基线低11-16%；2）翻译错误候选分散在所有28种非英语语言中，而基于准确率的基线将检测集中在少数语言上；3）能恢复被基于准确率基线遗漏的文化特定条目。
AI.conclusion: Multilingual-IRT框架能同时有效解决多语言基准测试的三大问题，提供更准确、更全面、更细粒度的评估能力，适用于大规模多语言LLM评估场景。

title: Rethinking Structural Anomaly Detection: From Decision Boundaries to Projection Operators
summary: Most existing anomaly detection methods rely on estimating a probability density or learning an enclosing decision boundary, implicitly assuming that normal data occupies a region of non-zero volume in the ambient space. In contrast, structural anomaly detection considers data that lies near a low-dimensional manifold, creating a mismatch between the inductive bias of existing methods and the structure of the data, often resulting in degraded performance. To address this mismatch, we introduce a geometric perspective. Specifically, we learn a projection operator onto the manifold of normal samples and define a sample as anomalous if it is altered by this projection. This formulation naturally integrates the inductive bias of manifold-supported data and reframes anomaly detection in terms of a projection residual, thereby resolving issues arising from modeling degenerate distributions. Notably, it provides a unifying interpretation of reconstruction-based methods by explaining their success and failure in terms of projection quality. In particular, it explains the strong generalization ability of projection-aligned models as a consequence of contraction behavior toward the manifold. Moreover, by decoupling anomaly detection from probabilistic modeling, it reduces the tendency to misclassify rare but normal samples, a widely recognized limitation of existing approaches. Empirically, we demonstrate that projection-aligned methods achieve strong performance, outperforming boundary-based methods while improving upon existing reconstruction-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 本文提出从几何视角进行结构异常检测，通过学习到正常样本流形的投影算子，将异常定义为投影前后发生显著改变的样本，统一了基于重构的方法，并解决了密度估计方法在流形支撑数据上的局限性。
AI.motivation: 现有异常检测方法（密度估计或边界学习）隐含假设正常数据在空间中占据非零体积区域，但现实数据往往位于低维流形附近，导致归纳偏置与数据结构不匹配，性能下降。本文旨在解决这一不匹配问题。
AI.method: 学习一个到正常样本流形的投影算子，通过计算投影残差（投影前后变化）来判断样本是否异常。该框架统一了基于重构的方法，将其成功与失败归因于投影质量，并解释了对齐模型的强泛化能力源于向流形的收缩行为。
AI.result: 投影对齐方法在性能上优于基于边界的方法，并改进了现有的基于重构的方法，同时减少了对罕见但正常样本的误分类。
AI.conclusion: 将异常检测与概率建模解耦，从几何投影残差角度重新定义异常，有效解决了流形支撑数据上的退化分布建模问题，并提供了对重构方法统一的理论解释。

title: Towards Next-Generation Healthcare: A Survey of Medical Embodied AI for Perception, Decision-Making, and Action
summary: Foundation models have demonstrated impressive performance in enhancing healthcare efficiency across a wide range of medical applications. Nevertheless, their limited ability to perceive, understand, and interact with the physical world significantly constrains their effectiveness in real-world clinical workflows, where safety-critical decision-making and physical execution are tightly coupled. Recently, embodied artificial intelligence (AI) has emerged as a promising physical-interactive paradigm for intelligent healthcare, enabling agents to operate in complex medical environments. As research in this area rapidly expands, understanding how intelligent agents function as integrated, end-to-end systems in clinical environments becomes increasingly critical. However, existing surveys on medical embodied AI largely emphasize individual aspects or functional components, lacking a unified system-level organization of the field. To support and consolidate recent advances, we systematically survey the core components of medical embodied AI, with a particular emphasis on the coordinated integration of perception, decision-making, and action. We further review representative medical applications and relevant datasets, and we analyze the major challenges encountered in real-world clinical practice. Finally, we discuss key directions for future research in this rapidly evolving field. The associated project can be found at https://github.com/VMVLab/Medical_Embodied_AI_Paper_List.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了医学具身人工智能的核心组件——感知、决策和行动的协调整合，回顾了代表性医学应用和相关数据集，分析了现实临床实践中的主要挑战，并讨论了未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 现有基础模型在医疗应用中缺乏对物理世界的感知、理解和交互能力，限制了其在安全关键型临床工作流中的有效性。现有综述多强调单个方面或功能组件，缺乏统一的系统级组织。
AI.method: 系统性地调研医学具身AI的核心组件，重点围绕感知、决策和行动三者的协调整合进行组织，并回顾代表性应用、数据集及现实挑战。
AI.result: 梳理了医学具身AI的系统框架，明确了感知-决策-行动协同整合的关键作用，总结了代表性应用场景和数据集，识别了临床实践中的主要挑战。
AI.conclusion: 医学具身AI在智能医疗中具有广阔前景，但临床落地仍面临诸多挑战，未来研究需聚焦于系统级整合与安全可靠部署。

title: Beyond English: Uncovering the Multilingual Gap in Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Vision-Language-Action models have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in learning generalist robot policies from large-scale multimodal data. However, most existing VLA systems are trained and evaluated primarily with English instructions, leaving their ability to understand and execute instructions in other languages largely unexplored. While the underlying large language models often possess multilingual capabilities, it remains unclear whether these multilingual capabilities transfer to VLAs during training. In this work, we present the first systematic study of multilingual instruction following in VLA models. We first construct multilingual instructions by extending existing benchmarks with translations of their instructions. Using these instructions, we evaluate several representative VLA models across a range of tasks in simulation settings. Our experiments reveal a significant multilingual gap: models trained primarily on English instructions exhibit substantial performance degradation when evaluated on other languages, even when the underlying language backbone is multilingual. We provide several findings and analyses to understand the multilingual gap. Cross-lingual transfer behavior analysis shows that performance drops correlate with both instruction understanding and action execution. Representation analyses suggest that multilingual instruction-caused representation shifts may contribute to the multilingual gap. Motivated by these findings, we further explore strategies to improve multilingual performance in VLAs. We propose a simple yet effective multilingual fine-tuning approach, Multilingual Principal Component Alignment, which leverages Principal Component Analysis to get the principal component subspace and align projected multilingual representations, effectively reducing the multilingual performance gap.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统研究了视觉-语言-动作模型在多语言指令跟随方面的表现，发现存在显著的多语言性能差距，并提出了一种基于主成分分析对齐的多语言微调方法（MPCA）来缩小这一差距。
AI.motivation: 现有VLA模型主要针对英语指令训练和评估，其在其他语言上的指令理解与执行能力尚未被系统探究，尽管底层LLM具备多语言能力，但这种能力能否迁移到VLA尚不清楚。
AI.method: 1）通过翻译构建多语言指令基准；2）评估多个代表性VLA模型的多语言性能，分析跨语言迁移行为与表示偏移；3）提出Multilingual Principal Component Alignment（MPCA）方法，利用PCA提取主成分子空间并对齐投影后的多语言表示。
AI.result: 实验表明，VLA模型在非英语指令上性能显著下降，存在多语言差距；性能下降与指令理解和动作执行均相关；多语言指令引起表示偏移是造成差距的原因之一；MPCA方法有效缩小了多语言性能差距。
AI.conclusion: VLA模型存在显著的多语言指令跟随差距，通过表示对齐的微调策略可以有效缓解该问题，为构建真正的多语言通用机器人策略提供了方向。

title: Hybrid NARX-LLM for Greenland Iceberg Discharge: Prompt-Driven Residual Correction
summary: Greenland iceberg discharge exhibits complex nonlinear dynamics with limited observability, challenging traditional predictive models. We present a Hybrid NARX-LLM framework that combines a nonlinear autoregressive model with exogenous inputs (NARX) and a large language model (LLM) for residual correction. We further propose a Physics-Informed Prompt (PIP) method that transforms unstructured physical knowledge into structured prompts for zero-shot in-context reasoning. The primary objective is to explore the corrective potential of this framework for modeling Greenland iceberg discharge, rather than merely optimizing predictive accuracy. The NARX component captures intrinsic temporal dependencies, while the LLM, guided by PIP, encodes glacier dynamics and environmental drivers and perceives key trend patterns to correct systematic prediction errors. This integration allows the model to reason about unmodeled factors and produce interpretable residuals, enhancing overall predictive accuracy. Applied to Greenland iceberg discharge time series, our approach addresses extreme events that are difficult to predict due to rare variations and nonstationary trends, a limitation often overlooked by traditional methods. By fusing structured time-series modeling with knowledge-driven foundation AI, the framework offers a scalable and interpretable pathway to bridge data-limited climate forecasting with physics-informed LLM reasoning. The code is available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出混合NARX-LLM框架，结合非线性自回归模型与大型语言模型进行残差校正，并引入物理知识提示(PIP)方法，用于建模格陵兰冰山排放的非线性复杂动态，提升极端事件预测能力。
AI.motivation: 格陵兰冰山排放呈现复杂非线性动力学且可观测性有限，传统预测模型难以应对稀有变化和非平稳趋势导致的极端事件，需要新的建模框架来弥补这一局限。
AI.method: 构建混合NARX-LLM框架：NARX组件捕获内在时间依赖关系，LLM在物理知识提示(PIP)指导下编码冰川动力学和环境驱动因素、感知关键趋势模式，通过零样本上下文推理校正系统性预测误差，生成可解释残差。
AI.result: 该方法能有效处理传统方法难以预测的极端事件，通过融合结构化时间序列建模与知识驱动的基础AI，提升了整体预测精度，且代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为数据受限的气候预测与物理信息LLM推理之间提供了可扩展且可解释的桥梁，探索了残差校正潜力而非单纯优化预测精度。

title: Advanced Machine Learning and Deep Learning Techniques for Enhanced Cattle Identification and Detection: A Comprehensive Review
comment: Published in the journal of Annals of Emerging Technologies in Computing (AETiC), 34 pages, 5 Figures. The Article is available here: http://aetic.theiaer.org/archive/v10/v10n2/p1.html
summary: The need for effective cattle identification technology is now more acutely felt than ever in maintaining biosecurity, food safety, and supply chain efficacy in livestock management. This paper presents a systematic review of recent research in cattle identification using machine learning and deep learning techniques. The present systematic review measures the effectiveness of traditional and modern cattle identification techniques using studies from major academic databases, where articles were subjected to full-text review. Among these techniques, classical Machine Learning Techniques such as K-Nearest Neighbors and Support Vector Machines have demonstrated good results in cattle identification; however, Deep Learning Techniques, such as Convolutional Neural Networks, Residual Networks, and You Only Look Once, are better in cognition, detection, and identification tasks. Feature extraction relies on common techniques like Local Binary Pattern (LBP), Speeded-Up Robust Features (SURF), and Scale-Invariant Feature Transform (SIFT), while key features commonly used in these studies include muzzle prints and coat patterns. The review highlights key hurdles involving cattle identification, such as the limited number of publicly accessible datasets, issues with data quality susceptible to environmental changes and animal mobility, and high demand for real-time processing ability. The paper aims to inform researchers, policymakers, and stakeholders about implementing scalable, humane, and effective cattle identification systems to achieve sustainable livestock management.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了基于机器学习和深度学习的牛只识别技术，涵盖传统方法（KNN、SVM）与现代深度学习方法（CNN、ResNet、YOLO），讨论了特征提取技术（LBP、SURF、SIFT）及关键特征（鼻纹、毛色图案），并指出了数据集稀缺、数据质量问题和实时处理需求等挑战。
AI.motivation: 牛只识别技术对保障生物安全、食品安全和供应链效率至关重要，然而现有技术面临诸多挑战，亟需系统性梳理和评估各类识别方法的有效性。
AI.method: 采用系统综述方法，从主要学术数据库中检索相关研究，对文章进行全文审查，比较传统机器学习技术（KNN、SVM）与深度学习技术（CNN、ResNet、YOLO）在牛只识别中的表现，并分析特征提取方法（LBP、SURF、SIFT）及所用特征（鼻纹、毛色图案）。
AI.result: 经典机器学习方法在牛只识别中表现良好，但深度学习方法在认知、检测和识别任务中表现更优；常用特征为鼻纹和毛色图案；主要挑战包括公开数据集有限、数据质量受环境影响和实时处理能力要求高。
AI.conclusion: 该综述旨在为研究人员、政策制定者和利益相关者实施可扩展、人道且有效的牛只识别系统提供参考，以促进可持续畜牧业管理。

title: Vernier: Probing Representational Misalignment Behind Lexical Gaps in Causal Reasoning
summary: Instruction-tuned language models can answer the same causal-reasoning question differently after its English variable names are replaced by type-preserving placeholders, although the structural causal model and the gold answer are unchanged. We ask whether this lexical gap reflects information loss in the placeholder view or a misaligned read-out from a representation that still carries answer-relevant content. Vernier uses a paired-view weight update as an instrument and then inspects the mechanism left after the gap closes. In the working regimes, the evidence favours representational misalignment. A variable-name probe becomes more accurate on the placeholder view, and activation patching on Qwen-7B, Qwen-14B, and Llama-3.1-8B shows that the decision-token representation can transfer answer identity between views. The update that realigns the views is counterfactual augmentation over original and placeholder prompts, while the answer-subspace KL mainly sharpens intermediate answer-belief agreement. Success is bounded by model family, scale, and task. CRASS transfer is reliable across Qwen scales and Llama, e-CARE remains weak, and preliminary non-causal rename tasks show a similar qualitative pattern.

AI.tldr: 论文研究了大语言模型在因果推理任务中，当变量名被替换为占位符后回答不一致的现象。通过配对视图权重更新等方法，发现这种不一致源于表征错位而非信息丢失。Qwen和Llama系列模型上的实验表明，通过反事实增强和对齐视图可以改善一致性，但效果受限于模型规模、家族和任务类型。
AI.motivation: 探究指令微调语言模型在因果推理问题中，当英文变量名被替换为类型保留的占位符后，回答不一致（词汇鸿沟）的根本原因：是占位符视图下信息丢失，还是表征中仍包含答案相关信息但读出存在错位。
AI.method: 使用配对视图权重更新（paired-view weight update）作为工具，通过变量名探针（variable-name probe）和激活修补（activation patching）分析Qwen-7B、Qwen-14B和Llama-3.1-8B模型。采用反事实增强（counterfactual augmentation）来重新对齐视图，并利用答案子空间KL散度来提升中间答案信念的一致性。
AI.result: 证据支持表征错位假说：变量名探针在占位符视图上变得更准确，激活修补表明决策token表征可以在视图间传递答案身份。反事实增强有效对齐视图，CRASS迁移在Qwen各规模和Llama上可靠，e-CARE任务上效果较弱，非因果重命名任务呈现类似定性模式。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型在因果推理中的词汇鸿沟主要由表征错位导致，而非信息丢失。通过反事实增强对齐视图可缓解该问题，但效果受模型家族、规模和任务类型的限制。

title: Discovering Lattice Reduction Strategies via Self-Play
summary: The Lenstra-Lenstra-Lovász (LLL) algorithm is a seminal contribution to computer science used for lattice basis reduction, yet its polynomial-time outputs produce bases that are far from optimal as the dimension grows. We show that deep reinforcement learning can discover strictly superior, generalizable reduction strategies by interacting with the primitive action space of LLL. We formulate lattice reduction as a single-player Markov Decision Process (MDP) and train a deep residual network using an AlphaZero-style self-play pipeline augmented with adaptive-horizon MCTS (Monte Carlo Tree Search), which couples multi-step network predictions with an entropy-gated expansion mechanism. The resulting policy, DeltaStar, is trained exclusively on small $8$-dimensional $q$-ary lattices and requires fewer primitive row operations than LLL. Crucially, it generalizes zero-shot to unseen moduli and higher dimensions up to $n=32$ without retraining.

AI.tldr: 本文提出DeltaStar，一种基于深度强化学习（AlphaZero框架+自适应视界MCTS）的格基约简策略，在仅使用8维q-ary格训练的情况下，零样本泛化至32维，且原始行操作次数少于LLL算法。
AI.motivation: LLL算法虽有多项式时间保证，但随着维度增长其输出基远非最优，存在改进空间。
AI.method: 将格基约简建模为单智能体马尔可夫决策过程（MDP），采用AlphaZero风格的自对弈流水线训练深度残差网络，结合自适应视界蒙特卡洛树搜索（MCTS）与熵门控扩展机制。
AI.result: DeltaStar在8维q-ary格上训练后，零样本泛化至未见过的模数和高达32维的格，且需要的原始行操作少于LLL。
AI.conclusion: 深度强化学习能够发现比LLL更优且可泛化的格基约简策略，为格密码学中的计算问题提供了新的解决范式。

title: Overcoming the Impedance Mismatch: A Theoretical Roadmap for Fusing Foundation Models and Knowledge Graphs
comment: 12 pages. Accepted at the ACL 2026 4th Workshop on Towards Knowledgeable Foundation Models (https://openreview.net/forum?id=hXDYsNAq8m)
summary: Modern artificial intelligence remains fundamentally divided between the continuous, probabilistic spaces of Foundation Models and the discrete, deterministic structures of Knowledge Graphs. While Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) attempts to connect them by serializing graph data into text, we argue this lexical bridging is merely a superficial patch. In this paper, we formalize the underlying structural and geometric friction as the \textit{Impedance Mismatch}. By categorizing current neuro-symbolic integration strategies into a three-tiered hierarchy, we demonstrate that neither surface-level prompt injection nor continuous representation alignment can preserve the strict logical motifs required for reliable multi-hop reasoning. We define the specific mathematical limits, such as the Lexical Bottleneck and Topological Collapse, that show current architectures will eventually hallucinate or conflate semantic nodes. To achieve true semantic fusion, we propose a rigorous theoretical roadmap. We advocate for natively internalizing discrete symbolic structures through Structured Residual Streams, utilizing Vector Symbolic Architectures for latent sub-graph injection, and performing model updates via Orthogonal Subspace Editing. This actionable framework paves the way for models that seamlessly fuse the precision of symbolic logic with the expressivity of parametric memory.

AI.tldr: 本文指出当前通过RAG将知识图谱序列化为文本的方式仅是表面修补，正式定义了神经符号系统间的"阻抗不匹配"问题，并提出通过结构化残差流、向量符号架构和正交子空间编辑实现真正语义融合的理论路线图。
AI.motivation: 当前基础模型（连续概率空间）与知识图谱（离散确定结构）之间存在底层结构与几何上的根本性不匹配，而RAG仅通过将图数据序列化为文本进行浅层连接，无法解决深层矛盾。
AI.method: 将神经符号集成策略划分为三层层级结构（表面提示注入、连续表示对齐、原生内部化），分析了词法瓶颈和拓扑坍缩等数学局限性，提出了结构残差流、向量符号架构进行潜在子图注入、正交子空间编辑进行模型更新的理论框架。
AI.result: 证明了当前架构（无论是表面提示注入还是连续表示对齐）都无法保留多跳推理所需的严格逻辑模式，最终会产生幻觉或混淆语义节点。
AI.conclusion: 要实现真正的语义融合，需要让模型原生内部化离散符号结构，从而融合符号逻辑的精确性与参数化记忆的表达力。

title: Retrievable Gradients: Continual Post-Training Without Cumulative Weight Drift
summary: Continual post-training enables models to absorb emerging knowledge after deployment, but repeatedly updating shared parameters can accumulate weight drift, potentially causing catastrophic forgetting and degrading general capabilities. Retrieval-augmented generation avoids such parameter drift, yet often lacks the depth of parametric knowledge integration. In this paper, we propose ReGrad (Retrievable Gradients), a new paradigm that treats gradients as retrievable units of knowledge. ReGrad pre-computes document-specific gradients offline, stores them in an indexed Gradient Bank, and retrieves only query-relevant gradients at inference time for temporary weight adaptation. However, raw language-modeling gradients are optimized for token-level document reconstruction rather than for query-driven knowledge use. We therefore introduce a bi-level meta-learning objective that reshapes document-derived gradients into generalizable adaptation signals for downstream tasks. Experiments across general and domain-specific settings show that \textsc{ReGrad} outperforms CPT and RAG baselines, enabling scalable and reversible parametric knowledge injection without accumulating weight drift.

AI.tldr: ReGrad提出了一种新范式，将梯度视为可检索的知识单元，通过预计算文档特定梯度并存储在梯度库中，在推理时仅检索查询相关梯度进行临时权重调整，从而在不累积权重漂移的情况下实现可扩展且可逆的参数化知识注入。
AI.motivation: 现有方法面临两难：持续后训练（CPT）会累积权重漂移导致灾难性遗忘和通用能力下降，而检索增强生成（RAG）虽避免参数漂移但缺乏参数化知识整合的深度。因此需要一种既能注入新知识又不会导致权重漂移累积的方法。
AI.method: ReGrad包含三个关键步骤：(1) 离线预计算文档特定梯度并建立索引梯度库；(2) 推理时仅检索与查询相关的梯度；(3) 使用双层元学习目标将文档梯度重塑为适用于下游任务的泛化性适应信号，实现临时权重调整。
AI.result: 在通用和领域特定设置下的实验表明，ReGrad优于CPT和RAG基线方法，能够在可扩展和可逆的方式下实现参数化知识注入，同时避免权重漂移的累积。
AI.conclusion: ReGrad提供了一种兼顾参数化知识整合深度与避免权重漂移的新路径，通过将梯度作为可检索知识单元，实现了可逆、可扩展的知识注入，为持续学习提供了有前景的替代方案。

title: LatentGym: A Testbed For Cross-Task Experiential Learning With Controllable Latent Structure
summary: We envision continually learning agentic systems that become more useful over time: as they encounter sequences of related tasks, they should infer the hidden structure shared across those tasks and use it to improve future decisions. This cross-task experiential learning capability is pivotal in domains such as personalization and interactive assistance, but existing training/evaluation frameworks do not provide shared, controllable latent structures and cannot measure whether or why agents improve. We introduce LatentGym: a controllable suite in which each environment is organized around a ground-truth latent variable governing the structure across tasks. Our construction yields metrics that separate exploration (whether the agent's actions gather information about the latent) from exploitation (whether the agent uses what it has gathered). We demonstrate our suite on empirical studies addressing three questions: how and why frontier models fail to adapt across related tasks; whether post-training on related task sequences improves general cross-task adaptation, and where those gains come from; and how design choices such as inter-task feedback shape training dynamics and generalization. Together, these results establish a controlled foundation for studying how LLM agents learn from experience across tasks, and for designing agents that adapt more reliably in sequential, personalized, and interactive settings.

AI.tldr: LatentGym是一个可控的评测套件，通过引入跨任务共享的隐变量结构，分离探索与利用指标，系统评估LLM智能体在序列任务中的经验学习与适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有训练/评估框架缺乏共享、可控的隐结构，无法衡量智能体是否以及为何能在相关任务序列中利用跨任务经验进行改进。为研究持续学习型智能体在个性化、交互式辅助等场景中的跨任务经验学习能力，需要建立可控的基础评测工具。
AI.method: 构建LatentGym套件，每个环境围绕一个控制任务间结构的地面真值隐变量组织；设计分离探索（信息收集）与利用（信息使用）的度量指标；通过三项实证研究验证套件有效性。
AI.result: 揭示了前沿模型未能适应相关任务的原因；验证了在相关任务序列上进行后训练能提升跨任务适应能力并分析了增益来源；展示了任务间反馈等设计选择对训练动态和泛化的影响。
AI.conclusion: LatentGym为研究LLM智能体如何从跨任务经验中学习提供了可控基础，并为设计在序列化、个性化和交互式场景中更可靠适应的智能体奠定了基础。

title: Where Did It Go Wrong? Process-Level Evaluation of Web Agents with Semantic State Tracking
summary: Web agents act through long interaction sequences, yet existing benchmarks evaluate only terminal success, discarding all process information and offering little guidance on improvement. In this work, we conduct a process-level analysis of web agents. We introduce WebStep, a benchmark of 1,800 task instances with controlled difficulty and automatic semantic state tracking. Each website exposes a deterministic semantic MDP alongside the GUI: the agent operates on the interface, while the environment records high-level states and transitions in the background, enabling fine-grained analysis without manual annotation. Based on the semantic trajectory, we first show that process metrics reveal differences invisible to outcome evaluation: three agents whose success rates cluster within 31-33% diverge in exploration reach versus execution accuracy. Then, decomposing by skill characterizes the nature of these differences, exposing opposite per-skill rankings hidden within the same website: e.g., on Housing, OpenAI CUA outperforms Qwen3.5 by 23.7% on commit actions yet underperforms it by 15.6% on filtering, pinpointing a concrete skill to improve even within a domain. Bifurcation analysis further localizes the decisive error that loses the task and shows that this error is agent-specific rather than shared. Finally, these differences widen as tasks grow harder: success rate is similar on easy tasks but separates sharply as exploration becomes more demanding. Our process-level analysis opens a new avenue in web agent evaluation, providing fine-grained and actionable insight into where and how each agent should be improved.

AI.tldr: 本文提出WebStep基准，通过语义状态追踪对Web智能体进行过程级分析，发现过程指标能揭示终端成功率无法反映的差异，并定位到具体技能缺陷和关键错误点。
AI.motivation: 现有Web智能体基准仅评估终端成功率，丢弃了所有过程信息，无法为改进提供指导。
AI.method: 构建WebStep基准（1800个任务实例），每个网站暴露确定性语义MDP，在后台记录高层状态和转换，实现细粒度过程分析；包括过程指标对比、技能分解、分岔点定位、难度影响分析。
AI.result: 1）过程指标揭示三个成功率相近（31-33%）的智能体在探索覆盖与执行准确度上差异显著；2）不同智能体在同一网站上的各技能排名相反（如CUA在提交动作上领先Qwen3.5 23.7%，但在过滤上落后15.6%）；3）分岔分析定位到智能体特有的关键失误点；4）任务变难时成功率差异扩大。
AI.conclusion: 过程级分析为Web智能体评估开辟了新方向，提供了细粒度、可操作的改进指导。

title: EHRNote-ChatQA: A Benchmark for Evidence-Grounded Multi-Turn Clinical Question Answering over Longitudinal Discharge Summaries
summary: Discharge summaries are crucial clinical documents containing the context of a patient's overall hospital stay, and are routinely reviewed by medical experts for patient readmission, ongoing care, and diagnostic decision-making. When reviewing them, medical experts often must iteratively synthesize information across multiple summaries while verifying the evidence supporting each answer. Although large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for clinical question answering, existing benchmarks do not sufficiently reflect this setting: they often evaluate exam-style medical knowledge or focus on single-turn question answering with limited evidence-grounding evaluation. We introduce EHRNote-ChatQA, the first benchmark for evidence-grounded multi-turn clinical question answering over patients' multiple discharge summaries. Built from de-identified MIMIC-IV discharge summaries, EHRNote-ChatQA contains 967 patient-level multi-turn samples spanning one to five notes and 16,072 medical-expert-verified QA pairs (8,036 content questions, each paired with an evidence-grounding question) across eight clinical categories. The benchmark is constructed through an expert-informed pipeline combining discharge-summary structuring schema, expert-curated multi-turn QA templates, and LLM-based generation, followed by review and revision of every single QA sample by 11 medical experts. Benchmarking 22 open- and closed-source LLMs reveals several challenges, including that LLMs struggle more with evidence grounding than content answering, multi-turn errors compound across turns, and single-turn clinical QA performance does not reliably transfer to this setting. These findings establish EHRNote-ChatQA as a rigorous and practical benchmark for evaluating clinical QA systems. The dataset will be made publicly available through PhysioNet credentialed access.

AI.tldr: EHRNote-ChatQA 是一个针对多轮临床问答的基准测试，基于 MIMIC-IV 出院小结构建，包含 967 个患者级样本和 16,072 个医学专家验证的 QA 对。对 22 个 LLM 的基准测试发现，模型在证据溯源方面比内容回答更困难，多轮错误会累积，且单轮问答性能无法可靠迁移到该场景。
AI.motivation: 现有临床问答基准多局限于单轮问答或医学知识考试风格，缺乏对多轮证据溯源问答场景的评估。而医学专家在实际工作中需要跨多份出院小结综合分析并验证证据，现有基准无法反映这一真实需求。
AI.method: 基于去标识化的 MIMIC-IV 出院小结，通过专家指导的管道构建，包括出院小结结构化方案、专家策划的多轮 QA 模板和 LLM 生成，随后由 11 位医学专家对每个 QA 样本进行审查和修订。最终构建了 967 个患者级多轮样本，涵盖 1-5 份出院小结，包含 16,072 个医学专家验证的 QA 对（8,036 个内容问题各配一个证据溯源问题），覆盖 8 个临床类别。
AI.result: 对 22 个开源和闭源 LLM 的基准测试揭示了以下挑战：(1) LLM 在证据溯源任务上比内容回答更困难；(2) 多轮错误会随轮次累积；(3) 单轮临床问答性能无法可靠迁移到多轮证据溯源场景。
AI.conclusion: EHRNote-ChatQA 是一个严谨且实用的临床问答系统评估基准，揭示了现有 LLM 在多轮证据溯源临床问答中的能力不足，为未来研究提供了重要参考。

title: LLMs on Tabular Data with Limited Semantics: Evidence from Industrial Car Retrofit Prediction
summary: Industrial retrofit planning depends on structured operational data rather than free text: planners must estimate whether a newly registered prototype will require a retrofit, which retrofit package it will need, and how long the work will take. We study an industrial dataset linking a prototype-registration system (284,271 vehicles) with a retrofit-management system (48,716 cleaned visits), and compare strong tabular machine learning baselines with three LLM-based strategies on row-serialized inputs: embedding features (Amazon Titan), direct prompted classification (Claude Sonnet 4), and an ML+LLM stacking approach. Across binary occurrence prediction, 15-way retrofit-type classification, per-visit duration regression, and an aggregated monthly benchmark, classical tree ensembles remain the strongest standalone models. However, the LLM results reveal a consistent pattern: embeddings remain useful on tables (binary AUC = 0.982), direct prompting collapses once semantic signal is stripped by hashing (binary AUC = 0.500; multiclass weighted F1 = 0.018), and hybrid stacking yields the best manually built multiclass model (weighted F1 = 0.626). On the monthly benchmark, lag-based machine learning outperforms time-series foundation models, though Chronos-small remains competitive in zero-shot forecasting. The results suggest that on privacy-constrained industrial tables, LLMs are more effective as complementary components than as replacements for strong tabular baselines.

AI.tldr: 本研究比较了传统机器学习、嵌入特征、直接提示分类和ML+LLM堆叠方法在工业改造规划（284,271辆车辆注册数据、48,716次维修访问）上的表现。经典树集成在二元预测、15类分类、时长回归和月度基准测试中仍是最强模型。LLM在隐私受限的工业表格中更适合作为补充组件而非替代方案。
AI.motivation: 工业改造规划依赖结构化操作数据而非自由文本，规划者需估算新注册原型是否需要改造、需要哪种改造包以及工时。现有方法缺乏对此类隐私受限的工业表格数据的系统比较。
AI.method: 使用原型注册系统（284,271辆车）与改造管理系统（48,716次访问）的链接数据集，比较强表格机器学习基线（树集成等）与三种LLM策略：嵌入特征（Amazon Titan）、直接提示分类（Claude Sonnet 4）、ML+LLM堆叠方法。涵盖二元发生预测、15向改造类型分类、每次访问时长回归及聚合月度基准测试。
AI.result: 经典树集成在所有任务中保持最强性能。嵌入特征在表格中有效（二元AUC=0.982）；直接提示在哈希去除语义信号后性能崩溃（二元AUC=0.500；多分类加权F1=0.018）；混合堆叠实现最佳手动构建多分类模型（加权F1=0.626）。月度基准中基于滞后的机器学习优于时间序列基础模型，Chronos-small在零样本预测中表现有竞争力。
AI.conclusion: 在隐私受限的工业表格数据上，LLM更适合作为强表格基线的补充组件而非替代方案。

title: Multi-agent Framework for Time-Sensitive Complementary Collaboration in Minecraft
summary: We present TickingCollabBench, a Minecraft-based multi-agent benchmark for a novel class of time-sensitive complementary collaboration tasks. Our benchmark reflects four core characteristics of real-world collaboration: agent heterogeneity, mandatory collaboration, dynamic environments, and strict real-time constraints with failure risks. To enable this, we develop the TickingCollab framework, which supports the generation of diverse dynamic environments and abstracts Minecraft's primitive APIs to enable declarative YAML task specifications for composing these events. Building on this, we design a feasibility-aware automated benchmark generation pipeline, where an LLM drafts structurally diverse task configurations and feasibility verifier filters out invalid ones using approximate constraints. Evaluations demonstrate that lang latency and inherent difficulty of coordinating under partial observability and agent heterogeneity cause LLMs to frequently fail under dynamic environments and fall significantly short of a global-knowledge oracle.

AI.tldr: 提出了TickingCollabBench，一个基于Minecraft的多智能体基准测试，专注于时间敏感的互补协作任务，并验证了LLM在动态环境中因延迟和协调困难而表现不佳。
AI.motivation: 现有基准缺乏对现实世界协作四个核心特征（智能体异质性、强制性协作、动态环境、严格实时约束与失败风险）的综合评估。
AI.method: 开发TickingCollab框架，支持动态环境生成并通过YAML声明式任务规范抽象Minecraft原始API；设计可行性感知的自动化基准生成流水线，使用LLM生成多样化任务配置并由可行性验证器过滤无效配置。
AI.result: LLM在动态环境下因延迟和部分可观测性下的协调困难而频繁失败，性能显著低于全局知识oracle。
AI.conclusion: TickingCollabBench有效揭示了当前LLM在时间敏感型多智能体协作中的局限性，为未来研究提供了具有挑战性的评估平台。

title: A Self Consistency Based Reranking for Narrative Question Answering
summary: Narrative question answering (NQA) is a challenging task in natural language processing that requires models to understand long textual contexts, capture relationships across events, and generate coherent responses. Despite recent advances in pretrained language models, most existing approaches rely on a single decoding output during inference, making them sensitive to generation variability and often resulting in incomplete or inconsistent answers .To address this limitation, we propose a self-ensemble Self-Consistency-Based reranking framework for narrative question answering. The proposed method generates multiple candidate answers for each story-question pair and selects the final answer based on semantic agreement among the generated responses. This allows the model to explore diverse answer formulations while improving robustness through consensus-based selection without requiring modifications to the underlying architecture .The framework combines pretrained and fine-tuned language generation with multi-answer inference and similarity-based reranking. We evaluate the proposed approach on the NarrativeQA dataset using multiple models, including FLAN-T5 (Base and Small) and Pegasus-Large, under both baseline and fine-tuned settings .Experimental results demonstrate that the proposed method consistently improves performance across all models. In particular, FLAN-T5-Base achieves the best overall performance, improving from 82.32% to 86.66% (+4.34%) when combined with self-ensemble inference. Additionally, the largest improvement is observed with Pegasus-Large, which increases from 72.50% to 87.07% (+14.57%), highlighting the effectiveness of the proposed strategy.

AI.tldr: 针对叙事问答中单次解码输出易产生不完整/不一致答案的问题，提出基于自集成一致性的重排序框架，通过生成多个候选答案并基于语义一致性选择最终答案，在NarrativeQA数据集上使FLAN-T5-Base从82.32%提升至86.66%，Pegasus-Large从72.50%提升至87.07%。
AI.motivation: 现有NQA方法在推理时仅依赖单次解码输出，对生成变异性敏感，常导致答案不完整或不一致。
AI.method: 提出自集成一致性重排序框架：为每个故事-问题对生成多个候选答案，基于语义一致性（而非架构修改）通过共识选择最终答案；结合预训练/微调语言生成、多答案推理和基于相似度的重排序。
AI.result: 在NarrativeQA上，FLAN-T5-Base从82.32%提升至86.66%（+4.34%）；Pegasus-Large从72.50%提升至87.07%（+14.57%），所有模型均获得一致性提升。
AI.conclusion: 自集成一致性重排序无需修改底层架构即可有效提升叙事问答的鲁棒性和性能，尤其对初始性能较低的模型提升显著。

title: Semantic DLM+: Improving Diffusion Language Models through Bias-variance Trade-off in Transition Kernel Design
summary: Diffusion Language Models (DLMs) have demonstrated strong scaling capacity as alternatives to autoregressive language models. However, their performance is highly sensitive to the choice of transition kernels, and poorly designed kernels can lead to issues like training instability, slow convergence, and biased sampling. In this paper, we study this sensitivity through a principled analysis of generalization error and identify three critical factors: asymptotic bias (difficulty in approximating the posterior distribution), exposure bias (error propagation during sampling), and optimization variance induced by kernel dispersion. We further compare different transition kernels: masking diffusion yields sparse and easier posterior-approximation targets, while uniform diffusion provides stronger sampling-side repair but induces harder approximation. Motivated by this trade-off, we revisit a previously overlooked variant, semantic DLM (SemDLM), where the transition kernel corrupts tokens to neighborhoods that are semantically similar. Our theory suggests that SemDLM can serve as a plausible middle ground by reducing the posterior approximation difficulty of uniform diffusion while retaining repair ability. However, we find that SemDLM suffers from a semantic basin problem, where sampling repeatedly stays within a semantic region and produces low-diversity text. To address this, we propose SemDLM+, which adds a global transition and a semantic-frequency penalty during sampling. Experiments on LM1B and OpenWebText show that SemDLM+ improves training dynamics and achieves competitive language modeling and generation quality with satisfactory diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文通过泛化误差分析，研究了扩散语言模型对转移核的敏感性，发现渐近偏差、暴露偏差和优化方差是三个关键因素。对比了掩码扩散和均匀扩散的优缺点，重新审视了语义DLM（SemDLM）作为折中方案，但发现其存在语义盆地问题导致生成多样性低。为此提出SemDLM+，通过添加全局转移和语义频率惩罚，在LM1B和OpenWebText上实现了竞争性的语言建模和生成质量，同时保持了良好的多样性。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型（DLM）对转移核的选择高度敏感，设计不当的核会导致训练不稳定、收敛慢和采样有偏。现有研究缺乏对这种敏感性的理论分析，需要系统地理解不同核的优劣，并寻找更好的折中方案。
AI.method: 1. 通过泛化误差分析识别三个关键因素：渐近偏差（后验近似难度）、暴露偏差（采样误差传播）和优化方差（核分散引起）。2. 理论对比掩码扩散（稀疏后验易近似）和均匀扩散（强修复能力但难近似）。3. 重新审视SemDLM（语义相似邻域转移），发现其存在语义盆地问题。4. 提出SemDLM+，添加全局转移和语义频率惩罚来解决多样性问题。
AI.result: 在LM1B和OpenWebText数据集上，SemDLM+改善了训练动态，在语言建模和生成质量上达到竞争性水平，同时保持了满意的多样性。
AI.conclusion: 转移核的设计对DLM性能至关重要，存在后验近似难度与采样修复能力之间的权衡。SemDLM作为折中方案具有潜力，但需额外机制解决语义盆地问题。SemDLM+有效缓解了该问题，实现了性能与多样性的平衡。

title: Recurrent Reasoning on Symbolic Puzzles with Sequence Models
summary: Large language models often appear strong on symbolic and algorithmic tasks, yet this apparent strength can hide brittle behaviour when problems become longer, harder, or slightly out of distribution. A major limitation of current reasoning benchmarks is that many primarily test whether a model can produce a valid answer, while paying less attention to whether the solution is minimal, robust, and stable under controlled difficulty scaling. We introduce RecurrReason, a difficulty-controlled benchmark of four recurrent logic puzzles (Tower of Hanoi, River Crossing, Block World, and Checkers Jumping) with BFS-optimal trajectories and a single interpretable difficulty parameter $N \in \{1,\dots,10\}$, totalling 10{,}817 unique puzzles and 285{,}933 moves. We benchmark two Transformer families, an encoder-decoder model (T5-style) and a decoder-only model (GPT-2-style), under consistent data splits and evaluation criteria, training on $N{=}1$ to $7$ and evaluating on both held-out in-distribution instances and harder out-of-distribution instances at $N{=}8$ to $10$. Fine-tuned pre-trained T5 achieves 97.27\% validation and 81.00\% OOD accuracy on Block World; all models score 0.00\% on River Crossing under all conditions. Failure mode analysis reveals that architecture is a stronger determinant of success than scale. Pre-training transfers only to puzzles with locally structured transition functions. Our code and dataset will be open-sourced upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RecurReason，一个包含四种递归逻辑谜题的难度可控基准测试，配有BFS最优轨迹和可解释难度参数N。在两个Transformer家族上进行实验，发现架构比规模更能决定成功，预训练仅对具有局部结构化转移函数的谜题有效。
AI.motivation: 当前推理基准测试主要关注模型能否生成有效答案，而较少关注解是否最小化、鲁棒以及在可控难度缩放下的稳定性。
AI.method: 构建RecurReason基准（包含汉诺塔、过河问题、积木世界、跳棋四种谜题），BFS生成最优轨迹，N=1~10共10,817个独特谜题和285,933步；在T5和GPT-2两种架构上训练N=1~7，评估分布内和分布外（N=8~10）性能。
AI.result: 微调T5在积木世界达97.27%验证准确率和81.00% OOD准确率；所有模型在过河问题上得分为0.00%；架构比规模更重要；预训练仅对局部结构化转移函数的谜题有迁移效果。
AI.conclusion: 现有推理模型在递归逻辑任务上存在脆弱性，架构选择对泛化能力影响显著，且不同谜题类型的迁移效果差异大。

title: ttda704 at SemEval-2026 Task 6: Structured Chain-of-Thought Prompting for Political Evasion Detection
summary: This paper describes our system for SemEval-2026 Task 6, which addresses the classification of political evasion strategies in English question-answer pairs extracted from U.S. presidential interviews. We systematically compare two distinct paradigms: (1) Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning of Qwen3 models (4B-32B) using QLoRA, enhanced with tiered upsampling and weighted cross-entropy loss to address severe class imbalance, and (2) structured Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting of reasoning-capable API models, namely DeepSeek-V3.2 and Grok-4-Fast. Our evaluation demonstrates that structured CoT prompting of reasoning-enabled models substantially outperforms our baseline parameter-efficient fine-tuning implementation in absolute Macro F1. Our best system, Grok-4-Fast with extended reasoning and few-shot hierarchical CoT prompting, achieves a Macro F1 of 0.5147 on Subtask 2 (9-class evasion) and 0.7979 on Subtask 1 (3-class clarity), ranking 8th out of 33 teams on Subtask 2 and 13th out of 41 teams on Subtask 1 on the official leaderboard. Furthermore, our ablation studies reveal key insights into effective prompt design for evasion detection: presenting labels within a hierarchical taxonomy helps structure model reasoning, while few-shot exemplars provide task calibration. However, the strongest prompt variants are not statistically distinguishable in Macro F1, and explicitly enabling extended reasoning modes yields substantial performance gains by facilitating the multi-step pragmatic analysis required to detect evasive intent.

AI.tldr: 本文针对SemEval-2026 Task 6的英语政治问答中回避策略分类任务，系统比较了两种范式：基于QLoRA的Qwen3参数高效微调（4B-32B）与基于结构化思维链提示的推理型API模型（DeepSeek-V3.2和Grok-4-Fast）。实验表明，结构化CoT提示的推理模型显著优于参数高效微调基线，最佳系统Grok-4-Fast在Subtask 2（9类回避）上取得0.5147 Macro F1，在Subtask 1（3类清晰度）上取得0.7979 Macro F1，分别位列排行榜第8/33名和第13/41名。消融实验揭示了层次化标签分类、少样本示例校准和扩展推理模式对回避检测的关键作用。
AI.motivation: 政治人物在采访中常采用言语回避策略来规避直接回答问题，现有方法在处理类别不平衡和细粒度回避分类方面存在不足。本文旨在系统比较参数高效微调与结构化推理提示两种范式在回避策略检测上的效果差异，并探索有效的提示设计策略。
AI.method: 采用两种范式：(1) 使用QLoRA对Qwen3模型（4B-32B）进行参数高效微调，结合层级上采样和加权交叉熵损失处理类别不平衡；(2) 对DeepSeek-V3.2和Grok-4-Fast采用结构化思维链（CoT）提示，包括层次化标签分类、少样本示例和扩展推理模式。在官方划分的9类回避策略（Subtask 2）和3类清晰度（Subtask 1）上进行评估。
AI.result: Grok-4-Fast结合扩展推理与少样本层次化CoT提示在Subtask 2上达到0.5147 Macro F1，Subtask 1上达到0.7979 Macro F1，分别排名第8/33和第13/41。结构化CoT提示显著优于QLoRA微调基线。消融实验表明层次化标签结构和扩展推理模式是关键因素，但最强提示变体间在统计上无显著差异。
AI.conclusion: 推理型大语言模型结合结构化CoT提示在政治回避策略检测上优于参数高效微调方法。层次化分类标签有助于结构化模型推理，扩展推理模式能显著提升对回避意图的多步语用分析能力，为未来政治话语分析任务提供了有效的提示设计参考。

title: Probabilistic Signature Inversion: Learning Conditional Distributions from Truncated Signatures
summary: The signature transform is a principled feature map for continuous-time paths, valued for its uniqueness and universality. Recovering a path from its truncated signature is, however, structurally ill-posed because the truncated signature map is not injective. We therefore reframe truncated signature inversion as a probabilistic problem -- learning the conditional distribution of a path given its truncated signature -- and adopt a signature-conditioned flow matching model as a practical estimator. This probabilistic formulation elucidates the fundamental difficulty of inversion: Bayes reconstruction error quantifies the irreducible uncertainty remaining after conditioning on a statistic. We derive the Bayes-optimal error under linear statistics, obtaining a closed form for log-GBM and numerically tractable formulas for log-fBM and OU, yielding a concrete theoretical baseline for model validation. This baseline upper-bounds the Bayes error under truncated-signature conditioning, since truncated signatures provide richer information than linear statistics. Experiments show that empirical reconstruction errors under linear-statistics conditioning faithfully align with the theory-derived baseline, while errors decrease when the statistic is replaced with truncated signatures. Moreover, generated paths faithfully recover the conditioning signature while preserving key distributional and temporal structures, indicating that the estimator is well-calibrated to the target conditional distribution. Together, these results establish a well-posed probabilistic framework for truncated-signature inversion, with applicability demonstrated on real financial data beyond the parametric process families covered by theory.

AI.tldr: 本文提出将截断签名逆问题重新定义为概率问题，使用基于签名条件的流匹配模型来学习路径的条件分布，并推导了线性统计下的贝叶斯最优误差作为理论基线。
AI.motivation: 截断签名映射非单射，导致从截断签名恢复路径的结构性不适定问题，需要新的概率框架来解决这一逆问题。
AI.method: 将截断签名逆问题重构为概率问题，采用签名条件的流匹配模型估计路径的条件分布，并推导线性统计下的贝叶斯最优误差。
AI.result: 线性统计下的经验重构误差与理论基线一致；用截断签名替代线性统计后误差降低；生成路径忠实恢复条件签名并保持分布与时间结构。
AI.conclusion: 建立了截断签名逆问题的良定概率框架，提供理论基线用于模型验证，并在真实金融数据上展示了方法的实用性。

title: Do LLMs Reliably Identify Correct Information Units in Aphasic Discourse?
summary: Correct Information Units (CIUs) are central to discourse assessment in aphasia because they quantify communicative informativeness rather than linguistic form alone. However, CIU scoring is time intensive and requires trained raters. This study examined whether instruction-tuned large language models (LLMs) can reliably perform token-level CIU classification from aphasic discourse transcripts. Sixteen picture-description transcripts elicited with the Cat Rescue stimulus were annotated for CIU status according to Nicholas and Brookshire (1993). The sample spanned four severity strata: control, mild, moderate, and severe aphasia. Four publicly available instruction-tuned LLMs were benchmarked under zero-shot and two few-shot prompting conditions across five stratified random seeds. Performance was evaluated against consensus human labels using accuracy, precision, recall, F1, and Cohen's kappa. Zero-shot prompting was insufficient across models. In contrast, few-shot prompting yielded substantial gains and produced competitive performance for three viable models. Mean few-shot F1 scores ranged from 0.776 to 0.817 across Llama-3.1-8B, Qwen2.5-7B, and Mistral-7B, with no significant differences between fixed global and per-chunk local example selection. Phi-3-mini was unstable and did not yield reliable performance. Viable models showed high recall but lower precision, suggesting systematic over-classification of tokens as CIUs. Performance also varied by discourse severity, with the weakest results in more severe aphasia. Few-shot LLM prompting can support automated CIU identification without gradient-based task training, but agreement with human annotation remains insufficient for fully autonomous use. These findings support LLM-based CIU scoring as a promising human-in-the-loop component of discourse assessment systems.

AI.tldr: 本研究评估了指令微调的大语言模型在零样本和少样本提示条件下对失语症语篇进行CIU（正确信息单元）标记分类的性能。少样本提示下Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B和Mistral-7B的F1得分达到0.776-0.817，但精度低于召回率（过度分类），且在严重失语症样本中表现较弱。LLM尚无法全自动替代人工标注，但可作为人机协同评估系统的组成部分。
AI.motivation: CIU是失语症语篇评估中衡量交际信息性的核心指标，但人工评分耗时且需要专业训练。本研究旨在探索指令微调的大语言模型能否可靠地自动完成CIU标记分类，以降低临床评估的人力成本。
AI.method: 使用Cat Rescue图片描述任务收集的16份语篇转录（涵盖正常、轻、中、重度失语症四个严重层级），按照Nicholas & Brookshire (1993)标准进行CIU标注。测试4个公开可用的指令微调LLM（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B、Phi-3-mini），在零样本和两种少样本提示条件下，基于5个分层随机种子进行评估。以准确率、精确率、召回率、F1和Cohen's kappa为评价指标，对照人工共识标签进行性能评估。
AI.result: 零样本提示下所有模型表现不足。少样本提示显著提升性能：三个可行模型（Llama-3.1-8B、Qwen2.5-7B、Mistral-7B）的平均F1得分在0.776-0.817之间，全局固定示例选择与分块局部示例选择间无显著差异。Phi-3-mini表现不稳定。模型召回率高但精确率低（系统性地过度将标记分类为CIU）。性能随失语症严重程度下降，在重度失语症样本中最弱。
AI.conclusion: 少样本LLM提示可以在无需梯度任务训练的情况下辅助自动化CIU识别，但与人类标注的一致性尚不足以实现全自动使用。LLM的CIU评分可作为人机协同（human-in-the-loop）语篇评估系统的有前景组件。

title: DYNA : Dynamic Episodic Memory Networks for Augmenting Large Language Models with Temporal Knowledge Graphs in Continuous Learning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle to incorporate new knowledge without forgetting or costly retraining. We propose DYNA, a lightweight framework that augments a frozen LLM with a temporal knowledge graph where events are nodes and temporal relations are directed, timestamped edges. The graph serves as an external, updatable memory. At query time, DYNA retrieves relevant nodes via random walks and centrality measures, then augments the LLM's response. Evaluated on three temporal recall tasks, DYNA reduces catastrophic forgetting by ~7% compared to fine-tuning and improves temporal ordering by ~5% over standard RAG. Higher graph clustering coefficients correlate with better retrieval, showing that graph structure matters. Contributions: (1) episodic memory as temporal KG, (2) retraining-free LLM augmentation, (3) graph properties as predictors of retrieval performance.

AI.tldr: 提出DYNA框架，通过向冻结的LLM附加一个时间知识图谱（事件为节点，时间关系为有向带时间戳边）作为外部可更新记忆，在查询时通过随机游走和中心性度量检索相关节点来增强LLM响应，无需微调即可注入新知识，在三个时间回忆任务上相比微调减少约7%灾难性遗忘，相比标准RAG提升约5%时间排序能力。
AI.motivation: LLM难以在不遗忘或昂贵重训练的情况下融入新知识，现有方法存在灾难性遗忘和计算成本高的问题。
AI.method: 构建时间知识图谱作为外部可更新记忆，采用随机游走和中心性度量进行检索，增强冻结的LLM响应。
AI.result: 灾难性遗忘降低约7%，时间排序能力提升约5%，图聚类系数与检索性能正相关。
AI.conclusion: 时间知识图谱作为外部记忆能有效缓解灾难性遗忘，图结构特性可作为检索性能的预测指标。

title: DiRecT: Safe Diffusion-Based Planning via Receding-Horizon Denoising
summary: Diffusion models have emerged as powerful tools for planning and control by learning multimodal distributions over actions and trajectories. Yet reliable inference-time safety enforcement remains a key barrier to their deployment in safety-critical tasks. Existing approaches typically project each denoising iterate onto the feasible set, even though constraints are defined only on the final clean trajectory. Enforcing feasibility on noisy intermediate samples can therefore overconstrain the sampling dynamics, substantially degrading sample quality. To address this limitation, we introduce DiRecT (Diffusion-based planning via Receding-horizon denoising with Terminal constraints), a training-free algorithm for constrained sampling from diffusion models via stochastic optimal control (SOC). DiRecT enforces constraints only on the final clean sample, avoiding unnecessary restrictions on the intermediate denoising dynamics. Inspired by model predictive control, we derive a principled receding-horizon surrogate for the otherwise intractable constrained SOC formulation, yielding an efficient algorithm that cleanly separates stochastic denoising from constraint satisfaction, progressively steering samples toward feasible final trajectories without distorting the learned diffusion dynamics. Furthermore, DiRecT is highly flexible: it can leverage off-the-shelf or domain-specific optimizers, incorporate priors over environment dynamics, and optimize additional soft rewards. Extensive experiments on safe planning benchmarks demonstrate that DiRecT substantially improves deployment safety and task performance over existing diffusion-based planning baselines.

AI.tldr: DiRecT是一种基于扩散模型的训练免费约束采样算法，通过随机最优控制和模型预测控制思想，仅在最终干净轨迹上施加约束，避免中间去噪过程中的过度约束，显著提升安全规划任务中的部署安全性和任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有扩散模型在安全关键任务中部署时，现有方法对每个去噪中间步投影到可行集，但约束仅定义在最终干净轨迹上，导致对噪声中间样本施加约束会过度约束采样动力学，严重降低样本质量。
AI.method: 提出DiRecT算法，基于随机最优控制（SOC）框架，采用类似模型预测控制的滚动时域代理来求解原本难以处理的约束SOC问题，仅在最终干净样本上施加约束，将随机去噪与约束满足清晰分离，逐步引导样本朝向可行最终轨迹。
AI.result: 在安全规划基准上的大量实验表明，DiRecT显著提升了部署安全性和任务性能，超越了现有基于扩散的规划基线。
AI.conclusion: DiRecT提供了一种灵活有效的训练免费方法，可在不扭曲学习到的扩散动力学的前提下实现约束满足，且能兼容现成或领域特定的优化器、环境动力学先验及软奖励优化。

title: Artificial Intelligence Index Report 2026
summary: Welcome to the ninth edition of the AI Index report. As AI continues to advance rapidly, the question becomes whether the systems built around it can keep up. Governance frameworks, evaluation methods, education systems, and the data infrastructure needed to track AI's impact are struggling to match the pace of the technology itself. That gap between what AI can do and how prepared we are to manage it runs through every chapter of this year's report. New in this edition, the report tracks how AI is being tested more ambitiously across reasoning, safety, and real-world task execution, and why those measurements are increasingly difficult to rely on. It also features new estimates of generative AI's economic value alongside emerging evidence of its labor market effects, an analytical framework on AI sovereignty, and a science chapter developed in collaboration with Schmidt Sciences. For the first time, the report features standalone chapters on AI in science and AI in medicine, reflecting AI's growing impact across these two domains.

AI.tldr: 第九版AI指数报告指出，AI技术发展速度远超治理框架、评估方法、教育体系和数据基础设施的配套能力，这种差距贯穿报告各章节。新增内容包括：更严格的推理、安全与真实任务测试及其可靠性问题；生成式AI的经济价值与劳动力市场影响估算；AI主权分析框架；与Schmidt Sciences合作开发科学章节；以及首次设立的AI科学与AI医学独立章节。
AI.motivation: 揭示AI技术快速进步与治理、评估、教育等配套体系之间日益扩大的鸿沟，系统追踪AI在各领域的影响并推动相关政策和研究框架的完善。
