In this work, we develop a bifurcation theory framework for gradient descent on the edge of stability that applies directly to overparameterized neural networks. By decomposing the training dynamics into components normal and tangent to the manifold of minimizers, we show that stable EoS training arises from a flip bifurcation in the normal direction, governed by the sign of the first Lyapunov coefficient, while the tangent dynamics drift toward regions of decreasing sharpness. Under mild spectral and geometric assumptions on the loss landscape, we prove convergence to the minimizing manifold when training at the EoS threshold. As a corollary, we recover and unify prior results: we show that the product-stability condition of Gan (2026) is an instance of our framework.

AI.tldr: 本文建立了过参数化神经网络在梯度下降训练中“稳定性边缘”（EoS）现象的分岔理论框架。通过将训练动力学分解为最小化流形法向和切向分量，证明了稳定EoS训练源于法向方向上的翻转分岔，由第一李雅普诺夫系数符号控制，切向动力学则向锐度递减区域漂移。在温和的谱和几何假设下，证明了在EoS阈值训练时收敛到最小化流形，并统一了先前结果。
AI.motivation: 梯度下降在锐度超过经典收敛阈值时仍能长期降低损失（EoS现象）在现代深度学习中普遍存在，但此前严格分析局限于标量或低维损失函数，缺乏适用于现实过参数化神经网络的理论框架。
AI.method: 1) 将训练动力学分解为最小化流形的法向和切向分量；2) 利用翻转分岔理论分析法向动力学，用第一李雅普诺夫系数判断稳定性；3) 证明切向动力学推动参数向锐度递减区域漂移；4) 在温和谱和几何假设下证明EoS阈值训练收敛到最小化流形。
AI.result: 建立了适用于过参数化神经网络的EoS分岔理论框架；证明了EoS训练稳定性的充分条件（第一李雅普诺夫系数符号）；证明了EoS阈值训练收敛到最小化流形；统一并推广了Gan (2026)的产品稳定性条件等先前结果。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供的分岔理论框架为理解过参数化神经网络中EoS现象提供了严格理论基础，揭示了法向翻转分岔与切向锐度漂移的耦合机制，将先前分散的结果纳入统一理论。

title: UrbanWell: Benchmarking Multimodal Large Language Models for Spatio-Temporal Urban Wellbeing Analytics
comment: accepted by KDD Datasets and Benchmarks Track 2026
summary: Understanding urban wellbeing from multimodal data requires integrating heterogeneous spatial and temporal signals, posing significant challenges for current multimodal large language models (MLLMs). We introduce UrbanWell, a large-scale benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the spatio-temporal reasoning capabilities of MLLMs for urban wellbeing analytics through joint modeling of satellite and street view imagery. UrbanWell spans 38 cities across multiple years and includes diverse indicators covering (1) environmental conditions (CO$_2$, NO$_2$, PM${2.5}$, and Normalized Difference Vegetation Index), (2) spatial accessibility (minimum distance to supermarkets and restaurants), (3) urban form (road length, road density, and land use), (4) urban vitality (population, economic activity diversity, and land use diversity), and (5) subjective perception attributes (e.g., safety, beauty, liveliness, wealth, and quietness). All indicators are aligned at grid level to enable standardized evaluation. Beyond static prediction, UrbanWell defines temporal reasoning tasks, including future value forecasting from historical observations and temporal trend classification. We benchmark 15 state-of-the-art representative MLLMs in a zero-shot setting, providing a comprehensive comparative evaluation across spatial and temporal dimensions. Experimental results indicate that while MLLMs capture salient spatial and perceptual cues, their performance varies substantially across heterogeneous urban indicators spanning environment and subjective perception. UrbanWell serves as a unified benchmark for evaluating multimodal spatial and temporal reasoning in urban wellbeing analytics, offering a standardized testbed for systematic assessment and future research on multimodal urban intelligence. Our codes and datasets are accessible via https://github.com/axin1301/UrbanWell-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: UrbanWell是一个大规模基准测试，通过卫星和街景图像联合建模，系统评估多模态大语言模型在空间和时间维度上推理城市福祉的能力，覆盖38个城市、多种环境、可达性、城市形态、活力和主观感知指标。实验表明，当前MLLMs在捕捉空间和感知线索方面有效，但在不同指标上表现差异显著。
AI.motivation: 从多模态数据理解城市福祉需要整合异构的空间和时间信号，而当前多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）在此方面面临显著挑战，缺乏统一的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建UrbanWell基准，涵盖38个城市多年数据，包含环境（CO₂、NO₂、PM2.5、NDVI）、空间可达性、城市形态、城市活力和主观感知五大类指标，所有指标在网格层级对齐。定义静态预测和时序推理（未来值预测、趋势分类）任务，在零样本设置下评估15个代表性MLLMs。
AI.result: MLLMs能够捕捉显著的空间和感知线索，但在不同城市指标（如环境和主观感知）上的表现差异显著，性能参差不齐。
AI.conclusion: UrbanWell为城市福祉分析中的多模态时空推理评估提供了统一基准和标准化测试平台，有助于推动多模态城市智能的后续研究。

title: Beyond NL2Code: A Structured Survey of Multimodal Code Intelligence
comment: Work completed in January 2026. Updating now
summary: While LLMs have substantially advanced text-to-code synthesis, many real programming tasks specify intent through visual artifacts such as screenshots, charts, documents, vector drawings, videos, and interactive states. These tasks require models to connect visual perception to executable programs, because correctness depends not only on syntax but also on layout, geometry, data semantics, editability, interaction behavior, and domain-specific constraints that apply after execution. This survey examines Multimodal Code Intelligence, covering systems that generate, edit, refine, execute, or reason with code under visually grounded inputs and outputs. We first formulate the field by the role that code plays in each task, distinguishing code as a rendered artifact, an editable symbolic structure, a scientific representation, an intermediate reasoning trace, or an executable policy or tool interface. We then organize benchmarks and methods into four domains: Graphical User Interface, Scientific Visualization, Structured Graphics, and Frontier Tasks and Frameworks. This taxonomy connects mature artifact-generation problems to emerging agentic and unified settings and allows us to compare how different tasks treat evidence of correctness. Looking ahead, we argue that future research may benefit from four verification-centered directions. Multi-signal validation can combine complementary evidence of correctness, multi-state verification can test behavior across execution trajectories, cross-task transfer testing can probe reusable visual-code skills, and verifiable agent traces can reveal whether agent actions are grounded in visual evidence. Together, these directions may move multimodal code generation from single-output imitation toward evidence-grounded executable systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了多模态代码智能领域，系统审视了在视觉输入/输出条件下生成、编辑、优化、执行或推理代码的系统，将任务按代码角色分类（渲染制品、可编辑符号结构、科学表示、中间推理轨迹、可执行策略/工具接口），并组织为四大领域（GUI、科学可视化、结构化图形、前沿任务与框架），最后提出四个以验证为中心的未来方向（多信号验证、多状态验证、跨任务迁移测试、可验证智能体轨迹），推动多模态代码生成从单输出模仿走向基于证据的可执行系统。
AI.motivation: 现实编程任务中大量意图通过视觉制品（截图、图表、文档、矢量图等）表达，而现有LLM主要处理文本到代码的合成，缺乏对视觉感知与可执行程序之间联系的系统理解，需要建立面向视觉驱动代码生成的形式化框架与验证方法论。
AI.method: 通过系统综述方法，首先对多模态代码智能任务按代码扮演的角色进行形式化分类，然后构建涵盖GUI、科学可视化、结构化图形及前沿任务的四领域基准与方法组织体系，最后提出四个以验证为中心的未来研究方向。
AI.result: 建立了多模态代码智能的形式化分类体系（五类代码角色），系统梳理了四个领域的基准与方法，揭示了不同任务对正确性证据的不同处理方式，提出了四个面向验证的演进方向。
AI.conclusion: 多模态代码生成正从单输出模仿范式转向基于多源证据的可执行系统范式，未来研究应聚焦于多种验证信号的融合、跨执行轨迹的行为测试、跨任务视觉-代码技能的迁移以及智能体行为在视觉证据上的可溯源性。

title: Distilling Drifting Transformers with Representation Autoencoders
summary: Representation Autoencoders (RAEs) have improved diffusion and flow models by semantically richer latent space owing to the strongly label-wise clustered DINO features in the pretrained encoders. Yet in the distillation stage, the severe anisotropy and large curvatures caused by the rich semantic representations would hinder the convergence and performance, making the trajectory-based distillation unstable. In this work, we argue that the RAE latent space is compatible with distillation via the newly proposed Drifting Models. We first quantitatively study the curvatures and isotropy statistics across different autoencoders, and theoretically reveal that Drifting Model itself is highly likely to fail on extremely scattered spaces like reconstruction-based VAEs. These motivate us to apply the drifting paradigm directly to representation autoencoders. Our proposed method, Drift-RAE, distills pretrained flow models in RAE latent spaces using Drifting, together with insightful modifications that improve training stability by thereotically aligning drifting fields with other frameworks. Regarding the experimental evidences, we achieve 1.77 FID on ImageNet 256 dataset using only 10k distillation steps, surpassing state-of-the-art RAE distillation methods and appearing comparative with the original Drifting Model without requiring an auxiliary MAE feature extractor. The code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Drift-RAE方法，在表征自编码器（RAE）的潜空间中使用Drifting模型进行蒸馏，通过理论分析和实验验证解决了RAE潜空间各向异性和大曲率导致的蒸馏不稳定性问题，在ImageNet 256数据集上以1.77 FID和仅1万步蒸馏步骤超越了现有方法。
AI.motivation: RAE通过DINO特征提供了语义更丰富的潜空间，但在蒸馏阶段，这种丰富语义表征导致的严重各向异性和大曲率会阻碍收敛和性能，使基于轨迹的蒸馏不稳定。现有Drifting模型在极端分散空间（如重建VAE）上很可能失败，因此需要将Drifting范式直接应用于RAE潜空间。
AI.method: 首先定量研究不同自编码器的曲率和各向同性统计量，理论上揭示Drifting模型在重建VAE等极端分散空间上失败的原因。然后提出Drift-RAE，将Drifting蒸馏范式直接应用于RAE潜空间，并引入改进训练稳定性的修改，从理论上将漂移场与其他框架对齐。
AI.result: 在ImageNet 256数据集上以1.77 FID和仅1万步蒸馏步骤达到最佳性能，超越了现有最先进的RAE蒸馏方法，并与原始Drifting模型性能相当，且无需辅助MAE特征提取器。
AI.conclusion: RAE潜空间与通过Drifting模型进行蒸馏是兼容的，Drift-RAE成功解决了RAE潜空间中的蒸馏不稳定问题，实现了高效且高质量的生成模型蒸馏。

title: Agentic Framework for Deep Learning workload migration via In-Context Learning
summary: Translating deep learning models from PyTorch's flexible, object-oriented design to JAX's functional, stateless setup is usually a manual and error-prone task. Automated migration is challenging because Large Language Models (LLMs) struggle with strict and dynamic API alignment and are prone to mistakes for exacting operations. We propose a fully autonomous system that combines In-Context Learning (ICL) with oracle-driven self-debugging. First, we curated an ICL context that serves as a strict reference for idiomatic JAX styling and test case generation. Second, instead of depending on the LLM to deduce mathematical outputs, we run the source PyTorch modules to get their actual dynamic tensor states. This creates an unchangeable execution oracle. We then use an autonomous agentic loop to synthesize tests based on the oracle data. The test cases are executed repeatedly, and the traceback is sent back to the LLM for self-correction. Ablations show that combining ICL references with oracle grounding and self-debugging greatly outperforms pure instructional and basic agentic baselines. This improvement does not add an excessive computational overhead. Our lightweight pipeline achieves 91% numerical equivalence (compared to baseline: 9%, instruction + self-debugging: 27%) on neural modules, providing a highly reliable, scalable blueprint for cross-framework migration. This has been validated across several state-of-the-art models including SAM (segment anything), T5, Code Whisper amongst others showing high numerical equivalency. Code: https://github.com/AI-Hypercomputer/accelerator-agents/tree/main/MaxCode

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种结合上下文学习(ICL)与Oracle驱动的自调试的自主系统，用于将PyTorch模型自动迁移到JAX框架，在神经模块上达到91%的数值等价性，显著优于基线方法(9%)。
AI.motivation: 将深度学习模型从PyTorch迁移到JAX通常需要手动操作且容易出错，因为LLM在严格的API对齐和精确操作方面表现不佳，缺乏自动化迁移方案。
AI.method: 该方法结合了三个关键组件：(1) 精心策划的ICL上下文作为JAX风格和测试用例生成的严格参考；(2) 运行源PyTorch模块获取动态张量状态，建立不可变的执行Oracle；(3) 自主智能体循环基于Oracle数据合成测试，反复执行并将回溯信息反馈给LLM进行自我修正。
AI.result: 在神经模块上达到91%的数值等价性，对比基线方法(9%)和指令+自调试方法(27%)有显著提升，且在SAM、T5、Code Whisper等模型上验证了高数值等价性。
AI.conclusion: 该轻量级管道在不增加过多计算开销的情况下，为跨框架迁移提供了高度可靠且可扩展的蓝图。

title: FinBalance: A Multi-Document Accounting Reconciliation Benchmark
comment: 18 pages, 12 figures. Code and data: https://github.com/Devansh1105/finbalance
summary: Existing financial-NLP benchmarks mostly evaluate prepared artifacts such as filings, tables, or extracted values. Real accounting begins earlier: source documents must be reconciled into cited journal entries, aggregated into a balance sheet, and checked for contradictions. We introduce FinBalance, a multi-document accounting reconciliation benchmark built from source-document bundles across eight industries, three period types, and five difficulty levels. Human-authored business scenarios, accounting policies, tax/FX treatments, document schemas, distractors, and inconsistency templates are composed by a deterministic generator whose ledger produces journal entries,balance sheets, and 23 inconsistency-code labels. On a 710-record evaluation split, six contemporary LLMs reach at most 46% exact final-balance-sheet accuracy. Four models show a 26-41 pp gap between BS_exact, the model's reported balance sheet, and BS_recon, the balance sheet obtained by replaying its entries through our ledger. Models often recover numerically plausible entries but fail to bind them to supporting documents and aggregate them consistently. Citation-pressure prompting barely changes document-linking errors, while ledger-feedback ablations substantially improve reported balance sheets and expose inconsistency-detection trade-offs. Expert finance reviewers validate the benchmark design and labels.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FinBalance，一个基于多文档的会计对账基准，涵盖8个行业、3种期间类型和5个难度级别。该基准通过确定性生成器从源文档生成日记账分录、资产负债表和23种不一致性代码标签。评估发现，六个当代LLM的最高准确率仅为46%，且模型在文档链接和一致性聚合方面存在显著缺陷。
AI.motivation: 现有金融NLP基准主要评估已准备好的文件（如申报表、表格或提取值），但真实会计始于更早的环节：源文档必须被对账到引用的日记账分录，汇总成资产负债表，并检查矛盾。现有基准忽视了这一多文档对账与一致性检查的复杂过程。
AI.method: 构建了一个基于确定性生成器的多文档会计对账基准FinBalance，包含：(1) 从8个行业、3种期间类型、5个难度级别生成的源文档包；(2) 人类编写的商业场景、会计政策、税务/外汇处理、文档模式、干扰项和不一致性模板；(3) 通过账本生成日记账分录、资产负债表和23种不一致性代码标签；(4) 在710条记录评估集上测试六个当代LLM。
AI.result: 六个LLM的最高最终资产负债表准确率仅为46%。四个模型在BS_exact（模型报告的资产负债表）与BS_recon（通过账本重放其分录获得的资产负债表）之间存在26-41个百分点的差距。模型能生成数字上合理的分录，但无法将其与支持文档绑定并一致聚合。引用压力提示对文档链接错误改善甚微，而账本反馈消融实验显著改善了报告的资产负债表，但暴露了不一致性检测的权衡。
AI.conclusion: FinBalance揭示了当前LLM在多文档会计对账任务中的根本局限性：模型能够产生数值合理的分录，但缺乏将分录与源文档可靠链接并一致聚合的能力。该基准为评估和改进LLM在真实会计流程中的表现提供了有效工具，专家评审验证了其设计合理性。

title: A Decision-Theoretic View of Test-Time Training: When, How Far, and Which Directions to Adapt
summary: Test-time training (TTT) adapts a pretrained model to each prompt via parameter updates, improving accuracy under pretraining-to-test distribution shifts. Yet, its performance often suffers from instability and sensitivity to hyperparameters such as update steps and subspace. We explain this behavior through a decision-theoretic lens, treating TTT as implicit Bayesian inference in the kernel regime. Under a Gaussian process benchmark, we show that TTT reduces prediction error when updates are spectrally matched to the prompt's signal-to-noise ratio and aligned with query-relevant eigen-directions. This perspective underpins the following results: (1) we show when fixed update steps and subspaces fail under distribution shifts, motivating adaptive strategies; (2) we prove that selecting update steps via prompt evidence admits a PAC-Bayes guarantee against overfitting; and (3) we characterize the Bayes-optimal update subspace under a linear-Gaussian correction model, yielding a scoring rule for selecting Transformer blocks and heads. Our theory helps explain the empirical instability of TTT, taking a step toward principled guidance for when, how far, and which directions to adapt.

AI.tldr: 本文通过决策理论视角将测试时训练（TTT）解释为核机制下的隐式贝叶斯推断，揭示了其不稳定性和超参数敏感性的根源，并提出了自适应更新步长、子空间选择的理论指导。
AI.motivation: TTT在分布偏移下性能不稳定且对超参数（如更新步长、子空间）高度敏感，现有方法缺乏理论解释和系统指导。
AI.method: 采用决策理论视角，将TTT建模为高斯过程（核机制）下的隐式贝叶斯推断，分析更新与提示信噪比谱匹配及查询相关本征方向对齐对预测误差的影响。
AI.result: (1) 固定步长和子空间在分布偏移下失效，需要自适应策略；(2) 通过提示证据选择步长具有PAC-Bayes过拟合保证；(3) 在线性-高斯校正模型下刻画了贝叶斯最优更新子空间，为选择Transformer块和注意力头提供了评分规则。
AI.conclusion: 该理论解释了TTT的经验不稳定性，为何时、更新多远、沿哪些方向进行自适应提供了原则性指导。

title: SciText2Eq: Assessing LLMs for Explainable Equation Generation for Scientific Creativity
summary: This work investigates the ability of large language models (LLMs) to generate mathematical equations from scientific texts. Prior work faces challenges in unstructured grounding, multi-equation dependency, and humanaligned evaluation. To this end, we construct a dataset of AI research papers, pairing contextual passages with ground-truth equations and variable descriptions. We develop an explainable equation generation workflow and evaluate it across diverse open- and closed-source LLM backbones. We introduce an evaluation protocol combining automatic metrics, LLM-based rubrics, and human judgments to assess accuracy, explainability, and human-LLM alignment. Results indicate that LLMs perform moderately on lexical- and syntactic-based similarity, while struggling with semantic accuracy. Comparisons between LLM-based evaluations and human judgments reveal limited alignment, highlighting challenges in using LLMs to assess equation quality. These findings offer insights for improving equation generation models and developing more reliable evaluation methods for scientific text. We provide code and data for reproducibility.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了大型语言模型从科学文本中生成数学方程的能力，构建了AI论文数据集，提出了可解释的方程生成流程，并设计了结合自动指标、LLM评分和人工判断的评估协议。结果表明LLM在词法和句法相似性上表现尚可，但语义准确性不足，且LLM评估与人工判断对齐有限。
AI.motivation: 现有工作在非结构化方程接地、多方程依赖关系处理以及人类对齐评估方面存在挑战，缺乏系统的方程生成与评估方法。
AI.method: 构建了AI研究论文数据集，包含上下文段落与真实方程及变量描述；开发了可解释的方程生成工作流；设计了结合自动指标、LLM评分和人类判断的评估协议。
AI.result: LLM在词法和句法相似性上表现中等，但在语义准确性上表现不佳；LLM评估与人类判断之间对齐度有限。
AI.conclusion: 研究为改进方程生成模型和开发更可靠的科学文本评估方法提供了见解，并公开了代码和数据以支持可复现性。

title: SAG: SQL-Retrieval Augmented Generation with Query-Time Dynamic Hyperedges
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) offers an effective approach for large language models to access external knowledge. However, existing methods rely on dense similarity retrieval and face inherent limitations in handling structured constraints and multi-hop reasoning. Incorporating knowledge graphs partially alleviates these issues, but at the cost of semantic fragmentation, high maintenance overhead, and difficult incremental updates. This paper introduces SAG (SQLRetrieval Augmented Generation), a structured architecture for retrieval and agent systems. Instead of pre-building a global static graph, SAG converts each chunk into one semantically complete event and a set of indexing entities, then uses SQL join queries to dynamically link events that share entities into local hyperedges,constructing, at query time, a dynamically instantiated local index structure. This design avoids the need for global graph rebuilding and ongoing maintenance; the system naturally supports incremental writes, concurrent processing, and continuous scaling through its reliance on standard database infrastructure. Across HotpotQA, 2WikiMultiHop, and MuSiQue, three standard multi-hop benchmarks,SAG achieves the best results on 8 out of 9 Recall@K metrics, reaching 80.0% Recall@5 on MuSiQue, the benchmark with the highest multi-hop reasoning demands.SAG has also been deployed at a production scale of hundreds of millions of data items, with online retrieval latency kept within seconds. Project site and code are available at https://github.com/Zleap-AI/SAG-Benchmark.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SAG架构，通过将文本块转换为语义完整的事件和索引实体，利用SQL连接查询动态构建局部超边，替代传统全局静态图，实现高效的多跳推理和结构化检索。在三个多跳基准测试中取得8/9的Recall@K最佳结果，并已部署于数亿级生产规模。
AI.motivation: 现有RAG方法依赖稠密相似性检索，在处理结构化约束和多跳推理时存在固有限制；引入知识图谱虽部分缓解问题，但带来语义碎片化、高维护成本和增量更新困难等缺陷。
AI.method: SAG将每个文本块转换为一个语义完整的事件和一组索引实体；在查询时通过SQL连接查询将共享实体的事件动态链接为局部超边，构建动态实例化的局部索引结构，无需预建全局图。
AI.result: 在HotpotQA、2WikiMultiHop和MuSiQue三个标准多跳基准上，SAG在9个Recall@K指标中取得8个最优结果，在MuSiQue上达到80.0% Recall@5；已部署于数亿数据项的生产规模，在线检索延迟保持在秒级以内。
AI.conclusion: 基于标准数据库基础设施的SAG架构避免了全局图重建和持续维护，天然支持增量写入、并发处理和持续扩展，为多跳推理检索提供了一种高效、可扩展的结构化方案。

title: Localizing Credit at the Divergence: Path-Conditioned Self-Distillation for LLM Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement learning from verifiable rewards assigns a single scalar to each rollout, leaving token-level credit assignment underspecified in long reasoning traces. On-policy self-distillation addresses this by letting the same model act as a teacher conditioned on privileged information, producing a dense per-token signal. But the common choice of a ground-truth answer is only an endpoint cue: on terse-answer tasks, the teacher falls silent at the intermediate positions where path-level guidance matters most. We propose Hindsight Self-Distillation (HSD), which conditions the teacher on a successful peer rollout drawn from the current training group. Such a peer is an exact sample from the success-conditioned policy, requiring no additional sampled rollouts. By providing a full successful continuation rather than only the final answer, the resulting credit signal concentrates at the divergence position between a failed rollout and a successful peer. Across Qwen3-8B and Qwen3-32B on math and code benchmarks, HSD obtains the best result against GRPO variants and on-policy distillation baselines, with the largest gains on terse-answer tasks such as AIME.

AI.tldr: 提出Hindsight Self-Distillation (HSD)方法，通过将教师条件设为当前训练组中成功的同伴 rollout（而非仅最终答案），在token级别生成密集的信用分配信号。在数学和代码基准上，HSD在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-32B上优于GRPO变体和在线自蒸馏基线，尤其在简洁答案任务（如AIME）上提升最大。
AI.motivation: 现有基于可验证奖励的强化学习为每个rollout分配单一标量，在长推理轨迹中缺乏token级别的信用分配。在线自蒸馏虽能产生密集信号，但在简洁答案任务中，教师仅在最终位置提供信号，中间推理路径缺乏指导。
AI.method: HSD将教师条件从地面真实答案改为当前训练组中的成功同伴rollout。成功同伴是从成功条件策略中精确采样的样本，无需额外的采样开销。通过提供完整的成功延续而非仅最终答案，信用信号聚焦在失败rollout与成功同伴之间的分歧位置。
AI.result: 在Qwen3-8B和Qwen3-32B的数学与代码基准上，HSD取得了最佳结果，优于GRPO变体和在线自蒸馏基线，在简洁答案任务（如AIME）上增益最大。
AI.conclusion: HSD通过利用成功的同伴rollout作为教师条件，有效解决了长推理轨迹中token级别信用分配问题，尤其适用于简洁答案任务，无需额外采样成本。

title: Auditing Reward Hackability in Code RL Training Environments
summary: We measure the rate at which code RL environments accept incorrect solutions as correct. On a 49-task sample of SWE-bench Verified, 28.5% of tasks have test suites weak enough that a Docker-verified incorrect patch passes them. On 20 R2E-Gym tasks across 6 repositories, the same pipeline at single-shot exploit generation yields 25.0%. A random-effects meta-analysis over 134 frontier model submissions to SWE-bench Verified finds, within the same human-rated difficulty stratum, model Pass@1 is +14.14 percentage points higher on flagged-hackable tasks than on robust ones (95% CI [+11.80, +16.48]; one-sided p < 10^-6; I^2 = 0%; 123 of 134 models positive). We then describe a procedure for hardening the broken tasks. An inline LLM judge with a Docker gold-sanity gate runs each generated test against the gold solution before the judge is consulted. On the 11 broken tasks in the audit, the gate flags 65 of 105 decisive LLM-generated tests as failing on the gold patch itself, a 61.9% per-augmentation defect rate the LLM judge alone misses. With diversity-biased retry, the loop converges 9 of 11 tasks to a gated upgrade.

AI.tldr: 代码RL环境评估显示，SWE-bench Verified中28.5%的任务和R2E-Gym中25.0%的任务存在测试套件脆弱性问题，允许错误补丁通过验证；134个前沿模型提交的元分析表明，在相同难度层级内，模型在可被利用的任务上Pass@1高出14.14个百分点。研究者提出了一种通过内联LLM法官与Docker黄金验证门控的测试加固流程，可检测并修复61.9%的有缺陷测试增强项。
AI.motivation: 当前代码强化学习环境中的测试套件存在脆弱性，可能接受错误解为正确解，导致模型性能评估虚高，需要量化这一问题并开发修复方法。
AI.method: 1) 测量SWE-bench Verified和R2E-Gym中弱测试套件的比例；2) 对134个前沿模型在SWE-bench Verified上的提交进行随机效应元分析；3) 提出内联LLM法官配合Docker黄金验证门控的测试加固流程，包含多样性偏置重试机制。
AI.result: SWE-bench Verified中28.5%的任务存在弱测试套件；R2E-Gym中25.0%的任务可被单一攻击利用；元分析显示在可被利用的任务上模型Pass@1高出14.14个百分点；门控流程检测出61.9%的LLM生成测试存在缺陷。
AI.conclusion: 代码RL评估环境中的测试套件脆弱性问题普遍存在且显著影响模型性能评估，提出的门控加固流程能有效识别和修复有缺陷的测试增强项，9/11的任务经迭代收敛后得到加固升级。

title: Formalize Once, Edit the Rest: Efficient Lean-Based Answer Selection for Math Reasoning
comment: 15 pages, 1 figure. Code available at https://github.com/ucr-rai/base-and-edit
summary: With large language models (LLMs) increasingly applied to mathematical reasoning, formal proof assistants such as Lean can be leveraged to verify reasoning outputs with machine-checkable rigor, enabling use cases such as answer selection in test-time scaling with K sampled candidate answers. However, employing Lean requires that LLM outputs, originally in natural language, first be formalized. Existing Lean-based answer-selection work uses an autoformalization model to generate a formal statement in Lean for each candidate answer independently, incurring a significant computational cost. We propose BASE, a base-and-edit pipeline that formalizes a single base candidate per problem and derives the remaining K-1 statements by editing the answer expression in place. To facilitate this, we train a rewriter model LEANSCRIBE to localize the answer in the base formalization and generate a reusable edit function for the other K-1 candidates. BASE simultaneously improves selection accuracy and reduces formalization cost - a Pareto improvement that holds on all 12 (dataset, solver) configurations across four benchmarks and three solvers, cutting autoformalizer calls by about 5x at K=8, with the reduction expected to become larger as K grows. Code is available at https://github.com/ucr-rai/base-and-edit.

AI.tldr: 提出BASE（基础-编辑）流水线，通过先形式化一个基础候选答案，再通过编辑函数重用生成其余K-1个形式化语句，相比独立形式化每个候选答案的方法，在12个配置上同时提升了选择准确率并降低了形式化成本（约5倍减少）。
AI.motivation: 现有的基于Lean的答案选择方法需要对每个候选答案独立进行自动形式化，计算成本高昂，亟需一种更高效的形式化方案来支持大规模候选答案的测试时扩展。
AI.method: 提出BASE流水线：对每个问题只形式化一个基础候选答案，训练LEANSCRIBE重写模型定位答案位置并生成可复用的编辑函数，将基础形式化中的答案替换为其他K-1个候选答案。
AI.result: 在4个基准测试、3个求解器构成的12个配置上，BASE同时提升了选择准确率并降低了形式化成本。当K=8时，自动形式化调用减少约5倍，且随K增长效益更大。
AI.conclusion: BASE是一种帕累托改进方案，在保持或提升准确率的同时显著降低形式化开销，具有较好的可扩展性。

title: Is Code Better Than Language for Algorithmic Reasoning
summary: For tool-augmented language models, comparing natural-language reasoning with code-execution pipelines is difficult because the comparison changes both the intermediate representation and the execution mechanism. We separate these factors with an intermediate intervention: the model expresses its reasoning as executable code, and the language model simulates that code in context to produce an answer. On a 40-task verifiable algorithmic benchmark, deterministic code execution outperforms natural-language reasoning by +31.6pp. We observe that the intermediate intervention is not meaningfully different from natural-language reasoning (+0.15pp). These results suggest that, in our evaluated setting, changing the intermediate representation alone does not explain the tool-use advantage, providing evidence for the performance gains requiring reliable external execution. We formalize this intuition with a simple statistical decision-theoretic model that characterizes when execution dominates end-to-end risk in our disentangled trace-generation/execution regime. We validate our theory using a reconstruction intervention that leverages a proxy language model to infer natural-language reasoning traces from code representations, recovering performance comparable to the original natural-language reasoning pipeline. All experiments are at https://github.com/TerryTong-Git/ToolProj.

AI.tldr: 本文通过分离中间表示和执行机制，发现工具增强语言模型的性能提升主要来自可靠的外部执行，而非中间表示从自然语言变为代码。
AI.motivation: 现有工作难以区分工具增强语言模型性能提升的来源：是改变了中间表示（自然语言→代码），还是改变了执行机制（模型内模拟→确定性执行）。作者希望分离这两个因素，探究性能增益的真正来源。
AI.method: 设计了中间干预实验：让模型将推理表达为可执行代码，但由语言模型在上下文中模拟执行该代码。在40个可验证算法任务上，比较确定性代码执行、自然语言推理和中间干预三种管线的性能。此外，通过代理语言模型从代码表示重构自然语言推理轨迹，验证理论。
AI.result: 确定性代码执行比自然语言推理高出+31.6pp；中间干预与自然语言推理无显著差异（+0.15pp）。从代码重构的自然语言推理轨迹性能与原始自然语言推理管线相当。
AI.conclusion: 工具增强的性能优势主要来自可靠的外部执行机制，而非中间表示的变化。作者用统计决策理论模型形式化了这一直觉，并验证了该理论。

title: Mind-Studio: Executable World Models with Lookahead Evaluation for Partially Observable Games
summary: World-model synthesis aims to turn interaction experience into an internal model of environment dynamics. Existing symbolic approaches often fit observed transitions or mixtures of local rules, but they do not produce a complete executable program that can run independently of the real environment. We present Mind-Studio, a framework that synthesizes executable pygame-style world models from state-action-next-state trajectories using large language models. Mind-Studio combines entropy-selected traces with a lightweight game skill file containing object, action, and static scene information extracted from screenshots. We evaluate synthesis quality with a K-step lookahead fidelity protocol that compares generated world-model rollouts against Real-ALE rollouts from the same state. On Montezuma's Revenge, Mind-Studio improves chosen-action next-state prediction from 0.3% for PoE-World to 48.7% while verifying 5 of 8 subgoals; across Alien, Assault, and Skiing, it achieves stronger branch-level fidelity than prior learned lookahead sources.

AI.tldr: Mind-Studio是一个利用大语言模型从交互轨迹中合成可执行pygame风格世界模型的框架，在Montezuma's Revenge等游戏中显著提升了状态预测准确率（从0.3%到48.7%），并能在多个Atari游戏中实现比先前方法更强的分支级保真度。
AI.motivation: 现有符号化世界模型合成方法通常拟合观测到的转移或局部规则混合，但无法生成独立于真实环境运行的完整可执行程序，缺乏真正的环境模拟能力。
AI.method: 结合熵选择的轨迹与轻量级游戏技能文件（包含从截图中提取的对象、动作和静态场景信息），利用大语言模型合成可执行的pygame风格世界模型。
AI.result: 在Montezuma's Revenge上，选定动作下一状态预测从PoE-World的0.3%提升至48.7%，验证了8个子目标中的5个；在Alien、Assault和Skiing上，分支级保真度优于先前学习方法。
AI.conclusion: Mind-Studio能够从交互轨迹中合成可执行的、高保真度的世界模型，显著优于现有方法，展示了LLM在程序化世界模型合成中的潜力。

title: A Large-Scale Multi-Dimensional Empirical Study of LLMs for Conversation Summarization
summary: Despite the significant advancement of LLMs in conversation summarization, their evaluation remains limited by insufficient scenarios, input lengths, and sample sizes. Furthermore, existing benchmarks often omit frontier reasoning systems and efficient small models, or lack fine-grained, multi-dimensional assessments. To bridge these gaps, we propose OmniCSEval, a unified benchmark comprising 1,800 diverse conversations across six real-world scenarios, featuring context lengths ranging from 128 to 32k tokens. For fine-grained evaluation, we employ a bidirectional fact-checking framework that integrates key fact matching to assess completeness and conciseness, alongside summary fact verification to evaluate faithfulness. To ensure reliable assessment, we establish a human-LLM collaborative pipeline for key fact extraction and a multi-LLM consensus verifier for summary fact decomposition. Leveraging this framework, we evaluate 28 LLMs across four distinct categories grouped by reasoning capability and model scale. Our extensive empirical study reveals critical insights regarding the cross-scenario challenges current LLMs continue to face, the impacts of reasoning and scale, and the efficiency and adaptability of reasoning models. We also provide guidance for system selection in real-world deployments.

AI.tldr: 提出了OmniCSEval，一个包含1800个对话（128到32k token长度）、覆盖6个真实场景的统一摘要评估基准，采用双向事实检查框架评估完整性、简洁性和忠实性，并对28个LLM进行了评估。
AI.motivation: 现有对话摘要评估存在场景不足、输入长度有限、样本量小的问题，且忽略了前沿推理模型和小型高效模型，缺乏细粒度多维评估。
AI.method: 构建了OmniCSEval基准（1800个对话，6场景，128-32k token长度）；提出双向事实检查框架，包含关键事实匹配（评估完整性和简洁性）和摘要事实验证（评估忠实性）；建立人-LLM协作的关键事实提取流水线和多LLM共识验证器用于摘要事实分解。
AI.result: 对28个LLM（4个类别）进行了评估，揭示了跨场景挑战、推理与规模的影响、推理模型的效率与适应性等关键发现。
AI.conclusion: 该基准和评估框架为对话摘要提供更全面的评估，并为实际部署中的系统选择提供指导。

title: MoECa: Aligning Feature Reuse with Expert Decomposition in Diffusion Transformers
summary: Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts (DiT-MoE) improve model capacity under sparse activation, but diffusion inference is still bottlenecked by redundant computation across timesteps. Existing caching methods mainly operate at the token level, which becomes suboptimal in DiT-MoE because each token update is internally decomposed into multiple routed expert branches. Our analysis shows that cross-timestep redundancy in DiT-MoE is better characterized at the expert-branch level than at the whole-token level. Based on this observation, we propose MoECa, a fine-grained caching framework that performs branch-level feature reuse across timesteps. MoECa further introduces expert-aware adaptive control and synchronized cache updates across MoE and attention paths to maintain stable intermediate states. Experiments on multiple DiT-MoE models show that MoECa consistently achieves a better speed-quality trade-off than prior caching methods, with up to 2.83$\times$ inference speedup and minimal quality degradation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出MoECa，一种针对Diffusion Transformers with Mixture-of-Experts的细粒度分支级缓存框架，通过在专家分支层级复用跨时间步特征，结合专家感知的自适应控制和同步缓存更新，实现高达2.83倍的推理加速且质量损失极小。
AI.motivation: 现有缓存方法主要工作在token级别，但在DiT-MoE中每个token更新被分解为多个路由专家分支，token级缓存变得次优。分析表明DiT-MoE的跨时间步冗余在专家分支级别比整个token级别更容易表征，因此需要更细粒度的分支级缓存策略。
AI.method: 提出MoECa框架：1) 分支级特征复用——在专家分支层级跨时间步复用特征；2) 专家感知的自适应控制——根据不同专家分支特性自适应控制缓存策略；3) 同步缓存更新——在MoE路径和Attention路径之间保持同步缓存更新以维持稳定的中间状态。
AI.result: 在多个DiT-MoE模型上，MoECa相比现有缓存方法一致地实现了更好的速度-质量权衡，最高可达2.83倍推理加速，同时质量退化极小。
AI.conclusion: MoECa通过利用DiT-MoE中专家分支级别的跨时间步冗余，实现了比token级缓存更优的性能，验证了分支级特征复用的有效性。

title: Rhythm of the Deep: A Computational-Linguistic Test of Duality of Patterning in Sperm Whale Codas
summary: Human language has often been described as combining structure at two levels: lower-level units combine into larger units, which then combine into larger sequences. We test for this design feature, duality of patterning, in sperm whale codas using 1,483 codas from the Dominica Sperm Whale Project. Because acoustic similarity can imitate symbolic structure, we treat the problem as computational-linguistic structure discovery from continuous audio rather than as a direct claim about language or meaning. We use a consensus of frozen audio encoders, held-out structural tests, per-statistic nulls, and acoustic-null recoverability gates. The evidence supports a narrow two-tier architecture. At the lower tier, clicks compose into codas not by a stable ordered rule, but by which clicks are present together with their inter-click rhythm. At the upper tier, coda tokens show bout-level sequential dependence, with an NSB second-order transfer-entropy lift of 0.132 bits (p = 0.002). Under tempo scaling, encoder-derived click identity is strongly rate-bound, while coda identity remains substantially more stable, yielding a measurable abstraction gradient across the click-to-coda step. Rhythm-only baselines recover substantial lower-tier structure but fail to reproduce the upper-tier sequential-dependence signal. We do not claim language, semantics, perception, or human-like phonemes. Instead, we report representation-level evidence for a duality-of-patterning-like architecture whose lower tier is rhythmic rather than segmental, and provide a portable null-controlled framework for testing combinatorial structure in induced acoustic token systems.

AI.tldr: 本文通过1,483次 sperm whale codas 录音，使用计算语言学结构发现方法，验证了精子鲸的通信系统存在"双重模式"（duality of patterning）——低层级（click组合成coda）依赖节律而非固定顺序，高层级（coda序列）存在统计显著的序列依赖性。研究不主张语言或语义含义，仅提供表征层面的证据和可移植的零假设控制框架。
AI.motivation: 检验动物通信系统（精子鲸coda）是否具备人类语言的"双重模式"设计特征——即低层级单位组合为高层级单位，高层级单位再组合为更长的序列。
AI.method: 将声学相似性视为模拟符号结构，采用计算语言学结构发现方法，使用冻结音频编码器共识、保留结构测试、逐统计量零假设和声学零假设可恢复性门控进行分析。
AI.result: 支持狭窄的两层架构：低层——click组成coda不依赖稳定顺序，而依赖哪些click同时出现及click间节律；高层——coda tokens展示出bout层级的序列依赖性（NSB二阶转移熵提升0.132 bits, p=0.002）。节律基线能恢复部分低层结构但无法复现高层序列依赖信号。click身份速率关联强，而coda身份更稳定，存在可测量的抽象梯度。
AI.conclusion: 精子鲸通信系统存在类似双重模式的架构，但其低层级是节律性而非分段性的。研究提供了一个可移植的零假设控制框架，可用于测试诱导声学符号系统中的组合结构。

title: ROMPAR: Morphological Completion and Demographic Unlearning for Romanian-Accented Speech Recognition
summary: Automated transcription of parliamentary proceedings faces significant hurdles due to demographic bias, dialectal variation, and technical artifacts such as utterance truncation during segmentation. This paper introduces the ROManian PARliamentary Speech Corpus (ROMPAR) dataset, a 17.80-hour corpus of Romanian and Moldavian parliamentary speech, featuring double-annotated ground truth and explicit labels for reconstructed word fragments. To build a robust ASR system, we propose a multi-task adversarial training framework that enforces demographic invariance across age, gender, and dialect. We address the inherent instability of adversarial objectives in generative architectures by introducing an exponential decay mechanism for the adversarial coefficients. Furthermore, we implement an LLM-guided decoding strategy with position-dependent weighting to facilitate morphological completion of truncated terminal words. Our results demonstrate that the proposed framework significantly reduces WER and achieves an F1-score of 96.6% in morphological reconstruction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了ROManian PARliamentary Speech Corpus (ROMPAR)数据集（17.80小时，罗马尼亚语和摩尔多瓦语议会语音），并设计了一个多任务对抗训练框架结合LLM引导的解码策略，解决议会语音转录中的人口统计偏差、方言变异和话语截断问题，在词错误率降低和形态重建F1=96.6%上取得显著效果。
AI.motivation: 议会语音转录面临三大挑战：人口统计偏差（年龄、性别）、方言变异（罗马尼亚语与摩尔多瓦语）以及技术伪影（分割导致的话语截断），现有ASR系统对此缺乏鲁棒性。
AI.method: 1) 构建ROMPAR数据集（17.80小时，双标注+显式词片段标签）；2) 多任务对抗训练框架，强制年龄、性别、方言的人口统计不变性；3) 对抗系数指数衰减机制解决对抗目标在生成架构中的不稳定性；4) LLM引导的解码策略，结合位置相关权重实现截断终端词的形态补全。
AI.result: 显著降低WER；形态重建F1-score达到96.6%。
AI.conclusion: 所提框架有效解决了议会语音转录中的多维度挑战，尤其在截断词的形态重建上表现优异。

title: Re-feeding Is Not Replaying: Measuring Replay Noise in Counterfactual Token-Credit Estimation
comment: 10 pages, 3 figures. Code, per-pivot data, logs, and registration: https://github.com/thaw-ai/thaw (benchmarks/, paper/refeed-drift/)
summary: Per-token counterfactual credit estimation asks which token in a language-model rollout caused the final answer to be right or wrong: cut the transcript at a pivot, substitute an alternative token, replay continuations, and compare outcomes. Published methods re-feed the transcript prefix as a fresh prompt, assuming this reproduces the state the model passed through during generation. We measure what that assumption costs on a stock inference engine, with a three-pass design: continuations resumed from the verified decode-time KV state, an identical second exact pass (a replica noise floor), and a re-feed pass. Across six configurations and three models (including a GRPO-trained checkpoint), at low-margin decision tokens, re-feeding changes the credit estimate at rates 14-28 percentage points above the replica floor (7-21pp under a treatment-independent conditioning; problem-clustered t = 2.9-6.4). Most changes are zero-boundary crossings of the quantized estimator rather than polarity reversals, and the perturbation is consistent with mean-zero, so averaged quantities are largely safe; but selection is not: a critical-token set chosen by thresholding $|\hat{A}_t|$ under re-feed overlaps the exact-resume selection at Jaccard 0.34-0.90, versus a 0.63-0.96 replica ceiling. A causal confirmation closes the loop: under vLLM's batch-invariant kernels all three passes are identical on every measured channel, with both disagreement rates exactly zero. Replica passes themselves disagree on 9-23% of eligible estimates: single-sample credit measurements at decision tokens are unreliable under any replay. Settings were fixed in advance; exact-pass cache hits in the second campaign are instrumented (100% hit rate, 3,434 pivots); total compute was under 10 USD. We recommend that counterfactual credit studies resume decoder state or use batch-invariant kernels, and report a replica floor.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了逐token反事实信用估计中，重新输入前缀（re-feed）与恢复解码状态（exact resume）两种方法在信用估计上的差异。实验发现，在低置信度决策token上，re-feed方法导致的信用估计变化率高出基线14-28个百分点，关键token选择重叠率仅为Jaccard 0.34-0.90（对比基线0.63-0.96）。建议反事实信用研究应恢复解码器状态或使用批不变内核，并报告replica基线。
AI.motivation: 现有逐token反事实信用估计方法通常通过重新输入前缀来模拟生成过程，但这一假设可能引入偏差。作者希望量化这一假设带来的估计误差，并评估其对关键token选择的影响。
AI.method: 采用三通道实验设计：1）从验证的解码时KV状态恢复的exact pass；2）完全相同的副本pass（replica噪声基线）；3）重新输入前缀的re-feed pass。在6种配置和3个模型（含GRPO训练检查点）上测试，使用vLLM的批不变内核进行因果验证。
AI.result: Re-feed方法在低置信度决策token上信用估计变化率高出replica基线14-28个百分点（条件独立下7-21pp）；关键token选择Jaccard系数仅0.34-0.90（replica基线0.63-0.96）。多数变化为量化估计器的零边界跨越而非极性反转，扰动均值为零故平均量基本安全。Replica passes自身在9-23%的估计上存在分歧。
AI.conclusion: 单样本信用测量在任何重放方式下都不可靠；反事实信用研究应恢复解码器状态或使用批不变内核，并报告replica基线以量化噪声水平。

title: RecourseBench: A Modular Framework for Reproducible Algorithmic Recourse Evaluation
summary: Algorithmic recourse methods provide counterfactual explanations that inform individuals of the actions required to overturn an unfavorable model decision. Despite rapid methodological progress, principled comparison remains elusive; existing frameworks are often difficult to extend and lack both interoperability and systematic verification that integrated methods faithfully reproduce their originally reported results. We introduce \emph{RecourseBench}, a unified evaluation framework built around three commitments namely, modularity, reproducibility, and interactivity. The framework decomposes the pipeline into five fully decoupled layers -- Data, Preprocessing, Model, Recourse Method, and Evaluation -- governed by abstract interfaces and a dynamic registry. To address the reproducibility gap in prior benchmarks, we introduce a four-tier classification system in which every integrated method is validated by an automated test suite against its originally reported results. We further provide an interactive web interface for flexible, configuration-driven comparison across methods, datasets, and model architectures. Our framework currently integrates 28 state-of-the-art recourse methods and, to our knowledge, constitutes the first recourse benchmark to explicitly enforce method-level reproducibility through automated, quantitative testing.

AI.tldr: RecourseBench是一个统一的可解释性评估框架，基于模块化、可复现性和交互性三大原则，集成了28种最新算法补救方法，并通过四层分类系统和自动化测试套件确保方法级可复现性。
AI.motivation: 现有算法补救（Algorithmic Recourse）方法缺乏统一、可扩展的比较框架，存在互操作性差、难以系统性验证集成方法是否能忠实复现原始结果的问题。
AI.method: 提出RecourseBench框架，将流程解耦为五个独立层（数据、预处理、模型、补救方法、评估），通过抽象接口和动态注册表管理；引入四层分类系统，利用自动化测试套件验证各集成方法是否复现原始报告结果；提供交互式Web界面支持灵活配置比较。
AI.result: 当前集成了28种最新算法补救方法，据作者所知，这是首个通过自动化定量测试显式强制执行方法级可复现性的算法补救基准。
AI.conclusion: RecourseBench通过模块化设计、自动验证机制和交互界面，为算法补救领域提供了可扩展、可信赖的统一评估平台，填补了可复现性验证方面的空白。

title: GRACE-DS: a Guarded Reward-guided Agent Correction Environment in Data Science
summary: We introduce GRACE-DS, a Guarded Reward-guided Agent Correction Environment in Data Science for pre-deployment evaluation of LLM-powered AutoML agents. GRACE-DS is a set of evaluation metrics in an isolated environment that can be applied to tabular ML tasks specific to a particular organization. It exposes agents to realistic workflow stages, from planning and data inspection through feature engineering, model development, validation, and code repair to final submission, while hidden executable validators measure not only final predictive performance but also leakage avoidance, reproducibility, protocol validity, correction behavior, and reward alignment. The strongest structured regime, flexible iterative interaction (our approach), achieves higher end-to-end normalized hidden-test quality than single-shot generation, unstructured interaction, and restart-based baselines, while also improving protocol-valid completion. Validated across more than 7,000 episodes, these results establish GRACE-DS as a robust platform for assessing the capacity of LLM-based AutoML agents to execute machine learning workflows under production-like conditions and in accordance with organization-specific requirements.

AI.tldr: GRACE-DS是一个用于在部署前评估LLM驱动的AutoML代理的受保护奖励引导代理校正环境，通过隐藏的执行验证器测量预测性能、泄漏避免、可重复性、协议有效性、校正行为和奖励对齐等多个维度，在超过7,000个episode上验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的AutoML代理缺乏在类似生产环境和组织特定约束下进行部署前评估的平台，特别是缺乏对泄漏避免、可重复性、协议有效性等关键维度的综合评估。
AI.method: 构建隔离评估环境，包含从规划、数据检查、特征工程、模型开发、验证、代码修复到最终提交的完整工作流阶段，使用隐藏执行验证器从多维度（预测性能、泄漏避免、可重复性、协议有效性、校正行为、奖励对齐）评估代理。提出灵活迭代交互（flexible iterative interaction）作为最强结构化机制。
AI.result: 灵活迭代交互方法在端到端归一化隐藏测试质量上优于一次性生成、非结构化交互和基于重启的基线方法，同时在协议有效完成方面也有提升。在超过7,000个episode上得到验证。
AI.conclusion: GRACE-DS为评估LLM-based AutoML代理在生产条件下的机器学习工作流执行能力提供了稳健平台，能有效满足组织特定需求。

title: Surprise-Guided MergeSort: Budget-Efficient Human-in-the-Loop Ranking via Adaptive Comparison Scheduling
summary: Pairwise comparison is the gold standard for subjective ranking tasks; however, exhaustive annotation requires a massive number of human comparisons ($O(n^2)$). While sorting-based methods have reduced this burden to $O(n\log n)$, they still require expensive human judgment for every single comparison. To further improve annotation efficiency, we propose leveraging a Vision-Language Model (VLM) not as an annotator replacement, but as a \emph{question prioritizer} to identify which comparisons genuinely require human judgment. The proposed \textbf{Surprise-Guided MergeSort (SGS)} framework achieves this through three integrated components: (1) a bottom-up MergeSort scheduler that structures comparisons and exploits transitivity, (2) a composite Surprise Scorer -- combining position-bias-cancelled VLM confidence, Elo gap, and vote entropy -- to quantify comparison ambiguity, and (3) an adaptive budget allocator that routes high-surprise pairs to humans while automating low-surprise pairs via transitivity inference. Validation was conducted on six diverse benchmarks spanning text similarity (STS-B, BIOSSES, SICKR-STS) and image quality assessment (KonIQ-10k, TID2013, LIVE Challenge). SGS effectively identified and skipped up to 535 non-informative comparisons per session. Consequently, it achieved Kendall's $τ{\times}100$ improvements of $+6$ to $+12$ over Active Elo under the same total budget. These results demonstrate that combining VLM-guided surprise metrics with algorithmic sorting provides a generally consistent accuracy-efficiency trade-off across diverse domains.

AI.tldr: 提出惊喜引导归并排序(SGS)框架，利用VLM作为问题优先级排序器，识别哪些比较需要人类判断，在6个基准测试上取得Kendall's τ×100提升+6到+12的效果。
AI.motivation: 成对比较是主观排序任务的金标准，但穷举标注需要O(n²)量级的人类比较；虽然基于排序的方法将负担降至O(n log n)，但仍需为每一对人类判断付费。现有方法效率仍有提升空间。
AI.method: 提出SGS框架，包含三个集成组件：(1) 自底向上归并排序调度器，利用传递性；(2) 复合惊喜评分器，融合位置偏差消除的VLM置信度、Elo差距和投票熵来量化比较模糊性；(3) 自适应预算分配器，将高惊喜对路由给人工，低惊喜对通过传递性推理自动处理。
AI.result: 在六个基准（STS-B, BIOSSES, SICKR-STS, KonIQ-10k, TID2013, LIVE Challenge）上验证。SGS每轮有效识别并跳过最多535个非信息性比较，在相同预算下Kendall's τ×100较Active Elo提升+6到+12。
AI.conclusion: 将VLM引导的惊喜度量与算法排序相结合，能在不同领域实现一致且良好的准确率-效率权衡。

title: Know Your Limits : On the Faithfulness of LLMs as Solvers and Autoformalizers in Legal Reasoning
comment: 10 pages, submitted to COLM 2026 (under review, average score of 6.25 across 4 reviewers) and accepted by the AI4Law workshop at ICML. This is the version where we already addressed most of the reviews from the COLM reviewers
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) achieve strong performance on reasoning tasks, but whether this reflects faithful logical inference or heuristic approximation remains unclear. We study this question in legal entailment by comparing three paradigms, including pure LLM classification, LLM-based Formal Reasoning, and solver-based Formal Reasoning using the Z3 SMT solver, on a re-annotated subset of ContractNLI across five LLMs. Our re-annotation reveals a systematic and measurable gap between pragmatic legal interpretation and strict formal entailment, where a substantial proportion of legally sound inferences are not formally grounded without additional unstated assumptions. While introducing formal structure improves accuracy, with LLM-based Formal Reasoning achieving the highest benchmark performance, we show that this gain does not imply faithful reasoning. We identify three recurring failure modes: scope laundering, where LLMs report solver-inconsistent classifications without executing the underlying formal reasoning, producing conclusions that appear logically grounded but are not; implicit constraint blindness, where LLMs overlook logical constraints present in formal representations; and program synthesis failures, where LLMs generate incorrect Z3 code despite structured prompting. Critically, scope laundering persists across all models, raising serious concerns about the faithfulness of LLM-based formal reasoning as a proxy for symbolic execution. These results reveal a fundamental gap between benchmark accuracy and logical faithfulness.

AI.tldr: 本研究通过法律文本蕴含任务，对比纯LLM分类、LLM形式推理和Z3求解器形式推理三种范式，发现LLM在形式推理中虽提升基准性能，但存在“范围清洗”、“隐式约束盲区”和“程序合成失败”三种不忠实推理模式，揭示了基准准确率与逻辑忠实性之间的根本差距。
AI.motivation: 探究LLM在推理任务中的高表现究竟是源于忠实的逻辑推理还是启发式近似，特别是在法律蕴含这一需要严格逻辑推理的场景中。
AI.method: 对ContractNLI数据集进行重新标注，对比纯LLM分类、LLM形式推理和基于Z3求解器的形式推理三种范式，在五个LLM上实验，识别LLM形式推理中的失败模式。
AI.result: LLM形式推理取得最高基准性能，但存在三种系统性失败模式：范围清洗（报告与求解器不一致的分类）、隐式约束盲区（忽略形式表示中的逻辑约束）、程序合成失败（生成错误的Z3代码）。范围清洗在所有模型中普遍存在。
AI.conclusion: 基准准确率与逻辑忠实性之间存在根本差距，LLM形式推理不能可靠地作为符号执行的代理。

title: Bridging the Usability Gap: Lessons from Interpreting Studies for Machine Interpreting Design
summary: Machine interpreting (MI), the live, real-time branch of speech translation, has achieved remarkable progress on standard benchmarks, with some systems approaching human parity on textual fidelity. Yet the user experience remains far inferior to interpreter-mediated communication, revealing what we term the \emph{accuracy illusion}: systems that appear accurate on paper but fail in practice to support smooth, goal-oriented interaction. This paper defines MI as a distinct subfield of speech translation, with its own characteristics and the need for evaluation methods grounded in communicative effectiveness rather than isolated fidelity metrics. Drawing on insights from interpreting studies, we identify critical dimensions of professional interpreting practice that are overlooked by current systems, and consolidate them into three interdependent design priorities for future MI: \emph{agency} (context-sensitive initiative and repair), \emph{grounding} (multimodal and discourse-level situational awareness), and \emph{experience} (adaptive improvement through real interaction). Together, these priorities chart a path toward closing the usability gap and enabling systems that can sustain authentic multilingual communication in real time.

AI.tldr: 本文指出现有机器口译（MI）系统虽然在某些基准测试中接近人类水平，但由于存在“准确性幻觉”——即表面准确但在实际交互中表现不佳，导致用户体验远逊于人工口译。作者将MI定义为语音翻译的一个独特子领域，并提出应基于沟通有效性而非孤立的忠实度指标进行评估。基于口译研究的启示，文章总结出三个设计优先级：代理（情境敏感主动性）、基础（多模态与话语层面的情境意识）和体验（通过真实交互自适应改进），以缩小可用性鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 当前机器口译系统在标准基准测试中表现优秀，甚至在某些文本忠实度指标上接近人类水平，但实际用户体验却远不如人工口译。作者将这种表面准确但实际失败的现象称为“准确性幻觉”，并由此出发，旨在推动MI评估从孤立忠实度指标转向基于沟通有效性的方法，同时为未来系统设计提供可操作的方向。
AI.method: 本文采用概念分析和跨学科整合的方法：首先界定机器口译（MI）为语音翻译中具有独特特征的分支领域；其次借鉴口译研究（interpreting studies）的专业实践视角，识别当前系统忽视的关键维度；最后将这些维度整合为三个相互依赖的设计优先级（代理、基础、体验）。
AI.result: 提出了三个设计优先级：1）代理（agency）——系统具备情境敏感的主动性和修复能力；2）基础（grounding）——多模态和话语层面的情境意识；3）体验（experience）——通过真实交互进行自适应改进。这三者相互依存，共同构成缩小可用性鸿沟的路径。
AI.conclusion: 现有的基于文本忠实度的评估方法无法反映真实口译场景中的交互质量。未来的MI系统需要从“准确”转向“有效沟通”，通过整合代理、基础和体验三个设计优先级，才能实现真正支持多语言实时交流的系统。

title: Conflict-Aware Federated Fine-Tuning of Large Language Models with Mixture-of-Experts
summary: The continuous scaling of large language models (LLMs) incurs prohibitive computational costs, making Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) a scalable alternative for efficient fine-tuning via sparse activation. While federated learning (FL) emerges as the paradigm for privacy-preserving collaborative optimization, integrating MoE into FL under data heterogeneity may trigger conflicting expert optimizations. Client-specific data distributions force same-indexed experts to optimize under inconsistent or even conflicting feature-label correlations. This mismatch induces destructive interference during aggregation, thus destabilizing the optimization trajectory and degrading model performance. To address this issue, we propose FC-MoE, a federated conflict-aware framework for MoE fine-tuning. It employs an importance aware weighting scheme to prioritize reliable local updates and utilizes gradient consensus projection to suppress conflicting updates, ensuring a stable global optimization path. Moreover, a local knowledge retention mechanism further preserves specialized client expertise by re-anchoring domain-specific residuals. Extensive experiments demonstrate that FC-MoE accelerates convergence and enhances both global and local model performance in non-IID federated environments.

AI.tldr: 针对联邦学习中MoE模型因数据异构性导致同索引专家更新冲突的问题，提出FC-MoE框架，通过重要性加权、梯度共识投影和局部知识保留机制，在非IID环境下加速收敛并提升全局与局部模型性能。
AI.motivation: 将MoE集成到联邦学习中时，各客户端数据分布异构导致同索引专家在不一致的特征-标签关联下优化，聚合时产生破坏性干扰，使优化轨迹不稳定并降低模型性能。
AI.method: 提出FC-MoE框架，包含三个核心机制：1）重要性感知加权方案以优先利用可靠的局部更新；2）梯度共识投影以抑制冲突更新，确保全局优化路径稳定；3）局部知识保留机制通过重新锚定领域特定残差来保留客户端专业知识。
AI.result: 实验表明，FC-MoE在非IID联邦环境下加速收敛，并同时提升了全局模型与局部模型的性能。
AI.conclusion: FC-MoE有效解决了联邦MoE中因数据异构引起的专家冲突问题，实现了稳定的全局优化和个性化的局部知识保留。

title: Thinking with Visual Grounding
summary: Visual thinking should not only sound right; it should show its evidence. While recent vision-language models (VLMs) can produce natural-language reasoning traces, these traces often leave the supporting image regions implicit, making them hard to verify and difficult to supervise. We introduce visually grounded thinking, a reasoning process in which models interleave natural-language thoughts with explicit point or box groundings of the visual evidence used at each step. This lets the model express intermediate reasoning in language while grounding key objects in the image regions they refer to. To train this behavior, we construct a scalable synthesis pipeline that distills correct visual reasoning traces, extracts the visual objects required by the traces, grounds them with a SAM3-based agent, and derives aligned point and box supervision from the resulting masks. We further propose grounding-aware reinforcement learning, which combines answer correctness rewards with dense grounding rewards that score whether generated object references match the correct image evidence. Across two counting benchmarks and four spatial reasoning benchmarks, adding visually grounded thinking to Gemma3-4B-IT consistently improves performance over the original model and the non-grounded thinking baseline. On spatial reasoning, the visually grounded thinking 4B models match, and in some cases surpass, Gemma3-27B-IT from the same model family. Our analysis shows that point grounding is well suited to counting, while box grounding benefits most from explicit grounding rewards on spatial tasks. Overall, our results show that VLMs think better when their intermediate thoughts are tied to the image regions that make them true.

AI.tldr: 本文提出视觉锚定思维（visually grounded thinking），让VLM在生成推理链时显式地用点或框标注所依赖的图像区域，并通过可扩展合成流水线和锚定感知强化学习训练该能力，实验表明该方法在计数和空间推理任务上显著优于基线和无锚定思维基线，4B模型甚至可达27B模型水平。
AI.motivation: 现有VLM能生成自然语言推理轨迹，但这些轨迹往往隐去了所依赖的图像区域，导致结果难以验证和监督。作者希望模型在推理过程中显式地将文本推理与视觉证据（点/框）锚定，从而提升可解释性和可验证性。
AI.method: 提出可扩展合成流水线：蒸馏正确推理轨迹，提取所需视觉对象，用SAM3智能体生成掩码并导出点/框监督信号。进一步提出锚定感知强化学习（grounding-aware RL），结合答案正确性奖励和密集锚定奖励（评估生成对象引用是否匹配正确图像证据）。
AI.result: 在2个计数基准和4个空间推理基准上，Gemma3-4B-IT添加视觉锚定思维后一致优于原始模型和无锚定思维基线；在空间推理上，4B模型匹配甚至超越Gemma3-27B-IT；点锚定适合计数任务，框锚定配合显式锚定奖励在空间任务上收益最大。
AI.conclusion: VLM的中间思维若与使之成立的图像区域绑定，则能更有效地推理。视觉锚定思维提升了性能、可验证性和可监督性。

title: Who Flips? Self- and Cross-Model Counterarguments Reveal Answer Instability in LLMs
comment: Accepted to the non-archival workshops AI4Good and AIWILD at ICML 2026
summary: Standard accuracy benchmarks are designed to test how closely large language models (LLMs) approach correct answers, but are not suitable for testing whether LLMs stick with a correct answer when that answer is challenged by a plausible counter-argument. We introduce a controlled protocol for evaluating answer stability: after a model answers a multiple-choice question correctly, we challenge the model's answer with a coherent argument for an incorrect option and measure whether the model flips. The setup a) isolates argumentative content from overt social pressure and b) varies argument length, self-attribution, and cross-model source. Across seven frontier models and 57 MMLU subjects, flip rates range from 17.5% to 97.3%, revealing large differences in stability that are not captured by accuracy metrics alone. We find that self-attribution consistently increases flip rates (mean +7.1pp, up to +18.7pp). Also, pooling wrong-answer arguments across models and selecting the most effective one per question yields stronger adversarial challenges than relying on any single source model. We further construct MaxFlip, a curated challenge set that amplifies flips by up to +23.6pp over standard self-generated challenges. We release the protocol, challenge records, and MaxFlip to support stability evaluation alongside standard accuracy benchmarks. Materials are available at https://github.com/nafisenik/WhoFlips and https://hf.co/datasets/nafisehNik/WhoFlips.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种评估大语言模型答案稳定性的控制实验协议：在模型正确回答多选题后，用连贯的论点挑战其答案，观察模型是否改变立场。在7个前沿模型和57个MMLU主题上的测试显示，翻转率从17.5%到97.3%不等，自归因会增加翻转率，跨模型整合错误论点能产生更强的对抗性挑战。作者构建了MaxFlip挑战集并开源了相关材料。
AI.motivation: 现有准确率基准测试只能评估LLM是否接近正确答案，但无法测试模型在面对合理反驳时是否坚持正确回答。作者希望引入一种新的评估维度——答案稳定性。
AI.method: 设计控制实验协议：1) 模型先回答多选题；2) 对正确答案提出连贯的对抗性论点，诱导模型选择错误选项；3) 控制变量包括论点长度、自归因（是否指出是模型自己的回答）、跨模型来源；4) 在7个前沿模型和57个MMLU主题上进行测试，并构建MaxFlip挑战集。
AI.result: 翻转率范围17.5%-97.3%；自归因一致增加翻转率（平均+7.1pp，最高+18.7pp）；跨模型整合最有效的错误论点比单一模型挑战更强；MaxFlip相比自生成挑战提升翻转率最多+23.6pp。
AI.conclusion: 准确率并不能反映模型的答案稳定性，需要将稳定性评估纳入标准基准测试。协议、挑战记录和MaxFlip已开源。

title: Formalizing and Mitigating Structural Distortion in LLM Attention for Zero-Shot Graph Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise for reasoning over Text-Attributed Graphs (TAGs). However, applying LLMs to graphs requires linearizing their structure into sequences, introducing distortion rooted in the graph bandwidth problem. While this distortion has been shown to degrade performance, it is often attributed to prompt design or model scale, leaving the underlying mechanism unclear. In this work, we show \textit{how} rotary positional embeddings turn graph linearization into bandwidth-dependent attention decay, suppressing attention between graph-adjacent nodes that are forced far apart in the serialized sequence. This shifts the focus of LLM-based graph reasoning from prompt engineering and scaling toward correcting attention misalignment. Motivated by this analysis, we propose \textbf{G}raph-\textbf{a}ligned \textbf{L}anguage \textbf{A}ttention (\textbf{GaLA}), a lightweight, inference-time modification for LLMs. GaLA biases attention toward graph-adjacent nodes while preserving the LLM's sequential inductive biases. Across TAG benchmarks, GaLA improves performance with negligible overhead, demonstrating that distortion is a correctable bottleneck in LLM-based graph reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM处理文本属性图时，图线性化会导致基于旋转位置编码的注意力衰减，即图相邻节点在序列中距离越远注意力越低。为此提出GaLA，一种轻量级推理时修改方法，通过偏置注意力朝向图相邻节点来校正注意力错位，在不破坏序列归纳偏置的前提下显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM应用于文本属性图时需要对图结构进行线性化，这引入了图带宽问题导致的失真。虽然已知这种失真会降低性能，但以往研究多归因于提示设计或模型规模，其底层机制尚不明确。本文旨在揭示失真影响注意力的根本原因。
AI.method: 首先从理论上揭示旋转位置编码(RoPE)如何将图线性化转化为与带宽相关的注意力衰减：序列中距离较远的图相邻节点之间的注意力会被抑制。基于此分析，提出GaLA（图对齐语言注意力），一种轻量级的推理时修改方法，通过偏置注意力权重使模型更关注图相邻节点，同时保留LLM原有的序列归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在多个TAG基准测试上，GaLA以极小的额外开销提升了模型性能，验证了失真确实是LLM图推理中可修正的瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 图线性化导致的注意力错位是LLM图推理性能下降的关键因素，而非单纯的提示设计或模型规模问题。通过GaLA校正此错位可有效提升性能，将关注点从提示工程和缩放转向注意力对齐校正。

title: VibeThinker-3B: Exploring the Frontier of Verifiable Reasoning in Small Language Models
summary: This technical report introduces VibeThinker-3B, a compact dense model with 3B parameters developed to investigate how far verifiable reasoning can be pushed within a strictly small-model regime. Building upon the Spectrum-to-Signal post-training paradigm, we systematically enhance the model through an optimized pipeline that includes curriculum-based supervised fine-tuning, multi-domain reinforcement learning, and offline self-distillation. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that VibeThinker-3B achieves frontier-level performance on highly demanding verifiable tasks. Specifically, it attains a score of 94.3 on AIME26 (improving to 97.1 with claim-level test-time scaling), an 80.2 Pass@1 on LiveCodeBench v6, and exhibits strong out-of-distribution generalization with a 96.1\% acceptance rate on recent unseen LeetCode contests. This effectively places it in the performance band of first-tier reasoning systems, matching or exceeding flagship models that are orders of magnitude larger, such as DeepSeek V3.2, GLM-5, and Gemini 3 Pro. Furthermore, a score of 93.4 on IFEval confirms that this extreme reasoning enhancement does not compromise strict instruction controllability. Extending our previous 1.5B work, these findings motivate the Parametric Compression-Coverage Hypothesis, which views verifiable reasoning as compressible into compact reasoning cores, while open-domain knowledge and general-purpose competence require broad parameter coverage over facts, concepts, and long-tail scenarios. This perspective suggests that compact models are not merely deployment-efficient substitutes, but a complementary path toward frontier-level performance in parameter-dense capability regimes.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了VibeThinker-3B，一个3B参数的小型稠密模型，通过频谱到信号后训练范式、课程式SFT、多域强化学习和离线自蒸馏等优化手段，在可验证推理任务上达到了前沿水平（AIME26 94.3分、LiveCodeBench v6 80.2% Pass@1等），性能匹敌甚至超越大规模旗舰模型，并提出了参数压缩-覆盖假说，认为可验证推理可压缩至紧凑推理核心，而通用知识需要广泛的参数覆盖。
AI.motivation: 探究在严格的小模型体制下，可验证推理能力究竟能达到何种程度，验证紧凑模型能否在参数密集型能力领域实现前沿性能。
AI.method: 基于Spectrum-to-Signal后训练范式，通过课程式监督微调（curriculum-based SFT）、多域强化学习（multi-domain RL）和离线自蒸馏（offline self-distillation）构成的优化流水线进行系统增强。
AI.result: AIME26得分94.3（测试时缩放达97.1），LiveCodeBench v6 Pass@1为80.2%，LeetCode未见竞赛接受率96.1%，IFEval得分93.4。性能匹敌或超越DeepSeek V3.2、GLM-5、Gemini 3 Pro等大模型。
AI.conclusion: 提出参数压缩-覆盖假说：可验证推理可压缩至紧凑推理核心，而开放域知识需要广泛参数覆盖。紧凑模型不仅是部署高效的替代方案，更是通向参数密集型前沿性能的补充路径。

title: Scaling Human and G2P Supervision for Robust Phonetic Transcription
summary: Expert phonetic annotation is costly, especially for non-standard dialects and atypical speech. A common alternative is using Grapheme-to-Phoneme (G2P) models to auto-generate phonetic labels from text transcripts at scale. We study how automatic phonetic transcription performance scales with human and G2P supervision in English. Using a curated 80-hour benchmark spanning native, non-native and post-stroke speech, we identify a supervision quality threshold: G2P supervision helps only when fewer than 20-30 hours of human annotation are available. Beyond this threshold, it provides no significant benefit and can reduce cross-dialect robustness. What is effective after this threshold is ASR pretraining which we use to achieve a 2.3x reduction in weighted phone feature error rate over prior systems, with strong gains on non-native and aphasic speech. These results suggest that quantity-driven G2P scaling may yield diminishing returns for robust generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了自动音标转录中人类标注与G2P模型监督的规模效应，发现存在监督质量阈值：当人类标注少于20-30小时时G2P有用，超过后无益甚至有害；而ASR预训练可显著提升性能，在非母语和失语症语音上获得2.3倍错误率降低。
AI.motivation: 专家音标标注成本高昂，尤其对于非标准方言和非典型语音，因此需要探索利用G2P模型自动生成音标标签的可扩展替代方案，并研究其在不同监督条件下的有效性边界。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含母语、非母语和中风后语音的80小时基准数据集，系统比较了人类标注量、G2P监督和ASR预训练对自动音标转录性能的影响。
AI.result: 发现20-30小时人类标注是关键阈值：低于此阈值G2P有提升，超过则无显著收益甚至损害跨方言鲁棒性；ASR预训练实现了加权音素特征错误率2.3倍的降低，在非母语和失语症语音上表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 单纯增加G2P数据量对鲁棒泛化的边际收益递减，ASR预训练是更有效的替代方案。

title: HAPI-EP: Towards Hybrid, Adaptive, and Predictive Digital Twins of Cardiac Electrophysiology
summary: A digital twin (DT) of a patient-specific heart offers significant potential in personalized medicine. However, its rapid and dynamic adaptation to an individual's live data and its predictive capability after adaptation remains central challenges. We examine this challenge from its two building blocks: DT formulation where mechanistic and data-driven models show competing merits and limitations, and DT optimization strategies that are largely driven by a reconstruction objective leading to un-identifiable models. We address both bottlenecks via HAPI -- an AI framework for building hybrid, adaptive, and predictive DTs with three key enablers. First, HAPI constructs a physics-integrated gray-box model in which an interpretable mechanistic backbone is augmented by a neural component that models its residual to the observed data. Second, rather than attempting to pre-encode all possible variations in a static hybrid model, HAPI enables rapid on-the-fly adaptation of the hybrid model to few-shot live data, achieved by feedforward meta-learners realizing amortized inference of both mechanistic and neural parameters of the hybrid model trained with predictive objectives. Finally, we show that this adaptivity corresponds to the construction of a conditional generative model (i.e., the hybrid DT) that endows it with theoretical identifiability and thus strong performance in predictive scenarios. We demonstrate the proof-of-concept of HAPI in cardiac electrophysiology using a hybrid monodomain model with mechanistic reaction kinetics and neural graph diffusion. Across synthetic and real-data studies, we show that HAPI's mechanistic-neural hybridization and predictive adaptation are critical for obtaining identifiable DTs with strong predictive and out-of-distribution capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出HAPI框架，用于构建心脏数字孪生的混合、自适应、可预测模型。它结合物理机理模型与神经网络残差校正，通过元学习实现快速适应个体实时数据，并具备理论可辨识性，在心脏电生理学中展示了优越的预测和分布外泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 患者特异性心脏数字孪生面临两大核心挑战：1) 机理模型与数据驱动模型各有优劣，难以兼顾可解释性与准确性；2) 传统基于重构目标的优化策略导致模型不可辨识，缺乏预测能力。需要一种既能快速适应个体实时数据又具备强预测能力的混合框架。
AI.method: HAPI框架包含三个关键组件：1) 物理集成灰盒模型，以可解释的机理模型为主干，神经网络建模残差；2) 基于前馈元学习的在线快速自适应机制，实现机理参数和神经参数的摊销推断；3) 构建条件生成模型实现理论可辨识性。在心脏电生理学中使用混合单域模型（机理反应动力学+神经图扩散）验证。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实数据实验中，HAPI的机理-神经混合与预测性自适应对于获得可辨识的数字孪生至关重要，展现出强大的预测能力和分布外泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: HAPI通过混合建模和元学习自适应有效解决了心脏数字孪生的可辨识性和预测性问题，为个性化医疗中的动态数字孪生提供了可行方案。

title: LiteOdyssey: A Lightweight Reasoning AI Agent for Interpretable Rare-Disease Diagnosis
summary: Most medical AI systems improve by scaling additional machinery: more fine-tuning data, more agents, and/or larger retrieval databases. In rare-disease diagnosis, however, such scaling can produce systems that are difficult to deploy, audit, and maintain. We asked whether state-of-the-art diagnostic performance could instead be achieved by extending the reasoning chain of a single AI agent: guiding it with a diagnostic policy, developed through human-AI collaboration and augmenting with freely available biomedical tools. We introduce LiteOdyssey, a lightweight rare-disease diagnostic framework that guides reasoning language model through a clinical genetics workflow. This framework was developed through Policy Iteration with Human Feedback (PIHF) and uses dynamic access to public biomedical tools. On two challenging benchmarks that provide only patient clinical features, LiteOdyssey achieved state-of-the-art performance, with an overall disease Recall@1 of 59.3% over the combined 1,243 cases of LIRICAL (n = 370) and the PhenoPacket Store (n = 873). Both benchmarks have a high proportion of ultra-rare disease (a prevalence below 1 in 1,000,000, with ultra-rare shares of approximately 45% and 52.8%, respectively). On the more difficult PhenoPacket subset, where causal diseases were not mapped to Orphanet in our rarity-mapping pipeline, LiteOdyssey achieved 60.7% Recall@1, compared with 10.7% for the same baseline model (GPT-5.4) without tools. This performance was achieved without fine-tuning, multi-agent ensembles, or a large case-retrieval database. Gains were also observed in the following: on cases never seen during development, on a private cohort of real-world rare disease patients, and on a smaller open-weights model. LiteOdyssey suggests a path toward rare-disease AI systems that are accurate, easier to deploy, and more transparent for physician review.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LiteOdyssey，一种轻量级罕见病诊断框架，通过人类-AI协作的迭代策略优化和动态接入公开生物医学工具来扩展单智能体的推理链，在不依赖微调、多智能体集成或大规模检索数据库的情况下，在两个基准测试（共1,243例）上实现了59.3%的疾病Recall@1，其中超罕见病例占比高达52.8%，在更难的子集上比基线模型（GPT-5.4无工具）提升了50个百分点（60.7% vs 10.7%），为构建准确、易部署且透明的罕见病AI系统提供了新路径。
AI.motivation: 现有医疗AI系统依赖扩展额外资源（更多微调数据、多智能体、更大检索数据库）来提升性能，但在罕见病诊断中，这种扩展方式导致系统难以部署、审计和维护。作者探索是否可以通过扩展单一AI智能体的推理链（即引导其遵循临床遗传学工作流）来实现最先进的诊断性能，从而避免资源密集型方法带来的问题。
AI.method: 提出LiteOdyssey框架，核心包括：(1) 通过人类反馈的策略迭代（PIHF）开发诊断策略，引导推理语言模型遵循临床遗传学工作流；(2) 动态访问公开生物医学工具（如数据库、知识库）以增强推理能力；(3) 不依赖微调、多智能体集成或大型病例检索数据库，仅通过改进推理链实现性能提升。
AI.result: 在LIRICAL（370例）和PhenoPacket Store（873例）共1,243例患者上，LiteOdyssey实现了59.3%的整体疾病Recall@1，两个基准中超罕见病占比分别约45%和52.8%。在更难的PhenoPacket子集（因果疾病未映射到Orphanet）上，Recall@1达60.7%，而基线GPT-5.4无工具仅为10.7%。在开发阶段未见过的病例、真实世界罕见病患者队列及小型开源模型上也观察到增益。
AI.conclusion: LiteOdyssey通过策略引导推理和工具增强，无需大规模资源扩展即可实现最先进的罕见病诊断性能，为构建准确、易部署、更透明的罕见病AI系统提供了可行路径，有助于医生审核和临床落地。

title: In-Domain Supervised Pathology Report Classification: A Reproducible Pipeline from Data Curation to Production-Matched Evaluation
summary: We introduce an in-domain supervised pipeline designed to counter the out-of-distribution performance drop that hampers supervised biomedical NLP models, a problem observed when models trained on pathology reports are moved across cancer registries. Our contribution is a reproducible recipe for training a supervised classifier from routinely collected cancer registry data. It describes how to build the in-domain training set and a production-matched holdout, and to choose operating points that keep the false-negative rate (FNR) very low while keeping reviewer workload manageable. The pipeline standardizes data curation with facility-stratified sampling and separate handling of reports linked to registry cases, and includes a blinded manual audit to estimate positive-case prevalence and label noise. On a 418k-report holdout set, the Kentucky model achieved FNR 0.003 and false-positive rate (FPR) 0.097, improving over the Seattle-trained MOSSAIC OncoID baseline (FNR 0.010, FPR 0.183) and raising F1 from 0.860 to 0.922. In a blinded manual review of 600 reports, estimated positive prevalence declined from 0.500 to 0.398, indicating substantial label noise with errors concentrated in rare primary sites.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种面向病理报告分类的领域内监督流水线，用于解决跨癌症登记机构时模型性能下降的问题。通过标准化数据采样、盲审标注噪声评估等方法，在418k报告测试集上实现了FNR 0.003、F1 0.922，显著优于跨域基线模型。
AI.motivation: 针对监督式生物医学NLP模型在跨癌症登记机构迁移时出现的分布外性能下降问题，现有模型在病理报告任务中因数据分布偏移导致泛化能力不足。
AI.method: 提出可复现的领域内监督流水线：1）基于机构分层采样构建领域内训练集和生产匹配留出集；2）采用与登记病例关联的独立报告处理策略；3）引入盲审手动审计估计阳性患病率和标签噪声；4）选择低假阴性率的工作点。
AI.result: 肯塔基模型在418k报告留出集上FNR=0.003、FPR=0.097，相比西雅图训练的MOSSAIC OncoID基线（FNR=0.010, FPR=0.183）显著提升，F1从0.860升至0.922。600份报告的盲审显示阳性患病率从0.500降至0.398，存在显著标签噪声且错误集中在罕见原发部位。
AI.conclusion: 所提领域内监督流水线能有效缓解跨域分布偏移，通过标准化数据构建和标签质量审计显著提升病理报告分类模型的跨机构泛化性能，同时保持低假阴性率和可控的审核工作负载。

title: Multi-Agent Framework for Audit Risk Assessment with Explicit Uncertainty and Evidence Conflict Modeling
summary: Audit risk assessment increasingly benefits from combining heterogeneous evidence sources, yet existing approaches typically produce point predictions without quantifying how well different evidence streams agree. We propose UMAR (Uncertainty-Aware Multi-Agent Risk Assessment), a framework that employs three specialized agents: an MD&A Text Agent, a Financial Ratio Agent, and a CAM Agent, each producing independent risk scores with calibrated uncertainty estimates. An Uncertainty Aggregator based on Dempster-Shafer evidence theory fuses these scores while explicitly measuring inter-agent conflict. We evaluate UMAR on a U.S. dataset of 3,200 firm-year observations from SEC 10-K filings (2019-2023), with financial restatement as the target label. Experimental results show that UMAR achieves an AUROC of 0.782 and a PR-AUC of 0.341, outperforming logistic regression, XGBoost, FinBERT, and single-agent and dual-agent LLM baselines. UMAR attains the lowest expected calibration error (ECE = 0.052) among all methods and identifies evidence-conflict patterns that correlate with actual restatement risk, offering auditors potentially actionable and interpretable risk signals.

AI.tldr: 提出UMAR框架，利用三个专用智能体（MD&A文本、财务比率、CAM）分别生成带校准不确定性估计的风险评分，再通过Dempster-Shafer证据理论融合并测量智能体间冲突，在3200个公司-年度观测数据上优于传统方法和LLM基线，AUROC达0.782，校准误差最低(ECE=0.052)。
AI.motivation: 现有审计风险评估方法通常产生点预测，无法量化不同证据来源之间的一致程度，缺乏不确定性感知能力。
AI.method: 构建三个专用智能体（MD&A文本、财务比率、CAM），各自生成带校准不确定性估计的独立风险评分；采用基于Dempster-Shafer证据理论的不确定性聚合器融合评分并显式测量智能体间冲突。
AI.result: AUROC=0.782, PR-AUC=0.341, ECE=0.052，优于逻辑回归、XGBoost、FinBERT及单/双智能体LLM基线。
AI.conclusion: UMAR通过多智能体不确定性感知融合框架，在提升预测性能的同时提供可解释的证据冲突信号，为审计师提供可操作的、可解释的风险指示。

title: The Quality-Utility Paradox: Why High-Reward Data Impairs Small Model Mathematical Reasoning
summary: Knowledge distillation from powerful reasoning models is widely used to improve Small Language Models (SLMs) on mathematical reasoning, often assuming that traces with higher reward model scores provide more useful supervision. We identify a counterintuitive \textbf{Quality-Utility Paradox} in mathematical reasoning distillation. Data refined or synthesized by a stronger Oracle obtains higher perceived quality according to reward models, yet consistently underperforms traces generated by the SLM itself and selected through rejection sampling across Qwen2.5, LLaMA-3, and DeepSeek families. Our analysis shows that Oracle refinement couples logical repair with distributional drift away from the SLM's native reasoning distribution. This drift increases the learner's adaptation cost and can outweigh the benefit of improved reasoning logic. To test this mechanism, we introduce \textbf{Style-Aligned Refinement}, which preserves the native trajectory of the SLM while retaining logical repair from the Oracle. This intervention lowers adaptation cost and restores downstream utility. These findings suggest that effective mathematical reasoning distillation should jointly optimize perceived solution quality and learner-data compatibility, rather than relying solely on reward-model scores. The datasets and code are available at https://github.com/Dracoqhl/Quality-Utility-Paradox.

AI.tldr: 研究发现数学推理蒸馏中存在“质量-效用悖论”：强教师模型优化的数据虽奖励模型评分更高，但反而不如SLM自身通过拒绝采样生成的轨迹有效，原因是Oracle修复逻辑的同时引入了分布漂移，增加了学习者的适应成本。
AI.motivation: 质疑“高奖励模型分数=更有用监督信号”这一广泛假设，揭示数学推理蒸馏中质量与效用之间的不一致现象。
AI.method: 通过实验对比Oracle精炼数据与SLM自身拒绝采样数据的下游表现，提出Style-Aligned Refinement方法在保留逻辑修复的同时保持SLM原生轨迹风格以降低适应成本。
AI.result: Oracle精炼数据在奖励模型上得分更高，但下游蒸馏效果更差；Style-Aligned Refinement能恢复下游效用。
AI.conclusion: 数学推理蒸馏应同时优化感知质量和学习者-数据兼容性，而非仅仅依赖奖励模型分数。

title: From Argument Components to Graphs: A Multi-Agent Debate with Confidence Gating for Argument Relations
comment: Accepted for publication in the proceedings of KES 2026
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly assessed and utilized in the field of Argument Mining (AM), thanks to their strong general reasoning capabilities. However, standard training-free models often miss sophisticated details, specifically in contexts where two parts of the text have to be analyzed together. Furthermore, self-correction mechanisms tend to reinforce initial hallucinations in reasoning. Overcoming these limitations typically requires expensive, domain-specific supervised fine-tuning. Recent work has shown that a multi-agent paradigm can address such weaknesses for the component classification task through dialectical refinement with a Proponent-Opponent-Judge architecture, setting a promising direction for training-free approaches in the field. In this paper, we extend and evaluate this framework on the Argument Relation Identification and Classification (ARIC) task, reformulating it as a debate over component pairs. Besides that, we introduce a confidence gating mechanism that enables debating only on the uncertain cases and accepting the initial prediction when confidence is high. On the UKP Argument Annotated Essays v2 corpus, we demonstrate that the selective debate achieves the highest Macro F1 among all training-free methods, while debate over all samples degrades performance below that of one of the baselines. All generative approaches also outperform fine-tuned RoBERTa models on Macro F1, suggesting that the under-representation of the Attack class was more damaging to supervised fine-tuning than to inference-only models. Additionally, our framework produces human-readable debate transcripts, offering interpretability absent from both single-agent and supervised classifiers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于多智能体辩论的选择性置信门控框架，用于论证关系识别与分类任务，在不需监督微调的情况下，通过仅对不确定样本进行辩论，在UKP语料库上取得了优于所有无训练方法和微调RoBERTa的Macro F1性能，并提供了可解释的辩论记录。
AI.motivation: 标准无训练LLM在论证挖掘中难以处理需要联合分析两段文本的复杂关系，且自纠正机制会强化初始幻觉；监督微调成本高昂且对稀疏类别（如Attack）敏感。
AI.method: 扩展Proponent-Opponent-Judge多智能体辩论架构至ARIC任务，将关系分类重构为组件对的辩论过程；引入置信门控机制，仅对模型置信度低的样本进行辩论，高置信样本直接接受初始预测。
AI.result: 在UKP Argument Annotated Essays v2数据集上，选择性辩论在所有无训练方法中取得最高Macro F1；全量辩论反而低于基线；所有生成式方法均优于微调RoBERTa；Attack类别的欠表示对监督微调的损害大于推理模型。
AI.conclusion: 选择性多智能体辩论是训练自由且有效的ARIC方案，兼具高性能与可解释性，优于传统监督方法。

title: CIWI-CKT: Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion and Cross-City Knowledge Transfer for Traffic Flow Forecasting
summary: Accurate traffic flow prediction remains challenging in cross-city, data-scarce scenarios where limited historical data hinders model generalisation. The chaotic nature of traffic dynamics, complex spatio-temporal dependencies, and heterogeneous urban networks complicate few-shot learning across cities. Existing deep learning approaches either treat traffic as purely deterministic or lack mechanisms to model wave-like interference patterns essential for cross-regime traffic dynamics. To address these limitations, this paper proposes CIWI-CKT, a novel Chaos-Informed Wave Interference Feature Fusion framework with Cross-City Knowledge Transfer. Our framework introduces three core innovations: chaos-informed wave generation that extracts measurable chaos invariants and models traffic as adaptive wave components; meta-interference processing that captures wave interactions between support and query regimes while producing a predictability score for confidence estimation; and chaos-aware meta-learning that enables efficient cross-city knowledge transfer while preserving chaotic characteristics. We establish theoretical guarantees including chaos-to-wave stability, wave-induced dimension reduction, and meta-learning generalisation bounds. Extensive experiments on four real-world traffic datasets demonstrate that CIWI-CKT significantly outperforms state-of-the-art spatio-temporal graph learning, transfer learning, prompt-based, and few-shot methods, improving prediction accuracy while substantially reducing required training data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CIWI-CKT框架，通过混沌感知的波干扰特征融合与跨城市知识迁移，解决数据稀缺下跨城市交通流预测难题，在四个真实数据集上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有交通流预测方法在跨城市、数据稀缺场景下泛化能力不足，难以建模交通动力学的混沌特性与波状干扰模式，缺乏有效的少样本学习机制。
AI.method: 提出CIWI-CKT框架，包含三个核心创新：混沌感知波生成（提取混沌不变量并建模为自适应波分量）、元干扰处理（捕获支持集与查询集间的波交互并生成可预测性评分）、混沌感知元学习（实现跨城市知识迁移同时保留混沌特征）。
AI.result: 在四个真实交通数据集上，CIWI-CKT显著优于当前最先进的时空图学习、迁移学习、提示学习和少样本学习方法，在提升预测精度的同时大幅减少所需训练数据。
AI.conclusion: CIWI-CKT通过融合混沌理论与波干扰特征，为数据稀缺的跨城市交通预测提供了有效且具有理论保障的解决方案。

title: AI Pluralism and the Worlds It Misses
comment: To be presented at the ICML Pluralistic Alignment Workshop
summary: AI pluralism is often framed as a problem of representing diverse values, preferences, users, or outputs. This paper argues that this framing is incomplete because AI systems also impose ontologies: they define what counts as an entity, relation, feature, harm, benefit, and valid form of evidence. We define ontological flattening as the conversion of situated, contested, and historically specific meanings into a restricted technical category, proxy, aggregation rule, or benchmark target that is treated as neutral and difficult to contest. The paper develops a bounded conceptual and qualitative synthesis across value pluralism, pluralistic alignment, participatory and democratic AI, procedural justice, science and technology studies, accountability research, aggregate themes from 11 expert interviews, and three urban AI companion cases. The cases illustrate how pluralistic methods can improve or structure model behavior while still compressing categories, proxies, aggregation rules, and revision rights before affected actors have procedural standing. We introduce Pluralistic Lifecycle Governance (PLG) as a preliminary qualitative audit scaffold for documenting ontological openness, epistemic inclusion, procedural authority, evaluation pluralism, and lifecycle accountability. PLG is not presented as a validated scoring instrument; it is a framework for making the evidence and governance conditions of pluralistic AI explicit.

AI.tldr: 本文指出AI多元化不仅涉及价值观和用户多样性，更关键的是AI系统强加的本体论（ontology）——即定义什么算作实体、关系、特征、伤害、利益和有效证据。作者提出"本体论扁平化"概念，描述将情境化、争议性的意义压缩为看似中立的技术类别。通过概念综合、专家访谈和三个城市AI案例，展示了多元化方法仍可能在本体论层面造成压缩。最后提出"多元化生命周期治理"（PLG）作为定性审计框架。
AI.motivation: 现有AI多元化讨论主要聚焦价值观、偏好和用户多样性，忽视了AI系统在更根本的本体论层面施加的影响——即如何定义和分类世界中的实体与关系。这种本体论层面的预设往往被视为中立且难以质疑。
AI.method: 采用有界概念与定性综合方法，整合价值多元主义、多元对齐、参与式/民主AI、程序正义、STS、问责研究等文献，结合11场专家访谈的主题聚合，以及三个城市AI配套案例研究。
AI.result: 多元化方法虽然能改善模型行为，但仍在本体论层面存在压缩：类别被固化、代理变量被标准化、聚合规则被预设、受影响的行动者在获得程序地位前修订权已被限制。
AI.conclusion: 提出多元生命周期治理（PLG）作为初步的定性审计框架，用于记录AI系统在本体论开放性、认识论包容性、程序权威性、评价多元性和生命周期问责性方面的表现。PLG并非验证过的评分工具，而是使多元AI的证据和治理条件显性化的框架。

title: PVminerLLM2: Improving Structured Extraction of Patient Voice via Preference Optimization
summary:
Motivation: Patient-generated text contains critical information on patients' lived experiences, social context, and care engagement, but remains largely unstructured, limiting its use in patient-centered outcomes research. Prior work introduced the PV-Miner benchmark and PVMinerLLM models for structured extraction.
