However, supervised fine-tuning (SFT) alone struggles with rare, fine-grained, and unevenly distributed errors, particularly in token-critical structured outputs.
  Results: We present PVminerLLM2, an improved set of LLMs for structured patient voice extraction that applies preference optimization to address token-critical errors beyond the reach of supervised fine-tuning. Our method introduces (i) a preference objective with token-level gated stabilization term that prevents degradation of absolute token likelihood under preference optimization, and (ii) confusion-aware preference pair construction to better capture low-separation distinctions. We further incorporate token-importance weighting and inverse-frequency reweighing to address token imbalance and class skew. Across multiple model sizes, PVMinerLLM2 consistently outperforms strong baselines, achieving gains of up to 4.43% (Code), 3.50% (Sub-code), and 1.55% (Span), and outperforms baseline LLM trained with existing preference optimization methods.
  Availability and Implementation: The supplementary material, code, evaluation scripts, and trained models for PVminerLLM2 are publicly available at: https://github.com/Data-Mining-Lab-Yale/PVminerLLM2

AI.tldr: 本文提出PVminerLLM2，通过偏好优化（含token级门控稳定项和混淆感知偏好对构建）改进患者语音的结构化提取，在Code、Sub-code、Span指标上分别提升最高4.43%、3.50%、1.55%，超越现有偏好优化方法。
AI.motivation: 患者生成文本包含关键信息但非结构化，现有监督微调在细粒度、稀疏且分布不均的token级错误上表现不足，尤其是在token关键的结构化输出场景中。
AI.method: 提出PVminerLLM2：①引入带token级门控稳定项的偏好目标，防止偏好优化下绝对token似然退化；②构建混淆感知偏好对，更好捕获低分离度区分；③加入token重要性加权和逆频率重加权，应对token不平衡和类别偏斜。
AI.result: 在多个模型规模上，PVminerLLM2一致优于强基线，Code提升4.43%，Sub-code提升3.50%，Span提升1.55%，并优于现有偏好优化方法训练的基线LLM。
AI.conclusion: 偏好优化能有效弥补监督微调在token级结构化提取中的不足，门控稳定项和混淆感知策略是提升稀疏错误处理能力的关键设计。

title: MosaicQuant: Inlier-Outlier Disaggregation for Unified 4-Bit LLM Quantization
summary: 4-bit quantization significantly reduces the memory footprint and accelerates the inference of large language models (LLMs). However, its limited bit-width representation struggles to faithfully capture both dense common values (\emph{inliers}) and rare large-magnitude values (\emph{outliers}), causing substantial accuracy degradation. Existing mixed-precision methods mitigate this by retaining outliers in high precision, but at the cost of breaking the uniformity of low-bit execution, introducing precision conversion and extra data movement that undermine practical speedup. We propose \textbf{MosaicQuant}, a unified 4-bit LLM quantization paradigm built on a novel principle of \emph{inlier--outlier disaggregation}. Rather than elevating outlier precision, MosaicQuant quantizes the full weight matrix into a dense 4-bit base component, where inliers are captured faithfully while outlier are inevitably quantized. A sparse 4-bit residual component is then introduced to compensate for these quantization errors, selectively targeting the most error-critical weight blocks where output distortion is shown to be concentrated. However, a unified representation alone is insufficient, as naïvely executing the sparse residual as a separate kernel still breaks the unified low-bit inference pipeline. To bridge this gap, we introduce \textbf{ZipperEngine}, which fuses sparse block computation into the dense 4-bit GEMM kernel via an overlapped pipeline, unifying not only the representation but also the execution into a single coherent low-bit inference pipeline. Extensive experiments on LLaMA3 and Qwen3 demonstrate that MosaicQuant preserves near-FP16 accuracy while achieving up to $1.24\times$ speedup over the W16A16 baseline.

AI.tldr: MosaicQuant提出了一种统一的4-bit LLM量化范式，通过将权重矩阵分解为密集4-bit基组件和稀疏4-bit残差组件来分离处理内点（密集常见值）和外点（稀疏大值），并设计了ZipperEngine将稀疏块计算融合到密集GEMM内核中，实现了接近FP16精度的同时比W16A16基线快1.24倍。
AI.motivation: 4-bit量化虽然能显著减少显存占用并加速LLM推理，但其有限的位宽难以同时忠实表示密集的常见值（内点）和罕见的大幅值（外点），导致严重精度下降。现有混合精度方法通过保留外点高精度缓解问题，但破坏了低比特执行的统一性，引入精度转换和额外数据移动，削弱了实际加速效果。
AI.method: 提出MosaicQuant，核心思想是"内点-外点分离"：1) 将全权重矩阵量化为密集4-bit基组件，内点被忠实捕捉，外点被量化但产生误差；2) 引入稀疏4-bit残差组件，选择性补偿最关键的误差权重块；3) 提出ZipperEngine，通过重叠流水线将稀疏块计算融合到密集4-bit GEMM内核中，实现表示和执行的统一。
AI.result: 在LLaMA3和Qwen3上的大量实验表明，MosaicQuant在保持接近FP16精度的同时，相比W16A16基线实现了高达1.24倍的加速。
AI.conclusion: MosaicQuant通过统一的4-bit表示和执行范式，在不牺牲精度的情况下实现了实际推理加速，解决了混合精度方法中精度与速度的权衡问题。

title: TimeVista: Exploring and Exploiting Vision-Language Models as Judges for Time Series Forecasting
summary: High-quality time series forecasting is pivotal for real-world decision-making. However, traditional point-wise metrics often fail to reveal complex temporal patterns and align poorly with human intuitive preferences. While the ''LLM-as-a-Judge'' paradigm has revolutionized text evaluation by providing flexible, human-aligned judgment, its application to time series remains largely unexplored. In this paper, we leverage Vision-Language Models (VLMs) as judges for time series forecasting, harnessing their ability to comprehend time series plots grounded in textual information. Specifically, we propose a novel framework integrating micro- and macro-level judgments informed by contextual information to evaluate time series forecasting. To this end, we introduce TimeVista, a comprehensive VLM-as-a-Judge benchmark comprising 5563 time series samples paired with detailed evaluation rubrics. Extensive meta-evaluations demonstrate that VLMs are highly reliable judges, achieving significantly higher consistency with human preferences than conventional metrics. Building upon our benchmark, we comprehensively assess recent Time Series Foundation Models (TSFMs) under the VLM-as-a-Judge paradigm. Our results demonstrate that VLMs serve as robust and interpretable judges, providing a comprehensive, human-aligned standard for evaluating time series models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出利用视觉语言模型（VLM）作为时间序列预测的评判者，构建了TimeVista基准（含5563个样本和评估标准），证明VLM比传统指标更符合人类偏好，并基于该范式评估了多个时间序列基础模型。
AI.motivation: 传统时间序列预测的点式评估指标无法揭示复杂时间模式，且与人类直觉偏好对齐不佳。尽管"LLM-as-a-Judge"范式在文本评估中取得突破，但在时间序列领域的应用尚属空白。
AI.method: 提出一个新颖框架，整合基于上下文的微观和宏观判断来评估时间序列预测；引入TimeVista基准，包含5563个时间序列样本及详细评估标准。
AI.result: 元评估表明VLM是高度可靠的评判者，与人类偏好的一致性显著高于传统指标；基于该基准对最新时间序列基础模型进行了全面评估。
AI.conclusion: VLM可作为稳健且可解释的评判者，为时间序列模型评估提供全面、符合人类标准的新范式。

title: Long-Context Modeling via GSS-Transformer Hybrid Architecture with Learnable Mixing
summary: Modeling long-range dependencies remains a central challenge in natural language processing. Transformer architectures achieve strong performance via self-attention but scale quadratically ($O(N^2)$) with sequence length, while State Space Models (SSMs) scale linearly ($O(N)$) but suffer from a selective recall bottleneck, struggling to retrieve precise information from compressed states. This creates a fundamental tradeoff between efficiency and perplexity. To tackle these challenges, we propose the \textit{Parallel Hybrid Architecture (PHA)}, which runs Gated State Spaces (GSS), Grouped Query Attention (GQA), and Feed-Forward Networks (FFNs) as independent parallel branches fused by a learnable mixing mechanism. Instead of forcing SSMs to approximate attention or serializing the two paradigms, PHA allows each branch to specialize: GSS captures global context, while attention performs selective retrieval, with FFN providing complementary processing. On WikiText-103, PHA achieves 16.51 PPL at 125M parameters, outperforming Hedgehog (16.70) and H3-125M (23.70). Scaling to 180M parameters yields 16.42 PPL, which gives comparable results with the pure attention baseline while delivering 24\% higher throughput and up to 40\% lower memory usage at long contexts. On OpenWebText, our 125M model achieves 19.72 PPL, outperforming standard Transformers (20.60) and GSS hybrid baselines (19.80). These results demonstrate that separating sequence modeling paradigms into parallel specialists enables Transformer-level perplexity with substantially improved efficiency for long-context language modeling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并行混合架构(PHA)，将门控状态空间(GSS)、分组查询注意力(GQA)和前馈网络(FFN)作为独立并行分支运行，通过可学习的混合机制融合，在保持Transformer级困惑度的同时显著提升长序列效率，在WikiText-103上125M参数达到16.51 PPL，吞吐量提升24%，内存降低40%。
AI.motivation: Transformer的自注意力机制随序列长度呈二次方缩放，而状态空间模型(SSM)虽线性缩放但存在选择性回忆瓶颈，难以从压缩状态中精确检索信息，导致效率与困惑度之间存在根本性权衡。
AI.method: PHA并行运行三个独立分支：门控状态空间(GSS)捕获全局上下文、分组查询注意力(GQA)执行选择性检索、前馈网络(FFN)提供互补处理，并通过可学习的混合机制融合各分支输出。
AI.result: WikiText-103上125M参数达16.51 PPL（优于Hedgehog 16.70和H3-125M 23.70）；180M参数达16.42 PPL，与纯注意力基线相当，但长上下文吞吐量提升24%、内存降低40%；OpenWebText上125M模型达19.72 PPL，优于标准Transformer(20.60)和GSS混合基线(19.80)。
AI.conclusion: 将序列建模范式分离为并行专家，能够在保持Transformer级困惑度的同时，大幅提升长上下文语言建模的效率。

title: Z-Plane Neural Networks: Bounded Geometric Activation Replaces ReLU and LayerNorm
summary: Modern deep neural networks rely on Euclidean scalar activations (e.g., ReLU) and global normalization techniques (e.g., LayerNorm) to prevent gradient instability in deep architectures. However, these mechanisms inherently cause dead neurons, discard critical directional information, and destroy the orthogonality of feature representations. Inspired by the frequency-modulation transmission of biological axons, we propose the Z-Plane Neural Network, which maps hidden states into 2D phasor bundles on a hypersphere. We introduce a novel geometric activation function, Radial Bounding($\mathbf{x} / \max(1, \|\mathbf{x}\|_2)$), which limits the energy magnitude while preserving the phase (direction). We demonstrate mathematically that this isotropic activation maintains 1-Lipschitz continuity and prevents gradient vanishing by preserving tangential gradients. Empirically, a 100-layer Z-Plane Multi-Layer Perceptron (MLP)-entirely devoid of ReLU and LayerNorm-successfully converges on the MNIST dataset with 98.34% accuracy and absolute numerical stability, proving that bounded geometric activation alone is sufficient for stable deep learning.

AI.tldr: 受生物轴突调频传输启发，提出Z-Plane神经网络，将隐藏态映射到超球面上的二维相量束，使用径向边界激活函数（x/max(1,||x||₂)）限制能量幅度同时保留相位（方向），该各向同性激活保持1-Lipschitz连续性并通过保留切向梯度防止梯度消失。100层纯MLP（无ReLU和LayerNorm）在MNIST上达到98.34%准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有深度神经网络依赖ReLU和LayerNorm等机制，但存在死神经元、丢弃方向信息、破坏特征表示正交性等问题。
AI.method: 提出Z-Plane神经网络，将隐藏状态映射到超球面上的2D相量束；引入径向边界激活函数（Radial Bounding: x/max(1,||x||₂)），该函数限制能量幅度同时保留相位（方向），具有各向同性、保持1-Lipschitz连续性、通过保留切向梯度防止梯度消失。
AI.result: 100层纯Z-Plane MLP（无ReLU和LayerNorm）在MNIST上成功收敛，准确率98.34%，数值绝对稳定。
AI.conclusion: 证明仅使用有界几何激活函数即可实现稳定的深度学习，无需ReLU和LayerNorm等传统机制。

title: PAL-Bench: Evidence-Grounded Profile Reconstruction from Longitudinal Personal Albums
summary: Longitudinal personal albums are weak-schema multimodal databases: noisy perceptual records whose key facts require joins across faces, text, timestamps, locations, and repeated events. Existing visual, video, document, and lifelog benchmarks test sub-problems, but not album-scale profile reconstruction with social identity binding and evidence citation. Benchmarking this task is difficult because the ground truth needed for evaluation--owner profiles, social graphs, face-name maps, and evidence provenance--is private state that real albums cannot safely release. We introduce PAL-Bench, a controlled benchmark for evidence-grounded reconstruction under a public-record contract. Its Evidence Compiler builds latent private worlds, programs target-level evidence paths, renders album pixels, re-measures them through perception pipelines, and exports audited public/private views. Agents receive only perception-derived public records; targets, identifier maps, and evidence paths remain hidden. PAL-Bench contains 50 synthetic users, 36,659 public photo records, and 2,799 targets over owner facts, identities, and relations. A privacy-preserving audit with 10 participants confirms that PAL-Bench evidence structures match real private albums, though equivalent releases remain privacy-prohibitive. Across seven systems and two compute-matched diagnostics, a seven-metric protocol reveals a gap between plausible profile summarization and faithful social reconstruction: systems recover some owner facts but struggle with recurring identities and evidence citation. PAL-TRACE, a reference framework that freezes identity bindings before owner-fact mining, performs best but leaves hard identity resolution far from solved. PAL-Bench provides a testbed for perceptual entity resolution, multimodal data integration, temporal evidence aggregation, and provenance-aware structured prediction.

AI.tldr: PAL-Bench是首个面向纵向个人相册的证据驱动身份与事实重建基准，包含50个合成用户、36,659张照片和2,799个目标，通过隐私安全审计验证其与现实相册的证据结构一致性，并揭示现有系统在身份解析和证据引用方面的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 纵向个人相册是弱模式多模态数据库，其关键事实需跨人脸、文本、时间戳、位置和重复事件进行联合推理。现有基准仅测试子问题，缺乏相册级别的个人档案重建与社交身份绑定及证据引用的综合评测。同时，真实相册因包含隐私敏感的拥有者档案、社交图谱、人脸-姓名映射和证据来源等地面真值而无法公开释放。
AI.method: PAL-Bench的Evidence Compiler构建潜在私有世界，编程目标级证据路径，渲染相册像素，通过感知流水线重新测量，并导出经审计的公共/私有视图。智能体仅接收感知导出的公共记录，目标、标识符映射和证据路径保持隐藏。包含50个合成用户、36,659张公共照片记录和2,799个目标（涵盖拥有者事实、身份和关系）。通过10名参与者的隐私保护审计验证证据结构与真实私有相册一致。
AI.result: 七系统两诊断的七指标评估协议显示，现有系统在合理的档案摘要与忠实的社交重建之间存在差距：系统能恢复部分拥有者事实，但在重复出现的身份解析和证据引用方面表现不佳。PAL-TRACE（冻结身份绑定后进行拥有者事实挖掘的参考框架）表现最佳，但硬身份解析远未解决。
AI.conclusion: PAL-Bench为感知实体解析、多模态数据集成、时间证据聚合和来源感知结构化预测提供了测试平台，填补了相册级个人档案重建基准的空白。

title: Towards Pareto-Optimal Tool-Integrated Agents with Pareto Ranking Policy Optimization
summary: Recent advances in tool-integrated language agents have significantly improved their ability to solve complex reasoning tasks. However, existing alignment methods predominantly focus on maximizing task accuracy, while overlooking auxiliary objectives such as tool-use efficiency, which are essential for practical deployment. To address this gap, we introduce ParetoPO, a two-stage multi-objective optimization framework for aligning tool-using large language models (LLMs) under competing objectives. In the first stage, ParetoPO leverages hypervolume-guided dynamic scalarization to adapt reward weights based on global Pareto frontier progress. In the second stage, it replaces scalarized learning signals with Pareto-ranking-based advantage computation, promoting nondominated trajectories through dominance-aware credit assignment. This design enables fine-grained, action-level optimization across multiple conflicting objectives. Experimental results on mathematic reasoning and multi-hop QA tasks show that ParetoPO consistently discovers policies with superior accuracy-efficiency trade-offs compared to static and heuristic baselines.

AI.tldr: ParetoPO是一个两阶段多目标优化框架，用于对齐工具集成语言模型，在准确性与工具使用效率等冲突目标之间实现更优的帕累托权衡，实验表明其优于静态和启发式基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐方法主要聚焦于最大化任务准确率，忽略了工具使用效率等辅助目标，而这些目标对于实际部署至关重要，因此需要一种能够平衡多个竞争目标的对齐方法。
AI.method: ParetoPO包含两阶段：(1) 超体积引导的动态标量化，根据全局帕累托前沿进展自适应调整奖励权重；(2) 基于帕累托排序的优势计算替代标量化学习信号，通过优势感知的信用分配促进非支配轨迹，实现跨多个冲突目标的细粒度动作级优化。
AI.result: 在数学推理和多跳问答任务上，ParetoPO发现的策略在准确性与效率的权衡上一致优于静态和启发式基线方法。
AI.conclusion: ParetoPO有效地解决了工具集成语言模型在多目标对齐中的挑战，为实际部署中兼顾准确性和效率提供了可行的优化框架。

title: The Reservoir Attention Network: Cross-Pass State in Pretrained Transformers via Content-Addressable Reservoir Injection
summary: A feasibility and dynamics study of the Reservoir Attention Network (RAN), an architecture that injects a fixed, randomly-initialized reservoir into the mid-layer attention of a pretrained transformer to carry state across forward passes. Experiments span GPT-2 (124M, 355M) to Qwen2.5 (0.5B, 1.5B) on a single consumer GPU. The tasks are minimal probes chosen to isolate individual mechanisms; the broader always-alive agent vision is treated throughout as compute-limited future work, not a claim of this paper. The reservoir is left untrained (fixed random) by design: this isolates whether untrained recurrent dynamics alone suffice to carry usable cross-pass state, leaving trained recurrence as a complementary, more expensive direction.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了残差注意力网络（RAN）架构，通过在预训练Transformer的中间层注入固定随机初始化的残差网络来跨前向传递携带状态，实验证明未训练的循环动态足以携带可用的跨传递状态。
AI.motivation: 探索是否仅靠未训练的循环动态就足以在Transformer的前向传播之间传递可用的状态信息，为计算受限场景下的"永久活跃"智能体愿景提供轻量级方案。
AI.method: 在预训练Transformer（GPT-2 124M/355M、Qwen2.5 0.5B/1.5B）的中层注意力中注入固定随机初始化的残差网络，残差保持未训练状态，在单块消费级GPU上进行最小探针任务实验。
AI.result: 未训练的循环动态能够跨前向传递携带可用状态信息。
AI.conclusion: 固定随机残差网络足以实现跨传递状态携带，而训练循环作为互补的且更昂贵的方向被留作未来工作。

title: Measuring Whether LLM Tutors Teach or Solve: A Diagnostic for Educational Impact
summary: Large language models are increasingly proposed as educational tutors, yet stronger task-solving ability does not necessarily imply stronger learning support. Motivated by recent calls to measure the social impact of NLP systems in practice, we study whether public LLM tutoring benchmarks distinguish learning-supportive behavior from mere answer production. We propose a lightweight diagnostic based on the gap between solving-oriented and pedagogy-oriented benchmark performance. Using public MathTutorBench leaderboard results, we show that these dimensions are only partially aligned: across eight publicly reported models, the correlation between solving and pedagogy composites is 0.421, and several models shift meaningfully in rank when evaluation moves from solving to pedagogy. We then analyze the public TutorBench sample and show that agency-relevant behaviors are explicitly encoded in benchmark rubrics, especially in active-learning settings that reward guiding questions, calibrated hints, and non-disclosive scaffolding. Together, these findings suggest that educational-impact evaluation should not treat task success as a sufficient proxy for learning support. We argue that public tutoring benchmarks can better support positive-impact evaluation by reporting solving-oriented and pedagogy-oriented scores separately and by making disclosure-sensitive, student-agency-preserving criteria more explicit.

AI.tldr: 大型语言模型的教育辅导能力不能仅通过任务解决能力来评估。本文提出基于"解决导向"与"教学导向"基准表现的差距来诊断模型是否真正支持学习。基于MathTutorBench排行榜数据，发现两者仅部分对齐（相关系数0.421），多个模型排名发生显著变化。进一步分析表明，与学习者主体性相关的行为（如引导性问题、校准提示、非揭露式脚手架）已编码在基准评分标准中。建议教育影响力评估应分别报告解决导向和教学导向得分，并明确学生主体性保护标准。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM作为教育辅导员的评估过度关注任务解决能力，忽视了真正的学习支持。受NLP系统社会影响评估呼吁的启发，需要研究公共LLM辅导基准是否能够区分学习支持行为与单纯的答案生成行为。
AI.method: 提出基于解决导向与教学导向基准表现差距的轻量级诊断方法。利用MathTutorBench排行榜上8个公开模型的成绩，计算解决能力和教学能力复合指标的相关性，并分析排名变化。同时分析TutorBench样本中与学习者主体性相关的评分标准编码情况。
AI.result: 解决与教学维度的复合指标相关性仅为0.421，多个模型在切换评估维度时排名发生明显变化。基准评分标准中明确编码了引导性问题、校准提示、非揭露式脚手架等主体性相关行为，尤其在主动学习场景中。
AI.conclusion: 任务成功不能作为学习支持的充分代理指标。公共辅导基准应分别报告解决导向和教学导向得分，并明确披露敏感性、学生主体性保护标准，以更好地支持正向影响力评估。

title: AuAu: A Benchmark for Auditing Authoritarian Alignment in Large Language Models
summary: The worldwide surge of authoritarianism, combined with the increasing central role in users' everyday lives, raises the question of to what extent specific models exhibit or promote authoritarian attitudes and characteristics. We introduce AuAu, a comprehensive benchmark that aims to assess the risk of LLMs generating responses with authoritarian tendencies. This benchmark combines three evaluation approaches: (i) psychometric questions from an extensive pool of 15 human validated instruments; (ii) contextual behavior vignettes probing intended actions in concrete situations; and (iii) responses to realistic user prompts. Unlike prior work, AuAu evaluates not only a general closeness towards authoritarianism but also the established sub-concepts Authoritarian Aggression, Authoritarian Submission, and Conventionalism. Evaluating 17 models from China, the EU, Russia, and the USA, we find that all tested models exhibit substantial authoritarian response rates under the psychometric evaluation, though rates drop significantly in increasingly more realistic downstream task. We further find that an authoritarian system prompt easily manipulates 15 out of 17 models to promote increased authoritarianism. Our results underscore the need for continued, systematic auditing of LLM-based AI systems to detect and ultimately mitigate undesired authoritarian tendencies in generated output. Our code and data are available at: https://github.com/andreaseinwiller/AuAu

AI.tldr: 本文提出AuAu基准，用于评估大语言模型生成具有威权主义倾向内容的风险，通过心理测量、情境行为测试和用户提示三种方法评估17个模型，发现所有模型均表现出不同程度的威权主义响应倾向，且易受系统提示操纵。
AI.motivation: 全球威权主义浪潮兴起，加之LLM在用户日常生活中扮演日益核心的角色，亟需系统评估AI模型是否表现或促进威权主义态度与特征。
AI.method: 构建AuAu基准，结合三类评估方法：(i) 15个人类验证的心理测量问卷；(ii) 情境行为小场景测试；(iii) 真实用户提示响应。评估来自中国、欧盟、俄罗斯和美国的17个模型，涵盖威权主义攻击性、威权主义服从性和传统主义三个子概念。
AI.result: 所有测试模型在心理测量评估下均表现出显著的威权主义响应率，但在更真实的下游任务中该比率显著下降；15/17的模型易被威权主义系统提示操纵以促进更高水平的威权主义。
AI.conclusion: 需要持续、系统性地审计基于LLM的AI系统，以检测并最终减轻生成输出中不期望的威权主义倾向。

title: ReQAT: Achieving Full-Precision Reasoning Accuracy with 4-bit Floating-Point Quantization-Aware Training
summary: Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) achieve strong problem-solving through long chain-of-thought, but their deployment is constrained by the high cost of full-precision inference and growing KV cache footprints. Microscaled FP4 formats enable efficient FP4 deployment; however, fully quantizing weights, activations, and KV caches (W4A4KV4) causes severe reasoning degradation that existing PTQ and QAT fail to recover. We identify that FP4 failures concentrate on low-entropy tokens--precise symbolic commitments such as digits and operators--where quantization noise inflates sampling errors that cascade through reasoning traces. Based on this insight, we propose ReQAT, a reasoning-centric FP4 training framework with three components: (i) Trace-Aligned QAT (TAQ), which revisits identical reasoning traces to focus updates on critical low-entropy decisions; (ii) Selective Entropy Minimization (SEM), which reinforces confidence at low-entropy positions; and (iii) Q-FIT, a quantization-friendly initialization that jointly calibrates RoPE-consistent KV cache transformations to stabilize QAT. Under the same training budget, ReQAT not only recovers but surpasses BF16 fine-tuning accuracy, while delivering up to 3.9x throughput speedup on NVIDIA DGX Spark and 3.1x on B200.

AI.tldr: 提出ReQAT框架，通过Trace-Aligned QAT、Selective Entropy Minimization和Q-FIT三组件，在FP4量化下恢复并超越BF16精度，实现最高3.9x加速。
AI.motivation: LRMs在FP4全量化（W4A4KV4）下推理性能严重下降，现有PTQ和QAT方法无法恢复，需针对推理特性设计量化训练框架。
AI.method: 提出ReQAT框架：(i) Trace-Aligned QAT (TAQ) 回溯相同推理轨迹，聚焦低熵关键决策更新；(ii) Selective Entropy Minimization (SEM) 增强低熵位置的置信度；(iii) Q-FIT 联合校准RoPE一致的KV缓存变换，稳定QAT训练。
AI.result: 在相同训练预算下，ReQAT恢复并超越BF16微调精度；在NVIDIA DGX Spark上实现3.9x吞吐加速，B200上实现3.1x加速。
AI.conclusion: FP4量化推理退化集中在低熵token（数字、运算符等），ReQAT通过针对性设计有效缓解，实现高效低比特推理。

title: Sensor-Conditioned Representation Learning via Scene-Relevant Observation Quotients
summary: Learned representations in intelligent sensing systems are often evaluated by reconstruction fidelity or downstream prediction accuracy, but these criteria do not specify which latent distinctions are justified by the sensing process. In sensor-conditioned environments, nuisance factors can change measurements without changing the scene, while distinct scenes may be indistinguishable under limited sensing capability. This paper formulates sensor-conditioned representation correctness as preserving sensing-supported scene distinctions while suppressing nuisance-induced and sensor-unsupported variation. We introduce the scene-relevant observation quotient, a representation target induced by sensing-supported distinguishability after nuisance canonicalization, and develop Observation-Quotient Tucker-Structured Autoencoding (OQ-TSAE), a scene-nuisance factorized framework with diagnostics for false distinction, false merge, nuisance sensitivity, and latent ordering consistency. Experiments on a controlled benchmark show that quotient-consistent supervision improves representation-correctness diagnostics over reconstruction-oriented, metric-learning, and contrastive-learning baselines. Sensitivity, perturbation, and ablation studies show the importance of quotient-aligned supervision, reliable quotient relations, and quotient geometry. Complementary real-radar experiments show that a reconstruction-only OQ-TSAE variant retains competitive downstream utility, robustness under observation degradation, and low seed-to-seed variability. These results suggest that sensor-conditioned representations should be evaluated not only by predictive utility, but also by whether their latent geometry preserves sensing-justified scene distinctions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出传感器条件化表示正确性的形式化框架，通过场景相关观测商（Observation Quotient）定义感知支持的场景区分，并开发OQ-TSAE模型实现因子化编码与诊断指标。实验表明，商一致的监督优于传统方法，且表示的正确性应基于潜在几何是否保持感知合理的场景区分来评估。
AI.motivation: 现有智能感知系统的学习表示通常以重建保真度或下游预测精度为评价标准，但这些标准无法指定哪些潜在区分是感知过程本身所证明合理的。在传感器条件化环境中， nuisance因素可在不改变场景的情况下改变测量值，而不同场景在有限感知能力下可能无法区分。因此需要一种能够反映传感器支持的可区分性的表示正确性准则。
AI.method: 提出场景相关观测商作为感知支持可区分性经 nuisance 规范化后的表示目标；开发OQ-TSAE（Observation-Quotient Tucker-Structured Autoencoding）场景-nuisance因子化框架，包含误区分（false distinction）、误合并（false merge）、nuisance敏感性和潜在排序一致性等诊断指标。
AI.result: 在受控基准上，商一致的监督在表示正确性诊断指标上优于重建导向、度量学习和对比学习基线。灵敏度、扰动和消融实验表明商对齐监督、可靠商关系和商几何的重要性。真实雷达实验表明仅重建的OQ-TSAE变体保持竞争力的下游效用、观测退化下的鲁棒性和低种子间变异性。
AI.conclusion: 传感器条件化表示不仅应通过预测效用评估，还应评估其潜在几何是否保持感知证明合理的场景区分。

title: XAI-Grounded Explanation Generation for Speech Deepfake Detection with Training-Free Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Speech deepfake detection (SDD) systems require trustworthy explanations for reliable decision-making. Existing explanation ways mainly fall into two categories. Traditional explainable AI (XAI), such as gradient-based attribution, produces low-level attribution signals tightly coupled with model decisions, and harder to be understood by human than natural language explanations. Meanwhile, large language model (LLM)-based explanation generation often produces generic and ungrounded descriptions due to the lack of heuristic evidence and task-specific supervision, stemming from limited grounded explanation datasets for SDD. We therefore propose a training-free explanation framework that integrates XAI evidence with multimodal LLMs to generate grounded and specific explanations. Using the PartialSpoof dataset, we construct a grounded explanation dataset and show that methods with XAI increase inside accuracy by over 45\%, verified through human evaluation and faithfulness checks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种无训练的解释框架，将可解释人工智能（XAI）证据与多模态大语言模型（LLM）相结合，为语音深度伪造检测（SDD）生成有依据且具体的自然语言解释。在PartialSpoof数据集上，结合XAI的方法将内在准确性提升了超过45%，并通过人类评估和忠实性检验得到验证。
AI.motivation: 现有SDD解释方法存在两类问题：传统XAI（如梯度归因）产生的低级归因信号与模型决策紧密耦合且难以理解；基于LLM的解释生成因缺乏启发式证据和任务特定监督，常产生泛化且无依据的描述。需要一种能生成有依据、可理解的自然语言解释方法。
AI.method: 提出无训练的解释框架，将XAI产生的归因证据作为输入，整合到多模态LLM中，引导其生成有具体依据的自然语言解释，无需额外训练或微调。
AI.result: 在PartialSpoof数据集上构建了有依据的解释数据集，结合XAI的方法使内在准确性提升超过45%，并通过人类评估和忠实性检验验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架有效融合了XAI的证据性和LLM的语义理解能力，为SDD系统提供了既忠实于模型决策又易于人类理解的可解释性方案。

title: Multi-Fidelity SINDy: Sparse Discovery of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems with Fidelity-Weighted Measurements
summary: Data from simulations and experiments are rarely noise-free and often exhibit heterogeneous levels of fidelity. Measurement uncertainty may vary across repeated observations, sensing devices, or even within a single experiment. This work addresses the problem of discovering nonlinear dynamical systems from such inhomogeneous data. We extend the Sparse Identification of Nonlinear Dynamical Systems (SINDy) framework to account for variable noise levels by combining Ensemble SINDy and Weak SINDy within a weighted regression formulation derived from generalized least squares. A statistical justification for the weighting strategy is also provided. The methodology is validated on several benchmark systems, including ordinary and partial differential equations. In addition, we show the benefit of multi-fidelity integration for forecasting the dynamics of a double pendulum system. The results confirm that the proposed approach mitigates the adverse effects of heteroscedastic noise and that repeated, low-cost, low-quality measurements can improve model recovery, in some cases matching or outperforming reconstructions obtained using only high-fidelity data.

AI.tldr: 本文针对含异方差噪声的非均匀数据，提出了加权SINDy方法（结合集成SINDy与弱SINDy及广义最小二乘加权回归），有效从不同保真度的观测数据中发现非线性动力系统，并通过多保真度融合提升模型恢复效果。
AI.motivation: 真实实验与仿真数据常含有不同程度噪声（异方差性），现有SINDy框架难以处理这类非均匀保真度的观测数据，亟需发展鲁棒的系统识别方法。
AI.method: 将集成SINDy与弱SINDy相结合，引入基于广义最小二乘的加权回归策略，为不同噪声水平的数据分配自适应权重，并给出了加权策略的统计理论依据。
AI.result: 在常微分与偏微分方程基准系统上验证了方法的有效性；在双摆系统中展示了多保真度融合的优势——低成本低质量重复测量可匹配甚至超越仅用高质量数据的模型恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 该加权方法能有效减轻异方差噪声的不利影响，且多保真度数据融合策略具有实际价值，可在降低数据获取成本的同时保证模型识别质量。

title: Latent Thought Flow: Efficient Latent Reasoning in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on intermediate reasoning, yet explicit Chain-of-Thought (CoT) suffers from a linguistic space bottleneck: each thought must be decoded into tokens, causing high inference overhead. Latent reasoning moves deliberation into continuous space, but existing methods mostly learn deterministic or reward-maximizing paths, lacking a principled way to allocate probability across trajectories with different correctness and costs. We propose Latent Thought Flow (LTF), which models reasoning as variable-length continuous trajectories and trains a sampler to match a reward-induced posterior over answer quality and computation cost. We instantiate this with a continuous GFlowNet using stochastic latent transitions. To handle sparse answer supervision, we introduce an Entropy-Weighted Subtrajectory Balance objective for intermediate rewards and a reference-prior regularizer to anchor exploration. Experiments under finetuning and transfer learning settings show that LTF outperforms explicit CoT and latent reasoning baselines, improving accuracy by 9.5% while reducing reasoning length by 27.2% on average compared with strong latent reasoning baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出潜思维流（LTF），将推理建模为连续空间中的变长轨迹，利用连续GFlowNet和随机潜状态转移，通过奖励后验分布分配轨迹概率，并引入熵加权子轨迹平衡目标和参考先验正则化器处理稀疏答案监督。相比显式思维链和潜推理基线，LTF平均准确率提升9.5%，推理长度减少27.2%。
AI.motivation: 显式思维链（CoT）存在语言空间瓶颈，每个思维必须解码为词元，导致高推理开销；现有潜推理方法主要学习确定性或奖励最大化路径，缺乏一种原则性方式来根据正确性和计算成本在轨迹间分配概率。
AI.method: 将推理建模为连续空间中变长轨迹，训练采样器匹配答案质量和计算成本的奖励诱导后验分布；使用连续GFlowNet和随机潜状态转移实例化；提出熵加权子轨迹平衡目标（EW-SubTB）处理稀疏中间奖励；引入参考先验正则化器锚定探索过程。
AI.result: 在微调和迁移学习场景下，LTF在准确率上比强潜推理基线平均提升9.5%，同时推理长度减少27.2%；优于显式CoT和现有潜推理基线。
AI.conclusion: LTF通过连续空间变长推理轨迹的概率建模，有效克服了显式CoT的语言瓶颈和现有潜推理方法缺乏原则性概率分配的问题，在提升准确率的同时显著降低了推理成本。

title: GRACE: Step-Level Benchmark for Faithful Reasoning over Context
summary: Many reasoning tasks require models to reason over input context, from document-grounded question answering to rule-based deduction. Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting produces traces that appear transparent, yet individual steps can silently deviate from the source evidence, even when the final answer is correct. Existing methods detect hallucinations at the response level but fail to identify where in the chain a failure occurs or what type it is. We introduce GRACE, the first human-annotated step-level faithfulness benchmark with a data-driven error taxonomy for context-grounded textual reasoning. GRACE covers CoT traces from 10 models across 4 source datasets, with each step annotated for faithfulness, error category, and natural language explanation. A data-driven taxonomy, discovered bottom-up via unsupervised clustering, organizes failures into two tracks: GRACE-Inference (deductive errors) and GRACE-Grounding (factual grounding errors), with four categories each. The evaluation set is human-annotated and challenging by design. Our experiments reveal substantial headroom for current models. In addition, integrating step-level faithfulness signals into reinforcement learning pipelines improves both downstream accuracy and reasoning reliability.

AI.tldr: GRACE是首个带有人工标注的步骤级忠实度基准，用于上下文驱动文本推理中的CoT链评估，包含数据驱动的错误分类体系，实验表明当前模型在该基准上表现不佳，且将步骤级忠实度信号融入强化学习可提升下游准确性和推理可靠性。
AI.motivation: 现有方法只能在响应级别检测幻觉，无法定位链中具体失败步骤及其类型，需要更细粒度的忠实度评估手段。
AI.method: 构建GRACE基准，通过无监督聚类自底向上发现错误分类体系，包含GRACE-Inference（演绎错误）和GRACE-Grounding（事实接地错误）两个轨道各四个类别，覆盖10个模型在4个源数据集上的CoT轨迹，每步进行人工忠实度标注。
AI.result: 当前模型在该基准上表现存在显著提升空间；将步骤级忠实度信号融入强化学习管道可同时提升下游任务准确性和推理可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 步骤级忠实度评估对于理解和改进CoT推理至关重要，细粒度忠实度信号可作为有效训练信号。

title: When Generator Replay Degrades: Projected Rehearsal Orchestration for Heterogeneous Federated Class-Incremental Learning
summary: Federated class-incremental learning (FCIL) becomes substantially harder when clients observe different label subsets, progress through tasks at different stages, and provide uneven supervision for the same semantic concepts. Existing FCIL methods often preserve old knowledge through input-space synthesis, but they can be fragile under heterogeneous task streams and difficult to transfer across modalities. To alleviate such issues, we propose PRO, a framework that replaces synthetic input replay with projected rehearsal orchestration. To remove external pretraining, we evaluate all methods under the same warmup. After this, PRO maintains compact class-level projected memories on the server and allows clients perform balanced pseudo multi-task training over current examples and old projected memories. To handle stronger representation drift, we further introduce PRO-MAX, which augments PRO with neighborhood-weighted memory alignment while preserving the same server-light principle that the server only aggregates model updates and memory statistics. Across image, text, and graph benchmarks, PRO and PRO-MAX improve retention and final utility under heterogeneous streams while remaining competitive in homogeneous FCIL. Even when baselines are given expanded replay budgets, they degrade under supervision imbalance and stage misalignment, indicating that replay quantity alone does not resolve replay-quality failures. Additional weak-task diagnostics further show that larger replay mismatch is associated with larger downstream degradation, while our method keeps projected memories better aligned with the evolving representation.

AI.tldr: 针对联邦类增量学习（FCIL）中客户端标签子集异构、任务进度不一致和语义监督不均衡的问题，提出PRO框架，用投影排练编排替代合成输入回放，通过服务器维护紧凑的类级投影记忆，让客户端进行平衡的伪多任务训练；进一步提出PRO-MAX，加入邻域加权记忆对齐以应对更强的表示漂移。在图像、文本和图基准上，PRO和PRO-MAX在异构流下显著提升保留率和最终效用，即使在同质FCIL中也保持竞争力。
AI.motivation: 现有FCIL方法在异构任务流下脆弱且难以跨模态迁移，因为它们依赖输入空间合成来保留旧知识，当客户端标签子集不同、任务进度不一致时，合成回放质量下降，导致灾难性遗忘严重。
AI.method: 提出PRO框架：去除外部预训练，所有方法在相同预热后开始；服务器维护紧凑的类级投影记忆；客户端对当前样本和旧投影记忆进行平衡的伪多任务训练。PRO-MAX进一步加入邻域加权记忆对齐，同时保持服务器只聚合模型更新和记忆统计的轻量原则。
AI.result: 在图像、文本和图基准上，PRO和PRO-MAX在异构流下显著提升保留率和最终效用，在同质FCIL中也保持竞争力。即使基线获得更大回放预算，在监督不平衡和阶段错位下仍会退化；更大的回放不匹配与更大的下游退化相关。
AI.conclusion: 回放数量不足以解决回放质量失败；投影记忆对齐是提升异构FCIL效果的关键；PRO系列方法在保持服务器轻量的同时有效缓解异构流下的灾难性遗忘。

title: SpecAlign: Efficient Specification-Grounded Alignment of Large Language Models via Synthetic Data
summary: As large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in real-world applications, alignment is no longer governed by a single universal notion of safety or helpfulness, but instead by provider- or application-specific model specifications. These specifications are typically long, structured, and frequently updated, yet existing alignment pipelines lack a systematic mechanism to operationalize them as training signals. In this paper, we propose specification-grounded alignment, a new alignment paradigm that treats provider-authored model specifications as the primary alignment target rather than abstract principles or static benchmarks. To instantiate this paradigm, we introduce SpecAlign, a framework that synthesizes alignment data directly from specification documents. SpecAlign combines structured rule annotation, controllable specification instantiation, and multi-agent adversarial data synthesis to generate fine-grained, boundary-aware preference pairs that capture both compliant behaviors and meaningful specification violations. Experiments across multiple model specifications and backbone models demonstrate that training with SpecAlign consistently improves rule compliance while preserving general capabilities and avoiding over-conservative behavior. These results suggest that grounding alignment in explicit model specifications enables rapid, precise, and scalable adaptation of LLM behavior to evolving policy requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种新的对齐范式——规范接地对齐（specification-grounded alignment），并实现了SpecAlign框架，通过从规范文档中合成对齐数据来训练大语言模型，使其行为精确符合提供者或应用特定的模型规范，实验表明该方法能持续提升规则遵从性且不损害通用能力。
AI.motivation: 现有对齐流水线缺乏系统化的机制来将提供者或应用特定的、长篇幅且频繁更新的模型规范作为训练信号进行操作化。
AI.method: 提出SpecAlign框架，结合结构化规则标注、可控规范实例化和多智能体对抗数据合成，从规范文档中生成细粒度、边界感知的偏好对，同时包含合规行为和有意义的不合规行为。
AI.result: 在多种模型规范和骨干模型上的实验表明，SpecAlign训练持续提升了规则遵从性，同时保留了通用能力并避免了过度保守的行为。
AI.conclusion: 将对齐过程显式地建立在模型规范之上，能够实现对大语言模型行为快速、精确且可扩展的适应，以应对不断演变的政策要求。

title: Weaving Multi-Source Evidence for Biomedical Reasoning: The BioMedHop Benchmark and BioWeave Framework
summary: Biomedical question answering (QA) increasingly requires reasoning over interacting entities, where supporting evidence is scattered across biomedical knowledge graphs, literature documents, and web-accessible resources. However, existing biomedical QA benchmarks mainly focus on exam-style knowledge, literature comprehension, or short-range multi-hop inference, leaving source-conditioned graph reasoning and evidence topology construction underexplored. To fill this gap, we introduce BioMedHop, a multi-source graph-grounded benchmark for evaluating biomedical reasoning over structured evidence topologies. BioMedHop contains 10,045 instances across KG, document, web, and hybrid evidence settings, covering shared-neighbor matching, intersection reasoning, path-based reasoning, and counting, with option-based, open-ended, and numeric count renderings. To support this benchmark, we further propose BioWeave, a source-aware reasoning framework that retrieves biomedical KG paths, gathers supporting clues from documents and web sources, assembles them into a unified evidence graph, and verifies answers through entity-level evidence support. Comprehensive experiments show that BioWeave achieves the best overall performance among compared methods on BioMedHop, outperforming the strong hybrid baseline ToG-2 by 10.5% in the overall average. Moreover, BioWeave consistently improves different LLM backbones and enables smaller models, such as Qwen3-4B, to achieve reasoning performance comparable to GPT-4-Turbo.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BioMedHop——一个多源图基生物医学推理基准（10,045个实例，覆盖KG/文献/网页/混合证据），以及BioWeave——一个源感知推理框架，通过构建统一证据图进行实体级验证，在BioMedHop上整体平均性能比强基线ToG-2高出10.5%，并使Qwen3-4B达到接近GPT-4-Turbo的推理水平。
AI.motivation: 现有生物医学QA基准主要聚焦考试知识、文献理解或短程多跳推理，缺乏对源条件图推理和证据拓扑构建的系统性评估。
AI.method: 构建BioMedHop基准（10,045实例，涵盖共享邻居匹配、交集推理、路径推理和计数四种推理类型，支持选项、开放式和数值三种输出形式）；提出BioWeave框架，通过检索KG路径、从文献和网页收集线索、统一构建证据图、实体级证据支持验证答案。
AI.result: BioWeave在BioMedHop上整体平均性能最佳，比ToG-2高10.5%；能一致提升不同LLM骨干性能，使Qwen3-4B达到接近GPT-4-Turbo的水平。
AI.conclusion: 多源图基推理是生物医学QA的关键方向，BioWeave通过结构化证据拓扑构建与验证能有效提升推理能力，且对轻量模型友好。

title: Robust Transformer-Based One-Step Stock Index Forecasting via Shifted Data Augmentation
summary: Transformers have shown remarkable success in sequence modeling, yet their direct application to financial time series remains challenging due to noisy signals, short-memory dynamics, and distributional shifts. This paper proposes a modified Transformer architecture for one-step stock index forecasting, combined with advanced learning-rate scheduling and a novel Shifted Data Augmentation (SDA) technique. We evaluate the proposed framework on two benchmark stock index datasets, VN30 and S&P 500. Experimental results demonstrate that cosine annealing with warmup consistently improves forecasting accuracy over the generalized inverse-power scheduler. Furthermore, SDA substantially reduces forecasting errors and run-to-run variability while improving robustness to hyperparameter selection. The combination of cosine annealing scheduling and SDA achieved the best performance on both datasets, indicating that data augmentation can play a more important role than increasing model complexity in Transformer-based financial forecasting. These findings provide a practical and computationally efficient approach for robust stock index forecasting in noisy financial environments.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种改进的Transformer架构，结合余弦退火学习率调度和移位数据增强（SDA）技术，用于股票指数一步预测。在VN30和S&P 500两个基准数据集上的实验表明，余弦退火加预热优于传统逆幂调度器，SDA显著降低预测误差和运行间方差，且组合方法达到最佳性能，证明数据增强比增加模型复杂度更有效。
AI.motivation: Transformer在序列建模中表现优异，但直接应用于金融时间序列面临噪声信号、短记忆动态和分布偏移三大挑战。现有方法未能有效解决这些问题，需要一种鲁棒且计算高效的预测框架。
AI.method: 提出改进的Transformer架构，采用余弦退火加预热的学习率调度策略替代传统逆幂调度器，并创新性地引入移位数据增强（SDA）技术来扩充训练数据、提升模型泛化能力。
AI.result: 余弦退火调度持续优于逆幂调度器；SDA显著降低预测误差和运行间变异性，提高对超参数选择的鲁棒性；两者组合在两个数据集上均取得最佳性能。
AI.conclusion: 在基于Transformer的金融预测中，数据增强比增加模型复杂度扮演更重要的角色，所提方法为噪声金融环境下的稳健股票指数预测提供了实用且计算高效的方案。

title: State-Grounded Multi-Agent Synthetic Data Generation for Tool-Augmented LLMs
summary: Training tool-augmented LLM agents requires large corpora of multi-turn, tool-grounded conversational data that is expensive to annotate, privacy-constrained in production settings, and largely absent from public datasets. We present StateGen, a synthetic data generation platform that produces scored, reasoning-trace-rich training conversations by orchestrating a four-role LLM loop: a persona-conditioned user simulator, an agent under test, a state-grounded tool simulator, and a multi-axis LLM judge. The key architectural contribution is an authoritative state manager that maintains a structured world-state object across turns, enforcing a backend-is-truth invariant that eliminates the dominant class of tool-call hallucinations by construction. StateGen extends naturally to hierarchical multi-agent settings by declaring sub-agents as tools, all sharing a single state object. We report results on 64,698 evaluated conversations across three production corpora: tool-call hallucination scores reach 9.66/10, the system supports persona-driven variation via a 23-dimensional trait vector, and a cleanly separated train and golden evaluation set split confirms the data is not memorization bait (per-criterion gap analysis). Comparison with eight external systems shows that no single publicly available platform combines multi-turn generation, state-grounded tool simulation, hierarchical multi-agent support, and built-in judge scoring.

AI.tldr: StateGen是一个合成数据生成平台，通过四角色LLM循环（用户模拟器、待测代理、状态驱动工具模拟器、多轴LLM评估器）和权威状态管理器（强制后端即真理不变性）生成带评分和推理轨迹的多轮、工具驱动的训练对话，有效消除工具调用幻觉，支持分层多智能体设置，并在64,698条生产对话中达到9.66/10的幻觉评分。
AI.motivation: 训练工具增强型LLM代理需要大量多轮、工具驱动的对话数据，但此类数据人工标注成本高、生产环境受隐私限制且公开数据集稀缺，因此需要自动化合成数据生成方案。
AI.method: 提出四角色LLM循环（用户模拟器、待测代理、状态驱动工具模拟器、多轴LLM评估器），核心创新是权威状态管理器维护结构化世界状态对象，强制后端即真理不变性消除工具调用幻觉；并通过将子代理声明为工具实现分层多智能体扩展，所有子代理共享单一状态对象。
AI.result: 在64,698条评估对话上，工具调用幻觉评分达9.66/10；支持23维特征向量的角色驱动变体；训练集与黄金评估集分离确认数据非记忆诱饵（逐标准差距分析）；与8个外部系统对比，无单一公开平台同时具备多轮生成、状态驱动工具模拟、分层多智能体支持和内置评估器评分。
AI.conclusion: StateGen在合成训练数据生成方面显著优于现有公开平台，是首个同时整合多轮生成、状态驱动工具模拟、分层多智能体支持和内置评估器评分的综合解决方案。

title: PACT: Privileged Trace Co-Training for Multi-Turn Tool-Use Agents
summary: Multi-turn tool-use agents must reason, call tools, and adapt to observations across several interaction turns. Post-training such agents is challenging, as reinforcement learning often suffers from sparse rewards and weak credit assignment despite matching the prompt-only inference setting, while supervised fine-tuning on expert traces provides dense process supervision but can over-constrain the model to fixed trajectories. To tackle this, we propose PACT, a Privileged trAce Co-Training framework for multi-turn tool-use agents. The key idea is to use expert traces only as training-time optimization signals rather than rollout-time hints. PACT keeps rollout generation prompt-only, then uses expert traces to guide optimization through two complementary signals: a trace-conditioned RL surrogate that evaluates prompt-only rollouts under expert-trace context, and a component-aware SFT loss that supervises reasoning prefixes and tool-calls with annealed strength. To reduce over-reliance on the training-only trace context, PACT further introduces a prompt-only anchoring. We also provide a latent-trace view that connects the two trace-based objectives and explains how expert traces can guide optimization without being used during rollout generation. Experiments on FTRL, BFCL, and ToolHop show that PACT consistently improves over strong SFT- and RL-based baselines, highlighting the value of privileged trace co-training for multi-turn tool-use learning.

AI.tldr: PACT提出了一种特权轨迹协同训练框架，通过将专家轨迹仅作为训练时优化信号（而非推理时提示），结合轨迹条件RL代理损失和组件感知SFT损失，并引入纯提示锚定，有效提升了多轮工具使用智能体的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有方法存在两难：强化学习遭遇稀疏奖励和信用分配问题，而监督微调虽然提供密集过程监督但会过度约束模型到固定轨迹。需要一种既能利用专家轨迹提供的密集监督信号，又不会在推理时限制模型灵活性的方法。
AI.method: 提出PACT框架：(1) 推理时仅使用纯提示生成轨迹；(2) 训练时利用专家轨迹提供两种互补优化信号——轨迹条件RL代理损失（在专家轨迹上下文中评估纯提示 rollout）和组件感知SFT损失（对推理前缀和工具调用进行退火强度的监督）；(3) 引入纯提示锚定减少对训练时轨迹上下文的过度依赖；(4) 提供潜在轨迹视图连接两种基于轨迹的目标。
AI.result: 在FTRL、BFCL和ToolHop三个基准上，PACT一致性地优于强SFT和RL基线，证明了特权轨迹协同训练对多轮工具使用学习的价值。
AI.conclusion: PACT通过将专家轨迹作为训练时特权信号而非推理时提示，有效结合了密集监督和推理灵活性的优势，为多轮工具使用智能体的后训练提供了新范式。

title: How to Score Experts for One-Shot MoE Expert Pruning: A Unified Formulation and Selection Principle
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) language models reduce per-token computation through sparse expert activation, yet deployment still requires storing the full expert pool, making one-shot expert pruning a practical approach for reducing memory usage. Although effective, existing criteria are largely heuristic, and no single criterion is universally optimal. Thus, establishing a principle for selecting pruning criteria suited to different deployment objectives remains an important yet largely underexplored problem in one-shot expert pruning. To this end, we introduce a unified formulation for one-shot MoE expert pruning organized around three factors: routing frequency, gate weighting, and activation strength. The formulation yields a criteria selection principle: task-agnostic pruning should favor routed-token-averaged, gate-free activation-based criteria, whereas task-specific pruning can benefit from retaining routing-frequency and gate-weight information. Beyond this principle, the formulation also provides a systematic view of existing heuristic criteria and gives rise to two new task-agnostic criteria, Mean Activation Norm (MAN) and Mean Squared Activation Norm (MSAN). Across four representative MoE models and 16 diverse benchmarks, MAN and MSAN are consistently strong in the task-agnostic setting, obtain the top-two average ranks, and improve average performance by up to 8.8 points over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的MoE专家剪枝公式，揭示了任务无关剪枝应基于激活强度（如MAN/MSAN），而任务特定剪枝可结合路由频率和门控权重。实验表明MAN和MSAN在16个基准上取得最佳平均性能，最高提升8.8个点。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE专家剪枝标准多为启发式，缺乏统一原则，且没有单一标准在所有场景下最优。因此需要建立一个准则选择原则，以适配不同的部署目标（任务无关 vs 任务特定）。
AI.method: 提出一个围绕三个因素（路由频率、门控权重、激活强度）的统一公式，由此推导出准则选择原则，并衍生出两种新准则：平均激活范数（MAN）和均方激活范数（MSAN）。
AI.result: 在4个代表性MoE模型和16个多样化基准上，MAN和MSAN在任务无关剪枝中始终表现强劲，获得前两名的平均排名，相比最强基线平均性能提升最高达8.8个点。
AI.conclusion: 该统一公式不仅为现有启发式准则提供了系统性视角，也为不同部署目标下的剪枝准则选择提供了理论指导，MAN和MSAN作为新准则在任务无关场景下效果显著。

title: Architectural Wisdom: A Framework for Governing Optimization in AI Systems
summary: Modern AI systems exhibit structural failures that capability scaling alone does not reliably fix: they optimize under-specified objectives with no architectural mechanism to question whether the objective should be optimized at all. Engagement maximization can amplify harmful pathways; tool-using agents can commit irreversible actions; preference-trained language models can become sycophantic. We argue that this failure is a wisdom problem, not an intelligence problem. We use "wisdom" in a deliberately architectural sense, not as a claim about virtue, consciousness, or moral omniscience. Intelligence accepts a goal and optimizes within it; wisdom interrogates whether the goal should be optimized at all. The two are separable architectural properties. We propose architectural wisdom as a corrigible objective-governance layer above the optimization substrate. The layer makes three structural commitments explicit and nondegenerate before any action: temporal horizon, relational boundary, and irreversibility. It is realized by four components (Structural Utility Transform, Moral Admissibility Interface, Arbitration and Escalation Controller, Value Revision Channel) that compute a six-coordinate wisdom tuple over horizon, relational coverage, irreversibility, admissibility, value revision, and auditability. We motivate the architecture by eight cases drawn from contemporary AI failures, secular wisdom traditions, and hard ethical situations, and defend the distinction against the intelligence-completeness thesis using goal-questioning over goal-taking, Bostrom's orthogonality, structural separation in our exemplar cases, and persistent failure modes despite capability scaling. The framework is the conceptual contract for a larger architecture whose formal specifications and empirical validation are developed in subsequent work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AI系统存在"智慧问题"而非"智能问题"，并设计了一个可修正的目标治理架构，在优化层之上显式计算时间跨度、关系边界和不可逆性等六个维度的智慧元组，以解决AI盲目优化未充分定义目标的结构性失败。
AI.motivation: 现有AI系统在能力扩展后仍无法可靠解决结构性失败——如优化未充分定义的目标（推荐系统放大有害路径）、工具型智能体可能造成不可逆后果、偏好训练的语言模型产生谄媚行为。这表明问题不在于智能（优化给定目标的能力），而在于智慧（质疑目标是否应该被优化的能力）。
AI.method: 提出"架构智慧"（architectural wisdom）作为位于优化层之上的可修正目标治理层，包含三个结构化承诺（时间跨度、关系边界、不可逆性）和四个组件（结构效用变换、道德可接受性接口、仲裁与升级控制器、价值修正通道），计算六坐标智慧元组（时间跨度、关系覆盖、不可逆性、可接受性、价值修正、可审计性）。
AI.result: 通过8个案例分析（包括当代AI失败案例、世俗智慧传统和硬伦理困境）以及针对"智能完备性论题"的四个反驳（目标质疑vs目标接受、Bostrom正交性、案例中的结构分离、能力扩展下持续存在的失败模式）来验证框架的合理性。
AI.conclusion: 该框架是更大架构的概念性契约，其形式化规范和实证验证将在后续工作中展开。核心贡献是将智慧与智能作为可分离的架构特性，并提供了一个具体可操作的目标治理架构设计。

title: Creative Collision: Directorial Persona Steering and Competition in Large Language Models
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 Workshop on Human-AI Co-Creativity
summary: Activation steering has emerged as a powerful tool for shaping the behaviour of large language models at inference time, yet most prior work injects a \emph{single} semantic direction into the residual stream. We study the richer setting in which two semantically opposing steering vectors are superimposed -- a regime we call \textbf{Creative Collision}. Concretely, we construct directorial persona vectors for Steven Spielberg (optimistic, redemptive moral valence) and Martin Scorsese (dark, morally ambiguous) via mean-difference activation contrast on curated screenplay-derived corpora, then interpolate between them with a scalar mixing parameter $α\in [0,1]$ and a steering coefficient $λ$. Across five evaluation axes -- moral valence, generation coherence, surface style, directional dominance, and vector geometry -- three principal findings emerge: (i)~Spielberg's representational signature exhibits robust \emph{directional dominance}, suppressing Scorsese's moral influence across almost the entire interpolation range; (ii)~intermediate collision points paradoxically \emph{improve} generation coherence relative to pure single-director steering at high $λ$; and (iii)~both personas localise maximally to layer~28 of a 40-layer decoder-only transformer, revealing a shared \emph{moral-tone substrate}. These results illuminate the geometry of competing semantic directions in transformer residual streams and have direct implications for controllable creative generation and value-aligned narrative synthesis.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在大型语言模型残差流中叠加两个语义相反的导演风格向量（斯皮尔伯格乐观/救赎 vs. 斯科塞斯黑暗/道德模糊）的"创造性碰撞"现象。通过标量混合参数α和引导系数λ插值，发现：(i)斯皮尔伯格表征具有方向主导性，几乎在整个插值范围内压制斯科塞斯的道德影响；(ii)中间碰撞点反而在高λ下提高了生成连贯性；(iii)两种风格向量都最大程度地定位在第28层，揭示了共享的"道德基调基底"。
AI.motivation: 现有激活引导方法多注入单一语义方向，尚未充分研究多个竞争性方向向量叠加时的几何交互特性及其对可控生成的影响。作者试图探索语义对立方向在残差流中竞争时的动力学行为。
AI.method: 通过均值差异激活对比在剧本衍生语料上构建斯皮尔伯格和斯科塞斯的导演人格向量，使用标量混合参数α∈[0,1]和引导系数λ进行插值，在五个评估轴线上系统分析（道德效价、生成连贯性、表面风格、方向主导性、向量几何）。
AI.result: (i)斯皮尔伯格表征具有稳健的方向主导性，几乎在所有插值区间压制斯科塞斯；(ii)中间碰撞点（α约0.5）在高λ时意外提升生成连贯性；(iii)两类人格向量均在第28层达到最大激活，共享一个道德基调的神经基底。
AI.conclusion: 揭示了transformer残差流中竞争语义方向的几何特性，为可控创意生成和价值观对齐的叙事合成提供了直接启示。

title: InstantForget: Update-Free Backdoor Unlearning with Inference-Time Feature Reset
summary: Backdoor unlearning aims to remove a malicious trigger behavior from a deployed model while preserving clean utility. We study the update-free inference-time setting, where model parameters remain frozen. First, we audit a common projection assumption under oracle paired clean and triggered features. Projection succeeds mainly on BadNets and leaves WaNet, Blended, and SIG at 0.683, 0.888, and 0.941 ASR on CIFAR-10 ResNet-18. This failure is not explained by spectral compactness, spatial locality, or subspace misalignment. It is predicted by a logit-triplet gap involving the target margin, target-logit drop, and non-target logit rise. We then introduce InstantForget, a clean-calibrated gated reset that flags anomalous features with a Mahalanobis score and moves only flagged features toward a neutral non-target representation. With one fixed operating point selected on held-out triggered validation, InstantForget reduces average ASR to 0.071 across four non-adaptive CIFAR-10 triggers without triggered samples or parameter updates at deployment. It also reaches 0.981 detection AUROC and transfers to six of eight tested backbones. Reported failures under WaNet, ModelNet10 point blend, two backbone geometries, and adaptive feature-compactness attacks define the method's scope.

AI.tldr: 本文提出InstantForget，一种无需参数更新的推理时后门遗忘方法，通过clean-calibrated gated reset机制基于马氏距离标记异常特征并将其移向中性非目标表征，在无触发样本和参数更新的情况下将CIFAR-10上四种非自适应后门的平均ASR降至0.071，AUROC达0.981，并迁移至六种骨干网络。
AI.motivation: 现有后门遗忘方法多需参数更新，在实际部署中不适用；且常见投影假设（即干净与触发特征共线）在WaNet、Blended、SIG等后门上失效，亟需一种无需更新、无需触发样本的推理时遗忘方法。
AI.method: InstantForget包含两步：(1) 利用马氏距离计算特征异常分数，标记可能被后门触发的特征；(2) 通过clean-calibrated gated reset机制，仅将标记特征向一个中性非目标表征方向移动，其余特征保持不变。该方法无需触发样本，无需模型参数更新。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10 ResNet-18上，InstantForget将四种非自适应后门（BadNets、WaNet、Blended、SIG）的平均ASR降至0.071，检测AUROC达0.981，且迁移至六种骨干网络。但在WaNet、ModelNet10点混合、两种骨干几何结构及自适应特征紧凑性攻击下存在失败案例。
AI.conclusion: InstantForget证明了在无需参数更新、无需触发样本的推理时设定下实现有效后门遗忘的可行性，但该方法在复杂几何变换后门和自适应攻击下仍有局限性，需进一步改进。

title: AdaSTORM: Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) demonstrate remarkable potential in dynamic graph reasoning, but suffer from a scaling bottleneck: current models can only handle graphs with tens of nodes, constrained by exponential reasoning overhead and finite context windows. While multi-agent systems (MAS) offer collective reasoning and topology-aware orchestration, capabilities naturally suited for graph-structured tasks, their application to dynamic graphs remains unexplored. This paper presents Scaling LLM Reasoning on Dynamic Graphs via Adaptive Spatio-Temporal Multi-Agent Collaboration (AdaSTORM), a framework that reformulates large-scale dynamic graph reasoning into two stages: (i) Adaptive Partitioning, partitioning large-scale dynamic graphs into subregions that match the model's reasoning capacity while minimizing inference cost; and (ii) Collaborative Reasoning, aligning graph partition topologies with a spatio-temporal decoupled multi-agent architecture. AdaSTORM is the first multi-agent framework tailored for dynamic graph reasoning. Extensive experiments show that AdaSTORM successfully breaks through the scaling bottleneck, scaling reasoning to thousand-node graphs with over 90% accuracy across several large-scale dynamic graph settings without external tools, significantly outperforms seven competitive baselines. Furthermore, it achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on existing benchmarks and generalizes robustly to real-world datasets. The source code is available at: https://github.com/irisorchid107/AdaSTORM/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AdaSTORM，一种自适应时空多智能体协作框架，将大规模动态图推理分解为自适应分区和协作推理两个阶段，成功将推理能力扩展到千节点规模图，准确率超过90%，显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM在动态图推理中存在缩放瓶颈，受限于指数级推理开销和有限上下文窗口，只能处理数十个节点的图，而多智能体系统虽具有集体推理和拓扑感知能力，但尚未应用于动态图任务。
AI.method: AdaSTORM采用两阶段方法：(i)自适应分区——将大规模动态图划分为与模型推理能力匹配的子区域，同时最小化推理成本；(ii)协作推理——将图分区拓扑与时空解耦的多智能体架构对齐，实现协同推理。
AI.result: 在多个大规模动态图设置中，AdaSTORM成功将推理扩展到千节点规模，准确率超过90%，显著优于七个竞争基线，并在现有基准上达到最先进水平，对真实世界数据集具有鲁棒泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AdaSTORM是首个专为动态图推理设计的多智能体框架，有效突破了LLM在动态图推理中的缩放瓶颈。

title: Who Should Lead Decoding Now? Tracking Reliable Trajectories for Ensembling Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked Diffusion Language Models (MDLMs) have emerged as a distinct paradigm for sequence generation. As MDLMs become diverse in capabilities and knowledge coverage, an important question is how to combine their knowledge. Toward this, we first investigate the unique decoding dynamics of MDLMs. We find that successful generations exhibit stable confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions, while unreliable trajectories can often be corrected by injecting promising intermediate states from other models. Guided by this observation, we propose $\textbf{TIE}$ ($\textbf{T}$rajectory-based $\textbf{I}$terative $\textbf{E}$nsembling), a knowledge fusion framework in which MDLMs iteratively identify reliable decoding trajectories and relay them across models. TIE tracks confidence dynamics over answer-relevant positions to determine which model currently follows a more reliable trajectory and selectively transfers partially denoised sequences across models. As the model on the more promising trajectory often changes across denoising steps, TIE allows different models to contribute complementary strengths at different stages of generation. Strong performance across diverse reasoning tasks, along with our analyses, suggests that TIE offers a practical approach to the underexplored problem of MDLM ensembling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TIE框架，通过轨迹迭代集成多个掩码扩散语言模型，利用置信度动态识别可靠解码轨迹并在不同模型间传递，实现知识融合。
AI.motivation: MDLM在能力和知识覆盖上日益多样化，但如何有效融合多个MDLM的知识仍是一个未被充分探索的问题。
AI.method: 提出TIE（Trajectory-based Iterative Ensembling）框架，跟踪答案相关位置上的置信度动态，判断哪个模型当前遵循更可靠的解码轨迹，并在不同模型间选择性地传输部分去噪序列。
AI.result: 在多种推理任务上取得了强性能，验证了TIE框架的有效性。
AI.conclusion: TIE提供了一种实用的MDLM集成方法，允许不同模型在生成的不同阶段贡献互补优势。

title: Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multimodal Learning
summary:
This paper addresses the missing-modality challenge in multi-modal learning by introducing Unsupervised Learning for Missing Modalities in Multi-Modal Learning (UL4M4), a flexible framework that imputes missing feature embeddings in a task-independent manner before supervised prediction. We propose modality-specific
  normalization and a novel partial-modality distance metric to enable fair clustering of incomplete observations, capturing cross-modal structures while preserving scale-invariance across varying dimensionalities and modality counts. Cluster centers from this unsupervised stage guide an iterative greedy imputation process for any
  missing modalities during training or inference, supporting arbitrary numbers of modalities and arbitrary missing patterns per sample. The imputation module is lightweight, uses frozen encoders, and decouples from the downstream task, allowing easy integration with any fusion/prediction architecture. Extensive experiments under diverse and highly incomplete regimes demonstrate UL4M4's robustness, achieving, to
  the best of our knowledge, the first consistent F1-Micro scores above 0.7 on challenging missing configurations even when more than 50\% of modality slots are missing. Results are also stable across cluster sizes and significantly outperform state-of-the-art baselines. Code is available here: https://github.com/h-ismkhan/Multimodal-Learning-with-Missing-Modalities-via-Unsupervised-Learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出UL4M4框架，通过无监督聚类引导的贪心插补方法解决多模态学习中任意缺失模态的问题，在超过50%模态缺失时仍能取得F1-Micro>0.7的鲁棒性能。
AI.motivation: 多模态学习常面临模态缺失挑战，现有方法对缺失模式依赖性强，缺乏统一处理任意数量模态和任意缺失模式的通用框架。
AI.method: 提出UL4M4框架：1) 使用模态特定归一化和部分模态距离度量实现不完整样本的公平聚类；2) 聚类中心引导迭代贪心插补缺失模态嵌入；3) 采用冻结编码器，插补模块轻量化且与下游任务解耦。
AI.result: 在多种高缺失率设置下，UL4M4在超过50%模态缺失时首次实现F1-Micro>0.7，显著优于现有基线方法，且对聚类大小稳定。
AI.conclusion: UL4M4是一种灵活、鲁棒且与任务无关的多模态缺失处理框架，可轻松集成到任意融合/预测架构中。

title: Exploiting Search in Symbolic Numeric Planning with Patterns
comment: Under Review at the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research
summary: In this paper, we present a procedure for numeric planning based on Symbolic Pattern Planning (SPP). Given a numeric planning problem $Π$, a pattern $\prec$ is a sequence of actions used to define a formula encoding the subsequences of $\prec$ executable from a starting state $S$. Cardellini, Giunchiglia, and Maratea (2024a) follow the Planning as Satisfiability approach by defining, at each step $n \ge 0$, a formula $Π^\prec_n$ in which $(i)$ the pattern $\prec$ is computed only for $n=0$ in the initial state $I$ of $Π$, and then exploited at each step $n$, $(ii)$ the starting state $S$ is set to $I$, and $(iii)$ the set $G$ of goals is required to hold in the last state that can be reached by one of the subsequences of $\prec$ concatenated $n$ times. The procedure begins with $n=0$, terminates as soon as $Π^\prec_n$ is satisfiable, and otherwise proceeds by incrementing $n$. In this paper, possibly at each step, $(i)$ we symbolically search for an intermediate state $P$ reachable from $I$, closer to a goal state, $(ii)$ dynamically recompute the pattern $\prec_h$ -- to be used in the next step -- in $P$, $(iii)$ refine the pattern $\prec_g$ used to reach $P$, and $(iv)$ start the new search from the state $S$ which can be either the initial state $I$ or the last computed intermediate state $P$, exploiting the computed patterns $\prec_g$ and $\prec_h$ to define the pattern $\prec$ to be used in the search. In particular, at each step, we define a formula $Π^{\prec}_{S,P}$ encoding the existence of a state $P'$ closer than $P$ to a goal state, with $P'$ reachable from the starting state $S$ when using the pattern $\prec$. We present different techniques for producing such formulas, each corresponding to a different strategy for exploring the search space. We prove their correctness and completeness, the latter under certain conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于符号模式规划（SPP）的数值规划改进方法，通过动态重计算模式、中间状态搜索和模式精化，在每一步符号化地寻找更接近目标状态的中间状态，并证明其正确性和在一定条件下的完备性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模式的数值规划方法（Cardellini et al., 2024a）仅在初始状态计算一次模式，后续步骤中固定使用该模式，缺乏对中间状态的动态调整能力，导致搜索效率受限。本文旨在通过动态重计算和模式精化来提升规划性能。
AI.method: 在每一步中：(i) 符号化搜索从初始状态可达且更接近目标状态的中间状态P；(ii) 动态重计算模式<sub>h</sub>用于下一步；(iii) 精化用于到达P的模式<sub>g</sub>；(iv) 从初始状态I或最新中间状态P开始新搜索，利用<sub>g</sub>和<sub>h</sub>定义新模式<sub>r</sub>。定义公式Π<sup><sub>r</sub></sup><sub>S,P</sub>编码存在比P更接近目标的状态P'，提出多种对应不同搜索策略的公式化技术。
AI.result: 提出了多种基于不同搜索策略的公式化技术，证明了算法的正确性，并在一定条件下证明了完备性。
AI.conclusion: 动态模式重计算和中间状态引导能有效提升数值规划中符号模式规划方法的搜索效率，正确性和条件完备性保证了方法的可靠性。

title: HiMPO: Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization for Less-Entangled Credit in Long-Horizon Agents
summary: Long-horizon agents rely on memory mechanisms to compress interaction history, but optimizing memory writing faces a distinct credit assignment challenge: a memory update may be rewarded or penalized due to downstream tool failures, noisy observations, or reasoning errors rather than its own contribution. This causally entangled credit can lead agents to discard useful evidence or preserve irrelevant information. We propose HiMPO, a Hindsight-Informed Memory Policy Optimization framework for assigning less-entangled credit to memory-writing actions in long-horizon agents. HiMPO first estimates the local utility of a memory update by comparing the task-relevant information recoverable from the previous and updated memories under the same pre-write state. It then uses hindsight relevance as a bounded retrospective filter that attenuates memory credit when local utility is not supported by the target outcome. The resulting memory-specific advantage is applied only to memory tokens, while trajectory-level rewards optimize the rest of the agent behavior. Across judge-based open-domain tasks and objective compressive-memory QA, HiMPO improves over strong memory-based and RL-based baselines while preserving compressed-context efficiency. Controlled interventions further show that HiMPO reduces blame leakage from tool-induced errors and improves attribution fidelity of memory updates.

AI.tldr: HiMPO提出了一种事后知情记忆策略优化框架，通过估计局部效用和事后相关性过滤，为长程智能体的记忆写入动作分配更少纠缠的信用，从而改进记忆更新效率。
AI.motivation: 长程智能体依赖记忆机制压缩交互历史，但记忆写入面临信用分配难题：记忆更新可能因下游工具故障、噪声观测或推理错误而受到奖励或惩罚，与其自身贡献无关。这种因果纠缠的信用会导致智能体丢弃有用证据或保留无关信息。
AI.method: HiMPO首先通过比较同一写前状态下从之前和更新后的记忆中可恢复的任务相关信息来估计记忆更新的局部效用；然后使用事后相关性作为有界回顾过滤器，当局部效用不受目标结果支持时衰减记忆信用；得到的记忆特定优势仅应用于记忆token，而轨迹级奖励优化智能体其余行为。
AI.result: 在基于评判的开放域任务和客观压缩记忆问答中，HiMPO超越了强大的基于记忆和基于RL的基线，同时保持了压缩上下文效率。受控干预进一步表明HiMPO减少了工具诱导错误的归因泄漏，并提高了记忆更新的归因保真度。
AI.conclusion: HiMPO通过解耦记忆信用与全局奖励的纠缠，有效改善了长程智能体在复杂环境中的记忆写入策略，为处理信用分配问题提供了新思路。

title: From Correlation to Causation in Lane Change Prediction for Automated Driving: A Causal Explanation Framework
summary: Lane-change prediction is a central task in intelligent vehicles, where early maneuver anticipation can support safer decision-making. However, many existing approaches mainly learn statistical associations between observed driving variables and future maneuvers, while overlooking the causal dependencies among the input variables themselves. This limits interpretability, especially when physically related variables such as longitudinal gap, relative longitudinal velocity, and Time-To-Collision (TTC) are treated as independent flat inputs. This article presents a causal-inference-based framework for lane-change prediction and explanation. The proposed approach combines linguistic feature construction, expert-constrained causal discovery, deep structural causal modeling with Deep End-to-end Causal Inference (DECI), intervention-based effect analysis, refutation testing, and recursive causal-chain explanation. The objective is not only to predict the future maneuver, but also to identify candidate variables that directly contribute to the prediction, the upstream factors influencing them, and the causal chains through which these effects propagate. The framework achieves average F1-scores above 95% during the first three seconds before the lane-marking crossing event. Beyond prediction accuracy, the framework uses intervention-based effect analysis to distinguish influential from weakly influential variables under the learned causal structure. It further distinguishes candidate direct contributors from mediated effects and generates contrastive causal-chain explanations that clarify why the predicted maneuver is favored and why the alternative maneuvers are less supported. The main contribution is therefore a mechanism-aware lane-change prediction pipeline that moves beyond correlation-based classification toward more interpretable causal reasoning for maneuver prediction.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于因果推断的车道变换预测框架，结合语言特征构建、专家约束因果发现、深度结构因果建模（DECI）、干预效应分析、反驳测试和递归因果链解释，不仅实现了前三秒内平均F1分数超过95%的高精度预测，还能识别直接贡献变量、上游影响因素及其因果传播链，生成对比性因果链解释，从相关性分类迈向可解释的因果推理。
AI.motivation: 现有车道变换预测方法主要学习观测驾驶变量与未来 maneuvers 之间的统计关联，忽略了输入变量间本身的因果依赖关系，导致可解释性受限，尤其是当纵向间隙、相对纵向速度、碰撞时间(TTC)等物理相关变量被当作独立平坦输入处理时。
AI.method: 提出因果推断框架，综合运用语言特征构建、专家约束的因果发现、基于DECI的深度结构因果建模、干预效应分析、反驳测试以及递归因果链解释等方法。
AI.result: 在车道标记穿越事件前的前三秒内，平均F1分数超过95%；通过干预效应分析区分了有影响力与弱影响力的变量，并区分了直接贡献者与中介效应。
AI.conclusion: 主要贡献在于构建了一个机制感知的车道变换预测流水线，从基于相关性的分类迈向更可解释的因果推理，实现了对预测 maneuver 为何被支持以及替代 maneuver 为何不被支持的对比性因果链解释。

title: Phase-Aware Guidance Injection for Recurrent MAPPO in Assembly-Line Disruption Recovery
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, accepted by the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Automation Science and Engineering (CASE 2026)
summary: Disruption recovery in industrial assembly lines requires timely decisions under machine faults, worker absence, and emergency orders. Existing methods either rely on rigid handcrafted recovery logic or learn adaptive policies that do not readily exploit heterogeneous external recovery knowledge at decision time to reduce abnormal recovery time (ART) and preserve on-time delivery (OTD). To address this gap, we propose a phase-aware guidance injection framework that augments a trained recurrent MAPPO (RMAPPO) scheduling policy through logit-level action bias during evaluation. The framework provides a unified decision-time interface for rule-based, replay-based, and online LLM-based guidance, while activating intervention only during abnormal and recovery phases. Experiments on a custom AssemblyLineEnv show that high-quality rule guidance yields the strongest gains, replay-based guidance degrades smoothly under imperfect availability, and online LLM guidance still provides useful intermediate improvements. These results show that decision-time guidance injection can exploit heterogeneous recovery hints without redesigning the actor.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种相位感知引导注入框架，通过在评估阶段对训练好的RMAPPO调度策略进行logit级动作偏置，实现规则、回放和在线LLM等异构外部恢复知识的统一决策时利用，在不重新设计智能体的情况下减少异常恢复时间并保持准时交付。
AI.motivation: 现有工业装配线中断恢复方法要么依赖僵化的手工恢复逻辑，要么学习自适应策略但无法在决策时充分利用异构的外部恢复知识来减少异常恢复时间并保持准时交付。
AI.method: 提出相位感知引导注入框架，在已训练的RMAPPO调度策略的评估阶段，通过logit级动作偏置注入外部引导信息；该框架提供统一的决策时接口支持基于规则、基于回放和基于在线LLM的引导，且仅在异常和恢复阶段激活干预。
AI.result: 在自定义AssemblyLineEnv上，高质量规则引导效果最强；回放引导在不完美可用性下性能平滑下降；在线LLM引导提供了有用的中间改进。
AI.conclusion: 决策时引导注入可以在不重新设计智能体的前提下有效利用异构恢复知识来改善装配线中断恢复性能。

title: PaperJury: Due-Process Review for Bounded LaTeX Revision
summary: Pre-submission hardening of human-authored LaTeX computer science papers differs from drafting assistance because it requires adversarial whole-paper review, explicit no-fix outcomes, and bounded artifact-safe revision. Existing writing assistants, critique generators, and judge-centered loops lack durable issue identity across rounds, deterministic routing from critique to adjudication, and manuscript control that can reject invalid concerns or defer author-dependent ones. We present PaperJury, a closed-loop review-verdict-revise-verify system built on a deterministic-versus-semantic split: deterministic orchestration manages decomposition, a frozen claim spine, a durable ledger, routing, stopping, and exact-once patch application, while semantic agents are limited to bounded review, judgment, and repair. PaperJury combines bounded holistic review, contestability-based routing, a due-process trial, and risk-proportional guard chains for anchor-bounded edits, yielding terminal outcomes of invalid-drop, valid-fixable, and author-required. In a two-arm expert-review evaluation on held-out Vision, natural language processing, and machine learning papers against four baselines, we assess issue quality, verdict and routing quality, edit safety, convergence behavior, and cost, supporting the thesis that load-bearing safety and completion logic should reside in deterministic orchestration rather than model discretion. PaperJury is available at https://github.com/u7079256/paperjury.

AI.tldr: PaperJury 提出了一种基于确定性编排与语义能力分离的闭环论文审阅系统，通过"审阅-裁决-修改-验证"流程实现对论文提交前硬化的可问责处理，在多个 NLP/CV/ML 论文上优于现有写作助手和批评生成器。
AI.motivation: 现有写作助手、批评生成器和以裁判为中心的循环缺乏跨回合的持久问题标识、从批评到裁决的确定性路由，以及能够拒绝无效关切或推迟依赖作者问题的稿件控制能力。论文提交前的硬化需要对抗性的全篇审阅、明确的"不修复"结果和有限的安全编辑。
AI.method: PaperJury 采用确定性编排与语义能力的分离架构：确定性层负责分解、冻结声明主干、持久账本、路由、停止和精确一次补丁应用；语义代理（LLM）仅负责受限的审阅、判断和修复。系统包括有限整体审阅、基于可争议性的路由、正当程序审判（检察官、辩护人、法官）和风险比例的保护链。
AI.result: 在 Vision、NLP 和 ML 论文上进行的双组专家评估中，针对四个基线系统，评估了问题质量、裁决和路由质量、编辑安全性、收敛行为和成本。结果支持"负载安全性和完成逻辑应驻留在确定性编排中而非模型自由裁量"的论点。
AI.conclusion: 负荷安全性和完成逻辑应置于确定性编排而非模型自由裁量中，PaperJury 在问题质量、裁决路由、编辑安全性和收敛行为方面优于现有方法。

title: The Data Manifold under the Microscope
summary:
A significant gap exists between theory and practice in deep learning. Generalization and approximation error bounds are often derived for simplified models or are too loose to be informative. Many rely on the manifold hypothesis and on geometric regularity such as intrinsic dimension, curvature, and reach. Progress requires insight into data-manifold geometry and suitable benchmarks, yet existing options are polarized: analytic manifolds with known geometry but limited applicability, or real-world datasets where geometry is only coarsely estimable. We introduce a benchmarking framework for studying data geometry. We repurpose and extend dSprites and COIL-20 with additional transformation dimensions and dense, axis-aligned sampling, and pair them with finite-difference estimators that recover curvature, reach, and volume at near-ground-truth accuracy in a regime where general-purpose estimators are unreliable or difficult to deploy. The framework is intended as a controlled testbed, useful as a calibration environment for geometric estimators and a sandbox for probing theoretical assumptions. To illustrate its use, we present two application studies, namely assessing the scaling behavior of the bounds of Genovese et al. and Fefferman et al., and tracking the layer-wise geometry of a $β$-VAE, highlighting the behavior of current bounds and the value of controlled benchmarks for guiding and validating future theory.
  A reference implementation is available at https://github.com/koulakis/manifold-microscope.

AI.tldr: 针对深度学习理论与实践的差距，本文引入了一个数据几何基准测试框架，通过扩展dSprites和COIL-20数据集并配以有限差分估计器，实现对流形曲率、可达性和体积的近似真实值估计，作为几何估计器的校准环境和理论假设的测试平台。
AI.motivation: 深度学习理论与实践中存在显著差距，现有的泛化与近似误差边界要么针对简化模型推导，要么过于松散而缺乏信息性；同时现有数据几何研究选项两极分化——要么是已知几何的理论流形（适用性有限），要么是几何信息只能粗略估计的现实数据集。需要能够同时支持几何估计器校准和理论假设验证的受控测试环境。
AI.method: 1) 扩展dSprites和COIL-20数据集，增加变换维度和密集轴对齐采样；2) 配备有限差分估计器，在通用估计器不可靠或难以部署的场景下恢复曲率、可达性和体积等几何量；3) 作为受控测试平台，应用于两个案例：评估Genovese等人和Fefferman等人的边界缩放行为，以及追踪β-VAE的逐层几何变化。
AI.result: 有限差分估计器能够在近真实值精度下恢复曲率、可达性和体积；通过两个应用案例展示了框架的有效性，揭示了现有理论边界的缩放行为以及β-VAE各层的几何演变。
AI.conclusion: 该框架可作为几何估计器的校准环境和理论假设的测试平台，有助于指导和完善未来的理论研究，弥合深度学习理论与实践之间的差距。

title: Medical Heuristic Learning: An LLM-Driven Framework for Interpretable and Auditable Clinical Decision Rules
summary: Predictive modeling for clinical tabular data is central to clinical decision support and therefore requires not only strong predictive performance but also transparent decision logic. Although deep learning and tree-based ensemble methods can achieve high accuracy, their black-box nature remains a major obstacle to clinical deployment. This challenge is further compounded by common characteristics of medical data, including limited sample sizes, severe class imbalance, and feature evolution arising from changes in diagnostic criteria and clinical documentation. To address these issues, we propose Medical Heuristic Learning (MHL), an instantiation of the learning-beyond-gradients paradigm for clinical tabular prediction. Instead of relying on neural network weight updates, MHL uses a large language model (LLM)-driven workflow that integrates statistical probes, medical knowledge probes, rule synthesis, and code-level iterative refinement to optimize a deterministic and executable decision system. The resulting model is expressed not as opaque parameters, but as versioned pure-Python decision rules that are explicitly interpretable, fully auditable, and clinically grounded. MHL also supports continual learning by starting from previously validated rules and iteratively revising them using updated feature information under data drift or feature evolution. Comprehensive experiments on medical datasets show that MHL achieves performance comparable to state-of-the-art methods while maintaining strong behavior in small-sample and highly imbalanced settings. The results further indicate that this explicit rule update mechanism can help alleviate catastrophic forgetting under feature evolution. Overall, these findings suggest that non-gradient-based heuristic systems offer a transparent and adaptable alternative for high-stakes clinical decision support.

AI.tldr: 本文提出医学启发学习（MHL），一种不依赖梯度更新的非神经网络方法，利用LLM驱动的工作流（统计探测、医学知识探测、规则合成与代码级迭代优化）为临床表格数据生成可解释的、版本化的Python决策规则，在性能媲美SOTA的同时支持小样本、高度不平衡及特征演化场景下的持续学习。
AI.motivation: 临床表格数据预测需要高精度与透明决策逻辑，但深度学习和树集成方法本质上是黑箱，且医疗数据存在样本量小、类别严重不平衡、诊断标准变化导致特征演化等挑战，这些共同阻碍了模型在临床中的部署。
AI.method: 提出Medical Heuristic Learning (MHL)，属于learning-beyond-gradients范式。不依赖神经网络权重更新，而是构建LLM驱动的工作流，包含统计探测、医学知识探测、规则合成和代码级迭代优化四个步骤，最终输出版本化的纯Python决策规则系统，支持基于已验证规则的持续学习。
AI.result: 在医学数据集上的综合实验表明，MHL在性能上与SOTA方法相当，在小样本和高度不平衡设定下表现稳健，且在特征演化场景下能有效缓解灾难性遗忘。
AI.conclusion: 非梯度基的启发式系统为高风险的临床决策支持提供了一种透明且可适应的替代方案。

title: TMASC: Transmasculine Attitude and Speech Corpus
summary: We introduce the Transmasculine Attitudes and Speech Corpus (TMASC), a multimodal corpus of 196 transmasculine individuals, including questionnaire responses and 66 audio recordings. The questionnaire includes items exploring the vocal health of transmasculine individuals. The audio recordings include cough and throat-clearing samples, a reading passage, and additional session-specific questions. This paper outlines the development of this corpus and the data collection procedures. To illustrate the utility of this corpus, we present three case studies demonstrating how this crowd-sourced multimodal corpus can be used to support transmasculine individuals. These include the integration of perceptual and acoustic data, the identification of group-level characteristics, and the calibration of acoustic measurements.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了跨性别男性态度与言语语料库（TMASC），包含196名跨性别男性的问卷数据和66份音频录音，并展示了该语料库在声学分析、群体特征识别等方面的应用价值。
AI.motivation: 跨性别男性群体在语音健康与声学特征方面的研究数据稀缺，缺乏专门针对该群体的多模态语料库，难以支持相关临床与语言学研究。
AI.method: 通过众包方式收集了196名跨性别男性的问卷数据及66份音频录音，音频内容包括咳嗽、清嗓样本、朗读段落及会话问题，构建了多模态语料库。
AI.result: 成功构建了TMASC语料库，并通过三个案例研究验证了其在感知与声学数据整合、群体特征识别及声学测量校准方面的实用性。
AI.conclusion: TMASC语料库为跨性别男性群体的语音健康与声学研究提供了宝贵资源，能够支持多维度分析，推动该领域研究发展。

title: Visualizing Uncertainty: Spatial Maps of Missing and Conflicting Evidence in Deep Learning
summary: Understanding when and why deep neural networks are uncertain is crucial for deploying reliable machine learning systems in safety-critical domains. While existing uncertainty quantification methods provide scalar measures of model confidence, they offer limited insight into which spatial regions of an input contribute to different types of uncertainty. We propose a novel visualization framework, Uncertainty Activation Map (UAM), that combines Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) with Full-Gradient Class Activation Mapping (FullGrad) to generate interpretable spatial uncertainty activation maps. Our approach distinguishes between two fundamental types of uncertainty: vacuity, representing lack of evidence, and dissonance, capturing conflicting evidence between competing hypotheses. By leveraging the complete gradient decomposition property of FullGrad and the principled uncertainty quantification of Subjective Logic, our method produces theoretically grounded visualizations that highlight specific image regions responsible for model uncertainty. With this framework, vacuity and dissonance activation maps are generated by computing belief-weighted attributions, enabling identification of where models lack knowledge versus where they encounter ambiguous evidence. Extensive evaluations across multiple benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed framework effectively addresses the critical gap between uncertainty quantification and explainability, providing intuitive visual feedback to assess model reliability in complex visual recognition tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出 Uncertainty Activation Map (UAM) 框架，结合 Evidential Deep Learning 与 Full-Gradient Class Activation Mapping，通过生成可解释的空间不确定性激活图，区分 vacuity（证据缺乏）和 dissonance（证据冲突）两种不确定性类型，从而弥合不确定性量化与可解释性之间的鸿沟。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性量化方法仅提供标量置信度，无法揭示输入中哪些空间区域贡献了不同类型的不确定性，限制了在安全关键领域的可靠部署。
AI.method: 将 Evidential Deep Learning (EDL) 与 Full-Gradient Class Activation Mapping (FullGrad) 相结合，利用 FullGrad 的完整梯度分解特性和主观逻辑的量化原理，通过计算信念加权归因生成 vacuity 和 dissonance 两种不确定性激活图。
AI.result: 在多个基准数据集上的广泛评估表明，该框架有效填补了不确定性量化与可解释性之间的关键空白，能够直观地识别模型缺乏知识的区域与遭遇模糊证据的区域。
AI.conclusion: UAM 框架为复杂视觉识别任务提供了直观的视觉反馈来评估模型可靠性，区分了两种根本不确定性类型，增强了模型部署的可信度。

title: Whose hotel does the AI recommend? An algorithm audit of reputation signals in LLM-assisted hotel selection
summary: Travelers increasingly ask large language model (LLM) assistants which hotel to book, making these systems gatekeepers of property visibility -- yet what moves their recommendations is undocumented. We conduct a pre-specified algorithm audit using a randomized choice-based conjoint: across personas, prompt templates, and twelve open-weight and proprietary models, assistants choose among five hotels whose guest rating, review volume and recency, management response, chain affiliation, price, eco-certification, and list position are independently randomized. We estimate the average marginal component effect of each signal on the probability of recommendation.
