Guest rating and price dominate (a top rating raises selection by 31.6 percentage points; a high price lowers it by 30.0), reproducing human valence-and-price primacy but over-weighting eco-certification and ignoring management response. List position -- a content-free artifact -- shifts recommendations causally, worth about \$12 per night. Stated reasons track revealed weights imperfectly. The findings ground generative engine optimization and the accountability of AI infomediaries in causal evidence.

AI.tldr: 通过随机化选择联合实验审计了12种大语言模型在酒店推荐中的决策依据，发现评分和价格主导推荐（顶评提升31.6个百分点，高价降低30.0），但生态认证被过度重视，管理回复被忽略，且列表位置这一无内容特征会因果性地影响推荐（价值约12美元/晚）。
AI.motivation: 旅行者越来越多地依赖LLM助手推荐酒店，但这些系统的推荐依据缺乏文档记录，缺乏对其决策透明度和公平性的因果证据。
AI.method: 采用预先指定的算法审计，通过随机化选择联合实验（choice-based conjoint），在多个维度的属性（评分、评论量及时效性、管理回复、连锁品牌、价格、生态认证、列表位置）上独立随机化，跨不同角色、提示模板和12种开源及专有模型，估计各信号的平均边际成分效应（AMCE）对推荐概率的影响。
AI.result: 评分和价格是主导因素（顶评提升推荐概率31.6个百分点，高价降低30.0个百分点）；生态认证被过度加权；管理回复被忽略；列表位置（无内容鬼影）因果性地影响推荐，等价于约12美元/晚的价格效应；模型陈述的理由与实际权重存在不一致。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为生成式引擎优化（GEO）提供了因果性证据基础，并促进了AI信息中介的问责机制。

title: Tyler: Typed Latent Reasoning for Language Models -- When to Think, What to Compute, and How Much to Allocate
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) prompting improves reasoning in large language models (LLMs) by externalizing intermediate computation as discrete text tokens, but this textual interface also introduces redundancy and inference overhead. Latent reasoning offers a promising alternative by carrying part of the computation in continuous representations. However, existing methods typically predefine when latent computation is invoked and how it is allocated during decoding, leaving a key problem unresolved: when to invoke latent computation, what type of computation to perform, and how much budget to allocate. We propose \textbf{Ty}ped \textbf{L}at\textbf{e}nt \textbf{R}easoning (Tyler), a typed and budget-aware framework for latent reasoning during autoregressive decoding. Tyler learns a policy that, at each decoding step, chooses between emitting a text token and switching to a latent computation module specialized for a particular reasoning function. Once invoked, an operator maps the current reasoning state into latent tokens that support global planning, local state updates, or reusable procedural abstraction. Across extensive experiments on three backbone LLMs, Tyler improves accuracy by up to 14.49 points over CoT and by up to 4.30 points over the strongest competing baseline. It further generalizes across diverse reasoning domains and achieves the best final-stage performance with the lowest forgetting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 Tyler（Typed Latent Reasoning），一种类型化、预算感知的潜在推理框架，在自回归解码中通过学习策略动态选择是生成文本 token 还是调用特定推理功能的潜在计算模块，在三个骨干 LLM 上相比 CoT 提升最多 14.49 个准确率点，相比最强基线提升最多 4.30 个点，并展现出良好的泛化能力和抗遗忘性。
AI.motivation: CoT 虽然通过离散文本外部化中间计算来提升推理能力，但引入了冗余和推理开销。潜在推理用连续表示进行计算，现有方法却预先定义了何时调用潜在计算以及如何分配计算资源，未能解决三个关键问题：何时调用潜在计算、执行何种类型的计算、以及分配多少预算。
AI.method: Tyler 学习一个策略，在每一步解码时选择发射文本 token 或切换到特定推理功能的潜在计算模块。模块中的算子将当前推理状态映射为潜在 token，支持全局规划、局部状态更新或可复用的过程抽象。该方法通过类型化和预算感知机制动态控制何时、何种类型以及多少资源用于潜在推理。
AI.result: 在三个骨干 LLM 上，Tyler 相比 CoT 准确率提升最多 14.49 点，相比最强基线提升最多 4.30 点。在多个推理领域上均展现出泛化能力，并在最终阶段取得最佳性能且遗忘率最低。
AI.conclusion: Tyler 通过类型化和预算感知的潜在推理框架，有效解决了潜在计算何时调用、何种类型、分配多少预算的关键问题，显著优于 CoT 和现有潜在推理方法，并能泛化到不同推理领域，具有较低的遗忘率。

title: Bayesian Networks with Latent Time Embedding for Stage-Aware Causal Modeling of Alzheimer's Disease Progression
summary: Alzheimer's disease (AD) progression is often described through the amyloid-tau-neurodegeneration, or AT(N), cascade. However, most longitudinal models represent this cascade either as a fixed sequence of biomarkers or as a black-box forecasting task. This makes it difficult to determine when biologically guided biomarker relationships influence future regional pathology. In this study, we introduce Bayesian Networks with Latent Time Embedding (BN-LTE), a Bayesian structural framework for stage-aware modeling of AD progression. BN-LTE estimates disease pseudotime from baseline biomarker profiles and constrains directed dependencies according to biologically plausible AT(N) ordering. Posterior spline-varying structural equations are then used to link initial multimodal measurements with future annualized regional tau-PET change. Across repeated subject-disjoint evaluations using ADNI data, BN-LTE shows strong spatial reconstruction of tau progression compared with the included forecasting baselines. Beyond spatial reconstruction, BN-LTE recovers posterior stage-varying AT(N)-constrained effects and identifies a mid-pseudotime window of amyloid sensitivity. This window is supported by model-implied g-formula contrasts, root-adjusted AIPW, mechanism-sensitive ablations, and robustness analyses across spline and prior specifications. Overall, these findings position BN-LTE as a Bayesian structural framework for forecasting tau progression while examining stage-dependent AT(N)-cascade mechanisms in observational longitudinal neuroimaging data. Our code is available at https://github.com/danleneurocom/BN-LTE.

AI.tldr: 本文提出BN-LTE（贝叶斯网络结合潜在时间嵌入）框架，用于在阿尔茨海默病进展中建模阶段依赖的AT(N)级联机制，该框架从基线生物标志物估计疾病伪时间，通过后验样条时变结构方程将多模态测量与区域tau-PET变化关联，在ADNI数据上优于基线方法，并识别出中伪时间窗口的淀粉样蛋白敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有纵向模型要么将AT(N)级联表示为固定生物标志物序列，要么作为黑箱预测任务，难以确定生物学引导的生物标志物关系何时影响未来的区域病理。
AI.method: BN-LTE框架包括三个阶段：1) 从基线生物标志物谱估计疾病伪时间；2) 根据AT(N)排序约束有向依赖关系；3) 使用后验样条时变结构方程将初始多模态测量与年度区域tau-PET变化关联。
AI.result: 在ADNI数据的重复受试者分离评估中，BN-LTE在tau进展的空间重建上优于所包含的预测基线；恢复出后验阶段变化的AT(N)约束效应；识别出中伪时间窗口的淀粉样蛋白敏感性，该结果经g-formula对比、AIPW、消融实验及鲁棒性分析验证。
AI.conclusion: BN-LTE作为贝叶斯结构框架，能够在预测tau进展的同时检验观察性纵向神经影像数据中阶段依赖的AT(N)级联机制。

title: Looking Is Not Picking: An Attention-Segment Account of Tool-Selection Failures in LLM Agents
summary: LLM agents mis-call tools, and the natural guess is that the model failed to see the right tool in a crowded harness. We show the opposite through a lens concurrent work sets aside -- the model's attention to labeled tool-definition segments. On real BFCL failures, by per-candidate attention argmax the model attends most to the correct tool 80% of the time (vs. 21% chance), and the gold is the under-attended segment on only 10%: it looks at the right tool and still picks wrong. This directly refutes the intuitive "crowded-harness / lost-in-the-middle" explanation: the failure is at the decision readout, not the harness, and we pin it there three ways. (1) Input vs. readout: repairing the prompt (reordering or duplicating the gold tool) recovers <=23% of failures, while readout-side interventions recover 59-91%. (2) Representation-invariance: two gold-pointed interventions in different representations -- an additive attention-logit bias and a residual-stream steering vector -- recover largely the same failures (per-task Jaccard 0.865 pooled, 0.79-0.91 per model), so the bottleneck is localized to the readout independent of which representation is poked. (3) A training-free, gold-free selector: per-segment attention closes most of the gold-free-vs-oracle gap on BFCL (+11.9 pts pooled function-name selection vs. +17.9-pt oracle headroom) and adds +14.9 pts on Seal-Tools; every model positive (exact McNemar p<=8e-4 each). Scopes differ: the causal attention-bias dose-response is bidirectional and monotonic on 10 mask-honoring models (3-32B), the full 0.5-32B span carrying only the correlational diagnostic; the deployable selector is evaluated on 5 single-turn models and does not yet transfer to a multi-turn loop.

AI.tldr: LLM代理工具调用错误的主因并非"拥挤工具箱"或"中间丢失"问题，而是决策读出阶段的失败。模型80%时正确关注了目标工具，但仍选错；通过注意力读出干预可恢复59-91%的失败案例，而输入侧干预仅恢复≤23%。基于每段注意力的无训练选择器在BFCL和Seal-Tools上分别提升+11.9和+14.9个点。
AI.motivation: 挑战直观假设：LLM代理工具调用失败是由于工具定义过多导致模型"找不到正确工具"（拥挤工具箱/中间丢失假说）。论文发现模型实际上能正确关注目标工具，失败源于读出阶段，从而重新定位问题根源。
AI.method: (1) 注意力分析：对每个候选工具定义段计算注意力argmax，验证模型是否关注正确工具。(2) 输入侧vs读出侧干预对比（重排序/重复目标工具 vs 注意力logit偏置/残差流导向向量）。(3) 注意力因果剂量-响应分析（双向单调性验证）。(4) 构建无训练、无黄金标签的选择器，基于每段注意力进行工具选择。
AI.result: (1) 80%失败案例中模型注意力最高指向正确工具（随机基线21%），仅10%案例中正确工具被低关注。(2) 输入修复（重排序/重复）仅恢复≤23%失败，读出侧干预恢复59-91%。(3) 两种不同表示的读出干预恢复高度重叠的失败（Jaccard 0.79-0.91）。(4) 注意力选择器在BFCL函数名选择上+11.9 pts（Oracle上限+17.9），Seal-Tools上+14.9 pts，所有模型显著（McNemar p≤8e-4）。
AI.conclusion: LLM代理工具调用失败的根本瓶颈在决策读出阶段而非输入编码阶段，注意力机制提供了有效且无需训练的诊断与修复手段。但当前结论局限于单轮场景，多轮循环尚未验证。

title: Evaluating LLM Personalization via Semantic Constraint Verification
summary: Current evaluation paradigms for Large Language Model (LLM) personalization rely heavily on brittle surface-matching metrics or computationally expensive LLM-as-a-judge protocols, both of which lack interpretability. To address these limitations, we introduce Natural Language Inference Constraint Verification (NLICV), a scalable, semantically invariant framework that maps sentence meanings to truth-condition sets to verify personalization constraints via a Natural Language Inference (NLI) model. Moving beyond binary scoring, NLICV categorizes LLM behaviors into four distinct modes: personalization, generalization, sycophancy, and failure. Extensive experiments demonstrate that NLICV aligns closely with human annotations while drastically reducing the latency and token costs associated with LLM judges (up to 2100 inference speedup). Finally, through an ablation-based procedure, NLICV pinpoints the exact sentences driving the constraint verification, yielding faithful, understandable evidence for its evaluations.

AI.tldr: 提出NLICV框架，利用自然语言推断将句子映射为真值条件集来验证LLM个性化约束，实现了可解释、高效、语义不变的评估，比LLM-as-a-judge快2100倍，并将行为分为个性化、泛化、谄媚和失败四类。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM个性化评估依赖脆弱的表面匹配指标或计算昂贵的LLM-as-a-judge协议，两者都缺乏可解释性。
AI.method: 提出NLICV框架，通过NLI模型将句子意义映射到真值条件集以验证个性化约束；将LLM行为分为个性化、泛化、谄媚和失败四种模式；基于消融过程定位驱动约束验证的关键句子。
AI.result: 与人工标注高度一致；相比LLM judge方法，推理速度提升高达2100倍，并大幅降低延迟和token成本。
AI.conclusion: NLICV是一种可扩展、语义不变、可解释且高效的LLM个性化评估框架，优于现有方法。

title: Proximal Policy Optimization for Amortized Discrete Sampling
summary: This paper explores policy gradient algorithms for training stochastic policies to sample from structured discrete probability distributions under the Generative Flow Network (GFlowNet) framework. Building on extensive theoretical connections between GFlowNets and entropy-regularized reinforcement learning, we derive equivalents of standard policy gradient algorithms for training GFlowNets, as well as experimentally explore their various methodological aspects, including baseline training and advantage estimation. Most importantly, our work is the first to derive and successfully apply proximal policy optimization to GFlowNets, showing its improved convergence speed and data efficiency compared to standard GFlowNet training objectives on benchmarks ranging from synthetic energies to molecular graph generation.

AI.tldr: 本文探索了在生成流网络框架下，利用策略梯度算法训练随机策略从结构化离散概率分布中采样的方法，首次推导并成功将近端策略优化应用于GFlowNets，在多个基准任务上展示了更优的收敛速度和数据效率。
AI.motivation: 在GFlowNet框架下，现有训练目标在收敛速度和数据效率方面存在不足，作者希望借助策略梯度算法（尤其是PPO）来改进GFlowNets的训练，使其能更高效地从结构化离散分布中采样。
AI.method: 基于GFlowNets与熵正则化强化学习之间的理论联系，推导了适用于GFlowNets的标准策略梯度算法等价形式，并实验探索了基线训练和优势估计等方法论方面。核心贡献是首次将近端策略优化（PPO）应用于GFlowNets。
AI.result: 在合成能量基准和分子图生成等任务上，PPO训练的GFlowNets相比标准训练目标表现出更快的收敛速度和更高的数据效率。
AI.conclusion: 策略梯度算法（尤其是PPO）可以有效地应用于GFlowNets训练，显著提升其性能；这为GFlowNets的训练方法提供了新的方向。

title: Posterior Twins: Distributional Behavioral Simulation for Enterprise Decisions
summary: Enterprise behavioral simulation requires more than producing a plausible response. Many decisions depend on the shape of a population under a proposed action: which segments accept, defect, hesitate, or move into risk-sensitive states. This paper introduces Posterior Twins, a memory-grounded digital-twin approach that represents likely behavior as an updated distribution under a specific decision context. We evaluate a family of Twinning Labs behavioral-model operating points on a 226-example held-out behavioral-response benchmark and report both modal accuracy and Wasserstein-1 distance. The results show that modal accuracy and distributional fidelity identify different operating regimes. TL-Twin Alpha achieves the lowest observed Wasserstein-1 distance in the reported result set ($W_1 = 1.16$), while TL-Twin Delta and TL-Twin Gamma provide balanced operating points near the modal-accuracy frontier. The paper frames these results as a systems result: governed memory, behavioral model routing, scenario orchestration, distributional aggregation, and auditability are necessary for turning simulated behavior into reusable enterprise decision evidence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Posterior Twins方法，一种基于记忆的数字孪生方法，用于在企业行为仿真中生成特定决策情境下的更新分布，并通过Wasserstein-1距离和模态准确率评估不同模型变体的表现。
AI.motivation: 企业行为仿真不仅需要生成合理的响应，还需要准确刻画群体在不同决策下的分布形态（如接受、拒绝、犹豫或进入风险敏感状态），现有方法在此方面存在不足。
AI.method: 提出Posterior Twins方法，一种记忆驱动（memory-grounded）的数字孪生方法，在特定决策上下文下将可能行为表示为更新的分布。实验基于226个样本的行为响应基准，评估Twinning Labs系列行为模型变体，使用模态准确率和Wasserstein-1距离作为评价指标。
AI.result: 模态准确率与分布保真度识别出不同的运行区域。TL-Twin Alpha在报告结果中取得最低Wasserstein-1距离（W₁=1.16）；TL-Twin Delta和TL-Twin Gamma在模态准确率前沿上提供了平衡的运行点。
AI.conclusion: 将结果框架化为系统级成果：受治理的记忆、行为模型路由、场景编排、分布聚合和可审计性是将模拟行为转化为可复用的企业决策证据的必要条件。

title: Surpassing Scale by Efficiency: A Compact 135M Parameter Foundational LLM Natively Adapted for the Bangla Language
summary: While the NLP landscape is dominated by multi-billion parameter architectures, their deployment in low-resource, non-Latin scripts remains computationally prohibitive for edge configurations, mobile systems, and decentralized local hardware. This paper presents bangla-smollm-135m, a highly compact 135-million parameter decoder-only foundational model engineered explicitly for high-efficiency language modeling in the Bangla script. By leveraging a deterministic intersect-and-append token merging strategy between TituLLMs and SmolLM2-135M, the model overcomes subword script fragmentation without destabilizing early pretrained parameter states. In zero-shot multi-task benchmark evaluations (PIQA_bn, OpenBookQA_bn, CommonsenseQA_bn, and Bangla_MMLU), bangla-smollm-135m matches or outperforms models twice its size (Gemma-3-270m) and achieves parity with models in the 1B parameter tier. The model is available at rnnandi/bangla-smollm-135m

AI.tldr: 本文提出 bangla-smollm-135m，一个仅 1.35 亿参数的纯解码器基础模型，专为孟加拉语高效语言建模设计。通过确定性的 intersect-and-append 词元合并策略，该模型克服了子词脚本碎片化问题，在零样本多任务评测中与两倍大小模型（Gemma-3-270m）相当，并达到 1B 参数级别模型水平。
AI.motivation: NLP领域虽被数十亿参数架构主导，但这些模型在低资源非拉丁语系脚本的部署中，在边缘配置、移动系统和去中心化本地硬件上仍面临计算负担过重的挑战。
AI.method: 采用确定性的 intersect-and-append 词元合并策略，在 TituLLMs 和 SmolLM2-135M 之间融合，在不破坏预训练参数稳定性的前提下克服子词脚本碎片化问题。
AI.result: 在 PIQA_bn、OpenBookQA_bn、CommonsenseQA_bn 和 Bangla_MMLU 等零样本多任务基准评测中，匹配或超越两倍大小的 Gemma-3-270m，并达到 1B 参数级别模型的表现水平。
AI.conclusion: 证明了紧凑型模型在低资源非拉丁语脚本上可以高效部署，为边缘计算和移动端场景提供了可行方案。

title: Mean-Field Parallel Decoding for Discrete Diffusion Language Models
summary: Discrete diffusion language models enable parallel token generation, offering a pathway to low-latency decoding. However, selecting tokens independently by marginal confidence limits effective parallelism: tokens that appear reliable in isolation can form incompatible configurations when several positions are updated at once. We introduce a training-free decoding framework that coordinates these parallel updates. At each forward pass, the method assigns a commit score to each masked position and refines these scores using pairwise interactions derived from the model's predictive distributions. A variational relaxation yields a simple fixed-point update that suppresses conflicting simultaneous commitments within a single forward pass. This mechanism allows the decoder to commit more tokens in parallel while maintaining competitive generation quality. The method is lightweight, requires no auxiliary model or retraining, and drops into existing diffusion decoding pipelines without modification. Experiments on reasoning and code-generation benchmarks show consistent improvements in the quality-latency trade-off.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种无需训练的解码框架，通过协调并行token更新中的冲突，在离散扩散语言模型中实现更优的质量-延迟权衡，实验证明在推理和代码生成任务上效果一致提升。
AI.motivation: 离散扩散语言模型虽能并行生成token以降低延迟，但基于边际置信度的独立采样会导致并行更新时生成不兼容的token组合，限制了并行性的有效性。
AI.method: 提出训练无关的解码框架，为每个掩码位置分配commit分数，利用模型预测分布的成对交互精炼分数，通过变分松弛得到固定点更新，在单次前向传播中抑制冲突的同时承诺，实现更多token并行提交。
AI.result: 在推理和代码生成基准测试中，该方法在保持生成质量的同时，一致地改善了质量-延迟权衡。
AI.conclusion: 该方法轻量、无需辅助模型或重训练，可直接嵌入现有扩散解码流程，有效提升并行解码的性能。

title: When Agent Automation Becomes Profitable: Quantifying and Insuring Autonomous AI Risk through Trace-Economic Underwriting
summary: AI agents can now take irreversible actions in operational systems, but agent-caused losses are still not clearly assigned, priced, or transferred. Providers often disclaim consequential damages, users are left with uncompensated losses, and default human review limits the efficiency gains of automation. We ask when autonomous AI deployment can become economically acceptable despite failure risk. Our answer is to quantify risk at the customer-task-trace episode level and transfer it through insurance. Automation is acceptable when its expected benefit exceeds the premium, control cost, and remaining risk. This requires a defined role with bounded permissions and comparable traces. We introduce trace-economic underwriting, which maps tool-use traces to customer exposure and claimable loss, then uses this representation for pricing, control, and risk transfer. It uses deterministic economic labels rather than an LLM judge. In our trace-to-loss testbed, trace-economic pricing reduces pricing MAE from $17.7K to $569 and removes regressive cross-subsidy. A 300-trace expert audit accepts 295 labels unchanged. On 1,000 real SWE-smith traces, trace-conditioned controls reduce CVaR95 by 72%. Theorem~1 gives a finite-sample scope condition. We release code, labels, and audit sheets.

AI.tldr: 论文针对AI代理部署中的损失责任分配问题，提出了一种基于轨迹的经济核保方法，通过量化客户-任务-轨迹级别的风险，利用保险机制实现风险转移，使得自主AI部署在经济上可接受。在测试中，该方法将定价MAE从$17.7K降至$569，CVaR95降低72%。
AI.motivation: 当前AI代理在操作系统中执行不可逆行动，但代理造成的损失缺乏明确的责任分配、定价和风险转移机制。服务商通常免责，用户承担未补偿损失，而默认的人工审查限制了自动化的效率提升。
AI.method: 提出轨迹经济核保方法，将工具使用轨迹映射到客户暴露和可索赔损失，用于定价、控制和风险转移。使用确定性经济标签而非LLM评判，在客户-任务-轨迹级别量化风险并通过保险转移。
AI.result: 轨迹经济定价将MAE从$17.7K降至$569，消除逆向交叉补贴；300条轨迹的专家审计接受295个标签；在1000条真实SWE-smith轨迹上，轨迹条件控制将CVaR95降低72%。
AI.conclusion: 自主AI部署在经济上可接受的条件是预期收益超过保费、控制成本和剩余风险之和。需要定义清晰的代理角色、有限权限和可比轨迹。定理1给出了有限样本范围条件。

title: A Mechanistic Understanding of Pronoun Fidelity in LLMs
summary: Faithful and robust pronoun use is important for fair and coherent generations, yet large language models largely fail when multiple referents use different pronouns. To study the interplay of reasoning, repetition, and bias in this task, prior work relies exclusively on behavioural approaches, which may not reflect a model's internal workings. Therefore, we provide a mechanistic, model-internal perspective on pronoun fidelity, testing whether three mechanisms -- group entity binding (G), recency bias (R), and stereotypical bias (S) -- are causally implemented across several SOTA language models. Using Boundless Distributed Alignment Search, we find all three coexist as causal subspaces distributed across network depth. No single mechanism fully explains model behaviour, but a combination of the three consistently accounts for 91-99.5%. An attention head analysis further reveals two competing copying routes; group binding and stereotype share a localized concept-level route that retrieves a bound occupation-pronoun unit, while recency uses a distributed token-level route that repeats surface forms. In sum, pronoun fidelity arises from competition between simultaneously active causal subspaces.

AI.tldr: 本文通过机械性分析发现，代词保真度由三个因果子空间（群体实体绑定、近因偏差、刻板偏差）共同作用决定，它们作为分布式因果子空间存在于网络各层，通过不同层级的复制路径竞争（概念级 vs. 标记级），共同解释模型91-99.5%的行为。
AI.motivation: 先前研究仅依赖行为实验方法研究代词使用中的推理、重复和偏差问题，无法反映模型内部工作机制，因此需要从机械性、模型内部视角理解代词保真度的因果机制。
AI.method: 使用Boundless Distributed Alignment Search（BDAS）方法，在多个SOTA语言模型中测试三种机制（群体实体绑定G、近因偏差R、刻板偏差S）是否作为因果子空间实现，并进行注意力头分析。
AI.result: 三种机制共存为分布式因果子空间，三者组合可解释91-99.5%的行为；群体绑定和刻板偏差共享概念级复制路径（检索已绑定的职业-代词单元），而近因偏差使用分布式标记级复制路径（重复表面形式）。
AI.conclusion: 代词保真度源于多个同时激活的因果子空间之间的竞争，没有任何单一机制能完全解释模型行为。

title: Continuous Cross-Domain Traffic State Prediction via Memory-Augmented Graph Liquid Time-Constant Networks
summary: Traffic state prediction is a fundamental task in intelligent transportation systems. In practical applications, some regions suffer from limited traffic observations due to insufficient sensing infrastructure, making cross-domain knowledge transfer an important solution for data-scarce traffic prediction. However, existing cross-domain traffic prediction methods still face several limitations, including coarse-grained source-target adaptation, limited capability in handling unseen target-domain patterns, and insufficient modeling of continuous traffic dynamics under irregular or heterogeneous temporal conditions. To address these issues, this paper proposes a continuous cross-domain traffic prediction framework, termed Memory-Augmented Graph Liquid Time-Constant Network (MA-GLTC). Specifically, we first construct spatio-temporal units (STUs) to decompose traffic networks into transferable local units, enabling fine-grained knowledge alignment across domains. Then, a graph liquid time-constant network (GLTC) is developed to model graph-coupled traffic evolution in continuous time. Different from generic graph neural ODE-based models, GLTC introduces graph-coupled recurrent conductance into liquid time-constant dynamics, allowing node states to evolve with leakage, adaptive time constants, and neighborhood-aware feedback. Furthermore, a Memory-based Transfer Storage (MTS) mechanism is designed to preserve source-domain knowledge, retrieve matched traffic patterns, and update reliable target-domain patterns when unseen states emerge. Experiments on five public traffic datasets demonstrate that MA-GLTC consistently outperforms representative innerdomain and cross-domain baselines in both short-term and longterm prediction tasks. Compared with the second-best method, MA-GLTC reduces the average prediction errors by 3.02%, 0.33%, 8.92%, 10.09%, and 2.11%, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出记忆增强图液体时间常数网络（MA-GLTC），用于解决跨域交通预测中的粗粒度适应、未见过模式识别及连续动态建模问题。该方法通过时空单元分解、图液体时间常数网络和记忆迁移存储机制，在五个公开数据集上优于现有方法，平均预测误差降低最高达10.09%。
AI.motivation: 现有跨域交通预测方法存在三个局限：源域与目标域之间的适应粒度粗糙、无法处理目标域中未见的模式、以及在非规则或异质时间条件下对连续交通动态建模不足。因此需要一种能够实现细粒度知识迁移、处理未知模式并建模连续时间演化的跨域交通预测框架。
AI.method: 1) 构建时空单元（STU）将交通网络分解为可迁移的局部单元，实现跨域的细粒度知识对齐；2) 提出图液体时间常数网络（GLTC），引入图耦合循环电导到液体时间常数动态中，使节点状态具备泄露、自适应时间常数和邻域感知反馈的演化能力；3) 设计基于记忆的迁移存储机制（MTS），保存源域知识、检索匹配交通模式，并在遇到未见过状态时更新目标域模式。
AI.result: 在五个公开交通数据集上，MA-GLTC在短期和长期预测任务中一致优于代表性域内和跨域基线方法。与次优方法相比，平均预测误差分别降低3.02%、0.33%、8.92%、10.09%和2.11%。
AI.conclusion: MA-GLTC通过细粒度的时空单元分解、连续时间图液体动态建模和记忆迁移存储机制，有效解决了跨域交通预测中的关键挑战，显著提升了数据稀缺场景下的预测性能。

title: Tensor-Coord: Algebraic Decomposition of Joint Plan Tensors for Conflict-Free Multi-Agent LLM Planning
summary: Large language models (LLMs) remain limited in multi-agent planning because independently generated plans can create coordination failures such as spatial collisions, resource contention, and temporal deadlocks. We introduce Tensor-Coord, a multilinear algebra framework that represents the joint plan of N agents as a third-order tensor \(T \in R^{N \times H \times A}\) over agents, timesteps, and actions. Canonical Polyadic (CP) and Tucker decompositions are used to identify latent coordination structure. The minimal epsilon-approximate CP rank R* defines a computable coordination complexity measure, with \(CC(Pi)=(R*-N)/N\). We prove that R*=N is necessary and sufficient for plan independence. The residual \(E=T-T_{R*}\) defines a conflict score over agent pairs, timesteps, and actions, localizing failures without domain-specific rules. Tucker factors provide interpretable agent roles, temporal phases, and action clusters that are converted into natural language constraints for iterative LLM replanning. Experiments on multi-robot delivery tasks across Easy (2 agents, 5x5 grid), Medium (3 agents, 5x5 grid), and Hard (4 agents, 5x5 grid) settings show convergence to conflict-free plans in 100% of 2-agent cases within 1.4 iterations on average, 80% of 3-agent cases within 3.2 iterations, and 60% of 4-agent cases within 4.0 iterations. CP rank scaled approximately linearly as \(R*(N) = 3.9N + 0.5\), supporting its use as a predictor of coordination complexity.

AI.tldr: 提出Tensor-Coord框架，利用三阶张量分解（CP和Tucker）表示多体智能体联合规划，通过CP秩定义协调复杂度度量，实现冲突检测与可解释约束生成，实验证明其有效性。
AI.motivation: LLMs在多智能体规划中存在协调失败问题（空间碰撞、资源竞争、时间死锁），需要一种可计算、可解释的协调复杂度度量与冲突定位方法。
AI.method: 将N个智能体的联合计划表示为三阶张量 \(T \in R^{N \times H \times A}\)，应用CP分解和Tucker分解提取潜在协调结构；定义最小ε-近似CP秩R*及协调复杂度 \(CC(\Pi)=(R*-N)/N\)；利用残差张量 \(E=T-T_{R*}\) 定位冲突；将Tucker因子转换为自然语言约束用于LLM迭代重规划。
AI.result: 2智能体100%收敛至无冲突计划（平均1.4次迭代），3智能体80%（平均3.2次迭代），4智能体60%（平均4.0次迭代）。CP秩呈近似线性增长 \(R*(N)=3.9N+0.5\)。
AI.conclusion: 提出基于张量分解的协调复杂度度量与冲突定位方法，能有效指导LLM多智能体重规划，CP秩可作为协调复杂度的预测指标。

title: PathRouter: Aligning Rewards with Retrieval Quality in Agentic Graph Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Agentic GraphRAG trains language-model agents to iteratively retrieve and reason over graph-structured evidence, enabling more accurate and context-aware decision-making by efficiently navigating complex information networks. However, outcome-only reinforcement learning suffers from \textit{\textbf{answer-path reward aliasing}}, where correct answers may come from shortcuts rather than useful evidence paths. It also exhibits \textit{\textbf{search-update ambiguity}}, as scalar trajectory-level feedback does not indicate which retrieval actions to adjust. To mitigate these shortcomings, we present PathRouter, a path-aware training framework for agentic GraphRAG. PathRouter jointly evaluates each trajectory along answer correctness and evidence-path overlap, yielding four trajectory categories with differentiated GRPO advantage scaling that suppresses shortcut reinforcement while preserving evidence-seeking behavior. For evidence-poor trajectories, a frozen gold-evidence teacher provides token-level KL guidance on reasoning and search-query tokens, excluding answer tokens to avoid direct response imitation. Experiments on six QA benchmarks across three model sizes show that PathRouter consistently improves answer F1 and evidence-path overlap, achieving average F1 gains of 3.1 on 3B and 4.9 on 7B models compared to a strong baseline.

AI.tldr: PathRouter是一种面向Agentic GraphRAG的路径感知训练框架，通过联合评估答案正确性和证据路径重叠，将轨迹分为四类并差异化调整GRPO优势缩放，同时利用冻结的金标证据教师提供token级KL引导，从而解决答案-路径奖励混淆和搜索-更新模糊问题，在6个QA基准上显著提升了答案F1和证据路径重叠。
AI.motivation: 现有Agentic GraphRAG中，基于结果的强化学习存在两个关键问题：(1) 答案-路径奖励混淆——正确答案可能来自捷径而非有效的证据路径；(2) 搜索-更新模糊性——标量的轨迹级反馈无法指示具体哪些检索动作需要调整。这些问题导致模型难以学习到真正的证据探索行为。
AI.method: PathRouter提出三部分方法：(1) 联合评估每个轨迹的答案正确性和证据路径重叠，将轨迹分为四类，并采用差异化的GRPO优势缩放，抑制捷径强化同时保留证据探索行为；(2) 对证据不足的轨迹，引入冻结的金标证据教师提供token级KL散度引导，覆盖推理和搜索查询token，排除答案token以避免直接响应模仿；(3) 整体框架作为路径感知的训练方案。
AI.result: 在6个QA基准、三种模型规模上的实验表明：相较于强基线，PathRouter持续提升了答案F1和证据路径重叠指标。3B模型上平均F1提升3.1，7B模型上平均F1提升4.9。
AI.conclusion: PathRouter通过路径感知的差异化训练策略，有效缓解了Agentic GraphRAG中基于结果的强化学习所面临的奖励混淆和搜索模糊问题，在多个QA任务上均取得了显著且一致的性能提升，证明了引入证据路径监督对于提升智能体检索与推理质量的重要性。

title: Brownian Kernel Ladders
summary:
Constructing mathematically tractable function spaces that capture hierarchical compositional representations remains a central challenge in statistical learning theory. We introduce Brownian kernel ladders (BKLs), a recursively defined hierarchy of integral reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces generated through Brownian-kernel integral constructions. Starting from linear functionals, each layer is obtained by integrating Brownian kernels over probability measures supported on subsets of the previous layer, yielding a recursive function-space model in which depth is encoded directly through the hierarchy.
  Based on this framework, we define canonical BKL spaces together with an associated complexity functional. We establish several analytical and statistical properties of these spaces. In particular, we show that BKL spaces form quasi-Banach spaces, satisfy depth-dependent Hölder regularity estimates, and exhibit strict monotonicity with respect to depth. We further prove existence results for regularized empirical risk minimization and derive Gaussian complexity bounds that remain uniformly controlled with respect to both the ambient dimension and the hierarchy depth.
  A key ingredient of the analysis is a combinatorial proof technique based on recursive subset decompositions and Brownian-kernel threshold representations. These estimates yield excess-risk guarantees of near-parametric order for regularized empirical risk minimization over BKL spaces. Our results provide a mathematically tractable hierarchical function-space framework for studying compositional representations in deep learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出布朗核梯子（BKL），一种通过递归布朗核积分构造的层级再生核希尔伯特空间，证明了其准巴拿赫空间性质、深度依赖的Hölder正则性、严格单调性以及均匀控制的高斯复杂度，并给出了近乎参数阶的超额风险保证。
AI.motivation: 统计学习理论中缺乏数学上易于处理且能捕获层级组合表示的函数空间，现有框架难以同时兼顾层次深度、维度无关的复杂度控制以及递归结构的可分析性。
AI.method: 通过布朗核积分递归定义函数空间层次：每一层通过对前一层子集上的概率测度积分布朗核得到；利用递归子集分解和布朗核阈值表示的组合证明技术进行理论分析。
AI.result: BKL空间形成准巴拿赫空间；满足深度依赖的Hölder正则性估计；深度严格单调性成立；正则化经验风险最小化存在解；高斯复杂度界对维度和深度均匀控制；超额风险达到近乎参数阶。
AI.conclusion: BKL为深度学习中组合表示研究提供了数学上易于处理的层级函数空间框架，其理论性质表明该框架在统计可学习性方面具有优势。

title: Steering Emotional Dynamics for Art Therapy: Controllable Narrative Script Generation through Hierarchically Guided LLM Agents
summary: Art therapy plays a vital role in emotional healing, in which narrative creation acts as the primary vehicle for emotional expression. Given the inherently dynamic nature of emotions during healing, narratives with finely controlled emotional fluctuations enable individuals to safely project inner conflicts and achieve emotional catharsis. Recently, with the rapid development of Large Language Models (LLMs), automated narrative generation technology has provided a new pathway to support such artistic designs. However, while existing methods can produce fluent texts, they struggle to generate narratives that adhere to specified affective trajectories, failing to meet the demands of emotion-oriented psychological healing. To address these issues, this paper proposes EC-Script, an LLM agent-based framework that enables hierarchical control of the affective trajectory in narrative generation for emotional healing. To ensure that the generated narratives strictly follow the given emotional patterns, EC-Script establishes overall narrative direction through Emotion-Trajectory Planning, propels scene-level plot development with Character-Driven Scene Generation, and regulates local emotional changes of characters via Emotion-Controlled Script Writing. Ultimately, it outputs scene-by-scene script content that remains highly consistent with the preset affective trajectory. Experimental results demonstrate that EC-Script significantly outperforms baseline methods in affective trajectory adherence, exhibiting excellent and reliable emotional controllability, thereby providing effective technical support for AI-assisted emotional healing scenarios.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EC-Script，一种基于LLM智能体的框架，通过分层情感轨迹控制（情感轨迹规划、角色驱动场景生成、情感控制脚本写作）生成严格遵循预设情感变化模式的叙事脚本，在情感疗愈场景中显著优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 艺术治疗中叙事创作是情感表达的主要载体，但现有自动叙事生成技术虽能生成流畅文本，却无法生成遵循特定情感轨迹的叙事，难以满足情感导向心理疗愈的需求。
AI.method: EC-Script框架包含三个层次：(1) 情感轨迹规划层，确定整体叙事方向；(2) 角色驱动场景生成层，推动场景级情节发展；(3) 情感控制脚本写作层，调节角色的局部情感变化，最终输出与预设情感轨迹高度一致的逐场景脚本内容。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，EC-Script在情感轨迹遵循度上显著优于基线方法，表现出优秀且可靠的情感可控性。
AI.conclusion: EC-Script为AI辅助情感疗愈场景提供了有效的技术支撑，能够生成严格遵循给定情感模式的叙事文本，满足情绪导向心理疗愈的需求。

title: LectūraAgents: A Multi-Agent Framework for Adaptive Personalized AI-Assisted Learning and Embodied Teaching
summary: Effective personalized AI-assisted learning demands systems that can not only generate accurate learner-specific educational materials, but also dynamically adapt their instruction to diverse learners. However, existing educational agents have primarily focused on lecture content automation and simulations, which often fall short of modelling multimodal and embodied instructional methods tailored for the individual learner. To this end, we propose LectūraAgents - a multi-agent framework that enables personalized learning through end-to-end adaptive embodied teaching. At its core, LectūraAgents mirrors a professor-student relationship, in which a ProfessorAgent leads a collaborative team of specialized subordinate agents through research, planning, review, and embodied delivery of lecture contents that adapt to a learner's needs. The framework offers three main contributions: (1) a hierarchical multi-agent architecture for end-to-end personalized learning; (2) an adaptive embodied teaching mechanism, wherein the ProfessorAgent executes visible and pedagogically motivated teaching actions (e.g., handwrite, highlight, underline, etc.) over contents in a teaching environment; and (3) a Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA) algorithm that employs salience-based heuristics and temporal semantic segmentation to generate coherent teaching action sequences aligned with learner profiles. We evaluate LectūraAgents on diverse courses at high school, undergraduate, and graduate levels using sample-specific rubric-based analysis; with generated lecture materials and teaching actions assessed and validated by expert educators. Experimental results show consistent gains in lecture content quality, embodied teaching quality, assessment, and personalization over existing approaches, positioning LectūraAgents as a pedagogically well-grounded framework for personalized learning at scale.

AI.tldr: LectūraAgents是一个多智能体框架，通过层次化架构、自适应具身教学和教学动作-语音对齐算法，实现端到端的个性化学习。该框架模拟教授-学生关系，由ProfessorAgent领导专业子智能体团队，在高中、本科和研究生课程上显著提升了授课内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化水平。
AI.motivation: 现有教育智能体主要关注讲座内容自动化和模拟，缺乏针对个体学习者的多模态和具身化教学方法建模，难以实现动态适应不同学习者的个性化教学。
AI.method: 提出LectūraAgents框架，包含三个核心贡献：(1) 层次化多智能体架构实现端到端个性化学习；(2) 自适应具身教学机制，ProfessorAgent在教学环境中执行可见的、教学驱动的教学动作（如手写、高亮、下划线等）；(3) Teaching Action-Speech Alignment (TASA)算法，利用显著性启发式和时序语义分割生成与学习者画像对齐的教学动作序列。
AI.result: 在高中、本科和研究生多个课程上，使用基于样本量规的分析方法评估，生成的教学材料和教学动作由专家教育者验证。实验结果表明，在授课内容质量、具身教学质量、评估和个性化方面均优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: LectūraAgents是一个具有坚实教学基础的个性化学习框架，能够实现大规模个性化学习。

title: SILAGE: Memory-Efficient, Full-Gradient-Free Nonconvex Optimization for Nested Finite Sums
comment: 80 pages, 3 algorithms, 4 theorems, 2 corollaries, 11 lemmas, 2 figures, 12 tables
summary: Empirical risk minimization on massive datasets naturally exhibits a nested double finite-sum structure, where $N=nm$ total samples are logically or physically partitioned into $n$ blocks of size $m$ (e.g., in pooled data silos, out-of-core learning, or deliberate stratification). While variance-reduced methods achieve optimal oracle complexities for nonconvex objectives, they suffer from severe scaling bottlenecks in this centralized regime. Recursive estimators, such as PAGE, require periodic global full-gradient refreshes over all $nm$ samples, which are computationally expensive. Conversely, single-loop methods, such as SILVER, avoid such refreshes but require an impractical $\mathcal{O}(nm)$ memory footprint to store a control variate for every sample. In this paper, we propose SILAGE, a variance-reduced algorithm that addresses this trade-off. By actively exploiting the double-sum structure, SILAGE eliminates periodic global full-gradient refreshes over all $nm$ components (evaluating at most one local group gradient per iteration) while requiring only $\mathcal{O}(n)$ memory. Furthermore, we provide a tight convergence analysis that avoids pessimistic worst-case Lipschitz constants. Instead, SILAGE's complexity natively adapts to the underlying data geometry via nested functional similarities: across-group ($δ_1$) and within-group ($δ_2$) heterogeneity. Our results improve existing state-of-the-art bounds in several practically relevant regimes.

AI.tldr: SILAGE是一种利用嵌套双有限和结构的方差缩减算法，通过仅评估一个局部组梯度并仅需O(n)内存，避免了全局全梯度刷新，同时收敛复杂度自适应于数据几何中的组间和组内异质性。
AI.motivation: 在大规模数据集上，经验风险最小化天然具有嵌套双有限和结构，但现有方差缩减方法（如PAGE需要周期性全局全梯度刷新，计算成本高；SILVER需要O(nm)内存存储控制变量，不实用）存在严重的扩展瓶颈，无法高效处理这种结构。
AI.method: 提出SILAGE算法，主动利用双求和结构，每次迭代最多评估一个局部组梯度，消除周期性全局全梯度刷新，仅需O(n)内存；并提供紧收敛分析，通过嵌套功能相似性（组间δ₁和组内δ₂异质性）自适应于底层数据几何，避免悲观最坏情况Lipschitz常数。
AI.result: SILAGE在多个实际相关场景中改进了现有最先进方法的收敛边界，实现了计算效率与内存效率的最佳权衡。
AI.conclusion: SILAGE通过主动利用双求和结构，成功解决了方差缩减方法在大规模嵌套数据结构上的计算-内存权衡问题，为实际应用中具有分组结构的大规模优化提供了更高效的方案。

title: Post-Hoc Merging is Not Enough: Many-Shot Model Merging with Loss-Gap Balancing
comment: Accepted to the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: Model merging has become a practical post-training strategy for building a single multi-task large language model (LLM) by combining multiple task-specialized models. However, most existing approaches rely on post-hoc merging, in which task-specific models are merged only once after training. This one-shot aggregation often suffers from task interference, leading to information erasure across individual tasks. In this work, we show that replacing post-hoc merging with an iterative many-shot merging protocol is effective in improving multi-task performance. Building on this insight, we propose METIS, Mitigating Erasure from Task Interference for Stable many-shot merging. METIS is a loss-aware many-shot merging method that addresses information erasure in post-hoc merging through task-wise loss-gap weighting and consensus-based masking. Notably, METIS exhibits significant performance improvement on the worst-performing task, effectively mitigating information erasure. (Project page: https://imkyungjin.github.io/METIS/)

AI.tldr: 本文提出METIS方法，通过迭代式多轮合并（many-shot merging）替代传统单次后合并（post-hoc merging），并引入任务级损失差距加权和共识掩码，有效缓解多任务大语言模型合并中的任务干扰与信息擦除问题，显著提升最差任务性能。
AI.motivation: 现有模型合并方法多为训练后的单次合并（post-hoc merging），这种一次性聚合方式容易导致任务间干扰，造成个别任务的信息被擦除，多任务性能受限。
AI.method: 提出METIS方法，包含两项核心技术：(1) 任务级损失差距加权（task-wise loss-gap weighting），根据各任务损失差异动态调整合并权重；(2) 共识掩码（consensus-based masking），通过多轮合并中的参数共识筛选有效参数，实现稳定的迭代式多轮合并。
AI.result: METIS在多个任务上相比传统后合并方法表现出显著性能提升，尤其在原本表现最差的任务上改进最为明显，有效缓解了信息擦除问题。
AI.conclusion: 迭代式多轮合并（many-shot merging）优于单次后合并，METIS通过损失感知的加权与掩码机制能够稳定实现多轮合并，为多任务LLM的模型融合提供了有效的新范式。

title: ACCORD: Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding for Language Agents
summary: User instructions are often underspecified because humans rely on implicit assumptions about the surrounding environment. For large language model (LLM) agents operating in information-rich digital and physical environments, these assumptions cannot be inferred from the instruction alone; they must be recovered from the current state of tools, data, interfaces, and observations. Effective execution therefore requires agents to identify missing context, ground it in observed evidence, and carry it forward into subsequent actions. We show that current agents often fail to do so. They act from assumed rather than observed specifics, overlook information they could have gathered, and fail to incorporate evidence that has already been returned. Building on this insight, we propose ACCORD (Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding), a simple and effective agent framework for adaptive grounding. Before each action, ACCORD actively probes the environment for missing information and integrates relevant context from the agent's trajectory that would otherwise be overlooked. Requiring no additional training or task-success signals, ACCORD improves task-goal completion on AppWorld by up to +20.6 points with GPT-5-mini, from 42.0% to 62.6%, compared to strong baselines. These gains persist with a substantially stronger base model (+10.8 with Claude-4.5-sonnet), an open-weight model (+10.1 with Qwen3.5-27B-FP8), and on the embodied AlfWorld benchmark (+7.4 success rate with GPT-5-mini).

AI.tldr: 本文发现LLM智能体常因忽略环境隐含信息导致任务失败，提出ACCORD框架在每次行动前主动探测环境、整合轨迹上下文，无需额外训练即可在多个基准上显著提升任务完成率（AppWorld最高+20.6%）。
AI.motivation: 用户指令常因依赖隐式环境假设而欠指定，现有LLM智能体无法从工具、数据、接口等环境中恢复这些假设，导致执行失败。
AI.method: 提出ACCORD（Action-Conditioned Contextual Grounding）框架：在每次行动前主动探测环境以获取缺失信息，并从智能体轨迹中整合被忽略的相关上下文，无需额外训练或任务成功信号。
AI.result: 在AppWorld上GPT-5-mini任务完成率从42.0%提升至62.6%（+20.6点）；Claude-4.5-sonnet提升+10.8点；Qwen3.5-27B-FP8提升+10.1点；AlfWorld上GPT-5-mini成功率提升+7.4点。
AI.conclusion: ACCORD是一种简单有效的自适应环境接地框架，能显著提升LLM智能体在信息丰富环境中的任务完成能力，且泛化性强，适用于不同模型和基准。

title: Wasserstein Convergence of ODE-Based Samplers in Decentralized Diffusion Model via Velocity Field Decomposition
summary: Diffusion models have achieved impressive empirical success in generative tasks, and their convergence theory is now relatively well understood. Motivated by privacy and scalability, recent decentralized diffusion architectures replace a single global velocity field with multiple local experts and a routing mechanism, yielding a sampling dynamics with stochastic expert switching that falls outside standard diffusion convergence analyses. In this work, We study a decentralized diffusion framework with stochastic velocity fields and ODE-based sampling. We establish a convergence guarantee in Wasserstein-2 distance, showing that the distribution of the $N$-step discretization converges to the analytical solution at rate $\mathcal{O}(N^{-1/2}+\varepsilon)$ in $W_2$, where $\varepsilon$ captures the neural approximation errors. To our knowledge, this is the first $W_2$ convergence result for decentralized diffusion models with an ODE-based sampling scheme.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了基于随机速度场和ODE采样的去中心化扩散框架，建立了Wasserstein-2距离下的收敛保证，证明N步离散化分布的收敛率为O(N^{-1/2}+ε)，其中ε为神经逼近误差。这是首个针对去中心化扩散模型ODE采样方案的W_2收敛结果。
AI.motivation: 受隐私保护和可扩展性需求的驱动，近期去中心化扩散架构用多个局部专家和路由机制替代单一的全局速度场，产生了一种超出标准扩散收敛分析的随机专家切换采样动力学，因此需要为其建立收敛性理论。
AI.method: 研究采用随机速度场和ODE采样方案，对去中心化扩散框架进行N步离散化分析，在Wasserstein-2距离下推导收敛率，并将神经逼近误差纳入分析框架。
AI.result: 建立了Wasserstein-2距离下的收敛保证，证明离散化分布以O(N^{-1/2}+ε)的速率收敛到解析解，其中ε刻画神经逼近误差。
AI.conclusion: 据作者所知，这是首个针对去中心化扩散模型ODE采样方案的W_2收敛性结果，填补了该领域理论分析的空白。

title: Model Graph Inductive Learning for Knowledge Graph Completion
summary:
Link prediction in knowledge graphs fundamentally depends on the quality of learned embeddings for entities and relations. However, most existing methods derive these embeddings by aggregating only the local neighborhood of each entity, neglecting the global structure of the knowledge graph. This limited view prevents models from capturing higher-level structural patterns that are essential for accurate and generalizable link prediction.
  To address these limitations, we introduce Model Graph Inductive Learning (\textbf{MGIL}), a framework that constructs a model graph by clustering entities based on the similarity of their incoming and outgoing relational structures or their entity types. A GNN is then applied to this model graph to produce embeddings that capture the global view of the knowledge graph. These embeddings subsequently serve as high-quality initial features %embeddings for the original knowledge graph, replacing random initialization and leading to more stable and expressive representations.
  Extensive experiments on standard and recently proposed inductive benchmarks demonstrate that MGIL achieves state-of-the-art or highly competitive performance in inductive link prediction, highlighting its effectiveness across diverse graph settings.

AI.tldr: 提出MGIL框架，通过构建模型图（基于实体关系结构或类型的聚类）并用GNN生成全局嵌入，替代随机初始化，提升知识图谱归纳链接预测性能。
AI.motivation: 现有知识图谱链接预测方法仅聚合局部邻域，忽略全局结构，限制了模型捕捉高层次结构模式的能力，影响预测精度和泛化性。
AI.method: 构建模型图：基于实体出入关系结构相似性或实体类型进行聚类；对模型图应用GNN生成捕获全局视角的嵌入；用这些嵌入作为原始知识图谱的高质量初始特征，替代随机初始化。
AI.result: 在标准和新提出的归纳基准上，MGIL在归纳链接预测任务中达到了最优或极具竞争力的性能。
AI.conclusion: MGIL通过全局结构建模有效增强了知识图谱嵌入的表达能力和稳定性，在多样化的图设置下展现出卓越的归纳链接预测效果。

title: From Awareness to Adherence: Bridging the Context Gap in Spoken Dialogue Systems via Context-Aware Decoding
summary: Despite the success of end-to-end (E2E) spoken dialogue systems, maintaining strict context adherence in multi-round conversations remains a challenge. While prior works attribute these failures to models forgetting dialogue history, we highlight an equally critical but overlooked bottleneck: a gap between latent context awareness and active adherence. Although models internally recognize relevant past utterances, strong parametric priors often overshadow these signals during decoding. To bridge this gap, we propose an audio-adapted Context-Aware Decoding (CAD) approach. By leveraging internal attention mechanisms to isolate key historical rounds, our approach contrasts output distributions with and without this key context during inference, directly amplifying multimodal contextual signals. Evaluations on the Audio MultiChallenge benchmark demonstrate significant improvements in Semantic Memory and Self Coherence subtasks, successfully enforcing strict, context-faithful adherence.

AI.tldr: 本文提出音频适应的上下文感知解码（CAD）方法，通过对比有无关键上下文的输出分布来放大多模态上下文信号，解决端到端口语对话系统中模型虽能识别但未能主动遵守上下文的问题，在Audio MultiChallenge基准上显著提升了语义记忆和自一致性性能。
AI.motivation: 端到端口语对话系统在多轮对话中难以严格遵循上下文，现有工作归因于模型遗忘对话历史，但本文指出存在一个被忽视的瓶颈：模型内部虽能识别相关历史话语（潜在上下文感知），但由于强烈的参数先验在解码时掩盖了这些信号，导致无法主动遵守上下文。
AI.method: 提出音频适应的上下文感知解码（CAD）方法，利用内部注意力机制隔离关键历史轮次，在推理时对比包含与不包含该关键上下文的输出分布，直接放大多模态上下文信号，从而增强模型对上下文的忠实遵循。
AI.result: 在Audio MultiChallenge基准测试中，该方法在语义记忆（Semantic Memory）和自一致性（Self Coherence）子任务上取得了显著改进，成功实现了严格、忠实于上下文的 adherence。
AI.conclusion: 模型在多轮对话中无法遵循上下文的原因不仅是历史遗忘，更是潜意识的上下文感知与主动遵守之间存在差距；通过CAD方法在解码阶段放大关键上下文信号可以有效弥合这一差距，提升对话系统的上下文忠实性。

title: David vs. Goliath in Next Activity Prediction: Argmax vs. LSTM, Transformer, and LLM
comment: Accepted for 24th International Conference on Business Process Management (2026) Forum
summary: Next activity prediction (NAP) is a cornerstone of predictive process monitoring (PPM), enabling organizations to move from retrospective analysis to proactive process steering. The PPM field has progressed from classical machine learning through deep learning architectures such as LSTMs and Transformers to large language models (LLMs). Despite growing model complexity, no benchmark jointly compares LLMs, Transformers, LSTMs, and simple baselines in a direct sequence modeling setting for NAP. In this paper, we fill this gap with a systematic benchmark. We compare vocabulary-adapted LLMs, Transformers trained from scratch, LLM-distilled Transformers, and LSTMs against a simple counting-based argmax baseline across seven real-life event logs. Our results tell a David vs. Goliath story: pretraining confers no consistent improvement over training from scratch, model size shows little effect on performance, and on most datasets the argmax baseline matches or approaches the performance of billion-parameter LLMs.

AI.tldr: 在下一个活动预测（NAP）任务中，经过系统基准测试发现：简单的argmax基线在多数数据集上匹配或接近十亿级参数大语言模型（LLM）的性能，预训练和模型规模带来的提升并不一致。
AI.motivation: 尽管预测过程监控（PPM）领域从经典机器学习发展到深度学习再到大型语言模型（LLM），模型复杂度不断提升，但缺乏一个统一的基准来联合比较LLM、Transformer、LSTM和简单基线在NAP任务上的直接序列建模表现。
AI.method: 构建系统基准，比较词汇自适应LLM、从头训练的Transformer、LLM蒸馏的Transformer、LSTM以及简单的基于计数的argmax基线，在七个真实事件日志上进行实验。
AI.result: 预训练相比从头训练没有一致的改进，模型大小对性能影响很小，且在大多数数据集上，简单的argmax基线匹配或接近十亿参数LLM的性能。
AI.conclusion: 在大卫vs歌利亚式的对比中，简单的计数基线在NAP任务上表现惊人地好，复杂模型和大规模预训练并未带来预期的显著提升。

title: Kairos: A Native World Model Stack for Physical AI
summary: World models are transitioning from passive visual generators to foundational, operational infrastructure for Physical AI: they must natively acquire world knowledge from heterogeneous experience, maintain persistent states over long horizons, and execute efficiently within real deployment constraints. We introduce Kairos, a native world model stack designed around these requirements. (1) Kairos learns the world by pioneering a Native Pre-training Paradigm governed by a Cross-Embodiment Data Curriculum, which organizes open-world videos, human behavioral data, and robot interactions into a progressive developmental pathway. (2) Kairos maintains the world by unified world understanding, generation, and prediction within a Native Unified Architecture equipped with Hybrid Linear Temporal Attention, where sliding-window attention captures local dynamics, dilated sliding windows capture mid-range dependencies, and gated linear attention maintains persistent global memory. We establish formal theoretical bounds demonstrating that this temporal factorization strictly limits error accumulation, mathematically guaranteeing state propagation across extended horizons. (3) Kairos runs the world by incorporating a Deployment-Aware System Co-Design to support low-latency rollout generation on server and consumer-grade hardware for real-world observation-action-feedback loops. Experiments on embodied world-model, long-horizon, and action-policy benchmarks show that Kairos achieves top level performance while offering a strong efficiency-capability trade-off. Together, these results position Kairos as a cohesive operational foundation for future self-evolving physical intelligence.

AI.tldr: Kairos是一个原生世界模型栈，通过原生预训练范式（跨具身数据课程）、原生统一架构（混合线性时序注意力）和部署感知系统协同设计，实现世界知识获取、长程状态保持和高效部署，在多项基准上达到顶级性能。
AI.motivation: 世界模型正从被动视觉生成器转变为物理AI的基础操作基础设施，需要原生获取异构经验中的世界知识、维持长程持久状态并在真实部署约束下高效执行，现有方法无法同时满足这些需求。
AI.method: (1) 原生预训练范式：跨具身数据课程（开放世界视频、人类行为数据、机器人交互）组织渐进式发展路径；(2) 原生统一架构：混合线性时序注意力（滑动窗口捕获局部动态、膨胀滑动窗口捕获中程依赖、门控线性注意力维持持久全局记忆），并建立形式化理论界限证明该时序分解严格限制误差累积；(3) 部署感知系统协同设计：支持服务器和消费级硬件上的低延迟 rollout 生成。
AI.result: 在具身世界模型、长程任务和动作策略基准上达到顶级性能，同时提供强大的效率-能力权衡。
AI.conclusion: Kairos定位为未来自进化物理智能的 cohesive 操作基础。

title: Lost at the End: Primacy Bias in Multimodal Retrieval-Augmented Question Answering
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. Under review at EMNLP 2026
summary: Knowledge-based visual question answering (KB-VQA) lets vision-language systems answer questions that exceed their parametric knowledge by conditioning a reader on passages retrieved from a Wikipedia-scale knowledge base. In pure-text long-context LLMs, retrieved-context use follows the U-shaped "lost-in-the-middle" effect of Liu et al. (2024): information at the start and end of context is used, the middle is lost. Whether this transfers to deployed multimodal KB-VQA is open. To close this gap, we design the first controlled probe of reader-side position dependence in multimodal KB-VQA: a gold-position protocol in which only the gold passage's prompt slot varies within question. We run it on three open-source 7B/8B VLM readers and two KB-VQA benchmarks at k up to 20. The shape flips from U to primacy: gold-at-first beats gold-at-last by 16 to 26 points on every reader-by-benchmark cell, an effect we call "Lost at the End". Three targeted ablations narrow the cause: a text-only control shows the multimodal setting amplifies an already-present text-mode primacy 2.2 to 4.5 times, and image-position and distractor-shuffle ablations together pin the locus to prompt slot 0 of the instruction-tuned reader. On a frozen reader, three retrieval-side fixes (MMR, oracle reranking, rank-based reordering) all leave the gap intact (no separable improvement). Our findings indicate that recall@k is the wrong metric for deployed KB-VQA and that closing the gap requires reader-side intervention; we release our protocol as a controlled instrument for evaluating such interventions.

AI.tldr: 本文首次系统探究多模态知识型视觉问答（KB-VQA）中阅读器对检索文档位置依赖问题，发现与纯文本大模型中的U形"lost-in-the-middle"效应相反，多模态KB-VQA表现为"Lost at the End"的首因效应（首位比末位高16-26个点），并通过消融实验定位原因为指令微调阅读器的提示槽0位置，且检索端优化无法解决该问题，表明recall@k是错误指标，需阅读器端干预。
AI.motivation: 纯文本长上下文LLM中存在"lost-in-the-middle"效应（上下文两端信息被利用，中间丢失），但这一效应是否迁移到部署态的多模态KB-VQA中尚属未知。本文旨在填补这一空白，首次设计受控实验探测多模态KB-VQA中阅读器端的位置依赖性。
AI.method: 设计"gold-position protocol"受控探测协议，仅改变gold passage在提示中的位置槽位；在3个开源7B/8B VLM阅读器和2个KB-VQA基准上，k最大20进行实验；并开展三项消融实验（纯文本对照、图像位置消融、干扰项打乱消融）定位原因。
AI.result: 发现与纯文本U形效应相反，多模态KB-VQA呈现"Lost at the End"的首因效应：首位比末位高16-26个点（所有读者×基准组合）；纯文本对照显示多模态将文本模式的首因效应放大2.2-4.5倍；消融定位原因在指令微调阅读器的prompt slot 0；三种检索端修复（MMR、oracle重排、基于排序的重排序）均无法消除差距。
AI.conclusion: recall@k是部署态KB-VQA的错误指标；缩小差距需要阅读器端干预而非检索端优化；作者将协议开源作为评估此类干预措施的控制工具。

title: Intelligence Is Not the Bottleneck: Validating an LLM First-Pass Manuscript Score Against Peer-Review Outcomes
summary: Large language model (LLM) systems are increasingly proposed to assist peer review, yet most evaluations judge the prose of machine-generated review text, not the validity of the numeric score a system assigns. We validate AIPR, which reads a submitted manuscript and emits five 0-100 quality dimensions and a weighted overall score, against the public decision outcomes of a major machine learning venue. AIPR grades by prompting alone, with no fine-tuning on reviews or decisions. Across 300 ICLR submissions with public decision tiers and reviewer ratings, graded under a frozen pipeline with hypotheses pre-registered before any score met any outcome, the overall score separates rejected from accepted submissions (AUROC 0.82, 95% CI 0.78-0.87), rises monotonically across tiers, and tracks the mean reviewer rating. The signal is strongest where we claim it: the lowest-scoring fifth is rejected far above the base rate, with oral papers absent. The validity comes mostly from the model: a one-paragraph prompt on the same model discriminates almost as well as the full pipeline (the small gap favours the pipeline but does not meet the pre-declared criterion, p = 0.09). What the engineering adds is reliability and a grounded review: AIPR's score barely moves across repeated runs (0.7 vs. 2.8 points within-paper SD) where the bare prompt swings, and the same pass returns a rubric-structured, evidence-grounded review rather than a bare number, with the human keeping the decision.

AI.tldr: 本文验证了AIPR系统——仅通过提示（prompting）方式对论文进行0-100分质量评分，无需微调——在ICLR 300篇投稿上的有效性。其总体评分能较好区分接收与拒稿（AUROC 0.82），单调递增地对应决策等级，且与评审均分吻合。评分主要源于模型能力，工程化贡献在于可靠性和结构化评审文本。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM辅助同行评审的评估多关注生成文本的流畅性，而非数值评分的有效性。本文旨在填补这一空白，验证仅凭提示（无微调）的LLM系统能否输出与真实决策一致的数值评分。
AI.method: AIPR系统读取投稿全文，通过提示（prompting）生成五个0-100维度的质量评分及加权总分，不进行任何微调。在300篇ICLR投稿上，使用冻结管道和预注册假设进行验证，以AUROC、单调性等指标评估与真实决策和评审均分的一致性。
AI.result: 总体评分AUROC为0.82（95% CI 0.78-0.87），单调递增对应决策等级，与评审均分吻合。最低分五分之一论文的拒稿率远超基准率，且无oral论文。单段提示的区分度几乎与完整管道相当（差距不显著，p=0.09）。AIPR的重复运行标准差为0.7分，远低于裸提示的2.8分。
AI.conclusion: AIPR的评分效度主要来自底层LLM的能力，工程管道的主要贡献在于提升评分可靠性和生成结构化、有证据支撑的评审文本，最终决策仍由人类掌控。

title: The Faithfulness Gap: Certifying Semantic Equivalence Between Natural-Language and Formal Mathematical Statements
summary: Autoformalization, translating natural-language mathematics into formal proof assistants, is bottlenecked not by translation fluency but by \emph{faithfulness}: a formal statement can typecheck and be provable, yet still encode a different theorem than the source intended. We introduce \emph{Bidirectional Provability Fingerprinting} (\bpf{}), a framework that certifies faithfulness by characterizing each candidate through its forward and backward consequence neighborhoods in the ambient theory and matching these against probes derived from the natural-language statement. We further introduce four novel components: (i) \emph{Counterfactual Probe Generation} (\cpg{}), a contrastive procedure that synthesizes probes targeting specific drift directions; (ii) the \emph{Equivalence Spectrum}, a continuous faithfulness score that replaces brittle binary verdicts; (iii) \emph{Adaptive Probe Budget Allocation} (\apba{}), an information-theoretic budget router; and (iv) \emph{Faithfulness-Guided Decoding} (\fgd{}), which uses \bpf{} signals as a reward during autoformalization. We prove a \emph{drift detection theorem} and a \emph{PAC-faithfulness} result establishing that the equivalence class of a natural language statement is learnable from $\mathcal{O}(\log(1/δ)/\varepsilon)$ probes under mild assumptions. We release \driftbench{}, a benchmark of $2{,}183$ NL/Lean~4 pairs with controlled drift labels across six subfields of mathlib4. \bpf{}\,+\,\cpg{} detects $89.6\%$ of drifted formalizations at a $3.0\%$ false-positive rate-against $41.2\%$ for typecheck and $63.3\%$ for LLM-judge baselines, and \fgd{} reduces the rate at which a state-of-the-art autoformalizer emits drifted statements by $47\%$. https://pmlrbd.github.io/BPF/

AI.tldr: 本文提出双向可证性指纹识别（BPF）框架，通过前向和后向推演邻域匹配来认证自然语言数学到形式证明助手的自动形式化的忠实性，并引入四项新组件，在2,183个NL/Lean 4对基准上实现89.6%的漂移检测率（3.0%假阳性率），并将SOTA自动形式化器的漂移语句率降低47%。
AI.motivation: 自动形式化的瓶颈并非翻译流畅性，而是忠实性：形式化语句可能类型检查通过且可证明，却编码了与源自然语言不同的定理。现有方法缺乏对形式化结果是否忠实于原意的认证机制。
AI.method: 提出BPF框架，通过候选形式化语句在环境理论中的前向和后向推演邻域特征与自然语言语句导出的探针进行匹配来认证忠实性。四项新组件包括：(i) 反事实探针生成（CPG）——对比式合成探针以定位特定漂移方向；(ii) 等价光谱——连续忠实性评分替代二元判定；(iii) 自适应探针预算分配（APBA）——信息论预算路由；(iv) 忠实性引导解码（FGD）——在自动形式化过程中使用BPF信号作为奖励。另证明漂移检测定理和PAC-忠实性结果，并发布含2,183对NL/Lean 4的DriftBench基准。
AI.result: BPF+CPG在3.0%假阳性率下检测出89.6%的漂移形式化，对比类型检查基线41.2%和LLM评判基线63.3%；FGD将SOTA自动形式化器生成漂移语句的比率降低47%。
AI.conclusion: BPF框架有效解决了自动形式化的忠实性认证问题，通过双向推演邻域匹配和多项创新组件，显著优于现有基线，为可信自动形式化提供了理论保证和实用工具。

title: REFLEX: Reflective Evolution from LLM Experience
summary: Large multimodal language models (LLMs) have emerged as powerful tools for guiding evolutionary search toward interpretable programmatic policies. However, existing frameworks rely on a monolithic model call to simultaneously interpret visual behavioral evidence and synthesize corrective code. This diagnosis-repair entanglement creates an opaque feedback loop, obscuring the rationale behind mutations and preventing the retention of algorithmic insights across independent runs. To achieve auditable and efficient policy search, we argue that visual diagnosis must be structurally decoupled from code generation. We present REFLEX, a train-free evolutionary framework that operationalizes this decoupling. In REFLEX, a vision-enabled Critic first distills task-specific behavioral evidence into structured, auditable diagnoses. Subsequently, a text-optimized Actor synthesizes child policies using these diagnoses alongside a persistent, self-evolving Skill Memory of reusable code snippets. This architecture not only provides transparent mutation traces but also enables cross-run programmatic knowledge transfer. Extensive evaluations across control benchmarks (Lunar Lander, Acrobot, Pendulum) and a 36-dimensional antenna array synthesis task demonstrate exceptional sample efficiency. Notably, REFLEX solves Acrobot and Pendulum in under 10 LLM calls and reaches a best Normalized Weighted Score of 1.092 on Lunar Lander, achieving highly competitive final performance while significantly accelerating the early-stage discovery of transparent policies.

AI.tldr: REFLEX提出了一种无需训练的演化框架，将视觉诊断与代码生成解耦，通过视觉Critic生成结构化诊断、文本Actor结合技能记忆库生成策略代码，在多个控制任务和天线阵列合成任务中显著提升样本效率，并支持跨运行的知识迁移。
AI.motivation: 现有大型多模态语言模型引导的演化搜索存在"诊断-修复纠缠"问题：单一模型同时处理视觉行为证据解读和代码修正，导致反馈循环不透明、突变理由模糊，且无法跨运行保留算法见解，亟需实现可审计且高效的策略搜索。
AI.method: REFLEX采用解耦架构：1）视觉驱动的Critic将任务特异性行为证据提炼为结构化、可审计的诊断报告；2）文本优化的Actor利用诊断报告和持续进化的技能记忆库（Skill Memory）合成子代策略；3）技能记忆库可跨运行重用代码片段，实现程序性知识迁移。
AI.result: 在Lunar Lander、Acrobot、Pendulum控制基准和36维天线阵列合成任务中，REFLEX表现出卓越的样本效率：Acrobot和Pendulum在10次LLM调用内解决，Lunar Lander达到1.092的最佳归一化加权分数，在显著加速透明策略早期发现的同时保持极具竞争力的最终性能。
AI.conclusion: 视觉诊断与代码生成的结构化解耦能够实现可审计、高效的演化策略搜索，并且跨运行的知识迁移机制进一步提升了样本效率和策略透明度。

title: Scalar-pathway fidelity improves physical accuracy in short-range equivariant interatomic potentials
summary: Accurate interatomic potentials enable molecular dynamics of materials, molecules, and interfaces beyond density-functional-theory length and time scales. Equivariant neural network potentials have improved the representation of local geometry. However, their deployable energy surfaces ultimately manifest through invariant scalar channels, whose aggregation and spectral resolution remain comparatively underexamined. Here we use Physics-Aware Neighborhood (PAN) pooling and Physics-Guided Spectral (PGS) mixers as controlled scalar-pathway probes: lightweight, symmetry-preserving modifications that act only on \(\ell=0\) channels while leaving the equivariant tensor backbone unchanged. Using MACE as a high-body-order mechanistic scaffold, PAN adds coordination-sensitive amplitude modulation, whereas PGS augments edge and readout scalar features with radial and tapered spectral bases. Across metallic Ag, covalent Si, a short-range ionic LiF/Li--F subset, and MD17/rMD17 molecules, this scalar-pathway correction reduces MACE force errors by 22--27\% and energy errors by 19--22\%; on systems with stress labels, stress errors decrease by 27--28\%, at approximately 5\% additional inference-FLOPs cost. Directionally consistent gains in Allegro and NequIP further indicate that the correction is portable across distinct short-range equivariant backbones, although effect sizes remain architecture-dependent. These results identify scalar-pathway fidelity as a practical design dimension for short-range equivariant interatomic potentials.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两种轻量级标量路径修正方法（PAN池化和PGS混合器），在不改变等变张量主干的情况下，通过改进等变神经网络势中\(\ell=0\)通道的标量表示，将MACE力误差降低22-27%、能量误差降低19-22%、应力误差降低27-28%，仅增加约5%的推理FLOPs开销，且该修正可迁移至Allegro和NequIP等不同等变骨架。
AI.motivation: 现有等变神经网络势（如MACE）虽通过等变表示改进了局部几何表征，但其最终的能量表面依赖于不变标量通道的聚合与谱分解，而这一标量路径的设计尚未被充分研究。作者旨在探索标量路径的保真度作为短程等变原子间势的一个实用设计维度。
AI.method: 以MACE为高体序机制骨架，引入两种轻量级、对称性保持的标量路径修正：(1) Physics-Aware Neighborhood (PAN) pooling——对\(\ell=0\)通道添加配位数敏感的幅度调制；(2) Physics-Guided Spectral (PGS) mixers——用径向和锥形谱基增强边特征和读出标量特征。两种操作仅作用于标量通道，不改变等变张量主干。
AI.result: 在金属Ag、共价Si、短程离子LiF/Li-F子集及MD17/rMD17分子上，标量路径修正使MACE力误差降低22-27%，能量误差降低19-22%；含应力标签的系统上应力误差降低27-28%，仅增加约5%推理FLOPs。修正可迁移至Allegro和NequIP，但效果幅度依赖于具体架构。
AI.conclusion: 标量路径保真度是短程等变原子间势的一个实用设计维度，简单的标量路径修正即可显著提升等变神经网络势的预测精度，且计算开销极小。

title: ROSA-RL: Uncertainty-Aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning
comment: 8 pages, 2 figures, 2 tables. Copyright 2026 IEEE. This is the accepted manuscript for 2026 IEEE International Conference on Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITSC), not the final published version
summary: Roundabouts challenge automated driving in mixed traffic, as heterogeneous and non-deterministic human behavior, unknown driving intentions, and high interaction complexity create uncertainty about whether the conflict zone will be blocked or available at the moment of entry. We present ROSA-RL -- uncertainty-aware Roundabout Optimized Speed Advisory with Reinforcement Learning. It enables safe and efficient roundabout entry for automated and human-driven vehicles in mixed traffic through probabilistic conflict forecasting. A Transformer-based model predicts conflict zone occupancy over a five-second horizon, capturing multi-agent interactions to anticipate upcoming conflicts and available gaps. The prediction outputs encode uncertainty in future motion and intent, and augment the state of a classical RL framework, enabling uncertainty-aware speed coordination. Evaluated in simulations grounded in real-world data, ROSA-RL can effectively handle uncertainty and outperform a comparable model-based baseline, closing the gap to an ideal setting assuming fully known occupancy while improving traffic efficiency and safety. The source code of this work is available under: github.com/urbanAIthi/ROSA-RL.

AI.tldr: ROSA-RL 提出了一种基于强化学习和Transformer概率冲突预测的混合交通环岛速度协调方法，通过不确定性感知实现安全高效的环岛入口通行，在仿真中优于模型基线并接近理想设置。
AI.motivation: 混合交通中环岛场景因人类行为异质、驾驶意图未知及交互高度复杂，导致冲突区域在入口时刻是否可用存在不确定性，现有方法难以安全高效应对。
AI.method: 使用Transformer模型预测未来5秒的冲突区域占用概率，编码多智能体交互的不确定性，并将预测输出作为强化学习的状态增强，实现不确定性感知的速度协调。
AI.result: 在基于真实数据的仿真评估中，ROSA-RL有效处理不确定性，优于基于模型的对比基线，接近理想全知设置的性能，同时提升了交通效率和安全性。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性感知的强化学习结合Transformer概率预测能够有效弥合混合交通环岛场景中理想与现实的性能差距，代码已开源。

title: SkillWiki: A Living Knowledge Infrastructure for Agent Skills
summary: While knowledge is managed through Wikipedia and software through GitHub, agent skills still lack an infrastructure for large-scale production, governance, and evolution. SkillWiki is a living knowledge infrastructure that supports the organization, grounding, and continuous evolution of agent skills by transforming heterogeneous knowledge into reusable skill assets linked to their originating evidence. Our demonstration presents the complete skill lifecycle, from knowledge ingestion and skill production to provenance-aware exploration, governance, and execution-driven evolution. SkillWiki highlights a future in which knowledge, skills, and execution experience co-evolve within a shared infrastructure. The live demonstration and source code are publicly available at https://github.com/Huangdingcheng/SkillWiki.

AI.tldr: SkillWiki 是一个支持智能体技能全生命周期（知识摄取、技能生产、溯源探索、治理和执行驱动演化）的基础设施，将异构知识转化为可复用的技能资产，并链接到原始证据。
AI.motivation: 当前知识通过维基百科管理、软件通过GitHub管理，但智能体技能缺乏大规模生产、治理和演化的基础设施，需要统一平台来组织、落地和持续演进技能。
AI.method: 通过将异构知识转化为可复用的技能资产并与原始证据链接，构建从知识摄取、技能生产到溯源探索、治理和执行驱动演化的完整技能生命周期基础设施。
AI.result: 实现了完整的技能生命周期演示，包括知识摄取、技能生产、溯源探索、治理和执行驱动演化，代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: SkillWiki 展示了知识、技能和执行经验在共享基础设施中共同演化的未来愿景，填补了智能体技能缺少系统化管理基础设施的空白。

title: Topological Flow Matching
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026. 26 pages, 24 figures. Code: https://github.com/KacperWyrwal/topological-flow-matching
summary: Flow matching is a powerful generative modeling framework, valued for its simplicity and strong empirical performance. However, its standard formulation treats signals on structured spaces, such as fMRI data on brain graphs, as points in Euclidean space, overlooking the rich topological features of their domains. To address this, we introduce topological flow matching, a topology-aware generalization of flow matching. We interpret flow matching as a framework for solving a degenerate Schrödinger bridge problem and inject topological information by augmenting the reference process with a Laplacian-derived drift. This principled modification captures the structure of the underlying domain while preserving the desirable properties of flow matching: a stable, simulation-free objective and deterministic sample paths. As a result, our framework serves as a drop-in replacement for standard flow matching. We demonstrate its effectiveness on diverse structured datasets, including brain fMRIs, ocean currents, seismic events, and traffic flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出拓扑流匹配（Topological Flow Matching），通过在参考过程中引入拉普拉斯派生漂移来注入拓扑信息，从而将流匹配推广为一种拓扑感知的生成框架，在脑fMRI、洋流、地震事件和交通流等结构化数据上展现出有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准流匹配将结构化空间上的信号（如脑图fMRI数据）视作欧几里得空间中的点，忽视了其域结构丰富的拓扑特征。
AI.method: 将流匹配重新解释为求解退化薛定谔桥问题，并通过在参考过程中引入拉普拉斯派生漂移来注入拓扑信息，同时保留流匹配的稳定、免模拟目标和确定性样本路径特性。
AI.result: 在脑fMRI、洋流、地震事件和交通流等多种结构化数据集上验证了有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法可作为标准流匹配的即插即用替代方案，在保持原有优势的同时捕捉底层域的结构信息。

title: TNODEV: Toolbox for Neural ODE Verification
comment: 29 pages, 7 figures, Under review in TMLR
summary: Neural ordinary differential equations (neural ODE) have started to appear in safety critical settings such as continuous-time controllers for cyber-physical systems and classifiers integrated into automated decision pipelines, raising the question of whether their behavior can be formally verified. Existing tools dedicated to neural ODE provide only a single reachability call without iterative input set refinement, limiting the precision of their verdicts to whatever one reachability call can deliver. We present TNODEV, the first sound formal verifier for neural ODE that integrates a falsification checker, a fast interval-based reachability backend based on continuous-time mixed monotonicity, a verification and refinement loop with three input-set splitting heuristics, and a parallel scheduler in a single end-to-end pipeline. TNODEV supports safe-set inclusion verification on pure neural ODE, neural ODE in closed loop with a neural network controller and general neural ODE (GNODE), with the safe set specified either as an interval or as the half-space intersection induced by a target classification label. We evaluate TNODEV on a range of benchmarks across safe-set inclusion and classification-robustness properties, including a direct reachability comparison against NNV~2.0 and CORA and a verification comparison against NNV2.0 on MNIST general neural ODE classifiers.

AI.tldr: TNODEV 是首个将 falsification 检查、基于连续时间混合单调性的快速区间可达性后端、三种输入集分割启发式的验证与精化循环以及并行调度器集成到单一端到端流水线中的神经 ODE 形式化验证器，支持安全集包含验证和分类鲁棒性验证。
AI.motivation: 神经 ODE 已出现在安全关键场景（如 CPS 连续时间控制器和自动化决策流水线中的分类器），但现有工具仅提供单次可达性调用，缺乏迭代输入集精化，限制了验证结论的精度。
AI.method: 提出 TNODEV，集成 falsification 检查器、基于连续时间混合单调性的快速区间可达性后端、三种输入集分割启发式的验证与精化循环以及并行调度器。支持纯神经 ODE、闭环神经 ODE 和一般神经 ODE（GNODE）的安全集包含验证。
AI.result: 在安全集包含和分类鲁棒性基准上进行了评估，包括与 NNV 2.0 和 CORA 的直接可达性比较，以及在 MNIST 一般神经 ODE 分类器上与 NNV2.0 的验证比较。
AI.conclusion: TNODEV 是首个端到端的形式化验证器，通过迭代精化循环提升了神经 ODE 验证的精度，并在多个基准上验证了有效性。

title: Can LLM Coding Agents Reason About Time Series?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly being used for automated decision-making systems in finance, healthcare, or environmental monitoring. Time series data are ubiquitous in these fields, yet hard to process automatically. Can time series be analyzed by LLM agents? We examine three approaches: providing the agent with raw numerical data, using the LLM as a coding agent, or a combination of both. In the coding agent setup, the model iteratively queries the data using Python code. Using two time series understanding benchmarks, we show that agents with code access can outperform models processing raw data by up to 10%. However, even the best performing agent still answers about 22-34% of the questions incorrectly. To get insights into models' strategies and reasoning gaps, we analyze the model outputs with a strong LLM judge. Our analysis reveals that coding agents can select appropriate statistical tests, but often miss important nuances. Meanwhile, models with access to raw data can reach the right conclusions using back-of-the-envelope calculations.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了LLM代理在时间序列分析中的三种方法：原始数据处理、代码代理以及两者结合。代码代理相比原始数据处理性能提升最高达10%，但最优代理仍有22-34%的问题回答错误。代码代理能选择合适统计测试但常忽略细微差异，而原始数据模型可通过粗略计算得出正确结论。
AI.motivation: 时间序列数据在金融、医疗、环境监测等领域普遍存在且难以自动处理，而LLM正越来越多地被用于这些领域的自动决策系统，因此探究LLM代理能否有效分析时间序列数据具有重要实用价值。
AI.method: 设计了三种对比方法：1) 向代理提供原始数值数据；2) 将LLM作为代码代理（迭代使用Python代码查询数据）；3) 两者结合。使用两个时间序列理解基准进行评测，并通过强LLM裁判分析模型输出策略与推理差距。
AI.result: 代码代理相比原始数据处理性能提升最高达10%，但最优代理仍错误回答22-34%的问题。代码代理能选择合适统计测试但常忽略关键细微差异，原始数据模型则可通过粗略心算（back-of-the-envelope calculations）得出正确结论。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM代理在处理时间序列数据时虽有潜力（代码代理表现更优），但仍存在显著的推理差距，无法可靠地用于自动化时间序列分析任务。

title: On-Policy Distillation with Curriculum Turn-level Guidance for Multi-turn Agents
summary: Multi-turn agents that plan, invoke tools, and interact with environments offer a promising paradigm for solving complex tasks, yet their capabilities typically rely on very large models whose inference cost is prohibitive in practice.On-Policy Distillation (OPD) is a natural recipe for transferring such capabilities to smaller students, but we find that it suffers a characteristic failure mode in this setting: small student errors compound across turns and push the trajectory out of the teacher's familiar state distribution, so the teacher's supervision becomes least reliable precisely where the student needs it most.We propose Guided On-Policy Distillation (Guided-OPD), a simple yet effective algorithm that mixes teacher- and student-generated turns within each rollout and schedules the teacher's intervention probability along a curriculum that decays to zero.Strong guidance keeps early trajectories close to the teacher distribution and is then gradually withdrawn to recover the purely on-policy regime used at inference.On ALFWorld, ScienceWorld, and WebShop, distilling Qwen3 students from a Qwen3-30B-A3B teacher, Guided-OPD improves Score by 21.1\% and Success Rate by 25.5\% over vanilla OPD on average, with larger gains on smaller students.

AI.tldr: 提出Guided-OPD方法，通过在蒸馏过程中混合教师和学生的轨迹并逐步减少教师干预，解决了多轮智能体知识蒸馏中学生错误累积导致教师监督失效的问题，在ALFWorld等任务上相比标准OPD平均提升21.1% Score和25.5% Success Rate。
AI.motivation: 多轮智能体通常依赖超大模型，推理成本高昂。虽然On-Policy Distillation (OPD)可以将大模型能力迁移到小模型，但存在一个特征性失败模式：小模型的轻微错误会在多轮交互中累积，使轨迹偏离教师熟悉的分布，导致教师在最需要监督的地方提供的监督最不可靠。
AI.method: 提出Guided On-Policy Distillation (Guided-OPD)，在每次rollout中混合教师生成和学生生成的轮次，并按照一个衰减到零的课程表来调度教师的干预概率。强引导使早期轨迹贴近教师分布，然后逐步撤除以恢复到推理时使用的纯在策略（on-policy）状态。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld、ScienceWorld和WebShop上，使用Qwen3-30B-A3B教师蒸馏Qwen3学生，Guided-OPD相比标准OPD平均提升Score 21.1%，Success Rate 25.5%，且学生模型越小收益越大。
AI.conclusion: Guided-OPD是一种简单有效的多轮智能体蒸馏算法，通过课程化的教师混合干预策略，有效克服了标准OPD在复杂多轮任务中的错误累积问题。

title: ARB4WM: An Adversarial Robustness Benchmark for World Models in Continuous Control
comment: 24 pages, 10 figures, 5 tables. Source code available at https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM
summary: World models are widely used in robotic and agentic engineering control systems due to their ability to learn latent dynamics for planning and decision-making. As these systems are increasingly deployed in safety-critical settings, understanding their robustness under adversarial conditions has become essential. However, existing evaluations lack a unified benchmark for testing adversarial threats across the policy, value, and latent-dynamics levels of world-model agents. To fill this gap, we present ARB4WM, a unified evaluation framework for pre-deployment robustness and risk assessment of world-model agents under visual perturbations. ARB4WM defines five white-box loss objectives across these three levels and studies their effects when combined with single-step or multi-step perturbation strategies and temporal attack modes, including full-frame, half-sequence, and sparse-frame exposure. Specifically, we evaluate four Dreamer-style agents across 20 tasks from MetaWorld and the DeepMind Control Suite under different loss objectives, perturbation strategies, and temporal attack modes. Results show that attacks targeting value estimation, latent representations, and RSSM dynamics can be as damaging as direct policy disruption, and that early or frequent perturbations are especially harmful, while input-level defenses provide limited recovery under adaptive attacks. These findings suggest that safety, risk, and reliability assessment for world models should cover multiple component-oriented attack objectives and temporal exposure protocols rather than relying solely on action-space robustness. Source code is available at https://github.com/zaoanguai/ARB4WM.

AI.tldr: ARB4WM是一个统一评估框架，用于在视觉扰动下对世界模型智能体进行部署前的鲁棒性和风险评估。该框架定义了五个跨策略、值和潜动态三个层次的白盒损失目标，并结合单步/多步扰动策略和时间攻击模式（全帧、半序列、稀疏帧）进行评估。在MetaWorld和DeepMind Control Suite的20个任务上评估了四种Dreamer风格智能体，发现针对值估计、潜表示和RSSM动力学的攻击与直接策略破坏同样有害，早期或频繁扰动尤其危险。
AI.motivation: 现有评估缺乏统一基准来测试世界模型智能体在策略、值和潜动态层次上的对抗性威胁。
AI.method: 定义了五个跨三个层次的白盒损失目标，结合单步/多步扰动策略和三种时间攻击模式（全帧、半序列、稀疏帧），在MetaWorld和DeepMind Control Suite的20个任务上评估四种Dreamer风格智能体。
AI.result: 针对值估计、潜表示和RSSM动力学的攻击与直接策略破坏同样有害；早期或频繁扰动尤其有害；输入级防御在自适应攻击下恢复能力有限。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的安全、风险和可靠性评估应覆盖多个面向组件的攻击目标和时间暴露协议，而非仅依赖动作空间鲁棒性。

title: The BD-LSC Dataset: Facilitating the Benchmarking of Models for Lexical Semantic Change Detection in Slang and Standard Usage
summary: Automatic semantic change detection aims to identify how word meanings shift over time, offering insights into both linguistic and societal change. Despite recent progress in computational lexical semantic change (LSC), existing benchmarks and methods struggle to capture bi-directional semantic change, particularly cases where words simultaneously gain and lose senses. This problem is especially challenging for words that have both slang and standard meanings. To address these gaps, we introduce two complementary benchmark datasets. The Bi-Directional Lexical Semantic Change (BD-LSC) dataset captures sense gain, sense loss, and stability across three time periods, enabling the study of complex semantic trajectories. The SlangTrack Word Sense Disambiguation (ST-WSD) dataset provides fine-grained, instance-level sense annotations for words combining slang and standard usages, supporting systematic benchmarking of WSD and semantic change detection models. Using these benchmarks, we systematically evaluate models across different methodological families: unsupervised clustering using contextualised embeddings, supervised machine learning, transformer-based models, and state-of-the-art large language models. Among the evaluated systems, the few-shot GPT-4o model achieved the strongest aggregate performance on Exact Sense Match (ESM) and multi-label accuracy; however, Macro-F1 scores near 0.5 across all systems show that rare slang senses remain difficult, which we identify as the central open challenge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出两个新基准数据集（BD-LSC和ST-WSD）以解决双义词义变化检测难题，系统评估了多种模型，发现Few-shot GPT-4o在精确义项匹配上表现最佳，但所有模型在罕见俚语义项上的Macro-F1仅约0.5，这是当前核心挑战。
AI.motivation: 现有词汇语义变化检测基准和方法难以捕捉双向语义变化（同时获得和丢失义项），尤其是兼具俚语和标准用法的词汇。为弥补这一空白，需要构建能支持复杂语义轨迹（义项获得、丢失、稳定）及细粒度实例级标注的基准数据集。
AI.method: 构建BD-LSC基准（覆盖三个时间段的义项获得、丢失和稳定）和ST-WSD基准（俚语与标准用法混合的实例级义项消歧标注）；系统评估无监督聚类、有监督机器学习、Transformer和LLM（包括Few-shot GPT-4o）四类方法。
AI.result: Few-shot GPT-4o在精确义项匹配和多标签准确率上聚合性能最优；但所有系统的Macro-F1均在0.5左右，表明罕见俚语义项检测仍是核心瓶颈。
AI.conclusion: 当前方法在罕见俚语义项检测上存在显著不足，这是该领域的核心开放挑战；所提基准可有效支撑后续研究。

title: Reinforcement Learning for LLM-based Event Forecasting
comment: Submitted internally at the University of Oxford in Oct 2025, migrated to arXiv on Jun 2026
summary:
We use Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), a recently devised sample and memory efficient reinforcement learning method, to finetune pretrained LLMs in the range of 1.5B to 14B parameters equipped with the ability to get current information through the use of a Wikipedia revisions tool, or news summaries, to forecast real events beyond the knowledge cutoff of the LLM, as well as problems made to simulate different aspects of the dynamics of that training.
  We use the results of these experiments to comment on the scaling capability of LLMs for forecasting, as well as classify how judgmental forecasting fits into the verifiable/unverifiable domain taxonomy, considering the impact of the inherent aleatoric uncertainty when forecasting future events (e.g. the roll of a die).
  As a result of the GRPO training, we manage to bring a 1.5B parameter transformer (Qwen 2.5 1.5B) to forecasting performance superior to Claude Sonnet 3.5 over the same dataset as measured by cross entropy from the market agreed probabilities. We also discuss various dead ends on the path to this result.

AI.tldr: 本文使用GRPO强化学习方法微调1.5B-14B参数规模的LLM，使其通过Wikipedia修订工具或新闻摘要获取实时信息来预测未来事件。实验表明，1.5B的Qwen 2.5模型经过GRPO训练后，在预测性能上超越了Claude Sonnet 3.5（以交叉熵衡量），并探讨了预测任务的归类和可验证性问题。
AI.motivation: 探索GRPO这一样本和内存高效的强化学习方法是否能够有效微调LLM，使其具备超越知识截止日期的实时事件预测能力，并研究LLM在预测任务上的规模缩放能力。
AI.method: 使用GRPO对1.5B到14B参数规模的预训练LLM进行微调，赋予模型通过Wikipedia revisions工具或新闻摘要获取当前信息的能力，以预测真实世界事件和模拟问题。通过交叉熵对比市场预测概率来评估性能。
AI.result: 1.5B参数的Qwen 2.5模型经GRPO微调后，在预测数据集上的交叉熵低于Claude Sonnet 3.5，取得了更优的预测性能。
AI.conclusion: GRPO能够有效提升小规模LLM的预测能力，使其超越更大规模的模型；同时揭示了预测任务在可验证/不可验证域分类中的位置，以及固有偶然不确定性对预测的影响。

title: CoffeeBench: Benchmarking Long-Horizon LLM Agents in Heterogeneous Multi-Agent Economies
summary: As LLM agents become capable of increasingly long-horizon tasks, evaluating their performance in economic systems is becoming increasingly important. Unlike existing benchmarks that primarily evaluate a single agent interacting with a passive environment, economic systems are inherently multi-agent, requiring autonomous agents to communicate, negotiate, and transact while pursuing their own objectives over extended periods. We introduce CoffeeBench, a benchmark for evaluating LLM agents in a long-horizon multi-agent economy composed of heterogeneous firms. In CoffeeBench, two farmers, two roasters, and two retailers autonomously operate their businesses over a 90-day simulation, each seeking to maximize cumulative net income through communication and transactions while managing cash, inventory, and pricing. The evaluated model controls one coffee roaster, while the remaining firms are controlled by fixed reference agents. Across several recent open-weight and proprietary LLMs, all models outperform a passive baseline that takes no actions, with most achieving positive net income. Analysis of agent behavior reveals substantial differences in long-horizon economic interaction: higher-performing models communicate more actively with other firms, whereas Claude~Haiku~4.5 exhibits an idle-drift failure mode, repeatedly choosing inaction despite producing coherent assessments and plans. We release our code and agent trajectories to support future research.

AI.tldr: CoffeeBench是一个用于评估LLM代理在长期多智能体经济系统中表现的基准测试。该基准模拟由异构公司组成的90天经济环境（2个农民、2个烘焙商、2个零售商），被评估模型控制一个咖啡烘焙商，与其他固定参考代理交互。研究发现在多个模型中，高性能模型更积极地与其他公司沟通，而Claude Haiku 4.5存在"空闲漂移"故障模式。
