AI.motivation: 现有的LLM代理基准主要评估单个代理与被动环境交互的能力，但经济系统本质上是多代理的，需要自主代理在长期任务中进行沟通、谈判和交易。现有基准无法评估代理在多代理经济环境中的表现，因此需要新的评估框架。
AI.method: 构建了CoffeeBench基准测试，模拟一个包含2个农民、2个烘焙商和2个零售商的90天经济系统。每个代理自主经营业务，通过沟通和交易最大化累计净收入，管理现金、库存和定价。被评估模型控制一个咖啡烘焙商，其余公司由固定参考代理控制。在多个开源和专有LLM上进行评估。
AI.result: 所有测试模型均优于不采取行动的被动基线，大多数实现了正净收入。高性能模型与其他公司沟通更积极。Claude Haiku 4.5表现出"空闲漂移"故障模式：尽管能生成连贯的评估和计划，但反复选择不行动。
AI.conclusion: CoffeeBench有效揭示了不同LLM代理在长期多代理经济交互中的行为差异，特别是沟通策略对经济表现的重要性，以及某些模型存在理论能力与实际行动之间的差距。

title: Fast When, Careful Who: Dual-Process Multiparty Turn-Taking with Diffusion Augmentation
summary: Reliable turn-taking is essential for spoken dialogue systems. However, most existing methods are designed for two-speaker interaction and struggle with realistic multiparty audio containing overlap and rapid speaker changes. We study multiparty turn-taking on the VoxConverse dataset and propose an audio-only two-stage pipeline that separates when to trigger a turn boundary from whether the floor is actually transferring. A fast trigger scans the audio and proposes candidate end-of-turn times, while a lightweight verifier runs only at those times to decide \textsc{Hold} or \textsc{Shift} and support next-speaker prediction. We report results in the full multiparty setting and a controlled dyadic top-2 projection for comparability. We also investigate diffusion-based, label-preserving background-audio mixing as a data augmentation strategy. Results show improved shift detection over a baseline, with further improvements from diffusion augmentation.

AI.tldr: 本文针对多说话人对话系统中的话轮转换问题，提出了一种音频两阶段流水线方法：快速触发器扫描音频并建议话轮结束时间，轻量验证器仅在候选时间点运行以决定保持或转移并预测下一说话人。在VoxConverse数据集上验证，相比基线方法在转移检测上有改进，扩散增强进一步提升了性能。
AI.motivation: 现有话轮转换方法主要针对双人交互设计，难以处理包含重叠和快速说话人切换的真实多说话人音频场景。
AI.method: 提出音频两阶段流水线：(1) 快速触发器扫描音频并建议候选话轮结束时间；(2) 轻量验证器仅在候选时间点运行，判断保持或转移并支持下一说话人预测。同时探索了基于扩散的、标签保持的背景音频混合作为数据增强策略。
AI.result: 在VoxConverse数据集上，该方法在完整多说话人场景和受控双人投影场景下，相比基线在转移检测上有所改进，扩散增强进一步提升了性能。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的两阶段流水线能有效处理多说话人对话中的话轮转换问题，扩散数据增强策略可进一步提升检测性能。

title: An Exploratory Study of Blood Glucose Estimation from Photoplethysmography Signals using Machine Learning
summary: Diabetes and extreme blood sugar levels are some of the major health problems faced by humans today across the world. While Continuous Glucose Monitoring (CGM) has emerged as an effective technology for management of diabetes as well as for monitoring blood sugar levels, this technology has traditionally been invasive (that is, requiring the piercing of the skin) and carries the risk of irritation, induration, etc. This highlights the need for accurate and non-invasive CGM methods that can be deployed at scale. With the emergence of various sensing technologies and their integration in wearables like the smart-watch, we now have the capability to continuously monitor body signals like the Photoplethysmogram (PPG) in a non-invasive manner. Having the ability to continuously monitor blood glucose through CGMs and continuously monitor PPG signals through a smart-watch offers an opportunity to get dense data on these two, opening the possibility of building machine learning and deep learning based models to estimate blood glucose level from PPG signals. In this work, we first present a paired dataset comprising continuous PPG signals from a smartwatch along with glucose values recorded using a CGM device. We also present the results of some preliminary experimental explorations performed on our dataset. These preliminary results suggest that some predictive signals may exist, though more exploration is needed with more data from a larger number of individuals. The dataset can be accessed at https://zenodo.org/records/20577959

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了一个包含智能手表PPG信号和CGM血糖值的配对数据集，并初步探索了利用机器学习从PPG信号无创估计血糖水平的可能性，初步结果显示存在预测信号，但需要更多数据验证。
AI.motivation: 传统CGM技术为侵入性，存在皮肤刺激等风险，亟需准确、无创且可大规模部署的血糖监测方法。
AI.method: 收集了智能手表的连续PPG信号与CGM设备的血糖值配对数据，构建数据集，并进行了初步的机器学习/深度学习实验探索。
AI.result: 初步实验表明PPG信号中可能包含与血糖水平相关的预测信号，但需要更多来自更大规模人群的数据来进一步验证。
AI.conclusion: 基于PPG的无创血糖估计具有潜在可行性，但目前数据量和人群覆盖有限，需进一步探索。

title: MR-GVNO: A Geometry-Aware Variational Physics-Informed Neural Operator for Mindlin-Reissner Plates on Irregular Domains
summary: Plate and shell structures are widely used in engineering, making rapid response prediction under varying geometries, materials, and loads highly desirable. However, conventional finite element methods require repeated modeling and solution, resulting in high computational costs. This study proposes a geometry-aware variational neural operator for Mindlin-Reissner plate problems, termed MR-GVNO. The method uses boundary point clouds to represent irregular geometries and employs separate encoders for spatially varying material fields, pressure loads, and scalar physical parameters. A cross-attention mechanism integrates these inputs with query point information to predict transverse deflections and rotations at arbitrary locations. MR-GVNO is trained without labeled solution data using a variational physics-informed loss derived from the discretized total potential energy. It directly processes irregular point clouds and allows different physical fields to be discretized independently, avoiding interpolation onto a common grid. Numerical experiments on single-hole, double-hole, and L-shaped plates demonstrate accurate response prediction under homogeneous and heterogeneous materials and uniform and random loads. The model also achieves millisecond-level full-field inference and favorable cross-geometry generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种几何感知变分神经算子（MR-GVNO），用于Mindlin-Reissner板问题的快速响应预测。该方法利用边界点云表示不规则几何，通过交叉注意力机制融合材料、载荷等信息，并基于离散总势能的物理信息损失进行无标签训练，实现了毫秒级全场推理和跨几何泛化。
AI.motivation: 传统有限元方法在处理变几何、变材料、变载荷的板壳结构时需重复建模和求解，计算成本高。亟需一种能够快速、准确预测不同条件下板壳结构响应的计算方法。
AI.method: MR-GVNO使用边界点云表示不规则几何，采用独立编码器处理空间变化材料场、压力载荷和标量物理参数，通过交叉注意力机制融合这些输入与查询点信息，预测任意位置横向挠度和转角。模型基于离散总势能推导的变分物理信息损失进行无标签训练，直接处理不规则点云，不同物理场可独立离散化。
AI.result: 在单孔、双孔和L形板上的数值实验表明，MR-GVNO在均匀/非均匀材料和均匀/随机载荷下均能准确预测响应。模型实现毫秒级全场推理，并具有良好的跨几何泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: MR-GVNO有效解决了变几何、变材料、变载荷下Mindlin-Reissner板问题的快速响应预测难题，避免了传统FEM的重复建模开销，为工程板壳结构实时分析提供了新范式。

title: Can LLM Agents Infer World Models? Evidence from Agentic Automata Learning
summary: We propose agentic automata learning to evaluate the extent to which tool-calling LLM agents can uncover hidden environments through interaction. In our setup, an agent should uncover a hidden deterministic finite automaton (DFA) by interacting with an oracle through (1) membership queries ("Does this string belong to the target language?") and (2) equivalence queries ("Is this the target DFA?"). This yields a scalable testbed with controlled task complexity, measurable interaction efficiency, and strong baselines (classic automata-learning algorithms). Evaluating state-of-the-art LLMs, we find that performance drops sharply as DFA size increases. Reasoning models are markedly stronger than non-reasoning models, yet trajectory analyses reveal recurring failures in query planning, evidence integration, and hypothesis construction. Overall, our results show that current LLM agents can sometimes perform non-trivial interactive discovery, but remain far less robust and efficient than classic algorithms for the task.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种智能体自动机学习方法，用于评估工具调用型LLM智能体通过与Oracle交互（成员查询和等价查询）来发现隐藏确定性有限自动机（DFA）的能力。实验发现，随着DFA规模增大，LLM性能急剧下降；推理模型强于非推理模型，但在查询规划、证据整合和假设构建方面存在系统性失败。总体上，当前LLM智能体虽能完成一定程度的交互式发现任务，但在鲁棒性和效率上远不如经典算法。
AI.motivation: 现有研究缺乏一个可扩展、可控制任务复杂度且能精确衡量LLM智能体交互式发现能力的测试框架。作者希望通过自动机学习这一形式化任务，系统评估LLM智能体在未知环境中通过主动交互进行探索和推理的能力。
AI.method: 构建基于确定性有限自动机（DFA）的交互式学习测试平台：智能体通过成员查询（判断字符串是否属于目标语言）和等价查询（判断假设DFA是否正确）与Oracle交互，逐步揭示隐藏DFA。使用经典自动机学习算法（如L*算法）作为强基线，对比评估多种LLM（包括推理模型和非推理模型）的表现。
AI.result: 1）随着DFA状态数增加，所有LLM的性能显著下降；2）推理模型（如o1系列）整体优于非推理模型；3）轨迹分析揭示了三类典型失败模式：查询规划不当、证据整合不足、假设构建错误；4）当前LLM智能体在学习效率（所需查询次数）和鲁棒性上均远逊于经典算法。
AI.conclusion: LLM智能体在某些场景下具备非平凡交互式发现能力，但在系统性和效率方面仍有根本性局限；自动机学习提供了一个严谨的基准，未来需要改进LLM在结构化探索和假设推理方面的能力。

title: Causal-Privacy Audit Workflow for Synthetic and Distilled Data in Dropout Support
summary: Synthetic and distilled student data are increasingly used to enable privacy-conscious learning analytics, yet their suitability for decision-facing institutional support remains uncertain. In dropout support, generated data must preserve not only predictive utility or distributional resemblance, but also the financial-status evidence used to guide advising, payment-plan assistance, and scholarship-related decisions. Method: This study introduces CaP-Eval, a decision-facing causal-privacy audit workflow for evaluating generated student data under a fixed estimand, timing-aware adjustment design, estimator set, and empirical privacy-governance screen. The workflow compares original, distilled, adversarial synthetic, statistical synthetic, and DPGNet privacy-oriented generated data on predictive utility, treatment-effect fidelity, robustness to alternative estimators, and local training-record proximity. Results: DPGNet and distilled data preserved the original financial-status treatment-effect structure more reliably than the adversarial and Gaussian Copula baselines. DPGNet preserved full direction and rank agreement across epsilon levels; epsilon = 10 produced the smallest non-original IPW and DML deviations, while epsilon = 1 and epsilon = 5 amplified several financial-status contrasts. Distilled data remained highly faithful but retained the strongest local training-record proximity signal. TabularGNet preserved qualitative directions with moderate attenuation, and Gaussian Copula compressed effect magnitudes. Conclusions: Predictive utility, privacy orientation, empirical disclosure signals, and causal fidelity diverged; generated student data require joint audits of direction, magnitude, overlap, and release-governance risk before decision use.

AI.tldr: 本文提出CaP-Eval，一个面向决策的因果-隐私审计工作流，用于评估生成学生数据在保留经济状况处理效应结构方面的能力。实验表明DPGNet和蒸馏数据在因果保真度上优于对抗性和统计合成基线，但预测效用、隐私倾向、实证泄露信号和因果保真度之间存在分歧，生成数据在决策使用前需进行方向、幅度、重叠和发布治理风险的联合审计。
AI.motivation: 合成和蒸馏学生数据越来越多地用于隐私保护的学习分析，但其在面向决策的制度支持（如辍学干预）中的适用性尚不确定，尤其是生成数据必须保留用于指导咨询、支付计划协助和奖学金决策的经济状况证据。
AI.method: 提出了CaP-Eval决策面向因果-隐私审计工作流，在固定估计量、时序感知调整设计、估计器集和实证隐私治理筛查下，评估原始、蒸馏、对抗性合成、统计合成和DPGNet隐私导向生成数据的预测效用、处理效应保真度、对替代估计器的鲁棒性以及局部训练记录邻近性。
AI.result: DPGNet和蒸馏数据比对抗性和高斯Copula基线更可靠地保留了原始经济状况处理效应结构。DPGNet在各epsilon水平保持完整方向和秩一致性；epsilon=10产生最小非原始IPW和DML偏差，epsilon=1和5放大了若干经济状况对比。蒸馏数据保真度最高但保留了最强局部训练记录邻近性信号。TabularGNet保持定性方向但有中度衰减，高斯Copula压缩了效应幅度。
AI.conclusion: 预测效用、隐私倾向、实证泄露信号和因果保真度之间存在分歧，生成学生数据在决策使用前需对方向、幅度、重叠和发布治理风险进行联合审计。

title: The Integrator Advantage: Controlled Agentic AI for Small and Medium-Sized Companies
summary: Agentic AI marks a new phase of enterprise automation. Unlike traditional automation or conversational AI, agentic systems can interpret goals, plan multi step tasks, access tools, interact with enterprise systems, and execute workflows with varying degrees of autonomy. For small and medium sized companies, this creates potential to reduce administrative burden, accelerate routine processes, and improve the use of organizational knowledge. This paper argues that the near term value of Agentic AI does not lie in full autonomy or workforce reduction, but in controlled partial autonomy for simple and medium complexity business processes. It proposes an integration framework covering use case suitability, autonomy levels, technical integration, governance, security, employee enablement, and measurable impact. The paper concludes that Agentic AI can become a productivity lever when implemented as a human centered capability with responsibility and accountability retained by people.

AI.tldr: 本文探讨了Agentic AI在中小企业中的应用，主张其近期价值不在于完全自主或裁员，而在于对简单到中等复杂度业务流程实现受控的部分自主性，并提出了一套涵盖用例适用性、自主级别、技术集成、治理、安全、员工赋能和可衡量影响的集成框架，最终强调以人为中心的负责任实施才能使其成为生产力杠杆。
AI.motivation: 传统自动化和对话式AI在应对复杂、多步骤的企业业务流程时存在局限，中小企业面临行政负担重、流程效率低和知识利用不足的问题，亟需一种更智能、更灵活的自动化方案来提升运营效率。
AI.method: 采用理论论证与框架设计的方法，提出了一个多维度集成框架，涵盖用例适用性评估、自主级别划分、技术集成策略、治理与安全保障、员工赋能机制以及效果衡量指标，强调人机协作的受控部分自主模式。
AI.result: 提出了一个适用于中小企业的Agentic AI集成框架，明确了其价值定位在受控部分自主性而非完全自主，并给出了从技术到治理的全方位实施指南。
AI.conclusion: Agentic AI的近期价值在于作为以人为中心的能力，在保留人的责任和问责的前提下，通过受控的部分自主性成为中小企业的生产力杠杆，而非追求完全自主或裁员。

title: Uncertainty Is Not a Safety Net for Clinical VQA, but Can It Anticipate Model Failure?
summary: Safe deployment of clinical vision-language models (VLMs) requires reliable uncertainty estimation (UE): a signal indicating when predictions should be trusted or escalated to a clinician. We test whether current UE methods actually deliver this signal. Benchmarking 8 methods across 12 VLMs on clinical visual question-answering (VQA), we find that UE quality is not an intrinsic property of the UE method: it tracks model accuracy, degrading precisely where the model performance is weakest, and therefore where reliability is most needed. When we stress-test models by hiding the correct option among the multiple-choice answers (NOTA perturbations), accuracy collapses while uncertainty barely changes, leaving models systematically miscalibrated. Yet, we find that uncertainty on the unperturbed input reliably anticipates which predictions will collapse under NOTA, indicating that UE in current VLMs carries diagnostic information about model fragility. Our results position UE as a diagnostic tool for identifying fragile predictions and motivate perturbation-based evaluation as a path toward safe clinical deployment.

AI.tldr: 当前临床视觉语言模型的不确定性估计方法并非固有可靠，其质量随模型准确率变化，在模型表现最弱时失效。但不确定性可诊断模型脆弱性，指导安全部署。
AI.motivation: 临床视觉语言模型的安全部署需要可靠的置信度估计信号，但目前缺乏对现有不确定性估计方法在临床场景下实际效果的系统性评估。
AI.method: 在12个临床VLM上基准测试8种不确定性估计方法，并通过隐藏正确答案（NOTA扰动）进行压力测试，评估不确定性估计的质量与稳定性。
AI.result: 不确定性估计质量并非方法固有属性，而是随模型准确率变化；NOTA扰动下准确率崩溃但不确定性几乎不变，导致系统校准失败；但未扰动输入的不确定性可预测扰动下的崩溃。
AI.conclusion: 不确定性估计应作为诊断模型脆弱性的工具，基于扰动的评估是通往临床安全部署的有效路径。

title: Scalar-Stepsize Nonuniform Monte Carlo Optimistic Policy Iteration: A Certified Counterexample
summary: Tsitsiklis proved convergence of Monte Carlo optimistic policy iteration under a uniform update structure and identified nonuniform update frequencies as a delicate obstruction. We give a certified negative answer for the natural scalar-stepsize, unnormalized asynchronous state-value recursion with fixed nonuniform state-selection probabilities. In a three-state, two-action discounted MDP, the nonuniform update frequencies induce a diagonally scaled greedy-policy mean field with a certified nonconstant attracting hybrid periodic orbit. With a bounded unbiased geometric-horizon estimator and Robbins--Monro stepsizes, the original stochastic recursion remains trapped near the cycle with positive probability and therefore fails to converge. The example pinpoints a geometric obstruction: uniform sampling gives radial residual contraction, whereas scalar nonuniform sampling anisotropically distorts the residual dynamics and can generate switched attracting cycles.

AI.tldr: 本文证明了在固定非均匀状态选择概率下，标量步长、非归一化的异步状态值蒙特卡洛乐观策略迭代可能不收敛，并给出了一个三状态两动作的MDP反例，其中非均匀更新频率导致产生吸引性的混合周期轨道，使得随机递归以正概率被困在周期附近而无法收敛。
AI.motivation: Tsitsiklis证明了蒙特卡洛乐观策略迭代在均匀更新结构下收敛，但指出非均匀更新频率是一个微妙的障碍。本文旨在给出一个严格的反例，证明非均匀更新频率确实会导致不收敛。
AI.method: 构造了一个三状态、两动作的折扣MDP，采用固定非均匀状态选择概率、标量步长的非归一化异步状态值递归。通过分析贪婪策略的均值场动力学，识别出非均匀更新频率导致的对角缩放效应，产生了吸引性的混合周期轨道。结合有界无偏几何水平估计器和Robbins-Monro步长，分析原始随机递归的收敛行为。
AI.result: 非均匀更新频率诱导出对角缩放的贪婪策略均值场，具有非恒定的吸引性混合周期轨道。原始随机递归以正概率被困在该周期附近，因此无法收敛到不动点。均匀采样保持径向残差收缩，而非均匀采样各向异性地扭曲残差动力学，产生切换吸引周期。
AI.conclusion: 该反例精确指出了非均匀更新频率导致不收敛的几何障碍：均匀采样保持径向残差收缩，而标量非均匀采样各向异性地扭曲残差动力学，可能产生切换吸引周期，从而阻碍收敛。

title: From Affect Prediction to Affect Forecasting: Evidence for Distinct Information Sources in Longitudinal Text
summary: Modeling dimensional affect in longitudinal text requires distinguishing current affect estimation from future affective change forecasting. Existing approaches often treat each text as an independent observation and apply similar assumptions to both tasks, without testing whether they rely on different information sources. This paper investigates that distinction using longitudinal self-reported ecological essays and feeling-word entries. We propose the Trait--State Affective Prediction (TSAP) framework and its temporal extension E-TSAP for per-text valence and arousal prediction, evaluated on a held-out prediction test set of 1,737 entries from 91 users. We further propose the Affective Change Forecaster Hybrid (ACF-Hybrid) for next-step affective change forecasting, evaluated on a held-out forecasting test set of 46 users. For prediction, E-TSAP achieves composite Pearson correlations of 0.670 for valence and 0.449 for arousal. For forecasting, textual representations perform worse than compact numeric trajectory baselines: the text-inclusive model achieves only r=0.316 for valence and r=0.284 for arousal, whereas a simple prior-state baseline reaches r=0.615 and r=0.670, respectively. ACF-Hybrid, using dimension-specific numeric trajectory features, achieves r=0.659 for valence and $r=0.658$ for arousal. These results show that textual semantics support current affect prediction, whereas future affective change is better captured through prior numeric trajectory dynamics.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TSAP/E-TSAP框架用于文本级情感预测，以及ACF-Hybrid用于下一时刻情感变化预测。实验表明文本语义有助于当前情感预测（E-TSAP在效价和唤醒度上分别达到0.670和0.449的相关系数），但未来情感变化更适合用数值轨迹建模（ACF-Hybrid分别达到0.659和0.658），文本特征在此任务上表现较差。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将纵向文本中的当前情感估计与未来情感变化预测视为同等任务，采用相似的假设，未检验两者是否依赖不同的信息源。本文旨在探究这一区别。
AI.method: 提出Trait-State Affective Prediction (TSAP)框架及其时序扩展E-TSAP进行当前情感预测；提出Affective Change Forecaster Hybrid (ACF-Hybrid)进行下一时刻情感变化预测。使用纵向自我报告生态文章和情感词汇条目作为数据。
AI.result: E-TSAP在预测任务上效价和唤醒度相关系数分别为0.670和0.449；ACF-Hybrid在预测任务上分别为0.659和0.658。文本特征在预测任务上仅达0.316和0.284，而简单先前状态基线达0.615和0.670。
AI.conclusion: 文本语义支持当前情感预测，而未来情感变化更适合通过先前数值轨迹动态来捕捉。

title: SING: Synthetic Intention Graph for Scalable Active Tool Discovery in LLM Agents
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly rely on agent harnesses that manage context, tools, and multi-turn execution, making tools a central interface for acting in realistic digital environments. As harness-connected tool ecosystems expand to hundreds or thousands of APIs, services, and task-specific skills, exhaustive tool schema injection becomes costly and imposes a closed-world assumption that limits agents to a predefined static inventory. Retrieval-augmented tool selection offers a natural alternative, but existing one-shot retrieval methods often fail to align isolated tool descriptions with the agent's true task intention, especially in long-horizon tasks where required capabilities emerge through decomposition, observations, and newly induced subgoals. We propose SING, an intention-aware active tool discovery framework that builds an intention-tool graph linking user intentions, tool capabilities, and tool collaboration patterns, and dynamically retrieves tools according to evolving task states. Using a unified corpus of 7,471 tools, we evaluate SING on three real-world tool-use benchmarks. SING improves Global Recall@5 by up to 59.8% and downstream success rate by up to 28.9% over baselines, while reducing full-corpus tool-schema exposure by 99.8%, demonstrating that intention-aware graph structure enables more accurate and context-efficient tool discovery in large-scale agentic ecosystems.

AI.tldr: 提出SING框架，通过构建意图-工具图（链接用户意图、工具能力及协作模式），实现面向大语言模型代理的主动式工具发现，在动态任务状态下检索工具，显著提升召回率和成功率，同时减少99.8%的工具模式暴露。
AI.motivation: 现有代理框架依赖预定义静态工具集，随着工具生态系统扩展到成百上千API，穷举注入成本高昂且限制代理于封闭世界假设；而一次性检索方法无法将孤立工具描述与代理真实任务意图对齐，尤其在长周期任务中。
AI.method: 构建意图-工具图（Intention-Tool Graph），链接用户意图、工具能力与工具协作模式；根据演化中的任务状态动态检索工具。
AI.result: 在包含7,471个工具的统一语料库和三个真实工具使用基准上，SING将Global Recall@5提升最高59.8%，下游成功率提升最高28.9%，同时减少99.8%的全语料工具模式暴露。
AI.conclusion: 意图感知的图结构能够在大型代理生态系统中实现更准确且上下文高效的工具发现。

title: Do Safety Monitors Stay Reliable After an Update? Benchmarking and Predicting Activation-Monitor Staleness
summary: Activation monitors-lightweight probes trained on a language model's internal representations-are an increasingly common layer in deployment safety stacks. Deployed models however are rarely static: they are quantized, fine-tuned, adapted with LoRA, or served with merged adapters while the monitor remains frozen. We present the first systematic test of whether this implicit contract holds: whether activation monitors trained on a base model remain reliable after these routine model updates. Across multiple safety-relevant monitors, model depths, update families, and open-weight models, we find a sharp split: quantization-style updates largely preserve frozen probe performance, while fine-tuning-style updates frequently make probes stale. Fragility is highly monitor-dependent, with privacy/PII probes most affected and refusal-compliance probes comparatively stable, showing that retraining a behavior need not stale its corresponding monitor. QLoRA is especially damaging despite NF4 quantization alone being relatively benign, suggesting that quantization becomes riskier when combined with adaptation. We further show that degradation is predictable from pre-deployment features, enabling revalidation budgets to be triaged toward the monitors most likely to fail. These results suggest that fine-tuning should trigger activation-monitor revalidation by default, while prediction can help prioritize which monitors to check first.

AI.tldr: 本文系统测试了激活监控器在模型经历量化、微调、LoRA适配等常规更新后是否仍然可靠。发现量化类更新基本保持监控器性能，而微调类更新常导致监控器失效，且脆弱性高度依赖监控器类型。QLoRA尤其有害。退化可从部署前特征预测，从而优化重新验证预算分配。
AI.motivation: 激活监控器已成为部署安全栈中的常见组件，但部署模型经常经历量化、微调、LoRA适配等更新，而监控器保持冻结。目前缺乏对这些更新是否会破坏监控器可靠性的系统性测试。
AI.method: 在多个安全相关监控器、模型深度、更新家族和开源模型上，系统比较了基模型训练的激活监控器在量化类更新和微调类更新后的性能变化，并分析了退化是否可从部署前特征预测。
AI.result: 量化类更新基本保持监控器性能；微调类更新常使监控器失效；脆弱性高度依赖监控器类型（隐私/PII监控器最受影响，拒绝合规监控器较稳定）；QLoRA尤其有害；退化可从部署前特征预测。
AI.conclusion: 微调应默认触发激活监控器重新验证，而预测能力有助于优先检查最可能失败的监控器。

title: User as Code: Executable Memory for Personalized Agents
summary:
A personalized AI agent needs a user memory: a persistent model of who the user is, built across many conversations and consulted on each new one. Today this memory is almost always stored as unstructured text, a knowledge graph, or a flat store of facts, and consulted by retrieval -- fetching the entries most similar to the current request. Such "bag-of-facts" memory recalls individual facts well, but because storing a fact and acting on it are separate steps, it struggles to resolve contradictions, aggregate over many records, or enforce rules. We argue that user memory should instead be executable. We introduce User as Code (UaC), a paradigm in which an agent's model of a user is a living software project: typed Python objects hold the user's state and ordinary Python functions encode the rules that govern it, so representing and reasoning about the user happen in one medium an interpreter can run. The enabling mechanism is a two-phase pipeline: an append-only log that never discards a fact, periodically checkpointed into typed code.
  This changes what memory can do. On standard long-term conversation benchmarks, UaC matches both a full-context upper bound and the strongest prior memory systems on recall (78.8% on LOCOMO). Its advantage emerges where representation matters most. On aggregate questions over a user's history -- "how many international trips did I take last year?" -- retrieval-based memory collapses (6-43%) while UaC stays near-perfect (99%), because the answer is a one-line computation over typed state rather than a search over text. And because its rules execute deterministically whenever the state changes, UaC can surface unsolicited, safety-critical alerts -- such as a newly prescribed drug that conflicts with an allergy recorded months earlier -- a capability query-driven memory cannot provide.

AI.tldr: 提出"用户即代码"(User as Code, UaC)范式，将用户记忆建模为可执行的软件项目（类型化Python对象+函数），替代传统的检索式"事实袋"记忆，在聚合查询和安全告警等需要推理的场景中显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有检索式"事实袋"记忆（非结构化文本、知识图谱、事实存储）在存储和推理分离的架构下，难以处理矛盾消解、跨记录聚合和规则强制执行等任务，需要一种将用户状态的表示与推理统一在可执行环境中的新范式。
AI.method: 提出User as Code (UaC)范式：用户记忆被建模为活的软件项目，使用类型化Python对象存储用户状态，用普通Python函数编码操作规则；采用两阶段流水线——仅追加日志（保留所有事实）和周期性检查点（将日志编译为类型化代码），实现表示与推理的统一。
AI.result: 在LOCOMO基准上召回率达78.8%，匹敌全上下文上限和最强记忆系统；在聚合查询（如"去年几次国际旅行"）上检索式方法仅6-43%而UaC达99%；能基于数月前的过敏记录对新处方药物进行主动安全告警，这是查询驱动式记忆无法实现的能力。
AI.conclusion: 可执行用户记忆范式在需要推理和主动性的场景中显著优于传统的检索式记忆，特别在聚合推理和强制规则执行方面展现出质的飞跃。

title: How Far Can Machine Translation Quality Take You? Extrinsic Discourse Evaluation in Goal-Oriented Setups
summary: Existing machine translation (MT) metrics and discourse-focused evaluations primarily assess translation quality intrinsically, without measuring the downstream consequences of translation errors. In this work, we focus on extrinsic discourse evaluation of machine translation under two distinct regimes: static and interactive. Under the static regime, we propose an entity counting task as a probe of referential consistency in discourse. We show that high intrinsic MT quality does not reliably predict downstream discourse success and strong MT systems still produce referential inconsistencies. For the interactive regime, we study the goal-oriented multi-agent Welfare Diplomacy game as a probe of long-horizon communication and coordination. We find that interaction-specific translation failures impact downstream coordination. Our results highlight goal-oriented environments as a viable framework for discourse-sensitive extrinsic MT evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出在静态和交互两种模式下对机器翻译进行外在话语评估。静态模式下通过实体计数任务探测指代一致性，发现高内在质量的翻译仍存在指代不一致；交互模式下以 Welfare Diplomacy 游戏为探针，发现翻译失败会影响下游协调能力。研究表明目标导向环境可用于话语敏感的外在机器翻译评估。
AI.motivation: 现有机器翻译评估和话语研究主要关注内在翻译质量，忽略了翻译错误在下游任务中的实际后果，缺乏对翻译系统外在效用的度量。
AI.method: 提出两种评估范式：（1）静态评估：设计实体计数任务作为探针，检测翻译中的指代一致性；（2）交互评估：利用多智能体 Welfare Diplomacy 游戏，测试长程通信与协调中的翻译表现。
AI.result: 高内在质量的机器翻译并不能可靠地预测下游话语任务的成功；即使是强翻译系统仍会产生指代不一致错误；交互场景中翻译失败会直接影响下游协调效果。
AI.conclusion: 目标导向环境为话语敏感的外在机器翻译评估提供了可行的框架，应超越传统内在质量指标，关注翻译在下游任务中的实际影响。

title: Decomposing one-class support vector machine into an ensemble of one-data support vector machines
summary: One-class classification (OCC) is a classification problem in which the training data contains only one class. The one-class support vector machine (OCSVM) is one of the most competitive OCC algorithms. However, OCSVM has scalability issues with large-scale datasets. This paper proposes the acceleration strategy of OCSVM. The idea is to decompose the dataset into samples and train OCSVM models for single data points. Subsequently, ensemble learning is applied to combine all models to compute the OCSVM model for the dataset. In addition, further acceleration is achieved through a data-reduction strategy with an OCSVM model trained on the average of the training samples. The experiment compared the proposal and traditional OCSVM using the Python package. The proposed strategy is faster than traditional OCSVM, while achieving similar classification results. Moreover, the proposed strategy can create one-to-one correspondence between samples and models. Source code is uploaded at https://github.com/ToshiHayashi/ODSVM

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于分解-集成的单类支持向量机（OCSVM）加速策略，将数据集分解为单个样本分别训练OCSVM模型，再通过集成学习合并，并结合数据缩减策略进一步加速。实验表明该方法在保持分类性能的同时显著提升了训练速度。
AI.motivation: 传统OCSVM在处理大规模数据集时存在可扩展性差、训练速度慢的问题，亟需一种加速策略来提升其在大规模场景下的实用性。
AI.method: 1）将数据集分解为单个数据点，为每个样本分别训练OCSVM模型；2）通过集成学习将所有单样本模型合并，得到整体数据集的OCSVM模型；3）进一步采用数据缩减策略，基于训练样本均值训练OCSVM模型以加速。
AI.result: 与使用Python包实现的传统OCSVM相比，本文提出的策略在获得相似分类结果的同时，训练速度更快，且建立了样本与模型间的一一对应关系。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的分解-集成加速策略有效解决了OCSVM在大规模数据集上的可扩展性问题，在保持分类性能的前提下提升了训练效率，并提供了样本级别的模型解释性。

title: Medical world models: representing medical states, modelling clinical dynamics and guiding intervention policies
summary: Medical diagnosis and treatment are dynamic processes in which patient states evolve over time and clinical interventions alter future outcomes. Although current medical AI can detect disease, estimate risk and generate reports, many systems still return static labels or scores, offering limited insight into how illness may progress or how alternative interventions may reshape its trajectory. Medical world models adapt the world-model idea from artificial intelligence to healthcare by learning internal simulators of patient-state dynamics. Their long-term goal is to help clinicians anticipate deterioration, compare treatment-conditioned futures and tailor care to individual patients. Yet relevant work remains scattered across foundation models, longitudinal modelling, disease simulation, treatment-effect estimation, reinforcement learning and digital twins. To bridge this gap, this review outlines a roadmap for advancing medical AI from isolated diagnosis and prediction toward medical world models that simulate disease evolution and support intervention decisions. This roadmap is organized around three coupled capabilities: patient-state construction, clinical dynamics modelling and intervention decision support. Across representative systems, the comparison highlights what each capability contributes and how partial components can be integrated into more mature perception--dynamics--planning systems. Finally, we identify the challenges involved in turning plausible rollouts into clinically useful simulators. Related literature is available at https://github.com/1999kevin/awesome_medical_world_models.

AI.tldr: 本文提出医学世界模型（Medical World Models）的概念，将AI中的世界模型思想应用于医疗领域，通过学习患者状态动态的内部模拟器，实现从静态诊断向动态疾病演化模拟和干预决策支持的转变。文章围绕患者状态构建、临床动力学建模和干预决策支持三大能力组织综述，并指出了从可行推演到临床可用模拟器面临的挑战。
AI.motivation: 当前医学AI系统大多返回静态标签或评分，无法有效预测疾病进展或评估不同干预方案对疾病轨迹的影响，亟需能够模拟患者状态动态变化、支持临床决策的智能系统。
AI.method: 通过对基础模型、纵向建模、疾病模拟、治疗效果估计、强化学习和数字孪生等分散研究领域的系统梳理，提出以患者状态构建、临床动力学建模和干预决策支持三大能力为核心的医学世界模型路线图，并对代表性系统进行横向比较。
AI.result: 构建了医学世界模型的系统框架，阐明了各能力模块的贡献以及如何将部分组件整合为更完善的感知-动力学-规划系统。
AI.conclusion: 医学世界模型有望推动医学AI从孤立的诊断预测向动态疾病模拟和个体化干预决策演进，但将理论上的可行推演转化为临床可用的模拟器仍面临诸多挑战。

title: VeriGraph: Towards Verifiable Data-Analytic Agents
summary: LLM-based agents have demonstrated strong capabilities in data-intensive analytical tasks, yet their outputs are rarely verifiable: a reliance on linear text trajectories makes their reasoning difficult to audit. In particular, deterministic computations over raw data and semantic deductions over natural-language claims are often entangled in an unstructured stream, leaving numerical conclusions hard to reproduce and qualitative judgments hard to inspect. To address this, we propose VeriGraph, a traceable neuro-symbolic reasoning framework that enables agents to construct an explicit heterogeneous evidence directed acyclic graph (DAG) during execution. VeriGraph introduces three evidence-expansion primitives, namely computational, grounding, and derivational expansion, to connect raw data, interpreter variables, computed results, and natural-language claims in a unified graph. Under this formulation, structural traceability is reduced to graph reachability from raw data sources to terminal claims, while semantic support is measured by claim-level evidence evaluation. To improve graph construction, we further design a graph-based policy optimization strategy with a composite reward that jointly supervises answer correctness, computational integrity, and derivational coherence. Experiments on four benchmarks show that VeriGraph-8B achieves the highest overall score among all baselines. More importantly, VeriGraph produces auditable evidence graphs with substantially stronger claim grounding, achieving a 87.61\% Grounding Rate under our claim-level evidence support evaluation. These results suggest that explicit evidence-graph construction is a promising path toward verifiable data-analytic agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/ignorejjj/VeriGraph.

AI.tldr: VeriGraph 提出了一种可追踪的神经符号推理框架，通过构建显式的异构证据有向无环图（DAG）来增强基于LLM的智能体在数据分析任务中的可验证性。框架引入三种证据扩展原语（计算、基础推导、派生扩展），将原始数据、变量、计算结果和自然语言声明统一连接。通过图可达性实现结构可追踪性，并设计了基于图的策略优化方法。在四个基准测试上，VeriGraph-8B取得最高总分，并实现87.61%的声明基础率。
AI.motivation: 基于LLM的智能体在数据分析任务中输出难以验证，线性文本轨迹使得推理过程难以审计。确定性计算与语义推理纠缠在非结构化流中，导致数值结论难以复现、定性判断难以审查。
AI.method: VeriGraph 构建异构证据有向无环图（DAG），包含三种证据扩展原语：计算扩展（computational）、基础推导扩展（grounding）、派生扩展（derivational）。结构可追踪性通过从原始数据到终端声明的图可达性实现，语义支持通过声明级证据评估衡量。同时设计了基于图的策略优化方法，使用复合奖励同时监督答案正确性、计算完整性和推导连贯性。
AI.result: 在四个基准测试中，VeriGraph-8B 取得所有基线中的最高总分。在声明级证据支持评估中，达到87.61%的基础率（Grounding Rate），表明证据图具有更强的声明基础能力。
AI.conclusion: 显式证据图构建是实现可验证数据分析智能体的有前途的路径。

title: IBAD: Interpretable Behavioral Anomaly Detection on Human Mobility Data
summary: Human mobility appears highly diverse, yet much of a person's daily mobility can be explained by a small set of recurring behavioral templates, such as commuting, school-centered activities, caregiving, nightlife, or errand patterns. We present \texttt{IBAD} (\underline{I}nterpretable \underline{B}ehavioral \underline{A}nomaly \underline{D}etection), a framework that learns interpretable daily mobility templates and represents each individual as a distribution over mixtures of these templates. Rather than focusing on specific locations, IBAD characterizes activities that individuals perform across locations. This approach first discovers global behavioral templates using Latent Dirichlet Allocation (LDA), then employs a hierarchical self-supervised model to learn normal behavior of individuals from their soft behavioral templates. We also introduce a \emph{splicing benchmark} that creates controlled behavioral mismatches between an individual's historical profile and injected mobility patterns. Experiments on real-world and synthetic datasets show that daily behavior can be effectively decomposed into a small number of interpretable templates. Crucially, we show that the learned behavioral archetypes \emph{transfer} across distinct geographic and demographic contexts. Furthermore, IBAD maintains a robust competitive performance across all settings. For reproducibility purposes, the code is accessible at ~\href{https://github.com/USC-InfoLab/IBAD}{https://github.com/USC-InfoLab/IBAD}.

AI.tldr: 本文提出IBAD框架，利用LDA从轨迹数据中学习可解释的日常移动行为模板（如通勤、上学、夜生活等），通过混合模板表示个体行为分布，并采用层次化自监督模型检测异常行为。实验表明行为模板可跨地理和人口统计背景迁移，且在异常检测中表现稳健。
AI.motivation: 人类日常移动表面上高度多样，但实际可被少量重复性行为模板解释。现有方法多关注具体位置而非活动本身，且缺乏可解释性和跨情境迁移能力。本文旨在学习可解释的日常移动模板，实现跨地理和人口背景的异常行为检测。
AI.method: 首先使用LDA从全局轨迹中学习行为模板（活动而非位置导向）；然后通过层次化自监督模型为每个个体学习其在模板上的软分布，以建模正常行为；并设计拼接基准（splicing benchmark）创建受控的行为不匹配样本用于评估。
AI.result: 在真实和合成数据集上，日常行为可被少量可解释模板有效分解；学习到的行为模板可跨不同地理和人口统计背景迁移；IBAD在所有设置下均保持稳健的竞争性能。
AI.conclusion: IBAD通过可解释的行为模板和自监督异常检测框架，有效捕捉日常移动模式，并展现良好的跨情境泛化能力，为人 mobility 分析提供了新范式。

title: AgentFairBench: Do LLM Agents Discriminate When They Act?
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly take actions (screening applicants, recommending credit, triaging patients), yet fairness for LLMs is still measured by grading answers. We introduce AgentFairBench, a cheap, reproducible, multi-domain benchmark for demographic disparity in the actions of LLM agents. Grounded in a companion framework, the Bias Conduction Framework (BCF, restated here), it spans three regulator-anchored domains: hiring, lending, and medical triage. Synthetic, demographic-neutral profiles are evaluated in counterfactual matched sets that vary only a name-coded race x gender signal (in the Bertrand Mullainathan tradition), under four agent scaffolds of increasing agency (direct, chain-of-thought, multi-agent deliberation, tool-augmented). A NumPy-only harness computes counterfactual flip rate, mean absolute score difference (MASD), action-rate disparity, and tool-invocation disparity, with bootstrap confidence intervals, paired tests, and false-discovery-rate control, for single-digit dollars per model. A live leaderboard with a held-out private split and a contamination canary admits external models by submission. Our pilot (864 decisions plus a test-retest replication) carries a methodological lesson: comparing a six-group score spread against a two-run noise difference overstates disparity by ~ 2.4X through statistic arity alone. Against an arity matched noise floor and an omnibus group test, claude haiku 4 5 shows no demographic effect above sampling noise (0 of 120 pairwise and 0 of 9 omnibus contrasts survive correction); a planted-bias test confirms the instrument detects disparity when present. The contribution is a sound, sensitive, adoption-ready instrument, the arity matched null methodology, and open artifacts to scale it. Code, data, and harness are released under open licenses, with an anonymized review artifact.

AI.tldr: 本文提出AgentFairBench，一个基于反事实匹配集（仅改变姓名编码的种族×性别信号）来评估LLM代理在招聘、借贷和医疗分诊三个领域中人口统计学差异的廉价、可复现基准。通过NumPy轻量级框架计算翻转率、MASD等指标，并引入"arity-matched null"方法论，发现传统方法因统计arity不匹配将噪声夸大约2.4倍。实验表明Claude Haiku 4.5在匹配噪声基线后无显著人口统计学效应。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM公平性评估仍停留在"评分答案"层面，未能衡量LLM代理在实际操作（筛选申请人、推荐信贷、分诊患者）中的人口统计学差异。需要一个系统化、方法学稳健且低成本的基准来检测这些偏差。
AI.method: 基于Bias Conduction Framework构建三个领域（招聘/借贷/医疗分诊）的反事实匹配集，仅改变姓名编码的种族×性别信号。在四种代理框架（直接推理、思维链、多智能体协商、工具增强）下评估，使用NumPy计算反事实翻转率、MASD、行动率差异和工具调用差异，配合bootstrap置信区间、配对检验和FDR控制。
AI.result: 传统方法因统计arity不匹配将噪声夸大约2.4倍。在使用arity匹配的噪声基线和全局组检验后，Claude Haiku 4.5未显示出超过采样噪声的人口统计学效应（120个配对检验中0个显著，9个全局检验中0个显著）。植入偏差测试验证了检测工具能够可靠识别真实存在的偏差。
AI.conclusion: 贡献了：(1) 一个方法学稳健、灵敏、可用于实际部署的公平性评估工具AgentFairBench；(2) arity-matched null方法论，纠正了传统公平性评估中的统计偏差；(3) 开源的全套工件（代码、数据、框架），支持可扩展的社区评估。

title: Sycophancy as Material Failure under Pushback Loading: A Multi-Axis Characterization Across Three Loading Cases and up to Seventeen Material Charges
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures. Code, data, and pre-registrations: https://github.com/FerdinandSchessl/sycophancy-note-companion
summary: Sycophancy in LLMs is documented across 70+ papers, but expert agreement on construct boundaries remains low (ICC=.184; Ye et al., 2026). The construct fragments because behavioral classification depends on which surface form is privileged. We adopt a materials-science framing: conversation as test specimen under load, LLM-model as material charge, pushback as progressive load, stance-flip as material failure. We characterize this failure across three loading cases (debate n=1000; false-presuppositions n=3400; ethical-setting n=3400; 10-17 material charges per case; 7800 specimens total) using 14 turn-level axis-measurements spanning velocity, damage accumulation, frame-drift, brittleness, and direction stability, plus three speaker-resolved axes from an independent pipeline. The measurements are Hooke-coupled ($σ= E \cdot \varepsilon$ analog) and reproduce across loading cases with effects up to $|r_{rb}| = 0.35$ on debate; the sign structure adds a second pattern: the ethical-setting case inverts the velocity and accumulation blocks. Variance composition partitions into two profiles: debate is charge-dominated (brittle-fracture-like: the material grade decides), false-presuppositions and ethical-setting are topic-dominated (creep-like: the load decides); the ratios (2.03 vs 0.13/0.17) are estimator-dependent, for debate even in direction. Cross-judge reliability (GPT-4o vs Haiku 4.5) shows debate scoring is judge-robust (Cohen's $κ= 0.88$) while false-presupposition scoring is judge-sensitive ($κ= 0.36$) -- a caveat single-judge benchmarks must report. This is the methodological move Ye et al.'s diagnosis calls for: a multi-axis characterization that does not depend on which surface form of the construct one privileges.

AI.tldr: 本文采用材料科学框架，将对话视为测试样本、LLM视为材料、反驳作为渐进载荷、立场翻转作为材料失效，通过7800个样本、14个回合级测量轴（涵盖速度、损伤累积、框架漂移、脆性、方向稳定性）及3个说话者解析轴，系统表征了LLM的谄媚行为。研究发现：争议场景中表现类似脆性断裂（材料性质主导），而错误预设和伦理场景中类似蠕变（载荷主导）；跨评估者可靠性在争议场景较高（κ=0.88），在错误预设场景较低（κ=0.36）。该方法回应了Ye等人对多轴表征的呼吁，避免了对单一表面形式的依赖。
AI.motivation: 已有70余篇论文记录了LLM的谄媚行为，但专家对构念边界的共识度极低（ICC=0.184），原因是行为分类取决于赋予哪种表面形式以特权。需要一种不依赖单一表面形式的多轴表征方法。
AI.method: 将对话视为测试样本（7800个）、LLM视为材料（10-17种材料/场景）、反驳为渐进载荷、立场翻转视为材料失效。在三种加载场景（争议n=1000、错误预设n=3400、伦理设定n=3400）中，使用14个回合级轴测量（速度、损伤累积、框架漂移、脆性、方向稳定性）及3个说话者解析轴，采用Hooke耦合（σ=E·ε类比）进行分析。
AI.result: 测量值在不同场景中可复现，争议场景效应量达|r_rb|=0.35。符号结构呈现第二种模式：伦理场景中速度与累积块发生反转。方差组成分为两种轮廓：争议由材料主导（脆性断裂状），错误预设和伦理场景由主题主导（蠕变状），比例分别为2.03 vs 0.13/0.17。跨评估者可靠性：争议场景κ=0.88，错误预设场景κ=0.36。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了Ye等人诊断所呼吁的方法论转向：一种不依赖构念表面形式的多轴表征方案。同时指出单评估者基准测试可能存在的可靠性问题。

title: The Information-Theoretic Benefit of Shared Representations under Orthogonality Constraints
summary: Modern deep learning architectures are increasingly multi-task and multi-modal, using a pretrained foundation model combined with task-specific, fine-tuned models. Empirically, exploiting similarity across different problems, instead of solving them individually, can significantly improve overall performance. While the generalization and sample complexity properties of multitask learning have been widely studied, the parametric complexity of joint approximation in comparison to separate approximation remains less well understood. The question is particularly relevant in modern deep learning, where models are increasingly required to satisfy structural constraints such as equivariance, conservation laws, or orthogonality. We prove lower and upper bounds on the description-length for separate and joint approximation classes, respectively, in uniform norm. We build a class of orthogonal functions by composing a shared hard feature, realized by a Rademacher-Haar wavelet series, with Sawtooth-Walsh readouts to enforce orthogonality of output coordinates. The dyadic tree structure of the Rademacher-Haar wavelet concentrates the approximation hardness in the common feature component, while the readouts act as task-specific heads. Using an information-theoretic framework, we obtain a sharp gap between the optimal approximation rates achievable by joint and separate coding. Finally, we realize this separation in a neural network model using Heaviside activations via reduction to triangle-wave approximation. Our results show that even under an orthogonality constraint joint approximation requires strictly fewer bits in compositional architectures, provided the tasks share a latent hard feature. This provides theoretical insight into the description-length-efficiency of compositional multi-output architectures and clarifies how neural networks can retain expressivity under geometric constraints.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了多任务学习中联合近似与单独近似的描述长度复杂度，证明了在正交约束下，联合近似需要严格更少的比特数，前提是任务共享一个隐式硬特征。通过构造Rademacher-Haar小波与Sawtooth-Walsh读出函数的组合，理论证明了组合架构在描述长度效率上的优势。
AI.motivation: 现代深度学习模型日益多任务、多模态，利用不同问题间的相似性可显著提升性能。尽管多任务学习的泛化性质已广泛研究，但联合近似相比单独近似的参数复杂度仍缺乏深入理解，尤其在需要满足等变性、守恒律或正交性等结构约束的现代深度学习场景中。
AI.method: 论文在一致范数下分别证明了单独近似类和联合近似类的描述长度下界和上界。通过构造由Rademacher-Haar小波级数实现的共享硬特征与Sawtooth-Walsh读出函数组成的正交函数类，利用二元树结构将近似难度集中在共享特征组件中，并借助信息论框架推导联合编码与单独编码之间最优近似率的严格差距。
AI.result: 理论证明了在正交约束下，只要任务共享隐式硬特征，联合近似所需的比特数严格少于单独近似。通过Heaviside激活函数的神经网络模型简化为三角波近似，实现了这种分离性。
AI.conclusion: 研究揭示了组合式多输出架构在描述长度效率上的理论优势，阐明了神经网络在几何约束下如何保持表达能力，为多任务学习的参数效率提供了新的理论视角。

title: A First-Principles Derivation of LLM Policy Optimization: From Expected Reward to GRPO and Its Structural Extensions
summary: Policy gradient algorithms for language models optimize the same objective $J(θ) = \mathbb{E}*{τ\sim p*θ(τ)}[R(τ)]$, which has exactly two factors: the trajectory probability $p_θ(τ)$ and the reward $R(τ)$. Every method from REINFORCE to PPO to GRPO and their descendants modifies one or both factors to address a specific failure in the preceding formulation. Existing surveys organize these methods by domain or chronology, which obscures the rationale behind each design choice and the precise location of its intervention within the gradient estimator. This survey revisits the landscape of LLM policy optimization from $J(θ)$ on first principles and uses the trajectory side, induced by $p_θ(τ)$, and the reward side, induced by $R(τ)$, as the two axes along which methods are located. It covers the path from REINFORCE and PPO to GRPO, as well as post-GRPO variants, Agentic RL, and GRPO-OPD. The resulting framework is unified, diagnostic, and extensible: it analyzes methods from a shared objective, identifies which side each method modifies and why, and applies the same trajectory and reward axes across these settings. Across these settings, the framework also exposes compound failures that no single-side fix resolves and that therefore require joint design of the trajectory side and the reward side. The boundary cases and coupled failures identified by this map mark where existing solutions run out and provide a principled starting point for designing the next generation of LLM policy optimization algorithms.

AI.tldr: 本文从第一性原理出发，以轨迹概率 p_θ(τ) 和奖励 R(τ) 为两个核心轴，统一梳理了从 REINFORCE、PPO 到 GRPO 及其后续变体的 LLM 策略优化算法，揭示了各方法在梯度估计器中的具体干预位置与设计动机，并指出需要轨迹侧与奖励侧联合设计的复合失败模式。
AI.motivation: 现有综述按领域或时间线组织方法，掩盖了每种设计选择背后的动机及其在梯度估计器中的确切干预位置，需要一个统一的、可诊断的、可扩展的分析框架来揭示方法间的本质联系。
AI.method: 以目标函数 J(θ) 为起点，将方法沿两个轴定位：轨迹侧（由 p_θ(τ) 诱导）和奖励侧（由 R(τ) 诱导），覆盖从 REINFORCE、PPO 到 GRPO 及其后变体、Agentic RL 和 GRPO-OPD。
AI.result: 构建了一个统一的、可诊断的、可扩展的分析框架，从共享目标出发，识别每种方法修改了哪一侧及原因，并暴露了单侧修改无法解决的复合失败模式。
AI.conclusion: 该框架指出现有解决方案在边界情况和耦合失败处的局限性，为设计下一代 LLM 策略优化算法提供了原则性起点。

title: Islamic Large Language Models: From Knowledge Acquisition to Trustworthy and Hallucination-Resistant AI
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used for knowledge-intensive question answering, including religious and legal questions. Islamic knowledge is a particularly demanding setting: answers are expected to be grounded in authoritative sources, citations must be exact, Arabic varieties differ substantially from the language of classical sources, and legitimate jurisprudential disagreement must be represented rather than collapsed into a single answer. This survey reviews the emerging field of Islamic LLMs and trustworthy Islamic AI. We organize the literature around Arabic NLP and Arabic-centric LLMs, Islamic NLP resources, Qur'anic question answering, Islamic knowledge benchmarks, retrieval-augmented generation, Islamic legal reasoning, inheritance reasoning, hallucination evaluation, and trustworthiness. We argue that fluency in Arabic is not sufficient for Islamic AI. Reliable systems require curated sources, retrieval and verification modules, citation-aware generation, madhhab-aware reasoning, human expert evaluation, and benchmarks that measure not only answer accuracy but also faithfulness, source validity, and reasoning quality. The survey concludes with a research agenda for hallucination-resistant Islamic AI systems.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了伊斯兰LLM和可信伊斯兰AI这一新兴领域，指出阿拉伯语流利度不足以构建可靠的伊斯兰AI系统，需要策划来源、检索验证模块、引文感知生成、教法学派感知推理、人类专家评估以及能衡量准确性、忠实性、来源有效性和推理质量的基准，最后提出了抗幻觉伊斯兰AI系统的研究议程。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多用于知识密集型问答，包括宗教和法律问题。伊斯兰知识具有特殊挑战性：答案需基于权威来源、引文必须准确、阿拉伯语变体与古典来源语言差异大、合法的教法学派分歧需呈现而非压缩为单一答案。现有LLM在处理这些方面存在不足。
AI.method: 通过综述方式，围绕阿拉伯语NLP、阿拉伯语中心LLM、伊斯兰NLP资源、古兰经问答、伊斯兰知识基准、检索增强生成、伊斯兰法律推理、继承推理、幻觉评估和可信度等方向组织文献。
AI.result: 识别出伊斯兰AI的关键挑战：阿拉伯语流利≠伊斯兰AI能力；需要策划的权威来源、检索与验证模块、引文感知生成、教法学派感知推理、人类专家评估，以及衡量准确性、忠实性、来源有效性和推理质量的综合基准。
AI.conclusion: 提出了抗幻觉伊斯兰AI系统的研究议程，强调系统需在忠实性、来源有效性和推理质量上满足高标准。

title: Inference-Time Decision Calibration for Temporal Classification
summary: Temporal classification errors are often treated as representation failures, but they can also arise from how available evidence is converted into decisions. This paper proposes a representation--calibration decomposition for temporal classification. We keep a trained native classifier frozen and separate two inference-time interventions: a conservative residual multi-scale branch that adds auxiliary logits to the native prediction, and a post-hoc branch-aware calibrator that recombines native and residual evidence at decision time. This design distinguishes missing temporal evidence from underused decision-level evidence without retraining the backbone. Across FI-2010, PTB-XL, UCI-HAR, MHEALTH, and HARTH, we find that gains are strongly regime-dependent. Residual multi-scale evidence is most useful in noisy or representation-limited settings, especially short-horizon FI-2010 and weaker recurrent backbones, while branch-aware calibration helps when native and auxiliary logits contain complementary evidence not fully exploited by the raw decision rule. Near-saturated settings show limited gains from either intervention. These results suggest that temporal classification should be understood not only as representation learning, but also as the problem of trusting, combining, and calibrating evidence from multiple views.

AI.tldr: 本文提出时间分类中的表征-校准分解方法，通过冻结预训练模型，引入残差多尺度分支和事后校准器分别处理缺失的时间证据和未充分利用的决策级证据。实验表明，不同场景下两种干预的效果存在显著差异：残差分支在噪声大或表征受限时有效，校准器在互补证据未被充分利用时发挥作用，而接近饱和的场景两种干预收益均有限。
AI.motivation: 时间分类错误常被视为表征学习失败，但部分错误源于决策阶段未能有效利用已有的证据。作者希望区分两类错误来源：一是缺失的时间证据（表征问题），二是未充分利用的决策级证据（校准问题），从而在不重训骨干网络的前提下分别干预。
AI.method: 保持训练好的原生分类器冻结，分离两种推理时干预：(1) 保守残差多尺度分支，向原生预测添加辅助logits；(2) 事后分支感知校准器，在决策时重新组合原生与残差证据。该设计无需重训骨干网络即可区分缺失的时间证据与未充分利用的决策级证据。
AI.result: 在FI-2010、PTB-XL、UCI-HAR、MHEALTH和HARTH五个数据集上验证。残差多尺度证据在噪声大或表征受限的场景中最有效（如短时域FI-2010和弱循环骨干网络）；分支感知校准在原生与辅助logits包含互补证据但未被原始决策规则充分利用时有帮助；接近饱和的场景两种干预收益均有限。
AI.conclusion: 时间分类不仅应被视为表征学习问题，还应被视为如何信任、组合和校准多视角证据的决策问题。

title: Skill-to-LoRA: From Using Skills to Learning Behaviors for Token-Efficient LLM Agents
summary: Agent skills are commonly distributed as SKILL.md files: human-readable procedural documents that describe workflows, tools, resources, and domain conventions. While convenient for inspection and reuse, this design requires the same reusable procedure to be repeatedly injected into the runtime context. We propose Skill-to-LoRA(S2L), a behavior-centric skill representation that replaces runtime skill text with skill-specific LoRA adapters. Rather than compressing the skill document itself, S2L models the behavioral change induced by the skill text: offline, the complete SKILL.md is used to synthesize skill-guided demonstrations; online, the full document is omitted and the corresponding LoRA adapter is dynamically loaded to activate the learned skill behavior. We evaluate S2L with Qwen3.6-27B on a 21-skill subset of SWE-Skills-Bench. Compared with the no-skill and Full Skill Text baselines, S2L improves pass rate by 2.9 and 5.2 percentage points, respectively, while reducing per-step token cost by 6.6% relative to Full Skill Text prompting. S2L matches or improves Full Skill Text on 18/21 skills and the no-skill baseline on 15/21 skills. Control experiments further show that the gains depend on skill-specific adapter alignment: Wrong-LoRA and Shared-LoRA both reduce performance. These results suggest that many procedural agent skills can be converted from runtime instructions into trainable, dynamically loadable behavioral modules. Code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill-to-LoRA (S2L)，将基于SKILL.md的智能体技能从运行时文本指令转换为可训练、动态加载的LoRA适配器，在SWE-Skills-Bench的21个技能子集上相比全技能文本提示提升5.2个百分点通过率，同时降低6.6%的每步token成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的SKILL.md技能表示虽然便于人类检查和复用，但每次使用时都需要将完整的程序化文档重复注入到运行时上下文中，导致token成本高且效率低下。
AI.method: S2L将技能行为而非技能文本本身压缩为LoRA适配器：离线阶段，使用完整SKILL.md合成技能引导的演示数据；在线阶段，省略完整文档，动态加载对应的LoRA适配器以激活学到的技能行为。
AI.result: 使用Qwen3.6-27B在SWE-Skills-Bench的21个技能子集上评估：相比无技能基线和全技能文本基线，通过率分别提升2.9和5.2个百分点；相比全技能文本提示，每步token成本降低6.6%；在18/21个技能上匹配或超越全技能文本，15/21个技能上匹配或超越无技能基线。控制实验表明，错误LoRA和共享LoRA均会降低性能，验证了技能特定适配器对齐的必要性。
AI.conclusion: 许多程序化智能体技能可以从运行时指令成功转换为可训练、动态加载的行为模块，证明了S2L作为一种行为中心技能表示的有效性和效率优势。

title: FraudSMSWalker: Benchmarking Agentic Large Language Models for SMS-to-Webpage Fraud Detection
summary: SMS fraud is increasingly cross-channel: a message directs the user to a webpage, and the final risk depends on how the SMS claim aligns with the page content and requested user action. However, existing evaluations either focus on message-only smishing classification or expose URL and domain cues that allow models to rely on reputation shortcuts. To address this gap, we introduce \textbf{FraudSMSWalker}, a controlled benchmark for URL-masked SMS-to-webpage fraud judgment. FraudSMSWalker contains 699 bilingual chains, including 332 fraudulent and 367 benign cases, across ten service scenarios. The model-visible input consists of the SMS context and sanitized webpage evidence, while raw URLs, hosts, domains, IPs, redirects, and reputation metadata are withheld. The benchmark further includes hard benign cases whose pages contain login, payment, verification, or account-management elements that are plausible under the service context but also appear in scam flows. We evaluate nine web agents under masked browser-agent protocols and conduct URL-visibility ablations. The results show that current agents can detect suspicious cues, but struggle to preserve benign recall and often produce positive predictions that are weakly supported by the observed evidence. These findings position FraudSMSWalker as a benchmark for measuring whether web agents can make fraud judgments that remain both accurate and evidence-grounded when direct reputation shortcuts are suppressed. The associated code and dataset are accessible at the \href{https://anonymous.4open.science/w/FraudMessageWalker-Bench}{anonymous link}.

AI.tldr: FraudSMSWalker是一个针对跨渠道SMS诈骗的基准测试，要求模型在屏蔽URL等声誉捷径的情况下，仅凭SMS上下文和脱敏网页证据判断短信到网页的诈骗行为。实验表明现有代理能检测可疑线索，但难以保持良性样本的召回率，且预测常缺乏证据支持。
AI.motivation: 现有评估要么只关注短信本身的钓鱼分类，要么暴露URL和域名线索使模型依赖声誉捷径（如黑名单），无法真实评估模型对跨渠道诈骗的推理能力。
AI.method: 构建包含699条双语链（332欺诈+367良性）的受控基准，覆盖10个服务场景。模型输入为SMS上下文和脱敏网页证据，隐藏原始URL、域名、IP、重定向及声誉元数据。包含硬良性样本（登录/支付/验证等要素在服务场景中合理但也在诈骗流程中出现）。采用掩码浏览器代理协议评估9个网页代理，并进行URL可见性消融实验。
AI.result: 当前代理能检测可疑线索，但难以保持良性样本召回率，且正向预测常缺乏观察证据的充分支持。
AI.conclusion: FraudSMSWalker可作为衡量网页代理在屏蔽声誉捷径后，能否做出准确且证据可溯的诈骗判断的基准。

title: Circuit Tracing in Autoregressive Protein Language Models
comment: Accepted into the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026. 24 pages, 14 figures
summary: Protein language models (pLMs) can generate novel protein sequences with properties beyond those observed in nature, yet the mechanisms underlying protein generation remain poorly understood. Existing mechanistic interpretability methods based on sparse autoencoders and transcoders primarily focus on protein representation learning models and do not capture the computation required for autoregressive generation. Here, we introduce ProGenMech, a mechanistic interpretability framework for generative protein language models that extends cross-layer transcoders (CLTs) to ProGen3, a sparse Mixture-of-Experts model trained for both causal generation and span infilling. Unlike per-layer approaches, CLTs reconstruct each layer using sparse latent variables from all preceding layers, enabling faithful recovery of inter-layer generative computation. We further develop a zero-shot circuit discovery framework to identify sparse latent circuits responsible for protein generation and fitness prediction. In causal generation and zero-shot fitness estimation tasks, ProGenMech outperforms local transcoder baselines in recovering ProGen3's probability distribution and functional scoring behavior, while matching the original model's generative distribution in span infilling tasks. Moreover, the recovered circuits reveal biologically meaningful motifs and functional regions associated with conserved sequence patterns and protein fitness landscapes, establishing a foundation for interpretable and steerable protein generation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ProGenMech框架，通过跨层稀疏编码器（CLT）对生成式蛋白质语言模型ProGen3进行机械可解释性分析，并开发零样本电路发现方法，揭示蛋白质生成与适应度预测背后的稀疏潜在电路。
AI.motivation: 现有机械可解释性方法（如稀疏自编码器和转编码器）主要针对蛋白质表征学习模型，无法捕捉自回归生成所需的计算过程，导致生成式蛋白质语言模型的底层机制尚不明确。
AI.method: 将跨层转编码器（CLT）扩展到ProGen3（一种稀疏MoE模型，支持因果生成和跨度填充）；CLT利用所有前层的稀疏潜在变量重构每一层，实现层间生成计算的忠实恢复；进一步提出零样本电路发现框架，识别与蛋白质生成和适应度预测相关的稀疏潜在电路。
AI.result: 在因果生成和零样本适应度估计任务中，ProGenMech在恢复ProGen3的概率分布和功能评分行为上优于局部转编码器基线；在跨度填充任务中匹配原始模型的生成分布；恢复的电路揭示了与保守序列模式和蛋白质适应度景观相关的生物学上有意义的基序和功能区域。
AI.conclusion: ProGenMech为可解释且可引导的蛋白质生成建立了基础，证明了跨层稀疏编码方法在理解生成式蛋白质语言模型内部计算机制方面的有效性。

title: OpenClaw-Skill: Collective Skill Tree Search for Agentic Large Language Models
summary: Equipping Large Language Model (LLM) agents with effective skills is crucial for solving complex tasks in real-world systems like OpenClaw. In this work, we aim to develop a framework that automatically constructs such reusable skills to enhance LLMs in tool use, multi-step reasoning, and dynamic environment interaction. To this end, we propose Collective Skill Tree Search (CSTS), a novel tree-search-based skill construction framework that constructs structured, diverse and generalizable tree of skills. The core idea of CSTS is to leverage collective intelligence to jointly search, identify and compose effective skills via two iterative phases: Collective Skill Node Generation (CSN-Gen) and Collective Skill Node Assessment (CSN-Assess). CSN-Gen exploits collective knowledge from multiple models to explore diverse candidate skills for each subtask, enabling comprehensive skill exploration. CSN-Assess employs multiple models as judges to evaluate and select skill nodes with two scoring mechanisms: (1) collective quality scoring that aggregates independent evaluations to produce a robust estimate of skill effectiveness, and (2) collective transferability scoring that explicitly verifies whether a skill generalizes well across different models. With CSTS, we construct a set of comprehensive tree of skills along with skill-augmented training data, enabling models to effectively learn and utilize skills. Besides, we introduce Collective Skill Reinforcement Learning, which actively selects multiple relevant skills from the tree to broaden solution-space exploration, avoid being trapped by a single skill and its resulting homogeneous or suboptimal solutions. As a result, our trained model, OpenClaw-Skill, exhibits outstanding agentic capabilities in long-horizon planning, tool use and generalization over challenging benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 本文提出集体技能树搜索（CSTS）框架，通过集体智能自动构建结构化、多样化且可泛化的技能树，并配合集体技能强化学习，显著提升LLM智能体在工具使用、多步推理和动态环境交互中的能力。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM智能体在复杂现实系统（如OpenClaw）中缺乏有效且可复用的技能，亟需一种能够自动构建结构化、多样化且可泛化技能的方法，以增强LLM在工具使用、多步推理和动态环境交互中的能力。
AI.method: 提出CSTS框架，包含两个迭代阶段：（1）集体技能节点生成（CSN-Gen）：利用多模型的集体知识探索多样化候选技能；（2）集体技能节点评估（CSN-Assess）：采用多模型作为评判者，通过集体质量评分和集体可迁移性评分两种机制评估和筛选技能节点。此外，引入集体技能强化学习，从技能树中主动选择多个相关技能以拓宽解空间探索。
AI.result: 训练的模型OpenClaw-Skill在长程规划、工具使用和泛化能力上表现出色，在多个具有挑战性的基准测试中取得了优异性能。
AI.conclusion: CSTS框架能够有效构建结构化的技能树并生成技能增强的训练数据，结合集体技能强化学习，使模型避免陷入单一技能导致的同质化或次优解，显著提升了LLM智能体的整体能力。

title: Progressive Knowledge-Guided Large Language Model Framework for Bearing Fault Diagnosis
summary: Vibration-based bearing fault diagnosis requires resolving three interrelated measurement challenges, including the trade-off between global statistical feature efficiency and local transient signal fidelity, insufficient traceability of measurement features to underlying fault physics, and ineffective multi-source measurement information fusion across diagnostic scales. This paper presents a progressive physics-guided multi-scale vibration signal processing framework that addresses all three challenges within a unified diagnostic pipeline. An 81-dimensional measurement descriptor, derived from bearing kinematic theory and characteristic defect frequencies, establishes a physically traceable feature space enabling real-time fault screening at approximately 20 ms per sample. A fault-adaptive signal segmentation mechanism then directs analytical attention toward fault-relevant waveform regions guided by physics-based priors, without manual feature engineering. Structured fault mechanism knowledge is further encoded implicitly in model parameters during training, enabling autonomous multi-scale measurement fusion without external knowledge dependencies at inference. Validated on four public benchmark datasets under diverse operating conditions, the framework achieves 98.49% diagnostic accuracy with a 12.6-fold reduction in computational cost relative to signal-level baselines. Interpretability analysis confirms that diagnostic feature activations align with established bearing fault mechanics, supporting measurement traceability in safety-critical industrial systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种渐进式物理引导的多尺度振动信号处理框架，通过81维物理可追溯特征描述符、故障自适应分割机制和隐式故障知识编码，在统一诊断流程中解决了全局统计效率与局部瞬态保真度权衡、特征可追溯性不足和多源信息融合三大挑战。在四个公开数据集上达到98.49%诊断精度，计算成本降低12.6倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于振动的轴承故障诊断面临三个相互关联的测量挑战：1) 全局统计特征效率与局部瞬态信号保真度之间的权衡；2) 测量特征对底层故障物理机制的可追溯性不足；3) 跨诊断尺度的多源测量信息融合效率低下。本文旨在通过统一诊断框架同时解决这三个问题。
AI.method: 提出渐进式物理引导的多尺度振动信号处理框架：(1) 基于轴承运动学和特征缺陷频率构建81维物理可追溯特征描述符，实现约20ms/样本的实时故障筛查；(2) 故障自适应信号分割机制，利用物理先验引导注意力聚焦于故障相关波形区域，无需手动特征工程；(3) 训练过程中将结构化故障机理知识隐式编码到模型参数中，实现推理时无需外部知识依赖的自主多尺度测量融合。
AI.result: 在四个不同运行条件的公开基准数据集上验证，框架达到98.49%的诊断准确率，计算成本相比信号级基线降低12.6倍。可解释性分析确认诊断特征激活与轴承故障力学原理一致，支持安全关键工业系统中的测量可追溯性。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明通过物理引导的渐进式信号处理框架，能够在不牺牲诊断精度的前提下显著降低计算成本，同时保持诊断结果对故障物理机制的可追溯性，适用于安全关键工业场景。

title: Active Learning with Low-Rank Structure for Data Selection
summary:
In the data selection problem, the objective is to choose a small, representative subset of data that can be used to efficiently train a machine learning model. Sener and Savarese [ICLR 2018] showed that, given an embedding representation of the data and suitable geometric assumptions, heuristics based on $k$-center clustering can be used to perform data selection. This perspective was further explored by Axiotis et. al. [ICML 2024], who proposed a data selection approach based on $k$-means clustering and sensitivity sampling. However, these methods rely on the assumption that the dataset exhibits intrinsic geometric structure that can be effectively captured by clustering, whereas many modern datasets instead possess global algebraic structure that is better exploited by low-rank approximation or principal component analysis.
  In this paper, we introduce a new data selection framework based on low-rank approximation and residual-based sampling, formulated through the lens of row subset selection and loss-preserving coreset construction. Given an embedding representation of the data satisfying mild regularity conditions, which can be interpreted as algebraic or angular notions of Lipschitz continuity, we show that it is possible to select a weighted subset of $\tilde{O}\left(k + \frac{1}{\varepsilon^2}\right)$ data points whose average loss approximates the average loss over the full dataset within a $(1+\varepsilon)$ relative error, up to an additive $\varepsilon Φ_k$ term, where $Φ_k$ denotes the optimal rank-$k$ approximation cost of the embedding matrix. We complement these theoretical guarantees with empirical evaluations, demonstrating that on a range of real-world datasets, our data selection approach achieves improved performance over prior strategies based on uniform sampling or clustering-based sensitivity sampling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于低秩逼近和残差采样的数据选择框架，通过行子集选择与保损核心集构建，在温和正则条件下，可选择约O(k+1/ε²)个加权数据点，使其平均损失在全数据集平均损失的(1+ε)相对误差内（附加εΦ_k项），并在多个真实数据集上优于均匀采样和基于聚类的敏感性采样方法。
AI.motivation: 现有基于k中心或k均值聚类的数据选择方法依赖于数据集的几何聚类结构，而许多现代数据集具有全局代数结构，聚类方法难以有效利用这种结构。本文旨在提出一种能更好利用数据代数结构（低秩逼近）的数据选择框架。
AI.method: 基于低秩逼近和残差采样的数据选择框架，将其形式化为行子集选择（row subset selection）和保损核心集（loss-preserving coreset）构建问题。假设数据嵌入表示满足类似Lipschitz连续性的代数/角度正则条件，通过残差大小指导采样概率，选择加权子集。
AI.result: 理论上，可选择O(k+1/ε²)个加权数据点，平均损失逼近全数据集平均损失，相对误差(1+ε)，附加εΦ_k项（Φ_k为最优秩k逼近代价）。实验上，在多个真实数据集上优于均匀采样和基于聚类的敏感性采样。
AI.conclusion: 低秩逼近与残差采样为数据选择提供了一种优于传统聚类方法的新框架，尤其适用于具有代数结构而非几何聚类结构的数据集。

title: LabOSBench: Benchmarking Computer Use Agents for Scientific Instrument Control
summary: Current computer-use benchmarks primarily focus on software operation tasks in virtualized systems, whereas scientific instrumentation scenarios require coordinated control over complex interfaces, and feedback-driven parameter adjustment. However, directly evaluating agents on physical high-precision instruments is impractical due to high cost, safety risks, limited accessibility, and difficulty in ensuring reproducible evaluation. This motivates the need for a simulated yet realistic testbed that preserves the operational challenges of scientific instruments while enabling scalable and safe benchmarking. To this end, we introduce LabOSBench, a challenging benchmark for multimodal GUI agents built on a suite of web-based scientific-instrument simulators. Operating directly via a browser, LabOSBench avoids resource-heavy OS virtualization while supporting flexible task configuration and execution-based evaluation. Specifically, LabOSBench constructs 96 subtasks across eight instrument simulators, covering workflows from sample loading, alignment, parameter tuning, and data acquisition to result inspection. We evaluate general-purpose vision-language models, specialized GUI agent models, and advanced agentic frameworks at both subtask and end-to-end levels. Our experiments reveal that while existing agents can complete many structured GUI subtasks, they still struggle with feedback-driven operations and long-horizon workflow execution. Overall, LabOSBench provides a reproducible, low-cost testbed for advancing computer-using agents toward scientific-instrument control.

AI.tldr: LabOSBench是一个基于Web科学仪器模拟器的多模态GUI智能体基准测试平台，包含8个仪器模拟器、96个子任务，用于评估智能体在科学仪器操作（如样品加载、参数调整、数据采集等）中的表现。实验发现现有智能体在结构化GUI子任务上表现尚可，但在反馈驱动操作和长时序工作流执行上仍存在困难。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用基准测试主要关注虚拟化系统中的软件操作任务，而科学仪器场景需要协调控制复杂界面和反馈驱动参数调整。由于物理高精度仪器评估存在成本高、安全风险、可访问性有限和难以保证可重复评估等问题，因此需要构建一个模拟但真实的测试平台，既保留科学仪器的操作挑战，又支持可扩展和安全的基准测试。
AI.method: 构建了一套基于Web的科学仪器模拟器，智能体通过浏览器直接操作，避免了资源密集型的OS虚拟化；支持灵活的任务配置和基于执行的评估；包含8个仪器模拟器、96个子任务，覆盖从样品加载、对齐、参数调优、数据采集到结果检查的完整工作流。
AI.result: 在子任务和端到端两个层面评估了通用视觉语言模型、专用GUI智能体模型和高级智能体框架。实验表明，现有智能体能够完成许多结构化GUI子任务，但在反馈驱动操作和长时序工作流执行方面仍存在困难。
AI.conclusion: LabOSBench为推进计算机使用智能体向科学仪器控制方向发展提供了一个可重复、低成本的测试平台。

title: Multi-Turn Reflective Masking Elicits Reasoning in Mask Diffusion Models
summary: While reasoning on autoregressive (AR) models is often performed by chain-of-thought reasoning and reflection, their refinement of previous outputs still relies on fully sequential generation, even when only local edits are needed. In contrast, the masking mechanism in Mask Diffusion Models (MDMs) naturally supports explicit local edits on previous outputs, allowing selective refinement without discarding previous answers and generating another from scratch. While this property more closely aligns with how humans correct mistakes by iterative local refinement, existing MDMs do not support multi-turn masking and denoising. We propose Reflective Masking (RM), which elicits such an intrinsic reasoning capability in MDMs via lightweight post-training. RM provides a native test-time scaling, where an MDM iteratively revisits and revises its prior outputs based on evolving context. To exploit insights from previous turns like AR reasoning, we further introduce History Reference, a parameter-free mechanism that leverages intermediate denoising states during revision. Our approach requires no architectural changes and is easily applicable to existing MDMs. Across diverse tasks and modalities, including text generation, Sudoku, and image editing, Reflective Masking consistently outperforms standard masking-based baselines and demonstrates strong generality, positioning RM as a fundamental primitive for reasoning on MDMs.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Reflective Masking (RM)方法，通过在掩码扩散模型(MDM)上进行轻量级后训练，使其具备多轮掩码和去噪能力，实现类似人类纠错的迭代局部精炼，无需架构修改即可在文本生成、数独和图像编辑等任务中提升性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自回归模型的推理依赖完全顺序生成，即使只需局部编辑也要从头生成；而掩码扩散模型虽天然支持局部编辑，却缺乏多轮掩码和去噪的能力，无法像人类一样通过迭代局部精炼来纠正错误。
AI.method: 提出Reflective Masking (RM)，通过轻量级后训练使MDM支持多轮掩码和去噪；引入History Reference机制，利用先前轮次的中间去噪状态来指导当前修订过程，无需参数更新或架构修改。
AI.result: 在文本生成、数独求解和图像编辑等多种任务和模态上，RM始终优于标准掩码基线方法，展现了良好的通用性和测试时缩放能力。
AI.conclusion: RM作为一种MDM上的基础推理原语，通过迭代局部精炼实现了测试时延展，为掩码扩散模型赋予类似自回归模型的推理能力，同时保留了局部编辑的自然优势。

title: ALCL: An Adaptive Log-Correntropy Loss for Robust Learning under Non-Gaussian Noise
summary: Robust deep learning under heavy-tailed and impulsive noise remains challenging because conventional losses such as mean squared error (MSE) exhibit unbounded sensitivity to outliers. Although correntropy-based objectives improve robustness, existing formulations rely on fixed kernel parameters that must be empirically tuned and remain static during training. To address these limitations, we propose an Adaptive Log-Correntropy Loss (ALCL), a heavy-tailed loss formulation that adaptively learns its robustness geometry during optimization. ALCL introduces a logarithmic residual model whose shape and scale parameters are learned jointly with network weights through differentiable reparameterization. This yields a principled maximum likelihood formulation whose influence function is formally bounded and redescending, allowing the loss geometry to adapt dynamically to evolving residual statistics while suppressing extreme outliers. Comparative experiments on four widely used benchmark datasets spanning grayscale and red-green-blue (RGB) image data under mixed heavy-tailed and impulsive noise demonstrate that ALCL consistently outperforms MSE and optimally tuned generalized correntropy losses in both reconstruction fidelity and downstream classification accuracy. While performance differences remain small under low-noise conditions, under high-noise regimes ALCL improves median accuracy by up to 4.75% on grayscale benchmarks and 4.51% on RGB datasets, with reduced variance across runs. These results demonstrate that adaptive robustness through joint learning of loss parameters provides a computationally efficient alternative to static correntropy-based losses for deep learning in non-Gaussian environments.

AI.tldr: 提出自适应对数科润特罗皮损失（ALCL），通过可微重参数化联合学习损失函数的形状和尺度参数，使鲁棒几何结构在训练过程中动态适应残差统计特性，在重尾和脉冲噪声环境下优于传统MSE和静态广义科润特罗皮损失。
AI.motivation: 传统MSE损失对离群点具有无界敏感性，而现有基于科润特罗皮的目标函数依赖固定核参数，需经验调参且训练期间保持静态，无法自适应地应对重尾和脉冲噪声。
AI.method: 提出ALCL（Adaptive Log-Correntropy Loss），采用对数残差模型，通过可微重参数化将损失函数的形状和尺度参数与网络权重联合学习，形成具有有界且回落型影响函数的极大似然公式，使损失几何结构动态适应残差统计演化并抑制极端离群点。
AI.result: 在四个基准数据集（含灰度与RGB图像）的混合重尾和脉冲噪声实验中，ALCL在重建保真度和下游分类准确率上均优于MSE和最优调参的广义科润特罗皮损失；高噪声下灰度基准中位准确率提升达4.75%，RGB数据集提升达4.51%，且运行间方差更低。
AI.conclusion: 通过联合学习损失参数实现自适应鲁棒性，为非高斯环境下深度学习中静态科润特罗皮损失提供了一种计算高效的替代方案。

title: Adaptive and Explicit safe: Triggering Latent Safety Awareness in Large Reasoning Models
summary: While Large Reasoning Models (LRMs) excel at complex tasks, they remain highly vulnerable to sophisticated jailbreaks and direct harmful queries. To address this vulnerability, prior works depend heavily on external manual data annotation for safety alignment. However, we observe that LRMs can inherently identify safety risks when being re-presented with original queries alongside their own reasoning trajectories -- a capability we term Latent Safety Awareness. To leverage this safety awareness, we first employ Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) to explicitly induce safe tags to trigger safety analysis and guidance following the initial reasoning content for unsafe queries, while preserving standard responses for general queries to ensure adaptive triggering. Subsequently, we apply Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) to further enhance the correctness and stability of the safety analysis and guidance. Notably, responses required for both training stages are entirely generated by models being optimized. With (Safe Trigger) SFT and DPO, experimental results demonstrate significant safety enhancement. For example, the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B, on average, drops 24.65% and 36.72% on harmful and jailbreak benchmarks, respectively. Finally, our Safe Trigger method exerts almost no negative impact on general performance or user experience.

AI.tldr: 本文发现大型推理模型（LRMs）具有内在的"潜在安全意识"——当模型被重新呈现原始查询及其自身推理轨迹时，能够自主识别安全风险。基于此，作者提出Safe Trigger方法：先用监督微调（SFT）诱导安全标签触发安全分析和指导，再用直接偏好优化（DPO）提升安全分析的准确性和稳定性。所有训练数据均由模型自身生成，无需外部人工标注。实验表明，该方法在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上使有害查询和越狱攻击的成功率分别下降24.65%和36.72%，且几乎不影响通用性能。
AI.motivation: 大型推理模型在复杂任务上表现优异，但极易受到高级越狱攻击和直接有害查询的侵害。现有安全对齐方法严重依赖外部人工数据标注，成本高且难以扩展。
AI.method: 提出Safe Trigger方法，包含两个阶段：(1) 监督微调（SFT），显式诱导安全标签，在初始推理内容后触发安全分析和指导，同时保留对通用查询的标准响应；(2) 直接偏好优化（DPO），增强安全分析和指导的正确性与稳定性。两个阶段的训练响应均由模型自身生成。
AI.result: 在DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Llama-8B上，有害查询的平均攻击成功率下降24.65%，越狱基准测试下降36.72%，且通用性能几乎不受影响。
AI.conclusion: Safe Trigger方法利用模型内在的安全意识，通过自生成的训练数据实现自适应安全触发，有效提升模型安全性且不影响用户体验，为无需外部标注的安全对齐提供了可行方案。

title: P3B3: A Multi-Turn Conversational Benchmark for Measuring European and Brazilian Portuguese Variety Bias in LLMs
comment: Accepted at MeLLM Workshop at ACL 2026
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) become embedded in everyday communication, capturing regional linguistic variation is essential for reliable and equitable language use. In Portuguese, European (pt-PT) and Brazilian (pt-BR) varieties remain unevenly represented, with pt-BR dominating in data quantity, while LLM preference for Portuguese variants remains underexplored. To address this gap, we introduce P3B3, an expert-curated language variety agnostic benchmark of conversational prompts, along with an evaluation framework for measuring variety bias and controllability. Experiments on several models show that most LLMs exhibit a strong bias toward pt-BR, with variation in controllability across models. These results highlight the need for more balanced multilingual representation across language varieties.

AI.tldr: 本文提出P3B3基准和评估框架，发现多数大语言模型在葡萄牙语中强烈偏向巴西变体（pt-BR），对欧洲变体（pt-PT）存在严重不平衡，且不同模型的可控性差异显著。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM在日常交流中的普及，捕捉区域性语言变异对可靠和公平的语言使用至关重要。葡萄牙语中欧洲（pt-PT）和巴西（pt-BR）变体的数据量极不平衡（pt-BR占主导），而LLM对葡萄牙语变体的偏好尚未被充分探索。
AI.method: 构建P3B3基准数据集——由专家策展的语言变体无关的对话提示集；设计评估框架，用于测量变体偏差和可控性。
AI.result: 多数LLM对pt-BR表现出强烈偏差；不同模型在变体可控性上存在差异。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在葡萄牙语变体上存在严重不平衡，亟需实现跨语言变体的更均衡多语言表征。

title: Beyond the Blood Draw: Explainable Machine Learning for Non-Invasive Dysglycemia Risk Screening
summary: Dysglycemia, encompassing both prediabetes and diabetes, affects huge numbers of adults worldwide, yet many of them remain undiagnosed. We developed and validated machine-learning (ML) models for non-invasive screening of dysglycemia risk that require no laboratory tests. Pooling data from the National Health and Nutrition Examination Survey (NHANES) 2017--2023 (n=14,352), we trained six ML models with stratified 5-fold cross-validation and compared them with two established clinical risk scores. LightGBM achieved the highest area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC=0.820, 95% CI: 0.806--0.835), outperforming the Finnish Diabetes Risk Score (0.745) and American Diabetes Association Risk Test (0.783). SHAP analysis identified age, race/ethnicity, and waist-to-height ratio as the most influential predictors. Subgroup analyses confirmed consistent performance across demographic strata (AUC: 0.735--0.832). These results demonstrate the feasibility of explainable, laboratory-free dysglycemia screening for deployment in community settings and self-tracking health applications.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用NHANES 2017-2023数据（n=14,352），开发并验证了无需实验室检测的机器学习模型用于非侵入性血糖异常筛查。LightGBM模型表现最优（AUC=0.820），优于芬兰糖尿病风险评分（0.745）和美国糖尿病协会风险测试（0.783），SHAP分析显示年龄、种族和腰围身高比是最重要的预测因子。
AI.motivation: 全球大量成年人存在血糖异常（包括糖尿病前期和糖尿病），但许多人未被诊断，亟需一种无需实验室检测的非侵入性筛查方法。
AI.method: 使用NHANES 2017-2023数据（n=14,352），训练六种机器学习模型，采用分层5折交叉验证，并与两种临床风险评分进行比较。利用SHAP进行模型解释，并进行亚组分析。
AI.result: LightGBM表现最佳（AUC=0.820, 95% CI: 0.806-0.835），优于芬兰糖尿病风险评分（0.745）和美国糖尿病协会风险测试（0.783）。亚组分析表现一致（AUC: 0.735-0.832）。
AI.conclusion: 开发的可解释、无需实验室检测的血糖异常筛查方法可在社区环境和自我健康追踪应用中部署。

title: Scaling LLM Reasoning from Minimal Labels: A Semi-Supervised Framework with a Lightweight Verifier
summary: For the development of Large language models (LLMs), recent approaches to generating pseudo intermediate reasoning have shown remarkable progress. But they typically rely on large numbers of correctly annotated answers to assess reasoning quality. This paper presents a semi-supervised framework that scales reasoning learning from minimal supervision, turning reasoning verification itself into a data creation mechanism. We train a lightweight reasoning-correctness classifier on only a few labeled samples, which judges whether intermediate reasoning traces generated by an LLM are valid. Furthermore, an entropy-based confidence threshold filters out unreliable samples, and the remaining high-confidence reasoning traces are used to fine-tune the model. Experiments on Verifiable Math Problems (Orca-Math subset) and Question Answering on Image Scene Graphs (GQA) with Visual Programming show that our method achieves accuracy comparable to using 10-15x more labeled data. Ablation analyses confirm that both the classifier and entropy filtering are essential for scalable and noise-resistant pseudo-labeling. By replacing expensive answer-level supervision with lightweight reasoning verification, our method provides a practical path toward constructing large-scale reasoning resources and paves the way for future autonomous reasoning systems that learn from minimal human input.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种半监督框架，通过轻量级推理正确性分类器和熵置信度阈值，仅用少量标注样本即可从LLM生成的推理轨迹中筛选高质量伪标签用于微调，在数学推理和视觉问答任务上达到10-15倍标注数据量的效果。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM推理方法依赖大量正确标注答案来评估推理质量，标注成本高；本文旨在从极少量监督出发，通过将推理验证本身转化为数据生成机制，以低成本方式构建大规模推理资源。
AI.method: 1) 在少量标注样本上训练轻量级推理正确性分类器，用于判断LLM生成的中间推理轨迹是否有效；2) 基于熵的置信度阈值过滤不可靠样本；3) 保留高置信度推理轨迹对模型进行微调。
AI.result: 在可验证数学问题(Orca-Math子集)和基于视觉编程的场景图问答(GQA)上，该方法达到与使用10-15倍标注数据相当的性能；消融实验验证了分类器和熵过滤对于可扩展、抗噪声的伪标注均不可或缺。
AI.conclusion: 通过用轻量级推理验证替代昂贵的答案级监督，该方法为大规模推理资源构建提供了实用路径，并为未来从最小人类输入中学习的自主推理系统奠定基础。

title: The Art of Mixology: Mixup-based Obfuscation for Privacy-Preserving Split Learning in Large Language Models
summary: Split learning provides a practical paradigm for resource-constrained users to train Large Language Models (LLMs) by offloading computation-intensive layers to a server while keeping raw data local. However, existing privacy-preserving split learning methods still face a difficult trade-off among utility, privacy, efficiency, and stability. Specifically, these methods often suffer from substantial utility degradation, remain vulnerable to advanced data reconstruction attacks, incur prohibitive computational and communication overhead, or exhibit unstable performance across different tasks. In this paper, we propose MIXGUARD, a novel mixup-based privacy-preserving split learning framework for LLMs. MIXGUARD introduces token-level obfuscation, representation-level obfuscation, and adaptive gradient perturbation mechanisms, which operate jointly to preserve useful learning signals while preventing privacy leakage to the server. Technically, MIXGUARD first constructs a lightweight calibration model on a public dataset to refine the approximated target representation, and then applies this model during privacy-preserving fine-tuning on private data. We conduct extensive experiments on four classification tasks and four text generation tasks across multiple LLM families, model sizes, architectures, and fine-tuning strategies. The results show that MIXGUARD preserves model utility comparable to non-split training baselines, consistently achieves stronger privacy protection than existing split learning defense methods against state-of-the-art data reconstruction attacks, and remains robust under adaptive attack settings.

AI.tldr: MIXGUARD提出了一种基于混合(mixup)的隐私保护拆分学习框架，通过令牌级混淆、表示级混淆和自适应梯度扰动三种机制协同工作，在不牺牲模型效用的前提下，有效防止服务器端的数据重建攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有隐私保护拆分学习方法在效用、隐私、效率和稳定性之间存在难以调和的权衡，要么效用严重下降，要么无法抵御高级数据重建攻击，要么计算通信开销过高，要么在不同任务上表现不稳定。
AI.method: MIXGUARD框架包含三个核心机制：令牌级混淆(token-level obfuscation)、表示级混淆(representation-level obfuscation)和自适应梯度扰动(adaptive gradient perturbation)。首先在公开数据集上构建轻量级校准模型以精炼近似目标表示，然后将该模型应用于私有数据的隐私保护微调过程。
AI.result: 在多种LLM系列、模型规模、架构和微调策略下的四个分类任务和四个文本生成任务上，MIXGUARD实现了与非拆分训练基线相当的模型效用，相比现有拆分学习防御方法提供了更强的隐私保护，且在自适应攻击设置下保持鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: MIXGUARD有效解决了拆分学习中的隐私-效用权衡难题，为资源受限用户在训练大语言模型时提供了一种实用且安全的隐私保护方案。

title: Mojo: A Promising Tool for Scalable Financial AI Efficiency
summary: For thirty years, quantitative finance has paid a costly two-language tax: models researched in Python are rewritten in C++ for production, often introducing numerical discrepancies. GPU-accelerated deep learning exacerbates this problem, as nondeterministic floating-point reductions can produce drift in long backtests, challenging regulatory reproducibility and auditability expectations. This article surveys Mojo, Modular's 2026 Python-like systems language, as a structural response for capital markets engineering. While closing the Python-to-C++ performance gap, Mojo uniquely combines native interoperability with the low-level systems control required to construct bit-exact deterministic kernels.
