title: IMPACTeen: Intentions, Manipulation, Persuasion, Annotations, and Consequences in Teen Communication Dataset
summary: IMPACTeen is a dataset of textual social influence scenarios spanning interpersonal, media-based, and digital settings in an adolescent context. It contains 1,021 texts, 5,100 individual annotation records, and gold labels for social influence techniques, with each text annotated from five distinct perspectives: teenagers, parents, psychologists, communication experts, and teachers. The resource was constructed through constrained LLM generation, followed by a two-step human editing and validation phase aimed at ensuring youth-context realism. A multi-dimensional annotation covered influence presence, techniques, intentions, consequences, resistance, reactions, and annotation confidence. The dataset supports research on social influence detection, annotator disagreement, cross-lingual modeling, and the training and evaluation of language models. The dataset was created in Polish and is accompanied by a corresponding English version.

AI.tldr: IMPACTeen是一个包含1,021条文本、5,100条标注记录的青少年社会影响力场景数据集，涵盖人际、媒体和数字环境，从青少年、家长、心理学家、传播专家和教师五个视角进行多维标注，支持社会影响力检测、标注者分歧、跨语言建模及语言模型训练评估等研究。
AI.motivation: 目前缺乏针对青少年语境、涵盖多视角标注的社会影响力文本数据集，难以支持社会影响力检测、标注者分歧分析及跨语言建模等研究。
AI.method: 通过受约束的大语言模型生成构建初始文本，经两阶段人工编辑和验证确保青少年语境真实性，并从五个不同视角（青少年、家长、心理学家、传播专家、教师）进行多维标注，涵盖影响力存在与否、技术类型、意图、后果、抵抗、反应及标注置信度。
AI.result: 构建了包含1,021条文本、5,100条标注记录的多视角标注数据集，并提供了对应的波兰语和英语版本。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为社会影响力检测、标注者分歧分析、跨语言建模以及语言模型训练与评估提供了有价值的资源。

title: Data Augmentations for Data-Constrained Language Model Pretraining
summary: As AI labs approach a data ceiling where compute capacity outpaces the rate of new high-quality text generation, language model pretraining is shifting toward a data-constrained, compute-abundant regime that demands productive multi-epoch training on fixed corpora. Standard autoregressive (AR) pretraining overfits severely in this setting, reaching its optimum early and then continuously deteriorating. We investigate data augmentation as a regularizer to mitigate this overfitting and enable productive training for hundreds of epochs on the same data. We introduce three orthogonal categories of augmentation for AR pretraining: token-level noise (masking, random replacement), sequence permutations (right-to-left prediction, Fill-in-the-Middle), and target offset prediction ($x_{t+i}$ for $i > 1$). Through systematic ablations, we find that individual augmentations delay overfitting and lower validation loss relative to the baseline, with random token replacement achieving the best minimum loss among individual methods. Combining augmentation categories further lowers the minimum validation loss. Our experiments demonstrate that data augmentations mitigate AR pretraining's data inefficiency and offer a promising solution to the data-constrained regime. All code and data are available at https://github.com/michaelchen-lab/data-augmentations-for-pretraining

AI.tldr: 本文研究在数据受限、算力充裕的预训练场景下，通过数据增强（token级噪声、序列排列、目标偏移预测）作为正则化手段，缓解自回归预训练的多轮过拟合问题，实验表明随机token替换效果最佳，组合多种增强可进一步降低验证损失。
AI.motivation: AI实验室面临"数据天花板"——算力增长速度快于高质量文本生成速度，语言模型预训练正进入数据受限、算力充裕的新模式。标准自回归预训练在此设定下严重过拟合，需要有效的正则化手段来支持在固定语料上进行数百轮的有效训练。
AI.method: 提出了三类正交的数据增强方法：(1) token级噪声：掩码、随机替换；(2) 序列排列：从右到左预测、中间填充（Fill-in-the-Middle）；(3) 目标偏移预测：预测$x_{t+i}$（i>1）。通过系统消融实验评估各方法及其组合效果。
AI.result: 各类增强均能延后过拟合并降低验证损失，其中随机token替换在单一方法中取得最佳最小损失；组合多种增强类别可进一步降低最小验证损失。
AI.conclusion: 数据增强能够缓解自回归预训练的数据效率问题，为数据受限条件下的预训练提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: Exploring Extrinsic and Intrinsic Properties for Effective Reasoning with Code Interpreter
summary: Reasoning with a Code Interpreter (CI) has emerged as an effective paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of large language models (LLMs) through executable computation and iterative verification. Despite its growing adoption, the behavioral properties underlying effective code reasoning remain largely underexplored. In this work, we investigate code reasoning from two distinct perspectives inspired by prior studies of natural language reasoning: extrinsic properties, represented by crucial tokens, and intrinsic properties, represented by code-specific cognitive behaviors. Across multiple LLMs, we find that stronger CI reasoning models consistently exhibit a higher prevalence of crucial tokens and cognitive behaviors, particularly verification, backtracking, and backward chaining. Building on these observations, we examine how these properties can be leveraged during both inference and training. At inference time, appending code-specific crucial tokens improves performance on several reasoning capabilities, including mathematical, ordering, and optimization, while yielding limited benefits elsewhere. At training time, augmenting a state-of-the-art framework with code-specific cognitive behaviors improves supervised fine-tuning and reinforcement learning performance in two of three evaluated models. Further analysis shows that these behaviors reduce overthinking in incorrect responses and improve token efficiency, while also revealing factors that limit gains in a certain model. Our findings provide the first systematic characterization of effective reasoning with CI and demonstrate both the potential and limitations of leveraging key properties to improve CI-based reasoning.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了代码解释器（CI）增强LLM推理的两种关键属性：外在属性（关键token）和内在属性（代码特定认知行为）。发现更强的CI推理模型在关键token和认知行为（验证、回溯、反向链）上表现更突出。推理时追加关键token可提升数学、排序、优化任务；训练时注入认知行为可改善SFT和RL性能，减少过度思考并提高token效率。
AI.motivation: 尽管代码解释器增强推理已成为有效范式，但有效代码推理的行为属性尚未被充分探索，特别是缺乏从外在和内在两个视角的系统性表征。
AI.method: 从两个视角分析：外在属性（关键token）和内在属性（代码特定认知行为如验证、回溯、反向链）。在多个LLM上对比强弱CI推理模型，并在推理和训练阶段分别测试这些属性的作用。
AI.result: 1）更强CI推理模型的关键token和认知行为发生率更高；2）推理时追加代码特定关键token可提升数学、排序、优化能力；3）训练时注入认知行为改善两个模型的SFT和RL性能；4）这些行为减少错误回答的过度思考并提高token效率，但某模型增益有限。
AI.conclusion: 本文首次系统性表征了CI有效推理的特征，展示了利用关键属性改进CI推理的潜力与局限性。

title: Variance Reduction for Non-Log-Concave Sampling with Applications to Inverse Problems
comment: Accepted to Uncertainty in Artificial Intelligence (UAI) 2026
summary: Sampling from high-dimensional, non-log-concave distributions with unnormalized densities is a fundamental challenge in machine learning, particularly when the exact gradient of the potential is unavailable and must be approximated via stochastic gradients that exhibit high variance under a fixed budget of gradient computations per iteration. Although variance reduction techniques such as SGD with momentum, STORM, and PAGE have demonstrated improved convergence properties in non-convex optimization, their implications for sampling from non-log-concave distributions remain largely unexplored. In this work, we develop the first unified analysis of these estimators for sampling from non-log-concave distributions. We establish improved non-asymptotic convergence rates in $\varepsilon$-relative Fisher information and, under a Poincaré inequality assumption, in squared total variation distance, and further prove weak convergence to the target distribution. We extend our analysis to solving inverse problems with score-based generative priors. We empirically validate our theory and demonstrate that, under a fixed gradient computations per iteration, variance-reduction techniques consistently improve sample quality in two standard imaging applications.

AI.tldr: 本文首次统一分析了随机梯度估计器（SGD with momentum、STORM、PAGE）在非对数凹分布采样中的应用，建立了改进的非渐近收敛率（ε-相对Fisher信息和平方全变差距离），并验证了方差缩减技术能提升图像生成质量。
AI.motivation: 高维非对数凹分布采样中，势函数的精确梯度不可用，需用随机梯度近似，但固定每步梯度计算预算下梯度方差高。现有方差缩减技术在非凸优化中有效，但在非对数凹采样中尚未被探索。
AI.method: 对SGD with momentum、STORM、PAGE三种方差缩减估计器进行统一分析，建立ε-相对Fisher信息下的非渐近收敛率；在Poincaré不等式假设下推导平方全变差距离收敛率；证明弱收敛性；将分析扩展到基于分数的生成先验求解逆问题。
AI.result: 建立了改进的非渐近收敛率；在Poincaré不等式下得到平方全变差距离收敛保证；证明了弱收敛到目标分布；在图像逆问题中方差缩减技术一致提升样本质量。
AI.conclusion: 方差缩减技术可以有效提升非对数凹分布采样的效率和质量，统一的收敛分析为高维采样提供了理论保证，并在图像生成等逆问题中展示了实用价值。

title: TokenPilot: Cache-Efficient Context Management for LLM Agents
summary: As LLM agents are deployed in long-horizon sessions, context accumulation drives up inference costs. Existing approaches utilize text pruning or dynamic memory eviction to minimize token footprints; however, their unconstrained sequence mutations alter layouts, introducing prefix mismatches and cache invalidation. This reveals a critical trade-off between text sparsity and prompt cache continuity. To address this, we present TokenPilot, a dual-granularity context management framework. Globally, Ingestion-Aware Compaction acts as a framework harness to stabilize prompt prefixes and eliminate open-world environmental noise at the ingestion gate. Locally, Lifecycle-Aware Eviction monitors the ongoing residual utility of context segments, enforcing a conservative batch-turn schedule to offload content segments only when task relevance expires. Experiments on PinchBench and Claw-Eval under both isolated and continuous modes demonstrate that TokenPilot reduces costs by 61% and 56% in isolated mode, and 61% and 87% in continuous mode, while maintaining competitive performance compared to prior systems. TokenPilot has been integrated into LightMem2 at https://github.com/zjunlp/LightMem2.

AI.tldr: TokenPilot是一个双粒度上下文管理框架，通过全局的Ingestion-Aware Compaction稳定前缀并消除噪声，以及局部的Lifecycle-Aware Eviction按任务相关性过期策略卸载内容，在长周期LLM Agent会话中实现61%-87%的成本降低，同时保持竞争性能。
AI.motivation: LLM Agent在长期会话中，上下文不断累积导致推理成本急剧上升。现有文本剪枝或动态内存驱逐方法虽然能减少token占用，但其无约束的序列突变会改变布局，导致前缀不匹配和缓存失效，因此在文本稀疏性与prompt缓存连续性之间存在关键权衡。
AI.method: 提出TokenPilot双粒度上下文管理框架：(1) 全局层面，Ingestion-Aware Compaction作为框架控制器，在输入入口处稳定prompt前缀并消除开放世界环境噪声；(2) 局部层面，Lifecycle-Aware Eviction监控上下文段的持续残差效用，采用保守的批处理轮次调度策略，仅在任务相关性过期时才卸载内容段。
AI.result: 在PinchBench和Claw-Eval基准上，孤立模式下成本降低61%和56%，连续模式下成本降低61%和87%，同时保持与先前系统竞争的性能。
AI.conclusion: TokenPilot有效平衡了文本稀疏性与缓存连续性之间的权衡，在显著降低推理成本的同时保持了任务性能，并已集成到LightMem2中开源。

title: FlowMPC: Improving Flow Matching policies with World Models
summary: Flow Matching (FM) is a powerful approach for behavior cloning in multimodal action spaces [Jiang et al., 2025], but because it is not trained to directly maximize expected return, there is still room to improve how FM policies act at test time. This work investigates whether a learned world model can improve FM policies by enabling Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) planning over candidate action sequences proposed by the policy. Building on TD-MPC2 [Hansen et al., 2024], I introduce FlowMPC, a framework that combines an imitation-learned FM policy with a learned world model for test-time planning in ManiSkill manipulation tasks [Tao et al., 2025]. Across PickCube and PickSingleYCB, adding the world model improved performance over the FM policy alone, with especially clear gains in end-of-episode success. These results suggest that world-model-based planning can effectively complement flow-based imitation policies without modifying the FM training objective.

AI.tldr: 本文提出FlowMPC框架，将流匹配（FM）模仿学习策略与TD-MPC2世界模型结合，通过模型预测路径积分（MPPI）规划在测试时优化动作选择，在ManiSkill操作任务中显著提升了任务成功率。
AI.motivation: FM策略虽在多模态动作空间的行为克隆中表现优异，但由于未直接最大化期望回报，其测试时的动作选择仍有改进空间，因此研究能否通过学习世界模型来提升FM策略的测试时性能。
AI.method: 在TD-MPC2基础上构建FlowMPC框架：以模仿学习的FM策略作为动作先验生成候选动作序列，结合学习的世界模型进行MPPI规划，在测试时对动作序列进行优化选择。
AI.result: 在PickCube和PickSingleYCB任务中，加入世界模型进行规划相比纯FM策略提升了性能，尤其在任务末期成功率方面提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 基于世界模型的规划能有效补充基于流的模仿学习策略，且无需修改FM训练目标即可提升测试时性能。

title: DEEPRUBRIC: Evidence-Tree Rubric Supervision for Efficient Reinforcement Learning of Deep Research Agents
summary: Deep research agents synthesize long-form reports by searching and reasoning over retrieved evidence. Reinforcement learning with rubric-based rewards improves these agents by optimizing them against checkable criteria that translate report quality into reward signals, but its efficiency depends on whether those criteria reliably capture the task scope and evidence needs. Most existing studies ask an LLM to generate rubrics for a given query, but when the model fails to infer the underlying information needs, the generated rubrics may be incomplete and reduce RL efficiency. To obtain more reliable query--rubric supervision, we introduce DeepRubric, a data construction framework that reverses this process: instead of inferring evaluation criteria for a given query, it first determines what an evidence-backed report should be evaluated on and then synthesizes aligned query--rubric pairs from those evaluation targets. Starting from a sampled seed topic, DeepRubric builds an evidence tree by recursively expanding evidence-backed sub-questions, whose leaves serve as atomic and verifiable evaluation targets. It then uses the evidence tree to synthesize the training query and rubrics, ensuring that the reward evaluates exactly the information requested by the query. Using DeepRubric, we construct 9K query--rubric supervision examples and train DeepRubric-8B with rubric-based GRPO, achieving comparable performance to prior open state-of-the-art deep research models across three benchmarks with roughly 13x fewer RL GPU-hours.

AI.tldr: DeepRubric是一种数据构建框架，通过逆向生成查询-评估标准对来改进基于强化学习的深度研究智能体。它先从种子主题构建证据树，再合成对齐的查询和评估标准，训练出的DeepRubric-8B模型在三个基准上达到与先前开源最优模型相当的性能，而RL GPU耗时减少约13倍。
AI.motivation: 现有基于奖励的强化学习方法依赖LLM为给定查询生成评估标准，但当模型无法推断底层信息需求时，生成的评估标准可能不完整，从而降低RL训练效率。需要更可靠的查询-评估标准监督信号。
AI.method: DeepRubric框架：从种子主题出发，递归扩展有证据支持的子问题构建证据树，叶节点作为原子可验证的评估目标；然后基于证据树合成训练查询和评估标准，确保奖励精确评估查询所需的信息。利用该框架构建9K查询-评估标准样本，使用基于评估标准的GRPO训练DeepRubric-8B模型。
AI.result: DeepRubric-8B在三个基准上达到与先前开源最优深度研究模型相当的性能，RL GPU耗时减少约13倍。
AI.conclusion: 逆向生成查询-评估标准对的方法能提供更可靠的监督信号，显著提升强化学习训练效率。

title: An affordable hardware-aware neural architecture search for deploying convolutional neural networks on ultra-low-power computing platforms
summary: Hardware-aware neural architecture search (HW-NAS) allows the integration of Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs) in microcontrollers devices by automatically designing neural architectures that can fit prearranged hardware constraints. However, state-of-the-art HW-NAS target high-performance microcontrollers, whose power consumption does not meet sensing nodes requirements. This work presents a HW-NAS generating tiny CNNs that can run on ultra-low-power microcontrollers, featuring a lightweight search procedure enabling its execution even on embedded devices. Empirical results on three well-known benchmarks for tiny computer vision proved that the proposed HW-NAS was able to generate tiny CNNs while preserving state-of-the-art classification accuracy.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种面向超低功耗微控制器的硬件感知神经架构搜索（HW-NAS）方法，能够生成可在嵌入式设备上运行的轻量级CNN，在三个视觉基准上保持了分类精度与SOTA相当。
AI.motivation: 现有HW-NAS针对高性能微控制器设计，功耗无法满足传感节点的需求，因此需要为超低功耗微控制器生成适配的tiny CNN。
AI.method: 提出一种轻量级HW-NAS方法，搜索过程可在嵌入式设备上执行，生成适合超低功耗微控制器的tiny CNN结构。
AI.result: 在三个小计算机视觉基准上，生成的tiny CNN在保持SOTA分类精度的同时，能够运行于超低功耗微控制器。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效弥合了HW-NAS与超低功耗嵌入式设备之间的差距，为资源受限场景下的CNN部署提供了可行方案。

title: KVEraser: Learning to Steer KV Cache for Efficient Localized Context Erasing
comment: Oral at the ICML 2026 Workshop on the Impact of Memorization on Trustworthy Foundation Models
summary: Post-hoc context erasing over the KV cache is challenging because a local edit has a global consequence: once a span has been processed, its influence propagates into the cached states of all subsequent tokens. This issue arises naturally in long-context LLM applications, where stale retrieved facts, incorrect tool observations, retracted user preferences, or harmful prompt injections may be identified only after prefill. Exact erasing must then recompute all tokens after the deleted span, making its computational cost depend on suffix length rather than erased-span length. We introduce KVEraser, a learned KV-cache editing method for efficient localized context erasing. Given a processed context and a span to remove, KVEraser replaces only the KV states of the erased interval with learned steering states while reusing the remaining cache unchanged. To learn a transferable erasing mechanism, we build a two-stage training pipeline: generic span-neighbor pre-training teaches the eraser to suppress the influence of the erased span, while task-specific fine-tuning adapts this capability to downstream scenarios. Experiments show that KVEraser nearly matches full recomputation in post-erasure performance on in-domain tasks across 1K--32K context lengths, while its latency increases by only 24% compared with a 17.6x increase for full recomputation. KVEraser also generalizes to unseen long-document QA tasks with harmful factual distractors, achieving the best performance among approximate baselines with a 3--4x speedup over full recomputation.

AI.tldr: KVEraser是一种基于学习的KV缓存编辑方法，通过替换被删除区间的KV状态为学习到的引导状态，实现高效的局部上下文擦除，在1K-32K上下文长度上几乎达到完全重计算的性能，而延迟仅增加24%（完全重计算增加17.6倍），同时能泛化到未见的长文档QA任务。
AI.motivation: 事后在KV缓存上进行上下文擦除面临局部编辑带来全局影响的挑战：删除一个跨度后，其影响会传播到后续所有token的缓存状态中。精确擦除需要重算所有后续token，计算成本取决于后缀长度而非删除跨度长度，这在长上下文LLM应用中尤其关键，因为过时检索事实、错误工具观测、收回的用户偏好或有害提示注入通常只能在prefill之后才能识别。
AI.method: KVEraser采用两阶段训练流水线：1) 通用跨度-邻居预训练，教导擦除器抑制被删除跨度的影响；2) 任务特定微调，将擦除能力适配到下游场景。在推理时，仅替换被删除区间对应的KV状态为学习到的引导状态，其余缓存保持不变。
AI.result: 在1K-32K上下文长度上，KVEraser在域内任务上几乎匹配完全重计算的后擦除性能，延迟仅增加24%（完全重计算增加17.6倍）。在未见过长文档QA任务上，KVEraser在有害事实干扰项下达到最佳近似基线性能，相比完全重计算获得3-4倍加速。
AI.conclusion: KVEraser通过学习引导状态替换策略，有效解决了KV缓存中局部上下文擦除的全局传播问题，在保持任务性能的同时显著降低计算开销，并能泛化到未见任务场景。

title: One-Step Generalization Ratio Guided Optimization for Domain Generalization
comment: 29 pages, accepted at the 42nd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2025)
summary: Domain Generalization (DG) aims to train models that generalize to unseen target domains but often overfit to domain-specific features, known as undesired correlations. Gradient-based DG methods typically guide gradients in a dominant direction but often inadvertently reinforce spurious correlations. Recent work has employed dropout to regularize overconfident parameters, but has not explicitly adjusted gradient alignment or ensured balanced parameter updates. We propose GENIE (Generalization-ENhancing Iterative Equalizer), a novel optimizer that leverages the One-Step Generalization Ratio (OSGR) to quantify each parameter's contribution to loss reduction and assess gradient alignment. By dynamically equalizing OSGR via a preconditioning factor, GENIE prevents a small subset of parameters from dominating optimization, thereby promoting domain-invariant feature learning. Theoretically, GENIE balances convergence contribution and gradient alignment among parameters, achieving higher OSGR while retaining SGD's convergence rate. Empirically, it outperforms existing optimizers and enhances performance when integrated with various DG and single-DG methods.

AI.tldr: GENIE是一种新型优化器，通过动态均衡每个参数的一步泛化比（OSGR）来防止少数参数主导优化，从而促进领域不变特征学习，提升领域泛化性能。
AI.motivation: 现有梯度-based领域泛化方法容易过拟合领域特定特征（伪相关），梯度方向被主导方向引导但未显式调整梯度对齐，且参数更新不平衡。Dropout虽能正则化过自信参数，但未解决梯度对齐和均衡参数更新问题。
AI.method: 提出GENIE优化器，引入One-Step Generalization Ratio (OSGR)量化每个参数对损失降低的贡献和梯度对齐程度；通过预条件因子动态均衡各参数的OSGR，防止少数参数主导优化过程。
AI.result: 理论上，GENIE在保持SGD收敛速率的同时，实现了更高的OSGR和参数间收敛贡献与梯度对齐的平衡。实验上，GENIE优于现有优化器，并能提升多种领域泛化方法和单源领域泛化方法的性能。
AI.conclusion: GENIE通过参数级别的OSGR均衡机制，有效缓解了领域泛化中的伪相关过拟合问题，是一种即插即用、理论保障与实证效果兼备的优化器。

title: Benchmarking LLM Agents on Meta-Analysis Articles from Nature Portfolio
comment: 13 pages, 7 figures, preprint for arXiv, dataset and code available at https://github.com/BFTree/MetaSyn
summary:
Meta-analysis is a demanding form of evidence synthesis that combines literature retrieval, PI/ECO-guided study selection, and statistical aggregation. Its structured, verifiable workflow makes it an ideal substrate for evaluating systematic scientific reasoning, yet existing benchmarks lack ground truth across the full retrieval-screening-synthesis pipeline. We introduce MetaSyn, a dataset of 442 expert-curated meta-analyses from Nature Portfolio journals. Each entry pairs a research question with PI/ECO criteria, a retrieval corpus of 140k PubMed articles, verified positive studies, hard negatives that are topically similar but PI/ECO-ineligible, and complete search strategies and date bounds.
  Benchmarking twelve pipeline configurations (nine RAG variants and a protocol-driven agent) reveals a critical screening bottleneck: despite a retrieval ceiling of 90.9% recall at K=200, no system recovers more than 52.7% of ground-truth included literature. Current LLMs fail to reliably separate eligible studies from PI/ECO-failing distractors in pools of comparable topical relevance. Stage-attributed metrics capture where systems succeed and fail; a single end-to-end score does not.

AI.tldr: MetaSyn是一个包含442篇Nature Portfolio期刊荟萃分析的数据集，涵盖从文献检索到统计合成的完整流程。基准测试显示，尽管检索上限在K=200时Recall达90.9%，但没有系统能召回超过52.7%的纳入文献，现有LLM无法可靠区分PI/ECO合格与不合格的文献，且分阶段指标比单一端到端分数更能揭示系统成败。
AI.motivation: 荟萃分析具有结构化、可验证的工作流程，是评估系统性科学推理的理想载体，但现有基准缺乏贯穿检索-筛选-合成全流程的ground truth数据。
AI.method: 构建MetaSyn数据集（442篇专家策展的荟萃分析，含研究问题、PI/ECO标准、14万篇PubMed文章、已验证阳性研究、主题相似但PI/ECO不合格的硬负样本、完整检索策略和日期范围），并对12种流水线配置（9种RAG变体和1种协议驱动智能体）进行基准测试。
AI.result: 检索阶段在K=200时Recall可达90.9%，但所有系统最多只能召回52.7%的ground-truth纳入文献；现有LLM无法在主题相关性相当的候选池中可靠区分PI/ECO合格与不合格的研究。
AI.conclusion: 当前流水线存在严重的筛选瓶颈，分阶段归因指标比单一端到端评分更能有效定位系统的成功与失败环节。

title: pFedUL: Layer-Aware Federated Unlearning for Personalized Federated Learning
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in CMC-Computers, Materials & Continua
summary: Federated unlearning (FU) enables the removal of specific data contributions from federated learning (FL) models to comply with regulations such as the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). However, most existing FU methods are designed for the FedAvg paradigm, where all clients share a single global model. In practice, personalized federated learning (pFL) methods such as FedPer, FedRep, Ditto, and FedBN have become widely adopted due to their superior handling of non-IID data. These methods decompose the model into shared global layers and client-specific personalized layers, fundamentally altering the semantics of unlearning, yet this setting has received little attention. We formalize FU under the pFL paradigm, identifying a tension between unlearning completeness on shared layers and personalization preservation for remaining clients. We then propose pFedUL, a layer-aware selective unlearning framework comprising three components: (1) gradient-based layer-wise contribution attribution that separately quantifies the target client's influence on shared and personalized parameters, (2) adaptive selective unlearning that applies differentiated forgetting strategies across layer types, and (3) a lightweight recalibration protocol enabling remaining clients to restore personalization with minimal overhead. We further introduce two new metrics, Personalization Preservation Score (PPS) and Cross-client Fairness Index (CFI), to evaluate pFL-specific unlearning quality. Experiments on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, and FEMNIST under varying non-IID settings indicate that pFedUL achieves unlearning effectiveness comparable to full retraining while maintaining an average of 97.3\% personalized accuracy for remaining clients. Compared with six state-of-the-art FU methods adapted to the pFL setting, pFedUL consistently achieves superior personalization preservation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出pFedUL，首个面向个性化联邦学习(pFL)的去学习框架。针对pFL中模型分为共享层与个性化层的特性，解决了去学习完整性(pFL)与剩余客户端个性化保持之间的张力。通过层感知的贡献归因、自适应选择性去学习和轻量级重校准协议，在三个数据集上达到与完整重训练相当的去学习效果，同时保持剩余客户端97.3%的个性化准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有联邦去学习(FU)方法主要针对FedAvg范式设计，但实际中个性化联邦学习(pFL)方法（如FedPer、FedRep、Ditto、FedBN）因其处理非IID数据的优越性而被广泛采用。pFL将模型分解为共享全局层和客户端特定个性化层，这从根本上改变了去学习的语义，但该设置鲜有关注。本文旨在形式化pFL范式下的去学习问题，并解决共享层上去学习完整性与剩余客户端个性化保持之间的张力。
AI.method: 提出pFedUL框架，包含三个组件：(1) 基于梯度的层贡献归因：分别量化目标客户端对共享参数和个性化参数的影响；(2) 自适应选择性去学习：跨层类型应用差异化遗忘策略；(3) 轻量级重校准协议：使剩余客户端能以最小开销恢复个性化。同时提出两个新评估指标：个性化保持分数(PPS)和跨客户端公平性指数(CFI)。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10、CIFAR-100和FEMNIST数据集上，在不同非IID设置下，pFedUL达到了与完整重训练相当的去学习效果，同时保持剩余客户端平均97.3%的个性化准确率。与六个适配到pFL设置的SOTA FU方法相比，pFedUL在个性化保持方面一致优于对比方法。
AI.conclusion: pFedUL能有效解决pFL场景下的联邦去学习问题，在保证去学习效果的同时最大化剩余客户端的个性化性能保持，为pFL提供了首个专门设计的去学习解决方案。

title: Context-Aware RL for Agentic and Multimodal LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) often fail when answering requires identifying a small but decisive piece of evidence within a long or complex context, such as a single line in a tool trace or a subtle detail in an image. We propose ContextRL, a context-aware reinforcement learning (RL) method that improves long-horizon reasoning and multimodal performance through an \emph{indirect} auxiliary objective. Instead of supervising only the final answer, ContextRL presents the model with a query, an answer, and two highly similar contexts, and rewards it for selecting the context that supports the query--answer pair, thereby encouraging fine-grained grounding. We construct contrastive context data in two domains: for coding agents, trajectories serve as contexts, yielding 1k pairs built via condition filtering; for multimodal reasoning, images serve as contexts, yielding 7K pairs built via generative editing and similarity search. ContextRL achieves average gains of +2.2% over standard GRPO on 5 long-horizon benchmarks, and +1.8% across 12 diverse visual question answering benchmarks. To disentangle the effect of the proposed objective from that of additional data, we compare against data-augmentation baselines that repurpose the same contrastive contexts as standard query--context--answer examples. These baselines provide little to no improvement, showing that the gains arise from the proposed context-selection objective rather than from the contrastive data alone.

AI.tldr: ContextRL 是一种上下文感知的强化学习方法，通过间接辅助目标（上下文选择任务）提升 LLM 在长程推理和多模态任务中的细粒度证据定位能力，在 5 个长程基准上平均提升 +2.2%，在 12 个视觉问答基准上平均提升 +1.8%，且增益来自目标设计而非额外数据。
AI.motivation: LLM 在需要从长或复杂上下文中识别微小但决定性证据（如工具轨迹中的单行代码、图像中的细微细节）时经常失败，现有监督方法仅关注最终答案，缺乏对细粒度证据定位的训练信号。
AI.method: 提出 ContextRL，在强化学习（GRPO）基础上引入间接辅助目标：给定查询、答案和两个高度相似的上下文，模型需选择支持该查询-答案对的正确上下文。在代码代理领域，通过条件过滤构建 1K 轨迹对；在多模态推理领域，通过生成式编辑和相似度搜索构建 7K 图像对。
AI.result: 在 5 个长程基准上平均提升 +2.2%（对比标准 GRPO）；在 12 个视觉问答基准上平均提升 +1.8%。消融实验表明，将相同对比数据作为标准查询-上下文-答案样本进行数据增强几乎无提升，证明增益来自上下文选择目标本身。
AI.conclusion: ContextRL 通过间接的上下文选择目标有效提升了 LLM 的细粒度上下文理解能力，且该增益不能仅归因于对比数据的引入，验证了目标设计的核心作用。

title: QK-Normed MLA: QK normalization without full key caching
summary: Query-key (QK) normalization stabilizes attention by controlling the scale of queries and keys before the dot product, but is not immediately compatible with Multi-head Latent Attention (MLA). MLA achieves efficient decoding by caching low-dimensional latent states instead of full keys, whereas post-projection QK RMSNorm appears to require the fully projected key for every cached token. We show this apparent incompatibility is an implementation artifact, not an architectural constraint. RMSNorm decomposes into a static affine weight and a dynamic scalar RMS statistic. The static key-side weight can be absorbed into the MLA query-side projection; the dynamic key statistic reduces to one inverse-RMS scalar per token and KV group. The resulting formulation is exactly equivalent to explicit post-projection QK RMSNorm in exact arithmetic and preserves MLA's latent decode path. In our 400M runs trained for up to 100B tokens, QK-Normed MLA achieves lower training loss and better downstream accuracy than QK clipping, while H800 decode benchmarks show less than 2% latency overhead up to 256k context. These results make QK normalization a practical stabilization option for MLA models without requiring full-key caching.

AI.tldr: 本文证明QK归一化（RMSNorm）与多头潜在注意力（MLA）并非架构不兼容，通过将静态键侧权重吸收到查询投影中、动态键统计量简化为每个token和KV组的逆RMS标量，实现了等效于显式后投影QK RMSNorm的公式化，同时保持MLA的潜在解码路径。在400M参数模型、100B token训练中，QK归一化MLA相比QK裁剪实现了更低的训练损失和更好的下游精度，H800解码基准测试在256k上下文下延迟开销低于2%。
AI.motivation: 解决QK归一化与MLA架构的表面不兼容问题，使MLA能够使用QK归一化进行注意力稳定，避免必须缓存完整键向量的实现负担。
AI.method: 将RMSNorm分解为静态仿射权重和动态标量RMS统计量，将静态键侧权重吸收到MLA查询侧投影中，动态键统计量简化为每token和KV组的逆RMS标量，得到与显式后投影QK RMSNorm完全等价的公式化。
AI.result: 400M参数模型训练100B token：QK归一化MLA比QK裁剪训练损失更低、下游准确率更好；H800解码基准测试在256k上下文下延迟开销小于2%。
AI.conclusion: QK归一化可作为MLA模型的实用稳定化选项，无需完整键缓存，且性能优于QK裁剪方案。

title: The Value Axis: Language Models Encode Whether They're on the Right Track
summary: We investigate whether language models internally track the value of their current trajectory, defined as the likelihood that their ongoing strategy will achieve their goals. Using synthetic, in-context reinforcement learning data, we construct a "value" axis for Qwen3-8B. We find that activations along this axis distinguish between high vs. low verbalized confidence, rollouts without and with backtracking, and correct vs. corrupted code. Steering towards high value causally suppresses self-correction and reduces explanatory verbosity, while steering towards low value induces backtracking and exploration. We demonstrate that direct preference optimization (DPO) can increase the internal value of rewarded behaviors (e.g. use a certain word), causing the model to act more confidently after exhibiting them. Finally, we apply the value axis to study in-the-wild settings. For example, we find that Qwen assigns low value to politically sensitive chat queries after post-training and that supervised fine-tuning increases internal confidence within the training domain. Our results suggest that language models linearly encode an estimate of expected goal success that modulates their confidence in pursuing a direction.

AI.tldr: 本文发现语言模型内部存在一个线性编码的“价值轴”，用于跟踪当前策略达成目标的可能性，该轴影响模型的置信度、自我纠正和探索行为，并可通过DPO等方法进行操控。
AI.motivation: 探究语言模型内部是否以及如何跟踪当前轨迹的价值（即当前策略达成目标的可能性），以及这种内部表征如何影响模型的行为表现。
AI.method: 使用合成上下文强化学习数据构建Qwen3-8B的"价值轴"，通过激活分析、因果干预（steering）、直接偏好优化（DPO）以及实际场景验证等方法进行研究。
AI.result: 价值轴激活能区分高低置信度、回溯与非回溯轨迹、正确与错误代码；朝高价值方向引导可抑制自我纠正、减少解释性冗余，朝低价值方向则诱导回溯和探索；DPO能提升奖励行为的内部分值；模型在政治敏感查询中分配低分值，SFT在训练领域内提升内部置信度。
AI.conclusion: 语言模型线性编码了对预期目标成功率的估计，这种估计会调节模型在追求某个方向时的置信度。

title: Diffusion Offline Reinforcement Learning for Fair and Energy-Efficient UAV-Assisted Wireless Networks
summary: The integration of generative artificial intelligence with wireless communication and signal processing systems has opened new avenues for intelligent, data-driven decision-making in future 6G networks. This work proposes a diffusion soft actor-critic (Diffusion-SAC) approach that leverages offline reinforcement learning (RL) enhanced by denoising diffusion probabilistic models (DDPMs) to optimize trajectory and scheduling control in unmanned aerial vehicle (UAV) networks. While offline RL methods, such as conservative Q-learning (CQL), can learn from static datasets, they often struggle to generalize in low-data or dynamic conditions. To address this, we combine the robustness of CQL with the generative power of diffusion models, enabling expressive and signal-aware policy learning that generalizes beyond behavior policies. Applied to a UAV-assisted wireless network, the proposed framework minimizes transmission energy and improves fairness among devices. Simulations show that Diffusion-SAC outperforms standard offline RL baselines, achieving more stable convergence and higher rewards even with limited datasets. The method enhances data efficiency, reduces energy consumption, and increases throughput by more than 35 % compared to existing algorithms, demonstrating its potential for robust policy learning in next-generation wireless control systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种扩散软演员-评论家（Diffusion-SAC）方法，结合离线强化学习与去噪扩散概率模型，用于优化无人机网络中的轨迹和调度控制，相比现有算法在能量效率、吞吐量和数据效率方面均有显著提升。
AI.motivation: 现有离线强化学习方法（如CQL）在数据稀疏或动态条件下泛化能力不足，难以应对6G网络中智能决策的需求。
AI.method: 将保守Q学习（CQL）的稳健性与去噪扩散概率模型（DDPM）的生成能力相结合，提出Diffusion-SAC框架，实现对信号感知策略的富有表现力的学习。
AI.result: Diffusion-SAC在收敛稳定性、奖励获取方面优于标准离线RL基线，吞吐量提升超过35%，同时降低了传输能耗并提升了设备间公平性。
AI.conclusion: 该方法展示了在下一代无线控制系统中实现稳健策略学习的潜力，尤其在数据效率、能耗优化和吞吐量提升方面表现突出。

title: Filtered ANN as a Phase Transition: When Selectivity-Estimation Error Causes Plan Regret
comment: 8 pages, 4 figures. Code, benchmarks, and full pre-registration:https://github.com/samyama-ai/filtered-ann-regret
summary: A filtered approximate-nearest-neighbor (ANN) query returns the k nearest vectors among those satisfying an attribute predicate P of selectivity s. The best execution strategy -- pre-filter, post-filter, or in-filter -- changes with s, so a system must estimate s and choose. We model this as an argmax over a landscape with phases (regions where each strategy wins) separated by boundaries, and show that selectivity-estimation error produces plan regret -- recall lost versus the oracle strategy -- only in the critical regions around those boundaries. The regret is a wedge of log-width equal to the multiplicative estimation error epsilon and height equal to the local cliff |V'(s*)| epsilon; the flip-margin 1/|V'(s*)| is the condition number of a sibling cardinality-estimation study reappearing as the local boundary theory. The two phase boundaries follow from independent mathematics: order statistics place the post-filter cliff at s ~ k/K, and site percolation places the in-filter cliff at s_c ~ 0.83/M for graph degree M (corpus-size independent). Criticality exists only under a constrained budget B < sqrt(k n). Under pre-registered decision rules we confirm, on synthetic sweeps and real SIFT1M, that regret concentrates ~290x at the boundary and that the regret curves obey a finite-size scaling collapse onto one universal wedge across two decades of corpus size. A real approximate index does not mis-locate the boundary, but a biased cost model opens a persistent miscalibration band that estimation-error robustness cannot fix. The contribution is a characterization, not a new index. Code and the full pre-registration are public.

AI.tldr: 本文系统性地分析了带属性谓词过滤的近似最近邻（ANN）查询中，在不同选择性条件下，预过滤、后过滤和内置过滤三种执行策略的边界行为与性能遗憾（regret），揭示了选择率估计误差仅在边界区域产生性能损失，并通过理论推导（顺序统计量与渗流理论）和实验验证（SIFT1M）给出了普适的标度律。
AI.motivation: 现有的过滤式ANN查询系统需要根据属性谓词的选择率选择最优执行策略，但选择率估计存在误差，导致次优策略的选取。本文旨在理论刻画策略选择误差带来的性能损失（regret）的分布规律和边界特征。
AI.method: 将策略选择建模为景观上的argmax问题，定义相（phase）与边界（boundary）；通过顺序统计量推导post-filter边界（s∼k/K），通过渗流理论（site percolation）推导in-filter边界（s_c∼0.83/M）；引入有限尺寸标度分析（finite-size scaling），并在合成数据和SIFT1M真实数据集上进行预注册实验验证。
AI.result: 遗憾仅在临界边界区域产生，呈现楔形结构（宽度与估计误差ε对数相关，高度为|V'(s*)|ε）；遗憾在边界处集中约290倍；遗憾曲线在跨两个数量级的语料库规模上服从普适的有限尺寸标度塌缩；真实近似索引不会错位边界，但有偏的成本模型会导致持续的系统偏差。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了对过滤式ANN查询策略选择问题的理论刻画，而非提出新的索引方法。关键发现是估计误差的鲁棒性仅在边界区域失效，且有偏成本模型带来的偏差无法通过估计误差鲁棒性修正。

title: Communication-Efficient Verifiable Attention for LLM Inference
summary: Computation integrity of remote large language model (LLM) serving can be questionable. For conventional deep neural networks (DNNs), the existing TEE-shielded DNN partitioning (TSDP) approach uses Trusted Execution Environment (TEE) to compute non-linear components and verify the integrity of linear components offloaded to an untrusted GPU. However, directly applying TSDP to Transformer-based LLMs incurs significant TEE computation and TEE-GPU communication overhead. This paper presents Communication-efficient TEE-GPU Attention (\textsc{VeriAttn}) for accelerating verifiable LLM inference. \textsc{VeriAttn} offloads both linear and non-linear computations of attention to the GPU, while TEE performs verification. Moreover, for prefill, \textsc{VeriAttn} uses a two-level pipeline to overlap data movement, TEE pre-/post-processing, and GPU computation. For decoding, when the key-value cache exceeds available GPU memory, \textsc{VeriAttn} partitions attention across TEE and GPU to reduce repeated key-value transfers. Evaluation on an Intel TDX platform shows that \textsc{VeriAttn} achieves 2.60-3.38$\times$ and 3.86-5.42$\times$ acceleration over TSDP for 6k-token prompts and 10k-token outputs during prefill and decoding, respectively.

AI.tldr: 本文提出VeriAttn，一种面向Transformer大模型的通信高效TEE-GPU注意力验证方案，通过将注意力计算完全卸载到GPU并由TEE验证完整性，结合两级流水线和跨TEE/GPU分区策略，显著加速可验证大模型推理。
AI.motivation: 现有TEE-安全DNN分区方法（TSDP）应用于Transformer大模型时，TEE计算负担和TEE-GPU通信开销过大，需要更高效的注意力验证方案。
AI.method: 将注意力的线性与非线性计算全部卸载到GPU，TEE仅执行验证；预填阶段采用两级流水线重叠数据迁移、TEE预处理/后处理与GPU计算；解码阶段在KV缓存超出GPU显存时跨TEE和GPU分区注意力以减少重复KV传输。
AI.result: 在Intel TDX平台上，相比TSDP，预填阶段6k token提示实现2.60-3.38×加速，解码阶段10k token输出实现3.86-5.42×加速。
AI.conclusion: VeriAttn通过通信优化的TEE-GPU注意力验证架构，有效解决了大模型服务中计算完整性验证的性能瓶颈。

title: Simulation-Augmented Multi-Step Split Conformal Prediction for Aggregated Forecasts
comment: Accepted at ICML 2026 workshop: Forecasting as a New Frontier of Intelligence
summary: We study uncertainty quantification for aggregated forecasting tasks such as annual totals and year-over-year growth rates. We propose SA-MSCP, a simulation-augmented multi-step split conformal method that generates future paths from cross-validated residuals using a block bootstrap and constructs prediction intervals from empirical quantiles. Experiments show that SA-MSCP improves empirical coverage over a simulated-path baseline for aggregated and growth-rate targets. Our results demonstrate that simulation-enhanced conformal calibration is an effective and general framework for uncertainty quantification in aggregated time-series forecasting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SA-MSCP方法，一种结合仿真增强和多步分裂保形预测的方法，用于聚合时间序列预测（如年度总量和同比增长率）的不确定性量化。该方法通过交叉验证残差和块自助法生成未来路径，并基于经验分位数构建预测区间。实验表明，SA-MSCP在聚合目标和增长率目标上优于模拟路径基线，证明仿真增强的保形校准是聚合时间序列预测中有效且通用的不确定性量化框架。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在聚合预测任务（如年度总量、同比增长率）的不确定性量化方面存在不足，需要一种能够有效处理这类聚合时间序列预测不确定性的通用方法。
AI.method: 提出SA-MSCP（Simulation-Augmented Multi-Step Split Conformal Prediction）方法，使用交叉验证残差和块自助法生成未来路径，然后通过经验分位数构建预测区间。
AI.result: 实验表明，SA-MSCP在聚合目标和增长率目标上比模拟路径基线具有更好的经验覆盖性能。
AI.conclusion: 仿真增强的保形校准是聚合时间序列预测中一种有效且通用的不确定性量化框架。

title: CacheMuon: Using Temporal Preconditioning To Approximate Polar Factor
summary: Muon is an optimizer that computes updates using the polar factor of the momentum matrix and has shown strong empirical performance across a range of training settings. A key component of Muon is the Newton-Schulz iteration used to compute this polar factor. Although this avoids the cost of an exact singular value decomposition, it remains expensive in practice because it is applied at every optimization step. At the same time, the momentum matrix changes smoothly over training, suggesting strong temporal correlation in the corresponding polar factors. In this paper, we exploit this structure and propose CacheMuon, a temporal preconditioning method that reuses information from previous optimization steps to approximate the polar factor at the current step. This reduces redundant orthogonalization computation across iterations. We analyze CacheMuon as an inexact Muon update, with error controlled by fresh-solver error and cache staleness. Empirically, CacheMuon provides a controllable quality-efficiency frontier: conservative thresholds closely match fresh Muon on language-model and vision training while reducing orthogonalization FLOPs, whereas more aggressive thresholds yield larger arithmetic savings at the cost of modest validation-quality degradation.

AI.tldr: CacheMuon通过利用动量矩阵的时间相关性，缓存先前优化步骤的极分解信息来近似当前步骤的极因子，从而减少冗余的正交化计算，在保持模型性能的同时降低计算开销。
AI.motivation: Muon优化器中的Newton-Schulz迭代在每个优化步骤都要计算极因子，计算成本高昂；然而动量矩阵在训练过程中平滑变化，其对应的极因子具有很强的时序相关性，因此可以利用这种结构来避免重复计算。
AI.method: 提出CacheMuon，一种时序预条件方法，通过复用先前优化步骤的信息来近似当前步骤的极因子，核心思路是利用动量矩阵的时序平滑性进行缓存。该方法可视为一种不精确的Muon更新，其误差由新鲜求解器误差和缓存陈旧度共同控制。
AI.result: CacheMuon在语言模型和视觉训练任务上提供了可控的质量-效率权衡：保守阈值下与原始Muon性能几乎一致，同时减少了正交化FLOPs；激进阈值下可获得更大的算术节省，但会带来适度的验证质量下降。
AI.conclusion: CacheMuon通过时序缓存策略有效降低了Muon优化器的计算成本，实现了质量与效率之间的可调节平衡。

title: Scalable and Interpretable Representation Alignment with Ordinal Similarity
summary: Evaluating representation similarity is fundamental to representation learning. However, existing metrics suffer from significant limitations: they lack interpretability due to shifting baselines, lack robustness to outliers, and are computationally intractable for large datasets, forcing reliance on heuristic approximations. To address this, we develop an ordinal-similarity framework, instantiated by the Triplet (TSI) and Quadruplet (QSI) Similarity Indices, which measure alignment by quantifying the consistency of ordinal relationships. We theoretically demonstrate this formulation is inherently interpretable, robust to outliers, and computationally efficient. Finally, we establish a formal equivalence between TSI and local neighborhood alignment, measured by Mutual Nearest Neighbors. Empirically, we validate these properties and show that ordinal similarity offers a scalable approach to measuring alignment, enabling practitioners to better understand and design representations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于序数关系的表示相似性度量框架（三元组相似性指数TSI和四元组相似性指数QSI），该框架具有可解释性强、对异常值鲁棒、计算高效的优势，并在理论上证明了其与局部邻域对齐（互最近邻）的等价性。
AI.motivation: 现有表示相似性度量指标存在三大缺陷：基线漂移导致缺乏可解释性、对异常值不鲁棒、大规模数据集上计算复杂导致依赖启发式近似，亟需一种克服这些局限的新方法。
AI.method: 提出序数相似性框架，通过量化序数关系的一致性来度量对齐程度，具体实例化为三元组相似性指数（TSI）和四元组相似性指数（QSI）。从理论上证明该框架具有内在可解释性、对异常值鲁棒且计算高效，并在TSI与互最近邻（MNN）度量的局部邻域对齐之间建立了形式化的等价关系。
AI.result: 通过实验验证了序数相似性框架的可解释性、鲁棒性和可扩展性，表明其能够作为一种可扩展的对齐度量方法，帮助从业者更好地理解和设计表示。
AI.conclusion: 序数相似性框架有效克服了现有表示相似性度量的核心局限性，为大规模表示学习中的对齐评估提供了一种兼具理论保证和实际可用性的解决方案。

title: Mixtures of Subspaces for Bandwidth Efficient Context Parallel Training
summary: Pretraining language models with extended context windows enhances their ability to leverage rich information during generation. Existing methods split input sequences into chunks, broadcast them across multiple devices, and compute attention block by block which incurs significant communication overhead. While feasible in high-speed clusters, these methods are impractical for decentralized training over low-bandwidth connections. We propose a compression method for communication-efficient context parallelism in decentralized settings, achieving a remarkable compression rate of over 95\% with negligible overhead and no loss in convergence. Our key insight is to exploit the intrinsic low-rank structure of activation outputs by dynamically constraining them to learned mixtures of subspaces via efficient reparameterizations. We demonstrate scaling billion-parameter decentralized models to context lengths exceeding 100K tokens on networks as slow as 300Mbps, matching the wall-clock convergence speed of centralized models on 100Gbps interconnects.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种针对去中心化训练场景的通信高效上下文并行压缩方法，通过利用激活输出的低秩结构实现95%以上的压缩率，使百亿参数模型能在300Mbps低速网络上扩展到10万+token上下文长度，收敛速度与100Gbps高速互联的集中式模型相当。
AI.motivation: 现有上下文并行方法在去中心化训练中面临严重的通信开销问题，因为它们在多个设备间广播分块序列并逐块计算注意力，这在高带宽集群中可行，但在低速网络环境下不实用。
AI.method: 利用激活输出的内在低秩结构，通过高效的重新参数化将其动态约束到学习的子空间混合上，实现通信压缩。
AI.result: 在低至300Mbps的网络上实现10万token以上的上下文长度，收敛速度与100Gbps高速互联的集中式模型匹配，压缩率超过95%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使去中心化训练能支持超长上下文，显著降低了对网络带宽的要求，为分布式训练在实际场景中的应用提供了可行方案。

title: Robust Neural Tucker Factorization with Bias Correction and Adaptive Initialization
summary: High-dimensional incomplete (HDI) tensors are widely used in traffic and climate applications, but sparse observations make accurate completion difficult. The intrinsic non-linear dynamics and non-stationary variations across distinct multi-modal fields severely hinder the efficacy of conventional linear reconstruction frameworks. Neural Tucker factorization provides an effective framework for modeling high-order interactions among tensor modes. By parameterizing underlying structural characteristics into continuous latent spaces, neural representations circumvent the rigid low-rank constraints of classical algebra. However, its performance can still be affected by implementation-level choices, especially parameter initialization and the bias configuration of the final output mapping. Suboptimal initializations frequently lead to variance explosion across the cubically expanded interaction spaces, driving the subsequent non-linear activation boundaries into severe gradient saturation zones, while the omission of a dedicated translation parameter forces interaction weights to implicitly absorb global statistical deviations. This paper proposes a simple yet effective neural Tucker factorization model with Kaiming initialization and bias correction (KaBiN) for HDI tensor completion. The proposed model utilizes Kaiming uniform initialization for the embedding and Tucker linear parameters, and adopts a simple bias correction in output mapping. By elegantly decoupling global mean shifts from local structural representations, the framework provides a highly stable and well-conditioned optimization landscape. Experiments on three real-world HDI tensor datasets show that KaBiN achieves better performance than the original NeuTucF, while introducing minimal computational overhead.

AI.tldr: 针对高维不完全张量补全问题，本文提出KaBiN模型，通过Kaiming初始化与偏置校正改进神经Tucker分解，有效解决参数初始化导致的梯度饱和与全局偏移隐式吸收问题，在三个真实数据集上以极小计算开销取得更优性能。
AI.motivation: 高维不完全张量在交通、气候等领域广泛存在，但稀疏观测导致补全困难。传统线性重构框架受限于刚性低秩约束，而神经Tucker分解虽能建模高阶交互，却受参数初始化策略与输出映射偏置配置的严重影响——次优初始化导致方差爆炸和非线性激活进入梯度饱和区，偏置缺失迫使交互权重隐式吸收全局统计偏差。
AI.method: 提出KaBiN模型：1) 对嵌入层和Tucker线性参数采用Kaiming均匀初始化，稳定跨模态交互空间的方差传播；2) 在输出映射中引入简单偏置校正项，将全局均值偏移与局部结构表征优雅解耦。整体框架在保持神经Tucker分解表达能力的同时，提供高度稳定且条件良好的优化景观。
AI.result: 在三个真实世界高维不完全张量数据集上，KaBiN相比原始NeuTucF取得了更优的补全性能，且仅引入极小的计算开销增量。
AI.conclusion: Kaiming初始化与偏置校正是提升神经Tucker分解有效性的关键实现级改进，为高维不完全张量补全提供了一种简单、稳定且高效的解决方案。

title: MUNI: Multimodal Unified Latent Diffusion for Coherent Any-to-Any Generation
summary: We introduce MUNI, an end-to-end multimodal latent diffusion framework for any-to-any generation that unifies subset-conditioned cross-modal generation and unconditional joint sampling through a shared stochastic latent. Existing multimodal generative models are largely LLM-based, which limits leveraging modality-specific generators and requires text-paired data for training. Recent diffusion- and flow-based any-to-any extensions take a different direction but still rely on text-aligned embeddings, fully-paired training, or matched-dimensionality deterministic mappings. MUNI rests on two complementary contributions, one architectural and one in the training objective. First, we extend latent diffusion to multimodal any-to-any generation end-to-end: instead of the standard two-stage recipe that precomputes a frozen latent space and then fits a prior over it, MUNI jointly trains modality-specific encoders, expressive decoders, and a single shared flow-based prior under one objective. Second, we identify that the standard aggregation rules of multimodal variational inference are insufficient once coupled with a learned prior and expressive decoders. A suitable shared latent must simultaneously satisfy coherence across generated modalities, predictive sufficiency of subset latents, and minimality of the latent content. We propose a routed training objective whose structural choices align the latent with these criteria and admit a minimal-sufficiency characterization in the realizable setting. Experiments on PolyMNIST-Quadrant-Labels and a large-scale image-text-audio benchmark show MUNI matching or exceeding the strongest baselines on conditional generation while opening its largest margins on unconditional coherence. Project page: https://muni-proj.github.io/.

AI.tldr: MUNI是一个端到端的多模态潜扩散框架，通过共享随机潜变量实现任意模态间的条件生成和无条件联合采样，采用联合训练的架构和路由训练目标来确保潜变量的最小充分性。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态生成模型大多基于LLM，依赖文本配对数据且无法充分利用模态专用生成器；而最近基于扩散/流的方法仍依赖文本对齐嵌入、完全配对数据或匹配维度的确定性映射，限制了生成灵活性和质量。
AI.method: 1) 架构上扩展潜扩散到端到端多模态任意生成，联合训练模态专用编码器、表达性解码器和共享基于流的先验；2) 提出路由训练目标，确保共享潜变量同时满足跨模态生成一致性、子集潜变量的预测充分性和潜内容最小性，实现最小充分性表征。
AI.result: 在PolyMNIST-Quadrant-Labels和大规模图像-文本-音频基准上，MUNI在条件生成任务中匹配或超越最强基线，在无条件下采样一致性上取得最大优势。
AI.conclusion: MUNI证明了端到端联合训练的多模态潜扩散框架在任意到任意生成中的有效性，特别是路由训练目标对实现最小充分性潜变量的关键作用，为多模态生成提供了新范式。

title: Not all Jensen-Shannon Divergence Estimators are Equal
summary: The Jensen-Shannon divergence is widely reported as a scalar measure of fidelity for synthetic tabular data. Yet, in practice, it is estimated from finite samples using protocols that are often underspecified. This creates a measurement problem. Although the population divergence is well defined, the empirical value depends on the estimator family, sampling protocol, calibration, dimensionality, and class balance. We show that different protocols can yield non-comparable values: marginal-based estimators ignore dependencies in the joint distribution and can severely underestimate divergence, while classifier-based estimators capture joint structure but exhibit strong estimator dependence. We systematically study this behavior across controlled settings with reference divergences and real-world synthetic tabular benchmarks. Our analysis reveals dependence blindness in marginal estimators, prior-shift bias under class imbalance, and estimator sensitivity in high dimensions. To address prior shift, we derive a closed-form posterior correction for classifier-based Jensen-Shannon estimation. Our results show that empirical Jensen-Shannon divergence values are inherently protocol-dependent, making explicit specification of the estimation procedure necessary for meaningful comparison. We provide practical guidelines and an open-source tool for estimator-aware Jensen-Shannon evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文揭示了JS散度在合成表格数据保真度评估中的估计协议依赖性问题：不同估计方法（边际估计 vs 分类器估计）会产生不可比较的结果，存在依赖盲区、先验偏移偏差和高维敏感度等问题，并提出了一种闭合形式的后验校正方法及开源工具。
AI.motivation: JS散度被广泛用作合成表格数据保真度的标量度量，但实践中对有限样本下的估计协议描述不足，导致测量结果不可靠、不可比较。
AI.method: 系统比较了边际估计器和分类器估计器在控制实验和真实合成数据基准上的表现，揭示了依赖盲区、先验偏移偏差和高维敏感度等问题；针对先验偏移，推导了分类器估计器的闭合形式后验校正。
AI.result: 经验JS散度值本质上依赖于估计协议；边际估计器忽略联合分布依赖导致低估，分类器估计器捕获联合结构但受估计器选择和类别不平衡影响；所提出的后验校正有效缓解了先验偏移偏差。
AI.conclusion: JS散度的可靠使用必须明确指定估计协议，研究提供了实践指南和开源工具以支持可比较的估计器感知评估。

title: Taylor-Calibrate: Principled Initialization for Hybrid Linear Attention Distillation
summary: Hybrid linear attention models offer an appealing path to faster long-context inference: they reduce the quadratic cost and KV-cache burden of full softmax attention while retaining much of the quality of Transformer models. A practical way to obtain such models is to convert a pretrained Transformer instead of pretraining a new architecture from scratch, but this conversion is still brittle. Simply copying the teacher attention projections into a Gated DeltaNet (GDN) student does not specify the new recurrent decay, write, and output-gating dynamics. As a result, the converted model often starts in a poor dynamical regime and must spend many distillation tokens repairing initialization rather than learning the remaining teacher behavior. We propose Taylor-Calibrate, a lightweight initialization method for hybrid GDN students. The method uses Taylor-guided teacher attention statistics to set the value projection, memory timescale, write gates, and output gate, then applies a short per-layer alignment step to match each converted layer to the teacher output. Across four teacher settings and three retained-layer policies, Taylor-Calibrate gives substantially stronger zero-shot students, with up to an 88x improvement in a representative ablation, and reaches matched recovery targets with 4.9x--9.2x fewer training tokens than naive conversion.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Taylor-Calibrate方法，通过泰勒引导的教师注意力统计量来初始化混合线性注意力学生模型（Gated DeltaNet），相较于朴素转换方法，零样本性能提升最高达88倍，达到相同恢复目标所需训练token减少4.9-9.2倍。
AI.motivation: 将预训练Transformer转换为混合线性注意力模型（如Gated DeltaNet）时，朴素复制注意力投影参数无法指定新的循环衰减、写入和输出门控动力学，导致模型初始处于不良动力状态，需要大量蒸馏token修复初始化而非学习教师行为。
AI.method: 提出Taylor-Calibrate轻量初始化方法：利用泰勒引导的教师注意力统计量设置值投影、记忆时间尺度、写入门和输出门，再通过短时逐层对齐步骤使每个转换层匹配教师输出。
AI.result: 在四种教师设置和三种保留层策略下，Taylor-Calibrate显著提升零样本学生模型性能，典型消融实验改进达88倍，达到相同恢复目标所需训练token减少4.9-9.2倍。
AI.conclusion: Taylor-Calibrate是一种高效的混合线性注意力模型初始化方法，能大幅降低转换成本和训练开销。

title: Autonomous End-to-End SOH Prediction Services for Battery Systems via Temporal-Contrastive Representation Learning
summary: Accurate state of health (SOH) estimation is a critical diagnostic service for lithium-ion battery management. However, reliance on labor-intensive manual feature engineering and opaque black-box models hinders scalable industrial deployment. To address this, we introduce TC-SOH: a modular, plug-and-play service architecture for autonomous, end-to-end SOH prediction. TC-SOH employs a temporal-contrastive mechanism and a cross-window prediction pretext task to extract degradation-relevant representations directly from raw operational data. To improve transparency, we connect model efficacy with representation diagnostics: visualization, sensitivity analysis, redundancy analysis, bidirectional probing, future-SOH probing, and temporal shuffling show that learned features overlap with selected expert descriptors while retaining additional SOH-relevant variation, and that ordered temporal context improves subsequent-SOH prediction. Across four public datasets, TC-SOH outperforms the considered physics-informed and data-driven baselines, reducing MAPE by 1.91 times and RMSE by 2.13 times.

AI.tldr: TC-SOH是一个模块化、即插即用的端到端锂离子电池健康状态（SOH）预测服务架构，采用时序对比机制和跨窗口预测预训练任务从原始运行数据中提取退化相关表征，在四个公开数据集上实现MAPE降低1.91倍、RMSE降低2.13倍的性能提升，并通过多维表征诊断提升了模型透明度。
AI.motivation: 解决现有SOH估计方法依赖人工特征工程和黑箱模型难以规模化工业部署的问题，需要一种自主、端到端且透明的SOH预测方案。
AI.method: 提出TC-SOH模块化即插即用架构，使用时序对比机制和跨窗口预测预训练任务从原始运行数据中提取退化表征，并通过可视化、敏感性分析、冗余分析、双向探测、未来SOH探测和时间洗牌等表征诊断工具提升可解释性。
AI.result: 在四个公开数据集上，TC-SOH相比所比较的物理信息驱动和数据驱动基线方法，MAPE降低1.91倍，RMSE降低2.13倍。表征诊断显示学习到的特征与专家描述符重叠且保留了额外的SOH相关变异，有序时序上下文有助于后续SOH预测。
AI.conclusion: TC-SOH实现了无需人工特征工程的端到端SOH预测，兼具高性能与可解释性，为工业部署提供了可行方案。

title: SDS-LoRA: Overcoming Anisotropic Gradient Scaling in Low-Rank Adaptation
summary: Low-Rank Adaptation (LoRA) enables efficient adaptation of large pre-trained models to downstream tasks by parameterizing weight updates with low-rank matrices. In this paper, we investigate the limitations of the LoRA parameterization from a geometric perspective. Specifically, we show that when a full fine-tuning gradient is backpropagated to the low-rank matrices, it undergoes anisotropic scaling driven by their singular values. We argue that this phenomenon is undesirable because it distorts the full fine-tuning gradient by skewing it toward dominant singular directions while suppressing others. Our analyses demonstrate that anisotropic gradient scaling reduces the effective rank of the low-rank matrices' gradients and results in suboptimal alignment between the full fine-tuning gradient and its low-rank approximation in LoRA, thereby exacerbating the gap to full fine-tuning. To address these limitations, we propose a new low-rank parameterization, SDS-LoRA, which structurally decouples singular values from the backward pass. Our method ensures that the full fine-tuning gradient backpropagates only through the orthonormal bases of the low-rank matrices' subspaces, independent of their scales. Convergence analysis demonstrates that while LoRA's convergence rate degrades with the condition number of the low-rank matrices, SDS-LoRA remains independent of it. Experimental results across natural language and vision benchmarks show that SDS-LoRA improves loss convergence and reduces the gap to full fine-tuning, significantly enhancing adaptation performance.

AI.tldr: 本文从几何角度分析了LoRA的局限性，指出反向传播中梯度经低秩矩阵时会因奇异值发生各向异性缩放，导致有效秩降低和梯度对齐不佳。为解决此问题，提出SDS-LoRA，在反向传播中结构性地解耦奇异值，使梯度仅通过正交基传播而不受尺度影响。理论分析和实验表明SDS-LoRA收敛更快、更接近全量微调效果。
AI.motivation: LoRA虽然高效但存在与全量微调之间的性能差距，作者从几何角度揭示其根本原因：低秩矩阵的奇异值导致梯度反向传播时发生各向异性缩放，扭曲了梯度信号，降低了低秩矩阵梯度的有效秩，并使梯度对齐变差。
AI.method: 提出SDS-LoRA（Singular Value Decoupled LoRA），核心思想是在反向传播中结构性地解耦奇异值，使得全量微调梯度仅通过低秩矩阵子空间的正交基传播，不受尺度（奇异值）影响，从而消除各向异性梯度缩放问题。
AI.result: 收敛性分析表明LoRA的收敛率受低秩矩阵条件数影响而退化，SDS-LoRA则与之无关。在自然语言和视觉基准上的实验验证了SDS-LoRA改善了损失收敛，缩小了与全量微调的差距，显著提升了适配性能。
AI.conclusion: SDS-LoRA通过解耦奇异值与反向传播，有效解决了LoRA的梯度各向异性缩放问题，是一种更优的低秩参数化方案，能够更好地逼近全量微调效果。

title: SPRI: SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization for Data-Constrained MoE Upcycling
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models enable efficient scaling, but training them from scratch remains prohibitively expensive. MoE upcycling mitigates this cost by converting pretrained dense models into sparse MoE models. However, existing upcycling methods typically rely on large-scale continued training and often perform poorly under data-constrained supervised adaptation, due to either homogeneous experts or overly disruptive perturbations to pretrained parameters. In this setting, effective upcycling must leverage pretrained weight structure while introducing sufficient diversity among routed experts. To this end, we propose SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization (SPRI), which distributes SVD-partitioned residuals derived from pretrained feed-forward network (FFN) weights across routed experts, introducing controlled expert diversity grounded in pretrained spectral structure. We further introduce a two-stage training strategy to improve adaptation stability. We evaluate SPRI on multilingual speech-to-text translation, where limited supervised data challenges MoE upcycling and multiple target languages provide natural routing heterogeneity. On CoVoST2 across 15 En-to-XX directions, SPRI improves average BLEU and COMET over fully fine-tuned dense models by 2.58 and 3.32 points, respectively, and outperforms the prior best MoE upcycling baseline by 3.39 BLEU and 4.34 COMET points.

AI.tldr: 提出SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization (SPRI)方法，利用预训练FFN权重的SVD分解残差初始化MoE专家，配合两阶段训练策略，在数据受限的多语言语音到文本翻译任务中显著优于现有MoE upcycling方法。
AI.motivation: 现有MoE upcycling方法在数据受限的监督适应场景下表现不佳，原因在于专家同质性过高或对预训练参数扰动过大。需要一种既能利用预训练权重结构又能引入足够专家多样性的upcycling方法。
AI.method: 1) SVD-Partitioned Residual Initialization (SPRI)：对预训练FFN权重进行SVD分解，将残差分量分配到不同的 routed expert 中，基于预训练的谱结构引入受控的专家多样性。2) 两阶段训练策略：提升适应稳定性。
AI.result: 在CoVoST2的15个En-to-XX翻译方向上，SPRI相比完全微调的稠密模型平均BLEU提升2.58、COMET提升3.32；相比最优MoE upcycling基线分别提升3.39 BLEU和4.34 COMET。
AI.conclusion: SPRI通过SVD分解预训练FFN权重来初始化专家，在数据受限场景下有效实现了专家多样性与预训练知识保留之间的平衡，显著提升了MoE upcycling在低资源多语言翻译任务上的性能。

title: Privacy from Symmetry: Orthogonally Equivariant Transformers for LLM Inference
summary: Running large language models locally is often impractical, pushing inference on sensitive text to third-party providers. Split inference partially mitigates this by keeping tokens on the client and sending only hidden representations, but these representations can still be recovered via nearest-neighbor search against the public embedding table. We propose an orthogonal obfuscation procedure in which the client multiplies embeddings by a secret orthogonal matrix before transmission. To enable correct inference under arbitrary rotations, we introduce ConjFormer, a transformer variant that is exactly $\mathrm{O}(d)$-equivariant via a lightweight normalization change (scalar RMSNorm) together with blockwise orthogonal conjugation of all linear weights. As a result, the server performs the full forward pass entirely in the rotated basis and never observes unrotated hidden states. Experiments on GPT-2 and Llama 3.2 1B models fine-tuned on PubMed show that orthogonal obfuscation eliminates direct cosine nearest-neighbor inversion and reduces token recovery from over 35% top-10 to at most 1.3%, while increasing perplexity by only 0.4% after fine-tuning. These results indicate that enforcing symmetry at the architectural level can provide a practical defense for privacy-preserving LLM inference without noise injection or heavy cryptographic machinery.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种通过正交混淆保护大模型推理隐私的方法，客户端将嵌入向量乘以秘密正交矩阵后再发送，并设计了O(d)-等变的ConjFormer架构，使服务器在旋转基下进行完整前向传播，从而消除直接余弦最近邻反转攻击，将令牌恢复率从35%以上降至1.3%以下，困惑度仅增加0.4%。
AI.motivation: 在本地运行大语言模型不切实际，将敏感文本推理交给第三方服务存在隐私泄露风险。现有的分割推理方法虽将令牌保留在客户端，但隐藏表示仍可通过最近邻搜索攻击从公开的嵌入表中恢复。
AI.method: 提出正交混淆程序：客户端在传输前将嵌入乘以秘密正交矩阵；设计ConjFormer——一种精确O(d)-等变的Transformer变体，通过标量RMSNorm归一化和对所有线性权重的分块正交共轭实现，使服务器在旋转基下执行完整前向传播，永不观察未旋转的隐藏状态。
AI.result: 在PubMed微调的GPT-2和Llama 3.2 1B模型上，正交混淆消除了直接余弦最近邻反转，令牌恢复率从超过35% top-10降低至最多1.3%，微调后困惑度仅增加0.4%。
AI.conclusion: 在架构层面强制对称性可以为隐私保护的大模型推理提供实用防御，无需噪声注入或重密码学机制。

title: Learning aligned EEG representations with subject-specific encoders
summary: Cross-subject EEG decoding promises more training data, but it also exposes neural networks to strong inter-subject distribution shifts. We study whether task supervision and architecture alone can learn subject-aligned representations. We replace a shared EEG encoder with subject-specific encoders followed by a common classifier, and compare this hybrid model with standard EEGNet, AttentionBaseNet, and CTNet baselines with Euclidean Alignment (EA) on four motor-imagery datasets. EA improves shared encoders by recentering subject covariances, but the hybrid encoder largely internalises this role: validation-loss curves and latent-distance analyses change little when EA is removed. Subject-specific heads increase class distinctiveness and place each subject close to its own latent manifold, improving most subjects while leaving a method-sensitive subset. These results support subject-specific encoders as a learned alignment mechanism for EEG decoding and identify head selection for unseen subjects as the remaining bottleneck.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在跨被试EEG解码中，使用被试特定编码器替代共享编码器可以作为一种学习性的对齐机制，有效处理被试间分布偏移，而无需依赖欧几里得对齐等预处理方法。
AI.motivation: 跨被试EEG解码面临被试间分布偏移的挑战，现有方法通常依赖欧几里得对齐（EA）等预处理来缓解。本研究旨在探究仅凭任务监督和架构设计本身能否学习到被试对齐的表征。
AI.method: 将共享EEG编码器替换为每个被试独立的编码器后接一个共享分类器（混合模型），在四个运动想象数据集上与标准EEGNet、AttentionBaseNet、CTNet基线及EA方法进行对比。通过验证损失曲线和潜在距离分析评估对齐效果。
AI.result: EA能改善共享编码器，但混合编码器在很大程度上内化了这一作用——移除EA后验证损失和潜在距离变化很小。被试特定头增加了类别区分度，使每个被试接近其自身的潜在流形，改善了大多数被试的表现，但存在一个对方法敏感的子集。
AI.conclusion: 被试特定编码器是一种有效的学习性对齐机制，可用于EEG解码；为未见过的被试选择合适编码器头是当前的主要瓶颈。

title: BRICKS-WM: Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models
summary: Model-based Reinforcement Learning (MBRL) has achieved remarkable success in continuous control by leveraging latent world models. However, prevailing approaches typically rely on monolithic latent dynamics, entangling environment dynamics into a coupled process. This coupling severely limits reusability: altering the agent necessitates retraining the entire world from scratch, even if the environment remains constant. To address this, we introduce BRICKS-WM (Building Reusability via Interface Composition Kinetics for Structured World Models), a framework for the modular assembly of structured world models. Driven by the insight that the physical world is composed of independent entities, we posit that global dynamics can be modeled as a composition of distinct dynamical modules interacting via latent interfaces. As a minimal instantiation, we factorize the latent state space into an actuated Agent module and an external Background module, bridged by a learned latent interface. Unlike prior object-centric methods that prioritize visual segmentation, BRICKS-WM enforces a functional separation in transition dynamics, ensuring that background dynamics remains agnostic to the agent's dynamics. Empirically, BRICKS-WM achieves control performance comparable to strong monolithic baselines when trained from scratch, and enables the reuse of frozen background dynamics across agents.

AI.tldr: BRICKS-WM 提出一种模块化世界模型构建方法，将潜在状态分解为智能体模块和背景模块，通过潜在接口交互，实现背景动力学跨智能体的零样本复用。
AI.motivation: 现有基于模型的强化学习（MBRL）方法使用单一潜在动力学模型，将环境动态耦合在一起，导致更换智能体时必须从头重新训练整个世界模型，缺乏可复用性。
AI.method: 将潜在状态空间分解为可操作的Agent模块和外部Background模块，两者通过学习的潜在接口桥接，实现功能分离的迁移动力学建模。
AI.result: BRICKS-WM 在从头训练时达到与强基线相当的控制器性能，并支持冻结的背景动力学在不同智能体间复用。
AI.conclusion: 通过模块化分解和接口设计，BRICKS-WM 在不牺牲控制性能的前提下，显著提升了世界模型的可复用性，为可迁移的MBRL提供了新范式。

title: daVinci-kernel: Co-Evolving Skill Selection, Summarization, and Utilization via RL for GPU Kernel Optimization
summary: GPU kernel optimization represents a paradigm where functional correctness is assumed and execution efficiency is the objective. We present daVinci-kernel, a reinforcement learning framework that couples skill discovery with skill exploitation through a dynamically evolving skill library. daVinci-kernel jointly trains three agents sharing one LLM backbone: a Skill Selection Agent that retrieves relevant techniques via BM25 and LLM reranking, a Policy Agent that generates multi-turn CUDA/Triton kernels conditioned on selected skills, and a Skill Summary Agent that distills successful rollouts into reusable skills. Candidate skills are added only after execution-based verification confirms reproducible speedups. All three agents share a single LLM backbone, are initialized via a structured SFT cold start on diversity-filtered data, and are then jointly optimized end-to-end with multi-turn REINFORCE and per-agent advantage estimation. On KernelBench, daVinci-kernel-14B achieves 37.2%, 70.6%, and 32.2% on Level 1, Level 2, and Level 3 under the Fast$_1$ threshold, outperforming the strongest prior RL-trained model, Dr.Kernel-14B.

AI.tldr: 提出了daVinci-kernel，一个结合技能发现与技能利用的强化学习框架，通过动态演化的技能库和三个共享LLM骨干的智能体联合训练，在KernelBench上显著超越了先前的RL模型Dr.Kernel-14B。
AI.motivation: GPU内核优化场景中，功能正确性已被假设成立，核心目标是执行效率；现有方法缺乏系统性的技能发现与复用机制，以提升优化效果。
AI.method: 设计三个共享同一个LLM骨干的智能体：技能选择智能体（BM25+LLM重排序检索）、策略智能体（生成多轮CUDA/Triton内核）、技能总结智能体（将成功样本蒸馏为可复用技能）。技能库动态演化，只有执行验证确认可复现加速比后才添加候选技能。通过结构化SFT冷启动初始化，再采用多轮REINFORCE和每智能体优势估计进行端到端联合优化。
AI.result: 在KernelBench上，daVinci-kernel-14B在Level 1、Level 2、Level 3上分别取得37.2%、70.6%、32.2%的Fast₁阈值通过率，全面超越最强RL基线模型Dr.Kernel-14B。
AI.conclusion: 所提出的技能发现与利用框架有效提升了GPU内核优化的RL训练效果，证明了动态技能库和共享LLM骨干的多智能体联合训练策略的有效性。

title: Tail-Shape Estimation in LLM Evaluation Is Fragile: A Protocol for Diagnosing False Positives
comment: 9 pages of main paper, 4 figures and 4 tables in the main paper, more in the appendix
summary: Recent work motivates moving large language model (LLM) evaluation from mean-based to tail-aware metrics, including conditional value-at-risk and tail-index estimates of reward-model error. We ask whether the canonical extreme-value-theory tail-index parameter, which isolates how heavy a tail is from how large the tail mass is, adds discriminative information beyond the mean and a standard tail-magnitude statistic in LLM evaluation. We pre-register a protocol covering admissibility, goodness-of-fit, threshold-stability, and effect-size requirements for any positive tail-shape claim. The protocol is the contribution of this paper; the empirical study below is a demonstration of what its gates catch. Applied to a standard LLM toxicity-evaluation setup under two structurally different scorer families, the protocol catches three distinct modes of false positives that a naive analysis would have published, and rejects the headline tail-shape claim on both scorers. We conclude that tail-shape estimation in the LLM toxicity-evaluation setups we examined is more fragile than the recent literature suggests, and recommend the protocol as a starting point for tail-index claims in similar setups.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并验证了一套严格的前置注册协议，用于检验LLM评估中尾指数（尾部形状参数）是否能提供超越均值和标准尾量统计量的判别信息。通过对两个毒性评估评分器的分析，该协议发现了三种假阳性模式，并拒绝了主要尾部形状假设，表明尾部形状估计比近期文献所显示的更为脆弱。
AI.motivation: 近期研究提出LLM评估应从基于均值转向关注尾部（如条件风险价值、尾指数估计等）。本文探究尾部形状参数（尾指数）在均值与标准尾量统计量之外是否具有额外的判别信息价值。
AI.method: 作者预先注册了一套完整协议，涵盖可接受性、拟合优度、阈值稳定性和效应量要求。将该协议应用于标准LLM毒性评估设置下的两类结构不同的评分器，以检测尾部形状声称的有效性。
AI.result: 协议检测到三种不同的假阳性模式（这些模式在朴素分析中会被发表），并在两个评分器上均拒绝了头条尾部形状声称。
AI.conclusion: 在LLM毒性评估设置中，尾部形状估计比近期文献所显示的更为脆弱，作者建议将该协议作为类似设置中尾指数声称的起点。

title: Direction-Conditioned Policies via Compositional Subgoal Scoring for Online Goal-Conditioned Reinforcement Learning
comment: 17 pages, Accepted to the 2nd Workshop on Compositional Learning at ICML 2026 (Seoul, South Korea)
summary: Hamilton-Jacobi-Bellman theory implies that the optimal goal-conditioned action depends on the goal only through the gradient of the goal-reaching distance at the current state, yet standard online GCRL still conditions the actor on the raw goal -- a signal that is geometrically uninformative when the goal is far from the data distribution. We propose Direction-Conditioned Policies (DCP), a fully online method that decomposes goal-reaching into two components sharing one InfoNCE representation $ψ$: a subgoal-scoring step that selects a visited state $z_t$ aligned with the final goal $g$ in $ψ_g$, and a direction-conditioned actor that consumes the unit direction $d_t$ and magnitude $r_t$ from $ψ(s_t)$ to $ψ(z_t)$. The two components train jointly, factor cleanly at deployment (subgoal scoring is removed, while direction conditioning remains with $g$ in place of $z_t$), and admit independent modification at the same $(d_t,r_t)$ interface. We prove three results. First, direction sufficiency under HJB: the optimal action under control-affine dynamics depends on the goal only through the value gradient. Second, a quantitative bound showing that, under mild conditions on the learned representation and assuming the scoring rule returns an on-path $z_t$, the actor's conditioning input at training and at deployment coincide up to representation error and geodesic slack. Third, a controllable-subspace characterization of when directional conditioning fails. Across nine environments, DCP improves over Contrastive RL on most final metrics, with the largest gains on manipulation and obstacle-interaction tasks; a qualitative analysis of the learned $ψ$-distance landscape shows the contrastive representation behaves as an online quasimetric encoding environment topology, and the single failure case (AntSoccer) localizes to a learned-gradient pathology that the theory anticipates.

AI.tldr: 提出方向条件策略(DCP)，将目标条件强化学习分解为子目标评分和方向条件策略两部分，共享InfoNCE表示，理论证明方向充分性并实验验证有效性。
AI.motivation: 标准在线目标条件强化学习(Goal-Conditioned RL)中，智能体直接将原始目标作为策略输入，但远距离目标在几何上信息量不足，导致学习效率低。作者希望利用HJB理论中"最优动作仅依赖于目标通过价值梯度的信息"这一洞察，设计更高效的目标条件策略。
AI.method: 提出DCP框架：(1) 子目标评分：选择与最终目标g在InfoNCE表示ψ中对齐的已访问状态z_t；(2) 方向条件策略：消费从ψ(s_t)到ψ(z_t)的单位方向d_t和幅值r_t。两部分共享一个InfoNCE表示ψ，联合训练，部署时可解耦（去除子目标评分，用g替代z_t输入方向条件策略）。
AI.result: 在9个环境中，DCP在大部分最终指标上优于Contrastive RL，在操作和障碍交互任务上提升最大；对比学习表示的ψ-距离景观定性分析表明其作为在线拟度量编码环境拓扑；唯一的失败案例(AntSoccer)定位到学习梯度病理，被理论所预见。
AI.conclusion: DCP通过方向条件有效解决了远距离目标几何信息不足的问题，理论证明了方向充分性（控制仿射动力学下最优动作仅通过值梯度依赖目标）、训练-部署一致性条件及方向条件失效的可控子空间刻画，实验验证了方法的有效性和理论预测的正确性。

title: How Post-Training Shapes Biological Reasoning Models
summary: Scientific reasoning models for biology combine language models with foundation models trained on multimodal biological data, including DNA, RNA, and proteins. These models are built through post-training, yet how each stage shapes reasoning and generalization remains poorly understood. We study when post-training improves performance and when it induces over-specialization. Across genomics, transcriptomics, and proteins, we train and evaluate more than 100 biological reasoning models under controlled variation in backbone, continued pre-training (CPT), supervised fine-tuning (SFT), and reinforcement learning (RL), measuring both in-domain (ID) and out-of-domain (OOD) performance. We find that each post-training stage reshapes generalization in a distinct way rather than contributing uniform gains. CPT improves downstream performance by aligning models with biological language. SFT consistently increases ID performance but causes OOD performance to peak early and decline as models fit the training distribution. RL, when applied to strong SFT checkpoints with aligned rewards, improves OOD performance and partially recovers generalization. These results show that biological reasoning does not improve monotonically with additional supervision or compute. Instead, performance depends on how training stages are composed. Under fixed post-training budgets, the strongest ID-OOD trade-off comes from brief SFT, larger RL allocations, and asymmetric adaptation capacity across stages.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了生物推理模型（基于语言模型与多模态生物基础模型）在后训练各阶段（CPT、SFT、RL）的表现，发现各阶段对泛化能力的影响不同：CPT提升生物语言对齐，SFT提升领域内性能但导致领域外性能先升后降，RL可部分恢复泛化。最优策略是短SFT加更多RL资源分配。
AI.motivation: 当前生物科学推理模型通过后训练构建，但后训练各阶段（CPT、SFT、RL）如何影响模型的推理能力和泛化能力尚不清楚，尤其是何时提升性能、何时导致过度专业化（over-specialization）缺乏系统性理解。
AI.method: 在基因组学、转录组学和蛋白质组学三个领域，通过控制骨干网络、CPT、SFT和RL等变量，训练并评估了超过100个生物推理模型，同时测量了领域内（ID）和领域外（OOD）性能。
AI.result: CPT通过对齐生物语言提升下游性能；SFT持续提升ID性能但导致OOD性能先升后降；RL在强SFT检查点和对齐奖励条件下可改善OOD性能并部分恢复泛化。生物推理性能并非随监督或计算单调提升，而是取决于各阶段的组合方式。
AI.conclusion: 在后训练预算固定的情况下，实现最佳ID-OOD权衡的策略是：短SFT、更大的RL分配，以及各阶段间的不对称适应能力。

title: Neural Bayesian Anomaly Mitigation: A Robust Loss that Doubles as an Unsupervised Contamination Classifier
summary: Engineered robust losses such as Huber, Student-$t$, and generalised cross-entropy make supervised models tolerant of contamination but cannot answer which observations are corrupted. We introduce Neural Bayesian Anomaly Mitigation (NBAM), a general-purpose drop-in loss derived from a Bayesian latent-switch mixture model: the marginal likelihood defines a robust supervised loss, and the associated posterior defines an unsupervised contamination classifier. Like Huber or Student-$t$, NBAM can replace the standard training loss in any supervised pipeline; unlike them, it additionally learns a structured contamination model and returns a calibrated per-sample contamination posterior. A learned input-dependent prior $π_φ(x)$ captures the spatial locality of contamination, so that samples near known corruptions are more likely to be flagged, while an Occam penalty emerges automatically and regularises against over-flagging. On CIFAR-10 with asymmetric label contamination, NBAM recovers the structure of the corruption process without supervision: the contamination posterior separates clean from corrupted samples, and the learned anomaly head identifies the direction of every label-flip pair. Alongside these capabilities, NBAM outperforms the four robust-loss baselines considered here at contamination rates 0.2-0.6.

AI.tldr: 提出NBAM，一种基于贝叶斯潜变量开关混合模型的通用鲁棒损失函数，既能像Huber/Student-t损失一样替代标准训练损失，又能额外学习结构化的污染模型并返回每个样本的污染后验概率，在CIFAR-10上优于四种鲁棒损失基线并恢复污染结构。
AI.motivation: 现有鲁棒损失（如Huber、Student-t、广义交叉熵）虽能使模型容忍数据污染，但无法识别哪些观测样本被污染，缺乏对污染样本的检测能力。
AI.method: 从贝叶斯潜变量开关混合模型推导边际似然作为鲁棒监督损失，同时利用后验概率构建无监督污染分类器；引入输入依赖的先验π_φ(x)捕捉污染的空间局部性，并利用奥卡姆惩罚自动正则化以防止过度标记。
AI.result: 在CIFAR-10非对称标签污染实验中，NBAM在0.2-0.6污染率下优于四种鲁棒损失基线；污染后验有效分离干净与污染样本；学习到的异常检测头准确识别了每个标签翻转对的方向。
AI.conclusion: NBAM作为即插即用的损失函数，兼具鲁棒训练与污染检测能力，能无监督地恢复污染过程的结构信息。

title: Assessing Reliability of Symbol Detection in Concept Bottleneck Models
summary: Concept Bottleneck Models (CBMs) are a relevant tool for explainable Artificial Intelligence because they make their predictions through human-interpretable symbols. However, high task accuracy does not guarantee that these symbols are detected faithfully: jointly trained CBMs may encode task-specific shortcuts in the bottleneck, making their explanations unreliable. In this paper, we study concept-detection reliability by swapping independently trained concept detectors and classification heads that share the same symbolic vocabulary. We use the resulting performance degradation, concept-level metrics, and symbol-wise uncertainty estimates to identify concepts that are especially prone to spurious firing. Finally, we propose a reliability-aware training strategy in which a shared concept detector is optimized with multiple classification heads and penalized for relying on globally or instance-wise unreliable symbols. On CUB-200-2011 with full concept supervision, detectors and heads are almost freely interchangeable (swap drop below one accuracy point, relative retention above $99\%$, and no concept detected below chance), whereas on a controlled synthetic task we show that, as the concept-supervision weight is reduced, models keep near-perfect task accuracy while swapped accuracy and agreement with the ground-truth concepts collapse to chance. Our reliability-aware training substantially mitigates this leakage, roughly doubling swap accuracy in the leaky regime.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了概念瓶颈模型（CBM）中概念检测的可靠性问题，指出联合训练的CBM可能在瓶颈中编码任务特定捷径导致解释不可靠。通过交换独立训练的概念检测器和分类头来评估性能下降，并提出了可靠性感知训练策略，在CUB-200-2011数据集上表现良好，在合成任务中显著缓解了信息泄漏问题。
AI.motivation: 联合训练的CBM虽然任务准确率高，但可能编码任务特定捷径，导致概念检测不可靠，需要研究概念检测的可靠性问题。
AI.method: 提出通过交换独立训练的概念检测器和分类头（共享相同符号词汇）来评估性能下降；使用概念级指标和符号级不确定性估计识别易出现虚假激活的概念；提出可靠性感知训练策略，用多个分类头优化共享概念检测器并惩罚依赖全局或实例不可靠符号的行为。
AI.result: 在CUB-200-2011（完全概念监督）上，检测器和头几乎可自由互换（交换准确率下降低于1%，相对保留率高于99%，无概念低于随机水平）；在合成任务中，减少概念监督权重时模型保持近完美任务准确率但交换准确率和与真实概念的一致性崩塌至随机水平；可靠性感知训练使泄漏情况下的交换准确率大致翻倍。
AI.conclusion: 联合训练的CBM可能存在概念检测不可靠问题，通过交换实验可有效评估可靠性，提出的可靠性感知训练能显著缓解信息泄漏问题。

title: Multimodal Evaluator Preference Collapse: Cross-Modal Contagion in Self-Evolving Agents
summary: When AI agents use language models to evaluate their own outputs in a feedback loop, systematic biases emerge. We show that Evaluator Preference Collapse (EPC) is dramatically amplified in multimodal settings. Using GPT-4o to evaluate DeepSeek-chat across text and visual tasks, we find that a single strategy (step_by_step) absorbs 48.4% of all weight -- 3.2x the collapse observed in text-only self-evaluation -- while three visual-domain strategies receive only 9.1% combined weight. We then demonstrate a novel phenomenon we term cross-modal contagion: evaluator preferences acquired on one modality transfer to and corrupt strategy selection on another. Through a four-phase isolation training paradigm, we measure contagion coefficients and document strategy inversion -- the optimal strategy for a modality reverses after cross-modal exposure. A Phase 3 statistical validation across four evaluator configurations (N=53 total independent repetitions, 15,592 API calls) reveals a clear hierarchy: cross-model evaluation (GPT-4o, N=8) produces strong but symmetric bidirectional contagion (mean gamma_{T->V}=1.176, gamma_{V->T}=1.089, Delta=-0.088, p=0.575, Cohen's d=0.29); high round counts (DashScope, 50 rounds) cause collapse to single-strategy dominance (70% zero contagion); and self-evaluation provides near-complete immunity -- 97% of runs (N=30, DeepSeek-chat) yield exactly zero contagion (mean gamma=0.033, 95% CI [-0.031, 0.010], p=0.642, d=0.07). No evaluator condition shows statistically significant directional asymmetry. We introduce the contagion matrix indexed by evaluator identity, release the MM-EPC experimental framework, and identify cross-model evaluator architecture as the primary risk factor for preference contagion.

AI.tldr: 本文发现多模态环境中AI代理使用语言模型自我评估时会出现评估者偏好坍缩（EPC）现象，比纯文本评估严重3.2倍；并提出跨模态传染新现象——某一模态获得的评估偏好会转移并污染另一模态的策略选择。通过四阶段隔离训练范式测量传染系数，发现跨模型评估产生强双向传染，高轮次导致单一策略主导，而自我评估近乎完全免疫。
AI.motivation: 探究AI代理在利用语言模型进行自我评估的反馈循环中，多模态环境是否加剧系统偏差，以及评估偏好是否会在不同模态间传播和污染策略选择。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o评估DeepSeek-chat在文本和视觉任务上的表现，采用四阶段隔离训练范式测量传染系数，并设置四种评估配置（N=53次独立重复，15,592次API调用）进行统计验证。
AI.result: 单策略（step_by_step）吸收48.4%权重，是文本-only自评估的3.2倍；跨模型评估产生强双向传染（GPT-4o, gamma_T->V=1.176, gamma_V->T=1.089），高轮次导致70%零传染，自我评估97%运行完全免疫；无显著方向不对称性。
AI.conclusion: 跨模型评估架构是多模态评估偏好传染的主要风险因素，自我评估具有近乎完全的免疫能力；发布了MM-EPC实验框架。

title: MIRAGE: Auditing Anti-Muslim Bias in Frontier LLMs Across Reasoning, Agentic, and Time-Coupled Conditions
summary: Five years after the discovery of persistent anti-Muslim bias in large language models, most evaluations remain confined to single-turn prompt completion, a setting that no longer reflects how frontier LLMs are deployed. We introduce \textbf{MIRAGE} (Muslim-Identity Reasoning and Agentic Generation Evaluation), a benchmark of 1{,}200 prompts spanning three deployment-realistic conditions: direct completion, chain-of-thought reasoning, and simulated agentic decision-making across content moderation, lending triage, refugee claim summarization, and hiring screens. Across six frontier models, we find that (i) chain-of-thought reasoning \emph{amplifies} rather than suppresses Muslim-violence associations by 12--34\% relative to direct completion, (ii) agentic decisions exhibit a 9--22 percentage-point asymmetry between Muslim and matched non-Muslim cases on identical evidence, and (iii) bias is sharply time-coupled to retrieved news context, increasing 18--27\% under recent-conflict retrieval. Existing prompt-based mitigations transfer poorly across our three conditions, suppressing direct-completion bias while leaving agentic asymmetry largely intact. We release MIRAGE and an open evaluation harness to support targeted mitigation research.

AI.tldr: MIRAGE基准测试表明，在 frontier LLM 的三种部署场景（直接补全、思维链推理、模拟智能体决策）中，反穆斯林偏见不仅持续存在，且思维链推理会放大而非抑制穆斯林-暴力关联（增加12-34%），智能体决策呈现9-22%的不对称性，偏见强度与检索新闻语境中的近期冲突内容强相关（增加18-27%），现有提示缓解措施跨场景迁移效果差。
AI.motivation: 发现反穆斯林偏见在大模型中持续存在已五年，但现有评估多局限于单轮提示补全，这已不再反映前沿LLM的实际部署方式，因此需要构建更贴近真实部署场景的基准测试。
AI.method: 构建MIRAGE基准，包含1,200个提示，涵盖三种部署条件：直接补全、思维链推理和模拟智能体决策（内容审核、贷款分类、难民申请摘要、招聘筛选）。对六种前沿模型进行系统性评测。
AI.result: 思维链推理使穆斯林-暴力关联增加12-34%；智能体决策在穆斯林与非穆斯林案例间存在9-22个百分点的差异；偏见在近期冲突检索语境下增加18-27%；现有基于提示的缓解措施无法有效跨条件迁移。
