AI.conclusion: 现有评估范式低估了实际部署中的偏见严重程度，思维链不仅未能缓解反而加剧了偏见，需要针对不同部署条件开发专门的缓解策略。MIRAGE基准和评测工具已开源以支持相关研究。

title: RepNet: Tackling spectral bias in deep neural networks via parameter reparameterization
summary: Deep neural networks (DNNs) have achieved remarkable success in scientific computing, yet they often suffer from spectral bias in capturing oscillatory and multiscale behaviors. In this study, we investigate this limitation by examining the failure of shallow ReLU neural networks in fitting high-frequency functions. This observation identifies two important factors in resolving rapid oscillations: the initial slope scale and the distribution of partition points induced by the networks. Motivated by this analysis, we propose RepNet, a reparameterized DNN model for ReLU and tanh networks designed for high-frequency and multiscale problems. The key idea is to reparameterize the weights and biases in the first hidden layer, which enables effective control of the initial slope scale and provides an appropriate distribution of the initial partition points. Furthermore, treating the reparameterized weights and biases as trainable parameters allows the DNN to achieve adaptive frequency scaling during training. In addition, we derive quantitative estimates for the output and slope magnitudes of the reparameterized DNN to guide the initialization of the proposed method. Numerical experiments, including multiscale one- and four-dimensional function approximation, forward and inverse PDE problems in combination with physics-informed neural networks (PINNs), and operator learning, demonstrate that RepNet improves the predicted accuracy of vanilla DNNs in capturing highly oscillatory features with slightly additional computational cost. These results indicate that RepNet provides an effective and flexible approach for overcoming spectral bias and applying DNNs to multiscale problems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RepNet，通过重参数化第一隐藏层的权重和偏置，有效控制初始斜率尺度和分割点分布，从而克服深度神经网络在高频和多尺度问题中的谱偏差，在函数逼近、正反演PDE问题和算子学习等数值实验中以轻微额外计算成本显著提升了预测精度。
AI.motivation: 深度神经网络在科学计算中取得显著成功，但在捕捉振荡和多尺度行为时存在谱偏差（spectral bias）这一局限性。本文旨在揭示该局限性的根源并提出解决方案。
AI.method: 首先通过分析浅层ReLU网络拟合高频函数的失败案例，识别出影响快速振荡解析的两个关键因素：初始斜率尺度和网络诱导的分割点分布。据此提出RepNet，对ReLU和tanh网络的第一隐藏层权重和偏置进行重参数化，使可训练参数能够实现自适应频率缩放，并推导了重参数化DNN输出和斜率幅度的定量估计以指导初始化。
AI.result: 在多尺度一维和四维函数逼近、结合PINNs的正反演PDE问题以及算子学习等数值实验中，RepNet以轻微额外计算成本显著提升了普通DNN在捕获高频振荡特征方面的预测精度。
AI.conclusion: RepNet提供了一种有效且灵活的方法来克服谱偏差，使DNN能够应用于多尺度问题。

title: MyPCBench: A Benchmark for Personally Intelligent Computer-Use Agents
summary: Current benchmarks for computer-use agents evaluate models in impersonal environments. This leaves a gap between evaluation and deployment where personal assistants are expected to work across a user's whole digital life, including their context, historical data, and logged-in accounts. This gap is widest on web tasks, where live web evaluations cannot exercise sites that require logging in or personal information, the kind of site a real personal assistant has to drive. We introduce MyPCBench, which tests computer-use agents as personal assistants on a Linux desktop populated with 17 simulated real-world web applications and a full desktop stack, all seeded for one canonical persona, Michael Scott from The Office. We define 184 tasks in this environment, each inspired by a real request drawn from the OpenClaw community, and benchmark six closed and open-weight models with a uniform computer+bash tool surface. We find that the best model, Claude Opus 4.6, fully solves 55.4\% of the tasks, the only model above 50\%. Model failures cluster on tasks that span many applications and on long trajectories, where personalization stresses an assistant the most. We release the environment, task set, and agent harness at https://mypcbench.com.

AI.tldr: MyPCBench是一个评估计算机使用代理作为个人助理的基准测试平台，在填充了17个模拟真实Web应用和完整桌面堆栈的Linux桌面环境中，为"The Office"中的Michael Scott角色预置了184个任务。最佳模型Claude Opus 4.6仅完全解决55.4%的任务，模型在跨多应用和长轨迹任务上表现最差。
AI.motivation: 现有计算机使用代理基准测试在非个人化环境中评估模型，忽略了个人助理需要处理用户上下文、历史数据和登录账户等真实场景。特别是Web任务中，实时Web评估无法测试需要登录或个人信息的网站，而这正是个人助理必须面对的。
AI.method: 构建MyPCBench基准：在Linux桌面环境中部署17个模拟真实Web应用及完整桌面栈，为单一规范角色（Michael Scott）预置数据；从OpenClaw社区收集184个真实请求任务；使用统一的计算机+bash工具接口评估6个闭源和开源模型。
AI.result: 最佳模型Claude Opus 4.6完全解决55.4%的任务，唯一超过50%的模型。模型失败主要集中在跨多应用的复杂任务和长轨迹任务上，个性化对助手提出最大挑战。
AI.conclusion: 当前最佳模型在个人化计算机使用任务上的表现仍有很大提升空间，尤其是在多应用协调和长任务执行场景中。论文开源了环境、任务集和代理框架以促进该方向的研究。

title: On the Entropy Formula for Real, Complex, and Quaternionic Deep Linear Networks
summary: We extend the entropy formula of Menon and Yu for the real Deep Linear Network (DLN) to its complex and quaternionic analogues, obtaining a unified formula for DLNs over $\mathbb{R}$, $\mathbb{C}$, and $\mathbb{H}$.

AI.tldr: 论文将实数值深度线性网络(DLN)的熵公式扩展到复数域和四元数域，得到了在实数域$\mathbb{R}$、复数域$\mathbb{C}$和四元数域$\mathbb{H}$上统一的DLN熵公式。
AI.motivation: 作者旨在推广Menon和Yu关于实深度线性网络熵公式的工作，使其适用于复数域和四元数域，从而建立不同代数域上深度线性网络的统一熵理论框架。
AI.method: 论文通过将Menon和Yu的实DLN熵公式进行代数扩展，推导出复数域和四元数域上的对应公式，并验证了其在$\mathbb{R}$、$\mathbb{C}$、$\mathbb{H}$三种代数结构下的统一形式。
AI.result: 成功获得了在实数域$\mathbb{R}$、复数域$\mathbb{C}$和四元数域$\mathbb{H}$上统一的深度线性网络熵公式。
AI.conclusion: 该工作为不同代数域上的深度线性网络提供了统一的熵表达，有助于理解不同数域下深度线性网络的容量与泛化特性。

title: Multi-Modal Spatio-Temporal Graph Neural Network with Mixture of Experts for Soil Organic Carbon Prediction
summary: Top-soil organic carbon (SOC) prediction is fundamental to agricultural sustainability, land use policy and fertilization planning. Existing approaches face two limitations: they pair hand-crafted covariates with classical ML or single-modal deep models that miss rich spectral and temporal information, and grid-based architectures ignore the irregular spatial structure of field measurements. We introduce SpTGNN, a multi-modal spatio-temporal graph neural network addressing both. SpTGNN represents soil measurements as nodes in a heterogeneous graph with three edge types (spatial proximity, spectral similarity, elevation), and applies relational graph attention to learn separate patterns per relation. A fine-tuned TerraMind encoder extracts node features from Sentinel-2, Sentinel-1 and DEM signals, combined with per-sample environmental covariates and learned positional and temporal embeddings. A sparse Mixture-of-Experts module fuses the four streams via top-$k$ routing. Uncertainty is captured by pairing heteroscedastic regression (aleatoric) with deep ensembles (epistemic), and a Moran's $I$ penalty regularizes spatial autocorrelation. We evaluate on a global SOC corpus split into three regional instances ($\sim$49k samples globally, Africa $\sim$26k, Europe $\sim$14k). Our 5-member deep ensemble reports $R^2=0.762$, RMSE $=3.51\pm0.48$ g/kg and MAPE $=22.9\%$ on the Africa test split, improving over a tabular XGBoost baseline; the best single checkpoint reaches validation $R^2=0.864$. Ablations confirm the heterogeneous graph, MoE fusion and fine-tuned backbone each contribute substantively, and the ensemble UQ stack achieves post-calibration ECE of $0.031$ (hybrid) and $0.026$ ($β$-NLL). To our knowledge, this is the first framework to unify foundation-model feature extraction, heterogeneous graph attention and decomposed uncertainty quantification for SOC estimation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SpTGNN，一个多模态时空图神经网络，用于表层土壤有机碳(SOC)预测。该方法通过异构关系图注意力机制（包含空间邻近、光谱相似性和高程三种边类型）、微调的TerraMind基础模型特征提取、稀疏MoE多模态融合以及结合异方差回归与深度集成的分解不确定性量化，解决了传统SOC预测中手工特征、单模态模型和网格架构的局限性。在约49k全球样本（非洲~26k、欧洲~14k）上的评估显示，非洲测试集R²=0.762，RMSE=3.51±0.48 g/kg，MAPE=22.9%，最佳单检查点验证R²=0.864，混合校准ECE达0.031。这是首个统一基础模型特征提取、异构图注意力和分解不确定性量化的SOC估计框架。
AI.motivation: 现有SOC预测方法存在两大局限：一是依赖手工特征与经典ML或单模态深度模型，无法充分利用丰富的光谱和时序信息；二是基于网格的架构忽略了田间测量的不规则空间结构。
AI.method: 1) 将土壤测量点构建为异构图的节点，包含空间邻近、光谱相似性和高程三种边类型，采用关系图注意力学习各关系的独立模式；2) 使用微调的TerraMind编码器从Sentinel-2、Sentinel-1和DEM信号提取节点特征，结合环境协变量、位置和时间嵌入；3) 稀疏MoE模块通过top-k路由融合四个数据流；4) 异方差回归（偶然不确定性）与深度集成（认知不确定性）配对捕捉不确定性；5) Moran's I惩罚项正则化空间自相关。
AI.result: 在约49k全球样本（非洲~26k、欧洲~14k）的三个区域实例上评估。5成员深度集成在非洲测试集上报告R²=0.762，RMSE=3.51±0.48 g/kg，MAPE=22.9%，优于XGBoost基线；最佳单检查点验证R²=0.864。消融实验证实了异构图、MoE融合和微调骨干网络的贡献；集成UQ在后校准中达到混合ECE 0.031和β-NLL ECE 0.026。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个统一基础模型特征提取、异构图注意力和分解不确定性量化的SOC估计框架。

title: Infant Spontaneous Movement Noise Improves Exploration in Deep RL
comment: 6 pages, 4 figures, 1 table. Accepted at IEEE ICDL 2026. Cite as: F. M. López, M. R. Ernst, F. Cruz, M. Hoffmann, and J. Triesch, "Infant Spontaneous Movement Noise Improves Exploration in Deep RL", in 2026 IEEE International Conference on Development and Learning (ICDL). IEEE, 2026, pp. 1-6
summary: Exploration in deep reinforcement learning (RL) is commonly implemented as temporally uncorrelated white noise. However, recent works show that temporally correlated colored noise can improve exploration efficiency by producing smooth trajectories with better coverage of the state space. We inquire whether action noise inspired by infant spontaneous movements can also improve exploration in deep RL. We find that the power spectral densities of babies' end-effector velocities follow a colored noise process where the spectral exponent increases with age. Inspired by this developmental pattern, we introduce a mechanism that progressively increases the temporal auto-correlation of exploration noise during RL training, matching the infant statistics. Experiments across several RL environments show that infant-inspired noise produces structured exploratory behavior and can improve learning efficiency compared to conventional exploration strategies. These findings suggest that human motor and cognitive development can provide useful guidance for designing learning mechanisms in artificial agents. Our code is available at https://github.com/trieschlab/baby-noise-rl.

AI.tldr: 本文受婴儿自发运动产生的彩色噪声启发，提出一种在深度强化学习中逐步增加探索噪声时间自相关性的机制，实验表明该方法能产生结构化探索行为并提高学习效率。
AI.motivation: 目前深度强化学习中常用的白噪声探索策略是时间不相关的，而近期研究表明时间相关的彩色噪声能通过产生平滑轨迹来改善状态空间覆盖。作者进一步探究婴儿自发运动中的噪声模式是否能启发更优的探索策略。
AI.method: 发现婴儿末端执行器速度的功率谱密度遵循彩色噪声过程，且谱指数随年龄增长而增加。据此提出一种机制，在强化学习训练过程中逐步增加探索噪声的时间自相关性，使其与婴儿发育统计数据相匹配。
AI.result: 在多个强化学习环境中的实验表明，受婴儿启发的噪声能够产生结构化的探索行为，并在学习效率上优于传统探索策略。
AI.conclusion: 人类运动与认知发育可以为人工智能体的学习机制设计提供有益指导。

title: PhysGuard: Fisher-Guided Gradient Projection for Sim-to-Real Neural PDE Surrogates
summary: Neural operator models trained on simulation data often lose accuracy when applied to experimental measurements due to the sim-to-real gap. Standard fine-tuning with limited real data can reduce this gap, but it may also damage the core physics-relevant representations learned during pretraining. Although knowledge-preserving adaptation has been widely investigated in vision or language tasks, it remains unclear whether these methods are suitable for neural operators whose architectures and protected knowledge are fundamentally different. Neural operators need to preserve core-scale physical structures rather than semantic or visual features. We propose PhysGuard, a physics-preserving framework for accurate sim-to-real adaptation of neural operators. Specifically, PhysGuard uses the empirical Fisher Information Matrix computed on simulation data to identify physics-critical parameter directions, then restricts fine-tuning updates to directions that do not interfere with them. A layer-wise Gram-matrix formulation makes this efficient for models with millions of parameters, while an adaptive threshold automatically determines the protected subspace size. A spectral probe experiment shows that the dominant Fisher directions are strongly associated with low-frequency output structures. Experiments on benchmark across four neural operator architectures and different physical systems show that PhysGuard performs strongly on most evaluation metrics compared to baselines. The benefits are most evident under severe domain shift, where it reduces low-frequency error by up to 32\% compared to standard fine-tuning while maintaining adaptability. Our code is available at https://github.com/ZhouChaunge/PhysGuard.

AI.tldr: PhysGuard是一个面向神经算子的物理保留微调框架，通过Fisher信息矩阵识别并保护物理关键参数方向，在仿真到真实数据迁移中保持模型对核心物理结构的表征能力，在严重域偏移下可降低低频误差达32%。
AI.motivation: 神经算子模型在仿真数据上训练后迁移到实验测量数据时存在sim-to-real gap，标准微调会破坏预训练学到的物理相关表征。现有知识保留方法主要针对视觉或语言任务，不适用于神经算子需要保护核心尺度物理结构而非语义特征的特殊需求。
AI.method: 基于仿真数据计算经验Fisher信息矩阵识别物理关键参数方向，限制微调更新仅在不干扰这些方向的空间中进行；采用逐层Gram矩阵公式实现高效计算，并设计自适应阈值自动确定受保护子空间大小。
AI.result: 在四种神经算子架构和不同物理系统基准上，PhysGuard在多数评估指标上优于基线方法；在严重域偏移下，相比标准微调可降低低频误差达32%。
AI.conclusion: PhysGuard有效保护了神经算子在仿真预训练中学习到的核心物理结构（尤其是低频输出结构），实现了仿真到真实场景的可靠迁移，且效率适用于百万级参数模型。

title: TCHG: Tri-Trust Conditioned Heterogeneous Graph Learning for Reliable Dynamic Trust Prediction
summary: Trust prediction infers latent user-user trust relations and provides important support for social recommendation, fake-review and manipulation detection, and risk identification. Graph neural networks have become a prominent approach to trust prediction because of their ability to learn network structures and complex trust dependencies. However, existing methods often rely on a unified representation of trust signals and do not disentangle heterogeneous trust evidence into separate evidence channels, failing to exploit the distinct roles that different evidence channels should play during trust modeling. To address this gap, this paper argues that trust evidence should not be treated as an undifferentiated input, but should be decomposed and used as functional control factors over graph propagation. We propose TCHG, a tri-trust conditioned heterogeneous graph learning framework that decomposes trust evidence into three channels and assigns them distinct functional roles in propagation: entity reliability governs message admission, interaction-behavior reliability modulates propagation strength, and contextual trust adjusts the propagation mode through context-conditioned operator selection. Since the three evidence channels evolve at different temporal scales, TCHG maintains independent temporal states with non-uniform decay rates to prevent rapidly changing contextual signals from overwriting slowly accumulated entity reliability. It further predicts trust probability and calibrates the output probability, improving predictive confidence under sparse or conflicting evidence. Extensive experiments on multiple public trust datasets show that TCHG achieves effective and reliable trust prediction compared with representative trust prediction and heterogeneous graph baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文提出TCHG框架，将信任证据分解为三个通道（实体可靠性、交互行为可靠性、上下文信任），并赋予它们在传播中不同的功能角色，实现更有效和可靠的信任预测。
AI.motivation: 现有图神经网络信任预测方法将信任信号统一表示，未将异质信任证据解耦为独立通道，未能利用不同证据通道在信任建模中应起的独特作用。
AI.method: 提出TCHG框架，将信任证据分解为三个通道：实体可靠性控制消息准入、交互行为可靠性调节传播强度、上下文信任通过条件化算子选择调整传播模式；维护三个独立时序状态并采用非均匀衰减率；输出概率校准提升稀疏或冲突证据下的预测置信度。
AI.result: 在多个公开信任数据集上，TCHG相比代表性信任预测和异质图基线方法，实现了有效且可靠的信任预测。
AI.conclusion: 信任证据应被分解并作为传播的功能控制因素，而非视为无差别的输入，TCHG通过三通道异质图学习框架验证了这一观点。

title: Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion
summary: Inference-time scaling has become the dominant lever for improving language-model reasoning, but existing methods derive rollout diversity from a single source: stochastic token-level sampling. We argue that this single-axis sampling space is fundamentally limiting, and identify a second, fully deterministic and complementary axis: the layer span $L$ at which a frozen model's top decoder layers are recursively re-applied at high-uncertainty tokens. Different choices of $L$ produce distinct rollouts that solve different subsets of problems, with no stochasticity. We instantiate this axis through Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR), a training-free decoding procedure that re-applies the top-$L$ layers for at most $K_{\max}$ iterations until the next-token distribution converges. Combined with $T$ temperature samples, EGLR turns a single-axis stochastic rollout pool into an $L\times T$ Cartesian sampling space at almost the same per-rollout cost. We characterize this space across $8$ instruction-tuned models and $6$ math reasoning benchmarks, and show that the $L$-axis is genuinely complementary to temperature: on MATH-500 with Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, the joint $L\times T$ oracle reaches $91.6\%$, $+8.2$ percentage points beyond the temperature-only oracle ($83.4\%$) and $+10.4$ points beyond the layer-only oracle ($81.2\%$), confirming that the two axes capture genuinely complementary problems. The expanded rollout pool provides richer per-prompt candidates for any downstream procedure that consumes rollouts, including self-consistency, best-of-$N$ with verifiers, and group-relative RL training (GRPO), opening a new direction for inference-time scaling that does not rely on stochastic noise.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EGLR方法，通过在不同层跨度L下递归应用冻结模型的高层解码器，构建了与随机温度采样正交的确定性推理轴，形成L×T笛卡尔采样空间，显著提升了推理时的扩展性能。在MATH-500上，联合oracle达到91.6%，比纯温度oracle高8.2个百分点。
AI.motivation: 现有推理时扩展方法仅依赖随机token级采样（单一温度轴）来获取多样性，作者认为这种单一轴采样空间存在根本性局限，需要探索新的互补维度。
AI.method: 提出Entropy-Gated Latent Recursion (EGLR)，一种无需训练的解码过程：在不确定性高的token处，冻结模型的高层解码器（top-L层）被递归重新应用最多K_max次，直到下一个token分布收敛。不同L选择产生完全确定性的不同路径，与温度采样T结合形成L×T的笛卡尔采样空间。
AI.result: 在8个指令微调模型和6个数学推理基准上验证。MATH-500上Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct：联合L×T oracle达91.6%，比纯温度oracle（83.4%）高8.2个百分点，比纯层oracle（81.2%）高10.4个百分点。两个轴捕获了真正互补的问题。
AI.conclusion: EGLR扩展了推理时rollout池的多样性，为自一致性、best-of-N、GRPO等下游程序提供了更丰富的每提示候选，开辟了不依赖随机噪声的推理时扩展新方向。

title: SPICE: Synergy and Partial Information Based Curriculum Evolution
summary: Multimodal learning exploits complementary information across heterogeneous modalities. The informativeness of each modality can vary widely across samples and training stages. Existing multimodal curriculum learning strategies often assume that the relative complexity of samples remains unchanged throughout training and therefore cannot adapt to model evolution. We propose SPICE (Synergy and Partial Information based Curriculum Evolution), a novel progressive curriculum framework for multimodal interaction learning. Guided by Partial Information Decomposition (PID) theory, our approach decomposes multimodal interactions into redundant, unique, and synergistic information components, enabling an interpretable and dynamic characterization of sample complexity. Building on this decomposition, we design a progressive curriculum that evolves throughout training, allowing the model to transition from learning shared cross-modal cues to modality-specific patterns and, finally, to complex synergistic interactions. Adapting to model evolution, sample ordering is refined in real-time using PID information estimates derived from unimodal and multimodal predictions. Experiments across multiple multimodal benchmarks demonstrate consistent improvements over conventional training and state-of-the-art baselines, highlighting the effectiveness of PID information decomposition and adaptive sample ordering for multimodal curriculum learning.

AI.tldr: 提出SPICE框架，利用部分信息分解（PID）理论将多模态交互分解为冗余、独特和协同信息成分，设计渐进式课程学习策略，根据模型进化动态调整样本排序，提升多模态学习效果。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态课程学习策略假设样本相对复杂度在训练过程中保持不变，无法适应模型演化，缺乏对多模态交互信息成分的细粒度理解和动态调度。
AI.method: 基于PID理论将多模态交互分解为冗余、独特和协同信息；设计渐进式课程，使模型从学习共享跨模态线索过渡到模态特有模式，再到复杂协同交互；利用PID信息估计实时优化样本排序以适应模型演化。
AI.result: 在多个多模态基准数据集上，SPICE一致优于传统训练方法和现有最先进基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PID信息分解和自适应样本排序在多模态课程学习中具有显著有效性。

title: Distribution Alignment for One-Shot Federated Learning via Optimal Transport
comment: Accepted at the 43rd International Conference on Machine Learning (ICML 2026)
summary: One-Shot Federated Learning (OSFL) addresses extreme communication regimes in which clients interact with the server only once, amplifying the impact of heterogeneous client data distributions. In particular, the interaction of domain shift and label shift across clients induces misaligned feature representations that cannot be corrected through iterative optimization. Existing OSFL methods rely on distillation, server-side generation or ensemble-based aggregation, but assume aligned representations or address domain and label shift separately. We introduce SLOT-Align (Single-round, Learning-free Optimal Transport Alignment), a geometry-aware feature harmonization framework for OSFL. SLOT-Align uses a shared frozen encoder to extract compact feature statistics, constructs a global reference via Bures-Wasserstein barycenters, and aligns local representations using closed-form geodesic optimal transport maps. The method is computationally efficient and can be combined with existing OSFL pipelines relying on frozen encoders without modifying their training procedures. Extensive experiments across multiple benchmarks, pretrained backbones, and OSFL methods show that SLOT-Align consistently improves accuracy and robustness under joint domain and label shift.

AI.tldr: SLOT-Align 提出了一种基于几何感知的单轮联邦学习特征对齐框架，通过 Bures-Wasserstein 重心和闭式测地线最优传输映射，在不修改现有 OSFL 方法训练流程的情况下，有效缓解客户端间域偏移和标签偏移导致的特征错位问题，在多个基准和骨干网络上持续提升精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有 OSFL 方法假设特征空间已对齐，或分别处理域偏移和标签偏移，无法解决二者共存时客户端数据异构导致的特征表征错位问题，且缺乏无需额外训练的几何对齐手段。
AI.method: SLOT-Align 采用共享冻结编码器提取紧凑特征统计量，通过 Bures-Wasserstein 重心构建全局参考分布，利用闭式测地线最优传输映射将各客户端局部特征对齐到全局参考空间，实现轻量级、无需额外训练的特征协调。
AI.result: 在多种基准数据集、预训练骨干网络和 OSFL 方法上的实验表明，SLOT-Align 在联合域偏移和标签偏移场景下持续提升了分类精度和鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: SLOT-Align 是一种高效、即插即用的特征对齐范式，能够在不修改现有 OSFL 训练流程的前提下，显著提升单轮联邦学习在极端异构环境下的性能表现。

title: Near-Optimal Stochastic Linear Bandits with Delay
summary: We study stochastic linear bandits with delayed feedback under several delay models and establish near-optimal regret guarantees. Our results identify when delayed linear bandits exhibit the same qualitative behavior as multi-armed bandits (MAB), and when the linear structure creates fundamentally new challenges. Specifically, (1) for \emph{loss-independent delays}, where the delay does not depend on the realized loss (but potentially depends on the arm), we show that delays incur only an additive regret penalty. Under stochastic delays, this penalty scales with the expected delay, while under adversarial delays, it scales with the maximum number of outstanding observations. Notably, both delay penalties are dimension-free, improving upon the state-of-the-art results; (2) for \emph{loss-dependent delays}, we show that linear bandits are substantially harder than MAB: unlike in MAB, we prove matching (up to log factors) upper and lower bounds in linear bandits, whose delay penalty depends on the square root of the dimension. (3) for the \emph{delay-as-payoff model}, a special case of loss-dependent delay, we show that the optimal MAB guarantee, which depends only on the delay of the optimal arm, is also unattainable in linear bandits. Together, these results provide a sharp characterization of how delayed feedback interacts with linear generalization.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了延迟反馈下的随机线性bandit问题，在三种延迟模型下建立了接近最优的遗憾界。对于损失无关延迟，延迟仅带来可加性惩罚且与维度无关；对于损失相关延迟，线性bandit比多臂bandit更难，惩罚依赖于维度的平方根；对于延迟作为回报模型，多臂bandit的最优保证在线性bandit中无法实现。
AI.motivation: 现有研究对延迟线性bandit的理解有限，特别是与多臂bandit相比，线性结构在延迟场景下是否带来新挑战尚不清楚。本文旨在刻画延迟反馈与线性泛化能力之间的交互关系。
AI.method: 本文分别针对损失无关延迟（含随机和对抗两种子情形）、损失相关延迟和延迟作为回报模型，推导了上下界，并与多臂bandit的已有结果进行对比分析。
AI.result: (1) 损失无关延迟：延迟仅带来可加性遗憾惩罚，与维度无关；(2) 损失相关延迟：线性bandit的延迟惩罚依赖于√d，而多臂bandit无此依赖；(3) 延迟作为回报模型：线性bandit无法达到多臂bandit中仅依赖最优臂延迟的最优保证。
AI.conclusion: 延迟反馈与线性结构之间存在根本性交互：损失无关延迟下线性bandit与多臂bandit定性相似，但损失相关延迟下线性bandit面临本质更难的问题，现有MAB结果无法直接推广。

title: Beyond Defensive Reporting: Machine Learning for Active Anti-Money Laundering Control in Insurance
summary: Money laundering through insurance claims poses a threat to insurers both through fraudulent payouts and reputational and regulatory risk. Despite this, little research has examined how such laundering can be prevented. This paper examines whether machine learning can help insurers flag suspicious claims before payout, shifting the focus from passive reporting to active prevention. Using production data from a major Norwegian insurer, we train gradient-boosted decision tree models to detect claims later reported to authorities for suspected money laundering. Because fraud and laundering may share behavioural patterns, we also examine whether insurance fraud labels can serve as an auxiliary training signal. We compare different learning setups using the Budget-Weighted Capture Rate, a metric introduced in this paper to measure how many laundering cases are captured when only a small share of claims can be manually reviewed. The results show that incorporating fraud-related investigation labels substantially improves laundering detection. The best-performing model captures nearly two-thirds of laundering cases within the top-ranked 2 to 6 percent of claims selected for investigation. To our knowledge, this is the first empirical study of machine learning for money laundering detection in insurance claims.

AI.tldr: 本文首次实证研究了机器学习在保险理赔中检测洗钱的应用。利用挪威某大型保险公司的生产数据，训练梯度提升决策树模型，发现融入欺诈调查标签可显著提升洗钱检测效果，最优模型可在仅审查前2%-6%的理赔案件时捕获近三分之二的洗钱案例。论文同时提出了Budget-Weighted Capture Rate这一新评估指标。
AI.motivation: 通过保险理赔进行洗钱活动对保险公司构成欺诈赔付、声誉与监管风险，但已有研究极少关注如何预防此类洗钱。本文旨在探索机器学习能否帮助保险公司在赔付前主动识别可疑理赔，将重点从被动报告转向主动预防。
AI.method: 使用挪威某大型保险公司的生产数据，训练梯度提升决策树（GBDT）模型。由于欺诈与洗钱可能存在共同行为模式，本文还探索了将保险欺诈标签作为辅助训练信号。提出了Budget-Weighted Capture Rate（预算加权捕获率）这一新指标，用于衡量在仅能人工审查少量理赔时模型的洗钱捕获效果。
AI.result: 融入欺诈调查标签可显著提升洗钱检测效果。最优模型在排名前2%-6%的理赔案件中捕获了近三分之二的洗钱案例。
AI.conclusion: 这是首个关于机器学习用于保险理赔洗钱检测的实证研究，证明了利用欺诈标签作为辅助信号可有效提升洗钱检测能力，为保险业主动防范洗钱提供了可行方案。

title: Adaptive inference and function vectors in deep transformers
summary: Transformers are widely used as a general-purpose substrate for learning complex correlations between a large collection of coupled variables, but their internal mechanisms have remained mysterious. We introduce a theory of a deep transformer as a mean-field interacting system that implements distributed inference, subject to constraints on communication, locality and depth. We show that such a system can exploit internal state representations ('function vectors') to infer a latent context variable at increasingly finer scales over its layers. In an in-context regression task, the theory predicts a non-trivial relationship between non-Gaussian, hierarchical structure in the latent context variable, and transformer depth. Predictions are tested using constrained linear attention transformers and demonstrate adaptive inference in deep architectures. Feedforward blocks and depth enable transformers to implement a much richer class of in-context learning algorithms than previously described.

AI.tldr: 本文提出深度Transformer作为平均场交互系统实现分布式推理的理论框架，证明其能通过内部状态表征（函数向量）逐层推断潜变量，并在上下文回归任务中揭示了非高斯分层结构与网络深度之间的非平凡关系。
AI.motivation: Transformer被广泛用于学习复杂变量间的相关性，但其内部机制仍然神秘，缺乏理论理解。
AI.method: 将深度Transformer建模为受通信、局部性和深度约束的平均场交互系统，利用内部状态表征（函数向量）逐层推断潜变量，并通过约束线性注意力Transformer进行理论预测验证。
AI.result: 理论预测了潜变量的非高斯分层结构与Transformer深度之间存在非平凡关系，并通过实验验证了深度架构中的自适应推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 前馈模块和深度使Transformer能够实现比先前描述更丰富的上下文学习算法类别。

title: Learning Policy from a Single Trajectory in Average-Reward Markov Decision Process
summary: While there is an extensive body of work characterizing the sample complexity of discounted cumulative-reward MDPs, finite sample analyses for average-reward MDPs have been limited, and most existing works rely on restrictive assumptions such as ergodicity or access to a generative model. In this work, we establish the first finite sample complexity guarantees from a single trajectory for weakly communicating average-reward MDPs. To this end, we study the dynamics of a single trajectory in weakly communicating MDPs and based on this analysis, we develop novel model-free methods. Notably, our value-based and policy-based methods provide finite sample complexity guarantees of $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$ and $\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$ from a single trajectory in weakly communicating MDPs, respectively. Furthermore, we introduce the first model-free method that requires no prior knowledge of problem-dependent quantities for communicating MDPs.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在弱连通平均奖励MDP中，仅从单条轨迹建立了$\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$和$\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$的有限样本复杂度保证，分别对应值函数方法和策略优化方法；同时提出了首个无需问题相关先验知识的无模型方法。
AI.motivation: 尽管折扣累积奖励MDP的样本复杂度已有大量研究，但平均奖励MDP的有限样本分析非常有限，且现有工作大多依赖遍历性假设或生成模型访问。本文旨在弱连通平均奖励MDP中，从单条轨迹建立有限样本复杂度保证，消除这些限制性假设。
AI.method: 本文通过分析弱连通MDP中单条轨迹的动态特性，开发了新的无模型方法。具体包括：1）基于值函数的方法；2）基于策略优化的方法。两种方法均仅需单条轨迹即可运行。
AI.result: 值函数方法实现了$\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^2)$的样本复杂度，策略优化方法实现了$\widetilde{O}(1/\varepsilon^4)$的样本复杂度。此外，针对连通MDP，提出了首个无需问题相关先验知识的无模型方法。
AI.conclusion: 本文填补了平均奖励MDP有限样本分析的理论空白，证明了在弱连通假设下无需遍历性或生成模型即可从单条轨迹获得高效的学习保证，推动了平均奖励强化学习的理论理解。

title: Maximum Entropy Inverse Reinforcement Learning for Mean-Field Games with Average Reward
summary: We study inverse reinforcement learning for discrete-time, infinite-horizon mean-field games (MFGs) under an average-reward criterion. Expert demonstrations are assumed to arise from a stationary mean-field equilibrium under an unknown reward, and the goal is to recover a policy explaining the observed behaviour via the maximum causal entropy principle. We formulate the inverse problem by enforcing consistency with the expert mean-field term and long-run feature expectations, treating two reward classes within a unified occupation-measure framework. For finite-dimensional linear rewards, we give a convex dual reformulation with an explicit log-partition objective, and prove smoothness and curvature properties justifying constant-step-size gradient descent. For infinite-dimensional RKHS rewards, we develop a Lagrangian relaxation whose inner-maximising policy is characterised by a soft Bellman equation. The main obstacle is the absence of a discount-factor contraction. We resolve this by introducing a minorisation-based sub-stochastic kernel that yields a strict contraction of the soft Bellman operator. We establish Fréchet differentiability and Lipschitz smoothness of the log-likelihood score, leading to a gradient ascent algorithm with convergence guarantees. Two numerical examples, a malware-spread MFG and an RKHS-based consumer-choice model, show that the recovered policies closely match expert behaviour.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了平均奖励准则下离散时间无限时域平均场博弈的逆向强化学习，通过最大因果熵原理从专家演示中恢复解释性策略，针对有限维线性奖励和无限维RKHS奖励分别提出了凸对偶重构和拉格朗日松弛方法，并给出了收敛保证的梯度算法。
AI.motivation: 逆向强化学习在平均场博弈中面临折扣因子收缩缺失的主要障碍，且现有方法缺乏对平稳平均场均衡下专家行为的逆向推理框架。
AI.method: 采用占据测度框架统一处理两类奖励；对于有限维线性奖励，给出凸对偶重构并证明平滑性和曲率性质以支持常数步长梯度下降；对于无限维RKHS奖励，引入基于minorization的次随机核实现软贝尔曼算子的严格收缩，建立Fréchet可微性和Lipschitz平滑性，提出梯度上升算法。
AI.result: 在恶意软件传播MFG和基于RKHS的消费者选择模型两个数值示例中，恢复的策略与专家行为紧密匹配。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法有效解决了无折扣因子收缩条件下平均场博弈的逆向强化学习问题，实现了从专家演示中准确恢复策略。

title: A Validated LBM Dataset and Pipeline for Surrogate Modeling of Turbulent 3D Obstructed Channel Flows
comment: 4 pages + appendix, 9 figures, Accepted at the 1st Workshop on Differentiable Systems and Scientific Machine Learning (SysDiff) @ EurIPS 2025, OpenReview: https://openreview.net/forum?id=rdmHT72NQH
summary: Evaluating neural operators for 3D turbulent flow requires validated datasets with physical benchmarks. We present a reproducible pipeline generating training data for 3D channel flows around generated geometries at Re=1,000-10,000. Our lattice Boltzmann solver with cumulant collision operators is rigorously verified against experimental measurements (Strouhal number, drag coefficients, turbulent fluctuations) with comprehensive grid convergence studies at resolution 1024x512x512. Building upon an established framework, this validated pipeline enables standardized surrogate model comparison. We outline planned systematic evaluation of Fourier Neural Operator and U-Net variants on forecasting, super-resolution, and error correction tasks, using physics-informed metrics to assess turbulent energy cascade representation. Future work will compare computational efficiency between numerical solvers and neural surrogates, exploring practical application. We seek community feedback on our validation approach, planned benchmark methodology, and evaluation priorities for neural operators in turbulent flows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个可复现的管道，用于生成3D湍流通道流动的训练数据，并使用格玻尔兹曼求解器进行严格验证，计划系统评估FNO和U-Net等神经算子，以物理信息指标衡量湍流能量级联表示能力。
AI.motivation: 评估神经算子在3D湍流中的性能需要经过验证的基准数据集，但目前缺乏标准化的验证管道和物理基准。
AI.method: 使用具有累积碰撞算子的格玻尔兹曼求解器，在1024x512x512分辨率下进行网格收敛研究，并针对Strouhal数、阻力系数和湍流波动等实验测量数据进行严格验证。
AI.result: 构建了经过实验验证的可复现数据生成管道，计划系统评估FNO和U-Net变体在预测、超分辨率和误差修正任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: 该验证管道可实现标准化的代理模型比较，未来将比较数值求解器与神经代理的计算效率，并寻求社区对验证方法和基准评估优先级的反馈。

title: Taming Curvature: Architecture Warm-Up for Stable Transformer Training
summary: Training billion-parameter Transformers is often brittle, with transient loss spikes and divergence that waste compute. Even though the recently developed Edge of Stability (EoS) theory provides a powerful tool to understand and control the stability of optimization methods via the (preconditioned) curvature, these curvature-controlling methods are not popular in large-scale Transformer training due to the complexity of curvature estimation. To this end, we first introduce a fast online estimator of the largest (preconditioned) Hessian eigenvalue (i.e., curvature) based on a warm-started variant for power iteration with Hessian-vector products. We show theoretically, and verify empirically, that the proposed method makes per-iteration curvature tracking feasible at billion parameter scale while being more accurate. Using this tool, we find that training instabilities coincide with surges in preconditioned curvature and that curvature grows with depth. Motivated by these observations, we propose architecture warm-up: progressively growing network depth to carefully control the preconditioned Hessian and stabilize training. Experiments on large Transformers validate that our approach enables efficient curvature tracking and reduces instabilities compared to existing state-of-the-art stabilization techniques without slowing down convergence.

AI.tldr: 本文针对十亿参数Transformer训练中的不稳定性问题，提出了一种基于热启动幂迭代的快速曲率在线估计方法，并发现训练不稳定与预条件曲率骤增及曲率随深度增长相关，据此提出架构热身（architecture warm-up）策略，通过逐步增加网络深度来控制预条件Hessian矩阵，从而在不降低收敛速度的前提下减少训练不稳定性。
AI.motivation: 十亿参数Transformer的训练常出现瞬态损失尖峰和发散现象，浪费大量计算资源。现有的边缘稳定性（EoS）理论虽提供了通过预条件曲率控制优化稳定性的方法，但由于曲率估计复杂度高，这些方法并未在大规模Transformer训练中普及。
AI.method: 1) 提出一种基于热启动幂迭代的快速在线估计器，用于估计最大预条件Hessian特征值（曲率），并通过Hessian-向量积实现高效计算。2) 发现训练不稳定性与预条件曲率骤增及曲率随深度增长相关。3) 提出架构热身策略，逐步增加网络深度以控制预条件Hessian矩阵，稳定训练过程。
AI.result: 理论分析和实验验证表明，所提方法在十亿参数规模下实现了逐迭代曲率追踪，且准确度更高。在大规模Transformer上的实验证明，该方法能实现高效的曲率追踪，并在不降低收敛速度的情况下，相比现有最先进的稳定技术减少了训练不稳定性。
AI.conclusion: 本文证明了在大规模Transformer训练中高效、准确地追踪曲率是可行的，并基于曲率与深度的关系提出了架构热身策略，有效提升了训练的稳定性。

title: GD$^2$PO: Mitigating Multi-Reward Conflicts via Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization
summary: As LLMs advance, post-training reinforcement learning (RL) increasingly relies on multi-dimensional rewards to cultivate comprehensive capabilities. This shift demands new algorithms capable of optimizing diverse and potentially competing objectives simultaneously. To address this, existing methods such as Group reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GDPO) decompose the overall score into independent reward groups, then compute the RL loss separately within each group. However, this strategy still encounters multi-reward conflicts: a single rollout can yield positive advantages on certain reward dimensions but negative ones on others, causing opposing signals to cancel each other out during aggregation, further hindering RL training efficiency. Inspired by Dynamic sAmpling Policy Optimization (DAPO), which improves RL training efficiency by filtering out ineffective rollouts with near-zero advantages, we propose Group-Dynamic reward-Decoupled Policy Optimization (GD$^2$PO). Specifically, GD$^2$PO employs a conflict-aware filtering mechanism to mask out rollouts suffering from severe reward-wise disagreement. By preventing conflicting signals from canceling each other out, this masking strategy preserves and enhances the magnitude of effective RL advantages, thereby significantly accelerating learning efficiency. Furthermore, we introduce query-level reweighting to dynamically adjust the update intensity of each query based on its overall reward consensus. Experiments on various multi-reward scenarios, including tool calling and human preference alignment, demonstrate that GD$^2$PO consistently and significantly outperforms existing baselines. The code is available at https://github.com/Qwen-Applications/GD2PO.

AI.tldr: 针对多维度奖励强化学习中的奖励冲突问题，提出GD$^2$PO方法，通过冲突感知过滤机制屏蔽存在严重奖励分歧的rollout，并结合查询级重加权动态调整更新强度，在工具调用和人类偏好对齐等场景显著提升学习效率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于多维度奖励的RL方法（如GDPO）在对奖励分组独立优化时，仍面临多奖励冲突问题：单个rollout在不同奖励维度上可能产生正负相反的advantage，导致聚合时信号相互抵消，阻碍训练效率。
AI.method: 受DAPO启发，提出GD$^2$PO：1）冲突感知过滤机制（conflict-aware filtering），屏蔽奖励维度间存在严重分歧的rollout，防止冲突信号相互抵消；2）查询级重加权（query-level reweighting），根据整体奖励共识动态调整每个查询的更新强度。
AI.result: 在工具调用和人类偏好对齐等多个多奖励场景下的实验表明，GD$^2$PO持续且显著优于现有基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过过滤奖励冲突的rollout和动态重加权查询更新，GD$^2$PO有效缓解了多奖励冲突问题，显著加速了多维度奖励RL训练的效率。

title: We Need Explanation Cards to Connect Explanation Algorithms to the Real World
summary: Algorithmic explanations are intended to help stakeholders understand opaque algorithmic decisions, but in practice, they often fall short. First, the meaning of algorithmic explanations is often not what one might intuitively expect, so expert knowledge is required to interpret them correctly. Second, recent work has shown that popular explanation algorithms are uninformative about the behavior of complex decision functions. Together, these issues create a gap between what explanations appear to convey and what they actually provide. In this work, we propose Explanation Cards for Explanation Algorithms, which augment standard explanations with complementary information about robustness and validity, as well as clear instructions for interpretation. The complementary information can render otherwise uninformative explanations practically useful, while also helping to detect cases where they are not. Importantly, the interpretation instructions in explanation cards shift responsibility from users to providers: Rather than expecting users to recognize what can and cannot be concluded from an explanation, providers must make this explicit upfront. Using counterfactual explanations and SHAP as examples, we demonstrate how providers can construct explanation cards and that these cards provide users with the guidance needed for sound interpretation. We further argue that explanation cards offer a practical means of operationalising the explainability provisions of the EU AI Act. Overall, explanation cards are a significant step toward making explanation algorithms fit for real-world use cases.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"解释卡"（Explanation Cards）概念，通过为算法解释补充鲁棒性、有效性等元信息和明确的使用说明，弥合解释算法表面含义与实际信息之间的鸿沟，帮助用户正确理解和使用算法解释，并可作为欧盟AI法案可解释性条款的实践工具。
AI.motivation: 当前算法解释存在两个关键问题：一是解释的语义与直觉不符，需要专家知识才能正确解读；二是流行的解释算法无法有效传达复杂决策函数的行为。这导致解释的表征与实际提供的信息之间存在"鸿沟"，用户难以正确使用解释结果。
AI.method: 提出"解释卡"框架，为标准解释结果附加三类补充信息：(1) 鲁棒性信息（解释的稳定性）；(2) 有效性信息（解释的准确度限制）；(3) 明确的解释使用说明。以反事实解释和SHAP为例，展示如何构建解释卡。
AI.result: 解释卡能将原本无信息的解释变得实际可用，同时帮助检测解释不可用的情况。通过将解释权责从用户转移到提供者，明确了什么可以/不可以从解释中得出的边界。
AI.conclusion: 解释卡是让算法解释适应真实世界应用的重要步骤，为欧盟AI法案中可解释性条款提供了一种可操作的实现路径。

title: Decision-Weighted Flow Matching for Contextual Stochastic Optimization
summary: Conditional generative models are increasingly used as scenario generators for stochastic optimization, but standard training objectives emphasize uniform distributional fit rather than the downstream decisions induced by generated scenarios. This creates an objective mismatch: errors in statistically common regions may have little effect on decision regret, whereas errors in decision-sensitive regions can substantially change the optimal action. We propose Decision-Weighted Flow Matching (DW-FM), a regret-aligned training framework that preserves the simplicity of standard flow matching while reweighting its velocity-regression objective using decision-sensitive endpoint information. Theoretically, we connect downstream regret to pathwise velocity mismatch through a loss-induced decision discrepancy and an adjoint transport argument, yielding an ideal regret-aligned surrogate and practical endpoint-weighted objectives with regret guarantees. Empirically, we demonstrate the effectiveness of DW-FM on three CVaR-based contextual stochastic optimization benchmarks spanning synthetic portfolio, semi-real financial, and traffic-CVaR tasks, where DW-FM improves downstream regret over standard baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出决策加权流匹配（DW-FM）框架，通过在流匹配的速率回归目标中引入决策敏感的端点权重，使生成式场景模型与下游随机优化的决策遗憾对齐，从而解决标准训练目标与下游决策之间的目标不匹配问题。
AI.motivation: 条件生成模型作为场景生成器用于随机优化时，标准训练目标强调分布拟合质量而非下游决策表现，导致目标不匹配：统计常见区域的误差对决策遗憾影响小，而决策敏感区域的误差可能根本改变最优行动。
AI.method: 提出DW-FM框架，保留标准流匹配的简洁性，通过决策敏感的端点信息对速率回归目标进行重新加权。理论上，通过损失诱导的决策差异和伴随传输论证，连接下游遗憾与路径速率不匹配，推导出理想遗憾对齐的替代目标及带遗憾保证的实用端点加权目标。
AI.result: 在三个基于CVaR的上下文随机优化基准（合成投资组合、半真实金融、交通CVaR任务）上，DW-FM相比标准基线显著提升了下游决策遗憾。
AI.conclusion: 通过决策加权将生成模型训练与下游优化目标对齐，可以有效缓解目标不匹配问题，提升场景生成在决策驱动任务中的实用性。

title: Deep Q-Learning on Hölder Spaces
summary: We study the operator-theoretic core of Q-learning in continuous-time stochastic control with continuous states and actions. In value-based reinforcement learning, each Q-learning or DQN update is built from a Bellman optimality target; our analysis isolates this target in a diffusion setting and studies its regularity and approximation complexity. Under uniform ellipticity and Hölder-regular coefficients, we show that a Bellman update maps bounded inputs into an anisotropic regularity class, smoothing the state variable while leaving only Lipschitz dependence on the action variable. This yields a compact family of Bellman iterates and motivates a tensor-product DeepONet architecture adapted to the mixed regularity of the problem. We then derive explicit approximation and resource bounds, together with a stiffness--complexity trade-off as the time step $δ\to 0$. The resulting theory makes a direct contribution to Q-learning theory at the level of Bellman target regularity and approximation in continuous stochastic control. At the same time, we do not claim a full convergence theorem for practical sampled Q-learning with exploration, replay, and stochastic gradient updates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了连续时间随机控制中Q-learning的算子核心，分析了Bellman最优性目标在扩散设定下的正则性与逼近复杂度，证明了Bellman更新将有界输入映射到各向异性正则类，并提出了适配混合正则性的张量积DeepONet架构，给出了显式逼近与资源界以及时间步长趋近于零时的刚度-复杂度权衡。
AI.motivation: 在基于值的强化学习中，Q-learning或DQN更新基于Bellman最优性目标，但连续状态-动作空间的连续时间随机控制场景下，该目标的正则性和逼近复杂度尚缺乏系统的算子理论分析。
AI.method: 在均匀椭圆性和Hölder正则系数假设下，分析Bellman更新算子的映射性质；证明其将有界输入映射到各向异性正则类（状态变量光滑、动作变量仅Lipschitz依赖）；基于此混合正则性设计张量积DeepONet架构；推导逼近误差和计算资源边界，分析时间步长趋零时的刚度-复杂度权衡。
AI.result: Bellman更新保持有界输入并提升其正则性，形成紧的迭代族；所提张量积DeepONet能有效适配混合正则性；给出了显式逼近界和资源复杂度；揭示了时间步长趋零时刚度与计算复杂度的权衡关系。
AI.conclusion: 该理论在Bellman目标正则性和逼近层面为连续时间随机控制中的Q-learning做出了直接贡献，但未涵盖实际采样Q-learning（含探索、回放和随机梯度更新）的完整收敛性定理。

title: HawkesNest: A Multi-Axis Synthetic Benchmark for Spatiotemporal Pattern Complexity
summary: Evaluation of spatiotemporal point process (STPP) models relies heavily on opaque real-world datasets, where latent generative structure is unknown and model failures are difficult to attribute. We introduce HawkesNest, a generator-aligned benchmark for controlled spatiotemporal pattern complexity built on a multivariate Hawkes backbone. HawkesNest defines four complexity axes: space--time entanglement, background heterogeneity, cross-type interaction, and domain topology. Each axis is associated with a deterministic index computed from the latent data-generating mechanism. By varying these axes while holding global rate, stability, and simulation budget fixed, HawkesNest enables diagnostic stress tests of STPP models under known structural difficulty. We verify that the indices are monotone and nearly orthogonal under controlled sweeps. We illustrate its use by showing that Hawkes-family baselines degrade under joint heterogeneity--entanglement complexity, even though they are structurally aligned with the Hawkes data-generating backbone. We further show that HawkesNest exposes neural-model sensitivity: AutoSTPP remains vulnerable under isolated increases in space--time entanglement. Code. Available at https://github.com/YahyaAalaila/HawkesNest

AI.tldr: HawkesNest是一个基于多元Hawkes过程的生成器对齐基准，用于可控地评估时空点过程模型，通过四个复杂度轴（时空纠缠、背景异质性、交叉类型交互、域拓扑）和对应的确定性指标，实现对STPP模型的诊断性压力测试。
AI.motivation: 现有的时空点过程模型评估依赖于不透明的真实数据集，其潜在生成结构未知，难以归因模型失败原因，缺乏可控的基准来系统诊断模型在不同复杂度维度下的表现。
AI.method: 基于多元Hawkes过程构建生成器对齐基准，定义四个复杂度轴（时空纠缠、背景异质性、交叉类型交互、域拓扑），每个轴对应一个从潜在数据生成机制计算的确定性指标；在固定全局速率、稳定性和模拟预算的条件下变化各轴指标，实现可控的复杂度扫描。
AI.result: 验证了指标在受控扫描下具有单调性和近似正交性；Hawkes系列基线在联合异质性-纠缠复杂度下性能下降，即便其结构与Hawkes生成器对齐；AutoSTPP等神经模型对孤立增加的时空纠缠维度仍表现出敏感性。
AI.conclusion: HawkesNest提供了一种系统可控的基准测试框架，能够有效揭示不同STPP模型在已知结构难度下的脆弱性，为模型诊断和比较提供了标准化工具。

title: Integrated Marketing Attribution: A Bayesian Framework for Privacy-Safe Granular Measurement Anchored in MMM
summary: Retail marketing measurement increasingly requires granular campaign-level insights without relying on user-level tracking. However, the two dominant approaches, Marketing Mix Modeling (MMM) and Multi-Touch Attribution (MTA), often produce fragmented insights. MMM is privacy-safe and robust for channel-level planning but is too coarse for campaign optimization, while MTA provides granular attribution but has become less reliable under increasing privacy restrictions. We propose Integrated Marketing Attribution (IMA), a unified framework that combines MMM with channel specific Bayesian attribution models to derive campaign-level effects from aggregated data. By leveraging MMM-informed priors, IMA delivers granular, privacy-safe attribution while preserving consistency with MMM.

AI.tldr: 提出集成营销归因（IMA）框架，通过结合营销组合模型（MMM）与贝叶斯归因模型，在隐私保护前提下实现细粒度、与MMM一致的战役级归因分析。
AI.motivation: 现有零售营销测量方法MMM（粗粒度、适合渠道规划）与MTA（细粒度但隐私受限）存在碎片化问题，缺乏既能保护隐私又能提供战役级细粒度洞察的统一方法。
AI.method: 提出IMA统一框架，将MMM与渠道特定贝叶斯归因模型相结合，利用MMM信息先验从聚合数据中推导战役级效果，实现隐私安全且与MMM一致的细粒度归因。
AI.result: IMA能够在隐私约束下提供细粒度战役级归因，同时保持与MMM结果的一致性，克服了MMM颗粒度不足和MTA隐私受限的双重缺陷。
AI.conclusion: IMA为零售营销测量提供了一种折中解决方案，在不依赖用户级追踪的前提下实现了战役级优化所需的细粒度洞察，并保持了与高层级MMM规划的统计一致性。

title: Upper Bounds on the Generalization Error of Deep Learning Models via Local Robustness and Stability
summary: Generalization is a critical property of data-driven models, particularly deep learning models deployed in safety-critical applications. Robustness-based generalization bounds have gained attention as a principled way to link robustness properties to generalization performance, often in a data-dependent manner. However, most existing bounds suffer from vacuousness in practical settings, yielding loose upper bounds that greatly exceed the actual error rates and limiting their usefulness for real-world evaluation. While this issue is often attributed to the uncertainty term, a substantial part of the problem originates from the robustness term itself, particularly for the 0-1 loss. Existing approaches typically treat the robustness term as a global measure, ignoring its variation across different sub-regions of the input space. In this work, we propose a generalization bound that addresses this limitation by scaling the robustness term according to the number of stable and unstable samples within each sub-region. Our bounds incorporate both data- and model-dependent factors while maintaining practical relevance (yielding tighter upper bounds on true error). Experiments on models trained on the ImageNet dataset show that our bounds remain consistently non-vacuous and achieve the tightest estimates among existing methods, closely aligning with empirical performance across a range of robust deep neural networks.

AI.tldr: 本文针对现有基于鲁棒性的泛化界限在实际应用中过于宽松的问题，提出了一种通过按输入空间子区域中稳定/不稳定样本数量缩放鲁棒性项的新泛化界限，在ImageNet上实现了非空洞且最紧的误差上界估计。
AI.motivation: 现有基于鲁棒性的泛化界限在实际场景中普遍存在空洞性（宽松上界远高于真实错误率），虽然问题常被归因于不确定性项，但作者指出鲁棒性项本身（特别是针对0-1损失）也是重要原因——现有方法将鲁棒性项作为全局度量，忽略了其在不同输入子区域间的变化。
AI.method: 提出一种新的泛化界限，通过按每个子区域内稳定样本和不稳定样本的数量对鲁棒性项进行缩放，使界限同时包含数据和模型依赖因素，并保持实际相关性（得到更紧的真实误差上界）。
AI.result: 在ImageNet数据集上训练的多种鲁棒深度神经网络上，所提界限始终保持非空洞，并且是现有方法中最紧的估计，与模型的经验性能高度吻合。
AI.conclusion: 通过对鲁棒性项进行子区域级别的精细化缩放，可以有效缓解泛化界限的空洞性问题，获得更紧且实际可用的误差上界。

title: Beyond Weights and Gradients: A Taxonomy of Federated Learning Messages
comment: 4 figures, 9 pages, with 7 pages of content
summary: Federated Learning is rapidly evolving beyond the exchange of traditional model weights and gradients, yet existing definitions fail to capture the full scope of modern payloads like synthetic data and federated analytics. This paper addresses the gap by proposing a formal mathematical definition of a federated message that accounts for both utility and privacy. We introduce a taxonomy that organizes these exchanges into three categories: model structures, statistical summaries, and data-conditioned representations. By evaluating these groups based on computational demands, communication costs, and privacy risks, we provide a clearer understanding of the trade-offs involved in decentralized training. Our review of 202 recent publications highlights a significant shift since 2021 toward diverse messaging paradigms, signaling a move away from standard deep learning updates toward more specialized information sharing. This framework provides a structured path for future research to optimize federated systems for varying hardware and security requirements.

AI.tldr: 本文针对联邦学习中消息定义的不足，提出了一种正式的数学定义，建立了包含模型结构、统计摘要和数据条件表示的三类消息分类法，并评估了各自的计算、通信和隐私权衡。通过对202篇文献的回顾，发现自2021年起联邦学习正从传统权重/梯度交换向更多样化的信息共享范式转变。
AI.motivation: 现有的联邦学习定义无法涵盖现代联邦学习中交换的多种数据载荷（如合成数据、联邦分析结果等），存在定义缺口，需要更全面的形式化框架来统一描述和理解这些交换内容。
AI.method: 提出了联邦消息（federated message）的形式化数学定义，构建了包含三类消息（模型结构、统计摘要、数据条件表示）的分类法，并从计算需求、通信成本和隐私风险三个维度进行评估，最后对202篇近期文献进行了系统综述。
AI.result: 自2021年以来，联邦学习领域出现向多样化消息范式的显著转变，从标准深度学习更新向更专业化的信息共享演进。
AI.conclusion: 该分类框架为优化联邦系统适应不同硬件和安全需求提供了结构化的未来研究方向。

title: Fantastic Pretraining Optimizers and Where to Find Them II: Hyperball Optimization
summary: Matrix based optimizers such as Muon can substantially speed up language model pretraining, but their gains over AdamW are observed to shrink as model size and data scale grow when using standard constant decoupled weight decay. We propose Hyperball, a simple optimizer wrapper that addresses this issue. Given a base optimizer such as Adam or Muon, Hyperball sets the Frobenius norms of weight matrices and their corresponding optimizer updates to fixed constants. On Qwen3 style models up to 1.2B parameters, Muon Hyperball achieves 20--30% token equivalent speedup over weight decay baselines. Hyperball also improves learning rate transfer across widths and depths compared to decoupled weight decay. This method is motivated by prior theory showing that training with weight decay leads to an equilibrium weight norm that only depends on the training hyperparameters. Through this mechanism, the weight decay then decides the angular learning rate, i.e. how fast the direction of the weight matrix changes.

AI.tldr: Hyperball是一种简单的优化器封装方法，通过将权重矩阵及其优化器更新的Frobenius范数固定为常数，解决了Muon等矩阵优化器在大规模模型训练中相对AdamW优势衰减的问题，在Qwen3风格模型上实现了20-30%的token等效加速。
AI.motivation: 基于矩阵的优化器（如Muon）在语言模型预训练中相比AdamW有显著加速效果，但当模型规模和数据量增大时，使用标准常数解耦权重衰减时，其优势会逐渐减弱。作者希望解决这一规模扩展性退化问题。
AI.method: 提出Hyperball优化器封装方法：给定一个基础优化器（如Adam或Muon），将权重矩阵的Frobenius范数及其对应的优化器更新量固定为常数，替代传统的解耦权重衰减策略。
AI.result: 在高达1.2B参数的Qwen3风格模型上，Muon Hyperball相比权重衰减基线实现了20-30%的token等效加速。Hyperball还改善了学习率在不同宽度和深度之间的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: Hyperball通过固定权重的Frobenius范数，避免了权重衰减在训练中通过平衡权重范数来决定角度学习率这一机制带来的问题，从而在更大规模模型上保持了优化器的加速优势，并提升了超参数的迁移性。

title: Factorized Neural Operators Decompose Dynamic and Persistent Responses
summary: Physical systems often exhibit heterogeneous mechanisms, where rapidly evolving dynamics coexist with persistent structures. Capturing such multiscale physical behavior remains challenging for existing neural operators, which typically rely on single dominant inductive bias and therefore couple distinct physical responses into a shared representation. We introduce the Unified Green's Function Framework across domains and propose the Factorized Neural Operators (FaNO), which decompose spectral representations into equivariant dynamic responses and invariant persistent responses, leading to better interpretability and generalization. Mechanistically, we show that the two operator branches spontaneously specialize into distinct physical roles that remain consistent across scales and domains: the equivariant branch captures rapidly varying transient dynamics, whereas the invariant branch extracts coherent persistent structures. This factorized mechanism of FaNO improves prediction accuracy, parameter efficiency and cross-scale generalization across physical systems and domains. In particular, it maintains consistent predictions under long-horizon autoregressive rollout, cross-resolution extrapolation and physical-regime shifts. These findings suggest that scalable physical modeling may benefit from moving beyond single-inductive-bias formulations toward factorized operator representations that better reflect the heterogeneous organization of physical systems, accelerating the reliable deployment of machine learning for scientific computing and discovery.

AI.tldr: 提出因子化神经算子（FaNO），将谱分解为等变动态响应和不变持久响应，分别捕获快速变化瞬态和持久结构，提升多尺度物理系统的预测精度与泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有神经算子依赖单一主导归纳偏置，将不同物理响应耦合到共享表示中，难以捕捉物理系统中快慢动态共存的异质多尺度行为。
AI.method: 提出统一格林函数框架与因子化神经算子（FaNO），将谱表示分解为等变动态响应分支（捕捉快速瞬态）和不变持久响应分支（提取持久结构）。
AI.result: FaNO在预测精度、参数效率、跨尺度泛化方面优于现有方法，在长时自回归滚动、跨分辨率外推和物理 regimes 转移下保持一致性预测。
AI.conclusion: 可扩展物理建模应超越单一归纳偏置，采用反映物理系统异质组织的因子化算子表示，加速机器学习在科学计算与发现中的可靠部署。

title: Demystifying Variance in Circuit Discovery of LLMs
summary:
Circuit discovery is a key technique in mechanistic interpretability to pinpoint the model components that are crucial for performing a given task. Although the current state-of-the-art method (EAP-IG) performs well on the metric of (un)faithfulness, it suffers from substantial variability. This includes resampling variance, where the circuit changes when we probe with a new batch of data from the same distribution; rephrasing variance, where the discovered circuit shifts when the prompts are rephrased; and sample-wise variance, where a circuit with low population unfaithfulness exhibits large fluctuations in unfaithfulness across individual samples.
  This paper studies the roots of these variances. We demonstrate that CEAP, our new circuit discovery method that improves upon EAP-IG with a theoretical guarantee, can substantially lessen resampling variance. We further show that rephrasing variance arises because prompts with different templates tend to activate different circuits in the model. This leads us to argue that it may be challenging to find a comprehensive circuit that explains and controls the model's behavior on a task, which can be expressed in countless templates, suggesting that LLMs may be inherently hard to steer. We show that sparsity, which has been claimed to form more compact and interpretable task circuits, fails to solve this problem. Regarding sample-wise variance, we argue that it is largely benign: extremely poor unfaithfulness scores often stem from how unfaithfulness is defined, rather than from defects in the measured circuits. We show that the magnitude of unfaithfulness is affected by selective contribution scaling, a neural mechanism that accounts for the extremely poor scores sometimes observed.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了电路发现中的方差问题（重采样方差、重述方差和样本方差），提出CEAP方法减轻重采样方差，分析重述方差源于不同模板激活不同电路，并论证样本方差主要源于不忠实度定义缺陷而非电路本身问题。
AI.motivation: 现有电路发现方法EAP-IG虽在不忠实度指标上表现良好，但存在显著的重采样方差、重述方差和样本方差，影响电路发现的可信度和可重复性。本文旨在探究这些方差的根源并提出改进方案。
AI.method: 提出CEAP方法，改进EAP-IG并带有理论保证；通过实验分析不同提示模板对电路的影响；研究选择性贡献缩放机制对不忠实度得分的影响。
AI.result: CEAP能显著减轻重采样方差；重述方差源于不同模板激活不同电路；样本方差中的极端不忠实得分主要源于不忠实度定义问题，受选择性贡献缩放机制影响。
AI.conclusion: 由于不同模板激活不同电路，找到全面解释和控制模型行为的电路具有挑战性，LLM可能本质难以被精确控制；稀疏性无法解决此问题；样本方差中的极端得分主要是不忠实度定义的伪影。

title: A Unified Causal-Origin Taxonomy of Distributional Shifts in Reinforcement Learning
comment: The paper is currently under review at the Journal of Artificial Intelligence Research (JAIR)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) systems often degrade when operating conditions differ from those previously encountered, reflecting distributional shifts in the underlying data-generating process. Such shifts may occur between training and evaluation, as in In-Distribution (ID) and Out-of-Distribution (OOD) generalization, or within non-stationary settings where environment dynamics evolve over time. However, the formal relationship between these views remains unclear, and existing work mainly focuses on mitigation rather than the causal origin of shift within the agent-environment interaction. This work develops a unified causal-origin taxonomy that characterizes sources of distributional shift in RL and relates ID/OOD generalization to non-stationary settings. We transfer the classical dataset-shift principle from supervised learning to RL by reformulating distributional shift in terms of the generative interaction process. Using a Partially Observable Markov Decision Process (POMDP), we decompose the interaction into structural components, including the state distribution, observation process, policy, reward, and transition dynamics, together with the shifted-time boundary. The proposed taxonomy distinguishes internal, agent-driven, and external, environment-driven, distributional shifts. The shifted-time boundary perspective further characterizes explicit, implicit, and hybrid shifts. This formulation unifies ID/OOD generalization and non-stationarity as structured changes in the underlying process. We also introduce an evaluation framework for measuring shift impact and adaptation through performance degradation and recovery metrics. By grounding distributional shift in the causal-origin structure of RL, this work supports systematic analysis of robustness under distributional shift.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种统一的因果起源分类法，将强化学习中的分布偏移（包括ID/OOD泛化和非平稳性）通过POMDP的结构化分解进行统一表征，并引入评估框架用于衡量偏移影响与适应能力。
AI.motivation: 现有研究主要关注缓解策略，而非分布偏移在智能体-环境交互中的因果起源；同时，ID/OOD泛化与非平稳性之间的形式化关系尚不明确。
AI.method: 从监督学习的经典数据集偏移原理出发，将其迁移至RL，利用POMDP对交互过程进行结构分解（状态分布、观测过程、策略、奖励、转移动力学及偏移时间边界），区分内部（智能体驱动）与外部（环境驱动）偏移，并从偏移时间边界视角刻画显式、隐式和混合偏移。
AI.result: 提出统一的因果起源分类法，将ID/OOD泛化与非平稳性统一为底层过程的结构化变化；引入基于性能退化与恢复指标的评估框架。
AI.conclusion: 通过将分布偏移扎根于RL的因果起源结构，为分布偏移下的鲁棒性系统性分析提供了理论支撑。

title: Scalable Circuit Learning for Interpreting Large Language Models
comment: Accepted to the Mechanistic Interpretability Workshop at ICML 2026
summary: A prominent research direction in mechanistic interpretability is learning sparse circuits over LLM components to reveal how they jointly produce model behavior. However, raw neurons are polysemantic, making learned circuits hard to interpret. Sparse autoencoder (SAE) features alleviate this, but their high dimensionality makes existing intervention-based circuit learning methods computationally prohibitive. We propose CircuitLasso, a scalable circuit-learning approach based on sparse linear regression. CircuitLasso recovers circuits whose structural accuracy matches that of state-of-the-art intervention-based methods on the benchmark data, at a fraction of the computational cost. For interpretability, CircuitLasso efficiently uncovers relationships among SAE features, showing how human-interpretable semantic features propagate through the model and influence its predictions. Finally, we validate the utility of our learned circuits by leveraging their insights to achieve comparable performance at substantially lower cost on a domain-generalization task.

AI.tldr: CircuitLasso提出了一种基于稀疏线性回归的可扩展电路学习方法，能够以极低的计算成本恢复与最先进干预方法结构精度相当的电路，并高效揭示SAE特征间的关系，提升可解释性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于干预的电路学习方法在处理高维稀疏自编码器（SAE）特征时计算成本过高，难以扩展；同时原始神经元的多语义性使得学习到的电路难以解释，需要一种兼具可解释性与可扩展性的电路学习方法。
AI.method: 采用稀疏线性回归（Lasso）作为核心方法，通过稀疏回归从SAE特征中学习电路结构，替代传统昂贵的干预式方法。
AI.result: 在基准数据集上，CircuitLasso的结构精度与最先进的基于干预的方法相当，但计算成本大幅降低；此外，能高效揭示SAE特征间的关系，并在域泛化任务中利用电路洞察以更低成本取得可比性能。
AI.conclusion: CircuitLasso为大规模LLM可解释性提供了一种高效且可扩展的电路学习范式，证明了稀疏线性回归在替代昂贵干预方法上的有效性，并展示了所学电路的实用价值。

title: Phantoms and Disclosures: a Causal Framework for Auditing Synthetic Data
summary: The rapid adoption of generative AI and Large Language Models (LLMs) has spurred interest in synthetic data as a privacy-preserving alternative to sensitive real-world datasets. However, generating high-utility synthetic data often carries the risk of memorizing and regurgitating private information from the training corpus. In this work, we present a customizable empirical auditing framework designed to detect and explain such data disclosures. Our framework introduces a mechanism to distinguish between "true disclosures"-where the system directly reproduces a user's information-and "phantom disclosures''-where the system incidentally generates a user's data. By partitioning input data into training and holdout sets and applying rigorous statistical hypothesis testing, we determine if observed disclosures are consistent with strict privacy baselines, such as zero-learning or specific Differential Privacy (DP) bounds. Crucially, this approach requires no model access, no canary insertion, and no reference model training -only the synthetic output and a held-out control set. We demonstrate that this framework effectively functions as a membership inference attack, providing empirical lower bounds on privacy leakage that are tighter than prior data-based auditing methods. Our approach is model-agnostic, applies to any synthetic data generation mechanism, and requires orders of magnitude fewer computational resources than shadow-model or canary-based alternatives.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种无需模型访问、无需插入金丝雀数据或训练参考模型的自定义经验审计框架，通过将输入数据划分为训练集和保留集并进行统计假设检验，来检测和解释生成式AI/LLM合成数据中的真实披露与虚假披露，并可作为成员推断攻击提供更紧致的隐私泄露经验下界。
AI.motivation: 生成式AI和LLM生成的合成数据虽能保护隐私，但存在记忆和复现训练语料中隐私信息的风险。现有审计方法需要模型访问、金丝雀插入或参考模型训练，计算成本高昂且适用性有限。因此需要一种高效、模型无关、无需特权访问的隐私泄露审计框架。
AI.method: 提出一个经验审计框架：(1)将输入数据划分为训练集和保留集；(2)通过统计假设检验判断观测到的披露是否与严格隐私基线（如零学习或特定差分隐私界限）一致；(3)区分真实披露（系统直接复现用户信息）与虚假披露（系统偶然生成用户数据）；(4)仅需合成输出和保留控制集，无需模型访问、金丝雀插入或参考模型训练。
AI.result: 该框架可有效作为成员推断攻击，提供比先前基于数据的审计方法更紧致的隐私泄露经验下界；模型无关且适用于任何合成数据生成机制；计算资源需求比影子模型或金丝雀基线方法低数个数量级。
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种实用、高效且可定制的隐私泄露审计框架，能在不依赖特殊模型访问权限的情况下检测合成数据生成中的隐私泄露，为实际部署中的隐私保障提供更严格的经验验证手段。

title: Beyond the Smile: A Hybrid Convolutional VAE for Crypto Volatility Surfaces
summary: We present a convolutional variational autoencoder for cryptocurrency implied-volatility surfaces, together with a deployable predictor that combines it with a quadratic smile re-fit through a deterministic per-tenor routing rule. Trained on 6,034 fully-filled hourly Binance Options surfaces of BTC and ETH spanning May-October 2023 and parameterised on a common $6 \times 7$ tenor-delta grid, the model attains a hidden-cell surface-completion RMSE in the 0.94-1.56 vol-point range across both markets and mask rates 10-50%. The hybrid predictor attains 0.83 vol points at 50% masking against 7.00 for the smile re-fit alone, an eightfold reduction obtained at no additional inference cost. Under structurally-correlated hole patterns that emulate the withdrawal of an entire tenor of strikes, the smile re-fit incurs 9.6-13.1 vol points of error while the learned model remains at 1.5-1.9, isolating a regime in which the generative model is the only viable predictor. Joint training on BTC and ETH improves the in-distribution model on both markets by 9-27% relative to the better-performing single-symbol counterpart, indicating a substantially shared vol-surface manifold across the two largest cryptocurrencies over the observation window. The hybrid is calendar- and butterfly-arbitrage-free at the listed strikes, a property that the parametric smile re-fit alone fails at high mask rates. The per-snapshot reconstruction error of the trained model flags the late-October ETF-anticipation rally and the August $17$, $2023$ flash crash as elevated-error periods without supervision. All training and evaluation infrastructure is released to support reproducible follow-on work.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种卷积变分自编码器用于加密货币隐含波动率曲面的建模，并结合二次微笑重新拟合与确定性期限路由规则形成混合预测器。在BTC和ETH期权数据上，混合模型在50%掩码率下将预测误差从7.00 vol点降至0.83，且无额外推理成本。当结构相关孔洞模式模拟整个期限的罢工价撤销时，微笑重新拟合误差高达9.6-13.1 vol点，而生成模型仅1.5-1.9。联合训练提升性能9-27%，混合模型在列出的罢工价上无日历和蝶式套利。
AI.motivation: 加密货币期权市场数据稀疏且存在大量缺失值（孔洞），传统参数化微笑拟合方法在高掩码率下表现差，亟需一种能够有效完成曲面补全且保持无套利约束的生成模型。
AI.method: 提出卷积变分自编码器（CVAE）学习波动率曲面的隐空间表示，结合二次微笑重新拟合（parametric smile re-fit）与确定性期限路由规则形成混合预测器。采用6×7期限-德尔塔网格参数化，在BTC和ETH共6034个全填充小时级曲面上训练，支持联合训练与单符号训练对比。
AI.result: 混合预测器在50%掩码率下RMSE 0.83 vol点（微笑重新拟合单独为7.00）；结构相关孔洞模式下生成模型误差1.5-1.9 vs 微笑重新拟合9.6-13.1；联合训练提升9-27%；混合模型在列出的罢工价上无套利；模型重建误差可识别市场异常事件（如ETF行情和闪崩）。
AI.conclusion: 生成式CVAE在极端缺失数据场景下是唯一可行的预测器，混合架构在保持无套利约束的同时实现显著误差降低，且加密货币波动率曲面在BTC和ETH间存在共享流形，支持跨市场迁移学习。

title: Scalable Pairwise Kernel Learning with Stochastic Vec Trick
summary: Pairwise learning is a specialized form of supervised learning that focuses on predicting outcomes for pairs of objects. In this work, we introduce SPaiK, a new scalable kernel learning method tailored for pairwise settings. Our approach preserves the expressive power of kernel methods while substantially reducing computational and memory requirements. The key innovation is the stochastic generalized vec trick (sGVT), a stochastic extension of the sparse Kronecker product multiplication algorithm, which enables efficient large-scale training with pairwise kernels. By incorporating sGVT, SPaiK makes it possible to apply kernel-based pairwise learning to datasets of a size previously out of reach. We evaluate the performance of SPaiK on seven real-world drug-target affinity datasets and compare the results with state-of-the-art methods in pairwise learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出SPaiK，一种基于随机广义vec技巧（sGVT）的可扩展核学习方法，用于高效处理大规模成对学习问题，并在七个药物-靶标亲和力数据集上验证了其优越性能。
AI.motivation: 成对学习在药物-靶标亲和力预测等领域有重要应用，但传统核方法在大规模数据上计算和内存开销巨大，限制了其实用性。
AI.method: 提出SPaiK方法，核心创新是随机广义vec技巧（sGVT），它是稀疏Kronecker积乘法的随机扩展，能够高效实现成对核的大规模训练。
AI.result: 在七个真实的药物-靶标亲和力数据集上评估，与当前最先进方法进行了比较，SPaiK在保持核方法表达能力的同时，显著降低了计算和内存需求，使核方法能够应用于以前无法企及的大规模数据集。
AI.conclusion: SPaiK通过sGVT技术有效解决了成对学习中核方法可扩展性不足的问题，为大规模成对学习场景提供了实用的解决方案。

title: Analytic Torsion and Spectral Gap Capture Persistent-Laplacian Performance
summary: While persistent Laplacians (PL) offer a richer geometric representation of data than persistent homology, utilizing their full eigenspectrum for learning tasks is often hampered by high dimensionality and the ``varying length'' problem across different filtration scales. We propose a compact spectral representation that distills the persistent Laplacian into three mathematically grounded invariants: Betti numbers, the spectral gap, and analytic torsion. Across benchmark datasets including MNIST, QM-3D, and SKEMPI WT, we demonstrate that this reduced feature space captures the essential predictive signal of the full spectrum, and in some cases outperforms it, while significantly reducing computational overhead and preventing the noise introduced by higher-frequency eigenvalues. Our results suggest that these invariants provide a principled, fixed-length interface between spectral geometry and topological learning.

AI.tldr: 针对持久拉普拉斯算子高维度和跨尺度特征长度不一致问题，提出由贝蒂数、谱间隙和分析挠率三种数学不变量构成的紧凑谱表示，在多个基准数据集上证明其能以更低计算开销捕获甚至超越全谱的预测性能。
AI.motivation: 持久拉普拉斯算子虽比持久同调提供更丰富的几何表示，但其完整特征谱存在高维度和不同过滤尺度下特征向量长度不一致（"varying length"问题），阻碍了其在学习任务中的应用。
AI.method: 将持久拉普拉斯算子蒸馏为三种数学不变量：贝蒂数（Betti numbers）、谱间隙（spectral gap）和分析挠率（analytic torsion），构成固定长度的紧凑谱表示。
AI.result: 在MNIST、QM-3D和SKEMPI WT基准数据集上，该降维特征空间能够捕获全谱的核心预测信号，部分情况下甚至超越全谱性能，同时显著降低计算开销并避免高频特征值引入的噪声。
AI.conclusion: 这些不变量为谱几何与拓扑学习之间提供了原则性的、固定长度的接口。

title: From Tokens to Policy: Causal and Interpretable Heterogeneous Treatment Effects Identification
summary: Heterogeneous Treatment Effect (HTE) identification is crucial to explain the impact of an intervention and optimize our policies accordingly. Existing approaches trade expressivity for interpretability, but, if some active heterogeneity drivers are unmeasured, methods at both ends of this spectrum allow for spurious HTE characterization with no causal reading. In this work, we focus on controlled experiments and argue that an oracle HTE causal characterization via the latent interactors is now within reach, thanks to (i) more extensive pre-treatment measurements, i.e., multi-modal and multi-view, and (ii) scalable representations with minimal human supervision. We then re-frame HTE identification as a Markov-blanket discovery problem on a sufficient and aligned pre-treatment representation, and introduce Neural EXposure Interaction Search (NEXIS), an iterative procedure with provable and empirically validated consistent selection. We deploy NEXIS on two anti-poverty programs in Africa, augmenting each with satellite imagery capturing previously unmeasured environmental effect modifiers, leading to novel, interpretable and prescriptive guidelines to optimize the programs' next iterations.

AI.tldr: 本文提出NEXIS方法，通过在预处理阶段利用多模态多视角数据（如卫星图像）学习充足且对齐的表征，将异质性处理效应（HTE）识别重构为马尔可夫毯发现问题，从而获得具有因果可解释性的潜在交互作用因子，并在两个非洲反贫困项目中验证了其有效性。
AI.motivation: 现有HTE识别方法在表达力与可解释性之间权衡，当某些活跃的异质性驱动因素未被测量时，无论方法处于该光谱的哪一端，都可能产生虚假的HTE表征，缺乏因果解释力。
AI.method: 将HTE识别重新定义为在充足且对齐的预处理表征上的马尔可夫毯发现问题，提出NEXIS（Neural Exposure Interaction Search）迭代算法，具有可证明且经实证验证的一致性选择特性。
AI.result: 在两个非洲反贫困项目中部署NEXIS，通过引入卫星图像作为环境效应修正因子，发现了新颖、可解释且可指导政策优化的异质性处理效应。
AI.conclusion: 借助更广泛的预处理多模态测量和可扩展的少监督表征学习，通过潜在交互因子实现具有因果解释力的HTE识别是可行的，并能产出可操作的优化政策指南。

title: Filtered Conformal Ellipsoids for Graph-Native Time Series
summary: Joint prediction sets for multivariate time series should control a single event while adapting to cross-coordinate dependence. We study filtered conformal ellipsoids: a frozen state-space filter emits a one-step predictive mean and covariance, and split-conformal calibration is applied to the resulting Mahalanobis scores. The filter is used to choose the ellipsoid shape; conformal calibration chooses the scalar radius, so the construction benefits from a learned predictive covariance without relying on Gaussian tail probabilities for coverage. The main difficulty is that filtered scores are dependent and learned recurrent filters need not contract in their raw hidden state; we therefore analyse contraction in an observable predictive-law quotient that identifies hidden states producing the same future sequence of emitted Gaussian laws. Under a stable Bayes Gaussian-projection filter, covariance bounds, and a finite-horizon observability Fisher condition, small excess Gaussian negative log-likelihood implies contraction of the learned emitted laws. Combined with a threshold-autocovariance envelope this yields a Chebyshev-type approximate coverage bound for filtered split-conformal prediction under dependence; a sharper Bernstein-type bound requires an additional geometric-mixing concentration assumption. Under Gaussian oracle realisability we also obtain a near-oracle log-volume comparison within the class of conditionally valid Gaussian ellipsoid rules. We instantiate the framework with a GCN-GRU filter with diagonal-plus-low-rank covariance. On moderate-size graph-native traffic benchmarks (METRLA-$20$ and PEMSBAY-$50$), the learned filter gives sharper at-target ellipsoids than static-covariance and non-filter baselines; at full-graph scale and on non-graph-native datasets, factor and copula baselines can be stronger.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于过滤共形椭球的多变量时间序列联合预测集方法，通过状态空间滤波器输出一步预测均值和协方差，再对马氏距离分数进行分割共形校准，在控制覆盖概率的同时适应跨坐标依赖。理论分析了滤波后分数的依赖性和收缩性，并在交通数据集上验证了方法的有效性。
AI.motivation: 多变量时间序列的联合预测集需要控制单一事件（即整体覆盖概率），同时适应跨坐标的依赖结构。现有方法往往假设高斯尾部概率或忽略序列依赖性，难以在非高斯、依赖性强的情况下保证有效覆盖。
AI.method: 使用冻结状态空间滤波器输出一步预测均值和协方差，计算马氏距离作为非符合性分数，再通过分割共形校准确定椭球半径。理论分析依赖于可观测预测律商（observable predictive-law quotient）来识别产生相同未来高斯律的隐藏状态，并在稳定贝叶斯高斯投影滤波器、协方差有界性和有限时域可观测性Fisher条件下，证明小超额高斯负对数似然意味着学习到的发射律的收缩性。结合阈值自协方差包络，在依赖条件下给出Chebyshev型近似覆盖界；在几何混合浓度假设下给出更尖锐的Bernstein型界。在高斯预言机可实现性下，获得条件有效高斯椭球规则类内的近预言机对数体积比较。实例化使用GCN-GRU滤波器配合对角加低秩协方差。
AI.result: 在METRLA-20和PEMSBAY-50中等规模图原生交通基准上，学习到的滤波器给出的目标椭球比静态协方差和非滤波基线更紧凑。但在全图规模和非图原生数据集上，因子和copula基线可能更强。
AI.conclusion: 过滤共形椭球能够有效结合预测协方差信息与共形校准的分布自由覆盖保证，在中等规模图原生数据上表现优越，但在大规模或非图原生场景下仍有改进空间。

title: ExpRL: Exploratory RL for LLM Mid-Training
summary: Sparse reward reinforcement learning (RL) has become a standard tool for improving LLM reasoning, but its success depends critically on the coverage present in the base model. In practice, models are often primed for RL through \emph{mid-training} on curated reasoning traces that teach useful primitive skills such as decomposition, verification, or self-correction. Although effective, this strategy requires manually specifying what the model should learn, and it remains unclear whether such primitive coverage is enough for much harder problems, which require combining these skills into broader solution strategies. We study a more automated approach: \emph{RL-based mid-training} using large corpora of human-written question-answer data. Rather than treating reference solutions as targets to imitate, our method, ExpRL, uses them as \emph{reward scaffolds}: references are hidden from the policy and used only to construct problem-specific grading rubrics for judging on-policy reasoning traces. The policy samples from the original problem prompt, while an LLM judge compares the sampled reasoning trace against the reference solution and assigns outcome-level or process-level dense rewards. This lets ExpRL reinforce partial progress, useful intermediate reductions, and productive reasoning behaviors that sparse final-answer rewards often fail to upweight. On challenging math reasoning tasks, ExpRL yields stronger RL priming than SFT, sparse-reward GRPO, and self-distillation, and provides a better initialization for subsequent sparse-reward RL. Additional mixed-domain experiments further suggest that ExpRL can extend beyond the original math-only setting.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ExpRL方法，利用人类编写的问答数据作为奖励支架（reward scaffolds），通过RL-based mid-training自动增强LLM推理能力，在数学推理任务上优于SFT、稀疏奖励GRPO和自蒸馏方法。
AI.motivation: 传统稀疏奖励RL的成功依赖于基模型的覆盖率，而人工指定模型应学习哪些原始技能（如分解、验证、自我纠错）的策略效率低下，且不清楚这些原始技能是否足以解决需要组合多种技能的更难问题。
AI.method: ExpRL使用人类编写的问答数据作为奖励支架，隐藏参考解并仅用于构建问题特定的评分标准，让LLM评判器将模型采样的推理轨迹与参考解进行比较，分配结果级或过程级密集奖励，以强化部分进展、有用的中间简化和生产性推理行为。
AI.result: 在具有挑战性的数学推理任务上，ExpRL在RL预训练方面优于SFT、稀疏奖励GRPO和自蒸馏，并为后续稀疏奖励RL提供更好的初始化；混合领域实验表明ExpRL可扩展到数学以外的领域。
AI.conclusion: ExpRL通过自动化RL-based mid-training，利用参考解作为奖励支架而非模仿目标，有效强化了稀疏奖励难以捕捉的中间推理行为，是一种更强的RL预训练策略。

title: HAMON: Passive Optical Sequence Mixing for Long-Horizon Forecasting
summary:
Simple linear and frequency-domain models remain surprisingly competitive in long-horizon time-series forecasting, and recent mechanistic evidence suggests that standard forecasting benchmarks may not require the dense superposed representations that make transformers powerful in other domains. This raises a substrate-level question: if the core forecasting operator is often low-complexity and approximately linear, does it need to be implemented as learned digital temporal mixing? We introduce HAMON, a passive diffractive optical forecasting core in which historical values are encoded onto an optical aperture, future positions are left dark, and cascaded trainable phase masks with free-space diffraction shape the forecast directly in the output field. At inference, prediction is performed by a single passive optical propagation pass with no trainable digital sequence-mixing layer.
  Across standard benchmarks, HAMON outperforms the strongest digital baselines considered on ETTm2 at all horizons and on ETTh2 at all but the longest horizon, improving MSE by up to 14\% and doing so consistently across horizons rather than at isolated points. It is competitive on Weather and trails the strongest baselines on the remaining ETT settings and on the high-channel-count Traffic and Electricity datasets. Phase encoding, intensity-compatible readout, and phase-scrambling ablations, together with a TorchOptics cross-simulator check, indicate that the forecasts arise from the data-bearing optical field rather than from a digital forecasting head. Because the passive core uses standard Fourier optics, HAMON defines a concrete target for optical hardware and for passive physical sequence mixing.

AI.tldr: HAMON是一种被动衍射光学预测核心，通过将历史值编码到光学孔径上，利用级联可训练相位掩模和自由空间衍射直接在输出场中形成预测，在多个标准基准上优于或匹敌最强的数字基线模型。
AI.motivation: 长时域时间序列预测的核心算子往往是低复杂度且近似线性的，现有研究质疑是否需要通过学习的数字时序混合层来实现这一算子，因此探索能否用被动光学硬件实现。
AI.method: 将历史值编码到光学孔径上，未来位置保持暗态，通过级联可训练相位掩模与自由空间衍射，在单次被动光学传播过程中直接在输出场形成预测，无需可训练的数字序列混合层。
AI.result: 在ETTm2所有预测长度和ETTh2除最长外所有长度上优于最强数字基线，MSE最高降低14%；在Weather上具有竞争力；在Traffic和Electricity等高通道数数据集上略逊于最强基线。消融实验和交叉模拟验证预测来自光学场而非数字预测头。
AI.conclusion: HAMON定义了被动光学硬件和物理序列混合的具体目标，证明了低复杂度的时序预测可以通过被动光学传播高效实现。

title: Your Privacy My Cloak: Backdoor Attacks on Differentially Private Federated Learning
summary: Prior research suggests that differential privacy (DP) inherently enhances the robustness of federated learning (FL) against backdoor attacks. In this paper, we challenge this assumption. Through an empirical analysis of two baseline attack strategies, we uncover a fundamental tension in DP-FL: while bypassing DP allows state-of-the-art defenses to detect and filter malicious updates, complying with DP inadvertently masks their distinguishing statistical characteristics. Consequently, existing defenses become ineffective as DP reduces the raw backdoor signal. Building on this masking effect, we propose RING, a novel attack that explicitly exploits DP to conceal malicious contributions while maximizing attack impact. By collaboratively crafting adversarial perturbations, compromised clients reconstruct a strong backdoor signal during aggregation without triggering anomaly detection. RING operates as a perturbation layer that is agnostic to the underlying backdoor technique, making it broadly applicable and composable with existing attacks -- a property that significantly amplifies the threat it poses to DP-FL. Extensive evaluations across four image and text datasets under non-iid distributions show that RING achieves an average attack success rate of 90.3% against six state-of-the-art defenses under a moderate privacy budget, an improvement of up to 26.08x over baseline strategies. Finally, we evaluate potential countermeasures and find that mitigating this threat incurs significant utility trade-offs, exposing a fundamental security gap in the deployment of differentially private FL.

AI.tldr: 本文挑战了"差分隐私（DP）天然增强联邦学习（FL）对后门攻击鲁棒性"这一假设，发现DP会掩盖恶意更新的统计特征，使现有防御失效。基于此掩蔽效应，提出RING攻击——利用DP隐藏恶意贡献同时最大化攻击影响，在中等隐私预算下对六种先进防御达到90.3%的平均攻击成功率，比基线策略提升高达26.08倍。
AI.motivation: 挑战"DP天然增强FL对后门攻击鲁棒性"的主流假设，揭示DP-FL中存在的根本性张力：绕过DP可被检测，遵守DP则掩盖恶意信号导致防御失效。
AI.method: 提出RING攻击，通过协作构建对抗性扰动，在聚合过程中重构强后门信号而不触发异常检测。RING作为与底层后门技术无关的扰动层，可组合现有攻击。
AI.result: 在四个图像和文本数据集、非独立同分布设置下，RING在中等隐私预算下对六种先进防御达到90.3%平均攻击成功率，较基线策略提升高达26.08倍。
AI.conclusion: DP在FL中并非天然防御后门攻击，反而可能被攻击者利用掩蔽恶意信号；缓解该威胁需付出显著的效用权衡，暴露了DP-FL部署中的根本性安全鸿沟。

title: Exact Posterior Score Estimation for Solving Linear Inverse Problems
summary: Diffusion and flow-based models learn powerful data priors by training a denoiser to reverse Gaussian corruption. To use this prior to solve a linear inverse problem, one needs to sample from the posterior, but the score that the prior provides is the unconditional score, not the posterior score. Existing methods either steer a fixed pretrained denoiser with approximate measurement-matching corrections, or train a conditional restoration model that abandons the denoising structure of the prior. We derive the exact posterior score in closed form for linear Gaussian inverse problems under general Gaussian interpolants, and show that posterior sampling reduces to a denoising problem at an operator-dependent shifted pivot under an anisotropic noise covariance. We turn this identity into Exact Posterior Score (EPS), a denoising training objective that preserves the input/output structure of standard pretraining and can therefore be trained from scratch or fine-tuned from a pretrained denoiser. At inference, EPS uses the same sampler as the underlying backbone, with no likelihood gradients or projections. We evaluate EPS on five linear inverse problems across FFHQ and ImageNet, where it outperforms training-free and training-based baselines on fidelity, perceptual, and distributional metrics, while using roughly an order of magnitude fewer denoiser evaluations than gradient-based posterior samplers.

AI.tldr: 本文提出EPS方法，通过推导线性高斯逆问题下的精确后验得分，将后验采样转化为特定偏移量下的去噪问题，该方法可从头训练或从预训练去噪器微调，在FFHQ和ImageNet上五项逆问题中优于现有基线，且去噪器调用次数比基于梯度的后验采样器少一个数量级。
AI.motivation: 扩散/流模型训练得到的是无条件先验的无条件得分，而要解决线性逆问题需要从后验分布采样。现有方法要么对固定预训练去噪器施加近似测量匹配校正，要么训练条件恢复模型但放弃去噪结构。作者希望推导出精确的闭式后验得分，从而在保持去噪结构的同时实现精确后验采样。
AI.method: 推导了线性高斯逆问题在一般高斯插值下的精确后验得分闭式解，指出后验采样可转化为在算子依赖的偏移量下、各向异性噪声协方差下的去噪问题。基于此提出Exact Posterior Score (EPS)训练目标，保持标准预训练的输入/输出结构，可从零训练或从预训练去噪器微调。推理时使用与骨干网络相同的采样器，无需似然梯度或投影。
AI.result: 在FFHQ和ImageNet上的五项线性逆问题（如超分辨率、去模糊、修复等）中，EPS在保真度、感知质量和分布度量上均优于训练无关和训练基线，且去噪器评估次数比基于梯度的后验采样器少约一个数量级。
AI.conclusion: EPS推导了精确后验得分的闭式解，将其简化为特定偏移下的去噪问题，训练目标兼容标准预训练，推理高效且无需额外似然校正，在多项逆问题中取得了最佳结果。
